1 Clinical Judgment and the Next Generation NCLEX (NGN)-RN Examination臨床判斷與新世代 NCLEX（NGN）-RN 考試

This chapter explains how the NCLEX-RN is built and delivered: a variable-length computer adaptive test based on the NCSBN test plan, with Client Needs categories, integrated processes and the Clinical Judgment Measurement Model. It also covers question formats, NGN item types and scoring, registration and test-day rules.本章說明 NCLEX-RN 的設計與施測方式：依 NCSBN 測驗藍圖進行的變動長度電腦適性測驗，包含病人需求類別、整合性過程及臨床判斷測量模式。另介紹題型、NGN 題型與計分、報名與考試當日規定。

Clinical judgment and the NCJMM臨床判斷與 NCJMM

  • Clinical judgment is the observable result of critical thinking and decision making; the NGN demands higher-level application of it.臨床判斷是批判性思考與決策的可觀察結果；NGN 要求更高層次的應用。
  • NCJMM has six cognitive skills: recognize cues, analyze cues, prioritize hypotheses, generate solutions, take action, evaluate outcomes.NCJMM 含六項認知技能：辨識線索、分析線索、排定假設優先順序、產生解決方案、採取行動、評值結果。
  • They parallel the nursing process: assessment, analysis, planning, implementation, evaluation.這些技能對應護理過程：評估、分析、計畫、執行、評值。
  • The exam contains traditional stand-alone items, clinical-judgment stand-alone items (bow-tie, trend) and unfolding case studies; NGN began April 2023.考試包含傳統單題、臨床判斷單題（蝴蝶結、趨勢）與漸進式個案；NGN 自 2023 年 4 月實施。
  • Check ncsbn.org regularly because item types and the test plan may change.項目類型與藍圖可能調整，請定期查閱 ncsbn.org。
PDF p.21

Computer adaptive testing (CAT) and test plan development電腦適性測驗（CAT）與藍圖制定

  • The exam is a variable-length CAT: each item is chosen to match your ability while meeting test-plan percentages; once requirements are met a stopping rule gives a reliable pass/fail decision.本考試為變動長度 CAT：每題依能力與藍圖比例選出，達到要求後依停止規則做出可靠的通過/不通過判定。
  • You cannot skip questions or go back to change answers; there is no penalty for guessing, so make an educated guess.不能跳題或回頭改答案；猜題不扣分，應做有根據的猜測。
  • No computer experience is needed; an NCSBN online tutorial covers the mouse, on-screen calculator and each question type.不需電腦經驗；NCSBN 線上教學涵蓋滑鼠、螢幕計算機與各題型操作。
  • The test plan comes from NCSBN, state laws and a practice analysis study done every 3 years with newly licensed RNs.測驗藍圖來自 NCSBN、各州法規及每 3 年對新進 RN 進行的執業分析研究。
  • Items are written from nursing activities, not from content areas such as pediatrics or maternity.題目依護理活動撰寫，而非兒科、產科等內容領域。
PDF p.22

Test plan: cognitive level and Client Needs測驗藍圖：認知層次與病人需求

  • Questions are at the applying level or higher (applying, analyzing, evaluating, creating); no simple remembering or understanding items.題目為應用層次以上（應用、分析、評價、創造），沒有單純記憶或理解題。
  • Four Client Needs: Safe and Effective Care Environment, Health Promotion and Maintenance, Psychosocial Integrity, Physiological Integrity.四大病人需求：安全有效的照護環境、健康促進與維護、心理社會整合、生理完整性。
  • Percentages: Management of Care 17-23; Safety and Infection Control 9-15; Health Promotion 6-12; Psychosocial 6-12; Basic Care and Comfort 6-12; Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies 12-18; Reduction of Risk Potential 9-15; Physiological Adaptation 11-17.比例：照護管理 17-23；安全與感染控制 9-15；健康促進 6-12；心理社會 6-12；基本照護與舒適 6-12；藥物與腸道外治療 12-18；降低風險 9-15；生理適應 11-17。
  • Integrated processes: Caring, Communication and Documentation, Nursing Process, Culture and Spirituality, Teaching and Learning.整合性過程：關懷、溝通與文件記錄、護理過程、文化與靈性、教學與學習。
PDF p.23, 24, 25

Question types and NGN item types題型與 NGN 題型

  • Current formats: multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank (type a number; round at the end), multiple response/SATA, ordered response, hot spot, chart/exhibit, graphic options, audio.現有題型：選擇題、填空（輸入數字，最後才四捨五入）、多重選擇/SATA、排序題、熱點圖、圖表/檔案題、圖片選項、聽診音檔題。
  • Traditional types are scored 0 or 1 (dichotomous, no partial credit).傳統題型計分為 0 或 1（無部分給分）。
  • NGN: each candidate gets 3 unfolding case studies with 6 items each (all six cognitive skills tested), given within the first 85 items; bow-tie and trend stand-alone items may follow.NGN：每位考生會有 3 個漸進式個案、每個 6 題（涵蓋六項認知技能），出現在前 85 題內；之後可能出現蝴蝶結與趨勢單題。
  • NGN item types include highlight in text/table, matrix choice/response, multiple response select N or SATA, grouping, drag-and-drop and drop-down cloze/rationale/in table.NGN 題型包含文字/表格標示、矩陣選擇/回應、選 N 項或 SATA、分組、拖放與下拉式填空/理由/表格。
  • NGN scoring: plus-minus (+/-) for select-any-number items, 0/1 for items like cloze and bow-tie, and rationale scoring for paired answers; most NGN items give partial credit.NGN 計分：任意選擇題用加減分（負分以 0 計）；填空、蝴蝶結等用 0/1；成對答案用理由計分；多數 NGN 題可部分給分。
PDF p.25, 26, 27, 28, 30

Registration and scheduling報名與預約

  • Obtain the Candidate Bulletin; apply to the state board of nursing where you want licensure, then register and pay fees.取得考生手冊；向欲取得執照之州護理委員會申請，並完成報名與繳費。
  • You need an Authorization to Test (ATT) before scheduling; note its validity dates; you may test in a different state from the licensing state.須先取得考試授權書（ATT）才能預約；注意有效期限；可在非執照申請州應試。
  • Change or cancel with proper notice; a no-show forfeits the fee and invalidates the ATT.改期或取消須依規定提前通知；缺考將沒收費用且 ATT 失效。
  • Request testing accommodations from the board of nursing before registering.如需考試調整措施，須在報名前向護理委員會申請。
PDF p.28, 29, 32

Test day and testing center考試當日與考場

  • Arrive at least 30 minutes early; bring the ATT and valid photo ID with signature whose names match the ATT.至少提前 30 分鐘到場；攜帶 ATT 及有效、附相片與簽名且姓名相符的證件。
  • Fingerprint, palm vein scan, photo and signature are taken; belongings go in a locker; no food, drink or tobacco in the room.會採集指紋、掌靜脈、照片與簽名；個人物品置於置物櫃；考場內不可飲食或吸菸。
  • Raise your hand for computer problems, a clean note board or a break; breaks are optional but count toward time.電腦問題、需更換白板或休息時請舉手；休息為自由選擇但計入時間。
PDF p.31, 32

Test design, results and licensure考試設計、成績與執照

  • Length 85-150 items (70-135 scored), 15 unscored pretest items, 3 unfolding cases (18 items), time limit 5 hours including tutorial and breaks.題數 85-150 題（計分 70-135 題）、15 題不計分預試題、3 個漸進式個案（18 題）、時限 5 小時（含教學與休息）。
  • Pass/fail is not a percentage of correct answers; it depends on item difficulty and test-plan area.通過與否並非答對百分比，而取決於題目難度與藍圖領域。
  • Results are scored twice and go to the board of nursing (about 6 weeks); some states offer paid Quick Results after 2 business days.成績會評分兩次並送交護理委員會（約 6 週）；部分州提供付費快速查詢（2 個工作天後）。
  • Failing candidates receive a performance report; wait 45 days (state rules vary) before retaking.未通過者會收到表現報告；重考須等待 45 天（依州別而異）。
  • Interstate endorsement or the Nurse Licensure Compact allows practice in other states; international nurses need credential evaluation, English proficiency and visa documents.可透過州際認可或護理執照互惠協定到他州執業；國際護理人員需學歷認證、英語能力及簽證文件。
PDF p.32, 33, 34

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. NCJMM order: recognize cues, analyze cues, prioritize hypotheses, generate solutions, take action, evaluate outcomes.NCJMM 順序：辨識線索、分析線索、排定假設優先順序、產生解決方案、採取行動、評值結果。 PDF p.21
  2. NCLEX items are applying level or higher; no recall-only questions.NCLEX 題目為應用層次以上，沒有純記憶題。 PDF p.23
  3. Minimum 85 and maximum 150 items; 5-hour limit; 15 unscored pretest items.最少 85 題、最多 150 題；時限 5 小時；含 15 題不計分預試題。 PDF p.32
  4. Management of Care (17-23%) and Pharmacological/Parenteral Therapies (12-18%) are the two heaviest subcategories.照護管理（17-23%）與藥物/腸道外治療（12-18%）是占比最大的兩個子類別。 PDF p.24
  5. You cannot skip or return to a question; guessing carries no penalty.不能跳題或回頭作答；猜題不扣分。 PDF p.22
  6. Three unfolding case studies (6 items each) are given within the first 85 questions.3 個漸進式個案（各 6 題）會出現在前 85 題內。 PDF p.25
  7. Traditional items are scored 0/1; NGN items use plus-minus, 0/1 or rationale partial-credit scoring.傳統題 0/1 計分；NGN 題使用加減分、0/1 或理由部分給分。 PDF p.25, 26, 29
  8. Acute epiglottitis: never examine the throat or take a throat culture; keep airway, sit upright, monitor SpO2, have trach tray ready.急性會厭炎：不可檢查喉嚨或採咽喉培養；維持呼吸道、坐直、監測血氧、備妥氣切包。 PDF p.28
  9. Oral contraceptives are contraindicated with thromboembolic disease, cardiovascular disease, hypertension, estrogen-dependent cancer, liver tumors/impairment.口服避孕藥禁忌：血栓栓塞症、心血管疾病、高血壓、雌激素依賴性癌、肝腫瘤或肝功能受損。 PDF p.30
  10. Infiltrated IV (blanching, cool, edema): remove the IV first.靜脈輸注外滲（蒼白、冰冷、水腫）：首先拔除靜脈導管。 PDF p.24
  11. Early digoxin toxicity: anorexia, nausea, vomiting; visual changes (yellow-green, halos) are later.毛地黃中毒早期：厭食、噁心、嘔吐；視覺異常（黃綠視、光暈）較晚出現。 PDF p.26
  12. Magnesium 3.5 mEq/L is high (normal 1.8-2.6): expect drowsiness, weak reflexes, respiratory depression, bradycardia, hypotension.鎂 3.5 mEq/L 偏高（正常 1.8-2.6）：預期嗜睡、反射減弱、呼吸抑制、心搏過緩、低血壓。 PDF p.26
  13. Ventricular fibrillation: start CPR immediately and defibrillate as soon as possible.心室顫動：立即 CPR 並盡快去顫。 PDF p.30
  14. Dose formula: Desired/Available x Volume (650 mg of 500 mg/15 mL = 19.5 mL).劑量公式：需要量 / 現有量 x 容量（650 mg、500 mg/15 mL = 19.5 mL）。 PDF p.27
  15. MRI prep: remove all metal and screen for pacemakers, shrapnel or metal implants.MRI 準備：移除所有金屬並篩檢心律調節器、彈片或金屬植入物。 PDF p.26

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Acronym for NCJMM: R-A-P-G-T-E = Recognize, Analyze, Prioritize, Generate, Take action, Evaluate (maps to ADPIE).NCJMM 口訣：R-A-P-G-T-E = 辨識、分析、排序、產生方案、行動、評值（對應 ADPIE）。 PDF p.21

2 Self-Efficacy and Pathways to Success自我效能與成功途徑

This short chapter applies Bandura's self-efficacy theory to NCLEX preparation. It guides you through self-reflection, goal setting, a structured study plan, self-care and a calm approach to the final days and exam day.本章將班杜拉自我效能理論應用於 NCLEX 備考，引導自我反思、設定目標、結構化讀書計畫、自我照顧，以及最後階段與考試日的穩定心態。

Self-efficacy (Bandura)自我效能（班杜拉）

  • Self-efficacy is a belief in your own ability to carry out particular behaviors; it shapes which behaviors you choose, how long you persevere and how well you perform.自我效能是相信自己有能力執行特定行為；它影響你選擇的行為、堅持程度與表現品質。
  • High self-efficacy expectations lead to hard work and persistence; low expectations lead to self-doubt about passing.高自我效能期望促使努力與堅持；低期望則導致對通過考試的自我懷疑。
  • Research (Silvestri, Clark and Moonie, 2013) found self-efficacy expectations were an important predictor of NCLEX success.研究（Silvestri 等，2013）顯示自我效能期望是 NCLEX 成功的重要預測因子。
PDF p.35

Pathways to success: self-reflection成功途徑：自我反思

  • Self-reflection lets you review past experiences and build confidence about your capabilities.自我反思讓你回顧過往經驗並建立對能力的信心。
  • Journal your accomplishments and re-read them whenever doubt appears.記錄你的成就，疑慮出現時重新閱讀。
  • Ask yourself about goal setting: are goals realistic, do you reach them, how do you overcome obstacles?自問目標設定：目標是否務實、是否達成、遇到障礙如何克服？
PDF p.35, 36

The foundation and the List基礎與目標清單

  • Foundation: strong positive attitude, sense of self-efficacy, self-control, and short- and long-term goals.基礎：積極態度、自我效能感、自我控制，以及短期與長期目標。
  • Calm yourself with slow breathing (inhale through the nose, hold for 4, exhale slowly through the mouth).以緩慢呼吸平靜自己（鼻吸、屏息數到 4、嘴慢慢吐氣）。
  • Write the List of goals (today, tomorrow, next month, future), set it aside 2-3 days, then review it.寫下目標清單（今天、明天、下個月、未來），擱置 2-3 天後再檢視。
PDF p.36

Plan for preparation and study schedule準備計畫與讀書時程

  • Choose the study pattern that has worked for you before (alone vs group, time of day, place).選擇過去有效的讀書模式（獨自或小組、時段、地點）。
  • Schedule at least 2 hours of quality, uninterrupted study daily on a calendar; quality matters more than quantity.在行事曆排定每天至少 2 小時不被打擾的高品質讀書時間；重質不重量。
  • Share your plan with family and friends; protect study time when others pressure you to skip it.與家人朋友分享計畫；他人勸你跳過時要守住讀書時間。
PDF p.36, 37

Implementing the study plan執行讀書計畫

  • Self-assess strong and weak content areas, then start practice questions in weaker areas.自我評估強弱項目，從較弱領域開始做題。
  • Note unfamiliar content and review it in your review book and textbooks after each session.記下不熟的內容，每次讀完後翻閱複習書與教科書補強。
  • Practice at least 4000 questions; start in Study Mode, read every rationale and strategy, then move to Exam Mode to check readiness.至少練習 4000 題；先用學習模式、閱讀每題解析與策略，再用考試模式檢測準備度。
PDF p.37, 38

Positive pampering, final preparation and exam day正向照顧自己、最後準備與考試日

  • Include exercise, healthy eating, water, complex carbohydrates, limited caffeine and fun in your schedule.排入運動、健康飲食、足量飲水、複合碳水化合物、限制咖啡因及休閒活動。
  • End studying 2 days before the exam and rest the day before; avoid perfectionism.考前 2 天結束複習，前一天好好休息；避免完美主義。
  • Do a test drive to the testing center; post your name with RN and the exam date.事先試開到考場；貼出你的名字加上 RN 與考試日期。
  • Exam day: eat a nutritious breakfast, breathe, believe, stay in control and visualize RN after your name.考試日：吃營養早餐，呼吸、相信自己、保持掌控，想像名字後面有 RN。
PDF p.38, 39

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Self-efficacy is a significant predictor of NCLEX success.自我效能是 NCLEX 成功的重要預測因子。 PDF p.35
  2. Plan at least 2 hours of quality study daily.每天規劃至少 2 小時高品質讀書時間。 PDF p.36
  3. Practice at least 4000 questions before the exam.考前至少練習 4000 題。 PDF p.37, 38
  4. Read rationales and test-taking strategies for every question, right or wrong.每題都要讀解析與策略，無論對錯。 PDF p.38
  5. Start with weaker content areas and keep notes on unfamiliar topics.從較弱領域開始並記錄不熟的主題。 PDF p.37
  6. Use Study Mode first, then Exam Mode to judge readiness.先用學習模式，再用考試模式評估準備度。 PDF p.38
  7. Stop studying 2 days before the exam; rest the day before.考前 2 天停止讀書；前一天休息。 PDF p.38
  8. Do a test drive to the testing center beforehand.事先試開前往考場。 PDF p.38

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Day-of-exam cue: Breathe, Believe, Control, Believe, Visualize.考試日口訣：呼吸、相信、掌控、相信、想像（Breathe-Believe-Control-Believe-Visualize）。 PDF p.39

3 The NCLEX-RN Examination from a Graduate's Perspective畢業生眼中的 NCLEX-RN 考試

A recent graduate shares how she registered, scheduled, studied and survived the NCLEX. Her practical timeline and self-care habits illustrate the preparation plan described in the previous chapters.一位新畢業護理師分享她如何報名、預約、準備並通過 NCLEX。她的實務時間表與自我照顧習慣，說明了前幾章所述的備考計畫。

Why the author became a nurse成為護理師的動機

  • The author was inspired to serve her community after the 2017 Las Vegas tragedy and entered a 16-month nursing program.作者受 2017 年拉斯維加斯事件啟發，決心服務社區，並就讀 16 個月護理課程。
  • The NCLEX is a national licensure exam that tests critical thinking and nursing judgment.NCLEX 是測試批判性思考與護理判斷的全國執照考試。
PDF p.40

Registration steps報名步驟

  • About 2 months before graduation she made an account with the state board, submitted the signed application, license and fingerprint fees.畢業前約 2 個月向州護理委員會建立帳號，提交簽名申請書與執照及指紋費用。
  • Start early; processing takes time. Download the Candidate Bulletin; steps vary by state.及早開始，處理需要時間；下載考生手冊，各州步驟不同。
  • After approval you may register with Pearson VUE, who sends the Authorization to Test (ATT) needed to schedule.核准後可向 Pearson VUE 註冊，並收到預約所需的考試授權書（ATT）。
PDF p.40

Scheduling and building a study plan預約與擬定讀書計畫

  • Appointments may be scarce; she checked daily for cancellations and obtained an earlier date.考位可能稀少；她每天查詢取消名額，因此提早應試。
  • Use resources that worked in nursing school; start with an initial assessment exam to find weak areas.使用在校期間有效的資源；先做初始評量找出弱點。
  • Her plan: 3-4 hours daily for 100-150 practice questions, then the rest of the day for self-care.她的計畫：每天 3-4 小時做 100-150 題，其餘時間照顧自己。
PDF p.40, 41

Using rationales and the final week運用解析與最後一週

  • Read the rationale and strategy for every question, including those answered correctly, to confirm your reasoning and see why other options are wrong.每題都讀解析與策略（含答對題），確認思路並瞭解其他選項為何錯誤。
  • About a week before, take another assessment exam and focus on remaining weak concepts.約考前一週再做一次評量，專攻剩餘弱項。
  • The day before: no questions or content, relax, recheck the route, ID and ATT, sleep well.前一天：不做題、不讀內容，放鬆、再確認路線、證件與 ATT、好好睡覺。
PDF p.41

Exam day and after考試日與考後

  • Have a light breakfast; at the center you get a locker, show ID and ATT, and are fingerprinted, palm-scanned and photographed.吃清淡早餐；到考場後使用置物櫃、出示證件與 ATT，並採集指紋、掌紋與照片。
  • Focus on one question at a time using your knowledge and test-taking strategies.一次專注一題，運用知識與應試策略。
  • Doubt after the exam is normal; she saw an unofficial early result as Pass after a couple of days.考後懷疑是正常的；她在數日後的早期查詢看到通過。
  • Believe in yourself and avoid being too hard on yourself.相信自己，別對自己太嚴苛。
PDF p.41

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Apply to the state board early; you need the ATT before scheduling.及早向州護理委員會申請；預約前需有 ATT。 PDF p.40
  2. Bring the ATT and valid ID to the testing center.攜帶 ATT 與有效證件到考場。 PDF p.41
  3. Check for appointment cancellations if the date is far away.若考期太遠，可留意取消名額。 PDF p.40
  4. Take an initial assessment to identify weak areas, then a second one about a week before.先做初始評量找弱項，考前約一週再做一次。 PDF p.41
  5. Read rationales and strategies even for correct answers.答對的題也要讀解析與策略。 PDF p.41
  6. Plan self-care after daily question goals (e.g., 100-150 questions).完成每日題量（如 100-150 題）後安排自我照顧。 PDF p.41
  7. The day before the exam: no studying, rest and verify directions.考前一天：不讀書，休息並確認路線。 PDF p.41
  8. Pearson VUE is the testing vendor that issues scheduling after state approval.Pearson VUE 為施測廠商，州核准後負責預約。 PDF p.40

4 Clinical Judgment and Test-Taking Strategies臨床判斷與應試策略

This chapter gives a toolkit for answering NCLEX questions: read the question carefully, note strategic words and the subject, prioritize with ABCs, Maslow and the nursing process, apply NCJMM skills, and eliminate poor options. It also covers delegation, available-resources thinking and pharmacology tips.本章提供作答工具：仔細讀題、注意策略性字詞與主題，以 ABC、馬斯洛與護理過程排定優先順序、運用 NCJMM 技能並刪去不佳選項。另含委派、資源假設與藥理應試技巧。

Clinical judgment and key strategies臨床判斷與關鍵策略

  • Combine the NCJMM cognitive skills with other test-taking strategies.將 NCJMM 認知技能與其他應試策略合併運用。
  • Read every word, identify the subject, who the client is, strategic words, and whether the query is positive or negative.逐字閱讀，找出主題、題目中的病人是誰、策略性字詞，以及題目是正向或負向。
  • Use process of elimination; reread the question before the final choice.運用刪去法；選定前再讀一次題目。
  • Avoid 'What if...' reading into traditional items, but for NGN items consider existing and potential concerns.傳統題避免『如果……』過度臆測；NGN 題則需考量現存與潛在問題。
PDF p.42, 43

Avoiding reading into the question; ingredients of a question避免過度解讀；題目的組成

  • Base the answer only on the data given; look for abnormalities, the client of the question, and assume all needed resources are at the bedside.只依題目資料作答；找出異常、確認題目中的病人，並假設床邊具備所有所需資源。
  • Ingredients: event (the situation), event query (the question stem) and options.題目組成：事件（情境）、事件詢問（題幹）與選項。
  • Multiple response: each option is true or false; choose all true ones. Ordered response: prioritize actions.多重選擇：每個選項為真或假，選出所有真者；排序題：依優先順序排列。
  • Chart/exhibit items contain relevant data and distractors; fill-in-the-blank requires rechecking calculations with the on-screen calculator.圖表題含相關資料與干擾資訊；填空題需用螢幕計算機再次檢查計算。
  • NGN trend example: for a client with new type 2 diabetes, rising pulse, rising respirations, high glucose, falling potassium and falling urine output are worsening findings to follow up.NGN 趨勢範例：新診斷第 2 型糖尿病病人，脈搏上升、呼吸上升、血糖偏高、鉀下降與尿量減少為惡化而需追蹤的發現。
PDF p.43, 44, 45, 46

Strategic words, subject, positive and negative event queries策略性字詞、主題、正負向詢問

  • Prioritizing words: best, early or late, essential, first, highest priority, immediate, initial, most, next, priority, primary.需排序的字詞：最佳、早期或晚期、必要、首先、最優先、立即、起始、最、接下來、優先、主要。
  • Assessment words (assess, check, determine, monitor, obtain information) often point to assessing first.評估字詞（評估、檢查、確定、監測、蒐集資料）常指向先評估。
  • A positive query asks for a correct item; a negative query (need for further teaching/follow-up) asks for an incorrect one.正向詢問要選正確項；負向詢問（需再教導/追蹤）要選不正確項。
  • Identify the subject; focus on it to rule out options that are true but irrelevant.辨識題目主題，排除正確但無關的選項。
PDF p.43, 46, 47

Prioritizing: ABCs, CAB, Maslow優先順序：ABC、CAB、馬斯洛

  • ABCs: airway, then breathing, then circulation; for CPR use CAB (compressions, airway, breathing).ABC：先氣道、再呼吸、再循環；CPR 使用 CAB（按壓、氣道、呼吸）。
  • Maslow: physiological, safety and security, love and belonging, self-esteem, self-actualization; if no physiological option exists, choose safety.馬斯洛：生理、安全與保障、愛與歸屬、自尊、自我實現；若無生理選項，選安全。
  • When prioritizing, all options may be correct; choose the order or the most urgent.排序時所有選項可能都正確；需選最緊急或排出順序。
  • Actual problems take priority over potential problems in most situations.多數情況下，現存問題優先於潛在問題。
PDF p.47, 48, 50

Nursing process and NCJMM in questions題目中的護理過程與 NCJMM

  • Assessment/recognize cues is first: choose the option collecting data when asked for first or initial action, unless it is an emergency.評估/辨識線索為第一步：問『首先』時選蒐集資料的選項，緊急情況除外。
  • Analysis: analyze cues and prioritize hypotheses; these are the hardest items and require interpreting data (e.g., ABG: pH 7.45, PCO2 30, HCO3 22 = compensated respiratory alkalosis).分析：分析線索並排序假設；最困難，需解讀資料（例：動脈血氣 pH 7.45、PCO2 30、HCO3 22 = 代償性呼吸性鹼中毒）。
  • Planning/generate solutions: set priorities and goals; implementation/take action: choose nursing actions, not medical actions.計畫/產生方案：設定優先順序與目標；執行/採取行動：選護理行動而非醫療行動。
  • Evaluation/evaluate outcomes: compare observed outcomes with expected; negative queries are common.評值/評值結果：比較實際與預期結果；常出現負向詢問。
  • If an abnormality exists, further assessment or action is needed; do not choose just continue monitoring or documenting.若有異常，需進一步評估或行動；不要選僅持續監測或記錄。
  • Choose options that ensure client safety.選擇確保病人安全的選項。
PDF p.48, 49, 50, 51

Client Needs categories and strategies病人需求類別與策略

  • Physiological Integrity: Maslow, ABCs, nursing process.生理完整性：馬斯洛、ABC、護理過程。
  • Safe and Effective Care Environment: safety, handwashing, call system, side rails, asepsis, precautions, triage, emergency planning.安全有效照護環境：安全、洗手、呼叫系統、床欄、無菌、隔離措施、檢傷、緊急應變。
  • Health Promotion and Maintenance: teaching-learning theory, client readiness first; negative queries are frequent.健康促進與維護：教與學理論，先確認病人準備度；常出現負向詢問。
  • Psychosocial Integrity: therapeutic communication focused on the client's feelings; avoid 'why' questions, false reassurance and blunt replies.心理社會整合：以病人感受為主的治療性溝通；避免『為什麼』、虛假保證與生硬回應。
PDF p.51, 52, 53

Eliminating options: alike, closed-ended words, umbrella刪去選項：相似、封閉字詞、傘狀選項

  • Comparable or alike options can usually be eliminated.相似的選項通常可刪除。
  • Closed-ended words (all, always, every, must, none, never, only) usually make an option wrong; open-ended words (may, usually, generally) are more likely right.封閉字詞（所有、總是、每個、必須、沒有、絕不、只）通常使選項錯誤；開放字詞（可能、通常、一般）較可能正確。
  • The umbrella option is broad and includes the concepts of other options; it is often correct (e.g., contact precautions includes gown and gloves).傘狀選項涵蓋其他選項概念，常為正確答案（如接觸隔離包含隔離衣與手套）。
PDF p.53

Delegation, resources and pharmacology委派、資源與藥理

  • AP: noninvasive care (skin care, ROM, ambulation, hygiene). LPN/LVN: AP tasks plus focused assessments, dressings, suctioning, catheterization, oral/SC/IM medications; RN: comprehensive assessment, teaching initiation, IV medications, supervision.助理（AP）：非侵入性照護（皮膚、關節活動、行走、衛生）。LPN/LVN：AP 工作加聚焦評估、換藥、抽吸、導尿、口服/皮下/肌肉藥物；RN：完整評估、起始衛教、靜脈給藥、督導。
  • Use national standards and the Nurse Practice Act; assume ideal conditions with all equipment at the bedside (e.g., chest tube dislodged: cover the site with a sterile dressing).依全國標準與護理執業法；假設理想狀況且設備齊全（例：胸管脫出，用無菌敷料覆蓋傷口）。
  • Pharmacology: identify drug class from name stems (-lol beta blocker, -pril ACE inhibitor), know the question focus (intended, side, adverse, toxic effect).藥理：由藥名字尾辨識類別（-lol 乙型阻斷劑、-pril ACE 抑制劑），確認題目焦點（預期、副作用、不良反應、毒性）。
  • Pyramid points: no antacids with meds; do not crush enteric-coated/sustained-release; never change doses or stop meds abruptly; avoid OTC/herbals unless approved; avoid alcohol; do not give unclear or abnormal orders.重點：服藥時不併用制酸劑；腸溶/緩釋劑不可壓碎；不可自行調整或突然停藥；非經核准避免 OTC/草藥；避免酒精；醫囑不清或劑量異常不給藥。
PDF p.54, 55

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Airway is always first (ABCs); in CPR use CAB.氣道永遠第一（ABC）；CPR 用 CAB。 PDF p.47
  2. Physiological needs come first (Maslow); if none, choose safety.生理需求優先（馬斯洛）；若無，選安全。 PDF p.47, 48
  3. Assessment is the first step of the nursing process unless the scenario is an emergency.護理過程第一步為評估，除非是緊急情況。 PDF p.48
  4. Base answers only on the data given; avoid the 'What if' syndrome on traditional items.只依題目資料作答；傳統題避免『如果』症候群。 PDF p.43
  5. Negative query (need for further teaching/follow-up) asks for the incorrect statement.負向詢問（需再教導/追蹤）要選不正確的陳述。 PDF p.47
  6. Eliminate options with closed-ended words (always, never, only, all, must).刪除含封閉字詞（總是、絕不、只、所有、必須）的選項。 PDF p.53
  7. Digoxin toxicity: GI upset, neurologic and visual changes, bradycardia; call provider if pulse < 60; keep potassium normal (3.5-5.0 mEq/L).毛地黃中毒：腸胃不適、神經與視覺改變、心搏過緩；脈搏低於 60 要通報；鉀需維持正常（3.5-5.0 mEq/L）。 PDF p.47, 51
  8. Morphine suppresses cough and respiration: priority is coughing and deep breathing (airway/breathing).嗎啡抑制咳嗽與呼吸：優先鼓勵咳嗽與深呼吸（氣道/呼吸）。 PDF p.48
  9. Cast with pain on passive movement: assess for paresthesia/paralysis (compartment syndrome) first.石膏處被動活動疼痛：先評估感覺異常/麻痺（腔室症候群）。 PDF p.49
  10. Nitroglycerin: unrelieved chest pain after one SL tablet, give another (up to 3 tablets 5 minutes apart) after checking blood pressure.硝化甘油：舌下一顆後胸痛未緩解，可再給（每 5 分鐘最多 3 顆），並先確認血壓。 PDF p.50
  11. Early hypovolemic shock sign is increased pulse (and restlessness); increased respiratory depth comes later.低血容性休克早期徵象為脈搏加快（與不安）；呼吸加深較晚出現。 PDF p.46
  12. Reference ranges cited: Na 135-145, K 3.5-5.0, phosphorus 3.0-4.5 mg/dL, Mg 1.8-2.6 mEq/L, pH 7.35-7.45.本章所列參考值：鈉 135-145、鉀 3.5-5.0、磷 3.0-4.5 mg/dL、鎂 1.8-2.6 mEq/L、pH 7.35-7.45。 PDF p.49, 51
  13. First-dose ACE inhibitor (-pril): monitor blood pressure (first-dose hypotension).ACE 抑制劑（-pril）首劑：監測血壓（首劑低血壓）。 PDF p.55
  14. Delegation: AP for stable, noninvasive tasks; client with bed rest to AP; invasive/unstable clients to licensed nurses.委派：穩定、非侵入性工作給 AP；臥床休養者可給 AP；侵入性/不穩定者給有執照護理人員。 PDF p.54
  15. Therapeutic communication: address the client's feelings; avoid asking 'why', false reassurance and blunt replies.治療性溝通：回應病人感受；避免問『為什麼』、虛假保證與生硬回應。 PDF p.53

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • ABC then CAB for CPR: Airway-Breathing-Circulation normally; Compressions-Airway-Breathing during CPR.一般 ABC（氣道-呼吸-循環）；CPR 時改為 CAB（按壓-氣道-呼吸）。 PDF p.47
  • Maslow ladder: Physiological, Safety, Love/belonging, Esteem, Self-actualization.馬斯洛階梯：生理、安全、愛與歸屬、自尊、自我實現。 PDF p.48
  • Closed-ended words to distrust: all, always, every, must, none, never, only.需警覺的封閉字詞：所有、總是、每個、必須、沒有、絕不、只。 PDF p.53

5 Population Health Nursing族群健康護理

This chapter reviews vulnerable and at-risk populations and how disparities, social determinants and culture shape care. It teaches a nonjudgmental, individualized assessment approach, key health risks for each group and nursing considerations such as interpreter use, teach-back, safety and referrals.本章回顧弱勢與高風險族群，以及健康不平等、社會決定因素與文化如何影響照護。強調非批判、個別化的評估，並說明各族群主要健康風險與護理考量（如口譯、回述、安全與轉介）。

Health care disparities and nursing assessment健康照護不平等與護理評估

  • Health care disparities are differences in care offered to different groups; vulnerable groups include minorities, the uninsured, those in poverty or homeless, people with chronic illness or disability, immigrants, refugees, limited-English speakers, the incarcerated and LGBTQIA people.健康照護不平等是不同群體獲得照護的差異；弱勢族群包括少數族群、無保險者、貧窮或無家者、慢性病或身心障礙者、移民、難民、英語能力有限者、受監禁者與 LGBTQIA。
  • Leading U.S. chronic problems: heart disease, cancer, lung disease, stroke, Alzheimer's, diabetes, kidney disease; risk factors include tobacco, poor nutrition, obesity, inactivity and excess alcohol.美國主要慢性病：心臟病、癌症、肺病、中風、阿茲海默症、糖尿病、腎臟病；危險因子包括吸菸、營養不良、肥胖、缺乏運動與過量飲酒。
  • Use a nonjudgmental, nonthreatening approach; address reported symptoms first to encourage adherence and follow-up.採非批判、非威脅的態度；先處理主訴症狀以促進遵從與回診。
  • The needs assessment tool asks about language, interpreter need, culture, diet, living situation, support, finances, insurance, safety/abuse, substances, advance directive, immunizations and mental health.需求評估工具詢問語言、是否需口譯、文化、飲食、居住、支持系統、經濟、保險、安全/虐待、物質使用、預立醫囑、疫苗與心理健康。
  • Be self-aware of your own values and biases; avoid stereotyping since every client is an individual.覺察自身價值觀與偏見；避免刻板印象，每位病人都是個體。
PDF p.58, 59, 60, 61

COVID-19 and minority groupsCOVID-19 與少數族群

  • COVID-19 is a highly contagious respiratory illness (SARS-CoV) that can affect many body systems; high risk includes older adults, chronic illness, cancer, immunocompromise and minority groups.COVID-19 為高傳染性呼吸道疾病（SARS-CoV），可影響多個系統；高風險族群含年長者、慢性病、癌症、免疫低下者與少數族群。
  • Emergency warning signs: trouble breathing, persistent chest pain or pressure, new confusion, inability to stay awake, bluish lips or face.緊急警訊：呼吸困難、持續胸痛或壓迫感、新發意識混亂、無法保持清醒、嘴唇或臉部發紫。
  • Prevention: handwashing, mask and eye protection, distancing, avoiding crowds and sick contacts, covering coughs, avoiding touching the face, quarantine.預防：洗手、口罩與護目、保持距離、避免人群與病人、遮掩咳嗽、避免觸摸臉部、自我隔離。
  • Minority groups face higher disparities; examples: obesity/diabetes in Hispanic/Latinx; smoking, diabetes, hepatitis B, TB, SIDS in Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander; diabetes, heart disease, accidents, suicide in Native American/Alaska Native; hypertension, heart disease, asthma in African Americans; cancer, TB, hepatitis in Asian Americans.少數族群不平等更明顯：拉丁裔肥胖/糖尿病；夏威夷原住民與太平洋島民吸菸、糖尿病、B 肝、結核、SIDS；美洲原住民/阿拉斯加原住民糖尿病、心臟病、意外、自殺；非裔高血壓、心臟病、氣喘；亞裔癌症、結核、肝炎。
  • Do not use family or friends as interpreters; use designated interpreters. Use cultural responsiveness and teach-back (return demonstration).不可請家人朋友擔任口譯，應使用指定口譯員。展現文化回應能力並使用回述（回覆示教）。
PDF p.61, 62

LGBTQIA individualsLGBTQIA 族群

  • Fear of stigma reduces access to care; transgender people are less likely to complete screenings such as mammograms, cervical and prostate screening.害怕汙名化降低就醫；跨性別者較少完成乳房攝影、子宮頸與攝護腺等篩檢。
  • Concerns: STIs, depression and suicide, bullying and abuse of youth, rejection by family, barriers to child-rearing.關注議題：性傳染病、憂鬱與自殺、青少年霸凌與虐待、家人排斥、育兒障礙。
  • Create a welcoming environment, use the client's identified name and pronouns, use inclusive forms and policies, take a careful sexual history.營造友善環境，使用病人認同的姓名與代名詞，採用包容的表單與政策，詳細詢問性史。
  • Consider nPEP after possible HIV exposure; monitor transgender hormone therapy (e.g., polycythemia with testosterone); keep age-appropriate screening for retained organs/breast tissue.可能暴露於 HIV 後考慮 nPEP；追蹤跨性別荷爾蒙治療（如睪固酮造成紅血球增多症）；對保留的器官/乳房組織持續做適齡篩檢。
PDF p.62, 63

Homeless, socioeconomically disadvantaged and uninsured無家者、社經弱勢與無保險者

  • Homelessness is linked to early death, malnutrition, STIs, TB and pneumonia, wounds, mental illness and substance abuse; children have asthma, lead poisoning and ear infections.無家者與早逝、營養不良、性傳染病、結核與肺炎、傷口、精神疾病及物質濫用相關；兒童常有氣喘、鉛中毒與中耳炎。
  • Address the client's stated symptom first (e.g., pain with numbness in both feet), assess wounds, establish an emergency contact and follow-up, and connect to resources.先處理病人主訴（例：雙腳疼痛麻木），評估傷口，建立緊急聯絡人與追蹤，並連結資源。
  • Social determinants (education, income, family and social support, community safety) are as important as lifestyle and access to care.社會決定因素（教育、收入、家庭與社會支持、社區安全）與生活型態及就醫可近性同樣重要。
  • Use social work and refer the uninsured to Medicaid or financial services; lack of insurance leads to missed preventive care.運用社工，並轉介無保險者申請 Medicaid 或財務服務；缺乏保險導致預防照護缺漏。
PDF p.63, 64

Intellectual disability, abuse and neglect, single parents, foster children智能障礙、虐待與忽略、單親與寄養兒童

  • Intellectually disabled clients may present atypically; history taking takes more time with questions asked in different ways; assess choking/aspiration risk; behavior change may signal illness.智能障礙病人症狀可能不典型；問診需花更多時間並以不同方式提問；評估噎嗆/吸入風險；行為改變可能是疾病訊號。
  • Abuse victims: bruises (eyes, neck), sprains/fractures, fatigue, PTSD, depression; safety is the priority; nurses are mandated reporters; photograph injuries when needed.受虐者：瘀傷（眼周、頸部）、扭傷/骨折、疲倦、創傷後壓力症、憂鬱；安全為優先；護理師為強制通報者；必要時拍攝傷處。
  • Single parents need a therapeutic relationship and community resources (child care, food security, immunizations); preventive screenings matter.單親需要治療性關係與社區資源（托育、糧食、疫苗）；預防篩檢很重要。
  • Foster children often have unmet physical, mental, behavioral and dental needs; include social workers and community resources.寄養兒童常有未滿足的身體、心理、行為與牙科需求；需納入社工與社區資源。
PDF p.64, 65

Mental health, older adults, veterans, prisoners精神疾病、老年人、退伍軍人、受刑人

  • Mental illness: psychotropic weight gain and metabolic syndrome, diabetes risk, STIs, xerostomia, poor access; screen regularly.精神疾病：精神科藥物導致體重增加與代謝症候群、糖尿病風險、性傳染病、口乾、就醫困難；需定期篩檢。
  • Older adults: neglect is the most common elder abuse; report suspected abuse; common problems include dementia, falls, depression, osteoporosis.老年人：忽略是最常見的老人虐待；疑似虐待須通報；常見問題包括失智、跌倒、憂鬱、骨質疏鬆。
  • Veterans: PTSD, moral injury, TBI, substance use and suicide risk, amputations, chemical exposure; treat mental health to reduce suicide risk.退伍軍人：創傷後壓力症、道德創傷、腦外傷、物質使用與自殺風險、截肢、化學暴露；治療心理健康以降低自殺風險。
  • Prisoners: TB, STIs and infectious disease risk, asthma, diabetes, hypertension, mental illness; facility is usually the only care provider; screening must be thorough and regular.受刑人：結核、性傳染病與傳染病風險、氣喘、糖尿病、高血壓、精神疾病；矯正機構通常是唯一照護提供者；篩檢須完整且定期。
PDF p.65, 66

Immigrants, refugees and chronic illness移民、難民與慢性病

  • Immigrants face language, culture, housing, employment and access barriers; infections include TB, hepatitis, STIs and vaccine-preventable diseases; services must be offered regardless of insurance; provide vaccinations.移民面臨語言、文化、住房、就業與就醫障礙；感染包括結核、肝炎、性傳染病與疫苗可預防疾病；不論保險均應提供服務並施打疫苗。
  • Refugees: mental health problems from war, violence and rape are a priority concern.難民：因戰爭、暴力與性侵造成的心理健康問題是優先關注。
  • Chronic illness is the leading cause of death and disability; modifiable factors (diet, inactivity, tobacco) vs nonmodifiable (age, genetics).慢性病為死亡與失能首要原因；可改變因素（飲食、缺乏運動、吸菸）與不可改變因素（年齡、基因）。
  • Manage the 'big picture', not one illness; use interprofessional collaboration, follow-up (home health) and include the client and supporters in decisions.管理整體狀況而非單一疾病；跨專業合作、持續追蹤（居家照護），並讓病人與支持者參與決策。
PDF p.66, 67

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Teach-back (return explanation/demonstration) is the most reliable way to confirm understanding.回述/回覆示教是確認理解最可靠的方式。 PDF p.62, 68
  2. Never use family or friends as interpreters; use agency-designated interpreters.絕不使用家人或朋友當口譯，應使用機構指定口譯員。 PDF p.62
  3. Address transgender clients by their identified name and pronouns.以跨性別者認同的姓名與代名詞稱呼。 PDF p.62, 68
  4. With homeless clients, address the client's reported symptom first to improve return and adherence.對無家者先處理其主訴，以提高回診與遵從。 PDF p.63, 68
  5. Abuse red flags: bruises around eyes, red-purple marks on neck, sprained wrists, PTSD, chronic fatigue.受虐警訊：眼周瘀傷、頸部紅紫痕、手腕扭傷、創傷後壓力、慢性疲倦。 PDF p.65, 69
  6. Nurses are mandated reporters of abuse and neglect; safety is the priority.護理師是虐待與忽略的強制通報者；安全為優先。 PDF p.65
  7. Neglect is the most common type of elder abuse.忽略是最常見的老人虐待類型。 PDF p.66
  8. Veterans: PTSD and suicide risk are the priority concerns.退伍軍人：創傷後壓力症與自殺風險為優先關注。 PDF p.66, 69
  9. Refugees: mental health care is the priority need.難民：心理健康照護為優先需求。 PDF p.67, 69
  10. Prison environments predispose to TB, STIs and other communicable diseases.監獄環境易導致結核、性傳染病與其他傳染病。 PDF p.66, 69
  11. Intellectually disabled clients: allow extra time for history, assess for choking, and watch behavior as a symptom.智能障礙者：病史採集多給時間、評估噎嗆、並將行為改變視為症狀。 PDF p.64, 69
  12. Chronic illness care: look at the big picture, collaborate across providers, involve client and supporters.慢性病照護：看整體、跨專業合作、讓病人與支持者參與。 PDF p.67, 69, 70
  13. COVID-19 emergency signs: dyspnea, chest pain, new confusion, cyanosis.COVID-19 緊急警訊：呼吸困難、胸痛、新發混亂、發紺。 PDF p.61
  14. Social determinants of health matter as much as lifestyle and access to care.社會決定因素與生活型態及就醫可近性同樣重要。 PDF p.64

6 Ethical and Legal Issues倫理與法律議題

This chapter covers ethical principles and dilemmas, regulation of nursing practice, liability, consents, HIPAA confidentiality, occurrence reports, documentation, advance directives and mandatory reporting. These topics are heavily tested under Management of Care.本章涵蓋倫理原則與兩難、護理執業規範、法律責任、同意書、HIPAA 保密、事件報告、文件記錄、預立醫囑與強制通報。這些內容常見於「照護管理」考題。

Ethics, principles and advocacy倫理、原則與倡議

  • Ethics distinguishes right from wrong using a body of knowledge; morals reflect customs or beliefs; values influence decisions; values clarification analyzes your own values.倫理依知識體系分辨對錯；道德反映習俗或信念；價值觀影響決策；價值澄清是分析自身價值觀。
  • Principles: autonomy, nonmaleficence (do no harm), beneficence (do good; paternalism is undesirable), justice, veracity (truth), fidelity (keep promises).原則：自主、不傷害、行善（家長式作風不可取）、公正、誠實、忠誠。
  • Ethical codes (ICN, ANA) are not legally binding but boards of nursing can discipline unprofessional conduct.倫理守則（ICN、ANA）無法律效力，但護理委員會可懲處不專業行為。
  • An ethical dilemma is a conflict between two or more ethical principles with no clearly correct choice; use ethical reasoning (gather data, examine values, state the problem, consider options, negotiate, evaluate).倫理兩難為兩項以上倫理原則衝突、無明確正解；運用倫理推理（蒐集資料、檢視價值、說明問題、考慮選項、協商、評值）。
  • An advocate speaks for the client and supports the client's decision even if it conflicts with the nurse's own; ethics committees offer interprofessional consultation.倡議者為病人發聲並支持其決定（即使與自己意見不同）；倫理委員會提供跨專業諮詢。
PDF p.72, 73

Regulation of nursing practice護理執業規範

  • The Nurse Practice Act (state statute) sets education requirements, scope of practice, licensure and grounds for discipline; nurses must know their state's act.護理執業法（州法）規範教育要求、執業範圍、執照與懲處依據；護理師須熟悉所在州法規。
  • Standards of care define what clients can expect; failing both standards and agency policy makes the nurse clearly liable. Respondeat superior makes the employer liable for employees' negligence within employment.照護標準界定病人可期待的照護；同時違反標準與機構政策則責任明確。僱主責任原則使僱主需為員工執行職務中的過失負責。
  • Policies are not laws but courts generally rule against nurses who violate them.政策不是法律，但法院通常判違反政策的護理師敗訴。
  • Understaffing: walking out can be abandonment; report short staffing to administration.人力不足：擅離可能構成遺棄；應向行政單位報告人力不足。
  • Floating is acceptable; refusal is allowed only with union contract protection or proven lack of knowledge. Tell the supervisor your limits, request a resource nurse and accept patients matching your experience.調派支援可接受；僅在工會合約保障或能證明缺乏相關知識時方可拒絕。向主管說明限制、要求資源護理師並接受符合經驗的病人。
  • Discipline reasons: unprofessional conduct, confidentiality breach, insufficient judgment, abuse, unsafe delegation, inaccurate or falsified records, leaving an assignment without notice.懲處原因：不專業行為、違反保密、判斷不足、虐待病人、不安全委派、記錄不實或偽造、未通知即離開工作。
PDF p.73, 74

Legal liability, negligence and malpractice法律責任、過失與醫療疏失

  • Negligence is conduct below the standard of care (acts of commission or omission); malpractice is professional negligence.過失是低於照護標準的行為（作為或不作為）；醫療疏失是專業過失。
  • Four elements of liability: duty, breach of duty, proximate cause, damage/injury.責任四要件：義務、違反義務、因果關係、損害。
  • Negligence examples: medication or IV errors, falls, burns, retained surgical items, failure to monitor, report or delegate properly, incomplete handoff.過失例子：給藥或輸液錯誤、跌倒、燙傷、手術遺留異物、未監測/通報/適當委派、交班不完整。
  • Own liability insurance gives the nurse an attorney whose only interest is the nurse; Good Samaritan laws protect those giving reasonable, uncompensated emergency care.自行投保責任險可有只為護理師利益的律師；好撒馬利亞人法保護提供合理且無償緊急救助者。
  • Controlled substances: locked, signed out, inventory counted.管制藥品：上鎖、簽領、清點庫存。
  • Collective bargaining negotiates wages and conditions; strikes pose a moral dilemma for nurses.集體協商談判薪資與勞動條件；罷工對護理師是道德困境。
PDF p.74, 75

Legal risk areas法律風險領域

  • Assault: threat causing fear of harmful contact; battery: touching without consent.傷害威脅：使人害怕有害接觸；傷害行為：未經同意的觸碰。
  • Invasion of privacy: violating confidentiality; false imprisonment: preventing a client from leaving or unjustified restraints; a competent client may sign an AMA form.侵犯隱私：違反保密；非法拘禁：不當阻止離院或無正當臨床需求使用約束；有行為能力者可簽自動出院（AMA）。
  • Defamation: libel (written) or slander (spoken); fraud: deliberate deception for gain.毀謗：書面（誹謗）或口頭（誹謗/口誹）；詐欺：蓄意欺騙以牟利。
  • Exception: acutely disturbed mental health clients who pose risk may need least-restrictive interventions first, then restraint if behavior demands.例外：急性精神困擾且有危險者，先採最低限制措施，必要時才約束。
PDF p.75, 76

Patient rights, organ donation and consents病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書

  • The Patient Care Partnership (formerly Bill of Rights) from the AHA must be posted; related laws include ADA, ACA, Mental Health Systems Act.美國醫院協會（AHA）的病人照護夥伴關係（原病人權利法案）須張貼；相關法律含 ADA、ACA、心理健康系統法。
  • Organ donation: adults 18+ may declare intent; heart, lungs, liver require a ventilated brain-dead donor; request usually by trained provider; no delay in funeral or cost to family.器官捐贈：18 歲以上成人可表達意願；心、肺、肝需來自使用呼吸器的腦死者；通常由受訓人員提出請求；不延誤喪禮且家屬無費用。
  • Informed consent is the provider's responsibility (risks, benefits, alternatives, consequences of refusal); the nurse witnesses the signature.知情同意由醫師負責說明（風險、益處、替代方案與拒絕後果）；護理師見證簽名。
  • Consent must be voluntary, witnessed, signed by a competent adult; not valid if sedated, unconscious, intoxicated or demented without a legal representative. Use a professional interpreter when needed.同意須自願、有見證、由有行為能力的成人簽署；鎮靜、昏迷、醉酒或失智而無法定代理人時無效。需要時使用專業口譯。
  • Emergencies waive consent; clients may refuse information or withdraw consent anytime; if a client changes their mind before surgery, hold prep and notify the surgeon.緊急情況可免同意；病人可拒絕資訊或隨時撤回同意；術前病人改變心意，應暫停術前準備並通知外科醫師。
  • Minors need parent/guardian consent except in emergencies, emancipated minors, or services like STI, HIV, birth control, pregnancy, substance abuse and psychiatric care in many states.未成年人需父母或監護人同意，除非緊急、已解除監護的未成年人，或多州允許自行同意的服務（性傳染病、HIV、避孕、懷孕、物質濫用、精神科）。
PDF p.76, 77, 78

HIPAA and confidentialityHIPAA 與保密

  • HIPAA protects personal health information (PHI); clients may inspect, request amendment, request disclosure list, restrict use and file complaints.HIPAA 保護個人健康資訊（PHI）；病人可查閱、要求修正、索取揭露清單、限制使用並提出申訴。
  • PHI may be used for treatment, payment and operations, emergencies, public health, legal proceedings and with signed authorization.PHI 可用於治療、付款與營運、緊急狀況、公共衛生、法律程序，及經簽署授權。
  • Only staff involved in care may access records; share information only on a need-to-know basis in private areas.僅參與照護者可取得記錄；僅在有必要時於私密場所分享。
  • Privacy violations include posting on social media, photographs, open curtains, overheard interviews and unauthorized record access; never share passwords.侵犯隱私包括社群媒體貼文、拍照、未拉簾、談話被聽到、未授權查閱記錄；絕不分享密碼。
PDF p.78, 79, 80

Legal safeguards, orders and documentation法律保障、醫囑與文件記錄

  • Occurrence (incident) reports: factual, not copied or mentioned in the chart; chart the event itself; reassess the client; notify the provider.事件報告：客觀陳述，不影印也不在病歷提及；病歷中記錄事件本身；再評估病人；通知醫師。
  • Carry out prescriptions unless inappropriate or inaccurate; if unclear or unusually high, do not give it and contact the prescriber, then the supervisor.執行醫囑，除非不適當或不正確；若不清楚或劑量異常，不給藥並聯絡開醫囑者，再通報主管。
  • Telephone orders: identify client, date/time, read back, write 't.o.' with prescriber's name and sign; prescriber countersigns.電話醫囑：確認病人、日期時間、覆誦、註明「t.o.」與醫師姓名並簽名；醫師事後簽署。
  • Documentation: objective, factual, timely, black ink, sign each entry, no erasing, no blank spaces, no judgmental terms, no unacceptable abbreviations, correct errors per policy.文件記錄：客觀、事實、即時、黑筆、每筆簽名、不擦拭、不留空白、不用評斷性字眼與禁用縮寫、依政策更正錯誤。
  • Document teaching: what was taught, understanding, who was present.記錄衛教：教了什麼、理解程度、在場者。
PDF p.80, 81

Advance directives and reporting duties預立醫囑與通報責任

  • Patient Self-Determination Act: ask about advance directives on admission and document them.病人自主權法：入院時詢問預立醫囑並記錄。
  • Two types: instructional directive (living will) and durable power of attorney for health care (proxy).兩類：指示型預立醫囑（生前遺囑）與醫療持續委任書（代理人）。
  • DNR requires informed consent and clear definition; without a DNR order, make every effort to resuscitate; review regularly.DNR 需知情同意且定義清楚；無 DNR 醫囑時須盡力急救；定期檢討。
  • Some agencies bar nurses from witnessing legal documents; if allowed, document who was present and the client's conduct.部分機構禁止護理師見證法律文件；若允許，須記錄在場者與病人表現。
  • Mandatory reports: certain communicable diseases, animal bites, suicides, child/elder abuse, domestic violence, gunshot or stab wounds, assaults, homicides.強制通報：特定傳染病、動物咬傷、自殺、兒童/老人虐待、家暴、槍傷或刀傷、攻擊、殺人。
  • Suspected impaired coworker: report confidentially to the supervisor; client safety first. OSHA protects workers who report unsafe conditions; sexual harassment is prohibited.懷疑同事受物質影響：向主管保密通報，病人安全優先。OSHA 保護通報不安全條件者；性騷擾受法律禁止。
PDF p.81, 82

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Occurrence reports record facts only; do not mention the report in the chart.事件報告只記錄事實；病歷中不提及該報告。 PDF p.80, 83, 84
  2. After a fall, reassess the client first.病人跌倒後首先再評估病人。 PDF p.83, 84
  3. Emergency without a legal representative: treat; consent is not required if delay causes harm.緊急且無法定代理人：直接治療；延誤會造成傷害時不需同意。 PDF p.78, 83, 84
  4. The provider explains the procedure for informed consent; the nurse witnesses the signature.由醫師說明並取得知情同意；護理師見證簽名。 PDF p.77, 78
  5. A sedated, intoxicated, or unconscious client cannot give informed consent.受鎮靜、醉酒或昏迷者不能給予知情同意。 PDF p.78
  6. If a client refuses surgery, hold preparation, explore concerns and notify the surgeon.病人拒絕手術時暫停準備、探究顧慮並通知外科醫師。 PDF p.77
  7. Do not give an unclear or abnormal medication order; contact the prescriber, then the supervisor.不執行不清楚或異常的醫囑；聯絡醫師，再通報主管。 PDF p.80, 84
  8. Suspected impaired nurse: report to the nursing supervisor.懷疑護理師受物質影響：通報護理主管。 PDF p.82, 84
  9. Floating: clarify the assignment for safety; do not refuse unless union protection or proven incompetence.調派支援：確認指派是否安全；除非有工會保障或能證明不具能力，否則不可拒絕。 PDF p.73, 74, 84
  10. Nurses are mandated reporters of child and elder abuse and domestic violence.護理師為兒童、老人虐待與家暴的強制通報者。 PDF p.82
  11. HIPAA: share PHI only with those involved in care or with client authorization.HIPAA：僅與參與照護者或經病人授權才分享 PHI。 PDF p.78, 79
  12. Documentation: factual, objective, no judgmental words such as 'uncooperative', black ink, no erasing.文件記錄：客觀事實、不用『不合作』等評斷字、黑筆、不擦拭。 PDF p.81
  13. Malpractice elements: duty, breach, proximate cause, damage.醫療疏失要件：義務、違反、因果關係、損害。 PDF p.74, 75
  14. Battery is touching without consent; assault is the threat of contact.傷害行為是未經同意的觸碰；傷害威脅是接觸的威脅。 PDF p.75

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Ethical principles A-N-B-J-V-F: Autonomy, Nonmaleficence, Beneficence, Justice, Veracity, Fidelity.倫理原則 A-N-B-J-V-F：自主、不傷害、行善、公正、誠實、忠誠。 PDF p.72
  • Liability elements D-B-P-D: Duty, Breach, Proximate cause, Damage.責任要件 D-B-P-D：義務、違反、因果關係、損害。 PDF p.74, 75

7 Prioritizing Client Care: Leadership, Delegation, and Emergency Response Planning照護優先順序：領導、委派與緊急應變計畫

This chapter covers health care delivery and insurance, nursing delivery models, leadership and management, quality improvement, change and conflict, the health care team, delegation and assignment, prioritizing care, and disaster response and triage. It is the core reference for prioritization and delegation questions.本章涵蓋醫療照護體系與保險、護理提供模式、領導與管理、品質改善、變革與衝突、醫療團隊、委派與指派、照護優先順序，以及災難應變與檢傷，是優先順序與委派題的核心參考。

Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑

  • Managed care controls costs through outcome-driven care, health promotion, early detection and efficient resource use; case management supports it with an interprofessional approach.管理式照護以成果導向、健康促進、早期發現與有效利用資源控制成本；個案管理以跨專業方式支持之。
  • Case manager (RN): assesses, plans, coordinates referrals and services, facilitates discharge, advocates for cost-effective care and knows insurance options.個案管理師（RN）：評估、計畫、協調轉介與服務、促進出院、倡導具成本效益的照護並熟悉保險。
  • Insurance types: HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, HSA. Medicare: age 65+, some disabled, ESRD (Part A hospital/SNF/hospice, Part B outpatient 80%, Part C private plan, Part D drugs). Medicaid: joint federal-state for low income.保險類型：HMO、PPO、EPO、POS、HDHP、HSA。Medicare：65 歲以上、部分身障者、末期腎病（A 部分住院/SNF/安寧、B 部分門診 80%、C 部分私人計畫、D 部分藥物）。Medicaid：聯邦與州合辦的低收入保險。
  • Critical pathway: evidence-based, time-framed care plan; variation analysis compares actual to expected outcomes to spot negative variance early.臨床路徑：循證、設定時間的照護計畫；變異分析比較實際與預期結果，及早發現負向變異。
  • Care planning tools: nursing care plan, ADPIE, nursing process, SBAR, SOAP, NCJMM.照護規劃工具：護理計畫、ADPIE、護理過程、SBAR、SOAP、NCJMM。
PDF p.88, 89

Nursing delivery systems護理提供模式

  • Functional nursing: task-oriented, efficient for many clients but fragmented with low accountability.功能制護理：以工作為導向，可照顧較多病人但照護片段且責任分散。
  • Team nursing: an RN team leader assesses, plans and evaluates; staff work within their scope (e.g., RN leading 2 LPNs and 3 APs for 12 clients).小組護理：RN 組長負責評估、計畫與評值；成員在各自範圍內工作（例：RN 帶 2 位 LPN 與 3 位 AP 照顧 12 位病人）。
  • Relationship-based (primary) nursing: one primary nurse manages care from admission to discharge, with an associate when off duty.關係導向（責任制）護理：由一位責任護理師從入院到出院負責，輪休時由輔助護理師接手。
  • Client-focused (total care/case method): the RN gives all needed care to assigned clients for the shift.以病人為中心（全責/個案制）：RN 在該班次提供指派病人所有所需照護。
PDF p.89, 90

Accountability, leadership styles and managers責任、領導風格與管理者

  • Accountability: answerable for choices and actions; assume only responsibilities within competence; admit mistakes.責任：對選擇與行動負責；只承擔能力範圍內的職責；承認錯誤。
  • Leadership influences others to achieve goals; management accomplishes tasks through oneself or others.領導是影響他人達成目標；管理是自己或透過他人完成任務。
  • Styles: authoritarian (leader decides), democratic (participative), laissez-faire (passive), situational, bureaucratic (policies), transformational (shared vision), servant.風格：權威式（領導者決定）、民主式（參與）、放任式（被動）、情境式、官僚式（依規定）、轉型式（共同願景）、服務式。
  • Management functions: planning, organizing, directing, controlling. Problem-solving steps parallel the nursing process and NCJMM.管理功能：計畫、組織、指導、控制。問題解決步驟與護理過程及 NCJMM 平行。
  • Managers: front-line (charge nurse, team leader), middle (unit manager, supervisor), nurse executive.管理者：第一線（組長、領導護理師）、中階（單位主任、督導）、護理主管。
  • Power types: reward, coercive, referent, expert, legitimate, personal, informational; empowerment enables others through open communication and shared decisions.權力類型：獎賞、強制、參照、專家、法定、個人、資訊；賦權透過開放溝通與共同決策使他人有能力。
PDF p.90, 91

Organizations, evidence-based practice and quality improvement組織、實證護理與品質改善

  • Mission, goals, organizational chart; policies guide, procedures describe methods, protocols prescribe care for a specific problem. Centralized vs decentralized decision-making.使命、目標、組織圖；政策提供方向、程序說明方法、準則規範特定問題的照護。集權與分權決策。
  • Evidence-based practice integrates best research, clinical expertise and client preferences; nurses question practice and formulate researchable questions. Level I evidence (reviews of RCTs) is strongest.實證護理整合最佳研究、臨床專業與病人偏好；護理師質疑現行作法並提出可研究的問題。第 I 級證據（多個 RCT 回顧）最強。
  • Quality improvement monitors outcomes against standards; retrospective audits review charts after discharge, concurrent audits evaluate during care; peer review evaluates colleagues' care.品質改善依標準監測成果；回溯稽核在出院後查閱病歷，同步稽核於照護期間評估；同儕審查評估同事的護理品質。
PDF p.92, 93

Change process and conflict變革歷程與衝突

  • Lewin's change model: unfreezing (identify problem, gather evidence), moving/changing (plan and implement), refreezing (stabilize).勒溫變革模式：解凍（辨識問題、蒐集證據）、移動/改變（規劃與執行）、再凍結（穩定）。
  • Resistance reasons: conformity, habit, fear, secondary gains, threats to basic needs, differing values. Overcome by involving everyone, stressing benefits, evaluating progress and giving feedback; confront resistant staff to elicit feelings.抗拒原因：從眾、習慣、恐懼、次級獲益、基本需求受威脅、價值差異。克服方法：全員參與、強調益處、持續評值與回饋；面質抗拒者以引導說出感受。
  • Conflict types: intrapersonal, interpersonal, organizational. Modes: avoidance, accommodation, competition, compromise (assertive and cooperative).衝突類型：個人內在、人際、組織。處理方式：迴避、順應、競爭、妥協（堅定且合作）。
PDF p.93, 94

Health care team and interprofessional collaboration醫療團隊與跨專業合作

  • Team roles: PHCP, PA, NP/APRN, PT, OT, respiratory therapist, speech therapist (swallowing), dietitian, continuing care nurse, pharmacist, social worker, chaplain, AP.團隊角色：醫師、PA、NP/APRN、物理治療師、職能治療師、呼吸治療師、語言治療師（吞嚥）、營養師、延續照護護理師、藥師、社工、牧靈人員、助理。
  • Reports: factual, accurate, complete, organized; change-of-shift reports may be at the bedside; transfer reports include name, diagnosis, status, needs, allergies, resuscitation status.報告：事實、準確、完整、有條理；交班可在床邊；轉送報告含姓名、診斷、狀況、需求、過敏與急救狀態。
  • SBAR: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. Telephone reports should be documented (when, who, what).SBAR：情況、背景、評估、建議。電話報告須記錄（時間、對象、內容）。
  • Consultation is sought when the problem exceeds nursing resources; rapid-response teams respond to early deterioration on non-ICU units to prevent arrest.問題超出護理資源時尋求會診；快速反應小組處理非加護單位早期惡化以預防心肺停止。
  • Medication reconciliation: compare current and new medication lists at transitions, resolve discrepancies, communicate the final list.藥物整合：在轉換照護時比對現用與新藥單、解決差異並傳達最終清單。
  • Discharge planning begins at admission; teach with teach-back about medications, diet, activity, complications, equipment, resources and follow-up.出院準備自入院即開始；以回述教導藥物、飲食、活動、併發症、設備、資源與追蹤。
PDF p.94, 95, 96

Delegation, assignments and time management委派、指派與時間管理

  • Delegation transfers a task to a competent person; the nurse keeps accountability. Five rights: task, circumstances, person, direction/communication, supervision/evaluation.委派是將任務交給有能力者；護理師仍負責任。五項正確：任務、情境、人員、指示/溝通、督導/評值。
  • Cannot delegate nursing judgment or critical decision making (assessment, teaching initiation, planning, evaluation).不可委派護理判斷或關鍵決策（評估、起始衛教、計畫、評值）。
  • AP: noninvasive tasks for stable clients. LPN/VN: stable clients, dressings, suctioning, catheterization, oral/SC/IM meds. RN: stable and unstable clients, IV meds, initial assessment and teaching.AP：穩定病人的非侵入性工作。LPN/VN：穩定病人、換藥、抽吸、導尿、口服/皮下/肌肉藥。RN：穩定與不穩定病人、靜脈給藥、初始評估與衛教。
  • Give clear directions, validate understanding, give feedback; match task to the nurse practice act and job description.指示清楚、確認理解、給予回饋；依護理執業法與職務說明配對任務。
  • Time management: list tasks, prioritize, begin rounds early, delegate, document concurrently, evaluate the day.時間管理：列出任務、排序、早班巡視、委派、同步記錄、評估當日。
PDF p.96, 97

Prioritizing care排定照護優先順序

  • Priorities are high (life-threatening), intermediate (nonemergency) or low (unrelated to illness); the client's own priorities count.優先順序分高（危及生命）、中（非緊急）、低（與疾病無直接關係）；病人自己的優先事項也要考量。
  • Use ABCs, Maslow and nursing process (assessment first); CPR uses CAB; actual problems before potential ones; act on critically abnormal values.使用 ABC、馬斯洛、護理過程（評估優先）；CPR 用 CAB；現存問題先於潛在問題；對嚴重異常值立即處理。
  • Group of clients: heart failure with 4-lb gain and dyspnea first, then fresh chest tube post-op, then absent bowel sounds, then pre-op teaching.多位病人：心衰竭體重增加 4 磅且呼吸喘者優先，其次術後胸管，其次腸音消失，最後術前衛教。
  • Teaching priorities: immediate needs, client's perceived needs, anxiety level, time available.衛教優先：立即需求、病人認為重要的事、焦慮程度、可用時間。
PDF p.97, 98

Disasters and emergency response災難與緊急應變

  • Internal disasters occur within the facility; external outside it; a mass casualty event exceeds hospital resources. Activate the emergency response plan immediately.內部災難發生於機構內；外部災難發生於機構外；大規模傷亡超出醫院資源。立即啟動緊急應變計畫。
  • FEMA phases: mitigation, preparedness, response, recovery; three disaster levels (I massive to III minor). ARC provides free relief, shelters and crisis counseling; HAZMAT teams handle exposures.FEMA 階段：減災、整備、應變、復原；災難三級（I 級重大至 III 級輕微）。紅十字會提供免費救援、庇護與危機諮商；HAZMAT 處理暴露事件。
  • Triage: START tags in 30-60 seconds; ED triage emergent (red, priority 1), urgent (yellow, priority 2), nonurgent (green, priority 3); black for expected deaths. Think survivability.檢傷：START 於 30-60 秒內分類；急診緊急（紅、第 1 優先）、次緊急（黃、第 2 優先）、非緊急（綠、第 3 優先）；黑色為預期死亡。思考可存活性。
  • Primary assessment (ABCs, check central pulse 5-10 seconds, agonal breathing needs ventilation) precedes secondary assessment (history, vital signs, neuro, pain, head-to-toe).初級評估（ABC、中心脈搏檢查 5-10 秒、瀕死喘息需通氣）先於次級評估（病史、生命徵象、神經、疼痛、頭到腳）。
  • Personal preparedness: 3-day supply of water (1 gallon per person per day) and food, medications, radio, flashlight, documents; replace water every 3 months and food every 6 months.個人整備：三天份飲水（每人每日 1 加侖）與食物、藥物、收音機、手電筒、證件；水每 3 個月、食物每 6 個月更換。
PDF p.98, 99, 100, 101, 102

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Airway first (ABCs); CPR uses CAB.先氣道（ABC）；CPR 用 CAB。 PDF p.98
  2. Delegate only tasks within the delegatee's scope; the delegating nurse stays accountable.只委派在被委派者範圍內的任務；委派的護理師仍負責任。 PDF p.96, 97
  3. Five rights of delegation: task, circumstances, person, direction/communication, supervision/evaluation.委派五正確：任務、情境、人員、指示/溝通、督導/評值。 PDF p.96
  4. Do not delegate assessment, teaching initiation, planning, evaluation or unstable clients.不可委派評估、起始衛教、計畫、評值或不穩定病人。 PDF p.96, 97
  5. AP tasks: ADLs, ambulation, skin care, collecting urine specimens, vitals on stable clients.AP 工作：日常生活照護、行走、皮膚照護、收集尿液檢體、穩定病人量生命徵象。 PDF p.97
  6. ED triage: chest pain, respiratory distress, trauma, acute neuro deficit, chemical eye splash = emergent (red).急診檢傷：胸痛、呼吸窘迫、外傷、急性神經缺損、眼睛化學物噴濺 = 緊急（紅）。 PDF p.101
  7. Think survivability when triaging disaster victims; treat those who can be saved first.災難檢傷時考量可存活性；先救治有存活機會者。 PDF p.101
  8. Closed chest-tube clients and unstable clients need assessment before stable teaching or discharge.胸管或不穩定病人須先於穩定病人的衛教或出院處理。 PDF p.98
  9. Team nursing: RN leader directs a team (LPNs and APs); functional is task-based; primary is one nurse per client.小組護理：RN 組長領導 LPN 與 AP；功能制按工作分配；責任制由一位護理師負責一位病人。 PDF p.89, 90
  10. SBAR: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation.SBAR：情況、背景、評估、建議。 PDF p.95
  11. Lewin: unfreezing, moving, refreezing; confront resisting staff to explore feelings.勒溫：解凍、移動、再凍結；面質抗拒者以探索感受。 PDF p.93, 94
  12. Medicare Part B covers 80%; client pays 20% unless supplemental insurance.Medicare B 部分給付 80%，其餘 20% 自付，除非有補充保險。 PDF p.89
  13. Rapid-response team: call early for signs of deterioration to prevent arrest.快速反應小組：出現惡化徵象時及早呼叫以預防心肺停止。 PDF p.96
  14. Disaster plan phases: mitigation, preparedness, response, recovery.災難計畫階段：減災、整備、應變、復原。 PDF p.99, 100
  15. Medication reconciliation at admission, transfer and discharge.在入院、轉床與出院時進行藥物整合。 PDF p.96
  16. Report impaired staff or short staffing to administration; never abandon an assignment.通報受物質影響的同事或人力不足；不可擅離工作。 PDF p.98

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Management functions P-O-D-C: Planning, Organizing, Directing, Controlling.管理功能 P-O-D-C：計畫、組織、指導、控制。 PDF p.91
  • Lewin: Unfreeze, Move, Refreeze.勒溫：解凍、移動、再凍結。 PDF p.93
  • ED triage colors: Red = emergent, Yellow = urgent, Green = nonurgent, Black = expected death.急診檢傷顏色：紅=緊急、黃=次緊急、綠=非緊急、黑=預期死亡。 PDF p.101

8 Fluids and Electrolytes體液與電解質

This chapter covers how water and electrolytes are distributed, moved and regulated, then walks through fluid volume deficit/excess and each major electrolyte imbalance (K+, Na+, Ca2+, Mg2+, phosphorus). For each one, know the normal range, common causes, assessment findings, ECG changes and the priority nursing interventions.本章說明水分與電解質在體內的分布、移動與調節,接著依序介紹體液容積不足與過多,以及主要電解質(鉀、鈉、鈣、鎂、磷)失衡。每一項都要熟記正常值、常見原因、評估發現、心電圖變化與優先護理措施。

Concepts of fluid and electrolyte balance體液與電解質平衡的基本概念

  • Electrolytes ionize in solution; cations are positive and anions negative, and they must balance. Activity is measured in milliequivalents (mEq).電解質在溶液中會解離成離子;陽離子帶正電、陰離子帶負電,兩者必須平衡,以毫當量(mEq)表示活性。
  • Fluid compartments: intracellular (about 70% of body water) and extracellular (about 30%), the latter split into interstitial (22%), intravascular (6%) and transcellular (2%).體液分區:細胞內液約佔 70%,細胞外液約佔 30%,其中組織間液 22%、血管內液 6%、跨細胞液 2%。
  • Third-spacing traps extracellular fluid in a body space (pleural, peritoneal, bowel, burned tissue); it is a real intravascular loss that may not show in weight or intake/output.第三間隙積液是指細胞外液被困在體腔(胸腔、腹腔、腸道、燒傷組織)中,實際造成血管內容積流失,但體重與輸出入量不一定反映。
  • Edema is excess interstitial fluid from altered oncotic or hydrostatic pressure, capillary permeability or lymphatic obstruction; generalized edema (anasarca) suggests cardiac, renal or liver disease.水腫是組織間液過多,源於膠體滲透壓、靜水壓、微血管通透性或淋巴阻塞改變;全身性水腫(anasarca)常見於心、腎或肝臟疾病。
  • Total body water is about 60% of weight in adults, 55% in older adults and 80% in infants, so infants and older adults are at greater risk for fluid imbalance.成人體水約佔體重 60%,老年人 55%,嬰兒 80%,因此嬰兒與老年人較易發生體液失衡。
PDF p.109, 110

Fluid transport and tonicity體液運輸與張力

  • Diffusion moves solute from high to low concentration; osmosis moves water toward the side with more solute; filtration moves fluid from higher to lower hydrostatic pressure.擴散是溶質由高濃度往低濃度移動;滲透是水往溶質較多的一側移動;過濾則是液體由高靜水壓往低靜水壓移動。
  • At the arterial end of a capillary hydrostatic pressure pushes fluid out; at the venous end osmotic pull draws fluid back; lymph returns the remainder.微血管動脈端靜水壓使液體流出,靜脈端滲透壓將液體拉回,剩餘部分由淋巴回收。
  • Normal plasma osmolality is 275-295 mOsm/kg.血漿滲透壓正常值為 275-295 mOsm/kg。
  • Isotonic solutions match body fluid osmolality (little osmosis); hypotonic solutions have lower and hypertonic solutions higher osmolality than body fluids.等張溶液與體液滲透壓相同(幾乎不產生滲透);低張溶液滲透壓較低,高張溶液較高。
  • Active transport moves ions (Na+, K+, Ca2+, H+) against a gradient and needs cellular energy.主動運輸需消耗細胞能量,使離子(Na+、K+、Ca2+、H+)逆濃度梯度移動。
PDF p.110, 111, 112

Fluid intake/output and regulation水分攝入、排出與調節

  • Intake is about 2300-2900 mL/day (drinks, food, metabolic water); output is about 2600-3000 mL/day, mostly kidney (about 1500 mL).每日攝入約 2300-2900 mL(飲水、食物、代謝水),排出約 2600-3000 mL,以腎臟最多(約 1500 mL)。
  • Insensible loss occurs through skin (600-800 mL) and lungs (400-600 mL) and cannot be measured exactly.不感性流失來自皮膚(600-800 mL)與肺部(400-600 mL),無法精確測量。
  • Kidneys are the major regulators; aldosterone retains sodium (and water), and ADH controls water reabsorption.腎臟是主要調節器官;醛固酮促進鈉(及水)再吸收,抗利尿激素(ADH)調節水分再吸收。
  • Severe diarrhea causes large fluid and electrolyte losses. With any imbalance, monitor cardiovascular, respiratory, neurological, musculoskeletal, renal, skin and GI status.嚴重腹瀉會造成大量體液與電解質流失。發生任何失衡時,須監測心血管、呼吸、神經、肌肉骨骼、腎臟、皮膚與腸胃狀態。
PDF p.112

Fluid volume deficit and excess體液容積不足與過多

  • Isotonic dehydration (hypovolemia) is the most common deficit: water and electrolytes are lost equally. Hypertonic: water loss exceeds electrolytes (cells shrink). Hypotonic: electrolyte loss exceeds water (cells swell).等張性脫水(低血容)最常見,水與電解質等比例流失;高張性脫水為水分流失多於電解質(細胞萎縮);低張性脫水為電解質流失多於水分(細胞腫脹)。
  • Deficit findings: tachycardia with thready pulse, hypotension, flat neck veins, low CVP, dry mucosa, poor turgor, weight loss, low urine output, high hematocrit/BUN/osmolality/urine specific gravity.容積不足表現:脈搏快而細弱、低血壓、頸靜脈扁塌、CVP 低、黏膜乾燥、皮膚彈性差、體重下降、尿量少,血比容、BUN、滲透壓與尿比重上升。
  • Excess findings: bounding pulse, high BP, distended neck veins, high CVP, crackles, dyspnea, edema, weight gain, ascites; low hematocrit/BUN/osmolality/urine specific gravity.容積過多表現:脈搏洪大、高血壓、頸靜脈怒張、CVP 高、囉音、呼吸困難、水腫、體重增加、腹水;血比容、BUN、滲透壓與尿比重下降。
  • Treat deficit with oral or IV fluids and treat the cause (isotonic loss with isotonic fluid, hypertonic with hypotonic, hypotonic with hypertonic fluid); monitor I&O.不足時給予口服或靜脈輸液並處理原因(等張流失用等張液、高張性用低張液、低張性用高張液),並監測輸出入量。
  • Treat excess with diuretics, fluid and sodium restriction, daily weight and I&O. Highest risk: AKI, CKD, heart failure, long-term corticosteroids.過多時給予利尿劑、限制水分與鈉攝取,監測每日體重與輸出入量。高風險族群:急性腎損傷、慢性腎病、心衰竭、長期使用類固醇者。
  • Hypotonic overhydration (water intoxication) occurs with SIADH, heart failure, early kidney disease, or hypotonic IV/irrigation fluids.低張性水過多(水中毒)見於 SIADH、心衰竭、早期腎病,或使用低張靜脈輸液/沖洗液。
PDF p.112, 113, 114

Potassium imbalances鉀離子失衡

  • Normal K+ is 3.5-5.0 mEq/L. Hypokalemia causes: diuretics, corticosteroids, albuterol, vomiting, diarrhea, NG suction, Cushing's, alkalosis, hyperinsulinism, NPO status.鉀正常值 3.5-5.0 mEq/L。低血鉀原因:利尿劑、類固醇、albuterol、嘔吐、腹瀉、鼻胃管抽吸、庫欣氏症、鹼中毒、高胰島素、禁食。
  • Hypokalemia findings: weak thready irregular pulse, shallow respirations, weakness and cramps, hypoactive bowel/paralytic ileus; ECG shows ST depression, flat/inverted T waves, prominent U waves.低血鉀表現:脈搏細弱不規則、呼吸淺、肌無力與抽筋、腸蠕動減弱/麻痺性腸阻塞;心電圖 ST 段下降、T 波平坦或倒置、U 波明顯。
  • Oral potassium: give with food/juice; liquid KCl tastes bad. IV potassium: always diluted, via infusion pump, never IV push, IM or subcutaneous.口服鉀劑須隨餐或加果汁服用;靜脈鉀劑一定要稀釋並使用輸液幫浦,絕不可靜脈推注、肌肉或皮下注射。
  • Hyperkalemia causes: K+ supplements or salt substitutes, K+-sparing diuretics, kidney disease, Addison's, tissue damage/burns, acidosis, stored blood.高血鉀原因:鉀補充劑或代鹽、保鉀利尿劑、腎病、愛迪生氏症、組織損傷/燒傷、酸中毒、庫存血。
  • Hyperkalemia findings: slow weak irregular pulse, hypotension, muscle weakness to ascending flaccid paralysis, hyperactive bowel/diarrhea; ECG shows tall peaked T, flat P, wide QRS, prolonged PR.高血鉀表現:心跳慢而弱且不規則、低血壓、肌無力甚至上行性弛緩性麻痺、腸蠕動亢進/腹瀉;心電圖 T 波高尖、P 波平坦、QRS 變寬、PR 間期延長。
  • Treat hyperkalemia: stop K+ intake, IV calcium (protect heart), insulin with glucose, sodium polystyrene sulfonate, K+-excreting diuretics, dialysis if critical.高血鉀處置:停止鉀攝入、靜脈鈣劑(保護心臟)、胰島素加葡萄糖、sodium polystyrene sulfonate、排鉀利尿劑,嚴重時透析。
PDF p.115, 116

Sodium imbalances鈉離子失衡

  • Normal Na+ is 135-145 mEq/L; sodium problems usually travel with fluid volume problems.鈉正常值 135-145 mEq/L;鈉失衡通常伴隨體液容積問題。
  • Hyponatremia causes: diaphoresis, diuretics, vomiting, diarrhea, SIADH, hypotonic fluids, heart failure, hyperglycemia, freshwater drowning.低血鈉原因:大量流汗、利尿劑、嘔吐、腹瀉、SIADH、低張液體、心衰竭、高血糖、淡水溺水。
  • Hyponatremia findings: headache, confusion, seizures, weakness, hyperactive bowel sounds, abdominal cramping, increased urine output, low urine specific gravity.低血鈉表現:頭痛、意識混亂、癲癇、無力、腸蠕動亢進、腹絞痛、尿量增加、尿比重降低。
  • Correct hyponatremia slowly; rapid correction risks osmotic demyelination. Hyponatremia can raise lithium levels toward toxicity.低血鈉須緩慢矯正,過快有滲透性去髓鞘病變風險;低血鈉亦可導致鋰中毒。
  • Hypernatremia causes: corticosteroids, Cushing's, hyperaldosteronism, excess sodium intake, low water intake, fever, watery diarrhea, diabetes insipidus.高血鈉原因:類固醇、庫欣氏症、高醛固酮症、鈉攝取過多、水分攝取不足、發燒、水瀉、尿崩症。
  • Hypernatremia findings: extreme thirst, dry sticky mucosa, flushed skin, agitation, confusion, seizures; high urine specific gravity. Altered cerebral function is the most common sign.高血鈉表現:極度口渴、黏膜乾而黏、皮膚潮紅、躁動、意識混亂、癲癇;尿比重上升。腦功能改變為最常見症狀。
PDF p.117, 118

Calcium imbalances鈣離子失衡

  • Normal calcium is 9-10.5 mg/dL. Corrected Ca = serum Ca + 0.8 x (4 - albumin). Ionized calcium normal is 4.64-5.28.鈣正常值 9-10.5 mg/dL。校正鈣 = 血清鈣 + 0.8 x (4 - 白蛋白)。離子鈣正常值 4.64-5.28。
  • Hypocalcemia causes: low intake or vitamin D, lactose intolerance, malabsorption (Crohn's, celiac), diarrhea, alkalosis, acute pancreatitis, hyperphosphatemia, hypoparathyroidism.低血鈣原因:攝取或維生素 D 不足、乳糖不耐、吸收不良(克隆氏症、乳糜瀉)、腹瀉、鹼中毒、急性胰臟炎、高血磷、副甲狀腺功能低下。
  • Hypocalcemia findings: tingling/numbness, twitching, cramps, tetany, seizures, hyperactive reflexes, positive Chvostek's and Trousseau's signs, increased GI motility; ECG prolonged ST and QT.低血鈣表現:麻刺感、抽搐、痙攣、手足僵直、癲癇、反射亢進、Chvostek 與 Trousseau 徵象陽性、腸蠕動增加;心電圖 ST 與 QT 延長。
  • Treat with oral calcium and vitamin D or slow warmed IV calcium (keep 10% calcium gluconate available), seizure precautions, quiet environment, careful handling (fracture risk).治療:口服鈣劑與維生素 D,或緩慢給予已加溫的靜脈鈣劑(備妥 10% 葡萄糖酸鈣)、癲癇防護、安靜環境、謹慎搬動(骨折風險)。
  • Hypercalcemia causes: hyperparathyroidism, hyperthyroidism, malignancy, immobility, thiazides, lithium, dehydration, excess calcium/vitamin D.高血鈣原因:副甲狀腺或甲狀腺功能亢進、惡性腫瘤、制動、thiazide 利尿劑、鋰、脫水、鈣/維生素 D 過量。
  • Hypercalcemia findings: muscle weakness, absent reflexes, constipation, anorexia, bradycardia/heart block; ECG shortened ST, widened T. Give isotonic saline, calcitonin, bisphosphonates; strain urine for stones.高血鈣表現:肌無力、反射消失、便秘、食慾差、心搏過緩/心臟傳導阻滯;心電圖 ST 縮短、T 波變寬。治療:等張生理食鹽水、calcitonin、雙磷酸鹽,並過濾尿液檢查結石。
PDF p.118, 119, 120

Magnesium imbalances鎂離子失衡

  • Normal magnesium is 1.8-2.6 mEq/L. Hypomagnesemia causes: malnutrition, alcoholism, diuretics, malabsorption, vomiting/diarrhea, insulin, sepsis.鎂正常值 1.8-2.6 mEq/L。低血鎂原因:營養不良、酒精中毒、利尿劑、吸收不良、嘔吐/腹瀉、胰島素、敗血症。
  • Hypomagnesemia findings: tachycardia, hypertension, hyperreflexia, tremors/twitching, tetany, seizures, positive Chvostek's/Trousseau's; often coexists with hypocalcemia.低血鎂表現:心跳快、高血壓、反射亢進、顫抖/抽搐、手足僵直、癲癇、Chvostek/Trousseau 陽性;常合併低血鈣。
  • IV magnesium sulfate is preferred in ill clients (IM is painful); monitor reflexes for loss, which signals toxicity.重症者以靜脈硫酸鎂補充(肌肉注射疼痛且傷組織);須監測深部肌腱反射,反射消失表示鎂過量。
  • Hypermagnesemia causes: Mg-containing antacids/laxatives, excess IV magnesium, renal insufficiency. Findings: bradycardia, hypotension, drowsiness, absent reflexes, respiratory depression; ECG prolonged PR, wide QRS.高血鎂原因:含鎂制酸劑/瀉劑、靜脈鎂過量、腎功能不全。表現:心跳慢、低血壓、嗜睡、反射消失、呼吸抑制;心電圖 PR 延長、QRS 變寬。
  • Antidote for magnesium overdose is IV calcium gluconate (or calcium chloride); diuretics increase excretion; avoid Mg-containing laxatives/antacids.鎂中毒的解毒劑為靜脈葡萄糖酸鈣(或氯化鈣);利尿劑促進排出;避免使用含鎂瀉劑與制酸劑。
PDF p.120, 121

Phosphorus imbalances磷離子失衡

  • Normal phosphorus is 3.0-4.5 mg/dL. Phosphorus and calcium have a reciprocal relationship: when one rises, the other falls.磷正常值 3.0-4.5 mg/dL。磷與鈣呈相反關係:一方上升,另一方下降。
  • Hypophosphatemia causes: malnutrition/starvation, hyperparathyroidism, malignancy, Mg- or aluminum-based antacids, hyperglycemia, respiratory alkalosis. Mild cases may be symptom-free.低血磷原因:營養不良/飢餓、副甲狀腺亢進、惡性腫瘤、含鎂或鋁的制酸劑、高血糖、呼吸性鹼中毒。輕度可能無症狀。
  • Treat hypophosphatemia with oral phosphorus plus vitamin D; IV phosphorus only when below 1 mg/dL with critical signs, given slowly after assessing renal function.低血磷以口服磷加維生素 D 治療;僅在低於 1 mg/dL 並有嚴重症狀時才靜脈給磷,須先評估腎功能並緩慢輸注。
  • Hyperphosphatemia causes: renal insufficiency, tumor lysis syndrome, hypoparathyroidism, phosphate laxatives/enemas. Its problems come from the resulting hypocalcemia.高血磷原因:腎功能不全、腫瘤溶解症候群、副甲狀腺功能低下、含磷瀉劑/灌腸劑。其問題主要來自隨之發生的低血鈣。
  • Give phosphate binders with or right after meals; limit high-phosphorus foods; avoid phosphate laxatives and enemas.磷結合劑須隨餐或餐後立即服用;減少高磷食物;避免含磷瀉劑與灌腸劑。
PDF p.121, 122

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Normal values: K+ 3.5-5.0; Na+ 135-145; Ca 9-10.5 mg/dL; Mg 1.8-2.6 mEq/L; phosphorus 3.0-4.5 mg/dL; osmolality 275-295 mOsm/kg.正常值:鉀 3.5-5.0;鈉 135-145;鈣 9-10.5 mg/dL;鎂 1.8-2.6 mEq/L;磷 3.0-4.5 mg/dL;滲透壓 275-295 mOsm/kg。 PDF p.111, 115, 117, 118, 120, 121
  2. IV potassium is never given by IV push, IM or subcutaneously; always dilute (max 1 mEq/10 mL), use a pump, 5-10 mEq/hr usual and never above 20 mEq/hr.靜脈鉀絕不可推注、肌肉或皮下注射;須稀釋(最多 1 mEq/10 mL)並用幫浦,常規 5-10 mEq/hr,絕不超過 20 mEq/hr。 PDF p.115, 116
  3. Over 10 mEq/hr of IV potassium requires cardiac monitoring; assess renal function and urine output (report under 30 mL/hr) and check IV site for phlebitis/infiltration.靜脈鉀超過 10 mEq/hr 需心電圖監測;須評估腎功能與尿量(低於 30 mL/hr 通報),並觀察注射部位有無靜脈炎/滲漏。 PDF p.116, 124
  4. Hyperkalemia ECG: tall peaked T, flat P, widened QRS, prolonged PR. Hypokalemia ECG: ST depression, flat/inverted T, prominent U.高血鉀心電圖:T 波高尖、P 波平坦、QRS 變寬、PR 延長。低血鉀:ST 下降、T 波平坦/倒置、U 波明顯。 PDF p.115, 116
  5. Severe hyperkalemia: stop K+, give IV calcium to protect the heart, insulin plus glucose to shift K+ into cells, then remove K+ (diuretics, sodium polystyrene sulfonate, dialysis).嚴重高血鉀:停鉀、靜脈鈣保護心臟、胰島素加葡萄糖使鉀移入細胞,再排除鉀(利尿劑、sodium polystyrene sulfonate、透析)。 PDF p.116
  6. Stored (older) blood releases potassium; give fresh blood when possible to a client with hyperkalemia.庫存較久的血液會釋出鉀;高血鉀患者輸血時盡量使用新鮮血。 PDF p.116
  7. Correct hyponatremia slowly to avoid osmotic demyelination; hyponatremia can precipitate lithium toxicity.低血鈉須緩慢矯正以避免滲透性去髓鞘;低血鈉會誘發鋰中毒。 PDF p.117
  8. Hypocalcemia signs: Chvostek's (facial twitch on tapping cheek) and Trousseau's (carpal spasm with BP cuff) signs, tetany, seizures, prolonged QT; keep 10% calcium gluconate available.低血鈣徵象:Chvostek(輕敲臉頰抽動)與 Trousseau(壓脈帶造成腕痙攣)、手足僵直、癲癇、QT 延長;備妥 10% 葡萄糖酸鈣。 PDF p.119, 120
  9. Correct calcium for low albumin: Ca + 0.8 x (4 - albumin), or check ionized calcium.低白蛋白時需校正鈣:鈣 + 0.8 x (4 - 白蛋白),或檢測離子鈣。 PDF p.119
  10. Calcium gluconate is the antidote for magnesium overdose; loss of deep tendon reflexes is an early sign of hypermagnesemia.葡萄糖酸鈣是鎂過量的解毒劑;深部肌腱反射消失是高血鎂的早期徵象。 PDF p.120, 121
  11. Calcium and phosphorus are reciprocal: high phosphorus lowers calcium, low phosphorus raises calcium.鈣與磷呈相反關係:磷高則鈣低,磷低則鈣高。 PDF p.121
  12. Fluid deficit: tachycardia, low BP, flat neck veins, weight loss, high hematocrit/BUN/specific gravity. Excess: bounding pulse, high BP, crackles, edema, weight gain, low hematocrit.容積不足:心跳快、低血壓、頸靜脈扁塌、體重下降、血比容/BUN/尿比重高。過多:脈搏洪大、高血壓、囉音、水腫、體重增加、血比容低。 PDF p.114
  13. Clients with AKI, CKD or heart failure are at high risk for fluid volume excess and hyperkalemia/hyperphosphatemia; vomiting, diarrhea, NG suction, ileostomy and diuretics cause deficits and hypokalemia.急性腎損傷、慢性腎病或心衰竭患者易有容積過多、高血鉀與高血磷;嘔吐、腹瀉、鼻胃管抽吸、迴腸造口與利尿劑易致不足與低血鉀。 PDF p.114, 115, 125
  14. Infants and older adults have a higher fluid-imbalance risk (total body water 80% and 55%).嬰兒與老年人體液失衡風險較高(體水量分別為 80% 與 55%)。 PDF p.110
  15. Moving clients with calcium or phosphorus imbalance carefully because of pathological fracture risk.鈣或磷失衡的患者須小心移動,以免病理性骨折。 PDF p.119, 120, 121

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Hyperkalemia ECG: 'Tall T, flat P, wide QRS' (peaked T waves, flat P waves, widened QRS). Hypokalemia is the opposite pattern: flat T, U wave appears ('U need K+').高血鉀心電圖口訣:「高 T、平 P、寬 QRS」。低血鉀相反:T 波平、出現 U 波(「U 需要 K+」)。 PDF p.115, 116
  • Hypocalcemia = 'CATS go numb': Convulsions, Arrhythmias, Tetany, Spasms (and numbness/tingling).低血鈣口訣「CATS」:Convulsions(癲癇)、Arrhythmias(心律不整)、Tetany(手足僵直)、Spasms(痙攣),並伴麻刺感。 PDF p.118, 119
  • Calcium-phosphorus seesaw: one goes up, the other goes down.鈣磷蹺蹺板:一個上升、另一個就下降。 PDF p.121
  • Fluid deficit vs excess: deficit = everything dry and low (low BP, low CVP, flat veins); excess = everything wet and high (high BP, high CVP, crackles).容積不足=乾而低(血壓低、CVP 低、靜脈扁);過多=濕而高(血壓高、CVP 高、囉音)。 PDF p.114

9 Acid-Base Balance酸鹼平衡

This chapter explains how the body holds pH at 7.35-7.45 using buffers, lungs, kidneys and potassium shifts, then covers the four primary acid-base disorders, their causes, signs and nursing care. It ends with ABG collection and the step-by-step method for interpreting ABGs, a staple of NCLEX questions.本章說明身體如何以緩衝系統、肺、腎與鉀離子移動將 pH 維持在 7.35-7.45,並介紹四種原發性酸鹼失衡的原因、徵象與護理處置,最後說明動脈血氣(ABG)採檢與逐步判讀法,這是 NCLEX 的常考重點。

Hydrogen ions, acids and bases氫離子、酸與鹼

  • Blood pH must stay between 7.35 and 7.45; below is acidosis, above is alkalosis.血液 pH 須維持在 7.35-7.45;低於此為酸中毒,高於此為鹼中毒。
  • Acids donate hydrogen ions and are end products of metabolism; bases accept hydrogen ions.酸是氫離子的提供者,為代謝終產物;鹼是氫離子的接受者。
  • Normal serum bicarbonate (HCO3-) is 21-28 mEq/L.血清碳酸氫根(HCO3-)正常值 21-28 mEq/L。
PDF p.128

Buffer systems緩衝系統

  • Buffers act fastest, giving immediate protection against pH change; once used up the body has less reserve.緩衝系統反應最快,能立即防止 pH 改變;用盡後身體的儲備就減少。
  • Extracellular buffers: hemoglobin (chloride shift), plasma proteins, carbonic acid-bicarbonate (the main buffer) and phosphate.細胞外緩衝系統包括血紅素(氯離子轉移)、血漿蛋白、碳酸-碳酸氫鹽(主要緩衝系統)與磷酸鹽。
  • Normal pH of 7.4 reflects a bicarbonate : carbonic acid ratio of 20:1; lungs control carbonic acid (CO2) and kidneys control bicarbonate.pH 7.4 代表碳酸氫根與碳酸比為 20:1;肺控制碳酸(CO2),腎控制碳酸氫根。
  • The underlying cause of any imbalance must be identified and treated.必須找出並治療酸鹼失衡的根本原因。
PDF p.128, 129

Lungs, kidneys and potassium肺、腎與鉀離子的調節

  • Lungs are the second defense and respond in 10-30 seconds: in acidosis rate and depth rise to blow off CO2; in alkalosis they fall to retain CO2.肺是第二道防線,10-30 秒內反應:酸中毒時呼吸加快加深以排出 CO2;鹼中毒時呼吸變慢變淺以留住 CO2。
  • Kidneys are slower (hours to days) but more thorough: they excrete H+ and retain HCO3- in acidosis, and excrete HCO3- in alkalosis.腎臟反應較慢(數小時至數天)但更完整:酸中毒時排 H+、留 HCO3-;鹼中毒時排 HCO3-。
  • Potassium shifts: in acidosis H+ enters cells and K+ leaves, causing hyperkalemia; in alkalosis K+ enters cells, causing hypokalemia.鉀離子移動:酸中毒時 H+ 進入細胞、K+ 移出,造成高血鉀;鹼中毒時 K+ 進入細胞,造成低血鉀。
  • Monitor potassium closely in any acid-base imbalance because of dysrhythmia risk.任何酸鹼失衡都須密切監測血鉀,因有心律不整風險。
PDF p.129, 130

Respiratory acidosis呼吸性酸中毒

  • Caused by hypoventilation with CO2 retention: COPD/emphysema, asthma, pneumonia, atelectasis, pulmonary edema or emboli, brain trauma, and CNS depressants (opioids, sedatives, anesthetics).因換氣不足導致 CO2 滯留:COPD/肺氣腫、氣喘、肺炎、肺不張、肺水腫或肺栓塞、腦外傷、中樞神經抑制劑(鴉片類、鎮靜劑、麻醉劑)。
  • Findings: lethargy, confusion, headache, dizziness, coma, hypotension, dysrhythmias (from hyperkalemia), warm flushed skin, seizures.表現:嗜睡、意識混亂、頭痛、頭暈、昏迷、低血壓、心律不整(高血鉀所致)、皮膚溫熱潮紅、癲癇。
  • Care: O2 as prescribed, semi-Fowler's position, turn/cough/deep-breathe, suction, respiratory treatments; avoid sedatives; prepare for intubation and ventilation if CO2 is above 50 mm Hg with acute distress.處置:依醫囑給氧、半坐臥、翻身咳嗽深呼吸、抽吸、呼吸治療;避免鎮靜劑;若 CO2 超過 50 mm Hg 且急性呼吸窘迫,準備插管與機械通氣。
PDF p.130, 131

Respiratory alkalosis呼吸性鹼中毒

  • Caused by overstimulated breathing: hyperventilation, anxiety, pain, fever, hypoxia, and over-ventilation by a mechanical ventilator.因呼吸過度刺激:換氣過度、焦慮、疼痛、發燒、缺氧,以及呼吸器過度換氣。
  • Findings: light-headedness, dizziness, confusion, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, nausea/vomiting, numbness and tingling of extremities, tetany, hyperreflexia, seizures.表現:輕飄感、頭暈、意識混亂、心跳快、心律不整、噁心嘔吐、四肢麻刺、手足僵直、反射亢進、癲癇。
  • Care: reassure, coach slow breathing, breath holding or rebreathing (paper bag/rebreather mask), adjust ventilator, calcium gluconate for tetany as prescribed.處置:安撫、指導緩慢呼吸、閉氣或再吸入(紙袋/再呼吸面罩)、調整呼吸器,依醫囑給葡萄糖酸鈣治療手足僵直。
PDF p.131

Metabolic acidosis代謝性酸中毒

  • Causes: diabetic ketoacidosis, aspirin overdose, lactic acidosis, malnutrition, high-fat diet, renal failure, severe diarrhea (loss of alkaline fluid).原因:糖尿病酮酸中毒、阿斯匹靈過量、乳酸中毒、營養不良、高脂飲食、腎衰竭、嚴重腹瀉(流失鹼性液體)。
  • Findings: lethargy, confusion, headache, hypotension, dysrhythmias, cold clammy skin, nausea/vomiting/diarrhea, and Kussmaul's respirations (deep, rapid).表現:嗜睡、意識混亂、頭痛、低血壓、心律不整、皮膚冰冷濕黏、噁心嘔吐腹瀉,以及 Kussmaul 呼吸(深快)。
  • Care: IV fluids and buffer base, monitor I&O and electrolytes; in DKA give insulin and fluid resuscitation; in kidney disease dialysis and a low-protein, high-calorie diet.處置:靜脈輸液與補充緩衝鹼、監測輸出入量與電解質;DKA 給予胰島素與輸液復甦;腎病則透析並採低蛋白高熱量飲食。
PDF p.131, 132

Metabolic alkalosis代謝性鹼中毒

  • Causes: excessive vomiting or NG suction (loss of HCl), diuretics, hyperaldosteronism, excess sodium bicarbonate, massive whole-blood transfusion (citrate becomes bicarbonate).原因:大量嘔吐或鼻胃管抽吸(流失鹽酸)、利尿劑、高醛固酮症、碳酸氫鈉過量、大量輸入全血(檸檬酸轉為碳酸氫鹽)。
  • Findings: dizziness, irritability, confusion, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, nausea/vomiting, tetany, tremors, tingling, muscle cramps, seizures; breathing becomes slow and shallow.表現:頭暈、易怒、意識混亂、心跳快、心律不整、噁心嘔吐、手足僵直、顫抖、麻刺、肌肉痙攣、癲癇;呼吸變慢變淺。
  • Care: IV fluids and medications to promote bicarbonate excretion, replace potassium as prescribed, monitor respiratory status.處置:依醫囑給予靜脈輸液與藥物促進碳酸氫根排出、補充鉀,並監測呼吸狀態。
PDF p.132, 133

ABG collection動脈血氣(ABG)採檢

  • Normal ABG: pH 7.35-7.45; PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg; HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L; PaO2 80-100 mm Hg (venous pH 7.31-7.41, PvO2 40-50).ABG 正常值:pH 7.35-7.45;PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg;HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L;PaO2 80-100 mm Hg(靜脈 pH 7.31-7.41、PvO2 40-50)。
  • Perform the Allen's test before radial puncture to confirm ulnar collateral flow; positive means immediate flushing after releasing the ulnar artery.橈動脈穿刺前先做 Allen 測試確認尺動脈側支循環;放開尺動脈後手掌立即變紅即為陽性。
  • Use a heparinized syringe, remove any air, press the site 5 minutes (10 if on anticoagulants), recheck the radial pulse, send on ice.使用含肝素針筒、排除空氣,穿刺後壓迫 5 分鐘(使用抗凝劑者 10 分鐘),再確認橈動脈搏動,冰浴送檢。
  • Record temperature and O2 delivery on the lab form; note recent suctioning (within 20 minutes) or O2 changes.檢驗單上註明體溫與給氧方式;留意 20 分鐘內是否抽痰或調整氧氣。
PDF p.133

Interpreting ABGs and compensationABG 判讀與代償

  • Step 1: pH low = acidosis, high = alkalosis. Step 2: if PaCO2 moves in the OPPOSITE direction to pH, it is respiratory. Step 3: if HCO3- moves in the SAME direction as pH, it is metabolic.步驟 1:pH 低為酸中毒、高為鹼中毒。步驟 2:PaCO2 與 pH 方向「相反」則為呼吸性。步驟 3:HCO3- 與 pH 方向「相同」則為代謝性。
  • Step 4: a normal pH (7.35-7.45) means full compensation; if pH is abnormal, check the other indicator: abnormal value = partial compensation, normal value = uncompensated.步驟 4:pH 回到 7.35-7.45 表示完全代償;pH 仍異常時,看另一指標:已異常為部分代償,仍正常為未代償。
  • Mixed disorders combine two problems (e.g., hyperventilation from pain plus gastric suction gives mixed alkalosis).混合性失衡為同時存在兩種問題(如疼痛致換氣過度加胃管抽吸造成混合性鹼中毒)。
  • Potassium is usually increased in acidosis and decreased in alkalosis.酸中毒時鉀通常上升,鹼中毒時鉀通常下降。
PDF p.133, 134

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Normal ABG: pH 7.35-7.45, PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg, HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L, PaO2 80-100 mm Hg.ABG 正常值:pH 7.35-7.45、PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg、HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L、PaO2 80-100 mm Hg。 PDF p.133
  2. Respiratory indicator is PaCO2; metabolic indicator is HCO3-.呼吸指標是 PaCO2;代謝指標是 HCO3-。 PDF p.134
  3. Respiratory imbalance: pH and PaCO2 move in opposite directions. Metabolic imbalance: pH and HCO3- move together.呼吸性失衡:pH 與 PaCO2 方向相反。代謝性失衡:pH 與 HCO3- 方向一致。 PDF p.134
  4. Full compensation = pH back within 7.35-7.45.完全代償 = pH 回到 7.35-7.45。 PDF p.134
  5. Respiratory acidosis: pH low, PaCO2 high. Respiratory alkalosis: pH high, PaCO2 low.呼吸性酸中毒:pH 低、PaCO2 高。呼吸性鹼中毒:pH 高、PaCO2 低。 PDF p.133
  6. Metabolic acidosis: pH low, HCO3- low. Metabolic alkalosis: pH high, HCO3- high.代謝性酸中毒:pH 低、HCO3- 低。代謝性鹼中毒:pH 高、HCO3- 高。 PDF p.134
