  7. Vomiting and NG suction cause metabolic alkalosis (HCl loss); severe diarrhea and DKA cause metabolic acidosis.嘔吐與鼻胃管抽吸造成代謝性鹼中毒(流失鹽酸);嚴重腹瀉與 DKA 造成代謝性酸中毒。 PDF p.132, 133
  8. COPD, hypoventilation and opioid/sedative overdose cause respiratory acidosis; avoid sedatives and opioids in these clients.COPD、換氣不足與鴉片類/鎮靜劑過量造成呼吸性酸中毒;此類患者應避免鎮靜劑與鴉片類。 PDF p.130, 131
  9. Kussmaul's respirations (deep and rapid) are the lungs' compensation for metabolic acidosis such as DKA.Kussmaul 呼吸(深而快)是肺對代謝性酸中毒(如 DKA)的代償。 PDF p.131, 136
  10. Acidosis raises serum K+ (hyperkalemia); alkalosis lowers it (hypokalemia). Watch for dysrhythmias.酸中毒使血鉀上升(高血鉀);鹼中毒使血鉀下降(低血鉀)。須留意心律不整。 PDF p.129, 130
  11. Lungs compensate in 10-30 seconds; kidneys take hours to days but are more complete.肺代償需 10-30 秒;腎臟需數小時至數天,但更完整。 PDF p.129
  12. Intubation/ventilation needed in respiratory acidosis when CO2 exceeds 50 mm Hg with acute respiratory distress.呼吸性酸中毒若 CO2 超過 50 mm Hg 並有急性呼吸窘迫,需準備插管與通氣。 PDF p.131
  13. Do an Allen's test before radial ABG puncture; after puncture hold pressure 5 min (10 min if anticoagulated).橈動脈採 ABG 前先做 Allen 測試;穿刺後壓迫 5 分鐘(使用抗凝劑 10 分鐘)。 PDF p.133
  14. Treat the underlying cause of every acid-base disorder and monitor level of consciousness, electrolytes and repeat ABGs.每種酸鹼失衡都要治療根本原因,並監測意識程度、電解質與追蹤 ABG。 PDF p.128, 130
  15. Hyperventilation from anxiety, pain or fever causes respiratory alkalosis; rebreathing (paper bag) and calm coaching help.焦慮、疼痛或發燒造成的換氣過度導致呼吸性鹼中毒;可用再吸入(紙袋)與安撫指導呼吸。 PDF p.131

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • ROME: Respiratory Opposite, Metabolic Equal (pH vs PaCO2 opposite = respiratory; pH vs HCO3- same direction = metabolic).ROME 口訣:呼吸性相反(Respiratory Opposite)、代謝性相同(Metabolic Equal)。pH 與 PaCO2 相反為呼吸性;pH 與 HCO3- 同向為代謝性。 PDF p.134
  • Tic-Tac-Toe ABG: place pH, PaCO2, HCO3- in a row and check which one matches the pH direction.ABG 判讀三格法:把 pH、PaCO2、HCO3- 排成一列,看哪一個與 pH 的方向吻合(酸中毒:pH 低,PaCO2 高 = 呼吸;HCO3- 低 = 代謝)。 PDF p.134
  • Vomiting = alkalosis (lose acid); diarrhea = acidosis (lose base).嘔吐=鹼中毒(失酸);腹瀉=酸中毒(失鹼)。 PDF p.132, 133

10 Vital Signs and Laboratory Reference Intervals生命徵象與檢驗參考值

This chapter covers how and when to measure temperature, pulse, respirations, blood pressure, oxygen saturation and pain, followed by pain-management interventions and drugs. It then lists high-yield laboratory reference intervals (electrolytes, coagulation studies, CBC, lipids, glucose/HbA1c, renal tests, WBC) with causes of abnormal results and nursing implications.本章說明體溫、脈搏、呼吸、血壓、血氧飽和度與疼痛的測量時機與方法,以及疼痛處置與藥物;接著列出常考的檢驗參考值(電解質、凝血功能、全血球計數、血脂、血糖/HbA1c、腎功能、白血球)及異常原因與護理意義。

Vital signs: principles and timing生命徵象:原則與測量時機

  • Vital signs are temperature, pulse, respirations, BP, pulse oximetry and pain; the first set is the baseline.生命徵象包括體溫、脈搏、呼吸、血壓、血氧飽和度與疼痛;第一次測量作為基準值。
  • Assistive personnel may measure routine vital signs, but the nurse interprets findings and reports abnormal values to the provider.輔助人員可測量常規生命徵象,但解讀結果並通報異常的責任在護理師。
  • Measure on admission, during assessment, before/after invasive or surgical procedures, with drugs affecting heart/lungs/temperature, before/during/after transfusion, with any change in condition, and every 2-4 hours with fever or infection.測量時機:入院、評估時、侵入性檢查或手術前後、使用影響心肺或體溫藥物時、輸血前中後、病情改變時,以及發燒或感染時每 2-4 小時。
  • Postoperative rising heart rate with falling BP and SpO2 suggests bleeding.術後心跳上升、血壓與血氧下降提示出血。
PDF p.139, 143

Temperature體溫

  • Normal range about 97.0-99.0 F (36.1-37.2 C); many settings define fever as 100.4 F (38 C) or higher.正常範圍約 97.0-99.0 F(36.1-37.2 C);許多機構以 100.4 F(38 C)以上定義為發燒。
  • Rectal readings run about 1 F higher; tympanic and axillary about 1 F lower than oral. Temperature is lowest on waking and peaks late afternoon/evening.肛溫約高 1 F;耳溫與腋溫約低 1 F。體溫起床時最低,傍晚到晚上最高。
  • Oral: wait 15-30 min after hot/cold food, smoking or gum; avoid with nasal congestion. Rectal: left side-lying, insert about 1.5 in (3.8 cm), 0.5 in in infants.口溫:進食冷熱食物、吸菸或嚼口香糖後等 15-30 分鐘;鼻塞者避免。肛溫:左側臥,插入約 1.5 吋(3.8 公分),嬰兒 0.5 吋。
  • No rectal temperatures in cardiac clients, rectal surgery, diarrhea, fecal impaction or bleeding risk. Axillary is least accurate. Temporal probe may go behind the earlobe if diaphoretic.心臟病患者、肛門手術後、腹瀉、糞便嵌塞或有出血風險者不量肛溫。腋溫最不準確。出汗時顳動脈探頭可置於耳垂後。
  • Conversion: F to C = (F - 32) x 5/9; C to F = C x 9/5 + 32.換算:攝氏 = (華氏 - 32) x 5/9;華氏 = 攝氏 x 9/5 + 32。
  • Inability to obtain a temperature should not be ignored; it may be hypothermia in infants or older adults.量不到體溫不可忽視,在嬰兒或老年人可能是低體溫。
PDF p.139, 140

Pulse and respirations脈搏與呼吸

  • Adult heart rate 60-100 bpm; assess rate, rhythm, strength and equality. Pulse grade: 4+ bounding, 3+ full, 2+ normal, 1+ weak, 0 absent.成人心率 60-100 次/分;評估速率、節律、強度與對稱性。脈搏分級:4+ 洪大、3+ 飽滿、2+ 正常、1+ 微弱、0 無。
  • Heart rate rises with exercise, pain, fever, emotions, stimulants, hypovolemia and hemorrhage; it slows with age and with depressant/cardiac drugs.運動、疼痛、發燒、情緒、興奮劑、血容不足與出血會使心率上升;年齡增加及抑制劑/心臟藥物使心率減慢。
  • Apical pulse (left midclavicular 5th intercostal space) is counted for 1 full minute for irregular pulse, cardiac disease, before digoxin or beta blockers, and in children under 2.心尖脈(左鎖骨中線第五肋間)須測滿 1 分鐘,適用於不規則脈搏、心臟疾病、給予 digoxin 或乙型阻斷劑前,及 2 歲以下兒童。
  • Pulse deficit = radial rate lower than apical rate; indicates poor perfusion/dysrhythmia; notify the provider.脈搏短絀 = 橈動脈脈率低於心尖脈率,表示周邊灌流不良或心律不整,須通報醫師。
  • Adult respiratory rate 12-20/min; count for 30 sec x 2 unless ill or irregular (then 1 full minute); assess rate, depth, pattern and sounds.成人呼吸 12-20 次/分;測 30 秒乘 2,若病重或不規則則測滿 1 分鐘;評估速率、深度、型態與呼吸音。
  • High CO2/low O2 raise the rate; head injury/raised ICP and opioids depress breathing.CO2 升高或 O2 降低使呼吸加快;頭部外傷/顱內壓上升及鴉片類藥物抑制呼吸。
PDF p.140, 141, 142

Blood pressure and pulse oximetry血壓與血氧飽和度

  • Adult categories: normal below 120/80; elevated 120-129 and under 80; stage 1 130-139 or 80-89; stage 2 at least 140 or 90; crisis over 180 and/or over 120.成人分類:正常低於 120/80;偏高 120-129 且舒張壓小於 80;第 1 期 130-139 或 80-89;第 2 期 140 以上或 90 以上;高血壓危象收縮壓大於 180 和/或舒張壓大於 120。
  • Orthostatic vitals: BP and pulse supine, sitting, standing, 1-3 minutes after each change.姿位性生命徵象:分別於平躺、坐、站姿測血壓與脈搏,每次改變姿勢後 1-3 分鐘測量。
  • Avoid cuffs on arms with IV, AV fistula/shunt, breast/axillary surgery or trauma. No smoking or exercise 30 min before; rest 5 min seated with feet flat.避免在有靜脈輸液、動靜脈瘻管/分流、乳房/腋下手術或外傷的手臂上量血壓。測前 30 分鐘勿吸菸或運動;坐姿雙腳平放休息 5 分鐘。
  • Too-small cuff gives a falsely high reading; too-large gives a falsely low reading. Systolic is Korotkoff phase 1; diastolic is phase 5.壓脈帶太小使讀數偏高,太大使讀數偏低。收縮壓為 Korotkoff 第 1 期,舒張壓為第 5 期。
  • SpO2 normal 95-100%; below 90% requires notifying the provider (except some chronic conditions). Nail polish, motion, hypotension, anemia and poor perfusion distort readings; do not use a cold extremity.SpO2 正常 95-100%;低於 90% 須通知醫師(部分慢性病患除外)。指甲油、移動、低血壓、貧血與灌流不良會影響讀數;勿選用冰冷的肢體。
PDF p.142, 143

Pain assessment and nonpharmacological care疼痛評估與非藥物處置

  • Pain types: acute, chronic noncancer, chronic episodic (migraine, sickle cell crisis), cancer, idiopathic.疼痛類型:急性、慢性非癌症、慢性間歇性(偏頭痛、鐮刀型紅血球危象)、癌症、特發性。
  • Pain is subjective; assess timing, location, severity, quality, aggravating and relieving factors. Use a 0-10 scale, or FACES/FLACC for children and nonverbal clients.疼痛為主觀感受;評估時間、位置、強度、性質、加重與緩解因素。使用 0-10 量表,兒童與無法言語者用 FACES/FLACC。
  • Older adults may show pain as sleep disturbance, gait change, withdrawal or depression; consider culture and beliefs.老年人疼痛可能表現為睡眠障礙、步態改變、社交減少或憂鬱;須考量文化與信仰。
  • Nonpharmacological: heat/cold (15-30 min with a barrier), massage, TENS, binders/elevation, distraction, relaxation, guided imagery, music, acupuncture, biofeedback.非藥物措施:冷熱敷(隔層布、15-30 分鐘)、按摩、TENS、束帶/抬高、分散注意力、放鬆、引導想像、音樂、針灸、生理回饋。
  • Ask about herbal remedies because of drug interactions.須詢問是否使用草藥,以免與藥物交互作用。
PDF p.143, 144, 145

Pharmacological pain management疼痛的藥物處置

  • NSAIDs/aspirin: gastric irritation, bleeding, sodium and water retention, tinnitus; take with food; avoid in ulcer disease; potentiate anticoagulants.NSAIDs/阿斯匹靈:胃刺激、出血、鈉水滯留、耳鳴;隨餐服用;潰瘍者避免;會加強抗凝劑作用。
  • Ibuprofen can cause hypoglycemia with oral antidiabetics and toxicity with calcium channel blockers.ibuprofen 與口服降血糖藥併用可能低血糖,與鈣離子阻斷劑併用有中毒風險。
  • Acetaminophen: main risk is hepatotoxicity; self-treatment no more than 10 days in adults (5 in children); antidote acetylcysteine.acetaminophen:主要風險為肝毒性;成人自行用藥不超過 10 天(兒童 5 天);解毒劑為 acetylcysteine。
  • Opioids: give 30-60 min before painful activity; hold and call if RR below 12 or bradycardia; check BP, sedation, bowel/bladder; keep naloxone, O2 and resuscitation equipment; use an infusion pump for continuous or PCA IV.鴉片類:於疼痛活動前 30-60 分鐘給予;呼吸低於 12 次/分或心搏過緩時暫停並通報;監測血壓、鎮靜程度、排便與排尿;備妥 naloxone、氧氣與急救設備;持續或 PCA 靜脈輸注須用輸液幫浦。
  • Adjuvants (amitriptyline, venlafaxine, gabapentin) help neuropathic pain.輔助藥物(amitriptyline、venlafaxine、gabapentin)有助於神經病變性疼痛。
PDF p.145, 146

Lab values: electrolytes and coagulation studies檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能

  • Sodium 135-145 mEq/L; potassium 3.5-5.0 mEq/L. Prolonged tourniquet or hemolysis can falsely raise potassium; do not draw from an arm with an infusion.鈉 135-145 mEq/L;鉀 3.5-5.0 mEq/L。止血帶綁太久或溶血會使鉀假性升高;勿由有輸液的手臂抽血。
  • aPTT normal 30-40 sec; therapeutic heparin is 1.5-2.5 times normal (about 45-100 sec). Start bleeding precautions if over 100 sec; draw 1 hr before the next intermittent dose.aPTT 正常 30-40 秒;使用肝素治療目標為正常的 1.5-2.5 倍(約 45-100 秒)。超過 100 秒啟動出血防範;間歇給藥者於下次劑量前 1 小時抽血。
  • PT 11-12.5 sec; INR 0.81-1.20; warfarin keeps PT at 1.5-2 times control. PT over 25 sec or INR over 3.0 on warfarin means bleeding precautions.PT 11-12.5 秒;INR 0.81-1.20;warfarin 使 PT 維持在對照值 1.5-2 倍。服用 warfarin 者 PT 超過 25 秒或 INR 超過 3.0 須啟動出血防範。
  • High vitamin K intake (green leafy vegetables) shortens PT and lowers warfarin effect.攝取大量維生素 K(深綠色葉菜)會縮短 PT、降低 warfarin 效果。
  • Platelets 150,000-400,000/mm3; low with chemotherapy, DIC, leukemia, hemorrhage; apply pressure to puncture sites 3-5 min.血小板 150,000-400,000/mm3;化療、DIC、白血病、出血時降低;穿刺處加壓 3-5 分鐘。
PDF p.146, 148, 149

Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能

  • Hemoglobin: male 14-18, female 12-16 g/dL. Hematocrit: male 42-52%, female 37-47%. Low in anemia and hemorrhage; hematocrit rises with dehydration and falls with overhydration.血紅素:男 14-18、女 12-16 g/dL。血比容:男 42-52%、女 37-47%。貧血與出血時降低;脫水使血比容上升,水過多則下降。
  • Lipids (fast 12-14 hr): total cholesterol under 200, LDL under 100, HDL over 60 mg/dL; triglycerides male 40-160, female 35-135 mg/dL.血脂(空腹 12-14 小時):總膽固醇低於 200、LDL 低於 100、HDL 高於 60 mg/dL;三酸甘油酯男 40-160、女 35-135 mg/dL。
  • Fasting glucose 70-99 mg/dL (fast 8-12 hr; hold morning insulin/oral agents until drawn). HbA1c reflects 3-4 months: normal under 5.7%, prediabetes 5.7-6.4%, diabetes 6.5% or more.空腹血糖 70-99 mg/dL(禁食 8-12 小時;抽血前暫停早晨胰島素/口服藥)。HbA1c 反映 3-4 個月血糖控制:正常低於 5.7%,糖尿病前期 5.7-6.4%,糖尿病 6.5% 以上。
  • Creatinine: male 0.6-1.2, female 0.5-1.1 mg/dL (specific for renal function). BUN 10-20 mg/dL; raised by dehydration, GI bleeding, renal disease.肌酸酐:男 0.6-1.2、女 0.5-1.1 mg/dL(腎功能的專一指標)。BUN 10-20 mg/dL;脫水、消化道出血、腎病時升高。
  • WBC 5,000-10,000/mm3; left shift (more immature neutrophils) suggests bacterial infection. Monitor WBC/differential in chemotherapy clients for neutropenia and infection.白血球 5,000-10,000/mm3;左移(未成熟嗜中性球增加)提示細菌感染。化療患者須監測白血球及分類以防嗜中性球低下與感染。
PDF p.149, 150, 151

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Adult norms: HR 60-100, RR 12-20, BP below 120/80, SpO2 95-100%; report SpO2 below 90%.成人正常值:心率 60-100、呼吸 12-20、血壓低於 120/80、SpO2 95-100%;SpO2 低於 90% 須通報。 PDF p.141, 142, 143
  2. Apical pulse for 1 full minute before digoxin and beta blockers, with irregular pulse or heart disease, and in children under 2.給予 digoxin 與乙型阻斷劑前、脈搏不規則或心臟病、及 2 歲以下兒童,須測心尖脈滿 1 分鐘。 PDF p.141
  3. Pulse deficit (radial lower than apical) indicates ineffective contractions; notify provider.脈搏短絀(橈動脈低於心尖)表示心臟收縮無效,須通報醫師。 PDF p.141
  4. Cuff too small = falsely high BP; too large = falsely low. Avoid arm with IV, fistula, mastectomy side or trauma.壓脈帶太小血壓偏高;太大偏低。避開有輸液、瘻管、乳房切除側或外傷的手臂。 PDF p.142, 143
  5. No rectal temperatures with cardiac disease, rectal surgery, diarrhea, impaction or bleeding risk; no oral temperature with nasal congestion.心臟病、肛門手術、腹瀉、糞便嵌塞或出血風險者不量肛溫;鼻塞者不量口溫。 PDF p.140, 152
  6. Opioids: hold and notify if RR under 12 or bradycardia; keep naloxone available; assess 30 min after dose.鴉片類:呼吸低於 12 次/分或心搏過緩時暫停並通報;備妥 naloxone;給藥後 30 分鐘評估效果。 PDF p.146
  7. Acetaminophen's major risk is hepatotoxicity; antidote acetylcysteine.acetaminophen 主要風險為肝毒性;解毒劑為 acetylcysteine。 PDF p.145
  8. NSAIDs increase bleeding, especially with warfarin; avoid with ulcer disease; ibuprofen with antidiabetics (hypoglycemia) or calcium channel blockers (toxicity).NSAIDs 增加出血風險,尤其合併 warfarin;潰瘍者避免;ibuprofen 與降血糖藥(低血糖)或鈣離子阻斷劑(中毒)併用須通報。 PDF p.145, 152
  9. Heparin: aPTT target 1.5-2.5 x normal (about 45-100 sec); over 100 sec = bleeding precautions and notify provider.肝素:aPTT 目標為正常 1.5-2.5 倍(約 45-100 秒);超過 100 秒須啟動出血防範並通報。 PDF p.148, 153
  10. Warfarin: PT 1.5-2 x control, INR therapeutic about 2-3; PT over 25 sec or INR over 3.0 = bleeding precautions and hold dose per provider.Warfarin:PT 為對照值 1.5-2 倍、INR 治療範圍約 2-3;PT 超過 25 秒或 INR 超過 3.0 須啟動出血防範並依醫囑暫停劑量。 PDF p.148, 151
  11. Potassium 3.5-5.0: report low values before giving furosemide to a cardiac client (ventricular dysrhythmia risk).鉀 3.5-5.0:心臟病患給 furosemide 前若血鉀偏低須通報(有心室心律不整風險)。 PDF p.153
  12. Platelets 150,000-400,000; low counts in chemotherapy, DIC, leukemia; institute bleeding precautions per agency threshold.血小板 150,000-400,000;化療、DIC、白血病時偏低;依機構閾值啟動出血防範。 PDF p.149
  13. HbA1c: 6.5% or higher is diabetes; 8% means chronic hyperglycemia, so teach prevention and recognition of hyperglycemia.HbA1c 6.5% 以上為糖尿病;8% 表示長期高血糖,須教導預防與辨識高血糖。 PDF p.150, 152
  14. BUN 10-20 and creatinine 0.6-1.2 (male); BUN falls with adequate rehydration; creatinine is the more specific renal marker.BUN 10-20、肌酸酐(男)0.6-1.2;補液充足時 BUN 下降;肌酸酐為較專一的腎功能指標。 PDF p.150, 152
  15. Neutropenic precautions for low WBC (e.g., 2000/mm3); monitor WBC with chemotherapy.白血球偏低(如 2000/mm3)須採嗜中性球低下防護;化療期間監測白血球。 PDF p.151, 152
  16. Lipid profile requires fasting 12-14 hr (water only) and no alcohol for 24 hr; fasting glucose requires 8-12 hr.血脂檢驗需空腹 12-14 小時(僅可喝水)且 24 小時內不飲酒;空腹血糖需禁食 8-12 小時。 PDF p.149

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Pulse grading 0-4+: 0 absent, 1+ weak, 2+ normal, 3+ full/increased, 4+ bounding.脈搏分級 0-4+:0 無、1+ 微弱、2+ 正常、3+ 飽滿、4+ 洪大。 PDF p.141
  • Heparin multiplies aPTT (30-40 sec) by 1.5-2.5; warfarin multiplies PT by 1.5-2 ('Heparin = aPTT, Warfarin = PT/INR').肝素看 aPTT(30-40 秒)乘 1.5-2.5 倍;warfarin 看 PT/INR 乘 1.5-2 倍(「肝素 aPTT、華法林 PT/INR」)。 PDF p.148
  • Opioid safety check: RR below 12/min = hold (under-12 rule); also sedation, pulse, BP.鴉片類安全檢核:呼吸低於 12 次/分即暫停(低於 12 規則),並檢查鎮靜程度、脈搏與血壓。 PDF p.146

11 Nutrition營養

This chapter reviews macronutrients, vitamins, minerals and water, markers of malnutrition, healthy-eating guidance, nutrition across the life span, and each therapeutic diet (liquid, soft, fiber, cardiac, renal, protein-, sodium- and potassium-modified, and others), plus vegetarian diets and enteral feeding. Expect NCLEX items asking which foods a client should choose or avoid.本章複習巨量營養素、維生素、礦物質與水分、營養不良指標、健康飲食原則、各生命階段營養,以及各類治療性飲食(流質、軟質、纖維、心臟、腎臟、蛋白質/鈉/鉀調整等)、素食與管灌飲食。NCLEX 常考「患者應選擇或避免哪些食物」。

Nutrients: carbohydrates, fats, proteins營養素:醣類、脂肪、蛋白質

  • Carbohydrates (4 kcal/g) are the preferred fuel for brain and muscle; sources include milk, grains, fruits and vegetables.醣類(4 kcal/g)是腦與肌肉偏好的能量來源;來源包括奶類、穀類、水果與蔬菜。
  • Fats (9 kcal/g) store energy, protect organs, keep body warm and carry fat-soluble vitamins; deficiency of essential fatty acids causes cold intolerance, skin lesions, infection risk and amenorrhea.脂肪(9 kcal/g)儲存能量、保護器官、維持體溫並協助吸收脂溶性維生素;必需脂肪酸缺乏會導致怕冷、皮膚病變、易感染與閉經。
  • Proteins (4 kcal/g) build and repair tissue, balance fluids and acid-base, make antibodies, enzymes and hormones.蛋白質(4 kcal/g)建構與修復組織、調節體液與酸鹼、製造抗體、酵素與荷爾蒙。
  • Complete proteins contain all essential amino acids; inadequate protein causes protein-energy malnutrition and wasting.完全蛋白質含所有必需胺基酸;蛋白質不足會造成蛋白質熱量營養不良與肌肉脂肪消耗。
  • Pregnancy, lactation, infancy, childhood and adolescence have special needs; aging also changes needs.懷孕、哺乳、嬰兒期、兒童期與青春期有特殊需求;老化也會改變營養需求。
PDF p.156

Vitamins, minerals and water維生素、礦物質與水

  • Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) are stored and can reach toxic levels; water-soluble (B vitamins, C) are excreted in urine.脂溶性維生素(A、D、E、K)會儲存,過量可中毒;水溶性維生素(B 群、C)隨尿液排出。
  • Vitamin sources: B12 in meat/liver; folic acid in leafy greens and liver; C in citrus, tomatoes, broccoli; K in green leafy and cruciferous vegetables; thiamine in pork, legumes, nuts, whole grains.維生素來源:B12 在肉類/肝臟;葉酸在綠葉蔬菜與肝臟;C 在柑橘、番茄、花椰菜;K 在綠葉與十字花科蔬菜;硫胺素(B1)在豬肉、豆類、堅果、全穀。
  • Mineral sources: calcium (dairy, tofu, greens); iron (red meat, liver, dried beans/fruits, fortified cereals); potassium (bananas, citrus, potatoes, melon, meats); magnesium (greens, nuts, legumes); sodium (table salt, processed foods).礦物質來源:鈣(乳製品、豆腐、綠葉蔬菜);鐵(紅肉、肝臟、乾豆/乾果、強化穀片);鉀(香蕉、柑橘、馬鈴薯、哈密瓜、肉類);鎂(綠葉蔬菜、堅果、豆類);鈉(食鹽、加工食品)。
  • Water is 60-70% of body weight; survival without it is limited to a few days.水佔體重 60-70%;缺水僅能存活數天。
PDF p.156, 157, 158

Malnutrition markers and healthy eating營養不良指標與健康飲食

  • Short-term protein status: retinol-binding protein, prealbumin, transferrin, creatinine, BUN. Long-term protein status: serum albumin. Nitrogen balance uses urinary urea.短期蛋白質狀態:視黃醇結合蛋白、前白蛋白、運鐵蛋白、肌酸酐、BUN。長期蛋白質狀態:血清白蛋白。氮平衡以尿中尿素評估。
  • CBC with indices helps separate anemias from nutritional deficiencies.全血球計數與紅血球指數有助區分貧血與營養缺乏。
  • Always assess ability to eat and swallow and support independence in eating.務必評估進食與吞嚥能力,並盡量促進自行進食。
  • MyPlate/Dietary Guidelines teaching: half the plate fruits and vegetables, at least half of grains whole, low-fat milk, varied proteins, less sodium/saturated fat/added sugar, water instead of sugary drinks.MyPlate/飲食指南教導:半盤水果與蔬菜、至少一半穀類為全穀、低脂奶、多樣蛋白質、減少鈉/飽和脂肪/添加糖、以水取代含糖飲料。
  • Consider culture, spiritual beliefs and personal choices when planning diets.規劃飲食時須考量文化、宗教與個人選擇。
PDF p.157, 158

Nutrition across the life span生命各階段的營養

  • Infants: breast/chest-feeding exclusively about 6 months; add new foods one at a time, 4-7 days apart; no cow's milk before 1 year; no honey or corn syrup before 1 year (botulism).嬰兒:約 6 個月純母乳;新食物一次一種、間隔 4-7 天;1 歲前不喝牛奶;1 歲前不吃蜂蜜或玉米糖漿(肉毒桿菌風險)。
  • Toddlers: more than 24 oz milk/day risks milk anemia; avoid choking hazards (hot dogs, grapes, nuts, popcorn, candy, raw vegetables); finger foods build independence.幼兒:每日牛奶超過 24 盎司有「牛奶貧血」風險;避免噎塞食物(熱狗、葡萄、堅果、爆米花、糖果、生菜);手抓食物可培養獨立。
  • School-age: watch high fat/sugar/salt snacks and childhood obesity; adolescents need more protein, calcium and iron and are at risk for eating disorders.學齡兒童:留意高脂/糖/鹽零食與肥胖;青少年需要更多蛋白質、鈣與鐵,且是飲食障礙好發期。
  • Pregnancy: protein 60 g/day, more calcium, iron and folic acid. Lactation: about 500 extra kcal/day, plenty of fluids, avoid alcohol and caffeine.懷孕:蛋白質每日 60 公克,增加鈣、鐵與葉酸。哺乳:每日約多 500 大卡、足量水分,避免酒精與咖啡因。
  • Older adults: lower energy needs, reduced taste, smell and thirst, dental changes; ensure calcium and vitamin D; discourage grapefruit with many medications.老年人:能量需求下降、味覺嗅覺與口渴感減退、牙齒變化;確保鈣與維生素 D;許多藥物不宜與葡萄柚併用。
PDF p.159

Liquid and texture-modified diets流質與質地調整飲食

  • Clear liquid: water, broth, clear juice, gelatin, ice pops, carbonated drinks, tea/coffee; short-term only; deficient in calories and nutrients. Dairy and opaque juices are not clear; avoid red/purple dye before colon exams.清流質:水、清湯、澄清果汁、果凍、冰棒、碳酸飲料、茶/咖啡;僅短期使用,熱量與營養不足。乳製品與不透明果汁不算清流質;腸道檢查前避免紅/紫色染料。
  • Weight change of 1 kg equals about 1 L of fluid gained or lost; monitor I&O and weight on liquid diets.體重變化 1 公斤約等於 1 公升水分增減;流質飲食期間須監測輸出入量與體重。
  • Full liquid adds milk, ice cream, pudding, custard, strained soups and cereals; use supplements if used more than 3 days.全流質加入牛奶、冰淇淋、布丁、卡士達、過濾湯品與精製穀粥;使用超過 3 天需營養補充品。
  • Mechanical soft: pureed, ground or chopped foods for chewing difficulty or dysphagia; avoid nuts, dried and raw fruits/vegetables, fried and tough meats.機械軟質:將食物打泥、絞碎或切碎,適用咀嚼困難或吞嚥困難;避免堅果、乾果、生蔬果、油炸與粗硬肉類。
  • Soft diet: for mouth sores, oral surgery, jaw fracture, stroke; serve cooler foods for mouth sores; avoid nuts/seeds, raw produce, fried foods and whole grains; no straw for dysphagia.軟質飲食:適用口腔潰瘍、口腔手術、下顎骨折、中風;口腔潰瘍給較涼的食物;避免堅果/種子、生蔬果、油炸與全穀類;吞嚥困難者不可使用吸管。
PDF p.157, 158, 159, 160

Fiber and cardiac-related diets纖維與心臟相關飲食

  • Low-fiber (low-residue) for IBD, partial obstruction, gastroenteritis, diarrhea: white bread, refined cereals, white rice, peeled potatoes; avoid raw fruits (except bananas), nuts, seeds, whole grains.低纖維(低渣)飲食適用發炎性腸道疾病、部分腸阻塞、腸胃炎、腹瀉:白麵包、精製穀片、白飯、去皮馬鈴薯;避免生水果(香蕉除外)、堅果、種子、全穀。
  • High-fiber 20-35 g/day for constipation, IBS and asymptomatic diverticular disease; increase gradually with plenty of fluids; limit gas-forming foods.高纖維每日 20-35 公克,適用便秘、大腸激躁症與無症狀憩室疾病;須漸進增加並大量喝水;限制易產氣食物。
  • Cardiac/DASH diet: restrict sodium, cholesterol and fats; fruits, vegetables, whole grains, low-fat dairy, fish, poultry, nuts.心臟/DASH 飲食:限制鈉、膽固醇與脂肪;多吃蔬果、全穀、低脂乳品、魚、禽肉、堅果。
  • Fat-restricted diet for malabsorption, pancreatitis, gallbladder disease, GERD; fecal fat above 6-8 g/day indicates malabsorption.限脂飲食適用吸收不良、胰臟炎、膽囊疾病、胃食道逆流;糞便脂肪每日超過 6-8 公克表示脂肪吸收不良。
  • High-calorie, high-protein diet for burns, cancer, HIV, COPD, wound healing; use calorie counts.高熱量高蛋白飲食適用燒傷、癌症、HIV、COPD、傷口癒合;可做熱量計算。
PDF p.160, 161

Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食

  • Carbohydrate-consistent diet (carb counting) for diabetes; Diabetes Plate: half nonstarchy vegetables, quarter lean protein, quarter complex carbohydrate, water.固定醣類飲食(醣類計算)適用糖尿病;糖尿病餐盤法:一半非澱粉蔬菜、四分之一瘦蛋白質、四分之一複合醣類,飲水。
  • Sodium restriction for hypertension, heart failure, renal, liver disease: under 2,300 mg/day, ideally 1,500. Avoid processed, canned, smoked, pickled foods and effervescent medicines; salt substitutes contain potassium and are not for renal disease.限鈉適用高血壓、心衰竭、腎臟與肝臟疾病:每日低於 2,300 mg,理想 1,500 mg。避免加工、罐頭、燻製、醃漬食品與發泡錠藥物;代鹽含鉀,腎病患者不可用。
  • Protein restriction (40-60 g/day) for renal disease and end-stage liver disease: use high-biological-value protein and enough calories so protein is not burned for energy.限制蛋白質(每日 40-60 公克)適用腎病與末期肝病:選擇高生物價蛋白質並確保足夠熱量,避免蛋白質被當作能量。
  • Renal diet controls protein, sodium, phosphorus, calcium, potassium and fluids; peritoneal dialysis is less restrictive than hemodialysis. Weigh daily as the priority indicator of fluid status.腎臟飲食控制蛋白質、鈉、磷、鈣、鉀與水分;腹膜透析比血液透析寬鬆。每日量體重是評估水分狀態的優先指標。
  • Thirst relief with fluid restriction: sugar-free gum or hard candy, frozen fluids, lemon in water, cold mouth rinse.限水時緩解口渴:無糖口香糖或硬糖、冰凍液體、水中加檸檬、冷漱口水。
PDF p.161, 162, 163

Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets鉀、鈣、普林與高鐵飲食

  • Low-potassium diet for hyperkalemia (renal failure, Addison's, ACE inhibitors, K+-sparing diuretics): applesauce, green beans, cabbage, lettuce, grapes, blueberries.低鉀飲食適用高血鉀(腎衰竭、愛迪生氏症、ACE 抑制劑、保鉀利尿劑):蘋果泥、四季豆、高麗菜、萵苣、葡萄、藍莓。
  • High-potassium diet for hypokalemia (diarrhea, vomiting, K+-depleting diuretics, Cushing's, steroids).高鉀飲食適用低血鉀(腹瀉、嘔吐、排鉀利尿劑、庫欣氏症、類固醇)。
  • High-calcium diet for bone growth and osteoporosis prevention; lactose-intolerant clients need nondairy calcium sources.高鈣飲食用於骨骼生長與預防骨質疏鬆;乳糖不耐者需攝取非乳製品鈣來源。
  • Low-purine diet for gout, kidney stones, high uric acid: avoid anchovies, herring, mackerel, sardines, scallops, organ meats, gravies, game.低普林飲食適用痛風、腎結石、高尿酸:避免鯷魚、鯡魚、鯖魚、沙丁魚、干貝、內臟、肉汁、野味。
  • High-iron diet for anemia (organ meats, meat, egg yolk, whole wheat, dark leafy greens, dried fruit, legumes); take vitamin C with iron to improve absorption.高鐵飲食適用貧血(內臟、肉類、蛋黃、全麥、深綠葉菜、乾果、豆類);鐵與維生素 C 併用可增加吸收。
PDF p.163

Vegetarian diets and enteral nutrition素食與管灌營養

  • Vegan: no animal products; lacto-vegetarian adds dairy; lacto-ovo adds dairy and eggs; ovo-vegetarian adds eggs only.純素:不含任何動物性產品;乳素加乳製品;蛋奶素加乳製品與蛋;蛋素僅加蛋。
  • Possible deficiencies: energy, protein, vitamin B12, zinc, iron, calcium, omega-3, vitamin D; B12 is most likely lacking in vegans.可能缺乏:熱量、蛋白質、維生素 B12、鋅、鐵、鈣、omega-3、維生素 D;純素者最容易缺乏 B12。
  • Teach complementary proteins across the day; eat iron plus vitamin C together; soy protein is comparable to animal protein.教導一天內搭配互補蛋白質;鐵與維生素 C 同餐;大豆蛋白品質與動物性蛋白相當。
  • BMI = weight (kg) / height (m) squared.BMI = 體重(公斤)/ 身高(公尺)平方。
  • Enteral nutrition: for a working GI tract when oral intake is inadequate (dysphagia, burns, trauma, organ failure, severe malnutrition); use lactose-free formula for lactose intolerance.管灌營養:適用腸胃道功能正常但口服攝取不足(吞嚥困難、燒傷、創傷、器官衰竭、嚴重營養不良);乳糖不耐者用無乳糖配方。
PDF p.163, 164

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Calories per gram: carbohydrate 4, protein 4, fat 9.每公克熱量:醣類 4、蛋白質 4、脂肪 9 大卡。 PDF p.156
  2. Short-term protein status = prealbumin/transferrin; long-term = albumin.短期蛋白質狀態看前白蛋白/運鐵蛋白;長期看白蛋白。 PDF p.157
  3. Vegans most often lack vitamin B12 (naturally found almost exclusively in animal products).純素者最常缺乏維生素 B12(天然來源幾乎僅存在於動物性食品)。 PDF p.164, 165
  4. Iron-deficiency anemia: iron foods plus vitamin C (oranges, leafy greens); avoid coffee and tea with iron foods.缺鐵性貧血:鐵質食物搭配維生素 C(柳橙、綠葉蔬菜);避免與咖啡、茶同時攝取。 PDF p.163, 164
  5. Clear liquids are transparent; dairy, pudding, custard and pureed foods are not.清流質為透明液體;乳製品、布丁、卡士達與泥狀食物不屬於清流質。 PDF p.158, 159, 165
  6. Sodium limit under 2,300 mg/day (ideal 1,500); smoked, cured, canned and processed foods are high in sodium.鈉攝取每日低於 2,300 mg(理想 1,500);燻製、醃製、罐頭與加工食品含鈉高。 PDF p.162, 166
  7. Salt substitutes contain potassium; avoid in renal disease.代鹽含鉀;腎病患者避免使用。 PDF p.162
  8. Renal/hemodialysis diet: limit sodium, potassium, phosphorus, fluid and (controlled) protein; weigh daily.腎臟/血液透析飲食:限制鈉、鉀、磷、水分並控制蛋白質;每日量體重。 PDF p.162, 163
  9. Protein restriction 40-60 g/day, but keep calories adequate and protein high biological value.限制蛋白質每日 40-60 公克,但須維持足夠熱量並選用高生物價蛋白。 PDF p.162
  10. Infants: no honey or corn syrup under 1 year (botulism); no cow's milk before 1 year; introduce one new food every 4-7 days.嬰兒:1 歲前不給蜂蜜或玉米糖漿(肉毒桿菌);1 歲前不喝牛奶;每 4-7 天新增一種食物。 PDF p.159
  11. Toddler choking hazards: hot dogs, grapes, nuts, popcorn, hard candy, raw vegetables.幼兒噎塞危險食物:熱狗、葡萄、堅果、爆米花、硬糖、生蔬菜。 PDF p.159
  12. Pregnancy: protein 60 g/day, folic acid, iron, calcium. Lactation: +500 kcal/day, avoid alcohol/caffeine.懷孕:蛋白質 60 公克/日、葉酸、鐵、鈣。哺乳:每日多 500 大卡,避免酒精/咖啡因。 PDF p.159
  13. Low-purine diet for gout/stones: avoid sardines, anchovies, herring, mackerel, organ meats, gravies.痛風/結石低普林飲食:避免沙丁魚、鯷魚、鯡魚、鯖魚、內臟、肉汁。 PDF p.163
  14. Fiber diets: low-fiber for diarrhea/IBD/partial obstruction; high-fiber 20-35 g/day for constipation, introduced gradually with fluids.纖維飲食:腹瀉/發炎性腸病/部分阻塞用低纖維;便秘用高纖維每日 20-35 公克,須漸進並搭配水分。 PDF p.160
  15. Dysphagia: assess swallowing, thicken liquids as prescribed, no straws; all clients: assess ability to eat and swallow.吞嚥困難:評估吞嚥、依醫囑增稠液體、不用吸管;所有患者皆須評估進食與吞嚥能力。 PDF p.157, 160
  16. Grapefruit and grapefruit juice alter absorption of many medications; discourage in older adults on prescriptions.葡萄柚與葡萄柚汁會改變多種藥物吸收;服藥的老年人應避免。 PDF p.159

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Fat-soluble vitamins: 'ADEK' (stored, toxic in excess); B and C are water-soluble (excreted).脂溶性維生素「ADEK」(可儲存、過量中毒);B 群與 C 為水溶性(排出體外)。 PDF p.156
  • Calories: 4-4-9 (carbs 4, protein 4, fat 9).熱量「4-4-9」:醣類 4、蛋白質 4、脂肪 9。 PDF p.156
  • Diabetes Plate: 1/2 nonstarchy vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 complex carbs.糖尿病餐盤:1/2 非澱粉蔬菜、1/4 瘦蛋白質、1/4 複合醣類。 PDF p.162

12 Health and Physical Assessment of the Adult Client成人健康評估與身體評估

This chapter covers the interview setting, health history, mental status, the four assessment techniques, and a system-by-system physical assessment (skin through rectum), with normal findings, key abnormal findings, tests such as Snellen, Romberg, Brudzinski and Kernig, cranial nerves, and client teaching. It closes with documentation principles.本章涵蓋會談環境、健康史、心智狀態、四種評估技術,以及由皮膚到直腸的各系統身體評估,包括正常與重要異常發現、Snellen、Romberg、Brudzinski、Kernig 等檢查、腦神經與衛教,最後說明記錄原則。

Interview, setting and SOAP notes會談、環境與 SOAP 記錄

  • Ensure privacy, comfort, good lighting and no interruptions; sit at eye level without barriers such as a desk; use open-ended questions and therapeutic communication.確保隱私與舒適、光線充足、避免打擾;坐在與患者視線同高處、避免桌子等阻隔;使用開放式問句與治療性溝通。
  • Consider culture, language (use a professional interpreter, not family), values, eye contact and touch.考量文化、語言(使用專業口譯人員,不要由家屬代譯)、價值觀、眼神接觸與觸碰。
  • Assessment types: complete (baseline), focused (a limited problem), episodic/follow-up (progress), emergency (rapid, during lifesaving care).評估類型:完整(基準資料)、聚焦(特定問題)、階段性/追蹤(評估進展)、緊急(搶救中快速收集資料)。
  • SOAP = Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan. History of present illness uses OLDCARTS (onset, location, duration, character, aggravating, relieving, timing, severity).SOAP = 主觀、客觀、評估、計畫。現病史以 OLDCARTS 分析(開始、位置、持續、性質、加重、緩解、時間、嚴重度)。
  • Health history: general state of health, chief complaint (client's own words), family and social history, and domestic violence screening done privately.健康史:整體健康狀態、主訴(記錄患者原話)、家族史與社會史,以及在私下進行的家庭暴力篩檢。
PDF p.168, 169, 170, 171

Mental status and assessment techniques心智狀態與評估技術

  • Mental status: appearance, behavior and level of consciousness, facial expression, speech, and cognitive function (orientation, attention, recent and remote memory, new learning, judgment, thought processes).心智狀態:外觀、行為與意識程度、表情、言語,以及認知功能(定向感、注意力、近期與遠期記憶、新學習、判斷力、思考過程)。
  • Order of techniques: inspection, palpation, percussion, auscultation; for the abdomen use inspection, auscultation, percussion, palpation.技術順序:視診、觸診、扣診、聽診;腹部則為視診、聽診、扣診、觸診。
  • Palpation: warm hands, light then deep, tender areas last. Percussion notes: resonance, hyperresonance, tympany, dullness, flatness.觸診:手保持溫暖、先輕後深、疼痛處最後。扣診音:清音、過度清音、鼓音、濁音、平音。
  • Vital signs, height, weight and nutritional status are part of the physical exam.生命徵象、身高、體重與營養狀態屬於身體評估的一部分。
PDF p.168, 169, 172

Integumentary system皮膚系統

  • Assess color, temperature, moisture, turgor, texture, lesions, edema, hair and nails; use a Wood's light for some lesions.評估顏色、溫度、濕度、彈性、質地、病灶、水腫、毛髮與指甲;部分病灶可用伍氏燈。
  • In dark skin: check lips/tongue (gray = cyanosis), nail beds/palms/soles (blue), conjunctivae for pallor, oral mucosa and sclera near the iris for jaundice.深色皮膚:看嘴唇/舌頭(灰色=發紺)、甲床/手掌/腳底(藍色)、結膜是否蒼白、口腔黏膜與靠近虹膜的鞏膜是否黃疸。
  • Capillary refill returns within 3 seconds when perfusion is normal. Poor turgor suggests severe dehydration or weight loss.灌流正常時微血管再充填在 3 秒內。皮膚彈性差提示嚴重脫水或體重過度減輕。
  • Pitting edema scale: 1+ slight, 2+ about 4 mm (10-15 s), 3+ deep (over a minute), 4+ very deep (2-5 min) with gross distortion.凹陷性水腫分級:1+ 輕微、2+ 約 4 mm(10-15 秒)、3+ 深(超過 1 分鐘)、4+ 非常深(2-5 分鐘)且肢體明顯變形。
  • Teach monthly skin self-exam with ABCDE: asymmetry, border, color, diameter over 6 mm, evolving; avoid sun exposure.教導每月皮膚自我檢查 ABCDE:不對稱、邊緣不規則、顏色不均、直徑大於 6 mm、變化中;避免曝曬。
PDF p.169, 170, 172

Head, neck and lymph nodes頭、頸與淋巴結

  • Inspect/palpate skull and face, temporal arteries, frontal and maxillary sinuses; TMJ movement tests cranial nerve V.視診/觸診頭骨與臉部、顳動脈、額竇與上頜竇;顳顎關節活動測試第 V 對腦神經。
  • Test cranial nerve XI by chin and shoulder-shrug against resistance. The trachea should be midline.以抵抗阻力轉頭與聳肩測試第 XI 對腦神經。氣管應位於中線。
  • Thyroid: inspect while the client swallows, palpate anterior-posterior; a normal thyroid is usually not palpable; auscultate for a bruit if enlarged.甲狀腺:吞嚥時視診、由前後方觸診;正常甲狀腺通常摸不到;若腫大需聽診是否有血管雜音。
  • Palpate lymph nodes gently with circular finger pads, both sides, from preauricular down to supraclavicular; note size, shape, mobility, consistency, tenderness.以指腹輕柔畫圈觸診淋巴結,雙側比較,由耳前往下到鎖骨上;記錄大小、形狀、活動度、硬度與壓痛。
  • Never move the neck if a neck injury is suspected.懷疑頸部受傷時,絕不可活動頸部。
PDF p.172, 173

Eyes眼睛

  • Inspect eyebrows, lashes, lids (ptosis), globes (exophthalmos/enophthalmos), conjunctiva (clear), sclera (white), cornea, iris.檢查眉毛、睫毛、眼瞼(下垂)、眼球(突眼/眼球內陷)、結膜(清澈)、鞏膜(白色)、角膜、虹膜。
  • Snellen chart: 20 feet, one eye at a time, keep distance glasses on; normal 20/20; tests cranial nerve II. Near vision normal 14/14. Confrontation tests peripheral vision.Snellen 視力表:距離 20 呎、單眼測試、保留遠視眼鏡;正常 20/20;測試第 II 對腦神經。近視力正常 14/14。對面法測周邊視野。
  • Corneal light reflex checks eye alignment; cover/uncover detects slight deviation; six cardinal positions test cranial nerves III, IV, VI and look for nystagmus.角膜光反射檢查眼軸平行;遮蓋/去遮蓋測微小斜視;六個基本注視方向測試第 III、IV、VI 對腦神經並觀察眼震。
  • Ishihara chart tests red-green color vision. PERRLA: pupils equal, round, reactive to light (direct and consensual) and accommodation.Ishihara 圖測紅綠色覺。PERRLA:瞳孔等大、圓形、對光(直接與間接)及調節有反應。
  • Ophthalmoscopy in a darkened room: red reflex; absent reflex may mean lens opacity; optic disc creamy yellow-orange to pink with distinct margins. Teach regular eye exams.眼底鏡檢查在暗室進行:觀察紅反射,缺失可能表示水晶體混濁;視神經盤為乳黃橘至粉紅色且邊緣清晰。教導定期眼科檢查。
PDF p.173, 174, 175

Ears, nose, mouth and throat耳、鼻、口與喉

  • Conductive hearing loss: obstruction to sound transmission. Sensorineural: cochlea, cranial nerve VIII or brain defect. Mixed: both.傳導性聽損:聲波傳導受阻。感覺神經性聽損:耳蝸、第 VIII 對腦神經或腦部缺損。混合性:兩者並存。
  • Whisper test (1-2 ft, one ear at a time) and ticking-watch test screen hearing; Weber/Rinne tuning-fork tests are less sensitive.耳語測試(1-2 呎、一次一耳)與滴答錶測試用於篩檢聽力;Weber/Rinne 音叉測試敏感度較低。
  • Otoscope: check canal for foreign body, never insert blindly; in adults pull the pinna up and back; normal drum is pearly gray with cone of light at 5 o'clock (right) and 7 o'clock (left). Clean ears with a washcloth, never cotton swabs.耳鏡:先檢查耳道有無異物,絕不盲目插入;成人將耳廓向上向後拉;正常鼓膜為珍珠灰,光錐在右耳 5 點、左耳 7 點。以濕毛巾清潔,勿用棉花棒。
  • Vestibular tests: Romberg (positive = marked sway), past pointing, gaze nystagmus, Dix-Hallpike.前庭檢查:Romberg(明顯搖晃為陽性)、指向偏差、凝視眼震、Dix-Hallpike。
  • Nose/sinuses: check patency, septum, sinus tenderness. Mouth/throat: lips, teeth, gums, tongue, buccal mucosa, palates, uvula (rises midline with 'ahh', CN X), tonsil grade 0-4+, tongue protrusion midline (CN XII), gag reflex (CN IX).鼻/竇:檢查通暢度、鼻中隔、竇壓痛。口/喉:嘴唇、牙齒、牙齦、舌、頰黏膜、顎、懸雍垂(發「啊」時居中上抬,第 X 對)、扁桃腺分級 0-4+、伸舌居中(第 XII 對)、作嘔反射(第 IX 對)。
PDF p.175, 176, 177

Lungs肺部

  • Record smoking in pack-years (packs per day x years). Screen for infectious respiratory illness (fever, cough, dyspnea, loss of taste/smell, exposure).吸菸史以包年記錄(每日包數 x 年數)。篩檢感染性呼吸道疾病(發燒、咳嗽、呼吸困難、味覺/嗅覺喪失、接觸史)。
  • Palpate chest excursion (symmetrical, thumbs separate about 2 inches/5 cm) and tactile fremitus ('ninety-nine').觸診胸廓擴張(對稱,雙拇指分開約 2 吋/5 公分)與觸覺震顫(說「九十九」)。
  • Percussion: resonance is normal; hyperresonance means excess air; dullness means density. Auscultate with the diaphragm, side to side, apices down; avoid breast tissue.扣診:清音為正常;過度清音表示空氣過多;濁音表示組織密度增加。以膜面聽診、左右對比、由肺尖往下;避開乳房組織。
  • Normal breath sounds: vesicular, bronchovesicular, bronchial (over trachea). Adventitious: fine crackles (end inspiration), coarse crackles, wheeze (high-pitched, asthma), rhonchi (low snoring), pleural friction rub.正常呼吸音:肺泡音、支氣管肺泡音、支氣管音(氣管上方)。異常音:細囉音(吸氣末)、粗囉音、哮鳴音(高音調、氣喘)、鼾音(低音調)、胸膜摩擦音。
  • Voice sounds (bronchophony, egophony, whispered pectoriloquy) are tested when pathology is suspected; teach smoking cessation and pneumonia/influenza vaccines.懷疑病變時測聲音傳導(支氣管語音、羊音、耳語胸音);教導戒菸與肺炎/流感疫苗。
PDF p.177, 178, 179

Heart and peripheral vascular system心臟與周邊血管

  • Apical impulse at the 4th-5th intercostal space, medial to the midclavicular line. Heart areas: aortic 2nd RICS, pulmonic 2nd LICS, Erb's point 3rd LICS, tricuspid 4th LICS, mitral 5th LMCL.心尖搏動位於第 4-5 肋間、鎖骨中線內側。聽診區:主動脈瓣右第 2 肋間、肺動脈瓣左第 2 肋間、Erb 點左第 3 肋間、三尖瓣左第 4 肋間、二尖瓣左鎖骨中線第 5 肋間。
  • S1 'lub' and S2 'dub' are normal; a murmur is a blowing or swooshing sound. Grades I-VI: grade IV and above have a palpable thrill.S1「lub」與 S2「dub」為正常;心雜音是吹風或嘶嘶聲。分級 I-VI:IV 級以上可摸到震顫。
  • Palpate only one carotid at a time. A carotid bruit signals turbulence or blockage: notify the provider and monitor neurological status.一次只觸診一側頸動脈。頸動脈雜音表示血流擾動或阻塞:通報醫師並監測神經功能。
  • Assess pulses for equality and force (0-4+), calf circumference and pretibial edema; use Doppler if pulse not palpable.評估脈搏對稱性與強度(0-4+)、小腿圍與脛前水腫;摸不到脈搏時用都卜勒。
PDF p.179, 180, 181

Breasts and abdomen乳房與腹部

  • Breast inspection with arms raised, hands on hips, and leaning forward; palpate supine with arm behind head and small pillow under shoulder, using pads of three fingers; one breast is often larger; axillary nodes are normally not palpable.乳房視診採舉手過頭、雙手叉腰、前傾姿勢;觸診平躺、同側手置頭後、肩下墊小枕,以三指指腹檢查;兩側常不一樣大;腋下淋巴結正常摸不到。
  • Teach breast self-exam and report lumps immediately.教導乳房自我檢查,發現腫塊須立即通報。
  • Abdomen: empty bladder, warm hands, painful areas last; order is inspection, auscultation, percussion, palpation.腹部:先排尿、手保持溫暖、疼痛處最後;順序為視診、聽診、扣診、觸診。
  • Bowel sounds: high-pitched gurgles 5-30 per minute, start in RLQ; listen 5 minutes before calling them absent. Tympany predominates; dullness over liver/spleen; costovertebral tenderness suggests kidney problem.腸蠕動音:高音調咕嚕聲每分鐘 5-30 次,從右下腹開始;判定消失前須聽 5 分鐘。以鼓音為主;肝脾上方為濁音;肋脊角壓痛提示腎臟問題。
  • Light palpation about 1 cm then deep 5-8 cm; the aortic pulsation expands laterally with an aneurysm.淺觸診約 1 公分、深觸診 5-8 公分;若有動脈瘤,主動脈搏動會向兩側擴張。
PDF p.180, 181, 182

Musculoskeletal and neurological systems肌肉骨骼與神經系統

  • Inspect gait, posture and spinal curves (lordosis, kyphosis, scoliosis); active and passive ROM; muscle strength 0-5 (5 = full range against gravity and full resistance).檢查步態、姿勢與脊椎彎曲(脊柱前凸、後凸、側彎);主動與被動關節活動度;肌力 0-5 級(5 級=可抗重力與完全阻力)。
  • Neuro exam: level of consciousness (Glasgow Coma Scale), pupils, motor, cerebellar (tandem gait, Romberg), coordination (rapid alternating movements, finger-to-nose, heel-to-shin), sensory (pain, light touch, position, stereognosis, graphesthesia).神經檢查:意識程度(格拉斯哥昏迷指數)、瞳孔、運動、小腦功能(直線行走、Romberg)、協調(快速輪替動作、指鼻、跟脛測試)、感覺(痛覺、輕觸、位置覺、實體覺、書寫覺)。
  • Cranial nerves: I smell, II vision, III/IV/VI eye movement, V face sensation and chewing, VII face movement and taste, VIII hearing and balance, IX/X swallowing and gag, XI shoulder shrug, XII tongue.腦神經:I 嗅覺、II 視覺、III/IV/VI 眼球運動、V 臉部感覺與咀嚼、VII 臉部運動與味覺、VIII 聽覺與平衡、IX/X 吞嚥與作嘔、XI 聳肩、XII 舌頭。
  • Deep tendon reflexes 0-4+ (2+ normal). Babinski's sign (great toe dorsiflexion with toe fanning) is abnormal over age 2 and indicates CNS disease.深部肌腱反射 0-4+(2+ 正常)。Babinski 徵象(大拇趾背屈、其餘腳趾散開)在 2 歲以上為異常,提示中樞神經疾病。
  • Meningeal irritation: Brudzinski (neck flexion makes hips and knees flex) and Kernig (pain when the flexed leg is extended).腦膜刺激徵象:Brudzinski(屈頸時髖膝不自主彎曲)與 Kernig(彎曲的腿伸直時疼痛)。
  • Teaching: calcium and vitamin D foods, avoid joint strain, keep normal weight; wear helmets and seat belts.衛教:攝取含鈣與維生素 D 食物、避免關節勞損、維持正常體重;戴安全帽與繫安全帶。
PDF p.182, 183, 184, 185, 186

Genitalia, rectum and documentation生殖器、直腸與記錄

  • Female exam: calm approach, empty bladder, lithotomy position; the nurse prepares and assists. Speculum exam permits Pap/HPV screening; bimanual exam checks uterus and adnexa. Check for cystocele and rectocele.女性檢查:態度平穩、先排尿、截石位;護理師負責準備與協助。窺陰器檢查可做 Pap/HPV 篩檢;雙合診檢查子宮與附屬器。注意膀胱膨出與直腸膨出。
  • Male exam: inspect penis and scrotum (left testicle normally hangs lower), check inguinal canal for hernia with cough. Teach testicular self-exam on the same day monthly, after a warm bath or shower.男性檢查:檢查陰莖與陰囊(左側睪丸通常較低)、咳嗽時檢查腹股溝管有無疝氣。教導每月固定日期在溫水沐浴後做睪丸自我檢查。
  • Rectal exam: lithotomy or bent-forward (or left lateral) position; assess sphincter tone, masses and prostate (firm without nodules; hard nodules suggest cancer, boggy or tender suggests infection). Teach high-fiber, low-fat diet and screening.直腸檢查:截石位或前彎(或左側臥)姿勢;評估括約肌張力、腫塊與前列腺(堅實無結節;硬結提示癌症,鬆軟或壓痛提示感染)。教導高纖低脂飲食與篩檢。
  • Teach STI prevention and that partners need evaluation.教導預防性傳染病,並告知伴侶須接受檢查。
  • Documentation is a legal record: accurate, concise, complete, legible, objective; chart as soon as possible after assessment and protect confidentiality.記錄為法律文件:須準確、簡潔、完整、清晰、客觀;評估後儘快記錄並保護隱私。
PDF p.186, 187

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Use a professional interpreter, not family or staff, for clients who need language services.需要語言協助的患者,應使用專業口譯人員,而非家屬或一般職員。 PDF p.168, 188, 189
  2. Order of assessment: inspection, palpation, percussion, auscultation; abdomen: inspection, auscultation, percussion, palpation.評估順序:視診、觸診、扣診、聽診;腹部:視診、聽診、扣診、觸診。 PDF p.169, 182
  3. Focused assessment targets the presenting problem (e.g., cough: lungs, temperature, respirations); complete assessment is the baseline.聚焦評估針對主訴(如咳嗽:肺部、體溫、呼吸);完整評估為基準資料。 PDF p.169, 189, 190
  4. Capillary refill within 3 seconds is normal; pitting edema graded 1+ to 4+.微血管再充填 3 秒內為正常;凹陷性水腫分 1+ 至 4+。 PDF p.172
  5. Never perform neck movement if a neck injury is suspected.懷疑頸部受傷時,絕不可活動頸部。 PDF p.173
  6. Snellen 20/20 tests cranial nerve II; six cardinal positions test III, IV, VI (extraocular muscle weakness); PERRLA documents normal pupils.Snellen 20/20 測第 II 對腦神經;六個基本注視方向測第 III、IV、VI 對(眼外肌無力);PERRLA 記錄正常瞳孔。 PDF p.173, 174, 188, 189
  7. Never insert an otoscope blindly; in adults pull the pinna up and back; never use cotton-tipped applicators in the ear.絕不盲目插入耳鏡;成人將耳廓向上向後拉;耳道勿使用棉花棒。 PDF p.175, 176
  8. Conductive hearing loss = physical obstruction to sound transmission; sensorineural = cochlea/CN VIII/brain.傳導性聽損=聲波傳導受阻;感覺神經性=耳蝸/第 VIII 對腦神經/大腦。 PDF p.175, 188, 189
  9. Positive Romberg = significant sway with feet together and eyes closed (balance/vestibular/cerebellar problem).Romberg 陽性=雙腳併攏閉眼時明顯搖晃(平衡/前庭/小腦問題)。 PDF p.176, 183, 189
  10. Wheezes (asthma, narrowed airways); fine crackles at end of inspiration (HF, pneumonia); rhonchi clear with coughing; pleural friction rub is not cleared by cough.哮鳴音(氣喘、氣道狹窄);吸氣末細囉音(心衰竭、肺炎);鼾音咳嗽後可能消失;胸膜摩擦音咳嗽無法消除。 PDF p.179, 190
  11. Carotid bruit: notify the provider and monitor neurological status; palpate carotids one at a time.頸動脈雜音:通報醫師並監測神經狀態;頸動脈一次只觸診一側。 PDF p.180, 181
  12. Absent bowel sounds can only be declared after listening 5 minutes; normal is 5-30/min.須聽診 5 分鐘才能判定腸蠕動音消失;正常為每分鐘 5-30 次。 PDF p.182
  13. Babinski's sign is abnormal after age 2 (CNS disease); positive Brudzinski/Kernig indicates meningeal irritation (meningitis).Babinski 徵象在 2 歲後為異常(中樞神經疾病);Brudzinski/Kernig 陽性表示腦膜刺激(腦膜炎)。 PDF p.185, 186, 190
  14. Cheyne-Stokes respirations: rhythmic breathing with periods of apnea.Cheyne-Stokes 呼吸:有規律的呼吸伴隨呼吸暫停期。 PDF p.188, 189
  15. Testicular self-exam: same day each month, after a warm shower or bath; breast self-exam and report lumps immediately.睪丸自我檢查:每月同一天、溫水沐浴後;乳房自我檢查,發現腫塊立即通報。 PDF p.181, 187, 190
  16. Pack-years = packs per day x years smoked (e.g., 0.5 pack x 20 years = 10 pack-years).包年 = 每日包數 x 吸菸年數(例如 0.5 包 x 20 年 = 10 包年)。 PDF p.177

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • OLDCARTS for symptom analysis: Onset, Location, Duration, Character, Aggravating, Relieving, Timing, Severity.OLDCARTS 症狀分析:Onset 開始、Location 位置、Duration 持續、Character 性質、Aggravating 加重、Relieving 緩解、Timing 時間、Severity 嚴重度。 PDF p.170
  • PERRLA: Pupils Equal, Round, Reactive to Light and Accommodation.PERRLA:瞳孔等大、圓形、對光與調節有反應。 PDF p.174
  • ABCDE of melanoma: Asymmetry, Border, Color, Diameter over 6 mm, Evolving.黑色素瘤 ABCDE:不對稱、邊緣、顏色、直徑大於 6 mm、變化。 PDF p.172
  • Abdominal assessment order: 'I Auscultate Pain Properly' = Inspect, Auscultate, Percuss, Palpate.腹部評估順序:視診、聽診、扣診、觸診(先聽診以免觸診改變腸蠕動)。 PDF p.182

13 Safety and Infection Control安全與感染控制

This chapter covers environmental safety (fire, electrical, radiation, sharps), fall prevention, restraints, poisoning, health care-associated infections, standard and transmission-based precautions, and bioterrorism/disaster response. Most questions ask what to do FIRST and which precaution or PPE fits the organism.本章涵蓋環境安全（火災、用電、輻射、尖銳物）、預防跌倒、約束、中毒、醫療照護相關感染、標準與傳播途徑預防措施，以及生物恐怖攻擊與災難應變。考題多半問「首先做什麼」，以及何種疾病應採用哪種隔離措施與個人防護裝備。

Fire and Electrical Safety火災與用電安全

  • Know exits, alarms, extinguisher locations and the agency evacuation plan; never use elevators in a fire; turn off oxygen and nearby appliances.熟悉出口、警報器、滅火器位置及機構疏散計畫；火災時不可搭電梯；關閉附近氧氣與電器。
  • Clients on life support are bagged manually with an Ambu bag until moved away from the danger.使用維生設備的個案，在移離危險區前以甦醒球（Ambu bag）人工維持呼吸。
  • Evacuation order: ambulatory clients walk out first, then wheelchair, then bedridden clients by bed/stretcher.疏散順序：可自行行走者先走，其次輪椅，臥床者以床或擔架移送。
  • Extinguisher classes: A ordinary combustibles, B flammable liquids, C electrical, D metals, K cooking oils/fats.滅火器類別：A 一般可燃物、B 易燃液體、C 電器、D 可燃金屬、K 烹飪油脂。
  • Electrical: use grounded three-prong plugs (third longer prong is ground), pull the plug not the cord, avoid water, remove frayed or faulty equipment, and turn off power before touching a shocked client.用電：使用有接地的三孔插頭（較長的第三腳為接地），拔插頭時握插頭不可拉電線，遠離水源，移除破損設備，觸電個案須先關閉電源再接觸。
  • Client-owned electrical equipment must be inspected before use in the facility.個案自備的電器必須經檢查後才能在院內使用。
PDF p.192, 193

Radiation Safety and Waste Disposal輻射安全與感染性廢棄物處理

  • Reduce exposure with time (limit), distance (maximize) and shielding (lead apron); wear a dosimeter badge.降低輻射暴露：縮短時間、拉大距離、使用鉛衣屏蔽，並配戴劑量計。
  • Client with a radiation implant: private room; never touch a dislodged implant with bare hands; keep linens in the room until the implant is removed.放射性植入物個案：住單人房；脫落的植入物不可徒手碰觸；植入物取出前，床單衣物留在房內。
  • Treat all infectious material as hazardous; use labeled, closed, puncture-resistant containers; never recap, bend or break needles.所有感染性物質視為危害物；使用有標示、密閉、防刺穿容器；針頭不可回套、折彎或折斷。
PDF p.193

Fall Prevention and Safe Ambulation預防跌倒與安全行走

  • Older adults have slower reflexes, reduced vision/hearing, weaker muscles and nocturia, all raising accident risk.老年人反射變慢、視聽力下降、肌力減弱、夜尿增加，都會提高意外風險。
  • Fall risk assessment is client-centered: validated scale, gait, balance, vision, medications, home hazards, prior falls, upcoming procedures.跌倒風險評估以個案為中心：使用量表，評估步態、平衡、視力、藥物、居家環境危險、過去跌倒史及即將進行的檢查處置。
  • Prevention: bed low and locked, call light and belongings within reach, bed/chair alarms, room near nurses' station, toileting schedule, clutter-free room, good lighting, sturdy non-skid footwear.預防措施：床降至最低並鎖定、呼叫鈴與物品放在可及處、使用床/椅警報器、安排靠近護理站、定時如廁、環境整潔、燈光充足、穿穩固防滑鞋。
  • Gait belt: apply before ambulating, snug enough for two fingers, hold both sides/back; return client to bed or chair if dizzy.使用步態帶（gait belt）：行走前繫上，鬆緊以可伸入兩指為度，握住兩側或後方；個案頭暈時立即回床或坐椅。
  • Nurse body mechanics: keep load close, bend knees, tighten abdominal muscles, keep trunk erect, use equipment.護理人員身體力學：負重靠近身體、彎曲膝蓋、收緊腹肌、保持軀幹直立、善用輔助設備。
PDF p.193, 194

Restraints (Safety Devices)約束（安全裝置）

  • Physical restraints limit movement by a device; chemical restraints are drugs used to control behavior. Use alternatives first.身體約束以裝置限制活動；化學約束則以藥物抑制行為。須優先使用替代方式。
  • Requires a PHCP prescription naming type, behaviors and a limited time; never PRN; PHCP evaluates within 1 hour if not present; renew per policy; explain to and get permission from client/family.需醫囑，註明約束類型、適用行為及有限時間；不得開 PRN；醫師若不在場須於1小時內評估；依規定更新；向個案與家屬說明並取得同意。
  • Secure straps to the bed frame (not side rails or movable parts) with a quick-release knot/half-bow or buckle; leave slack, two fingers fit under strap.約束帶固定於床架（不可綁在床欄或可移動部位），使用快速解開結或快扣；保留鬆度，可伸入兩指。
  • Assess skin, circulation and neurovascular status frequently; release at least every 2 hours for ROM, toileting, fluids and ADLs.頻繁評估皮膚、循環及神經血管狀態；至少每2小時解除一次，進行關節活動、如廁、補水與日常照護。
  • Only the top two side rails are used and bed stays lowest; side rails to prevent a sedated client from falling are generally not a restraint per policy.床欄僅使用上方兩側，且床維持最低位置；依規定，為防鎮靜個案跌落的床欄通常不算約束。
  • Alternatives for confusion: reorientation, sitters/family, room near station, clocks/night-light, familiar objects, toileting routine, remove unneeded tubes, review medications, look for causes (hypoxia, electrolytes).意識混亂的替代措施：重新定向、陪伴者或家屬、靠近護理站、時鐘與夜燈、熟悉物品、定時如廁、盡早移除不必要管路、檢視藥物、尋找原因（缺氧、電解質異常）。
  • Document reason, method, time applied, duration, response, release/assessments and ongoing need.記錄使用原因、方法、開始時間、持續時間、反應、解除與評估情形及持續需要性。
PDF p.194, 195

Poisoning中毒

  • Children (infants to young school-age) and older adults with poor vision or memory are most at risk of accidental poisoning.嬰幼兒至低年級學童，以及視力或記憶力差的老年人，是意外中毒的高風險族群。
  • Call Poison Control FIRST, before intervening; keep the number near the phone.先撥打毒物諮詢中心，再採取處置；電話號碼應放在電話旁。
  • Remove visible material from mouth/eyes/skin, identify substance and amount, save vomitus if asked, call an ambulance if directed to the ED.移除口、眼、皮膚上可見毒物，確認物質種類與量，依要求保留嘔吐物，若被指示送急診則叫救護車。
  • Never induce vomiting for lye, household cleaners, grease or petroleum products, or in an unconscious victim.吞食強鹼、家用清潔劑、油脂或石油產品，或個案昏迷時，絕不可催吐。
PDF p.196

Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施

  • HAIs are acquired in a facility and not incubating on admission; common resistant organisms: MRSA, VRE, CRE, multidrug-resistant TB, plus C. difficile.醫療照護相關感染為入院時未存在或潛伏、在醫療機構內獲得；常見抗藥菌：MRSA、VRE、CRE、多重抗藥結核，另有困難梭狀芽孢桿菌（C. difficile）。
  • C. difficile spreads by hand contact, mostly after prolonged multiple antibiotics; alcohol rubs do not kill spores, so wash with soap and water.C. difficile 經手接觸傳播，多見於長期使用多種抗生素者；酒精乾洗手無法殺死孢子，須以肥皂與水洗手。
  • Standard precautions apply to every client: blood, all body fluids, secretions, excretions, nonintact skin, mucous membranes.標準防護措施適用於所有個案：血液、所有體液、分泌物、排泄物、不完整皮膚及黏膜。
  • Hand hygiene between clients and after glove removal; alcohol rub if hands not visibly soiled; gloves, mask/eye protection, gown as splash/soiling risk dictates.個案間及脫手套後須手部衛生；手無明顯髒污可用酒精乾洗手；依噴濺或弄髒風險使用手套、口罩與護目、隔離衣。
  • Donning order: gown, mask/respirator, goggles/face shield, gloves. Removal: gloves first (outside is contaminated), then goggles, gown, mask; wash hands.穿戴順序：隔離衣、口罩/呼吸器、護目鏡/面罩、手套。脫除：先脫手套（外側受污染），再脫護目、隔離衣、口罩，最後洗手。
  • Clean blood spills with 1:10 bleach solution or approved disinfectant; contaminated linen in leak-proof bags; use safety needle devices.血液噴濺以 1:10 漂白水或核可消毒劑清潔；受污染被單置於防漏袋；使用安全針具。
PDF p.196, 197

Transmission-Based Precautions傳播途徑別防護措施

  • Airborne: measles, varicella/disseminated zoster, pulmonary or laryngeal TB, COVID-19. Negative-pressure private room, door closed, 6-12 air exchanges/hr, N95 or higher; mask client for transport.空氣傳染：麻疹、水痘／散播性帶狀疱疹、肺或喉結核、COVID-19。負壓單人房、門關閉、每小時6-12次換氣、戴 N95 或更高等級；個案外出時戴外科口罩。
  • Droplet: influenza, pertussis, meningitis, mumps, rubella, epiglottitis, pharyngeal diphtheria, scarlet fever, strep pharyngitis, mycoplasma/meningococcal pneumonia, parvovirus B19, sepsis. Private room or cohort; mask within about 3 feet; mask on client for transport.飛沫傳染：流感、百日咳、腦膜炎、腮腺炎、德國麻疹、會厭炎、咽喉白喉、猩紅熱、鏈球菌咽炎、黴漿菌／腦膜炎雙球菌肺炎、細小病毒B19、敗血症。單人房或同病原體集中安置；約3英尺內戴口罩；外出時個案戴口罩。
  • Contact: multidrug-resistant organisms, C. difficile and enteric infections, RSV, wound and skin infections (impetigo, scabies, lice, herpes simplex, zoster), conjunctivitis. Private room/cohort; gloves and gown on entry; dedicated equipment.接觸傳染：多重抗藥菌、C. difficile 及腸道感染、RSV、傷口與皮膚感染（膿痂疹、疥瘡、頭蝨、單純疱疹、帶狀疱疹）、結膜炎。單人房或集中安置；進入時穿戴手套與隔離衣；專用器材。
  • For C. difficile: gloves and gown, soap and water on exit, no shared equipment, room cleaned with chlorine (bleach).C. difficile：穿手套與隔離衣，離開時用肥皂水洗手，不共用器材，以含氯（漂白水）清潔病室。
  • COVID-19 may need airborne plus droplet plus contact precautions with eye protection, per agency protocol.COVID-19 可能需同時採空氣、飛沫與接觸防護並加護目，依機構規定。
PDF p.197, 198

Disasters and Biological Warfare Agents災難與生物戰劑

  • When notified of a disaster, activate the facility emergency response plan first; internal disasters occur in the facility, external ones (tornado, COVID surge) send victims to it.接獲災難通報時，首先啟動院內緊急應變計畫；內部災難發生在院內，外部災難（龍捲風、COVID 疫情高峰）則使傷病患湧入。
  • Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis): skin (painless black-centered ulcer), GI (undercooked meat), inhalation (flu-like then severe respiratory distress/shock); no person-to-person spread; ciprofloxacin, doxycycline or penicillin.炭疽（Bacillus anthracis）：皮膚型（無痛黑色焦痂潰瘍）、腸胃型（食用未煮熟肉類）、吸入型（先似流感，後出現嚴重呼吸窘迫與休克）；不會人傳人；用環丙沙星、多西環素或青黴素治療。
  • Smallpox: highly contagious by droplets/contaminated material; fever, back pain, then papules to pustules on face and limbs; vaccine available.天花：傳染力強，經飛沫或污染物傳播；發燒、背痛，之後出現丘疹進展為膿疱，先見於臉與四肢；有疫苗。
  • Botulism: toxin from Clostridium botulinum; descending paralysis, diplopia, ptosis, dysphagia; not person-to-person; antitoxin; may need ventilation; no vaccine.肉毒桿菌中毒：肉毒桿菌毒素；下行性麻痺、複視、眼瞼下垂、吞嚥困難；不會人傳人；用抗毒素；可能需呼吸器；無疫苗。
  • Plague (Yersinia pestis): bubonic most common, septicemic most deadly; pneumonic spreads person to person; streptomycin or gentamicin. Tularemia: ticks/deer flies, ulcer with lymphadenopathy.鼠疫（Yersinia pestis）：腺鼠疫最常見、敗血性最致命；肺鼠疫可人傳人；用鏈黴素或慶大黴素。兔熱病：蜱或鹿蠅傳播，皮膚潰瘍伴淋巴結腫大。
  • Viral hemorrhagic fevers (Ebola, Marburg, Lassa): fluids transmit; fever, headache, vomiting, unexplained bleeding; symptoms 2-21 days after exposure; supportive treatment only.病毒性出血熱（伊波拉、馬堡、拉薩）：經體液傳播；發燒、頭痛、嘔吐、不明出血；暴露後2-21天出現症狀；僅支持性治療。
  • Suspected Ebola (travel to endemic area within 21 days plus symptoms or temp 38 C / 100.4 F): isolate in private room with private bathroom, full PPE, limit entrants with a log, notify infection control and public health.疑似伊波拉（21天內曾至疫區並有症狀或體溫 38°C／100.4°F）：安置單人房與專用衛浴、完整 PPE、限制進入人員並記錄、通報感控與公共衛生單位。
  • Chemical agents: sarin (nerve gas, respiratory paralysis), phosgene (pulmonary edema), mustard gas (garlic odor, blisters). Ionizing radiation causes nausea, vomiting, leukopenia, hemorrhage.化學戰劑：沙林（神經毒氣，呼吸肌麻痺）、光氣（肺水腫）、芥子氣（蒜味、皮膚水疱）。游離輻射引起噁心、嘔吐、白血球減少與出血。
PDF p.198, 199, 200

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Fire priorities RACE: Rescue, Alarm, Confine, Extinguish. Extinguisher use PASS: Pull, Aim at base, Squeeze, Sweep.火災優先順序 RACE：救援、警報、侷限、滅火。滅火器 PASS：拔插銷、瞄準火源底部、握壓把手、左右掃射。 PDF p.192
  2. Never use side rails or movable bed parts to tie restraints; use a quick-release knot on the bed frame.約束帶不可綁在床欄或活動部位；應以快速解開結綁在床架。 PDF p.195
  3. Restraints need a time-limited PHCP prescription (not PRN), alternatives first, and release at least every 2 hours.約束需有限時醫囑（不可 PRN）、先用替代方案，且至少每2小時解除一次。 PDF p.194, 195
  4. Poisoning: call Poison Control first; never induce vomiting with corrosives, petroleum products or in unconscious clients.中毒：先打毒物諮詢中心；腐蝕劑、石油產品或昏迷者不可催吐。 PDF p.196
  5. Standard precautions apply to all clients regardless of diagnosis.標準防護措施適用於所有個案，不論診斷為何。 PDF p.196
  6. Alcohol hand rub does not kill C. difficile spores: use soap and water, gloves, gown and bleach cleaning.酒精乾洗手無法殺死 C. difficile 孢子：須用肥皂水洗手、戴手套穿隔離衣並以漂白水清潔。 PDF p.196, 198
  7. Airborne = measles, varicella, TB (also COVID): negative-pressure room, N95, door closed.空氣傳染＝麻疹、水痘、結核（及 COVID）：負壓病室、N95、關門。 PDF p.197
  8. Droplet = meningitis, influenza, pertussis, mumps, rubella, epiglottitis: private room/cohort and surgical mask.飛沫＝腦膜炎、流感、百日咳、腮腺炎、德國麻疹、會厭炎：單人房／集中安置並戴外科口罩。 PDF p.197
  9. Contact = MRSA, VRE, C. difficile, scabies, impetigo, RSV, conjunctivitis: gloves and gown on entry.接觸＝MRSA、VRE、C. difficile、疥瘡、膿痂疹、RSV、結膜炎：進入時戴手套穿隔離衣。 PDF p.198
  10. Wear goggles/face shield plus mask when splashes are possible (e.g., ostomy care, irrigation) even under contact precautions.可能噴濺時（如造口護理、沖洗）即使在接觸隔離下，也要戴護目鏡/面罩及口罩。 PDF p.196, 197
  11. Remove PPE with gloves first; outside of all PPE is contaminated.脫 PPE 先脫手套；所有 PPE 外側都視為受污染。 PDF p.197
  12. Radiation implant client: private room, time-distance-shielding, never touch a dislodged implant by hand, dosimeter badge.放射性植入個案：單人房、時間-距離-屏蔽原則、脫落植入物不可徒手碰、配戴劑量計。 PDF p.193
  13. Disaster notification: first activate the facility emergency response plan (umbrella action).接獲災難通知：首先啟動院內緊急應變計畫（涵蓋其他步驟的上位選項）。 PDF p.198, 203
  14. Anthrax, botulism are not spread person to person; smallpox, pneumonic plague and Ebola are.炭疽、肉毒桿菌中毒不會人傳人；天花、肺鼠疫與伊波拉會。 PDF p.198, 199, 200
  15. Suspected Ebola (recent travel plus fever/symptoms): isolate FIRST, then collect more data and notify authorities.疑似伊波拉（近期旅遊加發燒／症狀）：先隔離，再收集資料並通報主管機關。 PDF p.200
  16. Do not recap needles; discard sharps immediately into puncture-resistant containers.針頭不回套；尖銳物使用後立刻丟入防刺穿容器。 PDF p.193, 197

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • RACE: Rescue, Activate alarm, Confine, Extinguish.RACE：救援、啟動警報、侷限火勢、滅火。 PDF p.192
  • PASS: Pull the pin, Aim at the base, Squeeze the handle, Sweep side to side.PASS：拔插銷、瞄準底部、握壓把手、左右掃射。 PDF p.192
  • Gown-Mask-Goggles-Gloves to put on; gloves first off.穿：隔離衣→口罩→護目→手套；脫：手套最先。 PDF p.197
  • Airborne: MTV (Measles, TB, Varicella) plus COVID.空氣傳染：MTV（麻疹、結核、水痘）加 COVID。 PDF p.197

14 Medication Administration and Intravenous Therapies給藥與靜脈治療

This chapter reviews medication measurement systems, unit conversions, reading labels and prescriptions, oral and parenteral administration, syringes and injection sites, and dosage and IV flow-rate calculations. NCLEX expects you to calculate drops per minute, mL per hour and unit-per-hour infusions accurately and to question unsafe doses.本章複習藥物計量系統、單位換算、藥物標籤與處方判讀、口服與注射給藥、針筒與注射部位，以及劑量與靜脈輸液速率計算。NCLEX 要求能精確計算每分鐘滴數、每小時毫升數與每小時單位數的輸注，並能質疑不安全的劑量。

Medication Administration Overview and Rights給藥概述與給藥權利

  • Assess the order, reconcile with current medications, ask about allergies and herbal use, and review vital signs, labs and interactions before giving a drug.給藥前評估醫囑、與現用藥物核對（藥物整合）、詢問過敏與草藥使用，並檢視生命徵象、檢驗值與交互作用。
  • Rights include right prescription, medication, dose, client, route, time, reason, education, assessment, refusal, approach, evaluation and documentation.給藥權利包括正確的處方、藥物、劑量、個案、途徑、時間、原因、衛教、評估、拒絕權、技術方式、評值及記錄。
  • Teach the client the drug name, purpose, action and adverse effects; address cultural, religious or other concerns.向個案說明藥名、目的、作用與不良反應，並處理文化、宗教等顧慮。
  • Document administration and the client's response. If an order is unclear or inconsistent, contact the prescriber immediately.記錄給藥及個案反應。若醫囑不清或前後不一致，須立即聯絡開立者確認。
  • A nurse who gives a wrong dose is legally responsible regardless of the source of the error.不論錯誤來源為何，護理師給錯劑量須負法律責任。
PDF p.205, 206

Measurement Systems and Conversions計量系統與換算

  • Metric basics: meter (length), liter (volume), gram (mass). It is the most used system in practice.公制基本單位：公尺（長度）、公升（容積）、公克（質量），是臨床最常用系統。
  • 1 g = 1000 mg; 1 mg = 1000 mcg; 1 kg = 2.2 lb; 1 mL = 0.001 L.1 g = 1000 mg；1 mg = 1000 mcg；1 kg = 2.2 lb；1 mL = 0.001 L。
  • Larger to smaller unit: multiply by 1000 (move decimal 3 places right). Smaller to larger: divide by 1000 (3 places left).大單位換小單位：乘以1000（小數點右移3位）；小單位換大單位：除以1000（左移3位）。
  • Household measures (drop, teaspoon, tablespoon, ounce, cup) and apothecary units (grain, dram, minim) are older; NCLEX will not ask apothecary-to-metric conversion, though 1 gr = 60 mg appears in an example.家用單位（滴、茶匙、湯匙、盎司、杯）與藥衡制（grain、dram、minim）較舊；NCLEX 不考藥衡制換算公制，但書中範例用 1 gr = 60 mg。
  • mEq expresses electrolyte amounts; units (insulin, heparin, penicillin) measure drug activity rather than weight.mEq 表示電解質量；單位（胰島素、肝素、青黴素）以藥效而非重量計量。
  • Conversion is the first step in dosage calculation; labels show the generic name, so learn generic names.換算是劑量計算的第一步；藥標一定有學名，考試以學名為主。
PDF p.205, 206, 207

Oral Medications and Prescriptions口服藥物與處方

  • A complete prescription has client name, date/time, drug, dose, route, frequency/time and prescriber signature; use only Joint Commission-approved abbreviations.完整處方包括個案姓名、日期時間、藥名、劑量、途徑、頻率/時間及開立者簽名；僅用聯合委員會核可的縮寫。
  • Scored tablets may be split; enteric-coated and sustained-release products delay absorption and must not be crushed.有刻痕的錠劑可依規定分割；腸溶錠與緩釋劑延遲吸收，不可壓碎。
  • Medicine cup holds 30 mL (1 oz); pour at eye level on a flat surface. Volumes under 5 mL are measured in a syringe (no needle).藥杯容量30 mL（1盎司）；置於平面並平視刻度倒藥。小於5 mL以去針頭的針筒抽取。
  • Use a calibrated oral syringe for children.兒童使用有刻度的口服針筒。
PDF p.206, 207

Parenteral Medications, Syringes and Needles注射藥物、針筒與針頭

  • Parenteral routes: IV, IM, subcutaneous, intradermal. Angles: intradermal 5-15 degrees, subcutaneous 45 or 90 degrees, IM 90 degrees.注射途徑：靜脈、肌肉、皮下、皮內。角度：皮內5-15度、皮下45或90度、肌肉90度。
  • Draw to the top ring of the plunger (closest to the needle). Standard 3-mL syringe is calibrated in 0.1 mL; 5-mL in 0.2 mL; tuberculin 1-mL in 0.01 mL.抽藥時以活塞最靠針頭端的環對齊刻度。標準3 mL針筒刻度0.1 mL；5 mL為0.2 mL；結核菌素1 mL為0.01 mL。
  • Maximum volumes: IM 3 mL per site (2 mL deltoid); subcutaneous 0.5-1.5 mL for adults. Question larger volumes.最大注射量：肌肉每處3 mL（三角肌2 mL）；成人皮下0.5-1.5 mL。超量須再確認。
  • Subcutaneous: 25-gauge 5/8-inch needle at 45 degrees or 1/2-inch at 90 degrees. IM needle length depends on weight and fat; larger gauge for viscous drugs. Z-track uses a deep muscle such as ventrogluteal.皮下：25號、5/8吋針以45度，或1/2吋針以90度。肌肉針長依體重與脂肪厚度而定，黏稠藥物用較粗針；Z字法選深層肌肉如腹臀肌。
  • Insulin only in insulin syringes (100 units = 1 mL). Mixing: draw clear regular first, then NPH (RN). Pens and pumps are alternatives.胰島素僅用胰島素針筒（100單位 = 1 mL）。混合時先抽透明的 Regular，再抽 NPH（RN）。另有胰島素筆與幫浦。
  • Prefilled cartridges are single use; discard extra before injecting a partial dose. Engage safety needle device right after injection.預充式卡匣單次使用；給部分劑量時先丟棄多餘藥量。注射後立即啟動安全針具。
  • Powdered drugs are reconstituted with sterile diluent per label; the final volume exceeds the diluent volume; label multidose vials with date, time, initials and expiration.粉劑依標示以無菌稀釋液調製；最終體積大於稀釋液體積；多劑量瓶須標註日期時間、簽名縮寫及有效期。
PDF p.207, 208, 209

Dosage Calculation Methods劑量計算方法

  • Ratio and proportion: H : V :: D : X. Standard formula: (Desired / Available) x Quantity.比例法：H : V :: D : X。標準公式：（所需量／現有量）× 單位量。
  • Dimensional analysis: start with the desired unit, set conversion fractions so unwanted units cancel.單位分析法：先確定所求單位，排列換算分數使不需要的單位相消。
  • Check that everything is in the same unit first; more than 3 tablets or an oddly large injection volume should prompt verification.先確認單位一致；超過3錠或注射量異常過大時，須再確認。
  • Round at the end; adult injections to the nearest 0.1 mL; small or pediatric doses may be rounded down to 0.01 mL per policy; follow the rounding instruction in the question.計算完最後再四捨五入；成人注射至0.1 mL；微量或兒童劑量依規定可捨至0.01 mL；依題目指示進位。
  • Percent solution = g per 100 mL (10% calcium gluconate = 10 g/100 mL); ratio solution = g per total mL (epinephrine 1:1000 = 1 g/1000 mL).百分比溶液＝每100 mL的公克數（10%葡萄糖酸鈣＝10 g/100 mL）；比例溶液＝每總毫升的公克數（腎上腺素1:1000＝1 g/1000 mL）。
PDF p.207, 209, 210

IV Flow Rates and Infusion Safety靜脈輸液速率與安全

  • Drops/min = (total volume x drop factor) / time in minutes. mL/hr = total mL / hours. Infusion time = total volume / mL per hr.每分鐘滴數＝（總量 × 滴系數）／分鐘數；mL/hr＝總毫升／小時數；輸注時間＝總量／每小時毫升。
  • Macrodrip sets give 10-20 gtt/mL; microdrip about 60 gtt/mL (ICU, pediatrics). The calibration is printed on the tubing package.大滴管每 mL 10-20滴；微滴管約60滴/mL（加護與兒科）。滴系數印在輸液管包裝上。
  • Monitor flow rate often even with a pump. Never speed up a late infusion without PHCP approval; watch for crackles and increased respirations (fluid overload), especially in older, cardiac, renal, pulmonary or neurologic clients.即使使用幫浦也須經常檢查速率。輸液落後時未經醫師同意不可加快；觀察呼吸變快與肺部囉音（容積過量），尤其是老年及心、肺、腎、神經疾病個案。
  • IV fluids count as intake.靜脈輸液須計入輸入量。
  • Unit-per-hour infusions (heparin, regular insulin): step 1 units per mL = units in bag / mL in bag; step 2 mL/hr = dose per hr / units per mL.每小時單位數輸注（肝素、Regular 胰島素）：步驟1 每 mL 單位數＝袋內單位／袋內毫升；步驟2 mL/hr＝每小時劑量／每 mL 單位數。
PDF p.209, 210, 211

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Conversion comes first: g to mg multiply by 1000; mcg to mg divide by 1000 (150 mcg = 0.15 mg).先換算：g 轉 mg 乘1000；mcg 轉 mg 除以1000（150 mcg = 0.15 mg）。 PDF p.206, 214
  2. Drops/min = volume x drop factor / minutes; round to a whole number (drops cannot be fractional).滴/分＝總量 × 滴系數／分鐘；四捨五入至整數。 PDF p.210, 212
  3. Heparin/insulin drip: units per mL = units / mL in bag; mL/hr = ordered units per hr / units per mL.肝素／胰島素點滴：每 mL 單位＝單位／袋容量；mL/hr＝醫囑單位數／每 mL 單位。 PDF p.211
  4. Never speed up a behind-schedule IV without PHCP approval; assess for fluid overload when rate increases.IV 落後時未經醫師同意不可加速；速率增加時評估容積過量。 PDF p.209, 210
  5. Question any oral dose needing more than 3 tablets, or excessive injection volume (IM over 3 mL, 2 mL deltoid; subcutaneous over 1.5 mL).口服需超過3錠或注射量過大（肌肉超過3 mL、三角肌超過2 mL、皮下超過1.5 mL）須質疑。 PDF p.208, 209
  6. Do not crush enteric-coated or sustained-release medications.腸溶或緩釋劑不可壓碎。 PDF p.207
  7. Insulin is measured only in an insulin syringe; mix regular before NPH (RN).胰島素只用胰島素針筒；先抽 Regular 再抽 NPH（RN）。 PDF p.209
  8. Intradermal angle 5-15 degrees with a tuberculin syringe; IM 90 degrees; subcutaneous 45 or 90 degrees.皮內5-15度用結核菌素針筒；肌肉90度；皮下45或90度。 PDF p.208
  9. Verify unclear or inconsistent orders with the prescriber immediately.醫囑不清或不一致時，立即向開立者確認。 PDF p.206
  10. Reconstituted volume exceeds diluent volume; label multidose vials with date, time, initials, expiration.調製後體積大於稀釋液體積；多劑量瓶標註日期、時間、簽名、效期。 PDF p.210
  11. Draw the syringe to the top ring of the plunger closest to the needle.抽取針筒時以最靠針頭端的活塞環對齊刻度。 PDF p.208
  12. Medicine cup is 30 mL; use syringe for volumes under 5 mL, and for children.藥杯30 mL；小於5 mL及兒童劑量用針筒。 PDF p.207
  13. Percent solution is g/100 mL; 1:1000 epinephrine is 1 g/1000 mL (1 mg/mL).百分比溶液為 g/100 mL；1:1000 腎上腺素為 1 g/1000 mL（1 mg/mL）。 PDF p.209
  14. NCLEX uses generic drug names; learn generics.NCLEX 使用藥物學名，須熟記。 PDF p.206

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • RN: draw Regular insulin first, then NPH.RN：先抽 Regular 再抽 NPH。 PDF p.209
  • H : V :: D : X (on hand, vehicle, desired, unknown).H : V :: D : X（現有量、載體、所需量、未知數）。 PDF p.207
  • Big to small, multiply by 1000; small to big, divide by 1000.大換小乘1000；小換大除1000。 PDF p.206

15 Perioperative Nursing Care手術期護理

This chapter follows the surgical client from consent and preoperative preparation, through arrival in the operating room, to postoperative monitoring by body system, common postoperative complications, and discharge teaching after ambulatory surgery. Focus on airway and breathing first, hemorrhage and shock recognition, wound complications and consent rules.本章依序介紹手術個案從同意書與術前準備、進入手術室、術後依系統監測、常見術後併發症，到門診手術出院衛教。重點為優先處理呼吸道與呼吸、辨識出血與休克、傷口併發症及同意書規定。

Preoperative Consent, Nutrition, Elimination and Skin術前同意書、飲食、排泄與皮膚準備

  • The surgeon explains the procedure; the nurse may witness the signature after confirming the client understands. If the client is confused about the surgery, notify the surgeon before proceeding.由外科醫師說明手術；護理師確認個案理解後可見證簽名。若個案仍不了解，須通知外科醫師釐清後再繼續。
  • Minors, or clients not alert/oriented, need a parent, guardian or health care power of attorney; no sedation before signing. Telephone consent is acceptable with a second nurse as witness.未成年人或意識不清者需由父母、監護人或醫療委任代理人簽署；簽署前不可給鎮靜劑。電話同意可行，須有第二位護理師見證。
  • NPO about 6-8 hours before general anesthesia (about 3 hours for local, as prescribed) to prevent aspiration; start IV with a catheter large enough for blood products.全身麻醉前約禁食6-8小時（局部麻醉約3小時，依醫囑）以防吸入；建立足夠大口徑的靜脈管路以便輸血。
  • Client voids just before surgery; bowel prep and urinary catheter as prescribed; document urine output from catheter bags.術前立即排尿；依醫囑做腸道準備及放置導尿管；記錄導尿袋尿量。
  • Skin cleansing with antiseptic soap the night before; hair removal only as prescribed (head/face/eyebrows only if ordered).手術前晚以抗菌皂清潔；除毛依醫囑（頭、臉、眉毛須有醫囑才剃）。
PDF p.218, 219

Preoperative Teaching術前衛教

  • Ask about allergies (including latex), vitamins, herbals and OTC drugs; explain what to expect and any tubes, drains, catheters.詢問過敏（含乳膠）、維他命、草藥與成藥；說明術後預期情形及各種管路、引流。
  • Pain: expect some; use pain scales; PCA is pushed only by the client; teach relaxation, distraction, guided imagery.疼痛：預期會有一些疼痛；使用疼痛量表；PCA 僅限個案本人按壓；教導放鬆、分散注意力、引導想像。
  • No smoking for at least 24 hours before surgery.術前至少24小時不吸菸。
  • Deep breathing/coughing sitting upright: 3 deep breaths, hold the third 3 seconds, then cough 3 times, every 1-2 hours.深呼吸與咳嗽採坐姿：深呼吸3次，第3次屏息3秒後咳嗽3次，每1-2小時一次。
  • Incentive spirometer: sit upright, inhale slowly, hold 5 seconds, 10 times per hour.誘發性肺量計：坐直、緩慢吸氣、屏息5秒，每小時10次。
  • Leg exercises (calf pumping, quadriceps setting, foot circles), sequential compression devices, splinting the incision with pillow, turning schedule.腿部運動（踝泵、股四頭肌收縮、足部畫圈）、間歇性氣動加壓裝置、以枕頭護住傷口、翻身計畫。
PDF p.219, 220

Preoperative Checklist and Medications術前核對表與術前藥物

  • Verify ID band, allergies, signed consents (surgery, transfusion, limb disposal, sterilization), H&P, labs, ECG/chest x-ray, type and crossmatch.核對手圈、過敏、各項同意書（手術、輸血、肢體處置、結紮）、病歷與理學檢查、檢驗、心電圖／胸部X光、血型與交叉配對。
  • Remove jewelry, dentures, glasses, prostheses, makeup, hairpins; secure valuables; document last intake, voiding, vital signs and preop meds.取下飾品、假牙、眼鏡、義肢、化妝品、髮夾；貴重物品妥善保管；記錄最後飲食時間、排尿、生命徵象與術前給藥。
  • Risk factors: older age, obesity, bleeding disorders, diabetes, heart/lung disease, OSA, infection, liver disease, immunosuppression, smoking, substance abuse.風險因子：高齡、肥胖、出血疾患、糖尿病、心肺疾病、睡眠呼吸中止、感染、肝病、免疫抑制、吸菸、藥物濫用。
  • Aspirin, NSAIDs stop at least 48 hours before; clopidogrel about 5 days. Corticosteroids cause adrenal suppression; insulin needs vary; herbals can interact with anesthesia.阿斯匹靈、NSAIDs 至少術前48小時停用；氯吡格雷約5天。類固醇導致腎上腺抑制；胰島素需求會變動；草藥可能與麻醉交互作用。
  • After preoperative sedatives keep the client in bed with rails up, bed low, call bell in reach.給予術前鎮靜藥後，個案臥床、床欄拉起、床降低、呼叫鈴置於手邊。
PDF p.220, 221, 222

Operating Room Arrival and Wrong-Site Prevention進入手術室與防止錯誤部位手術

  • Surgeon marks the site while the client is awake; the team reconfirms the mark in the OR.外科醫師於個案清醒時標記手術部位；手術室內團隊再次確認標記。
  • A time-out with the whole team just before incision verifies client, procedure and site.切開前全體手術團隊執行暫停核對（time-out），確認個案、術式與部位。
  • OR nurse verifies ID band with client's verbal response and reviews chart, consents and allergies.手術室護理師以手圈加上個案口頭回答核對身分，並檢視病歷、同意書與過敏史。
PDF p.222

Postoperative Assessment by System術後各系統評估

  • Respiratory: airway first; stridor or crowing suggests obstruction/laryngospasm; crackles suggest atelectasis or edema; RR should be above 10 and below 30; SpO2 under 95% (or baseline) needs prompt notification.呼吸：先確保呼吸道；喘鳴或雞鳴聲提示阻塞／喉痙攣；囉音提示肺塌陷或水腫；呼吸速率應大於10、小於30；血氧低於95%（或基準值）須立即通報。
  • Cardiovascular: perfusion, bleeding, pulses, dysrhythmias, VTE prophylaxis with stockings, SCDs, early mobility.心血管：評估灌流、出血、脈搏、心律不整，以彈性襪、間歇性加壓裝置、早期活動預防靜脈血栓。
  • Position low-Fowler's for lung expansion; side-lying if semiconscious; turn every 1-2 hours; sit at bed edge before standing.採低半坐臥利於肺擴張；半昏迷者側臥；每1-2小時翻身；下床前先坐床緣。
  • Neuro: orient client, check motor/sensation; older adults take longer to reorient. Prevent hypothermia with warm blankets.神經：協助定向、檢查運動與感覺；老年人定向恢復較慢。以保暖毯預防體溫過低。
  • Wound: mark drainage on dressings, check drains, REEDA signs, abdominal binder for obese/debilitated.傷口：於敷料標記滲液、檢查引流、REEDA 評估，肥胖或虛弱者可用腹帶。
  • GI: NPO until gag reflex and peristalsis return, then ice chips and clear liquids; oral care every 2 hours; after gastric surgery do not irrigate or move NG tube unless ordered.腸胃：禁食至嘔吐反射與腸蠕動恢復，再給冰塊與清流質；每2小時口腔護理；胃手術後除非醫囑，不可沖洗或移動鼻胃管。
  • Renal: urine at least 30 mL/hr; void within 6-8 hours (at least 200 mL).腎臟：尿量至少30 mL/hr；術後6-8小時內排尿（至少200 mL）。
  • Pain: assess before giving analgesics, check respirations, BP, LOC; after opioid reassess RR and relief every 30 minutes; use nonpharmacologic measures too.疼痛：給止痛藥前先評估；檢查呼吸、血壓與意識；給予鴉片類後每30分鐘評估呼吸速率與止痛效果；併用非藥物方法。
PDF p.222, 223, 224

Respiratory and Circulatory Complications呼吸與循環併發症

  • Atelectasis typically 1-2 days postop; pneumonia 3-5 days. Signs: dyspnea, crackles, fever, productive cough. Treat with turning, deep breathing, incentive spirometry, fluids, ambulation.肺塌陷多在術後1-2天；肺炎3-5天。徵象：呼吸困難、囉音、發燒、有痰咳嗽。處置：翻身、深呼吸、誘發性肺量計、補水、下床活動。
  • Hypoxemia: restlessness (early), dyspnea, tachycardia, cyanosis, low SpO2; give oxygen and notify surgeon.低血氧：躁動（早期）、呼吸困難、心搏過速、發紺、血氧低；給氧並通知外科醫師。
  • Pulmonary embolism: sudden dyspnea, sharp chest pain, tachycardia, hypotension, cyanosis; notify surgeon immediately.肺栓塞：突發呼吸困難、尖銳胸痛、心搏過速、低血壓、發紺；立即通知外科醫師。
  • Hemorrhage/shock: restlessness, rapid weak pulse, hypotension, tachypnea, cool clammy skin, low urine output; apply pressure, oxygen, IV fluids/blood, elevate legs (spinal anesthesia: only on a pillow).出血／休克：躁動、脈快而弱、低血壓、呼吸快、皮膚濕冷、尿少；加壓止血、給氧、輸液／血品、抬高下肢（脊髓麻醉者僅墊枕頭高度）。
  • Thrombophlebitis: hard, cordlike, tender vein, aching leg, warmth, low fever; elevate leg 30 degrees without popliteal pressure, stockings, SCD, anticoagulants; do not let the client dangle legs.血栓性靜脈炎：靜脈硬如條索、壓痛、腿部痠痛、發熱、輕微發燒；抬腿30度且膕窩不受壓、彈性襪、間歇性加壓、抗凝血劑；不可讓個案垂腿。
PDF p.224, 225, 226

GI, Urinary and Wound Complications腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症

  • Urinary retention appears 6-8 hours postop: unable to void, lower abdominal pain, distended bladder; use ambulation, privacy, running water or warm water over perineum before catheterizing as prescribed.尿滯留於術後6-8小時出現：無法排尿、下腹痛、膀胱脹；導尿前先嘗試下床、隱私、流水聲或溫水沖會陰。
  • Constipation: no stool within 48 hours of solid diet; fluids up to 3000 mL/day, fiber, ambulation, stool softeners.便祕：恢復固體飲食後48小時未排便；每日補水至3000 mL、纖維、活動、軟便劑。
  • Paralytic ileus: vomiting, distention, absent bowel sounds or flatus; NPO, NG decompression with suction, IV fluids.麻痺性腸阻塞：嘔吐、腹脹、無腸音或排氣；禁食、鼻胃管減壓抽吸、靜脈輸液。
  • Wound infection 3-6 days postop: fever, chills, warm tender incision, drainage, high WBC; REEDA; cultures and antibiotics.傷口感染於術後3-6天：發燒、寒顫、傷口熱痛、滲液、白血球升高；REEDA 評估；培養與抗生素。
  • Dehiscence and evisceration occur 5-10 days postop, most often in obese, abdominal-surgery, poor-healing clients. Evisceration is an emergency.傷口裂開與內臟脫出多發生於術後5-10天，常見於肥胖、腹部手術、癒合不良者。內臟脫出為緊急狀況。
  • Evisceration care: stay with client, call for help, low-Fowler's with knees bent, cover with sterile saline-moistened dressing, monitor for shock, prepare for surgery.內臟脫出處置：陪伴個案、呼叫協助、低半坐臥並屈膝、以無菌生理食鹽水濕敷料覆蓋、監測休克、準備手術。
  • Sterile dressing change: verify order, check allergies, assess pain, clean from least to most contaminated with single strokes, date/time/initial dressing.無菌換藥：確認醫囑、確認過敏、評估疼痛，由最乾淨至最髒以單向擦拭，敷料標註日期時間簽名。
PDF p.226, 227, 228

Ambulatory Surgery Discharge門診手術出院

  • Criteria: alert and oriented, baseline vital signs, voided, no respiratory distress, able to ambulate/swallow/cough, minimal pain, no vomiting, minimal bleeding, responsible adult driver, surgeon release.出院條件：意識清楚、生命徵象回到基準、已排尿、無呼吸窘迫、可行走吞嚥咳嗽、疼痛輕微、無嘔吐、出血極少、有成人陪同載送、外科醫師同意。
  • Teach before the procedure day; provide written instructions; use teach-back.於手術日前即進行衛教；提供書面說明；使用回覆示教。
  • No driving, major decisions or legal signing for 24 hours after general anesthesia.全身麻醉後24小時內不可開車、做重大決定或簽署法律文件。
  • Sutures or staples out in 7-14 days; Steri-Strips may follow; cover incision with plastic when showering if allowed; 48-hour dressing supply.縫線或釘書針於7-14天拆除；之後可貼無菌膠帶；若可淋浴則以塑膠覆蓋傷口；提供48小時份敷料。
  • After major surgery no lifting for 6 weeks; abdominal incision no lifting 10 pounds or more, no pushing or pulling; return to work usually 6-8 weeks; drink 6-8 glasses fluid; high protein, calorie, vitamin diet.大手術後6週不提重物；腹部傷口不可提10磅以上、不可推拉；通常6-8週返回工作；每日飲水6-8杯；高蛋白、高熱量、高維生素飲食。
  • Teach signs of complications and when to call the surgeon.教導併發症徵象及何時聯絡外科醫師。
PDF p.228, 229

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. If a client is unclear about the surgery after signing, notify the surgeon before proceeding; consent comes before sedation.個案簽署後仍不清楚手術內容，須通知外科醫師後再進行；簽同意書前不可給鎮靜。 PDF p.218
  2. Telephone consent from guardian/POA is acceptable with a second nurse witness; do not send to surgery unsigned.監護人／委任代理人電話同意可行，須第二位護理師見證；不可無同意書送刀。 PDF p.218, 229
  3. NPO 6-8 hours before general anesthesia; no smoking 24 hours; aspirin/NSAIDs stop at least 48 hours, clopidogrel about 5 days.全身麻醉前禁食6-8小時；24小時不吸菸；阿斯匹靈／NSAIDs 至少停48小時、氯吡格雷約5天。 PDF p.218, 219, 221
  4. Verify client and site: marking, then time-out with the whole team.核對個案與部位：標記，然後全體團隊暫停核對。 PDF p.222
  5. Postoperative priority is airway and breathing; SpO2 below 95% or baseline requires prompt notification; RR 10-30.術後優先為呼吸道與呼吸；血氧低於95%或基準值須即時通報；呼吸速率10-30。 PDF p.222
  6. Postop urine output should be at least 30 mL/hr; falling urine with tachycardia and hypotension suggests hemorrhage/shock.術後尿量至少30 mL/hr；尿量減少合併心搏過速與低血壓提示出血／休克。 PDF p.224, 225
  7. Restlessness is an early sign of hypoxemia and hemorrhage.躁動是低血氧與出血的早期徵象。 PDF p.225
  8. Sudden dyspnea and chest pain postoperatively: suspect pulmonary embolism; notify surgeon immediately.術後突發呼吸困難與胸痛：懷疑肺栓塞，立即通知外科醫師。 PDF p.225
  9. Spinal anesthesia plus shock: legs raised only to a pillow level so the diaphragm is not impaired.脊髓麻醉合併休克：下肢僅墊枕頭高度，以免影響橫膈膜呼吸。 PDF p.225
  10. Evisceration: cover with saline-moistened sterile dressing, low-Fowler's with knees bent, stay with client, call surgeon.內臟脫出：以無菌生理食鹽水濕敷料覆蓋、低半坐臥屈膝、陪伴個案、通知外科醫師。 PDF p.228
  11. Postoperative vomiting, distention and absent bowel sounds indicate paralytic ileus: NPO, NG suction.術後嘔吐、腹脹、腸音消失表示麻痺性腸阻塞：禁食、鼻胃管抽吸。 PDF p.226
  12. Atelectasis occurs 1-2 days postop; pneumonia 3-5; wound infection 3-6; dehiscence/evisceration 5-10 days.肺塌陷術後1-2天；肺炎3-5天；傷口感染3-6天；裂開／內臟脫出5-10天。 PDF p.224, 227
  13. After gastric surgery do not irrigate or reposition the NG tube unless prescribed.胃手術後除非醫囑，不可沖洗或調整鼻胃管位置。 PDF p.224
  14. Do not allow thrombophlebitis clients to dangle legs or rub/massage the leg; elevate and anticoagulate as ordered.血栓性靜脈炎個案不可垂腿；依醫囑抬高並給予抗凝血劑。 PDF p.226
  15. Opioid given: reassess respiratory rate and pain relief every 30 minutes.給予鴉片類藥物後每30分鐘重新評估呼吸速率與止痛效果。 PDF p.224
  16. Same-day discharge requires a responsible adult driver and no driving or legal decisions for 24 hours after general anesthesia.當日出院需有負責任的成人載送，全身麻醉後24小時不可開車或做法律決定。 PDF p.228, 229

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • REEDA for wound assessment: Redness, Edema/Erythema, Ecchymosis, Drainage, Approximation.REEDA 傷口評估：紅、腫、瘀斑、滲液、傷口對合。 PDF p.227
  • Postop complication timing: atelectasis 1-2 d, pneumonia 3-5 d, wound infection 3-6 d, dehiscence 5-10 d.術後併發症時間：肺塌陷1-2天、肺炎3-5天、傷口感染3-6天、裂開5-10天。 PDF p.224, 227

16 Hygiene, Mobility, and Skin Integrity衛生、活動與皮膚完整性

This chapter covers hygiene care (bathing, skin, feet, mouth, hair, eyes, ears), the complications of immobility, assistive devices (crutches, canes, walkers), wound healing, and pressure injury prevention, staging and dressings. Expect questions on diabetic foot care, crutch and cane technique, and pressure injury stages.本章涵蓋衛生照護（沐浴、皮膚、足部、口腔、頭髮、眼耳鼻）、活動受限的併發症、輔具（拐杖、手杖、助行器）、傷口癒合，以及壓力性損傷的預防、分期與敷料。常考糖尿病足部護理、拐杖與手杖使用及壓力性損傷分期。

Hygiene: Self-Care and Bathing衛生：自我照顧與沐浴

  • Consider culture, preferences, developmental stage and body image; assess strength, balance, vision, sensation and signs of activity intolerance (changes in respirations, pulse, color, dizziness).考量文化、個人偏好、發展階段與身體意象；評估肌力、平衡、視力、感覺及活動耐受不良徵象（呼吸、脈搏、膚色改變、頭暈）。
  • Complete bed baths, tub baths and showers increase oxygen demand and can exhaust clients; partial baths suit partly dependent clients.全身床上擦浴、盆浴、淋浴會增加耗氧量而使個案疲憊；部分擦浴適合部分依賴者。
  • Basins can harbor bacteria; chlorhexidine (CHG) baths reduce bacterial growth; dry basins after use and do not store supplies in them.水盆易滋生細菌；氯己定（CHG）擦浴可減少細菌；用後須擦乾，且不可用來存放物品。
  • Check for allergies to soaps or products first; provide privacy, warmth, safety and promote independence.先確認對肥皂或產品是否過敏；提供隱私、保暖、安全並促進獨立。
  • Perineal care at least daily and as needed; higher risk for uncircumcised males, indwelling catheters, postpartum, rectal/genital surgery, incontinence and obesity.會陰護理至少每日一次及必要時；未割包皮男性、留置導尿管、產後、直腸或生殖器手術、失禁與肥胖者風險較高。
PDF p.234, 235

Skin, Foot and Nail Care皮膚、足部與指甲護理

  • Skin assessment during hygiene: color, texture, turgor, temperature, lesions, device contact points, skinfolds, perineum, and extra care in darker skin.沐浴時評估皮膚：顏色、質地、彈性、溫度、病灶、器材接觸處、皮膚皺摺、會陰；深膚色者須更仔細。
  • Skin risk factors: immobility, obesity, reduced sensation, dementia, poor nutrition/hydration, moisture, devices, vascular insufficiency.皮膚風險因子：活動受限、肥胖、感覺減退、失智、營養與水分不足、潮濕、醫療器材、血管不足。
  • Diabetes or peripheral vascular disease: do NOT soak feet, do NOT trim nails (refer to podiatrist/PHCP), wash daily in lukewarm water, dry between toes, lotion but not between toes, seamless clean cotton socks, well-fitting shoes.糖尿病或周邊血管疾病：不可泡腳、不可自行剪指甲（轉介足科或醫師）、每日以溫水洗淨、趾縫擦乾、擦乳液但趾縫不擦、穿無接縫乾淨棉襪、鞋子合腳。
  • Others trim nails straight across and file edges; avoid long soaks and harsh chemicals (maceration). Assess pedal pulses, sensation and gait.其他個案指甲剪直並磨平邊緣；避免長時間浸泡與刺激性化學品（浸軟）。評估足背脈搏、感覺與步態。
PDF p.235

Oral, Hair, Eye, Ear and Nose Care口腔、頭髮與眼耳鼻護理

  • Brush with fluoride toothpaste twice daily, floss (unwaxed), alcohol-free rinse; avoid vigorous flossing with chemotherapy, radiation or anticoagulants.每日兩次以含氟牙膏刷牙、使用無蠟牙線、酒精含量為零的漱口水；化療、放療或使用抗凝血劑者避免用力使用牙線。
  • Special oral needs: unconscious (pneumonia risk), diabetes, chemotherapy, immunosuppression, artificial airway; CHG oral care reduces ventilator-associated pneumonia.特殊口腔需求：意識不清（肺炎風險）、糖尿病、化療、免疫抑制、人工氣道；CHG 口腔護理可降低呼吸器相關肺炎。
  • Dentures: handle carefully, rinse after meals, remove at night, store in a labeled cup covered with water (not in tissue), clean with lukewarm water.假牙：小心處理、餐後清潔、夜間取下、放在標示個案姓名的杯中並以水覆蓋（不可包衛生紙）、以微溫水清洗。
