  • Hair/scalp: assess for alopecia, lice and lesions; electric razor for clients on anticoagulants/antiplatelets or with low platelets or bleeding disorders; each client uses own razor.頭髮與頭皮：評估禿髮、頭蝨與病灶；使用抗凝血劑／抗血小板藥、血小板低或出血疾患者用電動刮鬍刀；每位個案專用刮鬍刀。
  • Clean eyes inner to outer canthus with a different part of washcloth each time; lubricate eyes of unconscious clients; no Q-tips in ears; irrigate impacted cerumen.擦拭眼睛由內眥至外眥，每次用毛巾不同處；昏迷者需潤滑眼睛；耳朵不可用棉花棒；耳垢栓塞可沖洗。
PDF p.235, 236, 237

Mobility and Complications of Immobility活動力與制動併發症

  • Assess mobility from lying, to sitting, to transfer, to walking with or without devices.活動力評估順序：臥床、坐起、轉位到椅子、行走（有無輔具）。
  • Metabolic: lowered metabolic rate, negative nitrogen balance, muscle loss, calcium resorption (hypercalcemia, kidney stones, fractures), constipation.代謝：代謝率降低、負氮平衡、肌肉流失、鈣質流失（高血鈣、腎結石、骨折）、便祕。
  • Respiratory: atelectasis and hypostatic pneumonia. Cardiovascular: orthostatic hypotension, increased workload, thrombus formation.呼吸：肺塌陷與沉積性肺炎。心血管：姿位性低血壓、心臟負荷增加、血栓形成。
  • Musculoskeletal: weakness, disuse osteoporosis, contractures such as footdrop. Urinary: stasis, infection, calculi. Skin: pressure injury over bony prominences. Psychosocial: depression, withdrawal.肌肉骨骼：無力、廢用性骨質疏鬆、攣縮如垂足。泌尿：尿液滯留、感染、結石。皮膚：骨突處壓力性損傷。心理社會：憂鬱、退縮。
PDF p.237

Crutches, Canes and Walkers拐杖、手杖與助行器

  • Crutch fit: 2-3 finger widths between axilla and pad; elbows flexed 20-30 degrees; never bear weight on axillae (brachial plexus damage); crutches 6-10 inches diagonally ahead; stop if hands tingle or go numb. Stand on the affected side.拐杖合適度：腋下與腋墊相距2-3指寬；手肘彎曲20-30度；腋下不可承重（會傷臂神經叢）；拐杖置於腳斜前方6-10吋；手麻或刺痛須停止。護理師站在患側。
  • Gaits: four-point (both legs bear weight, three points always on floor), two-point (faster), three-point (one leg bears weight; move both crutches and weak leg, then the strong leg), swing-through (paraplegia with braces).步態：四點（雙腿可承重，隨時三點著地）、兩點（較快）、三點（僅一腿承重；兩拐杖與患肢同時向前，再跨健肢）、擺盪式（下肢支架的截癱者）。
  • Stairs: up with the good leg first (up with the good); down with crutches and the weak leg first (down with the bad). Sitting: strong leg against the chair.上下樓：上樓先出健腳（好的先上）；下樓先出拐杖與患腳（壞的先下）。坐下：健側腿貼近椅子。
  • Cane: held on the STRONGER side, 4-6 inches lateral to the foot, handle at greater trochanter, elbow 15-30 degrees; move cane with the weaker leg; two points of support at all times; check rubber tips.手杖：持於較強側，距腳外側4-6吋，握把與大轉子同高，手肘彎曲15-30度；手杖與患腿一起向前；隨時保持兩點支撐；定期檢查橡膠頭。
  • Walker: all four legs flat on floor before weight bearing; move walker, then weaker foot, then stronger foot. Keep tips dry and unworn.助行器：四腳平放地面後才承重；先移助行器，再移弱腳，再移強腳。橡膠頭保持乾燥未磨損。
PDF p.237, 238, 239

Skin Integrity and Wound Healing皮膚完整性與傷口癒合

  • Healing needs protein, calories, vitamins, trace minerals, oxygen/perfusion; infection, diabetes, older age, immobility and incontinence delay healing. Albumin indicates nutrition.癒合需要蛋白質、熱量、維生素、微量礦物質及氧氣灌流；感染、糖尿病、高齡、活動受限與失禁會延遲癒合。白蛋白可反映營養。
  • Braden scale predicts pressure injury risk.Braden 量表預測壓力性損傷風險。
  • Phases: inflammatory 3-5 days (edema, pain, redness, warmth); fibroblastic from day 4 for 2-4 weeks (granulation); maturation from about 3 weeks up to a year.癒合期：發炎期3-5天（水腫、疼痛、紅、熱）；纖維母細胞期第4天起2-4週（肉芽組織）；成熟期約3週起可達1年。
  • Intention: primary (edges approximated), secondary (tissue loss, fills in), tertiary (delayed primary closure).癒合方式：一期（傷口對合）、二期（組織缺損，由內填補）、三期（延遲一期縫合）。
  • Exudate: serous (clear), serosanguineous (pale pink), sanguineous (red, bleeding), purulent (yellow/green/brown, infection).滲液：漿液性（清澈）、漿血性（淡粉紅）、血性（紅色，出血）、膿性（黃綠褐，感染）。
  • Device-related pressure injury sources include tubes, cannulas, BiPAP masks, catheters, compression stockings, orthopedic devices and restraints.與器材相關的壓力性損傷來源：管路、鼻導管、BiPAP 面罩、導尿管、彈性襪、骨科器材與約束。
PDF p.239, 240

Pressure Injury: Prevention, Staging, Dressings壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料

  • Caused by pressure, shear and friction over bony prominences; risk rises with immobility, malnutrition, incontinence, reduced sensation.由壓力、剪力與摩擦於骨突處造成；活動受限、營養不良、失禁、感覺減退使風險增加。
  • Prevention: turn every 2 hours, pressure-relief surfaces, keep skin dry and linen wrinkle-free, barrier cream for incontinence, ROM at least every 8 hours, nutrition. NEVER massage reddened areas.預防：每2小時翻身、使用減壓裝置、保持皮膚乾燥與床單平整、失禁者用隔離霜、至少每8小時關節活動、補充營養。絕不按摩發紅處。
  • Stage 1: intact skin, nonblanchable redness. Stage 2: partial-thickness loss, exposed dermis, pink moist bed or blister. Stage 3: full-thickness, fat visible, no muscle/bone. Stage 4: exposed fascia, muscle, tendon, cartilage or bone.第1期：皮膚完整、不變白的發紅。第2期：部分皮層缺損、真皮外露、粉紅濕潤或水疱。第3期：全層皮膚缺損、可見脂肪，無肌肉骨骼外露。第4期：筋膜、肌肉、肌腱、軟骨或骨頭外露。
  • Unstageable: base covered by slough/eschar. Suspected deep-tissue injury: persistent deep red/maroon/purple area or blood-filled blister.無法分期：傷口底被腐肉或焦痂覆蓋。疑似深層組織損傷：持續暗紅、栗色或紫色，或血水疱。
  • Dressings: stage 1 transparent/hydrocolloid or none; stage 2 composite film, hydrocolloid, hydrogel with cover; stage 3-4 hydrocolloid/hydrogel/alginate/foam/gauze. Alginate is absorbent for deep/exudating wounds; antimicrobial for infected ones.敷料：第1期透明膜／水膠體或不用；第2期複合膜、水膠體、水凝膠加覆蓋；第3-4期水膠體／水凝膠／藻酸鹽／泡棉／紗布。藻酸鹽吸收力強用於深、滲液多傷口；感染傷口用抗菌敷料。
  • Document size (length, width, depth), exudate, undermining, tunneling; consider wound/nutrition referral. Other therapies: negative-pressure wound therapy, hyperbaric oxygen, electrical stimulation, growth factors.記錄大小（長寬深）、滲液、潛行與隧道；考慮轉介傷口與營養專家。其他治療：負壓傷口治療、高壓氧、電刺激、生長因子。
PDF p.240, 241, 242, 243

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Diabetes/PVD foot care: no soaking, no self nail trimming (podiatrist), dry between toes, no lotion between toes.糖尿病／周邊血管疾病足部護理：不泡腳、不自行剪甲（轉介足科）、趾縫擦乾、趾縫不擦乳液。 PDF p.235, 246
  2. Ask about soap/product allergies before a bed bath.床上擦浴前先詢問對肥皂／產品過敏。 PDF p.234, 246
  3. Never massage a reddened area: it damages capillaries and tissue.絕不按摩發紅處：會損傷微血管與組織。 PDF p.240
  4. Turn immobile clients at least every 2 hours; ROM at least every 8 hours.活動受限者至少每2小時翻身；至少每8小時做關節活動。 PDF p.240
  5. Stage 1 intact nonblanchable red; stage 2 partial thickness; stage 3 full thickness with fat; stage 4 muscle/tendon/bone.第1期完整不變白紅；第2期部分皮層；第3期全層伴脂肪；第4期肌肉／肌腱／骨頭。 PDF p.241, 242
  6. Eschar or slough hiding the base means unstageable; deep purple/maroon means suspected deep-tissue injury.焦痂或腐肉覆蓋底部為無法分期；深紫／栗色為疑似深層組織損傷。 PDF p.242
  7. Crutches resting on the axillae can injure the brachial plexus; keep 2-3 finger widths.拐杖壓在腋下會傷臂神經叢；保留2-3指寬空隙。 PDF p.237
  8. Cane goes on the stronger side; with right-sided weakness use the left hand.手杖持於較強側；右側無力用左手。 PDF p.238, 247
  9. Stairs with crutches: up with the good leg, down with the bad leg (crutches go with the affected leg).拐杖上下樓：好腳先上，壞腳（連同拐杖）先下。 PDF p.238
  10. Use an electric razor for clients on anticoagulants/antiplatelets, thrombocytopenia or bleeding disorders.使用抗凝血劑／抗血小板藥、血小板低或出血疾患者，須用電動刮鬍刀。 PDF p.236, 247
  11. Immobility complications: atelectasis, orthostatic hypotension, DVT, hypercalcemia/kidney stones, constipation, contractures, pressure injury.制動併發症：肺塌陷、姿位性低血壓、深部靜脈血栓、高血鈣／腎結石、便祕、攣縮、壓力性損傷。 PDF p.237
  12. Purulent exudate (yellow/green/brown) signals infection; sanguineous means active bleeding.膿性滲液（黃／綠／褐）提示感染；血性代表活動性出血。 PDF p.240
  13. Wound healing phases: inflammatory 3-5 days, fibroblastic day 4 to 4 weeks, maturation up to 1 year.癒合期：發炎期3-5天、纖維母細胞期第4天至4週、成熟期可達1年。 PDF p.239
  14. Dentures stored overnight in a labeled cup covered with water; clean with lukewarm water.假牙夜間放在有標示的杯中並以水覆蓋；用微溫水清洗。 PDF p.236, 246
  15. Unconscious clients need eye lubrication and frequent oral care.昏迷個案需眼部潤滑與頻繁口腔護理。 PDF p.236, 237

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Crutch stairs: 'Up with the good, down with the bad.'拐杖上下樓：「好的先上，壞的先下」。 PDF p.238
  • Cane: hold it on the strong side; cane and weak leg move together.手杖：持於強側；手杖與弱腿一起前進。 PDF p.238
  • Pressure injury stage memory: 1 intact red, 2 dermis, 3 fat, 4 bone/muscle.壓力性損傷分期記憶：1 完整紅、2 真皮、3 脂肪、4 骨與肌肉。 PDF p.241

17 Urinary and Bowel Elimination泌尿與腸道排泄

This chapter covers urinary assessment, retention, UTI, the types of incontinence, urinary catheters, urinary diversions, bowel assessment, constipation, impaction, diarrhea, ostomies, and restorative measures such as bladder training, enemas and laxatives. High-yield themes: urine output of 30 mL/hr, CAUTI prevention, stoma color, and ileostomy fluid loss.本章涵蓋泌尿評估、尿滯留、泌尿道感染、各類尿失禁、導尿管、尿路改道、腸道評估、便祕、糞便嵌塞、腹瀉、造口，以及膀胱訓練、灌腸與軟便劑等復健措施。高頻重點：尿量30 mL/hr、預防導尿管相關感染、造口顏色、迴腸造口體液流失。

Urinary Assessment泌尿評估

  • Assess voiding pattern: fluid intake, frequency, nocturia, urgency, dysuria, hesitancy, dribbling, hematuria, caffeine, and drugs such as diuretics.評估排尿型態：水分攝取、頻率、夜尿、急尿、排尿疼痛、遲滯、滴尿、血尿、咖啡因及利尿劑等藥物。
  • Urine output should be at least 30 mL/hr; below that, or two consecutive low voids, needs prompt follow-up for renal impairment or hypovolemia.尿量應至少30 mL/hr；低於此值或連續兩次排尿量偏少需立即追蹤，可能為腎功能受損或血容量不足。
  • Normal urine is clear, pale straw to amber, mild ammonia odor. Foul odor may mean UTI; cloudy from bacteria/WBC; blood is abnormal. Phenazopyridine and beets change color; asparagus changes odor.正常尿液清澈、淡稻草色至琥珀色、有輕微氨味。惡臭可能為泌尿道感染；混濁可因細菌或白血球；血尿為異常。Phenazopyridine 與甜菜根會改變顏色；蘆筍改變氣味。
  • Physical findings: flank pain and CVA tenderness (kidney), distended bladder, meatal drainage, perineal skin problems.身體檢查：腰痛與肋脊角壓痛（腎）、膀胱脹、尿道口分泌物、會陰皮膚問題。
PDF p.249, 250

Urinary Retention and UTI尿滯留與泌尿道感染

  • Retention: bladder cannot fully empty; straining, small frequent voids or dribbling, suprapubic discomfort. Postvoid residual by bladder scan or straight cath confirms it. Causes: enlarged prostate, stones.尿滯留：膀胱無法完全排空；用力排尿、少量頻尿或滴尿、恥骨上不適。以膀胱掃描或單次導尿測餘尿確認。原因：攝護腺肥大、結石。
  • UTI symptoms: dysuria, urgency, frequency, suprapubic tenderness, cloudy foul urine, hematuria. Older adults may show confusion, falls, incontinence and no fever.泌尿道感染症狀：排尿疼痛、急尿、頻尿、恥骨上壓痛、混濁惡臭尿、血尿。老年人可能只表現意識混亂、跌倒、失禁，且不發燒。
  • Most common organism is E. coli. Lower UTI = cystitis; upper = pyelonephritis; ascending infection can cause urosepsis.最常見致病菌為大腸桿菌。下泌尿道感染＝膀胱炎；上泌尿道＝腎盂腎炎；上行感染可致泌尿道敗血症。
  • Asymptomatic bacteriuria is not treated; symptomatic UTI gets antibiotics. CAUTI is a preventable health care-associated infection.無症狀性菌尿不治療；有症狀的泌尿道感染使用抗生素。導尿管相關感染（CAUTI）是可預防的醫療照護相關感染。
  • Risks: indwelling catheter, stasis, poor perineal hygiene, incontinence, constipation, stones, pregnancy, menopause, delayed voiding.風險：留置導尿管、尿液滯留、會陰衛生不良、失禁、便祕、結石、懷孕、停經、習慣憋尿。
PDF p.249, 250

Types of Urinary Incontinence尿失禁類型

  • Urge (overactive bladder): sudden strong urge then leakage before reaching toilet; nocturia.急迫性（膀胱過動）：突然強烈尿意，來不及到廁所即漏尿；夜尿。
  • Stress: small leaks with cough, laugh or exertion from weak sphincter or pelvic floor.壓力性：咳嗽、大笑或用力時少量漏尿，因括約肌或骨盆底肌無力。
  • Mixed: urge plus stress. Overflow: bladder distended by obstruction or underactive muscle, constant dribbling.混合性：急迫加壓力性。滿溢性：因阻塞或膀胱肌無力造成膀胱脹滿，持續滴尿。
  • Functional: normal urinary tract but cannot reach or use toilet in time (arthritis, mobility, cognition); reflex: nerve damage (MS, spinal cord injury) with leakage without warning.功能性：泌尿道正常，但因關節炎、行動或認知問題無法及時如廁；反射性：神經受損（多發性硬化、脊髓損傷），無預警漏尿。
  • Treat with pelvic floor exercises, bladder training, scheduled toileting, safety measures, and medication for overactive bladder.處理：骨盆底運動、膀胱訓練、定時如廁、安全措施，過動膀胱可用藥物。
PDF p.250, 251

Urinary Catheters導尿管

  • Straight (single lumen) for one-time drainage, specimens, residuals; indwelling with balloon (double lumen); three-way (triple lumen) for continuous bladder irrigation.單次導尿管（單腔）用於一次性排空、採檢、測餘尿；留置氣球導尿管（雙腔）；三腔導尿管用於持續膀胱灌洗。
  • Strict aseptic technique for insertion; sterile field above waist, 1-inch border contaminated. Female: advance about 3 inches then 1-2 inches more after urine; male: 7-9 inches then 1-2 inches more.插入須嚴格無菌；無菌區保持在腰部以上，邊緣1吋視為污染。女性：進約3吋，見尿後再進1-2吋；男性：進7-9吋，見尿後再進1-2吋。
  • Inflate balloon fully only after urine returns. If the client has pain on inflation, stop and deflate; do not continue.見尿後才完全充氣氣球。若充氣時個案疼痛，須停止並放氣，不可繼續。
  • Care: clean meatus and catheter with soap and water daily, keep bag below bladder level, secure catheter to thigh, no disconnecting the closed system, no lotion or powder near the catheter, empty bag regularly, remove as soon as possible.護理：每日以肥皂水清潔尿道口與導管、集尿袋低於膀胱、導管固定於大腿、不隨意中斷密閉系統、導管周圍不用乳液或粉、定時倒尿、盡早拔除。
  • Removal: deflate the balloon completely with a syringe, pull slowly, record first void and amounts for 24 hours.拔除：以針筒完全抽空氣球，緩慢拔出，記錄第一次排尿及24小時尿量。
  • Ureteral/nephrostomy tubes: never clamp, irrigate only if prescribed with at most 5 mL sterile saline; output under 30 mL/hr or none for 15 minutes is reported at once.輸尿管／腎造口管：絕不夾管，僅在醫囑下以最多5 mL無菌生理食鹽水緩慢沖洗；尿量低於30 mL/hr或15分鐘無尿須立即通報。
PDF p.251, 252

Urinary Diversion and Stoma Care尿路改道與造口護理

  • Types: ureterostomy (pouch needed), ileal conduit (stoma and pouch), continent internal ileal reservoir such as Kock pouch (self-catheterize every 4-6 hours), ureterosigmoidostomy (urine passes with stool, no stoma).類型：輸尿管造口（需戴袋）、迴腸導管（造口與尿袋）、可控式迴腸貯尿囊如 Kock pouch（每4-6小時自行導尿）、輸尿管乙狀結腸造口（尿隨糞便排出，無造口）。
  • Postop: check stoma hourly for 24 hours (red and moist); dusky or dark stoma means necrosis; urine flow 30-60 mL/hr, report under 30 mL/hr or none for 15 min.術後：前24小時每小時檢查造口（紅色濕潤）；暗黑或紫暗代表壞死；尿量30-60 mL/hr，低於30 mL/hr或15分鐘無尿須通報。
  • Watch for hematuria, peritonitis, return of peristalsis in 2-3 days, shock, hemorrhage, thrombophlebitis and lymphedema after radical cystectomy.觀察血尿、腹膜炎、2-3天腸蠕動恢復，以及根除性膀胱切除後的休克、出血、血栓性靜脈炎與淋巴水腫。
  • Urine pH should be 4.0-6.0; do not put the dipstick into the stoma.尿液 pH 應為4.0-6.0；試紙不可放入造口內。
  • Pouch care: change in the morning (least urine), cut barrier no more than 3 mm larger than stoma, empty when one-third full, change every 5-7 days, avoid karaya (urine erodes it), vinegar soak for odor, bath water below the stoma.尿袋護理：早晨更換（尿量最少）、底板開口不超過造口大3 mm、三分之一滿時倒空、每5-7天更換、避免 karaya（尿會侵蝕）、以稀釋白醋浸泡除臭、泡澡水位低於造口。
  • Reservoir catheterization: start every 2-3 hours, lengthen by 1 hour per week to every 4-6 hours; use clean technique; never force.貯尿囊導尿：起初每2-3小時，每週延長1小時至每4-6小時；使用清潔技術；不可強插。
PDF p.253, 254, 255

Promoting Urinary Elimination促進排尿

  • Fluids about 2000-2300 mL/day (if no heart/renal restriction); avoid fluids 2 hours before sleep for nocturia.每日水分約2000-2300 mL（無心腎限制時）；睡前2小時避免飲水以減少夜尿。
  • Privacy, normal position (women sitting, men standing), running water, double voiding, bladder scan for residual.提供隱私、採正常姿勢（女性坐、男性站）、流水聲、二次排尿、膀胱掃描測餘尿。
  • Prevent infection: fluids, perineal hygiene, front-to-back wiping, cotton underwear, regular voiding.預防感染：補水、會陰衛生、由前往後擦拭、棉質內褲、規律排尿。
  • Avoid bladder irritants (coffee, tea, soft drinks, chocolate, smoking). Kegel exercises, bladder training with urge suppression, scheduled toileting every 2-3 hours.避免膀胱刺激物（咖啡、茶、汽水、巧克力、吸菸）。凱格爾運動、以放鬆呼吸抑制尿意的膀胱訓練、每2-3小時定時如廁。
  • Intermittent catheterization: about 400 mL per cath shows a good schedule.間歇導尿：每次約400 mL表示排程適當。
PDF p.255, 256, 257

Bowel Assessment and Alterations腸道評估與異常

  • Influences: age, fiber and fluids, activity, stress/depression, medications (opioids and iron constipate; antibiotics cause diarrhea), position, pregnancy, pain.影響因素：年齡、纖維與水分、活動、壓力／憂鬱、藥物（鴉片類與鐵劑致便祕；抗生素致腹瀉）、姿勢、懷孕、疼痛。
  • Constipation: fewer than 3 stools per week, hard dry stools. Impaction: repeated urge without passage, seepage of liquid stool; confused and debilitated clients at greatest risk.便祕：每週少於3次、糞便硬而乾。糞便嵌塞：反覆便意卻無法排出、滲出液態糞便；意識混亂與虛弱者風險最高。
  • Diarrhea: unformed liquid stool, risk of dehydration and electrolyte imbalance; consider C. difficile after antibiotics.腹瀉：排出液狀稀便，有脫水與電解質失衡風險；抗生素後須考慮 C. difficile。
  • Incontinence, flatulence, and hemorrhoids (engorged rectal veins from straining, pregnancy, heart/liver failure).大便失禁、脹氣與痔瘡（因用力、懷孕、心肝衰竭致直腸靜脈腫脹）。
PDF p.256, 257

Bowel Diversion: Colostomy and Ileostomy腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口

  • Healthy stoma is red or pink and moist; pale suggests low Hgb/Hct; dark, dusky, purple or black means ischemia and the surgeon must be notified immediately.健康造口為紅或粉紅且濕潤；蒼白提示血紅素／血比容低；暗黑、紫暗或黑色代表缺血，須立即通知外科醫師。
  • Ascending colostomy gives liquid stool; transverse loose to semiformed; descending and sigmoid near-normal. Ileostomy output is liquid, green to yellow.升結腸造口排液狀便；橫結腸為糊狀至半成形；降結腸與乙狀結腸接近正常。迴腸造口為液狀、由深綠轉黃。
  • Ileostomy carries high risk of dehydration and electrolyte imbalance; monitor I&O.迴腸造口脫水與電解質失衡風險高；監測輸出入量。
  • Postop: pouch fitted early, empty at one-third full, keep stool off skin, passing flatus and stool by about 72 hours is expected, teach to limit gas-forming foods.術後：早期裝上造口袋、三分之一滿時倒空、避免糞便接觸皮膚、約72小時內排氣與排便屬預期，教導限制產氣食物。
  • Colostomy irrigation: 500-1000 mL lukewarm tap water, bag at shoulder level, insert without force, clamp for cramping, same time daily, about 1 hour after meals.結腸造口灌洗：500-1000 mL 微溫自來水、灌洗袋與肩同高、不可強行插入、絞痛時夾管、每日同一時間、飯後約1小時。
  • Preop: enterostomal therapist marks site, diet and bowel prep as ordered, teach-back, and psychosocial support about body image and sexuality.術前：造口治療師標記位置、依醫囑飲食與腸道準備、回覆示教、提供身體意象與性生活的心理支持。
PDF p.258, 259

Restorative Bowel Care, Laxatives and Enemas腸道復健、軟便劑與灌腸

  • Bowel training: same time daily, hot drink or prune juice, privacy, lean forward or footstool, exercise at least 150 minutes per week, high-fiber diet with fluids.腸道訓練：每日固定時間、熱飲或西梅汁、隱私、前傾或腳凳、每週運動至少150分鐘、高纖飲食並補水。
  • Diarrhea diet: clear liquids then low-residue (white rice, bread, bananas, potatoes); protect skin; fecal collection devices if skin intact.腹瀉飲食：清流質後改低渣（白飯、麵包、香蕉、馬鈴薯）；保護皮膚；皮膚完整時可用糞便收集裝置。
  • Laxatives should not be used long term (reduced motility and sensation). Antidiarrheals treat cause as well.軟便劑不可長期使用（降低蠕動與感覺）。腹瀉也應針對病因處理並可用止瀉藥。
  • Enema: left lateral position, tube toward umbilicus, container at shoulder height, stop and breathe for cramping, hold as long as possible; normal saline preferred (isotonic); hypertonic (Fleet) contraindicated in dehydration and young infants; tap water limited to 3 due to overload risk.灌腸：左側臥、管子朝向肚臍、容器與肩同高、絞痛時停止並深呼吸、盡量忍住；首選生理食鹽水（等張）；高張（Fleet）禁用於脫水與幼嬰；自來水灌腸最多3次以免容積過量。
  • Digital removal of stool: last resort, left lateral position, monitor pulse because vagal stimulation can slow heart rate.手挖糞便：最後手段，左側臥，監測脈搏，因迷走神經刺激可使心跳減慢。
PDF p.259, 260, 261

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Urine output below 30 mL/hr (or two consecutive low voids) requires prompt evaluation.尿量低於30 mL/hr（或連續兩次排尿量少）須立即評估。 PDF p.249
  2. Older adults with UTI may show only confusion, falls or incontinence, without fever.老年人泌尿道感染可能僅表現意識混亂、跌倒或失禁，且不發燒。 PDF p.250
  3. Asymptomatic bacteriuria is not treated with antibiotics.無症狀性菌尿不用抗生素治療。 PDF p.250
  4. CAUTI prevention: aseptic insertion, closed system, bag below bladder, daily care, remove catheter early.預防 CAUTI：無菌插入、密閉系統、集尿袋低於膀胱、每日護理、盡早拔管。 PDF p.251
  5. If a client has pain as the catheter balloon inflates, stop inflating and deflate; the balloon may be in the urethra.氣球充氣時個案疼痛，須停止並放氣；氣球可能仍在尿道內。 PDF p.252, 262
  6. Never clamp a ureteral or nephrostomy tube; irrigate only if prescribed with max 5 mL sterile saline.輸尿管／腎造口管絕不夾管；僅在醫囑下以最多5 mL無菌生理食鹽水沖洗。 PDF p.251, 252
  7. Urinary stoma pouch: empty at one-third full, change every 5-7 days, change in the morning.尿路造口袋：三分之一滿倒空、每5-7天更換、早晨更換。 PDF p.255
  8. A dusky, purple, dark blue or black stoma indicates necrosis: notify the surgeon immediately.造口暗紅、紫、深藍或黑色代表壞死：立即通知外科醫師。 PDF p.253, 258, 259
  9. Healthy stoma: red or pink and moist; passing flatus after colostomy is a normal sign of returning peristalsis.健康造口：紅或粉紅、濕潤；結腸造口後排氣是腸蠕動恢復的正常徵象。 PDF p.258, 262
  10. Ileostomy: most frequent complication is fluid and electrolyte imbalance.迴腸造口：最常見併發症為體液與電解質失衡。 PDF p.259, 263
  11. Stool consistency by colostomy site: ascending liquid, transverse loose/semiformed, descending/sigmoid near normal.各結腸造口糞便性質：升結腸液狀、橫結腸糊狀／半成形、降結腸與乙狀結腸接近正常。 PDF p.259
  12. Opioids and iron cause constipation; antibiotics cause diarrhea (watch for C. difficile).鴉片類與鐵劑引起便祕；抗生素引起腹瀉（注意 C. difficile）。 PDF p.257
  13. Digital stool removal can stimulate the vagus nerve and slow heart rate: monitor pulse.手挖糞便可刺激迷走神經使心跳變慢：監測脈搏。 PDF p.261
  14. Hypertonic enemas are contraindicated in dehydration and young infants; tap water enemas limited to 3.高張灌腸禁用於脫水與幼嬰；自來水灌腸最多3次。 PDF p.261
  15. Enema position: left lateral (Sims) with rectal tube aimed at the umbilicus.灌腸姿勢：左側臥（Sims 臥位），肛管朝向肚臍。 PDF p.260
  16. Do not place a urine dipstick into the stoma; normal urine pH is 4.0-6.0.試紙不可放入造口；正常尿液 pH 為4.0-6.0。 PDF p.255

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Stoma color: red = good, dusky/dark = dead (call the surgeon).造口顏色：紅＝好，暗黑＝壞死（通知外科醫師）。 PDF p.258
  • Further along the colon, firmer the stool: ascending liquid, descending formed.愈往遠端結腸，糞便愈成形：升結腸液狀，降結腸成形。 PDF p.259
  • Catheter bag stays below the bladder for downhill flow.集尿袋永遠低於膀胱，讓尿液順勢流下。 PDF p.251

18 Theories of Growth and Development成長與發展理論

This chapter summarizes four major developmental theories tested on NCLEX: Erikson (psychosocial), Piaget (cognitive), Kohlberg (moral) and Freud (psychosexual). Match each age group to its stage, task and appropriate nursing approach, and recognize when a finding is developmentally abnormal.本章整理 NCLEX 常考的四大發展理論：艾瑞克森（心理社會）、皮亞傑（認知）、柯爾伯格（道德）與佛洛伊德（心理性慾）。須將各年齡層對應其階段、任務與適當護理方式，並能辨識發展異常。

Erikson: Psychosocial Development艾瑞克森：心理社會發展

  • Eight stages from birth to death; each presents a crisis that must be resolved for emotional progress, though outcomes can be revised by later experience.從出生到死亡共八個階段；每階段有一個危機，須解決才能情緒成長，但結果可被日後經驗改變。
  • Infancy (birth-18 mo): trust vs mistrust; attachment to caregiver. Respond to infant cues, hold and comfort.嬰兒期（出生-18個月）：信任對不信任；與主要照顧者依附。回應嬰兒的訊號、擁抱與安撫。
  • Early childhood (18 mo-3 yr): autonomy vs shame and doubt; allow self-feeding, dressing and safe choices; set limits for tantrums with simple explanations.幼兒期（18個月-3歲）：自主對羞愧懷疑；讓孩子自行進食、穿衣與在安全下做選擇；對發脾氣設限並簡單說明。
  • Late childhood (3-6 yr): initiative vs guilt; purposeful play, medical-equipment play.學齡前期（3-6歲）：主動對罪惡感；有目的的遊戲、使用醫療器材玩具。
  • School age (6-12 yr): industry vs inferiority; learning and social skills; peers become important; continue schoolwork in hospital.學齡期（6-12歲）：勤奮對自卑；學習與社交技能；同儕變重要；住院時持續課業。
  • Adolescence (12-20 yr): identity vs role confusion; allow choices and private interviews without parents.青春期（12-20歲）：自我認同對角色混淆；讓其參與決定並可在無父母在場下會談。
  • Early adulthood (20-35): intimacy vs isolation. Middle adulthood (35-65): generativity vs stagnation. Later adulthood (65+): integrity vs despair; listen to reminiscence.成年早期（20-35歲）：親密對孤立。成年中期（35-65歲）：生產對停滯。老年期（65歲以上）：完整對絕望；傾聽其回顧人生。
PDF p.268, 269

Piaget: Cognitive Development皮亞傑：認知發展

  • Schema is a mental framework; assimilation fits new information into existing schemas; accommodation changes the schema to fit new information.基模是思考架構；同化是將新資訊納入既有基模；調適是改變基模以容納新資訊。
  • Sensorimotor (birth-2 yr): learns through senses and movement; object permanence develops (does not know hidden objects exist at first).感覺動作期（出生-2歲）：透過感覺與動作學習；發展物體恆存概念（起初不知被遮物體仍存在）。
  • Preoperational (2-7 yr): prelogical, egocentric, needs concrete examples, thinks in past/present/future.前運思期（2-7歲）：前邏輯思考、自我中心、需要具體例子，開始有過去、現在、未來概念。
  • Concrete operational (7-11 yr): classifies, orders, sorts; logical about concrete problems; less egocentric.具體運思期（7-11歲）：分類、排序、歸納；對具體問題有邏輯；較不自我中心。
  • Formal operational (11 yr to adulthood): abstract and logical thinking like an adult.形式運思期（11歲至成年）：如成人般抽象與邏輯思考。
  • A 6-year-old who lacks object permanence is abnormal: report to the pediatrician.6歲兒童缺乏物體恆存屬異常：應通報小兒科醫師。
PDF p.269, 270, 274

Kohlberg: Moral Development柯爾伯格：道德發展

  • Moral development is sequential; stages cannot be skipped; it follows cognitive development; not everyone reaches stages 5-6.道德發展依序進行，不可跳階；隨認知發展而進展；並非人人達到第5-6階段。
  • Preconventional: stage 1 punishment-obedience (2-4 yr), stage 2 instrumental relativist, 'what is in it for me' (4-7 yr). Motivated by punishment and reward.前習俗層次：第1階段懲罰與服從（2-4歲），第2階段工具相對（「我有什麼好處」）（4-7歲）。動機來自懲罰與獎賞。
  • Conventional: stage 3 good boy/nice girl (7-10 yr) to please others; stage 4 law and order (10-12 yr).習俗層次：第3階段乖男孩／好女孩（7-10歲），為取悅他人；第4階段法律與秩序（10-12歲）。
  • Postconventional (about age 13+): stage 5 social contract; stage 6 universal ethical principles; internal conscience.後習俗層次（約13歲後）：第5階段社會契約；第6階段普遍倫理原則；內在良知。
  • Toddler discipline: simple explanations, praise good behavior, distraction; avoid physical punishment or withdrawing love.幼兒管教：簡單說明、稱讚良好行為、轉移注意；避免體罰或收回關愛。
PDF p.270, 271

Freud: Levels of Awareness and Personality佛洛伊德：意識層次與人格結構

  • Unconscious: illogical, pleasure principle, repressed material. Preconscious: recallable. Conscious: logical, reality principle.潛意識：不合邏輯、享樂原則、壓抑的內容。前意識：可回憶。意識：合邏輯、現實原則。
  • Id: drives, pleasure principle, present at birth, impulsive. Ego: reality testing and problem solving, mediates between id and world, starts about 4-5 months. Superego: conscience and ego ideal, develops in phallic stage (3-6 yr).本我：驅力、享樂原則、出生即有、衝動。自我：現實檢驗與解決問題、調節本我與外界，約4-5個月開始形成。超我：良知與自我理想，於性器期（3-6歲）發展。
  • Defense mechanisms are mostly unconscious (except suppression) and distort reality to reduce anxiety; needed for survival but extreme use hinders adjustment.防衛機轉多為無意識（壓抑除外），扭曲現實以減少焦慮；為生存所必需，但過度使用妨礙適應。
PDF p.270, 271, 272

Freud: Psychosexual Stages佛洛伊德：心理性慾期

  • Oral (birth-1 yr): gratification through mouth; trust begins; ego emerges.口腔期（出生-1歲）：以口腔獲得滿足；信任開始；自我萌芽。
  • Anal (1-3 yr): toilet training and control of body; learning to delay gratification.肛門期（1-3歲）：如廁訓練與身體控制；學習延遲滿足。
  • Phallic (3-6 yr): genital focus, Oedipus complex, identification with same-sex parent; superego emerges.性器期（3-6歲）：注意生殖器、戀母情結、認同同性父母；超我出現。
  • Latency (6-12 yr): sexual urges quiet; energy goes to school, friends and skills.潛伏期（6-12歲）：性衝動沉寂；精力投入學業、友誼與技能。
  • Genital (12+): puberty, mature sexual and emotional relationships, life goals and identity.兩性期／生殖期（12歲以上）：青春期、成熟的性與情感關係、人生目標與認同。
  • Each stage has a conflict to resolve; early experiences shape adult personality.每階段有需解決的衝突；早期經驗形塑成人人格。
PDF p.272, 273

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Infant: trust vs mistrust; respond promptly and consistently to the infant's signals.嬰兒：信任對不信任；對嬰兒訊號迅速且一致地回應。 PDF p.269, 274
  2. Toddler: autonomy vs shame/doubt; allow safe choices, set limits on tantrums with simple explanations.幼兒：自主對羞愧懷疑；給予安全選擇，對發脾氣設限並簡單說明。 PDF p.268, 269
  3. Preschooler: initiative vs guilt; encourage purposeful, imaginative play.學齡前：主動對罪惡感；鼓勵有目的與想像的遊戲。 PDF p.269
  4. School-age: industry vs inferiority; peer focus is normal and healthy.學齡兒童：勤奮對自卑；注重同儕是正常且健康的。 PDF p.269, 274
  5. Adolescent: identity vs role confusion; interview privately and include in decisions.青少年：認同對角色混淆；私下會談並納入決策。 PDF p.269
  6. Older adult: integrity vs despair; listen to life reminiscence.老年人：完整對絕望；傾聽生命回顧。 PDF p.269
  7. Piaget: sensorimotor 0-2, preoperational 2-7, concrete 7-11, formal 11+.皮亞傑：感覺動作期0-2、前運思期2-7、具體運思期7-11、形式運思期11歲以上。 PDF p.270
  8. A school-age child without object permanence is developmentally delayed: report to the provider.學齡兒童缺乏物體恆存為發展遲緩：通報醫師。 PDF p.270, 274
  9. Preconventional morality is driven by punishment and reward.前習俗道德以懲罰與獎賞為動機。 PDF p.271, 274
  10. Kohlberg stages are sequential and cannot be skipped; preschoolers are preconventional, school-age conventional, adolescents postconventional.柯爾伯格階段依序、不可跳階；學齡前為前習俗、學齡期為習俗、青少年進入後習俗。 PDF p.271, 275
  11. Freud: anal stage = toilet training (1-3 yr); phallic = identification with same-sex parent; latency = sexual repression; oral = mouth gratification.佛洛伊德：肛門期＝如廁訓練（1-3歲）；性器期＝認同同性父母；潛伏期＝性衝動壓抑；口腔期＝口腔滿足。 PDF p.272, 274
  12. Id = pleasure principle, ego = reality principle, superego = conscience.本我＝享樂原則；自我＝現實原則；超我＝良知。 PDF p.270, 271, 272
  13. Defense mechanisms are unconscious except suppression.防衛機轉為無意識，唯壓抑（suppression）為有意識。 PDF p.272
  14. Do not use physical punishment or withdraw love with toddlers; use explanation, praise and distraction.對幼兒勿用體罰或收回關愛；用說明、稱讚與轉移注意力。 PDF p.271

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Erikson in order: Trust, Autonomy, Initiative, Industry, Identity, Intimacy, Generativity, Integrity (TAI-III-GI).艾瑞克森順序：信任、自主、主動、勤奮、認同、親密、生產、完整。 PDF p.269
  • Piaget: Sensorimotor, Preoperational, Concrete, Formal (S-P-C-F).皮亞傑：感覺動作、前運思、具體運思、形式運思（S-P-C-F）。 PDF p.270
  • Freud: Oral, Anal, Phallic, Latency, Genital (OAPLG).佛洛伊德：口腔、肛門、性器、潛伏、兩性（OAPLG）。 PDF p.272
  • Kohlberg: Pre-conventional (punish/reward), Conventional (please others/law), Post-conventional (principles).柯爾伯格：前習俗（懲罰／獎賞）、習俗（取悅他人／法律）、後習俗（原則）。 PDF p.271

19 Growth, Development, and Stages of Life成長、發展與生命階段

This chapter covers how hospitalization affects children at each age, communication and safety by developmental stage, well-child care, the childhood and adult immunization schedules, expected growth milestones from infancy through middle adulthood, gender identity, and end-of-life care. Age-appropriate play, safety teaching, vaccine contraindications and vital sign norms are heavily tested.本章涵蓋各年齡層兒童住院反應、依發展階段的溝通與安全、兒童健康檢查、兒童與成人疫苗時程、嬰兒至中年的生長發展里程碑、性別認同與臨終照護。適齡遊戲、安全衛教、疫苗禁忌與生命徵象正常值為常考重點。

Hospitalized Infant, Toddler, Preschooler住院的嬰兒、幼兒與學齡前兒童

  • Toddler separation anxiety has three phases: protest (crying, searching, aggression), despair (withdrawn, loses new skills), detachment (seems adjusted but is resignation; the most serious phase).幼兒分離焦慮三階段：抗議（哭鬧、尋找、攻擊）、絕望（退縮、喪失新技能）、疏離（看似適應，實為放棄；最嚴重）。
  • Toddlers fear pain and loss of control; they regress, show tantrums and ritual disruption. Offer choices, keep home routines, allow comfort objects, play therapy, accept regression.幼兒害怕疼痛與失控；會退化、發脾氣。提供選擇、維持家中作息、容許安慰物、遊戲治療、接納退化。
  • Infants: therapeutic touch, soft voice, pacifier for sucking even if NPO, contrasting colors and textures for stimulation.嬰兒：治療性碰觸、輕柔聲音、即使禁食也提供奶嘴吸吮、對比色與質感刺激。
  • Preschoolers: separation anxiety is less obvious; fear mutilation and invasive procedures and think illness is punishment for their thoughts. Encourage rooming-in or a favorite toy, simple explanations, play, independence, same-age peers.學齡前：分離焦慮較不明顯；害怕身體受損與侵入性處置，認為生病是自己想法或行為造成的。鼓勵陪住或帶心愛玩具、簡單說明、遊戲、獨立、同齡玩伴。
PDF p.277, 278

Hospitalized School-Age Child and Adolescent住院的學齡兒童與青少年

  • School-age: worry about missing school and being forgotten by friends; fear injury, disability, death and genital exams; protest-despair-detachment seldom occur.學齡兒童：擔心缺課與被朋友遺忘；害怕受傷、失能、死亡與生殖器檢查；少出現抗議-絕望-疏離。
  • Interventions: choices, involvement in care, body diagrams for explanations, privacy, schoolwork, contact with friends, accept regression but encourage independence.措施：提供選擇、參與照護、用人體圖說明、保護隱私、學業安排、與朋友聯繫、接納退化並鼓勵獨立。
  • Adolescents: ambivalent about parents, upset at being excluded by friends, fear being different, guard sexual-development exams; may seem unafraid.青少年：對父母態度矛盾、被朋友排除會難過、害怕與眾不同、對性發展檢查防衛；外表可能裝作不怕。
  • Support: privacy, own clothes and grooming, peer contact, schooling, future planning, positive coping.支持：隱私、穿自己的衣服與整理儀容、同儕聯繫、教育、未來規劃、正向因應。
PDF p.278, 279

Communication, Car Safety and Preventive Care溝通、汽車安全與預防保健

  • Infant: slow, calm approach, soft voice, respond to cries. Toddler: short concrete words, take words literally, prepare immediately before procedures, use play and let them handle equipment.嬰兒：緩慢溫和接近、輕柔聲音、回應哭聲。幼兒：簡短具體用詞、字面理解、操作前才準備、用遊戲並讓其摸器材。
  • Preschooler: simple sentences, offer choices, play and equipment handling. School-age: clear explanation, photos/dolls/medical play. Adolescent: privacy, avoid judgmental, too abstract or prying talk.學齡前：簡單句子、給選擇、遊戲與接觸器材。學齡兒童：清楚說明、照片/娃娃/醫療遊戲。青少年：保護隱私，避免批判、過度抽象或追問。
  • Back seat is safest for all children; follow manufacturer seat guidance; an 8-year-old 4 ft tall still needs a booster seat.所有兒童坐後座最安全；依製造商指引使用安全座椅；8 歲、身高 4 英尺（約 122 公分）仍需增高墊。
  • Well-child visits follow AAP/Bright Futures (screenings include development, autism, vision, hearing, lead, anemia, depression).依 AAP/Bright Futures 進行兒童健康檢查（篩檢包括發展、自閉症、視力、聽力、鉛、貧血、憂鬱）。
PDF p.279, 280

Immunizations: Principles and Childhood Schedule疫苗：原則與兒童時程

  • Missed doses are given without restarting the series; vaccines can be given simultaneously; preterm infants get full doses at chronological age.漏打只需補打不需重來；可同時接種；早產兒依實足年齡給足量。
  • Contraindications: anaphylaxis to prior dose or component; live vaccines not for severe immunodeficiency, pregnancy or gelatin sensitivity; caution with moderate/severe acute illness.禁忌：先前劑量或成分過敏性休克；活性疫苗不用於嚴重免疫缺損、孕婦或明膠過敏者；中重度急性病需小心。
  • Administration: separate syringes and sites; IM in vastus lateralis (deltoid from 36 months); IM needle 1 inch 23-25 g, subcutaneous 5/8 inch 25 g; observe 15-30 minutes; report adverse events.給藥：分開針筒與部位；肌肉注射於股外側肌（36 個月起可用三角肌）；IM 針 1 英寸 23-25 號、皮下針 5/8 英寸 25 號；觀察 15-30 分鐘；通報不良反應。
  • Schedule: birth HepB; 2, 4, 6 mo DTaP, Hib, IPV, PCV, RV; 12-15 mo MMR, varicella, HepA, PCV, Hib; 4-6 yr DTaP, IPV, MMR, varicella; 11-12 yr Tdap, MCV4, HPV. Flu yearly from 6 months.時程：出生 HepB；2、4、6 個月 DTaP、Hib、IPV、PCV、RV；12-15 個月 MMR、水痘、A 肝、PCV、Hib；4-6 歲 DTaP、IPV、MMR、水痘；11-12 歲 Tdap、MCV4、HPV。6 個月起每年流感。
  • Mother HBsAg positive: infant gets HepB vaccine and HBIG within 12 hours of birth.母親 HBsAg 陽性：嬰兒 12 小時內接種 HepB 疫苗並給 HBIG。
  • Rotavirus is oral; MMR, varicella, IPV given subcutaneously; delay MMR 3-6 months after immunoglobulin; avoid aspirin after varicella vaccine (Reye syndrome).輪狀病毒為口服；MMR、水痘、IPV 皮下注射；注射免疫球蛋白後 MMR 延後 3-6 個月；水痘疫苗後避免阿斯匹靈（Reye 症候群）。
PDF p.281, 282, 283

Other Vaccines, Adult Immunizations and Reactions其他疫苗、成人疫苗與反應

  • MCV4 at 11-12 yr with booster at 16; contraindicated with history of Guillain-Barre syndrome. HPV 3 doses over 6 months if started at 11-12 yr; avoid in pregnancy.MCV4 於 11-12 歲接種、16 歲追加；有格林巴利症候群病史者禁用。HPV 若 11-12 歲開始需 3 劑（6 個月內）；孕期避免。
  • Adults: yearly flu, Tdap then Td every 10 years, Tdap each pregnancy, zoster recombinant 2 doses at 50+, pneumococcal at 65+.成人：每年流感、Tdap 後每 10 年 Td、每次懷孕打 Tdap、50 歲以上帶狀疱疹重組疫苗 2 劑、65 歲以上肺炎鏈球菌。
  • Local reactions: tenderness, redness, low fever; cool compresses first 24 hours; acetaminophen or ibuprofen every 4-6 hr.局部反應：觸痛、紅腫、低燒；前 24 小時冷敷；每 4-6 小時給乙醯胺酚或布洛芬。
  • Anaphylaxis: secure airway, epinephrine, fluids, vasopressors, CPR if needed.過敏性休克：確保呼吸道、給 epinephrine、輸液、升壓劑，必要時 CPR。
  • COVID-19 vaccine: rare myocarditis/pericarditis; report chest pain, dyspnea, palpitations.COVID-19 疫苗：罕見心肌炎/心包炎；胸痛、呼吸困難、心悸須通報。
PDF p.283, 284

Infant Development嬰兒發展

  • Birth weight doubles at 5-6 months and triples at 12 months; length rises 50% by 1 year; head circumference 33-35 cm at birth.體重 5-6 個月加倍、12 個月三倍；1 歲身長增加 50%；出生頭圍 33-35 公分。
  • Posterior fontanel closes by 4 months; anterior by 18 months; soft and flat is normal; first teeth (lower central incisors) at 6-10 months.後囟門 4 個月前閉合；前囟門 18 個月前閉合；軟而平為正常；6-10 個月長出下中門牙。
  • Vital signs: newborn HR 120-160, RR 30-60; 1-year-old HR 90-130, RR 20-40, BP 90/56.生命徵象：新生兒心跳 120-160、呼吸 30-60；1 歲心跳 90-130、呼吸 20-40、血壓 90/56。
  • Nutrition: breast milk preferred for 6 months; vitamin D 400 IU for breastfed infants; iron stores depleted by 4 months; solids at 5-6 months one at a time every 4-5 days (iron-fortified rice cereal first); no cow's milk before 12 months, no honey under 12 months, no microwaving bottles, avoid choking foods.營養：6 個月內以母乳為佳；純母乳嬰兒補充維生素 D 400 IU；4 個月鐵質儲存耗盡；5-6 個月起一次一種副食品、間隔 4-5 天（先吃強化鐵米糊）；12 個月前不喝牛奶、不吃蜂蜜、不微波奶瓶、避免易噎食物。
  • Milestones: social smile 2-3 mo, rolls over 4-5 mo, sits with support and stranger fear 6-7 mo, sits unsupported and crawls 8-9 mo, walks alone 14-15 mo.里程碑：2-3 個月社交性微笑、4-5 個月翻身、6-7 個月扶坐與怕生、8-9 個月獨坐與爬行、14-15 個月獨自走路。
  • Safety: baby-proof, never leave on bed or in bath, no small toys, cords away, poison control number, never shake an infant.安全：居家防護、不讓嬰兒獨自在床上或浴缸、避免小零件玩具、繩索遠離、備毒物中心電話、絕不搖晃嬰兒。
PDF p.284, 285, 286

Toddler and Preschooler Development幼兒與學齡前兒童發展

  • Toddler: gains about 3 in/yr, 22-27 lb at 2 yr, lordosis (potbelly) normal, anterior fontanel closes 12-18 months, one nap, vital signs HR 80-120, RR 20-30.幼兒：每年長高約 7.5 公分、2 歲體重 10-12 公斤、腹部凸出（腰椎前凸）正常、前囟門 12-18 個月閉合、一次午睡、心跳 80-120、呼吸 20-30。
  • Toddler diet: 2-3 servings milk daily (24-30 oz), small meals, physiological anorexia normal, no bottle to bed, avoid choking foods, no food as reward.幼兒飲食：每天 2-3 份奶（700-800 mL）、少量多餐、生理性厭食正常、不含奶瓶入睡、避免易噎食物、不以食物當獎懲。
  • Toddler skills: runs by 2, hops on one foot by 3; about 300 words at 2; parallel play; toilet readiness signs (dry 2 hr, sits 5-10 min); bowel control precedes bladder.幼兒技能：2 歲會跑、3 歲單腳跳；2 歲約 300 字；平行遊戲；如廁準備徵象（乾燥 2 小時、可坐 5-10 分鐘）；先控制排便再控制排尿。
  • Toddler safety: back stove burners, pot handles inward, gates, window locks, never alone near water, lock poisons.幼兒安全：用後排爐頭、鍋柄朝內、安全門、窗鎖、水邊不離人、毒物上鎖。
  • Preschooler: 5 lb and 2.5-3 in per year, 12 hr sleep, alternates feet on stairs, cooperative and imaginative play, imaginary friends, magical thinking; teach fire, gun, stranger and 911 safety; guns locked unloaded.學齡前：每年增加 2.25 公斤與 6.5-7.5 公分、睡 12 小時、可雙腳交替上樓、合作性與想像遊戲、假想玩伴、魔幻思考；教導火、槍、陌生人與 119/911 安全；槍械退彈上鎖。
  • Preschooler vital signs HR 70-110, RR 16-22; vocabulary 900 words at 3 yr, 2100 at 5 yr.學齡前生命徵象心跳 70-110、呼吸 16-22；3 歲詞彙約 900 字、5 歲約 2100 字。
PDF p.286, 287, 288

School-Age, Adolescent and Adult Development學齡、青少年與成人發展

  • School-age: 2 in/yr, 4.5-6.5 lb/yr, permanent teeth from age 6, 10-12 hr sleep, competitive rule-based play, vital signs HR 60-100, RR 18-20; helmets, traffic and water safety.學齡：每年 5 公分、2-3 公斤、6 歲起恆齒、睡 10-12 小時、有規則的競爭遊戲、心跳 60-100、呼吸 18-20；戴安全帽、交通與水上安全。
  • Adolescent: puberty, menses about 2.5 years after puberty onset, risk-taking; teach about substances, seat belts, diving feet-first, STIs, internet safety; vitals HR 55-90, RR 12-20.青少年：青春期、初經約在青春期開始後 2.5 年、冒險行為；教導物質濫用、安全帶、腳先入水、性傳染病、網路安全；心跳 55-90、呼吸 12-20。
  • Early adulthood: separation from family, career/marriage decisions, ignores symptoms, STI risk. Middle adulthood: menopause/climacteric, generativity, empty nest, body image concerns.成年早期：脫離原生家庭、職涯婚姻決定、忽略症狀、性傳染病風險。成年中期：更年期、生產力（generativity）、空巢、身體形象。
  • Gender identity is personal sense of gender; gender expression is outward expression; sexual orientation is attraction. Support children with unconditional acceptance, watch for depression, prepare for bullying.性別認同為個人對自身性別的感受；性別表達為對外表現；性傾向為吸引對象。以無條件接納支持孩子、留意憂鬱、預備霸凌因應。
PDF p.288, 289, 290, 291

End-of-Life Care臨終照護

  • Care follows client wishes: advance directives, organ donation, withholding or withdrawing treatment, CPR. Palliative/hospice care focuses on comfort not cure.依個案意願：預立醫囑、器官捐贈、不給予或撤除治療、CPR。安寧緩和照護著重舒適而非治癒。
  • Near-death signs: slowed metabolism, blurred vision, hearing lost last, noisy respirations (death rattle), Cheyne-Stokes, slow HR and falling BP, cool mottled extremities, less urine, constipation, Kennedy terminal ulcer on sacrum.臨終徵象：代謝減慢、視力模糊、聽力最後消失、痰鳴（死前嘎嘎聲）、陳施氏呼吸、心跳慢血壓降、四肢冰冷斑駁、尿量減少、便秘、薦骨肯尼迪終末潰瘍。
  • Comfort care: never delay pain medication; elevate head of bed and oxygen for dyspnea; oral care, ice chips, do not force food; do not restrain restless client.舒適照護：不延誤止痛；呼吸困難時抬高床頭並給氧；口腔照護、冰塊、不強迫進食；躁動者不約束。
  • Address fears: pain, loneliness, being meaningless; allow family presence, touch if culturally acceptable, life review.處理恐懼：疼痛、孤獨、無意義感；容許家屬陪伴、文化允許時碰觸、生命回顧。
  • Respect culture and religion; ask the family about preferences. Postmortem care: dignity, check organ donor status, close eyes, replace dentures, wash, remove tubes, allow viewing; preserve evidence for medical examiner cases.尊重文化與宗教，詢問家屬偏好。遺體護理：維護尊嚴、確認器官捐贈、闔眼、裝回假牙、清潔、拔除管路、讓家屬瞻仰；需法醫案件須保留證據。
PDF p.291, 292, 293

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Detachment is the most serious phase of separation; the toddler looks adjusted but is resigned.疏離是分離反應中最嚴重階段；幼兒看似適應其實是放棄。 PDF p.277
  2. Preschoolers think illness is punishment and fear mutilation; use simple explanations and rooming-in.學齡前兒童認為生病是懲罰並害怕身體受損；用簡單說明並鼓勵陪住。 PDF p.278
  3. Hospitalized adolescents most fear separation from peers; school-age children fear missing school.住院青少年最怕與同儕分離；學齡兒童擔心缺課。 PDF p.278, 279
  4. Vital sign norms: newborn HR 120-160, RR 30-60; 1-yr RR 20-40; toddler HR 80-120; preschool HR 70-110; school-age HR 60-100; adolescent HR 55-90.生命徵象正常值：新生兒心跳 120-160、呼吸 30-60；1 歲呼吸 20-40；幼兒心跳 80-120；學齡前 70-110；學齡 60-100；青少年 55-90。 PDF p.284, 285, 286, 288, 289, 290
  5. Anterior fontanel soft and flat is normal; closes by 18 months. Posterior closes by 4 months.前囟門軟而平為正常，18 個月前閉合；後囟門 4 個月前閉合。 PDF p.284
  6. No honey or cow's milk under 12 months; no solids before 4-6 months; no microwaving bottles.12 個月前不可蜂蜜與牛奶；4-6 個月前不加副食品；不微波奶瓶。 PDF p.285
  7. Vitamin D 400 IU for breastfed infants; iron supplement when iron stores deplete at 4 months.母乳嬰兒補充維生素 D 400 IU；4 個月鐵質耗盡時補鐵。 PDF p.285
  8. Never let a toddler sleep with a bottle of milk or juice (bottle-mouth caries).幼兒不可含奶瓶（奶或果汁）入睡（奶瓶性齲齒）。 PDF p.286
  9. Choking foods for infants and toddlers: nuts, grapes, popcorn, raisins, hot dog pieces, seeds.嬰幼兒易噎食物：堅果、葡萄、爆米花、葡萄乾、熱狗片、帶籽食物。 PDF p.285, 287
  10. Never shake an infant (shaken baby syndrome).絕不搖晃嬰兒（嬰兒搖晃症候群）。 PDF p.286
  11. Vaccines: anaphylaxis is a contraindication; live vaccines avoided in pregnancy and severe immunodeficiency; mild illness is not a contraindication.疫苗：過敏性休克為禁忌；活性疫苗孕期與嚴重免疫缺損避免；輕微疾病不是禁忌。 PDF p.281
  12. Infant of HBsAg-positive mother gets HepB vaccine plus HBIG within 12 hours.HBsAg 陽性母親之嬰兒 12 小時內給 HepB 疫苗加 HBIG。 PDF p.282
  13. Avoid aspirin after varicella vaccine; delay MMR 3-6 months after immunoglobulin.水痘疫苗後避免阿斯匹靈；免疫球蛋白後 MMR 延後 3-6 個月。 PDF p.282, 283
  14. Infant IM vaccines go in vastus lateralis; observe 15-30 minutes after any vaccine for anaphylaxis.嬰兒肌肉注射選股外側肌；接種後觀察 15-30 分鐘以防過敏性休克。 PDF p.281, 284
  15. Car safety: back seat for all children; booster for 8-year-old under 4 ft 9 in.汽車安全：兒童坐後座；8 歲、未滿 4 英尺 9 英寸者用增高墊。 PDF p.280, 294
  16. Never delay pain medication for the dying client; do not restrain restlessness; hearing is last sense lost.臨終個案不延誤止痛；躁動不約束；聽覺最後消失。 PDF p.291, 293
  17. Kennedy terminal ulcer on the sacrum signals the dying process.薦骨肯尼迪終末潰瘍預示瀕死過程。 PDF p.292

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Separation response: P-D-D = Protest, Despair, Detachment.分離反應 P-D-D：抗議、絕望、疏離。 PDF p.277
  • Weight rule: birth weight doubles at 5-6 months, triples at 12 months.體重規則：5-6 個月兩倍、12 個月三倍。 PDF p.284
  • Posterior fontanel closes at 2-4 months-ish ('4 months'); anterior by 18 months ('12-18').後囟門約 4 個月前；前囟門約 12-18 個月。 PDF p.284

20 Care of the Older Client老年個案的照護

This chapter reviews normal age-related changes in each body system, common psychosocial and mental health concerns, pain, infection, medication safety, and mistreatment in older adults. Falls, medication toxicity, and atypical presentation of illness are the recurring NCLEX themes.本章整理老化在各身體系統的正常變化，以及老年人常見的心理社會與心理健康問題、疼痛、感染、用藥安全與受虐議題。跌倒、藥物毒性與疾病非典型表現是 NCLEX 常考重點。

Aging and Gerontology; Skin, Neuro and Musculoskeletal Changes老化與老年學；皮膚、神經與肌肉骨骼變化

  • Aging is a lifelong biopsychosocial process; gerontology is the study of aging.老化是從出生到死亡的生物、心理、社會變化歷程；老年學是研究老化的學科。
  • Skin: thinner epidermis, less elasticity, turgor, subcutaneous fat and sweating; bruises and tears easily, tolerates temperature extremes poorly.皮膚：表皮變薄、彈性與膚質張力下降、皮下脂肪與出汗減少；容易瘀青撕裂，對冷熱耐受差。
  • Skin care: inspect nails, cut toenails straight across, moisturize, ensure protein and fluids, dress for the weather.皮膚照護：檢查指甲、趾甲剪平、擦保濕劑、補充蛋白質與水分、依氣溫穿衣。
  • Neuro: slowed reflexes, tremor, poor balance, more night awakenings, short-term memory may decline while long-term memory is kept; do not rush the client.神經：反射變慢、輕微顫抖、平衡差、夜間易醒；短期記憶可能下降，長期記憶多半保留；不要催促個案。
  • Musculoskeletal: muscle atrophy, bone demineralization, kyphosis and height loss, wider-based shortened gait; combined with neuro changes this raises fall risk.肌肉骨骼：肌肉萎縮、骨質流失、駝背與身高變矮、步態變短且底寬；與神經變化合併使跌倒風險增加。
PDF p.301, 302

Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Blood, Immune and GI Changes心血管、呼吸、血液、免疫與消化變化

  • Cardiovascular: stiffer, thicker valves, lower cardiac output and exercise tolerance, weaker pulses, higher BP yet prone to orthostatic hypotension.心血管：瓣膜變厚變硬、心輸出量與運動耐受下降、脈搏較弱、血壓偏高但易姿勢性低血壓。
  • Respiratory: lower chest wall compliance, fewer alveoli, shallow breaths, weaker cough; respiratory rate itself is unchanged; infections are worse.呼吸：胸壁順應性下降、肺泡減少、呼吸變淺、咳痰能力差；呼吸速率本身不變；感染更嚴重。
  • Blood: Hgb/Hct at low end of normal, more clotting tendency, less albumin available to bind drugs.血液：Hgb/Hct 偏低正常範圍、較易凝血、可結合藥物的蛋白質減少。
  • Immune: reduced resistance; recommend influenza, pneumococcal and shingles vaccines.免疫：抵抗力下降；建議接種流感、肺炎鏈球菌與帶狀疱疹疫苗。
  • GI: lower caloric need, appetite and thirst, slowed motility, constipation, dehydration risk, dental problems, reduced taste/smell/saliva.消化：熱量需求、食慾與口渴感下降、腸蠕動變慢、便秘、易脫水、牙齒問題、味覺嗅覺與唾液減少。
PDF p.301, 302

Endocrine, Renal, Reproductive and Sensory Changes內分泌、腎臟、生殖與感覺變化

  • Endocrine: lower metabolic rate, decreased glucose tolerance with peripheral insulin resistance; dress warmly.內分泌：代謝率下降、葡萄糖耐受降低且周邊胰島素阻抗；需保暖。
  • Renal: smaller kidneys, lower GFR, reduced concentrating ability, smaller bladder capacity, more residual urine and infection; impaired drug excretion.腎臟：腎臟縮小、GFR 下降、濃縮能力差、膀胱容量小、殘尿與感染增加；藥物排除受損。
  • Bladder tips: limit fluids 2-4 hr before bed and void at least every 2 hr to prevent overflow incontinence.膀胱照護：睡前 2-4 小時減少飲水，至少每 2 小時排尿以預防滿溢性尿失禁。
  • Reproductive: lower testosterone, prostate changes (hesitancy, retention), vaginal dryness and reduced tone after menopause; teach Kegel exercises; sexual function varies.生殖：睪固酮下降、攝護腺改變（遲滯、滯留）、停經後陰道乾澀與肌張力下降；教導凱格爾運動；性功能因人而異。
  • Senses: reduced acuity, glare sensitivity, presbyopia and cataracts; hearing loss of high-frequency sounds so low-pitched tones are heard better; reduced pain awareness.感覺：視力下降、怕眩光、老花與白內障；高頻聽力喪失，低音調較易聽見；痛覺遲鈍。
PDF p.302, 303

Psychosocial and Mental Health Concerns心理社會與心理健康議題

  • Concerns include loss of independence, retirement and income, role change, loss of loved ones, health-care costs, and body image.常見困擾：失去獨立性、退休與收入減少、角色改變、親友逝去、醫療費用、身體形象。
  • Depression is common and may present as helplessness and low self-worth; always take suicide threats seriously.憂鬱常見，可表現為無助感與低自尊；任何自殺言語都須重視。
  • Grief and isolation are also frequent; effective coping after a death includes social activities and reminiscing, not neglect of grooming.哀傷與孤立也常見；喪親後有效的因應包括參與社交與回憶，而非忽略儀容。
  • Differentiate delirium (sudden, fluctuating, worse at night, impaired attention), depression (recent onset, flat affect, 'I don't know'), and dementia (insidious, years, stable).鑑別譫妄（突發、波動、夜間加重、注意力受損）、憂鬱（近期發作、情感平淡、常答不知道）與失智（隱匿、歷時數年、穩定）。
  • Promote autonomy by letting the client make choices.提供選擇讓個案自己決定，以促進自主。
PDF p.303, 304

Pain疼痛

  • Pain is often musculoskeletal and under-reported because older adults think it is normal aging or fear tests.疼痛多來自肌肉骨骼退化，且老人常因以為是老化或害怕檢查而少報。
  • Cues: restlessness, agitation, moaning, crying, verbal report.線索：躁動不安、激動、呻吟、哭泣、口述疼痛。
  • Set functional goals; use nonpharmacologic measures (distraction, relaxation, massage, heat/ice, stretching).設定功能性目標；採用非藥物措施（分散注意、放鬆、按摩、冷熱敷、伸展）。
  • Avoid opioids when possible; acetaminophen, topical lidocaine and others may be prescribed; evaluate effect.盡量避免使用鴉片類；可處方乙醯胺酚、利多卡因貼片等；並評估成效。
PDF p.303

Infection感染

  • Altered mental status, especially with a urinary tract infection, is a common sign of infection in the older adult.意識狀態改變是老人感染（尤其泌尿道感染）的常見徵象。
  • Nonspecific signs: anorexia, apathy, functional decline, falls, incontinence, tachypnea, hyperglycemia, BP below baseline.非特異性徵象：厭食、冷漠、功能下降、跌倒、尿失禁、呼吸急促、高血糖、血壓低於基準。
  • Risks: poor hygiene, poor nutrition or weight loss, inactivity, poor support, low albumin.風險因子：衛生不佳、營養不良或體重減輕、缺乏活動、社會支持差、低白蛋白。
PDF p.304

Medication Safety用藥安全

  • Problems: adverse effects, interactions, errors, nonadherence, polypharmacy, cost. Doses are often one-third to one-half of adult dose.問題：副作用、交互作用、用藥錯誤、不遵從、多重用藥、費用。劑量常為成人的三分之一至二分之一。
  • A sudden mental status change is a common sign of adverse drug reaction.突然的意識狀態改變是藥物不良反應的常見徵象。
  • Beers Criteria drugs to avoid: NSAIDs/ketorolac/indomethacin/meperidine, first-generation tricyclics and antihistamines, alpha-1 blockers, oxybutynin/tolterodine, muscle relaxants, benzodiazepines and barbiturates.Beers 準則應避免：NSAIDs/ketorolac/indomethacin/meperidine、第一代三環抗憂鬱劑與抗組織胺、alpha-1 阻斷劑、oxybutynin/tolterodine、肌肉鬆弛劑、苯二氮平類與巴比妥類。
  • Aspiration-safe oral meds: sit upright, one pill at a time, stay upright 30 min; do not crush enteric-coated or sustained-release tablets; thicken liquids, avoid straws.預防吸入的口服給藥：坐直、一次一顆、服後維持直立 30 分鐘；腸溶或長效錠不可磨碎；液體增稠、避免用吸管。
  • Polypharmacy first step: identify duplications; use one pharmacy, pill organizer, up-to-date list, and teach-back.多重用藥首要步驟：找出重複用藥；固定一家藥局、使用藥盒、隨身攜帶最新藥單、使用回覆示教。
PDF p.304, 305, 306

Mistreatment of the Older Adult老人受虐

  • Domestic mistreatment occurs at home (physical, psychological, financial, sexual, neglect, abandonment); institutional mistreatment occurs in facilities.家庭內虐待發生於家中（身體、心理、財務、性、疏忽、遺棄）；機構內虐待發生於照護機構。
  • Self-neglect is a competent person's choice; the person may refuse care unless declared incompetent.自我忽視是有行為能力者的選擇，除非被判無行為能力，否則有權拒絕照護。
  • Highest risk: dependent, immobile or cognitively impaired clients living with the abuser.高風險：依賴、行動不便或認知受損且與施虐者同住者。
  • Nurse actions: thorough injury assessment, private nonjudgmental interview, report to authorities, safety plan and resources.護理行動：完整傷勢評估、隱私且不批判的會談、通報主管機關、擬定安全計畫並提供資源。
  • Teach about scams: verify callers and never give bank, card, password or SSN information.教導防詐騙：查證來電者，絕不透露銀行、信用卡、密碼或社會安全號碼。
PDF p.306

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Falls risk comes from combined neurologic and musculoskeletal changes; do not rush the client and assess need for a cane or walker.跌倒風險來自神經與肌肉骨骼變化的合併；不要催促個案並評估是否需拐杖或助行器。 PDF p.301
  2. Decreased lean mass and GFR cause drug accumulation, so older clients are at risk for medication toxicity (e.g., digoxin).瘦體重與 GFR 下降使藥物蓄積，老人易發生藥物毒性（如 digoxin）。 PDF p.302, 306
  3. Respiratory rate is usually unchanged with aging; heart rate tends to decrease.老化時呼吸速率通常不變；心跳速率傾向下降。 PDF p.302
  4. Short-term memory may decline but long-term memory is usually preserved; marked loss is not normal.短期記憶可能下降但長期記憶通常保留。 PDF p.301
  5. Sudden confusion in an older adult suggests infection (often UTI) or drug reaction: assess first.老人突發意識混亂應考慮感染（常為 UTI）或藥物反應，先行評估。 PDF p.304, 305
  6. Delirium is sudden, fluctuating and worse at night; dementia is slow and progressive; depression has flat affect.譫妄突發、波動、夜間惡化；失智緩慢進行；憂鬱情感平淡。 PDF p.304
  7. Any suicide threat by an older client must be taken seriously.老人任何自殺言語都必須嚴肅處理。 PDF p.303
  8. High-frequency hearing is lost first; speak in a low pitch, face the client.高頻聽力先喪失；說話用低音調並面對個案。 PDF p.303, 307
  9. Avoid Beers Criteria drugs (benzodiazepines, first-generation antihistamines, meperidine, NSAIDs, etc.).避免 Beers 準則所列藥物（苯二氮平類、第一代抗組織胺、meperidine、NSAIDs 等）。 PDF p.305
  10. Do not crush enteric-coated or sustained-release tablets; keep upright 30 minutes after oral meds if aspiration risk.腸溶與長效錠不可磨碎；有吸入風險者服藥後維持直立 30 分鐘。 PDF p.305
  11. With polypharmacy, first identify duplicate medications, then interactions, then involve the provider.多重用藥時先找重複用藥，再查交互作用，最後聯絡醫療提供者。 PDF p.304, 307, 309
  12. Suspected elder abuse: assess, protect confidentiality, report, safety plan; most at risk are dependent, impaired clients.疑似老人虐待：評估、保密、通報、安全計畫；最高風險為依賴、功能受損者。 PDF p.306
  13. Older adults need flu, pneumococcal and shingles vaccines.老人應接種流感、肺炎鏈球菌與帶狀疱疹疫苗。 PDF p.302

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Three D's: Delirium = acute and fluctuating; Depression = affect flat; Dementia = decades slow.三個 D：譫妄＝急性波動；憂鬱＝情感平淡；失智＝多年緩慢。 PDF p.304
  • Beers drug groups: 'Pain, Mood, Allergy, BP, Bladder, Muscle, Sleep' (analgesics, TCAs, antihistamines, alpha blockers, antimuscarinics, relaxants, sedatives).Beers 藥物類別記憶：痛、情緒、過敏、血壓、膀胱、肌肉、睡眠。 PDF p.305

21 Reproductive System生殖系統

This chapter covers reproductive anatomy, the menstrual cycle, pelvis types and measurements, fertilization and implantation, fetal development, fetal environment and circulation, and family planning and infertility. Fetal circulation shunts and normal fetal heart rate are favorite exam topics.本章涵蓋生殖解剖、月經週期、骨盆類型與測量、受精與著床、胎兒發育、胎兒環境與循環，以及家庭計畫與不孕。胎兒循環分流與正常胎心率是常考重點。

Reproductive Structures and Functions生殖構造與功能

  • Ovaries form and release ova and secrete estrogen and progesterone.卵巢產生並排出卵子，分泌雌激素與黃體素。
  • Fallopian tubes carry the ovum to the uterus; the uterus is the pear-shaped organ where the fetus grows and menstruation occurs.輸卵管將卵子送往子宮；子宮為梨形肌肉器官，胎兒在此生長，月經亦由此而來。
  • Cervix links uterus and vagina; vagina is the 7.6-10 cm birth canal and menstrual outflow tract.子宮頸連接子宮與陰道；陰道長約 7.6-10 公分，是產道與經血出口。
  • Scrotum keeps the testes slightly cooler than body temperature; prostate secretes alkaline fluid that aids sperm and neutralizes vaginal acidity.陰囊使睪丸溫度略低於體溫；攝護腺分泌鹼性液，助精子活動並中和陰道酸性。
PDF p.313

Menstrual Cycle月經週期

  • Average cycle about 28 days; FSH and LH from the anterior pituitary drive ovarian and endometrial changes.平均週期約 28 天；腦下垂體前葉的 FSH 與 LH 驅動卵巢與子宮內膜變化。
  • Follicular phase: FSH grows follicles; estrogen rises and triggers the LH surge; ovulation occurs around days 12-16.濾泡期：FSH 促進濾泡生長；雌激素上升引發 LH 高峰；約第 12-16 天排卵。
  • Luteal phase: corpus luteum secretes estrogen and progesterone for 12-14 days, then degenerates if no pregnancy; body temperature rises 0.5-1 F after ovulation.黃體期：黃體分泌雌激素與黃體素 12-14 天，若未懷孕即退化；排卵後基礎體溫升高 0.5-1 華氏度。
  • Uterine phases: menstrual (4-6 days), proliferative (about 9 days, estrogen high), secretory (about 12 days, progesterone prepares endometrium).子宮週期：月經期（4-6 天）、增生期（約 9 天，雌激素高）、分泌期（約 12 天，黃體素準備內膜）。
PDF p.313, 314

Pelvis Types and Measurements骨盆類型與測量

  • True pelvis (inlet, midpelvis, outlet) is below the brim; false pelvis supports abdominal organs.真骨盆（入口、中骨盆、出口）在骨盆緣下方；假骨盆支撐腹部臟器。
  • Gynecoid is normal and most favorable for labor; android (heart-shaped) and platypelloid (flat) make vaginal birth difficult; anthropoid is oval with adequate outlet.女性型為正常骨盆，最利於生產；男性型（心形）與扁平型使陰道生產困難；類人猿型呈橢圓、出口足夠。
  • Obstetric conjugate is the smallest front-to-back inlet distance the fetal head must pass; the outlet is the smallest plane of the canal.產科結合徑為胎頭須通過的入口最小前後徑；骨盆出口為產道最小平面。
  • Cephalopelvic disproportion usually leads to cesarean birth.頭骨盆不對稱通常需剖腹產。
PDF p.313, 314

Fertilization and Implantation受精與著床

  • Fertilization occurs in the ampulla (outer third) of the tube; ovum is viable up to about 72 hours.受精發生於輸卵管壺腹（外三分之一）；卵子約可存活至 72 小時。
  • Each gamete carries 23 chromosomes; sperm carry X or Y, so sperm determines sex (XY male, XX female).每個生殖細胞有 23 條染色體；精子帶 X 或 Y，決定性別（XY 男、XX 女）。
  • Zygote implants 6-10 days after ovulation; the blastocyst makes hCG to keep the corpus luteum going for the first 2-3 months.受精卵於排卵後 6-10 天著床；囊胚分泌 hCG 維持黃體約前 2-3 個月。
  • The tubal isthmus stays contracted about 3 days so the ovum can develop and implant normally in the fundus.輸卵管峽部約 3 天維持收縮，使受精卵發育並正常著床於子宮底。
PDF p.314, 315, 319

Fetal Development胎兒發育

  • Preembryonic: first 2 weeks; embryonic: day 15 to week 8; fetal: week 9 to birth.前胚胎期：前 2 週；胚胎期：第 15 天至第 8 週；胎兒期：第 9 週至出生。
  • Week 8: all organ systems present; week 12: kidneys make urine, Doppler heartbeat 10-12 weeks; week 16-20: sex visible on ultrasound, fetoscope heartbeat at 20 weeks.第 8 週：所有器官系統成形；第 12 週：腎臟開始產尿，10-12 週可用都卜勒聽胎心；16-20 週：超音波可辨性別，20 週可用胎心聽診器。
  • Week 24: surfactant begins; week 28: lungs can exchange gas; week 36: L/S ratio over 2:1, lungs mature.第 24 週：開始產生表面張力素；第 28 週：肺可交換氣體；第 36 週：L/S 比值大於 2:1，肺成熟。
  • Week 40: length about 40 cm, over 3200 g; sole creases cover two-thirds of foot, entire sole after 41 weeks.第 40 週：身長約 40 公分、體重超過 3200 公克；足底紋路覆蓋三分之二，超過 41 週則滿布足底。
PDF p.315, 316

Fetal Environment胎兒環境

  • Amnion is the inner membrane, chorion the outer and forms the fetal placenta.羊膜為內層膜；絨毛膜為外層，形成胎盤的胎兒部分。
  • Amniotic fluid (800-1200 mL at term) cushions, allows movement, maintains temperature, and reflects fetal kidney function.羊水（足月 800-1200 mL）緩衝、利於胎動、維持體溫並反映胎兒腎功能。
  • Placenta exchanges nutrients and wastes, forms by week 12 and takes over hormone production; maternal IgG gives passive immunity.胎盤進行養分與廢物交換，12 週完成並接手荷爾蒙生產；母體 IgG 提供被動免疫。
  • Alcohol, drugs, antibiotics, viruses, antibodies and bacteria can cross the placenta.酒精、藥物、抗生素、病毒、抗體與細菌皆可通過胎盤。
  • CVS can be done at 10-12 weeks for genetic testing.絨毛膜取樣（CVS）可於 10-12 週進行基因檢查。
PDF p.315

Fetal Circulation胎兒循環

  • Umbilical cord: two arteries carry deoxygenated blood away from the fetus; one vein carries oxygenated blood to it.臍帶：兩條動脈將缺氧血帶離胎兒；一條靜脈將含氧血送往胎兒。
  • Three shunts: ductus venosus (umbilical vein to IVC, bypasses liver), foramen ovale (right to left atrium), ductus arteriosus (pulmonary artery to aorta); the latter two bypass the lungs.三個分流：靜脈導管（臍靜脈至下腔靜脈，繞過肝）、卵圓孔（右心房至左心房）、動脈導管（肺動脈至主動脈）；後兩者繞過肺。
  • Normal FHR 110-160 bpm (160-170 in first trimester), about twice the maternal rate.正常胎心率 110-160 次/分（第一孕期 160-170），約為母親心率兩倍。
PDF p.315, 317

Family Planning and Infertility家庭計畫與不孕

  • Contraceptive choice depends on effectiveness, safety, preference, beliefs, age, intercourse frequency, and ability to adhere; the client's preference matters most.避孕方式依有效性、安全性、偏好、信念、年齡、性交頻率與遵從能力而定；以個案偏好最重要。
  • Sterilization is for couples who have completed their families; reversal may fail, so ask about future childbearing plans.結紮適用已完成生育的夫妻；復通可能失敗，故應詢問未來生育計畫。
  • Infertility is inability to conceive when desired; causes in men (sperm, erection, seminal fluid) and women (ovulation, tubes, cervix, scarring).不孕為想懷孕卻無法受孕；男性（精子、勃起、精液）與女性（排卵、輸卵管、子宮頸、沾黏）皆可能。
  • Options: medications, surgery, artificial insemination, IVF, surrogate, adoption; support the couple's decision-making.選項：藥物、手術、人工授精、試管嬰兒、代理孕母、領養；支持夫妻決策。
PDF p.317, 318

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Normal FHR is 110-160 bpm; 174 at 38 weeks is abnormal, notify the provider.正常胎心率 110-160 次/分；38 週時 174 為異常，應通報醫師。 PDF p.315, 319
  2. Umbilical cord: 2 arteries (deoxygenated) and 1 vein (oxygenated).臍帶：2 動脈（缺氧血）、1 靜脈（含氧血）。 PDF p.315
  3. Ductus venosus: umbilical vein to IVC; foramen ovale: right to left atria; ductus arteriosus: pulmonary artery to aorta.靜脈導管：臍靜脈到下腔靜脈；卵圓孔：右到左心房；動脈導管：肺動脈到主動脈。 PDF p.315, 317
  4. Gynecoid pelvis is most favorable for vaginal birth.女性型骨盆最利於陰道生產。 PDF p.313, 320
  5. Fertilization occurs in the outer third of the fallopian tube; implantation 6-10 days after ovulation.受精於輸卵管外三分之一；排卵後 6-10 天著床。 PDF p.314, 315
  6. hCG from the blastocyst maintains the corpus luteum until the placenta takes over by week 12.囊胚的 hCG 維持黃體直到 12 週胎盤接手。 PDF p.315
  7. Lung maturity: L/S ratio 2:1 or greater at 36 weeks; surfactant begins at 24 weeks.肺成熟：36 週 L/S 比值 2:1 以上；24 週開始產生表面張力素。 PDF p.316
  8. Substances including alcohol, drugs and viruses cross the placenta; counsel pregnant adolescents on avoiding alcohol.酒精、藥物、病毒可通過胎盤；須輔導懷孕青少年避免飲酒。 PDF p.315
  9. Sperm determines fetal sex; sex visible on ultrasound at 16-20 weeks.精子決定胎兒性別；16-20 週超音波可見。 PDF p.314, 316, 319
  10. Sterilization counseling: ask whether the couple wants more children.結紮諮詢：詢問是否還想生育。 PDF p.317, 320
  11. Amniotic fluid reflects fetal kidney function; abnormal volume prompts further evaluation.羊水反映胎兒腎功能。 PDF p.315
  12. For sexual concerns use open-ended questions first to build trust.談性問題時先用開放式問句建立信任。 PDF p.319

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Fetal shunts: 'Venosus = Vein to Vena cava'; 'Ovale = Over (between atria)'; 'Arteriosus = Artery to Aorta'.胎兒分流：靜脈導管＝臍靜脈到下腔靜脈；卵圓孔＝心房之間；動脈導管＝肺動脈到主動脈。 PDF p.315
  • Cord: 'AVA' = 2 Arteries, 1 Vein; arteries away carry blood low in oxygen.臍帶：2 動脈 1 靜脈；動脈帶離胎兒、缺氧。 PDF p.315

22 Prenatal Period產前期

This chapter covers dating the pregnancy (Naegele's rule, GTPAL), signs of pregnancy, fundal height, physiological and psychological changes, common discomforts and their remedies, risk factors, and antepartum tests such as Rh screening, GCT, ultrasound, amniocentesis, NST and CST, plus prenatal nutrition.本章涵蓋妊娠日期推算（Naegele 法則、GTPAL）、懷孕徵象、子宮底高度、生理與心理變化、常見不適與緩解方式、風險因子、產前檢查（Rh 篩檢、GCT、超音波、羊膜穿刺、NST、CST），以及孕期營養。

Gestation, Naegele's Rule, Gravidity and Parity (GTPAL)妊娠、Naegele 法則、懷孕與生產史（GTPAL）

  • Gestation lasts about 280 days.妊娠期約 280 天。
  • Naegele's rule (regular 28-day cycle): first day of LMP minus 3 months plus 7 days (plus 1 year if needed). LMP Oct 19, 2023 gives July 26, 2024.Naegele 法則（月經週期規則 28 天）：末次月經第一天減 3 個月加 7 天（必要時加 1 年）。LMP 2023/10/19 → 2024/7/26。
  • Gravidity counts all pregnancies including the current one; parity counts births after 20 weeks, not fetuses.Gravidity 為包含本次的懷孕次數；parity 為 20 週後的生產次數，不論胎數。
  • GTPAL: Gravida, Term (over 37 wk), Preterm, Abortions (before 20 wk), Living children. Twins count once for G, T or P but twice for L.GTPAL：懷孕次數、足月產（超過 37 週）、早產、流產（20 週前）、現存子女數。雙胞胎在 G、T、P 算 1，在 L 算 2。
PDF p.322, 323

Signs of Pregnancy懷孕徵象

  • Presumptive: amenorrhea, nausea/vomiting, breast changes, urinary frequency, quickening (16-20 wk), fatigue, linea nigra, melasma.推定徵象：停經、噁心嘔吐、乳房變化、頻尿、胎動感（16-20 週）、疲倦、黑線、黃褐斑。
  • Probable: uterine enlargement, Hegar's, Goodell's and Chadwick's signs, ballottement, Braxton Hicks contractions, positive hCG test.可能徵象：子宮變大、Hegar、Goodell、Chadwick 徵象、浮球感、Braxton Hicks 收縮、hCG 陽性。
  • Positive (diagnostic): FHR by Doppler at 10-12 wk or fetoscope at 20 wk, palpable active fetal movement, fetal outline on ultrasound or radiograph.確定徵象：10-12 週都卜勒或 20 週胎心聽診器聽到胎心、檢查者觸及胎動、超音波或 X 光見胎兒輪廓。
PDF p.322, 323

Fundal Height and Physiological Changes子宮底高度與生理變化

  • Weeks 18-30: fundal height in cm approximately equals weeks of gestation, plus or minus 2 cm. 16 wk halfway between symphysis and umbilicus; 20-22 wk at umbilicus; 36 wk at xiphoid. Have client void first.18-30 週：子宮底高度（公分）約等於週數 ±2。16 週在恥骨聯合與肚臍中間；20-22 週在肚臍；36 週在劍突。測量前先排尿。
  • Cardiovascular: blood volume up 40-50%, physiological anemia, higher iron need, pulse up 10-15 bpm, BP dips in second trimester.心血管：血容積增加 40-50%、生理性貧血、鐵需求增加、脈搏增加 10-15 次/分、第二孕期血壓略降。
  • Respiratory: oxygen consumption up 15-20%, diaphragm elevated, dyspnea possible.呼吸：耗氧量增加 15-20%、橫膈上升、可能呼吸困難。
  • GI: nausea from hCG, constipation, heartburn from progesterone slowing motility, hemorrhoids, gum swelling and ptyalism from estrogen.消化：hCG 造成噁心；黃體素使蠕動變慢造成便秘、火燒心；痔瘡；雌激素造成牙齦腫脹與流涎。
  • Renal: urinary frequency in 1st and 3rd trimesters; reduced renal glucose threshold so glycosuria may appear.腎臟：第一與第三孕期頻尿；腎糖閾下降故可能出現糖尿。
  • Endocrine: higher BMR, prolactin and oxytocin, more insulin production. Uterus grows from about 60 g to 1000 g.內分泌：基礎代謝率上升、泌乳素與催產素、胰島素分泌增加。子宮由約 60 公克增至 1000 公克。
  • Cervix softens (Chadwick sign, violet) and forms a mucous plug; breasts enlarge, colostrum may leak; skin shows linea nigra, chloasma, striae.子宮頸變軟（Chadwick 徵象、紫藍色）並形成黏液栓；乳房變大、可能漏初乳；皮膚出現黑線、黃褐斑、妊娠紋。
  • Musculoskeletal: relaxin and progesterone loosen joints, lordosis, waddling gait, fall risk; eyes may have corneal edema.肌肉骨骼：relaxin 與黃體素使關節鬆弛、腰椎前凸、鴨步、易跌倒；眼睛可能角膜水腫。
PDF p.323, 324, 325

Psychological Changes心理變化

  • Early ambivalence is normal even in planned pregnancy; partner may be ambivalent too.即使是計畫中的懷孕，早期矛盾感也屬正常；伴侶亦可能如此。
  • Tasks: accept pregnancy, identify with parent role, solidify partner relationship, bond with the fetus, prepare for birth.任務：接受懷孕、認同父母角色、鞏固伴侶關係、與胎兒建立連結、為生產做準備。
  • Emotional lability and body image changes are common; bonding progresses from accepting pregnancy, to accepting the fetus as separate, to preparing for birth.情緒不穩與身體形象改變很常見；連結歷程為接受懷孕、接受胎兒為獨立個體、實際準備生產。
PDF p.325, 326

Discomforts of Pregnancy and Interventions孕期不適與處置

  • Nausea: dry crackers before rising, small frequent low-fat meals, fluids between meals, avoid fried/spicy food, protein bedtime snack.噁心：起床前吃蘇打餅乾、少量多餐低脂、兩餐間喝水、避免油炸辛辣、睡前吃蛋白質點心。
  • Supine hypotension: avoid lying flat in 2nd/3rd trimester (uterus compresses inferior vena cava); side-lying, change positions slowly.仰臥低血壓：第二、三孕期避免平躺（子宮壓迫下腔靜脈）；採側臥並緩慢變換姿勢。
  • Urinary frequency: at least 2000 mL fluid by day, limit evening fluids and diuretic foods, Kegels.頻尿：白天至少飲水 2000 mL，傍晚減少並避免利尿食物，做凱格爾運動。
  • Heartburn: small meals, upright 30 min after eating, avoid fatty/spicy food; ask provider about antacids.火燒心：少量多餐、飯後坐直 30 分鐘、避免油膩辛辣；詢問醫師可否用制酸劑。
  • Ankle edema and varicose veins: elevate legs, side-lying, support hose, avoid prolonged standing or crossing legs.腳踝水腫與靜脈曲張：抬高腿、側臥、穿彈性襪、避免久站久坐或蹺腳。
  • Constipation and hemorrhoids: high fiber, 2000 mL fluids, walking, sitz bath; consult provider for stool softeners.便秘與痔瘡：高纖、2000 mL 水分、散步、溫水坐浴；用軟便劑前諮詢醫師。
  • Backache: pelvic tilt, good posture, squat to lift, low-heeled shoes. Leg cramps: dorsiflex the foot, increase calcium, walk.背痛：骨盆傾斜運動、良好姿勢、蹲下拿物、穿低跟鞋。腿抽筋：足背屈、增加鈣質、散步。
  • Increased thin vaginal discharge (leukorrhea) is normal; use cotton underwear, no douching or tampons. Nasal stuffiness: humidifier, avoid decongestant sprays unless approved.陰道分泌物增加（白帶）正常；穿棉質內褲，不灌洗、不用衛生棉條。鼻塞：用加濕器，未經許可避免鼻噴劑。
  • Headaches are usually benign in first trimester but need evaluation later; acetaminophen only if prescribed.頭痛在第一孕期多屬良性，後期需進一步評估；僅在處方下使用乙醯胺酚。
PDF p.326, 327, 328

Pregnancy Risk Factors妊娠風險因子

  • Age under 20 or over 35 raises perinatal risk; adolescent risks include poor nutrition, hypertension, anemia, CPD, preterm and low-birth-weight infants, and lack of support.年齡小於 20 或大於 35 歲增加風險；青少年懷孕風險包括營養不良、高血壓、貧血、頭骨盆不對稱、早產與低出生體重、缺乏支持。
  • Folic acid for all people of childbearing age prevents neural tube defects and orofacial clefts.所有育齡者應補充葉酸，預防神經管缺陷與唇顎裂。
  • Rubella in the first 8 weeks has highest fetal infection and anomaly rate.前 8 週感染德國麻疹胎兒感染與畸形率最高。
  • Abuse raises risk of abruptio placentae and preterm birth; interview the client alone and examine breasts, abdomen, genitals.暴力增加胎盤早期剝離與早產風險；應單獨訪談個案，並檢查乳房、腹部與生殖器。
  • HIV: perinatal zidovudine lowers transmission. Substance use: growth restriction, abruptio, fetal bradycardia; smoking causes low birth weight and stillbirth; alcohol causes fetal alcohol syndrome.HIV：周產期給予 zidovudine 可降低傳染。物質濫用：胎兒生長受限、胎盤早剝、胎心過慢；吸菸造成低出生體重與死產；酒精造成胎兒酒精症候群。
PDF p.328, 329

Antepartum Laboratory Tests產前實驗室檢查

  • Visit schedule: every 4 weeks to 28-32 wk, every 2 weeks 32-36 wk, weekly 36-40 wk.產檢頻率：28-32 週前每 4 週、32-36 週每 2 週、36-40 週每週。
  • Rh-negative with negative antibody screen: RhoGAM at 28 weeks and within 72 hr after birth of an Rh-positive infant; also after miscarriage/termination and CVS.Rh 陰性且抗體篩檢陰性：28 週給 RhoGAM，Rh 陽性新生兒出生後 72 小時內再給；流產、人工流產及 CVS 後亦給。
  • Rubella titer under 1:8: give live vaccine subcutaneously postpartum; avoid pregnancy 1-3 months and contact with immunocompromised people; ask about egg allergy; never give during pregnancy.德國麻疹抗體價低於 1:8：產後皮下注射活性疫苗；1-3 個月內避免懷孕並避免接觸免疫低下者；詢問蛋過敏；孕期不可施打。
  • Anemia in pregnancy: Hgb under 10 g/dL or Hct under 30%. WBC mildly elevated is normal.孕期貧血：Hgb 低於 10 g/dL 或 Hct 低於 30%。白血球輕度上升屬正常。
  • GCT at 24-28 weeks: 50 g glucose, 1-hour level over 140 mg/dL is positive and needs the 3-hour test.GCT 於 24-28 週：口服 50 g 葡萄糖，1 小時血糖超過 140 mg/dL 為陽性，需做 3 小時試驗。
  • Urine at each visit for glucose and protein; 2+ to 4+ protein suggests infection or preeclampsia.每次產檢驗尿糖與尿蛋白；蛋白 2+ 至 4+ 提示感染或子癇前症。
  • Hepatitis B antigen testing for all; hepatitis B vaccine is not contraindicated in pregnancy. TB: positive skin test needs chest X-ray with shield only after 20 weeks.所有孕婦篩檢 B 肝表面抗原；B 肝疫苗孕期不禁忌。結核菌素陽性者需於 20 週後以鉛屏護腹拍胸部 X 光。
  • GBS vaginal/rectal swab at about 36 weeks (20-25% colonized).約 36 週採陰道/直腸 GBS 培養（20-25% 帶菌）。
PDF p.329, 330, 332

Antepartum Fetal Assessment and Procedures產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查

  • Ultrasound: no known risk; abdominal scan needs a full bladder; transvaginal in first trimester checks cervix length.超音波：無已知風險；腹部超音波需憋尿；第一孕期經陰道超音波可測子宮頸長度。
  • Biophysical profile: breathing, movement, tone, amniotic fluid index, NST. Doppler studies placental and fetal blood flow.生物物理評估：呼吸、動作、張力、羊水指數、NST。都卜勒評估胎盤與胎兒血流。
  • Quad screen (AFP at 16-18 wk) screens for Down syndrome and neural tube defects; cell-free DNA blood test from 7 weeks screens trisomy 21, 18, 13.四指標篩檢（16-18 週 AFP）篩檢唐氏症與神經管缺陷；7 週起可做游離 DNA 抽血篩檢 21、18、13 三染色體。
  • CVS at 10-13 wk (genetic diagnosis, give RhoGAM if Rh-negative, rest 24 hr). Amniocentesis at 15-20 wk (full bladder before 20 wk, empty after; consent; FHR monitoring; left side after).CVS 於 10-13 週（基因診斷，Rh 陰性給 RhoGAM，休息 24 小時）。羊膜穿刺於 15-20 週（20 週前憋尿、之後排空；需同意書；監測胎心；術後左側臥）。
  • After CVS or amniocentesis report fever over 100.4 F (38 C), chills, bleeding, fluid leak, decreased fetal movement, contractions or cramping.CVS 或羊膜穿刺後，若發燒超過 38 度（100.4 F）、寒顫、出血、漏液、胎動減少、宮縮或痙攣應通報。
  • Kick counts from 28 weeks: sitting or side-lying, at least 10 movements in 2 hours.28 週起數胎動：坐或側臥，2 小時至少 10 次。
  • Ruptured membranes: fern test shows ferning; nitrazine paper turns blue (pH 7.0-7.5) versus vaginal pH 4.5-5.5. Fetal fibronectin at 22-34 wk predicts preterm labor (negative is reassuring).胎膜破裂：羊齒葉試驗呈羊齒狀；硝氮試紙變藍（pH 7.0-7.5，陰道 pH 4.5-5.5）。22-34 週胎兒纖維連接蛋白預測早產（陰性較安心）。
PDF p.330, 331, 332

NST, CST and Prenatal NutritionNST、CST 與孕期營養

  • Reactive NST (normal): 2 or more accelerations of at least 15 bpm lasting at least 15 sec within 20 min with movement. Nonreactive: none in 40 min.反應型 NST（正常）：20 分鐘內有 2 次以上、至少上升 15 bpm 且持續 15 秒以上的加速。無反應型：40 分鐘內無。
  • Position side-lying for NST/CST to avoid vena cava compression.NST/CST 採側臥避免壓迫下腔靜脈。
  • CST: negative (normal) = no late decelerations; positive (abnormal) = late decelerations with 50% or more of contractions; 3 contractions of 40 sec in 10 min required.CST：陰性（正常）＝無晚期減速；陽性（異常）＝50% 以上宮縮出現晚期減速；需 10 分鐘內 3 次、每次 40 秒以上宮縮。
  • Weight gain 25-35 lb (11-16 kg) for normal prepregnancy weight; +300 kcal/day in pregnancy, +500 during lactation; fluids 8-10 glasses; sodium not restricted.體重增加：孕前體重正常者 11-16 公斤（25-35 磅）；孕期每日加 300 大卡、哺乳加 500 大卡；水分 8-10 杯；不限鈉。
  • Vegetarian risks: B12, iron, zinc, calcium, vitamin D, omega-3; pair iron with vitamin C. Lactose intolerance: nondairy calcium, lactase.素食風險：B12、鐵、鋅、鈣、維生素 D、omega-3；鐵搭配維生素 C。乳糖不耐：非乳製鈣來源、乳糖酶。
  • Pica (eating dirt, clay, starch) can cause iron-deficiency anemia.異食癖（吃泥土、黏土、澱粉）可造成缺鐵性貧血。
PDF p.332, 333

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Naegele's rule: LMP minus 3 months plus 7 days (plus 1 year).Naegele 法則：末次月經減 3 個月加 7 天（再加 1 年）。 PDF p.322, 323, 336
  2. GTPAL: abortions before 20 wk count in gravida but not parity; twins count as one birth but two living children.GTPAL：20 週前流產算入 G 不算 P；雙胞胎算一次生產、兩個現存子女。 PDF p.322, 323, 336
  3. Fundal height (cm) equals weeks plus or minus 2 between 18-30 weeks; 36 weeks at xiphoid.18-30 週子宮底高度（公分）≈週數 ±2；36 週在劍突。 PDF p.323, 336
  4. Positive (diagnostic) signs: fetal heart tones, fetal movement felt by examiner, ultrasound outline. Others are presumptive or probable.確定徵象：胎心音、檢查者觸及胎動、超音波輪廓；其餘為推定或可能徵象。 PDF p.322, 323, 336
  5. Avoid supine position after 20 weeks (supine hypotension from IVC compression).20 週後避免仰臥（壓迫下腔靜脈造成仰臥低血壓）。 PDF p.323, 326
  6. RhoGAM at 28 weeks and within 72 hours of delivery of an Rh-positive baby for Rh-negative clients.Rh 陰性者 28 週與生下 Rh 陽性寶寶後 72 小時內施打 RhoGAM。 PDF p.329
  7. Rubella vaccine is live: never in pregnancy; postpartum, avoid pregnancy 1-3 months; compatible with breastfeeding.德國麻疹疫苗為活性疫苗：孕期禁用；產後 1-3 個月避免懷孕；可哺乳。 PDF p.329, 335
  8. Folic acid supplementation prevents neural tube defects.補充葉酸預防神經管缺陷。 PDF p.328, 333
  9. Hgb under 10 g/dL or Hct under 30% means anemia in pregnancy.Hgb 低於 10 或 Hct 低於 30% 為孕期貧血。 PDF p.329
  10. GCT 24-28 weeks; 1-hr glucose over 140 mg/dL is positive.GCT 於 24-28 週；1 小時血糖超過 140 mg/dL 為陽性。 PDF p.330
  11. Reactive NST is normal; negative CST is normal; positive CST (late decelerations) is abnormal.NST 反應型為正常；CST 陰性為正常；CST 陽性（晚期減速）為異常。 PDF p.332, 333, 335
  12. Amniocentesis: consent, report fever, bleeding, leaking, reduced movement; Rh-negative needs RhoGAM.羊膜穿刺：需同意書，通報發燒、出血、漏液、胎動減少；Rh 陰性需 RhoGAM。 PDF p.331, 334, 335
  13. Nitrazine turns blue (pH 7.0-7.5) for amniotic fluid; ferning confirms.羊水使硝氮試紙變藍（pH 7.0-7.5）；羊齒狀結晶可確認。 PDF p.331, 332
  14. Kick counts: 10 movements in 2 hours, sit or side-lying, not flat on back.數胎動：2 小時 10 次，坐或側臥，不可平躺。 PDF p.331, 335
  15. Braxton Hicks (irregular, painless) and leukorrhea are normal; no need for emergency visit.Braxton Hicks（不規則無痛）與白帶屬正常，無需急診。 PDF p.323, 335, 336
  16. Screen for abuse privately; ask partner to leave the room.私下篩檢家暴；請伴侶離開房間。 PDF p.328

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • GTPAL: Gravida, Term, Preterm, Abortion, Living.GTPAL：懷孕、足月、早產、流產、存活。 PDF p.323
  • Pregnancy signs: Presumptive = what she feels; Probable = what the examiner finds; Positive = the fetus itself.懷孕徵象：推定＝孕婦自覺；可能＝檢查者發現；確定＝胎兒本身。 PDF p.322, 323

23 Risk Conditions Related to Pregnancy妊娠相關風險狀況

This chapter covers high-risk pregnancy conditions: bleeding disorders (abortion, ectopic, molar pregnancy, previa, abruption, DIC), medical disorders (cardiac disease, diabetes, hypertensive disorders, infections), and TORCH/STI infections. Know the key assessment differences and priority nursing actions, especially magnesium sulfate safety and previa versus abruption.本章涵蓋高危險妊娠：出血性問題（流產、子宮外孕、葡萄胎、前置胎盤、胎盤早期剝離、DIC）、內科疾病（心臟病、糖尿病、高血壓疾患、感染）與 TORCH/性傳染病。須熟記關鍵評估差異與優先處置，特別是硫酸鎂安全與前置胎盤對胎盤早剝。

Bleeding, Abortion and Ectopic Pregnancy出血、流產與子宮外孕

  • Implantation bleeding occurs 10-14 days after conception, is light, lasts 1-2 days, and needs no treatment.著床出血發生於受孕後 10-14 天，量少、持續 1-2 天，無需治療。
  • Abortion is loss before 20 weeks. Types: threatened (bleeding and cramping, cervix closed), inevitable (cervix dilating), incomplete (some tissue retained), complete, missed (fetal death retained), habitual (3 or more).流產為 20 週前終止妊娠。類型：先兆流產（出血痙攣、子宮頸未開）、不可避免流產（子宮頸開始擴張）、不完全流產（部分組織殘留）、完全流產、過期流產（胎死留於子宮）、習慣性流產（連續 3 次以上）。
  • Care: monitor vital signs, count and weigh pads (1 g = 1 mL), save tissue, IV fluids, D&C for incomplete abortion, RhoGAM if Rh-negative, emotional support.照護：監測生命徵象、計算並秤重護墊（1 g＝1 mL）、保留排出組織、靜脈輸液、不完全流產做刮除術、Rh 陰性給 RhoGAM、情緒支持。
  • Ectopic pregnancy: usually ampulla of tube; missed period, abdominal pain, dark red/brown spotting; rupture brings severe pain, shoulder pain and shock.子宮外孕：多在輸卵管壺腹；停經、腹痛、暗紅或棕色出血；破裂時劇痛、肩痛與休克。
  • Ectopic management: methotrexate (folic acid antagonist) for early cases, or laparotomy/tube removal or repair; RhoGAM if Rh-negative.子宮外孕處置：早期用 methotrexate（葉酸拮抗劑），或剖腹手術切除/修補輸卵管；Rh 陰性給 RhoGAM。
  • Incompetent cervix: painless dilation at 4th-5th month, treated with cerclage at 10-14 weeks; remove at 37 weeks.子宮頸閉鎖不全：第 4-5 個月無痛性擴張，10-14 週行子宮頸環紮，37 週拆除。
PDF p.338, 339, 342, 347

Hydatidiform Mole and Hyperemesis Gravidarum葡萄胎與妊娠劇吐

  • Mole: abnormal trophoblast, grape-like cluster; no fetal heart tones, hyperemesis, bleeding, early preeclampsia signs before 20 weeks, uterus larger than dates, hCG over 100,000 mIU/mL, snowstorm ultrasound.葡萄胎：滋養層異常、葡萄串狀；無胎心、嚴重孕吐、出血、20 週前出現子癇前症徵象、子宮大於週數、hCG 超過 100,000 mIU/mL、超音波呈暴風雪樣。
  • Treat with suction evacuation; follow hCG every 1-2 weeks until normal, then monthly for 1 year; avoid pregnancy during follow-up (risk of choriocarcinoma).以抽吸術清除；每 1-2 週追蹤 hCG 至正常，之後每 1-2 個月追蹤一年；追蹤期避孕（可能轉為絨毛膜癌）。
  • Hyperemesis: intractable vomiting in first trimester with weight loss, dehydration, electrolyte imbalance and ketonuria; give IV fluids, antiemetics, small low-fat carbohydrate meals, fluids between meals.妊娠劇吐：第一孕期持續嘔吐，伴體重減輕、脫水、電解質失衡與酮尿；給靜脈輸液、止吐藥、低脂碳水少量餐、兩餐間喝水。
PDF p.343, 344

Cardiac Disease, Chorioamnionitis, Diabetes心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病

  • Blood volume peaks at 32-34 weeks; watch for cardiac decompensation: cough, dyspnea, fatigue, palpitations, edema, chest pain. Limit activity, low-sodium diet, avoid excess weight gain.血容積於 32-34 週達高峰；注意心臟代償不全：咳嗽、呼吸困難、疲倦、心悸、水腫、胸痛。限制活動、低鈉飲食、避免體重過度增加。
  • Cardiac labor care: side-lying with head and shoulders raised, oxygen, early pain control, controlled pushing, cardiac and fetal monitoring.心臟病產婦產程：側臥並抬高頭肩、給氧、早期止痛、控制用力、心臟與胎兒監測。
  • Chorioamnionitis: infection of amniotic cavity after prolonged rupture; uterine tenderness, fever, maternal/fetal tachycardia, foul fluid, leukocytosis; give antibiotics after cultures.絨毛膜羊膜炎：破水過久後羊膜腔感染；子宮壓痛、發燒、母胎心搏過速、羊水惡臭、白血球增加；培養後給抗生素。
  • Diabetes: glucose crosses the placenta, insulin does not; insulin needs fall in first trimester, rise in 2nd/3rd, and drop sharply after placenta delivery.糖尿病：葡萄糖可通過胎盤，胰島素不行；第一孕期胰島素需求下降，二、三孕期上升，胎盤娩出後驟降。
  • Infant of diabetic mother: macrosomia, hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, RDS, hypocalcemia, anomalies.糖尿病母親的新生兒：巨嬰、低血糖、高膽紅素、呼吸窘迫、低血鈣、先天異常。
  • GDM: screen 24-28 weeks (1-hr GCT 140 or more, then 3-hr OGTT); diet, exercise, glucose checks 4x daily; targets fasting under 95, 1-hr under 130-140, 2-hr under 120 mg/dL.妊娠糖尿病：24-28 週篩檢（1 小時 GCT ≥140 再做 3 小時 OGTT）；飲食、運動、每日 4 次血糖監測；目標空腹小於 95、餐後 1 小時小於 130-140、2 小時小於 120 mg/dL。
  • Labor: continuous fetal monitoring, regulate insulin and IV glucose. Postpartum: watch for hypoglycemia as insulin need falls.產程：持續胎心監測，調整胰島素與靜脈葡萄糖。產後：胰島素需求下降，注意低血糖。
PDF p.338, 339, 340, 341

DIC, Hematoma and Hepatitis BDIC、血腫與 B 型肝炎

  • DIC: clotting cascade activated, consuming platelets and factors; bleeding, petechiae, purpura, shock; low fibrinogen/platelets, high PT/PTT and fibrin degradation products; keep urine at least 30 mL/hr.DIC：凝血串聯被活化，耗盡血小板與凝血因子；出血、瘀點、紫斑、休克；纖維蛋白原與血小板降低、PT/PTT 與纖維蛋白降解物升高；尿量至少 30 mL/hr。
  • Predisposing: abruptio placentae, amniotic fluid embolism, gestational hypertension, HELLP, fetal demise, sepsis, severe hemorrhage.誘發因素：胎盤早剝、羊水栓塞、妊娠高血壓、HELLP、胎死腹中、敗血症、嚴重出血。
  • Vulvar hematoma: severe perineal pain, pressure, swelling, inability to void, falling Hgb/Hct; apply ice, analgesics, catheterize if needed, antibiotics.外陰血腫：劇烈會陰疼痛、壓迫感、腫脹、無法排尿、Hgb/Hct 下降；冰敷、止痛、必要時導尿、抗生素。
  • Hepatitis B: after birth wash blood off the newborn first, then give HBIG and hepatitis B vaccine (doses at birth, 1 and 6 months); breastfeeding allowed after newborn treated.B 肝：新生兒出生後先清除血液，再給 HBIG 與 B 肝疫苗（出生、1 個月、6 個月）；治療後可哺乳。
PDF p.341, 342

HIV/AIDSHIV/AIDS

  • HAART (3 drugs) lowers viral load; zidovudine orally after 12 weeks, IV in labor (1 hr before vaginal birth, 3 hr before cesarean if RNA 400 or more or unknown), and syrup to newborn at 2 hr then q12h for 6 weeks.HAART（三合一）降低病毒量；12 週後口服 zidovudine，產程靜脈注射（陰道生產前 1 小時、剖腹前 3 小時，若 RNA ≥400 或不明），新生兒出生 2 小時後起每 12 小時口服糖漿共 6 週。
  • Vaginal birth acceptable if viral load under 1000 copies/mL; otherwise cesarean.病毒量小於 1000 copies/mL 可陰道生產；否則剖腹。
  • Single reactive ELISA is not diagnostic; confirm with Western blot or IFA.單次 ELISA 反應不能確診；需 Western blot 或 IFA 確認。
  • Avoid amniocentesis, scalp electrodes, episiotomy, oxytocin; remove newborn blood promptly; breastfeeding generally restricted.避免羊膜穿刺、胎兒頭皮電極、會陰切開、催產素；盡快清除新生兒身上血液；通常限制哺乳。
PDF p.342, 343

Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy妊娠高血壓疾患

  • Categories: chronic hypertension (before 20 wk), gestational hypertension (after 20 wk), preeclampsia, chronic hypertension with superimposed preeclampsia; eclampsia means seizures.分類：慢性高血壓（20 週前）、妊娠高血壓（20 週後）、子癇前症、慢性高血壓合併子癇前症；子癇指抽搐。
  • Preeclampsia BP 140/90 or higher twice 4 hr apart after 20 weeks; severe features: 160/110 or higher, platelets under 100,000, doubled liver enzymes, creatinine over 1.0, pulmonary edema, headache, visual changes, RUQ pain, oliguria under 500 mL/day.子癇前症：20 週後相隔 4 小時兩次血壓 ≥140/90；嚴重特徵：≥160/110、血小板小於 100,000、肝酵素加倍、肌酐酸大於 1.0、肺水腫、頭痛、視覺障礙、右上腹痛、尿量小於 500 mL/天。
  • Proteinuria is no longer a reliable diagnostic criterion. HELLP: hemolysis, elevated liver enzymes, low platelets; an emergency.蛋白尿不再是可靠診斷標準。HELLP：溶血、肝酵素升高、血小板低下；屬急症。
  • Care: side-lying rest, BP and weight monitoring, kick counts, urine output at least 30 mL/hr, check reflexes and clonus, lower BP gradually, corticosteroids for fetal lungs, delivery planning.照護：側臥休息、監測血壓與體重、數胎動、尿量至少 30 mL/hr、檢查反射與陣攣、血壓緩慢下降、給予類固醇促進胎肺成熟、準備分娩。
  • Magnesium sulfate via controlled pump to prevent seizures (continue 24-48 hr postpartum). Toxicity: flushing, sweating, hypotension, absent reflexes, low urine output, respiratory depression; antidote calcium gluconate.硫酸鎂以控制輸液幫浦給予預防抽搐（產後持續 24-48 小時）。中毒徵象：潮紅、出汗、低血壓、反射消失、尿量減少、呼吸抑制；解毒劑為葡萄糖酸鈣。
  • Eclampsia seizure: stay, call for help, side-lying, airway, oxygen 8-10 L/min, monitor FHR, give seizure medication, suction after.子癇抽搐：留在床邊並求援、側臥、維持呼吸道、給氧 8-10 L/min、監測胎心、給予抗痙攣藥、抽搐後抽吸。
PDF p.344, 345, 346, 347

TORCH and Other InfectionsTORCH 與其他感染

  • Toxoplasmosis: raw meat and cat litter; teach avoidance. Rubella: teratogenic in first trimester (eyes, heart, ears, brain); vaccinate postpartum if titer under 1:8.弓形蟲：生肉與貓砂；教導避免。德國麻疹：第一孕期致畸（眼、心、耳、腦）；抗體價小於 1:8 者產後接種。
  • CMV: low birth weight, hepatosplenomegaly, jaundice, hearing loss, seizures; contact precautions.
