HSV: no vaginal exams with active lesions; cesarean if vaginal lesions; acyclovir/valacyclovir suppression late pregnancy.CMV：低出生體重、肝脾腫大、黃疸、聽力喪失、抽搐；接觸隔離。HSV：有活動性病灶不做陰道檢查；陰道有病灶時剖腹；孕晚期用 acyclovir/valacyclovir 抑制。
  • GBS: vaginal/rectal culture at 35-37 weeks; IV antibiotics in labor to prevent early-onset newborn sepsis.GBS：35-37 週陰道/直腸培養；產程給靜脈抗生素預防新生兒早發型敗血症。
  • COVID-19: pregnant people have higher risk of severe illness and preterm birth. Zika: microcephaly risk; supportive care, avoid aspirin/NSAIDs.COVID-19：孕婦重症與早產風險較高。Zika：小頭症風險；支持性療法，避免阿斯匹靈與 NSAIDs。
PDF p.347, 348, 354, 355

Multiple Gestation and Placental Abnormalities多胞胎與胎盤異常

  • Multiples: large-for-dates uterus, more than one FHR, excessive weight gain; risks include anemia, preterm labor, IUGR, hypertension, polyhydramnios, postpartum hemorrhage; give oxytocics after birth.多胞胎：子宮大於週數、聽到多個胎心、體重增加過多；風險包括貧血、早產、胎兒生長受限、高血壓、羊水過多、產後出血；產後給子宮收縮劑。
  • Placenta accreta, increta, percreta: abnormal adherence; hemorrhage after birth, possible hysterectomy.植入性胎盤（accreta、increta、percreta）：胎盤異常附著；產後出血，可能需子宮切除。
  • Previa: painless bright red bleeding, soft relaxed nontender uterus; NO vaginal exams; types total, partial, marginal; total needs cesarean.前置胎盤：無痛性鮮紅色出血、子宮柔軟放鬆無壓痛；禁做陰道檢查；分完全、部分、邊緣型；完全型需剖腹。
  • Abruptio: dark red bleeding (may be concealed), painful rigid tender uterus, fetal distress, shock, DIC risk; rapid delivery.胎盤早期剝離：暗紅色出血（可為隱性）、子宮疼痛僵硬壓痛、胎兒窘迫、休克、DIC 風險；儘速分娩。
PDF p.348, 349, 350

STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他

  • Chlamydia: often asymptomatic, neonatal conjunctivitis/pneumonia; gonorrhea: ophthalmia neonatorum; treat partner; rescreen near term.披衣菌：常無症狀，新生兒結膜炎/肺炎；淋病：新生兒眼炎；伴侶需治療；近足月再篩檢。
  • Syphilis: VDRL/RPR at first visit and again at 36 weeks; crosses placenta after month 4; test for HIV too.梅毒：首次產檢與 36 週做 VDRL/RPR；4 個月後通過胎盤；亦需驗 HIV。
  • HPV warts: treatment usually delayed until after birth; cesarean only if obstructing. Trichomoniasis and bacterial vaginosis: metronidazole. Candidiasis: topical antifungal; avoid oral fluconazole.HPV 生殖器疣：通常延至產後治療；僅阻塞產道才剖腹。滴蟲與細菌性陰道炎：metronidazole。念珠菌：局部抗黴菌劑；避免口服 fluconazole。
  • TB: chest X-ray only after 20 weeks with shield; isoniazid, pyrazinamide, rifampin (add ethambutol if resistance) with pyridoxine; breastfeed only if noninfectious.結核：20 週後才拍胸部 X 光並護腹；isoniazid、pyrazinamide、rifampin（可能抗藥加 ethambutol）並併用維生素 B6；僅無傳染性時可哺乳。
  • UTI: screen at first visit or 12-16 weeks; pyelonephritis needs hospitalization, risks preterm labor.泌尿道感染：首次產檢或 12-16 週篩檢；腎盂腎炎需住院，有早產風險。
  • Obesity: GDM, hypertension, preeclampsia, VTE, cesarean, postpartum hemorrhage, endometritis; use SCDs/stockings, early ambulation, incision care.肥胖：妊娠糖尿病、高血壓、子癇前症、靜脈栓塞、剖腹、產後出血、子宮內膜炎；使用 SCD/彈性襪、早期下床、傷口照護。
  • Iron-deficiency anemia: CBC at first visit, 24-28 and 36 weeks; iron between meals. Asthma meds are generally safe; maintain action plan.缺鐵性貧血：首次產檢、24-28 週、36 週做 CBC；鐵劑於兩餐間服用。氣喘藥物一般安全；維持氣喘行動計畫。
PDF p.350, 351, 352, 353, 354, 355

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Placenta previa: painless bright red bleeding, soft nontender uterus, NO vaginal exam. Abruptio: dark red bleeding, painful rigid uterus.前置胎盤：無痛鮮紅出血、子宮柔軟無壓痛、禁陰道檢查。胎盤早剝：暗紅出血、子宮疼痛僵硬。 PDF p.349, 350
  2. Magnesium sulfate toxicity: absent DTRs, low urine output, respiratory depression; antidote calcium gluconate; use a pump and check reflexes, RR, urine output.硫酸鎂中毒：反射消失、尿量減少、呼吸抑制；解毒劑葡萄糖酸鈣；使用幫浦並監測反射、呼吸、尿量。 PDF p.346, 347
  3. Preeclampsia worsening signs: headache, blurred vision, RUQ/epigastric pain, hyperreflexia, oliguria, BP 160/110 or higher.子癇前症惡化徵象：頭痛、視力模糊、右上腹/上腹痛、反射亢進、少尿、血壓 ≥160/110。 PDF p.345, 346
  4. Eclamptic seizure: side-lying, airway, oxygen 8-10 L/min, monitor FHR, seizure meds, stay with client.子癇抽搐：側臥、維持呼吸道、給氧 8-10 L/min、監測胎心、給藥、留在床邊。 PDF p.347
  5. Lower BP gradually in preeclampsia to preserve placental perfusion.子癇前症血壓應緩慢下降以維持胎盤灌流。 PDF p.346
  6. DIC: bleeding with low platelets and fibrinogen, high PT/PTT and FDP; remove cause, replace blood, keep urine at least 30 mL/hr.DIC：出血、血小板與纖維蛋白原低、PT/PTT 與 FDP 高；除去病因、輸血、尿量至少 30 mL/hr。 PDF p.341
  7. Ectopic pregnancy rupture: sudden severe pain, shoulder pain, shock; methotrexate for early unruptured cases.子宮外孕破裂：突發劇痛、肩痛、休克；未破裂早期用 methotrexate。 PDF p.341, 342
  8. Hydatidiform mole: no FHT, hCG over 100,000, snowstorm ultrasound; follow hCG for 1 year and avoid pregnancy.葡萄胎：無胎心、hCG 超過 100,000、暴風雪超音波；追蹤 hCG 一年並避孕。 PDF p.343, 344
  9. Insulin needs: decrease in first trimester, increase in second/third, drop sharply after delivery of the placenta.胰島素需求：第一孕期下降、二三孕期上升、胎盤娩出後驟降。 PDF p.340, 341
  10. GDM screening 24-28 weeks; 1-hour GCT 140 mg/dL or higher then 3-hour OGTT; exercise is safe.妊娠糖尿病 24-28 週篩檢；1 小時 GCT ≥140 mg/dL 再做 3 小時 OGTT；運動安全。 PDF p.340, 355
  11. Infant of diabetic mother: watch hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, RDS, hypocalcemia.糖尿病母親之新生兒：注意低血糖、高膽紅素、呼吸窘迫、低血鈣。 PDF p.340
  12. HIV: zidovudine antepartum, intrapartum and to newborn for 6 weeks; avoid scalp electrodes, episiotomy, oxytocin; formula feeding generally advised.HIV：產前、產中與新生兒 6 週給 zidovudine；避免頭皮電極、會陰切開、催產素；一般建議配方奶。 PDF p.343, 355
  13. HSV with active vaginal lesions: cesarean; no vaginal exams. GBS cultures at 35-37 weeks, IV antibiotics in labor.HSV 陰道有活動性病灶：剖腹；不做陰道檢查。GBS 35-37 週培養，產程給靜脈抗生素。 PDF p.348
  14. Rubella, toxoplasmosis, CMV: teratogenic infections; avoid raw meat and cat litter.德國麻疹、弓形蟲、CMV：致畸感染；避免生肉與貓砂。 PDF p.347, 348
  15. Syphilis: screen at first visit and 36 weeks; crosses placenta; treat partner.梅毒：首次產檢與 36 週篩檢；可通過胎盤；伴侶需治療。 PDF p.351
  16. Hepatitis B: remove maternal blood from newborn, then HBIG plus vaccine; breastfeeding allowed after vaccination.B 肝：先清除新生兒母血，再給 HBIG 加疫苗；接種後可哺乳。 PDF p.342
  17. Cardiac disease in pregnancy: watch decompensation; blood volume peaks 32-34 weeks; low sodium, side-lying in labor.孕期心臟病：注意代償不全；血容積 32-34 週最高；低鈉飲食、產程側臥。 PDF p.338, 339

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • TORCH: Toxoplasmosis, Other (syphilis, HIV, hepatitis B, parvovirus), Rubella, Cytomegalovirus, Herpes.TORCH：弓形蟲、其他（梅毒、HIV、B 肝、細小病毒）、德國麻疹、巨細胞病毒、疱疹。 PDF p.347, 348
  • HELLP: Hemolysis, Elevated Liver enzymes, Low Platelets.HELLP：溶血、肝酵素升高、血小板低。 PDF p.345
  • Magnesium toxicity: 'Reflexes gone, Respirations slow, Urine low' - give calcium gluconate.硫酸鎂中毒：反射消失、呼吸變慢、尿量少，給葡萄糖酸鈣。 PDF p.346, 347
  • Previa = Painless, Pretty red; Abruptio = Agonizing, Dark, rigid.前置胎盤＝無痛、鮮紅；早剝＝劇痛、暗紅、僵硬。 PDF p.349, 350

24 Labor and Birth分娩與生產

This chapter covers the normal process of labor: the 4 Ps, fetal lie/presentation/position/station, signs of true vs false labor, fetal heart rate (FHR) monitoring, the four stages of labor, anesthesia options, and common obstetric procedures. Reading fetal monitor patterns and knowing the first-priority action for nonreassuring patterns is the most heavily tested skill.本章說明正常分娩過程：4P（產力、產道、胎兒、心理）、胎位相關名詞（胎勢、胎向、先露、胎位、站位）、真假陣痛、胎心率（FHR）監測、產程四階段、麻醉方式與常見產科處置。能判讀胎心監測圖形並知道不安心圖形的首要處置，是最常考的能力。

Process of Labor: the 4 Ps and fetal terms分娩過程：4P與胎兒相關名詞

  • The 4 Ps are Powers (contractions, effacement, dilation, pushing), Passageway (bony pelvis and soft tissue), Passenger (fetus, membranes, placenta) and Psyche (emotional state).4P為產力（宮縮、子宮頸變薄與擴張、用力）、產道（骨盆與軟組織）、胎兒及附屬物（胎兒、胎膜、胎盤）與心理狀態。
  • Normal attitude is flexion (chin to chest, limbs folded); extension presents larger diameters.正常胎勢為屈曲（下巴貼胸、四肢蜷曲）；伸展會使胎頭通過的徑線變大。
  • Lie: longitudinal (spines parallel; cephalic or breech) vs transverse (right angle, shoulder presenting, cesarean needed).胎向：縱向（脊柱平行，頭位或臀位）；橫向（垂直，肩先露，需剖腹產）。
  • Presentation: cephalic (most common: vertex, military, brow, face), breech (frank, full, footling), shoulder.先露：頭位（最常見：頂位、軍姿位、額位、顏面位）、臀位（單臀、完全、足先露）、肩位。
  • Station measures descent relative to the ischial spines: 0 = at spines (engaged), minus = above, plus = below.站位以坐骨棘為基準測量下降：0為在坐骨棘（已入盆）、負值在上方、正值在下方。
PDF p.363

Signs of labor and mechanisms of labor產兆與分娩機轉

  • Pre-labor signs: lightening (about 2 weeks before in first pregnancies), more Braxton Hicks, bloody show, cervical ripening, nesting burst of energy, 1-3 lb weight loss, rupture of membranes.產前徵兆：胎兒下降（初產婦約提前2週）、假性宮縮增加、見紅、子宮頸成熟、築巢本能、體重減輕1至3磅、破水。
  • True labor: contractions regular, stronger, longer, closer; progressive dilation/effacement and descent. False labor: irregular, no cervical change, often relieved by walking.真陣痛：規律、越來越強、越長、間隔越短，子宮頸持續變化與下降；假陣痛：不規則、無頸部變化，走動常可緩解。
  • Cardinal movements in order: engagement, descent, flexion, internal rotation, extension, restitution, external rotation, expulsion.分娩機轉順序：入盆、下降、屈曲、內旋轉、伸展、復位、外旋轉、娩出。
  • Leopold maneuvers locate the fetal back (smooth, hard) and small parts (knobs) and help place the Doppler.李氏四步觸診可判斷胎背（光滑堅硬）與小肢體（不規則突起），並協助放置胎心探頭。
  • Breathing: slow-paced, modified (shallow fast), pattern-paced (pant-blow); blow in short puffs to avoid pushing early; limit breath-holding to under 6-8 seconds when pushing.呼吸技巧：慢式、改良式（淺快）、模式式（喘吹）；不想用力時短促吹氣；用力時憋氣少於6至8秒。
PDF p.364, 365, 366

Fetal monitoring and FHR patterns胎兒監測與胎心率圖形

  • Normal baseline FHR at term is 110-160 bpm, measured between contractions. Bradycardia <110, tachycardia >160 for 10 minutes or more.足月正常基準胎心率為110至160次/分，於宮縮間測量；持續10分鐘以上低於110為心搏過緩，高於160為過速。
  • External monitoring: ultrasound transducer over the fetal back, tocotransducer over the fundus; side-lying to avoid vena cava compression. Internal monitoring (scalp electrode, IUPC) needs ruptured membranes and 2-3 cm dilation.外部監測：超音波探頭置於胎背處、宮縮壓力計置於子宮底；採側臥避免壓迫下腔靜脈。內部監測（胎頭電極、子宮內壓導管）需破水且擴張2至3公分。
  • Variability: absent (undetected), minimal (<=5), moderate (6-25), marked (>25 bpm). Absent/minimal can mean hypoxemia, acidosis, drugs, or fetal sleep (up to 30 min).變異性：無（測不到）、輕微（5以下）、中度（6至25）、顯著（大於25次/分）。缺乏或輕微可能代表缺氧、酸中毒、藥物或胎兒睡眠（最長約30分鐘）。
  • Accelerations (>=15 bpm for >=15 sec) are reassuring.加速（上升至少15次/分且持續至少15秒）為安心圖形。
  • Early decelerations: mirror the contraction, head compression, benign. Late: start after contraction onset, uteroplacental insufficiency, nonreassuring. Variable: abrupt, variable shape, cord compression.早期減速：與宮縮呈鏡像、胎頭受壓、良性；晚期減速：宮縮開始後才出現、子宮胎盤功能不全、不安心；變異減速：突然、形狀不一、臍帶受壓。
  • Significant variables fall below 70 bpm and last 60 seconds or longer. Uterine resting tone averages 5-15 mm Hg; contractions 50-75 mm Hg; uterus should relax 60 seconds or more between contractions.重要的變異減速為降至70次/分以下且持續60秒以上。子宮靜止張力平均5至15 mmHg，宮縮強度50至75 mmHg，宮縮間子宮應放鬆至少60秒。
PDF p.366, 367, 368

Stages of labor產程階段

  • Stage 1 latent: 1-4 cm, contractions q15-30 min, 15-30 sec, mild; ambulate, fluids, void every 1-2 hr.第一產程潛伏期：1至4公分，每15至30分鐘一次、持續15至30秒、輕度；鼓勵走動、補充水分、每1至2小時排尿。
  • Stage 1 active: 4-7 cm, q3-5 min, 30-60 sec, moderate; breathing support, back rubs, sacral pressure.活躍期：4至7公分，每3至5分鐘、持續30至60秒、中度；協助呼吸、背部按摩、薦骨加壓。
  • Transition: 8-10 cm, q2-3 min, 45-90 sec, strong; rest between contractions, privacy, wake client to start breathing.過渡期：8至10公分，每2至3分鐘、持續45至90秒、強烈；宮縮間休息、維護隱私、宮縮開始時喚醒產婦開始呼吸。
  • Stage 2: complete dilation to birth; Ferguson reflex urge to push, bloody show increases; assess every 5 minutes.第二產程：全開至胎兒娩出；出現Ferguson反射的用力衝動、血性分泌物增加；每5分鐘評估一次。
  • Stage 3: placenta expelled 5-30 min after birth. Schultze: shiny fetal side first; Duncan: dull maternal side first. Inspect placenta for completeness; fundus firm, 2 fingerbreadths below umbilicus.第三產程：胎兒娩出後5至30分鐘胎盤娩出。Schultze為光亮胎兒面先出；Duncan為粗糙母體面先出。檢查胎盤是否完整；子宮底堅硬、位於肚臍下兩指幅。
  • Stage 4: 1-4 hours after birth; assess every 15 min x1 hr, 30 min x1 hr, then hourly x2; warm blankets, perineal ice, fundal massage, lochia moderate and red.第四產程：產後1至4小時；每15分鐘評估1小時、每30分鐘1小時，之後每小時2小時；保暖、會陰冰敷、子宮按摩、惡露中量紅色。
PDF p.368, 369, 370

Anesthesia and analgesia麻醉與止痛

  • Local (episiotomy): no fetal effect.局部麻醉（會陰切開）：對胎兒無影響。
  • Epidural (L3-L4): hypotension, bladder distention, longer second stage; keep side-lying or wedge under right hip, give IV fluids, check bladder; watch opioid effects (nausea, itching, respiratory depression).硬膜外麻醉（L3至L4）：可能低血壓、膀胱脹、第二產程延長；側臥或右臀下墊枕、給予靜脈輸液、檢查膀胱；注意鴉片類副作用（噁心、搔癢、呼吸抑制）。
  • Spinal (L3-L5): hypotension and postdural headache; lie flat 8-12 hours.脊髓麻醉（L3至L5）：低血壓與脊髓穿刺後頭痛；需平躺8至12小時。
  • General: risk of respiratory depression, vomiting, aspiration.全身麻醉：有呼吸抑制、嘔吐與吸入性肺炎風險。
PDF p.370

Obstetric procedures產科處置

  • Bishop score (dilation, effacement, consistency, position, station) of 8 or more means a favorable cervix for induction.Bishop評分（擴張、變薄、質地、位置、站位）達8分以上代表子宮頸有利於引產。
  • Oxytocin induction: baseline tracing first; do not increase once contractions reach every 2-3 min lasting 60 sec; stop if contractions closer than 2 min, longer than 90 sec, or fetal distress.催產素引產：先取得基準圖形；宮縮達每2至3分鐘、持續60秒即不再加量；宮縮間隔小於2分鐘、持續超過90秒或胎兒窘迫時停藥。
  • Amniotomy at 0 or plus station: risks cord prolapse and infection; check FHR before and after, note fluid color (meconium = distress, bloody = abruption, foul = infection).人工破水於站位0或正值時進行：有臍帶脫垂與感染風險；破水前後檢查胎心，記錄羊水顏色（胎便＝窘迫、血性＝胎盤早剝、臭味＝感染）。
  • External version after 34 weeks: for Rh-negative clients, confirm RhoGAM was already given at 28 weeks (not administered during the procedure); a nonstress test is done both before and after; Kleihauer-Betke test afterward.外轉胎位術於34週後進行：Rh陰性者應確認28週時已給予RhoGAM（非於此時才給藥）；術前與術後皆需做無壓力試驗；術後加做Kleihauer-Betke試驗。
  • Episiotomy: ice 24 hours then sitz baths; front-to-back, blot dry. Forceps/vacuum: check infant for injury; vacuum no longer than 25 minutes; watch for cephalhematoma (caput resolves in 24 hr).會陰切開：24小時冰敷後改坐浴；由前往後、輕拍擦乾。產鉗與真空吸引：檢查新生兒有無傷害；真空吸引不超過25分鐘；注意頭血腫（產瘤24小時內消退）。
  • Cesarean: consent, IV, Foley, Rh status; postop watch for UTI, endometritis (tender uterus, foul lochia), pneumonia, thrombophlebitis.剖腹產：同意書、靜脈留置、導尿、確認Rh；術後注意泌尿道感染、子宮內膜炎（子宮壓痛、惡露惡臭）、肺炎、血栓靜脈炎。
PDF p.370, 371, 372

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Normal FHR 110-160 bpm; a baseline of 100 between contractions or 180 needs provider notification.正常胎心率110至160次/分；宮縮間為100或達180需通知醫師。 PDF p.366, 374, 375
  2. Late decelerations = uteroplacental insufficiency: turn side-lying, oxygen 8-10 L/min by face mask, IV fluids, stop oxytocin, notify provider.晚期減速＝子宮胎盤功能不全：側臥、面罩給氧8至10 L/分、靜脈輸液、停催產素、通知醫師。 PDF p.367, 374
  3. Variable decelerations = cord compression: stop oxytocin, reposition, oxygen, assist with amnioinfusion if prescribed.變異減速＝臍帶受壓：停催產素、變換姿勢、給氧、依醫囑協助羊水灌注。 PDF p.367, 368
  4. Early decelerations and accelerations are reassuring; early decelerations need no intervention.早期減速與加速為安心圖形；早期減速不需處置。 PDF p.366, 367
  5. Nonreassuring patterns: bradycardia, tachycardia, late or prolonged decelerations, hypertonic uterus, decreased or absent variability, severe variables (<70 bpm for >60 sec).不安心圖形：心搏過緩、過速、晚期或延長減速、子宮張力過高、變異性減少或消失、嚴重變異減速（低於70次/分超過60秒）。 PDF p.367
  6. If oxytocin is running and fetal distress or hyperstimulation appears, the priority is to stop the oxytocin infusion.使用催產素時若出現胎兒窘迫或過度刺激，首要處置為停止催產素。 PDF p.371, 375
  7. After rupture of membranes (spontaneous or amniotomy) check FHR first because of cord prolapse risk.破水後（自然或人工）首先確認胎心率，以排除臍帶脫垂。 PDF p.369, 371, 375
  8. Avoid supine position: use side-lying or a wedge under the right hip to prevent vena cava compression, including on the cesarean table.避免仰臥：採側臥或右臀下墊楔形枕，以防下腔靜脈受壓，剖腹產手術台亦然。 PDF p.366, 370, 374
  9. Spinal anesthesia: lie flat 8-12 hours, risk of hypotension and headache. Epidural: hypotension, check bladder.脊髓麻醉：平躺8至12小時，有低血壓與頭痛風險；硬膜外：低血壓、檢查膀胱。 PDF p.370
  10. True labor shows progressive cervical change; contractions that last longer and stronger. Walking relieves false labor.真陣痛使子宮頸持續變化、宮縮增強延長；假陣痛走動可緩解。 PDF p.365, 375
  11. Bishop score 8 or higher = favorable for induction. Amniotomy requires fetus at 0 or plus station.Bishop評分8分以上有利引產；人工破水需胎頭在站位0或正值。 PDF p.371
  12. Meconium-stained fluid suggests fetal distress; bloody fluid suggests abruption; foul-smelling fluid suggests infection.胎便污染羊水提示胎兒窘迫；血性提示胎盤早剝；惡臭提示感染。 PDF p.371
  13. Never leave a laboring client in transition alone; in second stage prioritize rest between contractions and effective pushing.過渡期產婦不可獨留；第二產程重點為宮縮間休息與有效用力。 PDF p.369, 375
  14. Postpartum complications after cesarean: pain/burning urination (UTI), tender uterus plus foul lochia (endometritis), productive cough/chills (pneumonia), calf pain/redness (thrombophlebitis).剖腹產術後併發症：排尿灼痛（泌尿道感染）、子宮壓痛合併惡露惡臭（子宮內膜炎）、有痰咳嗽或畏寒（肺炎）、小腿疼痛紅腫（血栓靜脈炎）。 PDF p.372

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • VEAL CHOP: Variable decels - Cord compression; Early - Head compression; Accelerations - OK; Late - Placental insufficiency.VEAL CHOP：變異減速－臍帶受壓；早期－胎頭受壓；加速－正常；晚期－胎盤功能不全。 PDF p.367
  • Cardinal movements: "EDFIEREE" - Engagement, Descent, Flexion, Internal rotation, Extension, Restitution, External rotation, Expulsion.分娩機轉口訣：入盆、下降、屈曲、內旋轉、伸展、復位、外旋轉、娩出。 PDF p.365
  • 4 Ps of labor: Powers, Passageway, Passenger, Psyche.分娩4P：產力、產道、胎兒、心理。 PDF p.363

25 Problems with Labor and Birth分娩與生產的問題

This chapter covers intrapartum emergencies and complications: premature rupture of membranes, cord prolapse, supine hypotension, preterm labor, precipitous birth, dystocia, amniotic fluid embolism (anaphylactoid syndrome of pregnancy), fetal distress and demise, uterine rupture and inversion. Most items test the first priority action: relieve cord compression, improve oxygenation and perfusion, and notify the provider.本章涵蓋產程中的急症與併發症：胎膜早破、臍帶脫垂、仰臥低血壓、早產、急產、難產、羊水栓塞（妊娠類過敏症候群）、胎兒窘迫與胎死腹中、子宮破裂與子宮內翻。考題多測驗首要處置：解除臍帶壓迫、改善氧合與灌流並通知醫師。

Premature rupture of membranes胎膜早破

  • Spontaneous rupture before labor onset; gestational age guides management; preterm rupture with delayed birth raises infection risk.於陣痛開始前自然破水；週數決定處置；早產且延遲分娩時感染風險增加。
  • Assess pooled vaginal fluid, positive nitrazine test, fluid amount/color/odor, temperature, and FHR (fetal tachycardia can signal maternal infection).評估陰道積液、石蕊試紙（nitrazine）陽性、羊水量／顏色／氣味、體溫與胎心率（胎兒心搏過速可能代表母體感染）。
  • Avoid vaginal examinations; give antibiotics as prescribed; monitor for infection or fetal compromise.避免陰道檢查；依醫囑給予抗生素；監測感染與胎兒狀況。
PDF p.377

Prolapsed umbilical cord臍帶脫垂

  • Cord slips ahead of or beside the presenting part, compressing and cutting off fetal circulation. Suspect it with a sensation of something in the vagina, visible or palpable cord, bradycardia or variable decelerations after rupture.臍帶滑到先露部前方或旁邊而受壓，阻斷胎兒血流。若產婦感覺陰道有東西、見到或摸到臍帶、破水後胎心過慢或變異減速，應懷疑。
  • Immediately relieve pressure: sterile gloved hand lifts the presenting part off the cord and stays there.立即解除壓力：以無菌手套的手將先露部上推離開臍帶並維持不動。
  • Position: extreme Trendelenburg, modified left lateral or knee-chest. Call for help, oxygen 8-10 L/min, wrap exposed cord in warm sterile saline-soaked towel, IV fluids, prepare for emergency cesarean.姿勢：極度頭低腳高、改良左側臥或膝胸臥位。呼叫協助、給氧8至10 L/分、以溫無菌生理食鹽水濕巾包覆外露臍帶、靜脈輸液、準備緊急剖腹產。
  • Never push the cord back into the uterus.絕不可將臍帶推回子宮。
PDF p.377, 378

Supine hypotension and preterm labor仰臥低血壓與早產

  • Supine hypotension: uterus compresses vena cava and aorta; pallor, dizziness, tachycardia, hypotension, clammy skin, fetal distress. Turn to the side or place a wedge under the hip.仰臥低血壓：子宮壓迫下腔靜脈與主動脈；蒼白、頭暈、心跳快、低血壓、冒冷汗、胎兒窘迫。處置為側臥或臀下墊楔形枕。
  • Preterm labor: after 20 weeks and before 37 weeks. Risks include multiples, infection, anemia, substance abuse, age under 18, or a first pregnancy after age 40.早產：20週後至未滿37週。危險因子包括多胞胎、感染、貧血、物質濫用、年齡小於18歲，或大於40歲的初產婦。
  • Signs: contractions, cramping or diarrhea, low back pain, pelvic pressure, change in discharge, ruptured membranes, positive fetal fibronectin, shortened cervix.徵象：宮縮、腹部絞痛或腹瀉、下背痛、骨盆壓迫感、分泌物改變、破水、胎兒纖維連接蛋白陽性、子宮頸縮短。
  • Care: treat infection, restrict activity, hydrate, lateral bed rest, monitor fetus, tocolytics as prescribed, 17P injections to lower risk of preterm birth.處置：治療感染、限制活動、補充水分、側臥休息、監測胎兒、依醫囑給予安胎藥、使用17P注射以降低早產風險。
PDF p.378

Precipitous labor and dystocia急產與難產

  • Precipitous labor lasts under 3 hours: stay with client, keep her calm, pant between contractions, do not try to stop delivery.急產指產程少於3小時：陪伴產婦、使其鎮定、宮縮間喘息呼吸，不可阻止胎兒娩出。
  • Emergency birth: support perineum and apply gentle pressure on head (Ritgen), check for cord around neck, suction mouth then nose, dry and warm the infant, allow placenta to separate naturally, skin-to-skin to promote contractions.緊急接生：支托會陰並輕壓胎頭（Ritgen手法）、檢查臍帶繞頸、先吸口再吸鼻、擦乾保暖新生兒、讓胎盤自然剝離、肌膚接觸促進子宮收縮。
  • Dystocia: prolonged or painful labor from contractions, fetus (large, malpositioned) or pelvis. Hypotonic contractions are weak and irregular (oxytocin or amniotomy may help); hypertonic are painful, frequent, uncoordinated (pain relief and rest; no oxytocin).難產：因宮縮、胎兒（過大、胎位不正）或骨盆問題導致產程延長或疼痛。低張性宮縮微弱不規則（可用催產素或人工破水）；高張性宮縮疼痛、頻繁、不協調（止痛與休息；不用催產素）。
  • Dystocia care: monitor FHR first, contractions, maternal temperature/pulse, hydration, I&O, position changes, watch for cord prolapse after rupture.難產處置：首要監測胎心率，並監測宮縮、母體體溫與脈搏、水分、輸出入量、變換姿勢，破水後留意臍帶脫垂。
PDF p.378, 379

Amniotic fluid embolism and fetal distress/demise羊水栓塞與胎兒窘迫／胎死腹中

  • Anaphylactoid syndrome of pregnancy (amniotic fluid embolism): sudden respiratory distress, chest pain, cyanosis, coagulation failure; often fatal. Give 100% oxygen/ventilation, side position, fluids, blood products, prepare for emergency delivery.妊娠類過敏症候群（羊水栓塞）：突發呼吸窘迫、胸痛、發紺、凝血功能障礙，常致命。給予高濃度氧與通氣、側臥、輸液、血液製品，準備緊急分娩。
  • Fetal distress: FHR <110 or >160, meconium, late or severe variable decelerations, decreasing variability, abnormal activity. Stop oxytocin, lateral position, oxygen 8-10 L/min, IV fluid bolus, prepare for cesarean.胎兒窘迫：胎心<110或>160、胎便、晚期或嚴重變異減速、變異性下降、胎動異常。停催產素、側臥、給氧8至10 L/分、靜脈輸液快速注入、準備剖腹產。
  • Fetal demise (after 20 weeks): no fetal movement or heart tones; retained 3-4 weeks risks DIC (low platelets, bleeding from puncture sites). Support grieving, respect culture and religion, accept sadness/anger, refer to support groups.胎死腹中（20週後）：無胎動與胎心音；滯留3至4週有DIC風險（血小板低、穿刺處出血）。支持哀傷、尊重文化與宗教、接納悲傷與憤怒、轉介支持團體。
PDF p.379, 380

Uterine rupture and inversion子宮破裂與子宮內翻

  • Rupture risks: labor after prior cesarean, overdistended uterus, trauma. Signs: abdominal pain/tenderness, chest pain, contractions stop, rigid abdomen, absent FHR, shock.破裂危險因子：剖腹產後試產、子宮過度膨脹、外傷。徵象：腹痛壓痛、胸痛、宮縮停止、腹部僵硬、胎心消失、休克。
  • Rupture care: treat shock (oxygen, fluids, blood), prepare for cesarean, possible hysterectomy.破裂處置：治療休克（氧氣、輸液、輸血）、準備剖腹產，可能需子宮切除。
  • Inversion: uterus turns inside out, often with fundal placenta, cord traction, or atony. Signs: fundal depression, visible uterine tissue, severe pain, hemorrhage, shock.內翻：子宮翻出，常見於底部著床、強拉臍帶或子宮收縮不良。徵象：子宮底凹陷、可見子宮組織、劇痛、大出血、休克。
  • Inversion care: treat shock, prepare for vaginal replacement or laparotomy.內翻處置：治療休克、準備經陰道復位，失敗則剖腹復位。
PDF p.380, 381

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Cord prolapse: relieve pressure with a gloved hand holding the presenting part up; Trendelenburg or knee-chest; oxygen; never push the cord back.臍帶脫垂：戴手套的手上推先露部以解除壓迫；頭低腳高或膝胸臥位；給氧；絕不將臍帶推回。 PDF p.377, 378, 383
  2. After membranes rupture, check FHR immediately (cord prolapse risk) and note fluid color.破水後立即檢查胎心率（臍帶脫垂風險）並記錄羊水顏色。 PDF p.377, 379
  3. PROM: no routine vaginal exams (infection); watch for fever and fetal tachycardia.胎膜早破：不做常規陰道檢查（避免感染）；注意發燒與胎兒心搏過速。 PDF p.377, 382
  4. Fetal distress: stop oxytocin, lateral position, oxygen 8-10 L/min by face mask, IV fluids, notify provider, prepare for cesarean.胎兒窘迫：停催產素、側臥、面罩給氧8至10 L/分、輸液、通知醫師、準備剖腹產。 PDF p.380, 382
  5. Hypertonic contractions: pain relief and rest, not oxytocin or amniotomy. Hypotonic contractions may get oxytocin with fetal monitoring.高張性宮縮：止痛與休息，不用催產素或人工破水；低張性宮縮可在胎兒監測下使用催產素。 PDF p.379, 382
  6. Supine hypotension: turn to the side or wedge under the hip.仰臥低血壓：側臥或臀下墊楔形枕。 PDF p.378
  7. Preterm labor: 20 to <37 weeks; fetal fibronectin positive and short cervix; hydration, lateral rest, tocolytics, 17P.早產：20週至未滿37週；胎兒纖維連接蛋白陽性與子宮頸短；補水、側臥、安胎藥、17P。 PDF p.378
  8. Precipitous birth: never hold the baby back; support head and perineum, check cord around neck, suction mouth then nose.急產：不可阻止胎兒娩出；支托胎頭與會陰、檢查臍帶繞頸、先吸口再吸鼻。 PDF p.378, 379
  9. Amniotic fluid embolism: abrupt dyspnea, chest pain, cyanosis, then DIC; 100% oxygen, intubation readiness, correct coagulopathy.羊水栓塞：突發呼吸困難、胸痛、發紺，隨後DIC；給100%氧、準備插管、矯正凝血異常。 PDF p.379
  10. Fetal demise retained 3-4 weeks leads to DIC; monitor coagulation labs and bleeding.胎死腹中滯留3至4週可導致DIC；監測凝血檢驗與出血。 PDF p.380
  11. Uterine rupture: sudden pain, contractions stop, absent FHR, shock. Uterine inversion: fundal dimple, hemorrhage, shock; do not massage or push.子宮破裂：突發疼痛、宮縮停止、胎心消失、休克。子宮內翻：底部凹陷、出血、休克；不可按摩或推壓。 PDF p.380, 381
  12. In dystocia the priority is fetal heart rate monitoring.難產時首要為監測胎心率。 PDF p.379, 382

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Cord prolapse: "Up, Out of the way, Oxygen" - lift the presenting part, elevate the hips, give oxygen, call for help.臍帶脫垂：「上推、抬高、給氧」－上推先露部、抬高臀部、給氧、呼叫協助。 PDF p.377
  • Preterm labor window: after week 20, before week 37.早產：20週之後、37週之前。 PDF p.378

26 Postpartum Period產後期

This chapter covers normal physiologic recovery after birth (involution, lochia, breasts, urinary and GI changes, vital signs), routine postpartum assessment and teaching, common discomforts, emotional changes, and breast-feeding/chest-feeding. Know what is normal versus a red flag for hemorrhage or infection.本章說明產後正常生理恢復（子宮復舊、惡露、乳房、泌尿與腸胃變化、生命徵象）、產後評估與衛教、常見不適、情緒變化與哺乳。重點在分辨正常與出血或感染的警訊。

Postpartum period and involution產後期與子宮復舊

  • The postpartum period runs from birth to about 6 weeks.產後期從分娩後至約6週。
  • Uterus shrinks from about 2 lb (900 g) to 2 oz (57 g) in 6 weeks; fundus descends about 1 cm/day and is not palpable abdominally by day 10. Breast-/chest-feeding speeds involution through oxytocin.子宮於6週內由約2磅（900 g）縮至2盎司（57 g）；子宮底每日下降約1公分，第10天腹部已摸不到。哺乳透過催產素加速復舊。
  • Boggy (flaccid) fundus = atony, massage until firm; tender fundus suggests infection; a full bladder displaces the uterus upward and prevents contraction, so have client void before assessment.子宮軟而鬆弛＝子宮收縮不良，需按摩至變硬；子宮壓痛提示感染；膀胱脹滿會將子宮推高並妨礙收縮，評估前先請產婦排尿。
  • Afterpains are more common in multiparas, nursing parents, oxytocin use, and overdistended uterus.後陣痛較常見於經產婦、哺乳者、使用催產素及子宮過度膨脹者。
PDF p.385, 387

Lochia惡露

  • Rubra: bright red, days 0-3. Serosa: brownish pink, days 4-10. Alba: white, days 11-14.紅惡露：鮮紅，第0至3天；漿液惡露：粉褐色，第4至10天；白惡露：白色，第11至14天。
  • Normal odor resembles menstrual flow; foul odor suggests infection. Large clots (>1 cm) or saturating a pad in 15 minutes (excessive) need provider notification.正常氣味似月經；惡臭提示感染。血塊大於1公分或15分鐘浸濕一片護墊（過量）需通知醫師。
  • Amount: scant <2.5 cm/hr, light <10 cm, moderate <15 cm, heavy saturated in 1 hr, excessive saturated in 15 min. Weigh pads for accuracy.量：極少（每小時<2.5 cm）、少（<10 cm）、中（<15 cm）、多（1小時浸濕）、過多（15分鐘浸濕）。可秤護墊重量以求準確。
PDF p.385, 386

Other physiologic changes and vital signs其他生理變化與生命徵象

  • Menses return in 1-2 months if not nursing, 3-6 months if nursing; ovulation can precede menses, so lactation is not reliable contraception.未哺乳者1至2個月月經恢復，哺乳者約3至6個月；可能先排卵再來月經，因此哺乳不是可靠的避孕。
  • Colostrum 48-72 hr; milk comes in day 3; engorgement about day 4. Non-nursing: snug bra/binder, ice, avoid nipple stimulation; resolves in 24-36 hr.初乳持續48至72小時；第3天泌乳；約第4天脹奶。未哺乳者：穿緊身胸罩或束帶、冰敷、避免刺激乳頭；24至36小時緩解。
  • Diuresis begins within 12 hr; urinary retention is possible; bowel movement by day 2-3; hemorrhoids common.12小時內開始利尿；可能尿滯留；第2至3天排便；痔瘡常見。
  • Temp may reach 100.4 F (38 C) in first 24 hr from dehydration, higher suggests infection. Pulse may fall to 50 (normal); >100 suggests hemorrhage or infection. Falling BP suggests hypovolemia; rising respirations suggest PE, atony or hemorrhage.前24小時因脫水體溫可達100.4°F（38°C），更高提示感染。脈搏可降至50次/分（正常）；大於100提示出血或感染。血壓下降提示低血容量；呼吸明顯加快提示肺栓塞、子宮收縮不良或出血。
  • Orthostatic hypotension may occur in the first 8 hours: assist when getting up.產後前8小時可能有姿勢性低血壓：下床需有人協助。
PDF p.386, 387

Postpartum assessment and teaching產後評估與衛教

  • Assess vital signs, pain, fundus (height, consistency, location after voiding), lochia, breasts, perineum (REEDA-type swelling/discoloration), incisions, bowel, I&O, calf for thrombophlebitis, bonding, emotions.評估生命徵象、疼痛、子宮底（排尿後測高度、硬度、位置）、惡露、乳房、會陰（腫脹或瘀青）、傷口、腸道、輸出入量、小腿血栓靜脈炎、親子依附與情緒。
  • Give Rho(D) immune globulin within 72 hours to Rh-negative clients with Rh-positive newborn; check rubella immunity and vaccinate if nonimmune, avoid conception 1-3 months.Rh陰性且新生兒為Rh陽性者，72小時內給予Rho(D)免疫球蛋白；確認德國麻疹免疫，無免疫者接種疫苗，之後1至3個月避免受孕。
  • Teach: no heavy lifting for 3 weeks, daily rest, delay intercourse until lochia stops, follow-up at 4-6 weeks, report chills, fever, increased lochia, or depressed mood.衛教：3週內避免提重物、每日休息、惡露停止後再行房、4至6週回診、有畏寒、發燒、惡露增多或情緒低落立即通報。
PDF p.386, 387

Postpartum discomforts and emotional changes產後不適與情緒變化

  • Perineum/episiotomy: ice first 24 hours then sitz baths; perineal care after voiding; analgesic spray; avoid suppositories/enemas with lacerations.會陰／會陰切開：前24小時冰敷，之後坐浴；排尿後做會陰護理；使用止痛噴劑；有撕裂傷時避免塞劑與灌腸。
  • Constipation: 2000 mL fluid/day, fiber, ambulation, stool softener if prescribed.便秘：每日2000 mL水分、高纖飲食、走動、依醫囑用軟便劑。
  • Postpartum blues: tearfulness, mood swings, anxiety, fatigue, usually self-limited. Depression: guilt, loss of pleasure, less responsive to infant, suicidal thoughts. Psychosis: delusions, hallucinations, confusion, break with reality (emergency).產後憂鬱情緒：愛哭、情緒起伏、焦慮、疲倦，通常自行緩解。產後憂鬱症：罪惡感、失去興趣、對嬰兒反應少、自殺意念。產後精神病：妄想、幻覺、混亂、脫離現實（急症）。
  • All clients should be screened for depression in pregnancy and postpartum.所有孕產婦於孕期與產後均應篩檢憂鬱。
PDF p.387, 388

Nutrition and breast-feeding/chest-feeding營養與哺乳

  • Nursing parents need 200-500 extra kcal/day, more fluids, and continued prenatal vitamins; avoid alcohol, unprescribed medications, gas-forming foods and caffeine.哺乳者每日增加200至500大卡、多喝水、持續服用孕期維生素；避免酒精、未經處方藥物、產氣食物與咖啡因。
  • Start feeding early; use LATCH (Latch, Audible swallowing, Type of nipple, Comfort, Hold).儘早開始哺乳；以LATCH評估（含乳、吞嚥聲、乳頭型態、舒適度、抱姿）。
  • Wash breasts with water only (no soap); supportive non-underwire bra day and night; air-dry cracked nipples 10-20 min, ensure areolar latch, rotate positions.乳房只用清水清潔（不用肥皂）；日夜穿支撐型無鋼圈胸罩；乳頭皸裂時風乾10至20分鐘、確保含住乳暈、輪換姿勢。
  • Engorgement: feed frequently, warm before, cold between feeds, massage. Estrogen-containing pills not recommended; progestin-only less likely to reduce milk.脹奶：頻繁哺乳、餵前熱敷、餵後冷敷、按摩。不建議含雌激素避孕藥；單純黃體素較不影響奶量。
  • Newborn stools are light yellow, seedy, watery, frequent.母乳寶寶糞便為淺黃色、顆粒狀、水樣、次數多。
PDF p.388, 389

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Boggy uterus: massage the fundus until firm (first check bladder); never push on an uncontracted uterus (inversion risk).子宮鬆軟：按摩至變硬（先確認膀胱排空）；切勿用力推壓未收縮的子宮（有內翻風險）。 PDF p.385, 391
  2. Saturating a pad in 15 minutes = excessive bleeding: massage fundus, notify the provider.15分鐘浸濕一片護墊＝過量出血：按摩子宮底並通知醫師。 PDF p.385, 386, 391
  3. Clots larger than 1 cm are abnormal; notify provider.大於1公分血塊為異常，需通知醫師。 PDF p.391
  4. Lochia: rubra 0-3 days, serosa 4-10, alba 11-14; foul odor = infection.惡露：紅色0至3天、漿液4至10天、白色11至14天；惡臭＝感染。 PDF p.385, 391
  5. Temp up to 100.4 F in first 24 hr is expected; push oral fluids.前24小時體溫至100.4°F屬預期；鼓勵多喝水。 PDF p.387, 390
  6. Pulse >100, falling BP, and restlessness suggest hemorrhage; a pulse of 50 to 60 can be normal postpartum bradycardia.脈搏大於100、血壓下降、躁動提示出血；產後脈搏50至60可為正常心搏過緩。 PDF p.385, 387
  7. Full bladder pushes the uterus up and to the side and causes atony.膀胱脹滿會把子宮推向上方與側邊並導致收縮不良。 PDF p.387
  8. Rh-negative mother with Rh-positive newborn: Rho(D) immune globulin within 72 hours.Rh陰性母親、Rh陽性新生兒：72小時內給Rho(D)免疫球蛋白。 PDF p.386
  9. Rubella-nonimmune: vaccinate postpartum, avoid pregnancy for 1-3 months.德國麻疹無免疫：產後接種，1至3個月內避免懷孕。 PDF p.387
  10. Ice perineum first 24 hours, then sitz baths.會陰前24小時冰敷，之後坐浴。 PDF p.387
  11. Breast-feeding is not reliable contraception; avoid estrogen pills while nursing.哺乳不是可靠避孕；哺乳期避免含雌激素避孕藥。 PDF p.386, 388, 389
  12. Do not use soap on nipples; air-dry cracked nipples; do not limit feeding during engorgement.乳頭不用肥皂；皸裂乳頭風乾；脹奶時不要限制哺乳。 PDF p.388, 391
  13. Calf pain, warmth, redness suggests thrombophlebitis; postpartum depression requires screening and suicide risk assessment.小腿疼痛、溫熱、紅腫提示血栓靜脈炎；產後憂鬱需篩檢並評估自殺風險。 PDF p.386, 388
  14. After cesarean, delay abdominal exercises for 3-4 weeks; get out of bed by turning on the side and pushing up.剖腹產後3至4週才做腹部運動；下床時先側身再用手臂撐起。 PDF p.390, 391

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Lochia colors: RSA - Rubra (red), Serosa (pink-brown), Alba (white).惡露顏色RSA：紅（Rubra）、漿液粉褐（Serosa）、白（Alba）。 PDF p.385
  • BUBBLE-HE postpartum check: Breasts, Uterus, Bladder, Bowels, Lochia, Episiotomy/perineum, Homans/legs, Emotions.BUBBLE-HE產後檢查：乳房、子宮、膀胱、腸道、惡露、會陰、下肢、情緒。 PDF p.386
  • LATCH: Latch, Audible swallowing, Type of nipple, Comfort, Hold.LATCH：含乳、吞嚥聲、乳頭型態、舒適度、抱姿。 PDF p.388

27 Postpartum Complications產後併發症

This chapter covers postpartum complications: cystitis, hematoma, uterine atony, hemorrhage and shock, infection, mastitis, endometritis, pulmonary embolism, subinvolution, thrombophlebitis, and perinatal loss. The key skill is recognizing early hemorrhage and shock and acting in the right order.本章涵蓋產後併發症：膀胱炎、血腫、子宮收縮不良、出血與休克、感染、乳腺炎、子宮內膜炎、肺栓塞、子宮復舊不全、血栓靜脈炎與周產期喪失。重點是及早辨識出血與休克，並依正確順序處置。

Cystitis and hematoma膀胱炎與血腫

  • Cystitis: encourage fluids and frequent voiding; get urine culture (voided or straight cath) before antibiotics.膀胱炎：鼓勵多喝水與頻繁排尿；使用抗生素前先留尿液培養（自解或單次導尿）。
  • Hematoma (vulvar most common): linked to forceps and vessel injury. Signs: severe unrelieved pain, perineal pressure, bulging discolored mass, inability to void, falling Hgb/Hct, tachycardia/hypotension.血腫（以外陰最常見）：與產鉗及血管損傷有關。徵象：無法緩解的劇痛、會陰壓迫感、隆起變色腫塊、無法排尿、血紅素與血容比下降、心跳快、低血壓。
  • Care: ice, analgesics, catheter if cannot void, IV fluids, blood products, antibiotics, possible incision and evacuation; small ones reabsorb.處置：冰敷、止痛、無法排尿則導尿、靜脈輸液、輸血、抗生素，必要時切開引流；小血腫可自行吸收。
  • With epidural anesthesia the client may not feel pain, so changes in vital signs are the best clue.接受硬膜外麻醉者可能無痛感，因此生命徵象改變是最佳線索。
PDF p.393

Uterine atony and postpartum hemorrhage子宮收縮不良與產後出血

  • Atony: boggy uterus; massage until firm, empty the bladder, notify provider if not resolved.收縮不良：子宮鬆軟；按摩至變硬、排空膀胱，無改善則通知醫師。
  • Hemorrhage: >500 mL vaginal birth, >1000 mL cesarean, or 10% Hgb/Hct drop with symptoms. Highest risk in first 4 hours, then first 24 hours; late is beyond 24 hours.出血定義：陰道生產大於500 mL、剖腹產大於1000 mL，或血紅素／血容比下降10%並有症狀。風險最高為產後4小時內，其次24小時內；24小時後為晚期出血。
  • Causes: atony, lacerations, hematoma, retained placenta fragments. Risk factors: prior PPH, coagulopathy, chorioamnionitis, previa/abruption, overdistention, multiparity, prolonged labor, operative delivery.原因：收縮不良、裂傷、血腫、胎盤殘留。危險因子：曾有產後出血、凝血異常、絨毛膜羊膜炎、前置胎盤／胎盤早剝、子宮過度膨脹、多產、產程延長、手術生產。
  • Assess: pad soaked in 15 min; weigh pads (1 g = 1 mL). Early signs restlessness and rising pulse; later low BP, cool clammy ashen skin, low urine output, altered consciousness.評估：15分鐘浸濕護墊；秤護墊重量（1 g = 1 mL）。早期徵象為躁動與脈搏上升；晚期為低血壓、皮膚冰冷濕黏灰白、尿量減少、意識改變。
  • Take-action sequence: airway, oxygen 8-10 L/min nonrebreather, call OB, legs up about 30 degrees, massage if atonic, IV (two lines, 16-18 gauge), uterotonics (oxytocin, prostaglandins), fluids (LR/NS), Foley, blood products, prepare for surgery.處置順序：確保呼吸道、非再吸入面罩給氧8至10 L/分、呼叫產科醫師、抬腿約30度、鬆軟則按摩、建立兩條16至18號靜脈、子宮收縮劑（催產素、前列腺素）、輸液（LR／NS）、導尿、輸血、準備手術。
PDF p.393, 394, 395

Infection, mastitis and endometritis感染、乳腺炎與子宮內膜炎

  • Postpartum infection occurs within 28 days; fever at or above 100.4 F after the first 24 hours is infection until proven otherwise. Malodorous discharge, chills, malaise, pelvic pain, high WBC.產後感染發生於28天內；24小時後體溫達100.4°F以上視為感染。惡臭分泌物、畏寒、倦怠、骨盆痛、白血球升高。
  • Care: VS q2-4h, position for drainage, fluids 3000-4000 mL/day, high-calorie high-protein diet, hand hygiene, antibiotics per culture, antipyretics.處置：每2至4小時測生命徵象、引流姿勢、每日水分3000至4000 mL、高熱量高蛋白飲食、洗手、依培養結果用抗生素、退燒藥。
  • Mastitis: usually 2-3 weeks postpartum in nursing parents; localized heat, swelling, pain, axillary nodes, fever, flu-like symptoms. Continue emptying the breast (nurse or pump every 3-4 h), fluids 2500-3000 mL, supportive non-underwire bra, antibiotics.乳腺炎：多見於產後2至3週的哺乳者；局部紅熱腫痛、腋下淋巴結痛、發燒、類流感症狀。持續排空乳房（哺乳或每3至4小時擠奶）、水分2500至3000 mL、穿無鋼圈支撐胸罩、抗生素。
  • Endometritis: fever, chills, tachycardia, headache, backache, severe prolonged afterpains, large tender uterus, foul or reddish-brown lochia, ileus. Fowler's position, private room, IV antibiotics, no need to isolate newborn.子宮內膜炎：發燒、畏寒、心跳快、頭痛、背痛、嚴重持續後陣痛、子宮大而壓痛、惡露惡臭或紅褐色、腸阻塞。採半坐臥、單人房、靜脈抗生素，不需隔離新生兒。
PDF p.394, 395, 396

Pulmonary embolism, subinvolution and thrombophlebitis肺栓塞、子宮復舊不全與血栓靜脈炎

  • PE: sudden dyspnea, chest pain, tachypnea, tachycardia, cough, crackles, hemoptysis, impending doom. Oxygen first, elevate head, monitor, IV fluids, anticoagulants, possible thrombolytics.肺栓塞：突發呼吸困難、胸痛、呼吸心跳快、咳嗽、囉音、咳血、瀕死感。先給氧、抬高床頭、監測、輸液、抗凝血劑，必要時溶栓。
  • Subinvolution: painful, larger than expected uterus, heavy bleeding, prolonged lochia rubra; treat with methylergonovine as prescribed, frequent voiding, monitor Hgb/Hct.子宮復舊不全：子宮疼痛、比預期大、出血多、紅惡露延長；依醫囑給予methylergonovine、常排尿、監測血紅素／血容比。
  • Thrombophlebitis: hard bumpy tender vessel, warm red area, fever, diminished pulses, swelling. Bed rest, elevate leg, warm moist heat, stockings, anticoagulation; NEVER massage the leg; avoid aspirin-containing drugs with anticoagulants; early ambulation after cesarean prevents it.血栓靜脈炎：血管硬、凹凸、壓痛，局部紅熱、發燒、脈搏減弱、腫脹。臥床休息、抬高患肢、溫濕敷、彈性襪、抗凝血；絕不可按摩小腿；使用抗凝血劑時避免含阿斯匹靈藥物；剖腹產後早期下床可預防。
  • Teach: avoid leg crossing and prolonged sitting, avoid constrictive clothing, stop smoking, adhere to anticoagulants.衛教：避免蹺腳與久坐、避免緊身衣物、戒菸、確實服用抗凝血劑。
PDF p.396, 397

Perinatal loss周產期喪失

  • Includes miscarriage, stillbirth, neonatal death, abortion, and loss from preterm/complicated births or adoption.包括流產、死產、新生兒死亡、人工流產，以及早產／合併症新生兒或送養所致的失落。
  • Listen actively and allow time to grieve; offer chaplain; offer seeing/holding/bathing the infant and rituals; memory box (footprints, photos); private room with a discreet loss sign; support group referral.積極傾聽並給予哀悼時間；通知院牧；提供看、抱、沐浴嬰兒及儀式的選項；製作紀念盒（腳印、照片）；單人房並於門口放置隱諱標示；轉介支持團體。
  • Respect cultural, spiritual and religious practices; not every intervention fits every family.尊重文化、靈性與宗教習慣；並非每項措施都適用每個家庭。
PDF p.397

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Earliest sign of postpartum hemorrhage: rising pulse and restlessness; blood pressure drops late.產後出血最早徵象：脈搏上升與躁動；血壓下降較晚。 PDF p.394, 398
  2. Firm fundus but excessive bleeding suggests laceration: notify the OB; do not keep massaging.子宮底堅硬但出血過多提示裂傷：通知產科醫師，不要一直按摩。 PDF p.399
  3. Boggy uterus: massage until firm; never push on a boggy uterus (inversion).子宮鬆軟：按摩至變硬；切勿推壓鬆軟子宮（內翻）。 PDF p.393, 400
  4. PPH: >500 mL vaginal, >1000 mL cesarean; weigh pads 1 g = 1 mL.產後出血：陰道生產大於500 mL、剖腹產大於1000 mL；護墊秤重1 g = 1 mL。 PDF p.393, 394
  5. Shock bundle: airway, O2 8-10 L/min, legs up 30 degrees (avoid Trendelenburg), call OB, fluids, uterotonics, 2 large IVs, Foley, blood.休克處置：呼吸道、給氧8至10 L/分、抬腿30度（避免頭低腳高）、呼叫醫師、輸液、子宮收縮劑、兩條大管徑靜脈、導尿、輸血。 PDF p.395, 399
  6. Temperature 100.4 F or higher after 24 hours is infection.24小時後體溫達100.4°F以上為感染。 PDF p.394
  7. Mastitis: keep emptying the breast, finish antibiotics, fluids, supportive bra.乳腺炎：持續排空乳房、完成抗生素療程、多喝水、穿支撐胸罩。 PDF p.395, 399
  8. Endometritis: tender, enlarged uterus, foul lochia, fever; Fowler's position; do not isolate baby.子宮內膜炎：子宮壓痛腫大、惡露惡臭、發燒；半坐臥；不隔離嬰兒。 PDF p.396
  9. Suspected PE: oxygen first, then IV, vitals, anticoagulant.疑似肺栓塞：先給氧，再建立靜脈、監測生命徵象、抗凝血劑。 PDF p.396, 399
  10. Never massage a leg with thrombophlebitis; avoid aspirin with anticoagulants; monitor for PE.血栓靜脈炎的腿不可按摩；抗凝血劑期間避免阿斯匹靈；監測肺栓塞。 PDF p.396, 397
  11. Vulvar hematoma: severe perineal pain/pressure; ice during the first 12 hours after delivery; with epidural, vital-sign changes are the clue.外陰血腫：會陰劇痛與壓迫；產後12小時內冰敷；硬膜外麻醉者以生命徵象改變為線索。 PDF p.393, 400
  12. Subinvolution: prolonged lochia rubra, large tender uterus; methylergonovine.子宮復舊不全：紅惡露延長、子宮大而壓痛；methylergonovine。 PDF p.396
  13. Obtain urine culture before starting antibiotics for cystitis; push fluids.膀胱炎於抗生素前先留尿培養；多補充水分。 PDF p.393, 399
  14. Perinatal loss: individualize to culture and religion; offer memories and time with infant.周產期喪失：依文化與宗教個別化照護；提供紀念與與嬰兒相處的時間。 PDF p.397

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • The 4 Ts of postpartum hemorrhage: Tone (atony), Trauma (lacerations/hematoma), Tissue (retained placenta), Thrombin (coagulopathy).產後出血4T：張力（收縮不良）、創傷（裂傷／血腫）、組織（胎盤殘留）、凝血（凝血異常）。 PDF p.394
  • Early shock: restless and fast pulse; late shock: low BP and cool, clammy skin.休克早期：躁動與脈搏快；晚期：低血壓與冰冷濕黏的皮膚。 PDF p.394

28 Care of the Newborn新生兒照護

This chapter covers immediate newborn care and Apgar scoring, the head-to-toe newborn exam, body system adaptations (thermoregulation, jaundice, vitamin K, cord and circumcision care), reflexes, safety and parent teaching, and common neonatal problems: preterm/postterm, SGA/LGA, respiratory conditions, NEC, hyperbilirubinemia, Rh disease, sepsis, infections, substance exposure, maternal diabetes, hypoglycemia, infant choking and CPR.本章涵蓋新生兒立即照護與Apgar評分、新生兒全身評估、各系統適應（體溫調節、黃疸、維生素K、臍帶與包皮環切照護）、反射、安全與父母衛教，以及常見新生兒問題：早產／過期產、SGA/LGA、呼吸問題、壞死性腸炎、高膽紅素血症、Rh疾病、敗血症、感染、物質暴露、母親糖尿病、低血糖、嬰兒哽塞與CPR。

Initial care and Apgar scoring初期照護與Apgar評分

  • Dry and stimulate; suction mouth first then nose; skin-to-skin, warm blankets, hat, radiant warmer; wear gloves until the first bath; matching ID bracelets, footprints.擦乾並刺激；先吸口再吸鼻；肌膚接觸、保暖毯、帽子、輻射保暖台；初次沐浴前戴手套；配戴相符手環、採足印。
  • Apgar scored at 1 and 5 minutes on heart rate, respiratory effort, muscle tone, reflex irritability, color (0-2 each). 8-10 support only; 4-7 stimulate, oxygen, rescore; 0-3 full resuscitation.於1及5分鐘評估心率、呼吸、肌張力、反射、膚色（各0至2分）。8至10分僅需支持；4至7分刺激、給氧、再評分；0至3分需完整復甦。
  • Transition period (first 6-8 hours): first reactivity, decreased responsiveness, second reactivity.轉換期（前6至8小時）：第一反應期、反應遲鈍期、第二反應期。
PDF p.402, 403

Vital signs, measurements and head/face exam生命徵象、測量與頭面部評估

  • HR 110-160 (apical, 1 full min; 90-110 asleep, up to 180 crying); RR 30-60; axillary temp 97.7-<99.5 F (36.5-<37.5 C); BP 80-90/40-50 only if cardiac concern.心率110至160次/分（心尖脈量1分鐘；睡眠90至110、哭泣可達180）；呼吸30至60次/分；腋溫36.5至未滿37.5°C（97.7至<99.5°F）；僅疑心臟問題時測血壓80至90/40至50。
  • Length 18-22 in (45-55 cm), weight 2500-4000 g, head circumference 33-35 cm.身長45至55公分、體重2500至4000公克、頭圍33至35公分。
  • Molding resolves in about 72 hr. Caput succedaneum crosses suture lines, resolves in days; cephalhematoma does not cross sutures, resolves in weeks (up to 6).產瘤變形約72小時消退。產瘤跨越縫合線，數日消退；頭血腫不跨縫合線，需數週（至6週）吸收。
  • Anterior fontanel closes 12-18 months; posterior by 2-3 months. Eyes cross occasionally, red reflex present. Low-set ears suggest syndromes. Nose breathers; flaring means distress. Epstein pearls normal; thrush does not wipe off.前囟門12至18個月閉合；後囟門2至3個月內閉合。眼睛偶爾斜視、有紅色反射。耳位低提示症候群。新生兒用鼻呼吸；鼻翼搧動代表窘迫。上顎珍珠腫正常；鵝口瘡擦不掉。
PDF p.403, 404

Skin, abdomen, genitals, spine, extremities皮膚、腹部、生殖器、脊柱與四肢

  • Acrocyanosis normal early; central cyanosis is not. Vernix, lanugo, milia, Mongolian spots, stork bites normal. Harlequin sign may point to cardiac shunting or sepsis.初期手腳發紺屬正常；中心性發紺不正常。胎脂、胎毛、粟粒疹、蒙古斑、鸛咬痕屬正常。小丑症狀可能代表心臟分流或敗血症。
  • Cord has 2 arteries and 1 vein; a 2-vessel cord is linked to IUGR and anomalies. Cord clamp stays at least 24 hr; first meconium within 24 hr; first void within 24 hr.臍帶有2條動脈1條靜脈；兩條血管者與子宮內生長遲滯及異常有關。臍夾至少保留24小時；24小時內排胎便與首次排尿。
  • Port-wine stain stays; strawberry mark fades by 7-9 yr; stork bites fade by 2 yr; Mongolian spots fade in 1-2 yr.葡萄酒斑不會消退；草莓狀血管瘤7至9歲消退；鸛咬痕2歲前消退；蒙古斑1至2年內消退。
  • Check clavicle fractures, hip dysplasia (Ortolani/Barlow), spinal dimples or hair tufts, symmetric movements. Jittery tremors may signal hypoglycemia, hypocalcemia, or drug withdrawal.檢查鎖骨骨折、髖關節發育不良（Ortolani／Barlow）、脊柱凹陷或毛髮叢、動作對稱性。顫抖可能代表低血糖、低血鈣或藥物戒斷。
PDF p.405, 406

Body systems: respiratory, hepatic, renal, immune身體系統：呼吸、肝臟、腎臟、免疫

  • Respiratory distress: grunting, flaring, retractions, cyanosis, apnea over 15 sec. Bulb syringe: compress before insertion.呼吸窘迫：呻吟、鼻翼搧動、肋間凹陷、發紺、呼吸中止超過15秒。吸球使用前先擠壓。
  • Physiologic jaundice appears after 24 hr (term) and peaks around day 5 (indirect bili 6-7 mg/dL); jaundice in the first 24 hr is pathologic. Prevent chilling; feed early.生理性黃疸於24小時後出現（足月），約第5天最高（間接膽紅素6至7 mg/dL）；24小時內出現黃疸為病理性。避免受寒、儘早餵食。
  • Vitamin K (phytonadione) 0.5-1 mg IM into the vastus lateralis prevents hemorrhagic disease because gut flora is absent.維生素K（phytonadione）0.5至1 mg肌肉注射於股外側肌，因腸道菌叢尚未建立，可預防出血性疾病。
  • Weight loss 5-10% in week 1, regain by 10-14 days; 6 wet diapers by day 4 (1 g = 1 mL).第1週體重下降5至10%，10至14天恢復；第4天起每日6片濕尿布（1 g = 1 mL）。
  • IgG crosses placenta, IgA via colostrum; raised IgM suggests intrauterine infection. Eye prophylaxis (erythromycin 0.5%) within 1 hr to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum (gonorrhea).IgG經胎盤傳遞、IgA來自初乳；IgM升高提示子宮內感染。1小時內給予紅黴素0.5%眼藥膏預防新生兒眼炎（淋病）。
  • Cord care: keep dry and clean, fold diaper below cord, sponge baths until it falls off (10-14 days); moist, oozing, reddened base means infection. Circumcision: petroleum gauze, loose diaper, must void within 24 hr, yellow exudate normal; some blood tinge normal.臍帶照護：保持乾燥清潔、尿布折在臍帶下方、掉落前（10至14天）以擦澡；潮濕、滲液、基部發紅提示感染。包皮環切：凡士林紗布、尿布寬鬆、24小時內須排尿；黃色滲出物屬正常；少許血跡正常。
PDF p.406, 407

GI, neurologic and thermal regulation; reflexes腸胃、神經與體溫調節；反射

  • Stomach <10 mL at birth, about 90 mL by day 10. Breastfeed every 2-3 hr, formula every 3-4 hr; burp; position right side after feeding but supine for sleep (SIDS prevention). Meconium first 24 hr, transitional stool, then seedy yellow (breast) or pale yellow-brown (formula).出生時胃容量少於10 mL，約第10天達90 mL。母乳每2至3小時、配方奶每3至4小時；拍嗝；餵後右側臥，但睡覺一律仰臥（預防SIDS）。依序為胎便（24小時內）、過渡便、黃色顆粒便（母乳）或淺黃至淺褐便（配方奶）。
  • PKU screening after 24 hr of formula/human milk.PKU篩檢於攝入配方奶或母乳24小時後進行。
  • Newborns do not shiver; use brown fat. Heat loss: evaporation (dry), radiation (away from cold walls), convection (no drafts), conduction (warm surfaces). Cold stress leads to hypoxia, hypoglycemia and acidosis. Axillary temp q30 min for 2 hr, q4h to 24 hr.新生兒不會顫抖，靠棕色脂肪產熱。散熱方式：蒸發（擦乾）、輻射（遠離冰冷牆面）、對流（避免風）、傳導（暖墊）。受寒會導致缺氧、低血糖與酸中毒。腋溫前2小時每30分鐘一次，至24小時每4小時。
  • Reflexes: rooting/sucking (3-4 mo), tonic neck (3-4 mo), palmar grasp (3-4 mo), plantar grasp (8 mo), Moro (gone by 6 mo; persistence abnormal), startle (4 mo), Babinski (1 yr), stepping (3-4 mo), crawling (6 wk). Absence of normal reflexes needs neurologic evaluation.反射：尋乳／吸吮（3至4個月）、頸張力（3至4個月）、手掌抓握（3至4個月）、足底抓握（8個月）、擁抱反射Moro（6個月消失；持續為異常）、驚嚇（4個月）、巴賓斯基（1歲）、踏步（3至4個月）、爬行（6週）。正常反射缺失需神經評估。
PDF p.408, 409, 410

Newborn safety and parent teaching新生兒安全與父母衛教

  • Match ID bands, transport infant in bassinet (never carry), verify staff badges, crib away from door, never leave infant unattended or alone on elevated surface.核對手環、以嬰兒車運送（不可抱著走）、確認工作人員識別證、嬰兒床遠離門口、不可獨留嬰兒或放在高處。
  • Formula or human milk is sufficient for 4-6 months; do not microwave bottles. Bathe in warm room, clean to dirty, eyes inner to outer canthus. Dress newborn in one more layer than parents.配方奶或母乳足以供應4至6個月；勿用微波爐加熱奶瓶。在溫暖房間沐浴，由乾淨到髒、眼睛由內眥往外。穿著比父母多一層。
  • Uncircumcised: never forcibly retract foreskin; separation completes by 3-6 years.未割包皮：切勿強行翻開包皮；3至6歲自然分離。
PDF p.410, 411

Gestational age variations and respiratory problems胎齡差異與呼吸問題

  • Preterm (<37 wk): apnea, hypothermia, poor suck, thin skin, lanugo; keep in warmer, monitor VS q2-4h, girth, weight. Postterm (>42 wk): hypoglycemia, dry cracked skin, long nails, meconium staining.早產（<37週）：呼吸中止、低體溫、吸吮差、皮膚薄、胎毛多；置於保暖設備、每2至4小時測生命徵象、腹圍、體重。過期產（>42週）：低血糖、皮膚乾裂、指甲長、胎便染色。
  • SGA (<=10th percentile) and LGA (>=90th): both at risk for hypoglycemia; SGA also polycythemia, LGA birth trauma.SGA（小於等於第10百分位）與LGA（大於等於第90百分位）：皆有低血糖風險；SGA另有紅血球增多症，LGA有產傷風險。
  • RDS: surfactant deficiency; grunting, flaring, seesaw breathing; surfactant therapy, lowest effective oxygen, eye exam for ROP; side/back position, neck slightly extended.呼吸窘迫症候群：缺乏表面張力素；呻吟、鼻翼搧動、蹺蹺板式呼吸；給予表面張力素、使用最低有效氧濃度、檢查視網膜病變；側臥或仰臥、頸部微伸。
  • Meconium aspiration: term/postterm, yellow-green staining; suction if depressed. BPD: oxygen-dependent >28 days. TTN: retained lung fluid, resolves in 24-48 hr.胎便吸入：足月／過期產、黃綠染色；若活力差需氣管內抽吸。支氣管肺發育不良：依賴氧氣超過28天。暫時性呼吸急促：肺液吸收不全，24至48小時消退。
PDF p.411, 412, 413

IVH, ROP, NEC腦室內出血、早產兒視網膜病變、壞死性腸炎

  • IVH: prematurity, RDS; absent Moro, lethargy, apnea, shrill cry, seizures; midline head, elevate 30 degrees.腦室內出血：早產、RDS；莫羅反射減弱或消失、嗜睡、呼吸中止、尖叫、抽搐；頭保持中線、抬高30度。
  • ROP: prematurity and prolonged oxygen; leukocoria; laser treatment.早產兒視網膜病變：早產與長期用氧；白瞳症；雷射治療。
  • NEC: day 4-10, preterm; girth increase, absent bowel sounds, bile-stained vomit, bloody stool. No rectal temps; hold feeds, OG decompression, IV antibiotics and fluids.壞死性腸炎：第4至10天、早產兒；腹圍增加、腸音減弱或消失、膽汁性嘔吐、血便。不測肛溫；禁食、胃管減壓、靜脈抗生素與輸液。
PDF p.413

Hyperbilirubinemia, Rh disease, sepsis, infections高膽紅素血症、Rh疾病、敗血症與感染

  • Evaluate bilirubin >12 mg/dL in term infant; kernicterus is the danger. Jaundice spreads head to toe; check in natural light with blanching. Early frequent feeding (every 2-4 hr; continue breastfeeding).足月兒膽紅素大於12 mg/dL需評估；怕核黃疸。黃疸由頭向腳擴散；於自然光下按壓皮膚檢查。早期頻繁餵食（每2至4小時；持續哺乳）。
  • Phototherapy: expose skin, cover genitals, eye shields (remove each shift), photometer, extra fluids, skin temp, loose green stools, bronze baby syndrome, reposition q2h, turn lights off before drawing bilirubin, watch for rebound.光照療法：暴露皮膚、遮蓋生殖器、戴眼罩（每班移除檢查）、光度計、增加水分、監測皮膚溫度、綠色稀便、青銅寶寶症候群、每2小時翻身、抽血前關燈、注意反彈性升高。
  • Erythroblastosis fetalis: Rh-negative mother, Rh-positive fetus; jaundice before 24 hr, anemia, edema; RhoGAM within 72 hr; exchange transfusion.胎兒母細胞增多症：Rh陰性母親、Rh陽性胎兒；24小時內黃疸、貧血、水腫；72小時內給RhoGAM；換血治療。
  • Sepsis (e.g., group B strep): pallor, temperature instability, poor feeding, apnea, distention; cultures, antibiotics, warmth.敗血症（如B群鏈球菌）：蒼白、體溫不穩、吸吮差、呼吸中止、腹脹；做培養、給抗生素、保暖。
  • Congenital syphilis: hepatosplenomegaly, palmar rash, snuffles; penicillin; contact precautions; gloves until 24 hr of antibiotics.先天性梅毒：肝脾腫大、手掌皮疹、鼻塞（snuffles）；青黴素；接觸隔離；抗生素24小時內戴手套。
PDF p.413, 414, 415, 416

Substance exposure, HIV, maternal diabetes, hypoglycemia, hypothyroidism物質暴露、HIV、母親糖尿病、低血糖、甲狀腺低下

  • Addicted newborn: irritable, tremors, hypertonic, high-pitched cry, sneezing, poor feeding, fist-sucking, seizures. Swaddle, dim quiet room, small frequent feeds, seizure precautions.藥物成癮新生兒：易怒、顫抖、肌張力高、高頻哭聲、打噴嚏、吸吮差、吸拳頭、抽搐。包裹、昏暗安靜環境、少量多餐、癲癇防護。
  • FASD: short palpebral fissures, thin upper lip, flat philtrum and midface, abnormal palmar creases, heart defects; priority is feeding and weight gain monitoring, low stimulation.胎兒酒精譜系障礙：眼裂短、上唇薄、人中平坦、中臉扁平、手掌紋異常、心臟缺損；優先監測餵食與體重，減少刺激。
  • HIV-exposed newborn: standard precautions, no breastfeeding/chest-feeding, clean skin before injections, no circumcision until status known, PJP prophylaxis, antiretrovirals 6 weeks, delay live vaccines.HIV暴露新生兒：標準防護、不哺乳、注射前清潔皮膚、確定感染狀態前不做包皮環切、預防肺囊蟲肺炎、抗反轉錄病毒藥物6週、延後活性疫苗。
  • Infant of diabetic mother: large, puffy, hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, RDS, hypocalcemia, birth trauma. Early feeding, glucose monitoring.糖尿病母親的新生兒：體型大、浮腫、低血糖、高膽紅素血症、RDS、低血鈣、產傷。儘早餵食並監測血糖。
  • Hypoglycemia <45 mg/dL (normal 45-60 day 1; 50-90 after): jitteriness, high-pitched cry, apnea, seizures; early feeds or IV glucose.低血糖小於45 mg/dL（第1天正常45至60；之後50至90）：顫抖、高頻哭聲、呼吸中止、抽搐；儘早餵食或靜脈給葡萄糖。
  • Hypothyroidism: thick protruding tongue, hoarse cry, low tone, abdominal distention; thyroid replacement.甲狀腺低下：舌大突出、哭聲沙啞、肌張力低、腹脹；甲狀腺素補充。
PDF p.416, 417, 418

Infant choking and CPR嬰兒哽塞與CPR

  • Mild obstruction: good air exchange, forceful cough; do not interfere. Severe: weak/no cough, high-pitched or no sound, cyanosis, cannot cry.輕度阻塞：氣體交換良好、有力咳嗽；不要干預。重度：咳嗽無力或無聲、高頻或無聲音、發紺、無法哭。
  • Severe: 5 back slaps (head lower than chest, supported on forearm), then 5 chest thrusts (lower half of sternum); repeat; no blind finger sweeps; if unresponsive call for help and start CPR.重度：5次背部拍擊（頭低於胸，以前臂支撐），再5次胸部推擠（胸骨下半）；重複進行；不可盲目手指清除；若無反應則求救並開始CPR。
  • Infant pulse check: brachial artery; infant = 1 year or younger.嬰兒脈搏檢查：肱動脈；嬰兒指1歲或以下。
PDF p.418, 419

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Apgar 8-10 no intervention; 4-7 stimulate and oxygen; 0-3 full resuscitation.Apgar 8至10分不需處置；4至7分刺激與給氧；0至3分完整復甦。 PDF p.403
  2. Newborn norms: HR 110-160, RR 30-60, axillary temp 97.7 to <99.5 F, weight 2500-4000 g, head 33-35 cm.新生兒正常值：心率110至160、呼吸30至60、腋溫97.7至<99.5°F、體重2500至4000 g、頭圍33至35 cm。 PDF p.403
  3. Caput crosses sutures; cephalhematoma does not.產瘤跨越縫合線；頭血腫不跨縫合線。 PDF p.403
  4. Jaundice in the first 24 hours is pathologic: report it.出生24小時內出現黃疸為病理性：需通報。 PDF p.406, 414
  5. Prevent heat loss: dry the infant (evaporation), warm surfaces (conduction), avoid drafts (convection), keep away from cold walls (radiation). Cold stress causes hypoglycemia and acidosis.預防散熱：擦乾（蒸發）、暖墊（傳導）、避風（對流）、遠離冷牆（輻射）。受寒導致低血糖與酸中毒。 PDF p.408, 409, 421
  6. Vitamin K IM in the vastus lateralis prevents bleeding because newborn gut lacks bacteria to make it.維生素K肌肉注射於股外側肌，因新生兒腸道無菌叢可合成而預防出血。 PDF p.407, 423
  7. Erythromycin eye ointment within 1 hour prevents ophthalmia neonatorum from gonorrhea.1小時內塗紅黴素眼藥膏以預防淋病引起的新生兒眼炎。 PDF p.407, 422
  8. Put the baby to sleep on the back; avoid prone and side positions (SIDS).嬰兒睡眠採仰臥；避免俯臥與側臥（SIDS）。 PDF p.408
  9. Signs of cord infection: moist, oozing, discharge, red base: call provider.臍帶感染徵象：潮濕、滲液、分泌物、基部發紅：通知醫師。 PDF p.406, 407, 421
  10. RDS signs: tachypnea, grunting, retractions, flaring, cyanosis; give surfactant; barrel chest is not RDS.RDS徵象：呼吸急促、呻吟、凹陷、鼻翼搧動、發紺；給予表面張力素；桶狀胸非RDS表現。 PDF p.412, 421
  11. Phototherapy: eye shields, cover genitals, extra fluids, loose green stools expected, bronze baby syndrome, turn lights off for bilirubin draws.光照療法：戴眼罩、遮蓋生殖器、多補水、預期綠色稀便、青銅寶寶症候群、抽膽紅素前關燈。 PDF p.414
  12. Continue breastfeeding with hyperbilirubinemia; feed every 2-4 hours.高膽紅素血症仍持續哺乳；每2至4小時一次。 PDF p.414, 420
  13. Rh-negative mother with Rh-positive baby: RhoGAM within 72 hours.Rh陰性母親生下Rh陽性嬰兒：72小時內給RhoGAM。 PDF p.415
  14. NEC: no rectal temperatures; abdominal girth, bile-stained emesis, bloody stool.壞死性腸炎：不量肛溫；腹圍、膽汁性嘔吐、血便。 PDF p.413
  15. Infant of diabetic mother: priority is hypoglycemia. Hypoglycemia <45 mg/dL.糖尿病母親的新生兒：首要為低血糖；低血糖小於45 mg/dL。 PDF p.418, 423
  16. HIV-positive parent: no breastfeeding; standard precautions; delay live vaccines.HIV陽性父母：不哺乳；標準防護；延後活性疫苗。 PDF p.417, 422
  17. Infant choking: 5 back blows then 5 chest thrusts; no blind finger sweeps.嬰兒哽塞：5次背拍、5次胸推；不盲目手指清除。 PDF p.418, 419
  18. Newborn abduction prevention: carry in bassinet only, badge check, never unattended.防止新生兒被抱走：只用嬰兒車運送、檢查識別證、不可無人看護。 PDF p.410, 423

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • APGAR: Appearance (color), Pulse, Grimace (reflex), Activity (tone), Respiration.APGAR：外觀（膚色）、脈搏、反射（做鬼臉）、活動（肌張力）、呼吸。 PDF p.403
  • Heat loss: ECRC - Evaporation, Conduction, Radiation, Convection.散熱四途徑：蒸發、傳導、輻射、對流。 PDF p.408
  • Choking in infants: 5 and 5 - five back slaps, five chest thrusts.嬰兒哽塞「5加5」：5次背拍、5次胸推。 PDF p.419

29 Maternity and Newborn Medications產科與新生兒藥物

This chapter covers medications used in pregnancy, labor, postpartum and the newborn: tocolytics, magnesium sulfate, antenatal corticosteroids, labor analgesics, prostaglandins, oxytocin, postpartum hemorrhage drugs, Rho(D) immune globulin, rubella vaccine, surfactant, newborn eye prophylaxis, vitamin K, hepatitis B vaccine, contraceptives and fertility drugs. The key items are safety checks (respirations, DTRs, urine output, blood pressure) and antidotes.本章涵蓋孕期、生產、產後與新生兒用藥：安胎藥、硫酸鎂、產前類固醇、產程止痛藥、前列腺素、催產素、產後出血用藥、Rho(D)免疫球蛋白、德國麻疹疫苗、表面張力素、新生兒眼部預防、維生素K、B型肝炎疫苗、避孕藥與助孕藥。重點在給藥前安全評估（呼吸、深肌腱反射、尿量、血壓）與解毒劑。

Tocolytics overview安胎藥總論

  • FDA's PLLR replaced pregnancy letter categories (A, B, C, D, X) with narrative risk-benefit information.FDA的PLLR取代了孕期字母分級（A、B、C、D、X），改以文字敘述風險與效益。
  • Tocolytics relax the uterus to delay preterm birth. Maternal contraindications: severe preeclampsia/eclampsia, active bleeding, intrauterine infection, cardiac disease, abruption, uncontrolled diabetes.安胎藥使子宮放鬆以延遲早產。母體禁忌：重度子癇前症／子癇、活動性出血、子宮內感染、心臟病、胎盤早剝、血糖控制不良。
  • Fetal contraindications: >37 weeks, dilation >4 cm, fetal demise, lethal anomaly, chorioamnionitis, acute distress, chronic IUGR.胎兒禁忌：大於37週、擴張大於4公分、胎死腹中、致死性異常、絨毛膜羊膜炎、急性窘迫、慢性生長遲滯。
  • Care: side-lying, frequent maternal/fetal/labor monitoring, adverse effects, daily weight, I&O, psychosocial support.護理：側臥、頻繁監測母體／胎兒／產程、副作用、每日體重、輸出入量、心理支持。
  • Indomethacin (NSAID): not >2-3 days, avoid >32 weeks (ductus arteriosus closure), oligohydramnios, NEC/IVH risk. Nifedipine (calcium channel blocker): tachycardia, hypotension, headache, flushing; avoid with magnesium sulfate.Indomethacin（NSAID）：不超過2至3天，32週後避免（動脈導管早閉）、羊水過少、增加NEC／腦室內出血風險。Nifedipine（鈣離子阻斷劑）：心搏過速、低血壓、頭痛、臉潮紅；避免與硫酸鎂併用。
PDF p.425, 426

Magnesium sulfate硫酸鎂

  • CNS depressant and smooth muscle relaxant; used to prevent/control seizures in preeclampsia/eclampsia and sometimes for preterm labor. Antidote: calcium gluconate.中樞神經抑制劑與平滑肌鬆弛劑；用於預防及控制子癇前症／子癇抽搐，有時用於早產。解毒劑：葡萄糖酸鈣。
  • Toxicity: respiratory depression (RR <12), loss of DTRs, hypotension, flushing, extreme weakness, urine output <25-30 mL/hr (<100 mL/4 hr), pulmonary edema, heart block, cardiac arrest.中毒徵象：呼吸抑制（呼吸小於12次/分）、深肌腱反射消失、低血壓、臉潮紅、極度無力、尿量小於25至30 mL/小時（4小時小於100 mL）、肺水腫、心臟傳導阻滯、心跳停止。
  • Therapeutic level as tocolytic 4-7.5 mEq/L (2-3.75 mmol/L); check levels every 6 hr; give by IV pump only; check patellar reflex and RR before each parenteral dose; keep calcium gluconate and suction/oxygen at bedside.作為安胎藥的治療濃度4至7.5 mEq/L（2至3.75 mmol/L）；每6小時檢測；僅用靜脈輸液幫浦給藥；每次注射前檢查膝反射與呼吸；床邊備葡萄糖酸鈣、抽吸與氧氣。
  • Contraindicated in heart block, myocardial damage, kidney failure; newborn may show hypotonia and sleepiness; if used for preeclampsia it continues 12-24 hr postpartum.禁用於心臟傳導阻滯、心肌損傷、腎衰竭；新生兒可能肌張力低、嗜睡；用於子癇前症時產後持續12至24小時。
  • DTR grading 0-4: 2 is expected; 0 none, 1 diminished, 3 brisk, 4 clonus.深肌腱反射分級0至4：2為預期正常；0無反應、1減弱、3較活躍、4陣攣。
PDF p.425, 426, 427

Antenatal corticosteroids and analgesics產前類固醇與止痛藥

  • Betamethasone/dexamethasone speed fetal lung maturity (surfactant) for preterm labor at 28-32 weeks if labor can be delayed 48 hr; deep IM; monitor infection, WBC, glucose (hyperglycemia in diabetics), pulmonary edema.Betamethasone／dexamethasone促進胎兒肺成熟（表面張力素）；用於28至32週早產且可延遲48小時者；深部肌肉注射；監測感染、白血球、血糖（糖尿病者血糖升高）、肺水腫。
  • Opioid analgesics in labor: withhold and call provider if RR <=12; monitor FHR and contractions, hypotension (keep recumbent with hip wedge), bladder; keep naloxone ready (may precipitate withdrawal in dependent clients). Newborn withdrawal: irritability, tremors, seizures.產程鴉片類止痛藥：呼吸小於等於12次/分暫停給藥並通知醫師；監測胎心與宮縮、低血壓（採側臥並以楔形枕墊髖）、膀胱；備妥naloxone（對依賴者可誘發戒斷）。新生兒戒斷：易怒、顫抖、抽搐。
PDF p.427

Prostaglandins and oxytocin前列腺素與催產素

  • Prostaglandins ripen cervix when Bishop score <=4 (dinoprostone PGE2 gel/insert; misoprostol PGE1). Effects: GI upset, fever, tachysystole (>=12 contractions in 20 min), hyperstimulation, meconium. Client voids first, lies supine with lateral tilt or side-lying 30-60 min (gel) to 2 hr (insert). Stop when Bishop >=8 or 3+ contractions in 10 min; oxytocin can start 6-12 hr later.前列腺素用於Bishop評分小於等於4時軟化子宮頸（dinoprostone PGE2凝膠／栓劑；misoprostol PGE1）。副作用：腸胃不適、發燒、過度收縮（20分鐘內大於等於12次）、過度刺激、胎便。先排尿，採仰臥並側傾或側臥：凝膠30至60分鐘、栓劑至2小時。Bishop達8以上或10分鐘內達3次以上宮縮即停；催產素可於6至12小時後開始。
  • Prostaglandin contraindications include prior cesarean or uterine surgery, fetal malpresentation, nonreassuring FHR, previa, significant CPD, regular contractions.前列腺素禁忌：曾剖腹產或子宮手術、胎位不正、胎心不安心、前置胎盤、明顯頭骨盆不對稱、已有規律宮縮。
  • Oxytocin: increases force, frequency, duration of contractions; milk let-down; induces or augments labor, controls postpartum bleeding. Give IV by pump, piggyback at port nearest the insertion, never leave client unattended. Monitor vitals, contractions, FHR every 15 min. Risks: hypertonic contractions, uterine rupture, water intoxication, postpartum atony. Contraindicated with inability to deliver vaginally, hypertonic contractions, active genital herpes.催產素：增強宮縮強度、頻率與持續時間；促進泌乳排出；引產或加強宮縮、控制產後出血。以靜脈幫浦給藥，接在最靠近穿刺處的接口，不可離開產婦。每15分鐘監測生命徵象、宮縮與胎心。風險：高張性宮縮、子宮破裂、水中毒、產後子宮收縮不良。禁忌：無法經陰道生產、高張性宮縮、活動性生殖器疱疹。
  • If hyperstimulation or nonreassuring FHR: stop oxytocin, side-lying, increase plain IV fluid, oxygen by face mask; have magnesium sulfate available to relax uterus.若過度刺激或胎心不安心：停催產素、側臥、增加無藥輸液速度、面罩給氧；備妥硫酸鎂以放鬆子宮。
  • Dose example: oxytocin 2 mU/min from 20 U in 1000 mL = 0.1 mL/min = 6 mL/hr (convert mU to U first).劑量範例：催產素2 mU/分，配置為20 U加於1000 mL，等於0.1 mL/分＝6 mL/小時（先將mU換算為U）。
PDF p.427, 428, 429

Postpartum hemorrhage drugs產後出血用藥

  • Methylergonovine (ergot alkaloid): firm tetanic uterine contraction, vasoconstriction. Give only after placenta delivered. Check BP first; withhold and notify if BP raised. Contraindicated in hypertension, preeclampsia, cardiovascular and peripheral vascular disease. Adverse: nausea, cramping, bradycardia, severe hypertension, MI.Methylergonovine（麥角生物鹼）：使子宮強直收縮、血管收縮。僅於胎盤娩出後使用。給藥前先量血壓；血壓高則暫停並通知醫師。禁用於高血壓、子癇前症、心血管與周邊血管疾病。副作用：噁心、絞痛、心搏過緩、嚴重高血壓、心肌梗塞。
  • Carboprost (PGF2 alpha): contracts uterus; adverse headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, tachycardia, hypertension; contraindicated in asthma.Carboprost（PGF2α）：使子宮收縮；副作用頭痛、噁心嘔吐、腹瀉、發燒、心搏過速、高血壓；氣喘者禁用。
  • Oxytocin is the first-line uterotonic.催產素為首選子宮收縮劑。
PDF p.429, 430

Rho(D) immune globulin and rubella vaccineRho(D)免疫球蛋白與德國麻疹疫苗

  • Rho(D) IG: Rh-negative, antibody-negative client; IM at 28 weeks and within 72 hr after delivery of an Rh-positive baby; also after amniocentesis, CVS, abortion, trauma, bleeding. Never IV, not for the newborn, no benefit if already sensitized (positive titer).Rho(D)免疫球蛋白：用於Rh陰性且抗體陰性者；28週肌肉注射，分娩Rh陽性嬰兒後72小時內再注射；羊膜穿刺、絨毛取樣、流產、外傷、出血後亦需給予。不可靜脈注射、不給新生兒、已致敏（抗體滴度陽性）者無效。
  • Rubella vaccine: subcutaneous before discharge if titer <1:8; check egg allergy and immunocompromised household members; avoid pregnancy 1-3 months.德國麻疹疫苗：滴度小於1:8者出院前皮下注射；評估蛋過敏與家人免疫功能低下；1至3個月內避免懷孕。
PDF p.430

Newborn medications新生兒藥物

  • Surfactant: intratracheal for RDS; watch bradycardia and desaturation; no suctioning for 2 hours after.表面張力素：氣管內給藥治療RDS；注意心搏過緩與血氧下降；給藥後2小時內避免抽吸。
  • Erythromycin eye ointment: legally required; prevents gonorrhea and chlamydia ophthalmia; clean eyes first, do not flush; may delay up to 1 hr for bonding.紅黴素眼藥膏：法律規定；預防淋病與披衣菌所致眼炎；先清潔眼睛、給藥後不沖洗；為親子依附可延後最多1小時。
  • Phytonadione (vitamin K): protect from light; IM into the vastus lateralis; newborns deficient for first 5-8 days; rare hyperbilirubinemia; monitor bruising and cord bleeding.維生素K（phytonadione）：避光；肌肉注射於股外側肌；新生兒前5至8天缺乏；少見高膽紅素血症；監測瘀青與臍帶出血。
  • Hepatitis B vaccine IM in vastus lateralis before discharge with parental consent; if mother HBsAg-positive, add hepatitis B immune globulin within 12 hr of birth.B型肝炎疫苗於出院前取得同意後肌肉注射股外側肌；母親HBsAg陽性者，出生12小時內加打B型肝炎免疫球蛋白。
PDF p.430, 431

Contraceptives and fertility medications避孕藥與助孕藥

  • Combined estrogen-progestin suppress ovulation and thicken cervical mucus; usually 21 days on, 7 off; full effect up to 1 week.雌激素合併黃體素複方抑制排卵並使子宮頸黏液變稠；通常服21天、停7天；可能需1週才完全有效。
  • Risk: smoking, obesity, hypertension. Contraindicated: hypertension, thromboembolism, CVA/CAD, estrogen-dependent cancer, pregnancy. Antibiotics may reduce effectiveness; report thromboembolic signs; diabetics monitor glucose.風險：吸菸、肥胖、高血壓。禁忌：高血壓、血栓栓塞、腦中風／冠心病、雌激素依賴性癌症、懷孕。抗生素可能降低效果；回報血栓徵象；糖尿病者監測血糖。
  • Patch: 3 weeks on, 1 week off, new site weekly; off <24 hr reapply/replace, >24 hr start new cycle. Ring: 3 weeks in, 1 out; discard in foil, not toilet. Use backup 2 months after stopping before conceiving.貼片：貼3週、停1週，每週換新位置；脫落小於24小時可重貼或換新，超過24小時需開始新週期。陰道環：置入3週、取出1週；以鋁箔包好丟棄，不可丟馬桶。停藥後為排出荷爾蒙，需再避孕2個月才受孕。
  • Fertility drugs (clomiphene, menotropins, FSH analogs, hCG): risks multiple births, ovarian hyperstimulation (abdominal pain, distention, ascites, pleural effusion); teach timing of intercourse and follow-up.助孕藥（clomiphene、menotropins、FSH類似物、hCG）：風險為多胞胎、卵巢過度刺激（腹痛、腹脹、腹水、肋膜積水）；衛教行房時機與追蹤。
PDF p.431, 432

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Magnesium sulfate toxicity: RR <12, absent DTRs, urine output <25-30 mL/hr; stop infusion, give calcium gluconate, notify provider.硫酸鎂中毒：呼吸小於12、DTR消失、尿量小於25至30 mL/小時；停藥、給葡萄糖酸鈣、通知醫師。 PDF p.426, 427, 434
  2. Therapeutic magnesium 4-7.5 mEq/L; give with IV pump; keep calcium gluconate at bedside.鎂的治療濃度4至7.5 mEq/L；以靜脈幫浦給藥；床邊備葡萄糖酸鈣。 PDF p.426
  3. Oxytocin: stop for hyperstimulation, late decelerations or nonreassuring FHR; turn side-lying, increase plain IV fluid, oxygen.催產素：過度刺激、晚期減速或胎心不安心時停藥；側臥、增加無藥輸液、給氧。 PDF p.429, 434
  4. Oxytocin calculation: 2 mU/min from 20 U/1000 mL = 6 mL/hr.催產素計算：2 mU/分，20 U/1000 mL＝6 mL/小時。 PDF p.429
  5. Methylergonovine: check BP first; contraindicated in hypertension, preeclampsia, vascular disease; given only after placenta delivery.Methylergonovine：先量血壓；高血壓、子癇前症、血管疾病禁用；胎盤娩出後才給。 PDF p.429, 430, 435
  6. Carboprost is contraindicated in asthma.Carboprost氣喘者禁用。 PDF p.430
  7. Betamethasone at 28-32 weeks accelerates fetal lung maturity if labor can be delayed 48 hours.28至32週給betamethasone，若可延遲48小時則加速胎兒肺成熟。 PDF p.427, 434
  8. Naloxone reverses opioid respiratory depression; withhold opioid if RR <=12.Naloxone可逆轉鴉片類呼吸抑制；呼吸小於等於12次/分暫停鴉片類。 PDF p.427, 435
  9. Rho(D) IG: IM only, 28 weeks and within 72 hr of birth; not for Rh-positive mothers or the newborn; no help once sensitized.Rho(D)免疫球蛋白：僅肌肉注射，28週與產後72小時內；Rh陽性母親與新生兒不用；已致敏無效。 PDF p.430, 435
  10. Rubella vaccine: give if titer <1:8; avoid pregnancy 1-3 months.德國麻疹疫苗：滴度小於1:8給予；1至3個月避免懷孕。 PDF p.430
  11. Surfactant is given intratracheal; no suctioning for 2 hours.表面張力素經氣管內給予；2小時內不抽吸。 PDF p.430, 434
  12. Newborn eye ointment: don't flush; within 1 hour; prevents gonorrhea/chlamydia ophthalmia.新生兒眼藥膏：不沖洗；1小時內；預防淋病與披衣菌眼炎。 PDF p.431, 434
  13. Vitamin K IM in vastus lateralis; hepatitis B vaccine plus HBIG within 12 hr if mother HBsAg-positive.維生素K肌肉注射於股外側肌；母親HBsAg陽性者12小時內加打HBIG與B肝疫苗。 PDF p.431
  14. Indomethacin tocolysis: no more than 2-3 days and not after 32 weeks (ductus closure).Indomethacin安胎：不超過2至3天，32週後不用（動脈導管閉合）。 PDF p.426
  15. Nifedipine plus magnesium sulfate can cause severe hypotension; avoid combination.Nifedipine合併硫酸鎂可造成嚴重低血壓；避免併用。 PDF p.426
  16. Antibiotics may reduce oral contraceptive effectiveness: use backup method.抗生素可能降低口服避孕藥效果：需使用備用避孕方式。 PDF p.431, 432

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Magnesium toxicity: check the 3 Rs-- Respirations (>=12), Reflexes (present), Renal output (>=25-30 mL/hr).鎂中毒檢查三R：呼吸（至少12）、反射（存在）、腎臟尿量（至少25至30 mL/小時）。 PDF p.426, 427
  • Oxytocin trouble: stop, side, fluids, oxygen (stop drip, turn to side, increase plain IV, O2 8-10 L/min).催產素出問題：停藥、側臥、輸液、給氧（停滴、側臥、增加無藥輸液、氧氣8至10 L/分）。 PDF p.429
  • Antidotes: magnesium - calcium gluconate; opioids - naloxone.解毒劑：鎂－葡萄糖酸鈣；鴉片類－naloxone。 PDF p.425, 427

30 Integumentary Problems皮膚問題

Pediatric skin disorders: eczema, impetigo, head lice, scabies and burns. Focus on infection control, correct topical medication use, home decontamination teaching and the special features of burns in children.小兒皮膚疾病：濕疹、膿痂疹、頭蝨、疥瘡與燒傷。重點為感染控制、外用藥正確使用、居家環境處理衛教，以及兒童燒傷的特殊性。

Eczema (dermatitis)濕疹（皮膚炎）

  • Superficial inflammation of the epidermis; linked to family history, allergies, asthma, allergic rhinitis.表皮淺層發炎；與家族史、過敏、氣喘、過敏性鼻炎有關。
  • Signs: itching, redness, scaling, tiny papules and vesicles, weeping/oozing and crusting; typical on scalp, face, elbow/knee creases, neck, wrists, ankles; axilla, buttocks, groin uncommon.症狀：搔癢、紅斑、脫屑、小丘疹與水泡、滲液結痂；好發頭皮、臉、肘膝彎處、頸、腕、踝；腋下、臀、鼠蹊少見。
  • Infantile form starts at 2-6 months and may remit by 3 years; childhood form 2-3 years; adolescent form from about 12 years onward.嬰兒型 2–6 個月開始，3 歲前可能緩解；兒童型 2–3 歲；青少年型約 12 歲起。
  • Goals: relieve itch, hydrate skin, reduce inflammation, prevent/control secondary infection.目標：止癢、保濕、消炎、預防或控制續發感染。
PDF p.438

Eczema care濕疹照護

  • Short (5-10 min) lukewarm baths, oatmeal soothing; moisturize immediately with thick cream/ointment.短時間（5–10 分鐘）微溫水浴，可用燕麥浴；浴後立即塗厚層乳霜或軟膏。
  • Topical medication goes on within 3 minutes after the bath, before the moisturizer; corticosteroids in a thin layer rubbed in well.外用藥於浴後 3 分鐘內先塗，再塗保濕劑；類固醇薄塗並充分推開。
  • Avoid irritants: harsh soaps, detergents, fabric softeners, wipes, powder, wool, latex, heat, wet diapers.避免刺激物：刺激性肥皂、洗衣精、柔軟精、濕紙巾、爽身粉、羊毛、乳膠、高溫、濕尿布。
  • Keep nails short, cover hands with gloves/cotton socks; cool wet compresses for itch.指甲剪短，手戴手套或棉襪；冷濕敷止癢。
  • Honey-colored crusts with surrounding redness means secondary infection: seek care promptly.蜜黃色痂皮伴周圍紅斑代表續發感染，應立即就醫。
PDF p.438, 439

Impetigo膿痂疹

  • Contagious skin infection by group A strep and Staphylococcus aureus; more common in hot, humid months, often at insect bites or damaged skin.由 A 群鏈球菌與金黃色葡萄球菌引起的傳染性皮膚感染；炎熱潮濕季節多見，常發生於蚊蟲叮咬或受損皮膚。
  • Most common on face around mouth/nose, then hands, neck, extremities; vesicles/pustules rupture leaving honey-colored crusts.好發於口鼻周圍，其次手、頸、四肢；水泡/膿疱破裂後留下蜜黃色痂皮。
  • Contact isolation plus standard precautions; contagious until 24 hours after antibiotics started.接觸隔離加標準防護；開始抗生素後 24 小時內仍具傳染性。
  • Cover lesions, warm compresses 2-3 times daily to soften crusts, topical or oral antibiotics; finish the full course (risk of glomerulonephritis with strep).覆蓋傷口，每日 2–3 次溫敷軟化痂皮，外用或口服抗生素；須完成療程（鏈球菌可併發腎絲球腎炎）。
  • Separate towels, linens, utensils; hot-water wash of linens; bleach the tub; short nails; careful handwashing.毛巾、床單、餐具分開；寢具以熱水清洗；浴缸以漂白水清潔；指甲剪短；勤洗手。
PDF p.439

Pediculosis capitis (lice)頭蝨

  • Lice infest hair/scalp, mostly occipital area and behind ears; nits are glued to the hair shaft near the scalp and do not flake off like dandruff.蝨子寄生頭髮與頭皮，多在枕部與耳後；蟲卵（蝨卵）牢固黏於近頭皮髮幹，不像頭皮屑易掉落。
  • Spread by direct/indirect contact (brushes, hats, towels, bedding); lice live about 48 hours off the host; nits hatch in 7-10 days.經直接或間接接觸（梳子、帽子、毛巾、寢具）傳播；離開宿主約存活 48 小時；卵 7–10 天孵化。
  • Use pediculicide as prescribed; most not for infants under 6 months; lindane not for under 2 years (neurotoxicity, seizures).依醫囑使用殺蝨劑；多數不適用 6 個月以下；林丹（lindane）不可用於 2 歲以下（神經毒性、癲癇）。
  • Daily nit removal with fine metal comb (wear gloves); examine and treat contacts as needed.每日以細齒金屬梳除卵（戴手套）；檢查並視需要治療接觸者。
  • Launder clothing/bedding from previous 2 days in hot water and hot dryer 20 min; seal nonwashables in plastic bag 2 weeks; vacuum and discard bag; soak combs in boiling water 10 min.洗滌前 2 天衣物寢具用熱水並熱烘 20 分鐘；不可洗物品密封塑膠袋 2 週；吸塵並丟棄集塵袋；梳子以沸水浸泡 10 分鐘。
PDF p.439, 440

Scabies疥瘡

  • Caused by the itch mite Sarcoptes scabiei; spread by close contact; infectious throughout the infestation.由疥蟲引起；經密切接觸傳染；整個感染期皆具傳染性。
  • Findings: pruritic papular rash and burrows (fine grayish-red threadlike lines).表現：搔癢丘疹與皮膚隧道（細灰紅色線狀）。
  • Permethrin: apply to cool, dry skin at least 30 min after bath, over all skin surfaces, head to soles per this chapter (scabicides in general: neck down, not face; follow product label), leave 8-14 hours, then wash off; repeat if needed.Permethrin：於沐浴後至少 30 分鐘、皮膚涼且乾時塗抹，全身皮膚（非僅皮疹處；本章述及頭至腳底，一般殺疥劑為頸部以下、避開臉，依產品說明）塗抹，停留 8–14 小時後洗去；必要時重複。
  • Treat all household members and contacts simultaneously.所有同住者與接觸者須同時治療。
  • Change and hot-wash linens daily for at least 1 week; seal nonwashables in bags at least 4 days.每日更換並熱水清洗寢具至少 1 週；不可洗物品密封至少 4 天。
PDF p.440, 441

Burn injuries in children兒童燒傷

  • Thinner skin: lower temperature and shorter exposure cause deeper burns; higher mortality in very young children.皮膚較薄：較低溫度與較短時間即可造成深度燒傷；幼童死亡率較高。
  • Greater risk of fluid and heat loss, dehydration, metabolic acidosis, protein-calorie deficiency, infection, severe scarring, body image problems and growth delay.較易發生水分與熱量散失、脫水、代謝性酸中毒、蛋白質熱量不足、感染、嚴重疤痕、身體心像問題與生長遲緩。
  • Do not use the rule of nines; use age-related charts (Lund-Browder type, Fig 30.3) for %TBSA.勿用九分法；以依年齡之圖表（圖 30.3）估算燒傷面積百分比。
  • Burns >10% TBSA need fluid resuscitation during the first 24 hours; crystalloids first, colloids to maintain volume.燒傷 >10% TBSA 需於前 24 小時液體復甦；先給晶體液，膠體液維持血容量。
  • Adequacy of resuscitation: heart rate, urine output, capillary refill, sensorium.復甦是否足夠：心跳、尿量、微血管再充填、意識狀態。
  • First aid: stop burning, check airway, CAB if needed, remove burned clothing not stuck, cool (not cold) running water, cover clean, keep warm, call EMS.急救：停止燒灼、確認呼吸道、必要時 CAB、移除未黏著衣物、以涼（非冰）流水沖、乾淨布覆蓋、保暖、呼叫 EMS。
PDF p.441, 442

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Monitor any child with a skin disorder for local skin infection and systemic infection.皮膚疾病孩童須監測局部皮膚感染與全身感染。 PDF p.439
  2. Best indicators of burn fluid resuscitation adequacy: HR, urine output, capillary refill, sensorium.評估燒傷液體復甦是否足夠：心跳、尿量、微血管再充填、意識。 PDF p.441, 443
  3. Burns >10% TBSA in a child require fluid resuscitation.兒童燒傷 >10% TBSA 需液體復甦。 PDF p.441
  4. Use age-specific charts, not rule of nines, for pediatric burns.兒童燒傷使用年齡別圖表，不用九分法。 PDF p.441, 442
  5. Lindane shampoo is contraindicated under 2 years (CNS toxicity, seizures).林丹洗髮精 2 歲以下禁用（中樞神經毒性、癲癇）。 PDF p.440, 444
  6. Scabies = burrows (fine grayish-red lines); impetigo = honey-colored crusts; nits = white sacs stuck to hair shaft.疥瘡＝隧道（灰紅細線）；膿痂疹＝蜜黃色痂；蝨卵＝黏在髮幹的白色小囊。 PDF p.440, 443
  7. Permethrin goes on all skin surfaces, not just the rash, for 8-14 hours on cool dry skin 30+ minutes after bathing.Permethrin 塗全身皮膚（非僅皮疹）、停留 8–14 小時，須於沐浴 30 分鐘後在涼乾皮膚上使用。 PDF p.440, 443
  8. Treat all household contacts of scabies at the same time.疥瘡的所有同住接觸者須同時治療。 PDF p.440
  9. Impetigo is contagious for 24 hours after antibiotic start; complete the antibiotic course to prevent glomerulonephritis.膿痂疹開始抗生素後 24 小時內仍有傳染性；須完成療程以防腎絲球腎炎。 PDF p.439
  10. Topical steroid: thin layer, rubbed in, on affected skin only; apply topical medication within 3 minutes of bath.外用類固醇：只塗患處、薄層並推開；沐浴後 3 分鐘內塗藥。 PDF p.438, 444
  11. Fire/burn first aid: cool (not cold) water, remove clothing not stuck, cover clean, keep child warm.燒燙傷急救：涼（非冰）水、移除未黏衣物、乾淨覆蓋、保暖。 PDF p.441

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Eczema triggers to avoid: latex, wool, heat, wet diapers, harsh detergents.濕疹誘因：乳膠、羊毛、高溫、濕尿布、刺激性洗劑。 PDF p.438

31 Hematological Problems血液問題

Pediatric blood disorders: sickle cell anemia, hemophilia, von Willebrand disease, beta-thalassemia major, iron-deficiency anemia and aplastic anemia. Key themes are perfusion, bleeding safety, hydration and transfusion complications.小兒血液疾病：鐮狀細胞貧血、血友病、類血友病（von Willebrand 病）、重型 β 型地中海型貧血、缺鐵性貧血與再生不良性貧血。重點為組織灌流、出血安全、水分補充與輸血併發症。

Sickle cell anemia: pathophysiology鐮狀細胞貧血：病理

  • Hemoglobinopathy: hemoglobin S replaces HbA; autosomal inheritance, higher risk with heterozygous parents or African American descent.血紅素病：HbS 取代 HbA；父母為異型合子或非裔美國人風險較高。
  • Screening Sickledex (finger stick, 3 minutes); a positive result needs Hgb electrophoresis to tell trait from disease.篩檢用 Sickledex（指尖血、3 分鐘）；陽性需血紅素電泳區分帶因者與疾病。
  • Low oxygen makes cells rigid and sickled, clumping and blocking capillaries; sickling is reversible with oxygen and hydration at first.缺氧使紅血球僵硬呈鐮狀並聚集阻塞微血管；早期補氧與補水可逆。
  • Triggers: fever, dehydration, hypoxia, infection, trauma, emotional or physical stress.誘因：發燒、脫水、缺氧、感染、外傷、情緒或身體壓力。
PDF p.446

Sickle cell crises鐮狀細胞危象

  • Vaso-occlusive: ischemia and infarction; fever, painful swelling of hands/feet/joints, abdominal pain.血管阻塞型：缺血梗塞；發燒、手足關節疼痛腫脹、腹痛。
  • Splenic sequestration: blood pools in spleen; profound anemia, hypovolemia, shock.脾臟滯留型：血液積聚於脾臟；嚴重貧血、低血容、休克。
  • Hyperhemolytic: rapid RBC destruction; anemia, jaundice, reticulocytosis.溶血型：紅血球快速破壞；貧血、黃疸、網狀紅血球增多。
  • Aplastic: decreased production (viral infection, folic acid depletion); profound anemia and pallor.再生不良型：造血減少（病毒感染、葉酸缺乏）；嚴重貧血蒼白。
  • Complications seen in Fig 31.1: dactylitis, stroke, acute chest syndrome, priapism, gallstones, avascular necrosis, autosplenectomy.圖 31.1 併發症：指趾炎、中風、急性胸症候群、陰莖異常勃起、膽結石、缺血性壞死、自體脾切除。
PDF p.447

Sickle cell care鐮狀細胞照護

  • Hydration orally and IV (1.5-2 times maintenance); without it pain is not controlled.口服與靜脈補液（維持量 1.5–2 倍）；水分不足疼痛無法控制。
  • Oxygen, transfusions/exchange transfusion, around-the-clock analgesics; avoid meperidine (normeperidine seizures).氧氣、輸血/換血、定時止痛；避免 meperidine（代謝物 normeperidine 致癲癇）。
  • Position extremities extended, HOB no more than 30 degrees, do not raise knee gatch, avoid joint strain; bed rest.四肢伸直擺位，床頭不超過 30 度，勿抬膝部，避免關節受壓；臥床休息。
  • High-calorie, high-protein diet with folic acid; hydroxyurea reduces sickling and vaso-occlusive events.高熱量高蛋白飲食加葉酸；hydroxyurea 減少鐮狀化與血管阻塞事件。
  • Antibiotics for infection; pneumococcal, meningococcal and annual influenza vaccines (functional asplenia); splenectomy for recurrent sequestration.抗生素治療感染；接種肺炎鏈球菌、腦膜炎雙球菌與每年流感疫苗（功能性無脾）；反覆脾臟滯留可能切脾。
  • Monitor for shock, worsening anemia, poor perfusion; teach early crisis signs and genetic counseling.監測休克、貧血惡化、灌流不良；教導早期危象徵象與遺傳諮詢。
PDF p.446, 447

Hemophilia血友病

  • Missing clotting factor: factor VIII (hemophilia A) or IX (B, Christmas disease); X-linked recessive, carrier mothers pass to sons.凝血因子缺乏：第 VIII 因子（A 型）或第 IX 因子（B 型）；X 染色體隱性，帶因母親傳給兒子。
  • Signs: bleeding after trauma/surgery/circumcision, epistaxis, easy bruising, hemarthrosis (joint pain, swelling, limited motion).表現：外傷/手術/割包皮後出血、流鼻血、易瘀青、關節積血（疼痛腫脹活動受限）。
  • Platelet function tests normal; PTT prolonged.血小板功能檢查正常；PTT 延長。
  • Treat with replacement factor (recombinant or pooled plasma); DDAVP raises factor VIII in mild disease.以替代凝血因子治療（重組或血漿來源）；DDAVP 可提高輕度患者因子 VIII。
  • Joint bleed: immobilize, elevate, ice; superficial bleed: pressure 15 minutes; watch neuro status for intracranial hemorrhage and hematuria.關節出血：固定、抬高、冰敷；表淺出血：加壓 15 分鐘；監測神經狀態（顱內出血）與血尿。
  • Avoid contact sports; swimming is safe; helmets and pads; MedicAlert bracelet.避免接觸性運動；游泳安全；戴頭盔護具；配戴醫療警示手環。
PDF p.447, 448

Von Willebrand disease類血友病（von Willebrand 病）

  • Hereditary deficiency/defect of von Willebrand factor, which helps platelets adhere and carries factor VIII.遺傳性 von Willebrand 因子缺乏或缺陷；此因子協助血小板黏附並攜帶因子 VIII。
  • Mucous membrane bleeding: epistaxis, gum bleeding, easy bruising, heavy menses.黏膜出血：流鼻血、牙齦出血、易瘀青、經血過多。
  • Management similar to hemophilia, including clotting factors; emotional support; MedicAlert.處置類似血友病，包括補充凝血因子；情緒支持；醫療警示手環。
PDF p.448

Beta-thalassemia major重型 β 型地中海型貧血

  • Autosomal recessive, both parents carriers; common in Mediterranean descent; also called Cooley anemia.體染色體隱性，雙親皆為帶因者；地中海後裔多見；又稱 Cooley 貧血。
  • Findings: frontal bossing, maxillary prominence, wide-set eyes, greenish-yellow skin, hepatosplenomegaly, severe microcytic hypochromic anemia.表現：額頭突出、上顎突出、眼距寬、膚色黃綠、肝脾腫大、嚴重小球低色素貧血。
  • Lifelong transfusions; bone marrow transplant possible; splenectomy for severe splenomegaly.終身輸血；可考慮骨髓移植；嚴重脾腫大可切脾。
  • Iron overload (hemosiderosis): chelation with deferasirox or deferoxamine.鐵過量（含鐵血黃素沉積）：以 deferasirox 或 deferoxamine 排鐵。
  • After splenectomy report infection (sepsis risk); give pneumococcal, meningococcal, annual flu vaccines; genetic counseling.切脾後有感染應回報（敗血症風險）；接種肺炎鏈球菌、腦膜炎雙球菌與每年流感疫苗；遺傳諮詢。
PDF p.448, 449

Iron-deficiency and aplastic anemia缺鐵性與再生不良性貧血

  • Iron stores depleted; RBCs microcytic and hypochromic; Hgb low, RBC count low.鐵儲存耗盡；紅血球小球低色素；血紅素與紅血球數降低。
  • Risk: cow's milk over 24 oz/day and poor iron-rich diet.風險：每日牛奶超過 24 盎司與富鐵食物攝取不足。
  • Give iron between meals, not with milk; liquid iron through a straw or dropper at back of mouth; brush teeth afterward (stains).鐵劑於兩餐之間服用，不與牛奶併服；液態鐵用吸管或滴管置於口腔後方；服後刷牙（會染齒）。
  • Aplastic anemia: marrow failure with pancytopenia (low RBC, WBC, platelets).再生不良性貧血：骨髓衰竭致全血球減少（紅血球、白血球、血小板皆低）。
PDF p.449

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Sickle crisis: hydrate, oxygenate, treat pain; never restrict fluids; avoid meperidine.鐮狀危象：補水、給氧、止痛；勿限水；避免 meperidine。 PDF p.446, 447, 451
  2. Hemophilia: PTT prolonged, platelets/Hgb/Hct normal.血友病：PTT 延長，血小板、Hgb、Hct 正常。 PDF p.448, 450
  3. Hemophilia A joint/bleed after injury: give IV factor VIII; ice, elevate, immobilize.血友病 A 受傷：靜脈給予第 VIII 因子；冰敷、抬高、固定。 PDF p.448, 451
  4. Pressure for at least 15 minutes on superficial bleeding in hemophilia.血友病表淺出血至少加壓 15 分鐘。 PDF p.448
  5. Safe sport for hemophilia: swimming; avoid contact sports like soccer, football, hockey.血友病安全運動：游泳；避免足球等接觸運動。 PDF p.448, 450
  6. Sickle crisis position: extremities extended, HOB max 30 degrees, no knee gatch elevation.鐮狀危象擺位：四肢伸直，床頭最多 30 度，勿抬膝。 PDF p.446
  7. Deferoxamine (defer- = remove iron) treats iron overload from thalassemia transfusions.Deferoxamine（defer＝移除鐵）用於地中海型貧血輸血後鐵過量。 PDF p.449, 451
  8. Splenic sequestration = profound anemia, hypovolemia, shock: emergency.脾臟滯留＝嚴重貧血、低血容、休克：緊急。 PDF p.447
  9. Vaccinate asplenic or splenectomized children: pneumococcal, meningococcal, annual flu.無脾或切脾兒童須接種肺炎鏈球菌、腦膜炎雙球菌、年度流感疫苗。 PDF p.447, 449
  10. Oral liquid iron: straw, between meals, no milk, brush teeth.口服液態鐵：吸管、兩餐間、不配牛奶、服後刷牙。 PDF p.449, 451
