  11. Sickling triggers: fever, dehydration, hypoxia, stress, infection. Fluid overload is not a trigger.鐮狀化誘因：發燒、脫水、缺氧、壓力、感染；液體過量不是誘因。 PDF p.446, 451
  12. Von Willebrand: mucosal bleeding, heavy menses; treat like hemophilia.von Willebrand 病：黏膜出血、月經過多；處置如血友病。 PDF p.448

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Sickle crisis types (V-S-H-A): Vaso-occlusive, Sequestration, Hyperhemolytic, Aplastic.鐮狀危象四型（V-S-H-A）：血管阻塞、脾滯留、溶血、再生不良。 PDF p.447
  • Defer- drugs remove iron (deferoxamine, deferasirox).Defer- 開頭藥物移除鐵（deferoxamine、deferasirox）。 PDF p.449

32 Oncological Problems腫瘤問題

Childhood cancers: leukemia, Hodgkin disease, Wilms tumor, neuroblastoma, osteosarcoma and brain tumors. Key nursing themes are infection and bleeding protection during chemotherapy, ICP monitoring, and tumor-specific precautions such as not palpating a Wilms tumor.兒童癌症：白血病、何杰金氏病、威爾姆氏瘤、神經母細胞瘤、骨肉瘤與腦瘤。護理重點為化療期間防感染與防出血、顱內壓監測，以及各腫瘤特殊注意事項（如威爾姆氏瘤不可觸診腹部）。

Leukemia: description and assessment白血病：說明與評估

  • Malignant overproduction of immature WBCs (blasts) in bone marrow causing anemia, neutropenia (infection) and thrombocytopenia (bleeding). ALL is the most common childhood cancer.骨髓中未成熟白血球（blast）惡性增生，造成貧血、嗜中性球低下（感染）與血小板低下（出血）。ALL 為兒童最常見癌症。
  • Chemotherapy phases: induction (remission), intensification/consolidation, CNS prophylaxis, maintenance.化療階段：誘導（緩解）、強化/鞏固、中樞神經預防、維持。
  • Signs: fever, pallor, fatigue, anorexia, petechiae, bone/joint pain, pathological fractures, hepatosplenomegaly, lymphadenopathy.徵象：發燒、蒼白、疲倦、厭食、瘀點、骨關節痛、病理性骨折、肝脾腫大、淋巴結腫大。
  • WBC may be low, normal or high; Hgb/Hct and platelets decreased.白血球可低、正常或高；Hgb/Hct 與血小板下降。
  • Bone marrow biopsy with blasts confirms; lumbar puncture detects CNS disease (signs of increased ICP, cranial nerve VII).骨髓切片見 blast 確診；腰椎穿刺偵測中樞神經侵犯（顱內壓上升徵象、第 VII 對腦神經）。
PDF p.454

Protecting from infection, bleeding; chemotherapy care防感染、防出血與化療照護

  • Infection: protective isolation, private room (HEPA), strict asepsis, masks, no raw fruits/vegetables, no fresh flowers or standing water, daily antimicrobial bath, frequent oral care.感染防護：保護性隔離、單人房（HEPA）、嚴格無菌技術、戴口罩、不吃生鮮蔬果、禁鮮花與積水、每日抗菌洗澡、常口腔護理。
  • Avoid injections, rectal temperatures, catheterization; give G-CSF; no live-virus vaccines or varicella vaccine; inactivated polio ok.避免注射、肛溫、導尿；給予 G-CSF；不可打活性病毒疫苗與水痘疫苗；可打不活化小兒麻痺疫苗。
  • Neutropenic fever: obtain cultures and CBC with differential, then start antibiotics.嗜中性球低下發燒：先採檢體培養與 CBC 分類，再給抗生素。
  • Bleeding: platelet transfusion for active bleeding unresponsive to local care; soft toothbrush, no floss, no NSAIDs/aspirin, no rectal meds, firm pressure 10 minutes after needlestick, measure abdominal girth.出血防護：活動性出血且局部處理無效才輸血小板；軟毛牙刷、不用牙線、禁 NSAID/阿斯匹靈、禁肛門給藥、針刺後加壓至少 10 分鐘、量腹圍。
  • Chemo: watch nadir, nausea/vomiting (antiemetics before, during, after), constipation (stool softeners), mucositis, hemorrhagic cystitis, peripheral neuropathy; hair regrows in 3-6 months.化療：留意最低點（nadir）、噁心嘔吐（化療前中後給止吐藥）、便祕（軟便劑）、黏膜炎、出血性膀胱炎、周邊神經病變；毛髮 3–6 個月再生。
  • Small, soft, non-irritating meals; cluster care to conserve energy.少量、軟、無刺激飲食；集中護理節省體力。
PDF p.454, 455, 456

Increased ICP and Hodgkin disease顱內壓上升與何杰金氏病

  • Infant ICP signs: bulging fontanel, split sutures, Macewen sign, high-pitched cry, setting-sun eyes; older child: headache, forceful vomiting, diplopia, seizures.嬰兒顱內壓徵象：囪門膨出、縫線分離、Macewen 徵象、高頻哭聲、落日眼；較大兒童：頭痛、噴射嘔吐、複視、癲癇。
  • Late ICP signs: bradycardia, pupil changes, posturing, Cheyne-Stokes, papilledema, coma.顱內壓晚期徵象：心搏過緩、瞳孔改變、去大腦/去皮質姿勢、Cheyne-Stokes 呼吸、視乳突水腫、昏迷。
  • Hodgkin: lymph node malignancy with Reed-Sternberg cells; peak mid-adolescence; excellent prognosis.何杰金氏病：淋巴結惡性腫瘤，可見 Reed-Sternberg 細胞；高峰在青春中期；預後佳。
  • Painless firm movable cervical/supraclavicular nodes, nonproductive cough, fever, night sweats, weight loss, pruritus; biopsy confirms.無痛、硬、可移動的頸部/鎖骨上淋巴結、乾咳、發燒、盜汗、體重減輕、搔癢；切片確診。
  • Treat with chemo +/- radiation; Table 32.1 lists radiation effects (anorexia, mucositis, alopecia, skin desquamation, cystitis, myelosuppression).以化療加/不加放療；表 32.1 列放療副作用（厭食、黏膜炎、掉髮、皮膚脫屑、膀胱炎、骨髓抑制）。
PDF p.455, 456, 457, 458

Wilms tumor and neuroblastoma威爾姆氏瘤與神經母細胞瘤

  • Wilms: most common childhood kidney/intra-abdominal tumor, peak age 3; firm, nontender, one-sided flank mass, hematuria, hypertension (renin), anemia, fever.威爾姆氏瘤：兒童最常見腎臟/腹內腫瘤，高峰 3 歲；單側側腹硬、無痛腫塊、血尿、高血壓（腎素）、貧血、發燒。
  • Do NOT palpate the abdomen (risk of tumor rupture and spread); post sign; measure girth daily; handle gently. Treatment: nephrectomy plus chemo +/- radiation.勿觸診腹部（腫瘤破裂擴散風險）；床邊放警示牌；每日量腹圍；輕柔搬動。治療：腎切除加化療 ± 放療。
  • Post-op Wilms: monitor BP, temperature, hemorrhage, infection, I&O, bowel sounds/obstruction.威爾姆氏瘤術後：監測血壓、體溫、出血、感染、輸出入量、腸音/腸阻塞。
  • Neuroblastoma: neural crest tumor of adrenal medulla/sympathetic chain; diagnosed late with metastasis; urine VMA, HVA, dopamine, norepinephrine elevated.神經母細胞瘤：源自腎上腺髓質/交感神經鏈的神經嵴腫瘤；多診斷時已轉移；尿 VMA、HVA、多巴胺、正腎上腺素升高。
  • Firm irregular abdominal mass crossing midline, bone pain, periorbital ecchymosis/exophthalmos, cord compression paralysis; younger age gives better survival.堅硬不規則腹部腫塊且越過中線、骨痛、眼眶周圍瘀斑/突眼、脊髓壓迫麻痺；診斷年齡越小存活越好。
PDF p.457, 458, 459

Osteosarcoma骨肉瘤

  • Most common bone cancer in children, peak age 13-16, metaphysis of long bones, often femur.兒童最常見骨癌，高峰 13–16 歲，長骨幹骺端，多在股骨。
  • Localized pain (often relieved by flexion), mass, limp, limited ROM, pathological fracture; early mistaken for growing pains.局部疼痛（屈曲時緩解）、腫塊、跛行、活動受限、病理性骨折；早期常誤為生長痛。
  • Treatment: chemo plus limb-salvage surgery or amputation; prosthesis fitting; teach phantom limb pain (tingling, itching, pain).治療：化療加保肢手術或截肢；義肢配置；教導幻肢痛（刺麻、癢、痛）。
  • Support body image; communicate honestly.支持身體心像；誠實溝通。
PDF p.459

Brain tumors and craniotomy care腦瘤與開顱術照護

  • Infratentorial (posterior, cerebellum/brainstem) tumors are most common in children; supratentorial in cerebrum; MRI is the main diagnostic.幕下（後方，小腦/腦幹）腫瘤在兒童最常見；幕上位於大腦；MRI 為主要診斷。
  • Signs: morning headache improving through the day, vomiting unrelated to feeding, ataxia, seizures, behavior change, diplopia, facial weakness.徵象：晨起頭痛白天緩解、與進食無關的嘔吐、共濟失調、癲癇、行為改變、複視、顏面無力。
  • Preop: neuro checks at least every 4 hours, seizure precautions, nutrition assessment, prepare child for large head dressing.術前：至少每 4 小時神經評估、癲癇防護、營養評估、告知術後會有大頭部敷料。
  • Postop: neuro and pupil checks, temperature (cooling blanket), meningitis signs, ICP signs, hemorrhage (check back of dressing), prevent vomiting, quiet environment.術後：神經與瞳孔檢查、體溫（備降溫毯）、腦膜炎徵象、顱內壓徵象、出血（檢查敷料後方）、預防嘔吐、安靜環境。
  • Clear/colorless drainage = CSF (glucose positive on dipstick): report immediately.無色引流液＝腦脊髓液（試紙測葡萄糖陽性）：立即通報。
  • Positioning: never Trendelenburg; supratentorial: head elevated; infratentorial: flat or on side; after large tumor removal avoid operative side.擺位：絕不採頭低腳高；幕上手術抬高頭部；幕下手術平躺或側臥；大型腫瘤切除後避免壓術側。
PDF p.459, 460

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Colorless drainage on a craniotomy dressing is CSF: notify the surgeon immediately.開顱術後敷料無色滲液＝腦脊髓液：立即通知外科醫師。 PDF p.460, 462
  2. Do not palpate the abdomen in suspected Wilms tumor.疑似威爾姆氏瘤不可觸診腹部。 PDF p.458, 460, 462
  3. Never place a post-craniotomy child in Trendelenburg or supine; it raises ICP.開顱術後絕不採頭低腳高或平躺；會增加顱內壓。 PDF p.460, 462
  4. Bone marrow biopsy with blasts confirms leukemia; Reed-Sternberg cells confirm Hodgkin.骨髓見 blast 確診白血病；Reed-Sternberg 細胞確診何杰金氏病。 PDF p.454, 457, 463
  5. Platelets below 50,000 call for bleeding precautions (example 19,500 mm3).血小板低於 50,000 需出血防護（例：19,500 mm3）。 PDF p.461, 462
  6. No fresh flowers, plants or standing water for neutropenic children (Aspergillus, Pseudomonas).嗜中性球低下兒童禁鮮花、植物與積水（麴菌、綠膿桿菌）。 PDF p.455, 463
  7. Neutropenic fever: cultures and CBC with differential first, then antibiotics.嗜中性球低下發燒：先採培養與 CBC 分類，再給抗生素。 PDF p.455
  8. No live virus vaccines for immunosuppressed child; inactivated polio acceptable.免疫抑制兒童禁打活性病毒疫苗；不活化小兒麻痺可。 PDF p.455
  9. Vomiting is an early ICP sign in a child whose fontanels are closed; infants show bulging fontanel.囪門已閉的兒童嘔吐是顱內壓上升早期徵象；嬰兒則見囪門膨出。 PDF p.455, 462
  10. Urine VMA elevation suggests neuroblastoma.尿 VMA 升高提示神經母細胞瘤。 PDF p.458, 463
  11. Avoid aspirin/NSAIDs, rectal temperatures, enemas, suppositories, injections in thrombocytopenic child.血小板低下兒童避免阿斯匹靈/NSAID、肛溫、灌腸、塞劑、注射。 PDF p.456
  12. Osteosarcoma pain often dismissed as growing pains; femur most common.骨肉瘤疼痛常被誤認為生長痛；股骨最常見。 PDF p.459

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Wilms = Won't palpate.Wilms 腫瘤＝「不要摸」（Won't palpate）。 PDF p.458
  • ICP early vs late: vomiting, headache early; bradycardia, posturing late (Cushing-type).顱內壓早期：嘔吐、頭痛；晚期：心搏過緩、姿勢異常。 PDF p.455

33 Metabolic and Endocrine Problems代謝與內分泌問題

Pediatric fever, dehydration, phenylketonuria, childhood obesity and diabetes mellitus (hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia, sick-day rules, DKA). High-yield numbers include glucose cutoffs, PKU phenylalanine levels and dehydration signs.小兒發燒、脫水、苯酮尿症、兒童肥胖與糖尿病（低血糖、高血糖、生病日原則、酮酸中毒）。高頻數值包括血糖切點、PKU 苯丙胺酸濃度與脫水徵象。

Fever發燒

  • Fever is 38.0 C (100.4 F) or higher; normal about 36.4-37.0 C. Fever in an infant under 1 month is an emergency: call the provider immediately.發燒定義為 ≥38.0°C（100.4°F）；正常約 36.4–37.0°C。未滿 1 個月嬰兒發燒屬緊急，須立即聯絡醫師。
  • Signs: flushed warm skin, diaphoresis, chills, restlessness or lethargy.徵象：皮膚潮紅溫熱、出汗、寒顫、躁動或嗜睡。
  • Remove excess clothing/blankets, cool room, circulate air; acetaminophen, or ibuprofen if older than 6 months; no aspirin (Reye syndrome).脫去多餘衣被、降低室溫、增加通風；給予乙醯胺酚，或 6 個月以上給 ibuprofen；禁用阿斯匹靈（雷氏症候群）。
  • Recheck temperature 30-60 minutes after antipyretic; encourage fluids; avoid cold sponge baths (shivering).退燒藥後 30–60 分鐘再測體溫；鼓勵飲水；避免冷水擦浴（引發顫抖）。
PDF p.465

Dehydration脫水

  • Infants/children are vulnerable: immature kidneys and more body water in extracellular fluid.嬰幼兒易脫水：腎臟未成熟且細胞外液比例較高。
  • Table 33.1: mild 3-5% (infant) weight loss; moderate 6-9%; severe 10% or more. Severe: very fast pulse, hyperpnea, lethargy, absent tears, sunken fontanel, capillary refill over 4 sec, oliguria/anuria.表 33.1：輕度體重減少 3–5%（嬰兒）；中度 6–9%；重度 ≥10%。重度：脈搏很快、深快呼吸、嗜睡、無淚、囪門凹陷、微血管再充填 >4 秒、少尿/無尿。
  • Monitor weight, I&O, urine specific gravity, LOC, skin turgor, mucous membranes.監測體重、輸出入量、尿比重、意識、皮膚彈性、黏膜。
  • Mild-moderate: oral rehydration (Pedialyte); avoid carbonated drinks and apple juice. Severe: NPO and IV fluids.輕中度：口服電解質液（如 Pedialyte）；避免碳酸飲料與蘋果汁。重度：禁食並靜脈輸液。
  • Before IV potassium confirm the child has voided and has adequate renal function.給靜脈鉀前確認已排尿且腎功能足夠。
PDF p.465, 466

Phenylketonuria (PKU)苯酮尿症

  • Autosomal recessive; phenylalanine toxic to CNS. PKU: phenylalanine above 20 mg/dL; normal 0-2 mg/dL.體染色體隱性；苯丙胺酸對中樞神經有毒性。PKU：苯丙胺酸 >20 mg/dL；正常 0–2 mg/dL。
  • Signs: vomiting, seizures, musty urine odor, intellectual disability; older: eczema, hypertonia, hypopigmentation, hyperactivity.徵象：嘔吐、癲癇、尿液霉味、智能障礙；較大：濕疹、肌張力高、毛髮皮膚虹膜色素減退、過動。
  • Newborn screening after feeding begun; rescreen by 14 days if first test before 24 hours old.新生兒篩檢須已開始餵奶；若 24 小時內採檢，14 天內再篩。
  • Restrict phenylalanine: meats, dairy, aspartame; use special formula; allowed cereals, pasta, rice, fruits, vegetables; follow-up and social support.限制苯丙胺酸：肉類、乳製品、阿斯巴甜；使用特殊配方奶；可吃穀類、麵、飯、蔬果；定期追蹤與社會資源。
PDF p.466, 467

Childhood obesity兒童肥胖

  • Use BMI percentile for ages 2-20: overweight 85th to under 95th; obese above 95th; severe obesity 120% of 95th percentile or BMI 35 or more.2–20 歲使用 BMI 百分位：過重 85th 至 <95th；肥胖 >95th；重度肥胖為 95th 的 120% 或 BMI ≥35。
  • Consequences: asthma, sleep apnea, joint problems, type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia, heart disease, adult obesity.後果：氣喘、睡眠呼吸中止、關節問題、第二型糖尿病、高血脂、心臟病、成年肥胖。
  • Box 33.1: water instead of sugary drinks, more fruits/vegetables, 60 minutes activity daily, screen time limited to 60 minutes.框 33.1：以水取代含糖飲料、多吃蔬果、每日活動 60 分鐘、螢幕時間限 60 分鐘。
PDF p.467, 468

Diabetes mellitus: basics, diet, exercise糖尿病：基礎、飲食、運動

  • Type 1: beta-cell destruction and absolute insulin deficiency. Type 2: insulin resistance; overweight is the top childhood risk.第一型：胰島 beta 細胞破壞，絕對缺乏胰島素。第二型：胰島素阻抗；過重為最大危險因子。
  • Signs: polyuria, polydipsia, polyphagia, weight loss, fatigue, enuresis in toilet-trained child, vaginal candidiasis, fruity breath, blurred vision, slow healing. DKA can be first presentation.徵象：多尿、多渴、多食、體重減輕、疲倦、已訓練如廁者遺尿、陰道念珠菌感染、水果味呼吸、視力模糊、傷口難癒。DKA 可能是首次表現。
  • Diet: three meals plus midafternoon and bedtime snacks, consistent carbohydrate; fat 30% or less; carry glucose tablets.飲食：三餐加下午與睡前點心，碳水穩定；脂肪 ≤30%；隨身攜帶葡萄糖錠。
  • Exercise: 10-15 g extra carbohydrate per 30-45 minutes of activity; check glucose before and after.運動：每 30–45 分鐘活動加 10–15 g 碳水；運動前後測血糖。
  • Long-term: growth failure, neuropathy, retinal and renal microvascular disease, cardiovascular disease.長期併發症：生長遲緩、神經病變、視網膜與腎微血管病變、心血管疾病。
PDF p.467, 468, 469

Insulin and monitoring胰島素與監測

  • HbA1c every 3 months (reference under 6%). Never withhold insulin during illness; stress and infection raise insulin need.每 3 個月測 HbA1c（參考值 <6%）。生病時不可停胰島素；感染與壓力使需求增加。
  • Teach hypo/hyperglycemia recognition, glucagon IM/SC for unconscious child, spare insulin, MedicAlert.教導辨識低/高血糖、無法進食者施打 glucagon（IM/SC）、備用胰島素、醫療警示手環。
  • Blood glucose monitoring more accurate than urine; second-voided urine for ketones; test ketones when ill or glucose persistently over 200 mg/dL.血糖監測比尿糖準確；尿酮用第二次排尿；生病或血糖持續 >200 mg/dL 時驗尿酮。
  • Less painful finger sticks: warm finger, side of the pad, ring finger or thumb, light lancet pressure.減輕採血疼痛：先溫手、取指腹側邊、用無名指或拇指、輕壓採血筆。
PDF p.469

Hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia低血糖與高血糖

  • Hypoglycemia: under 70 mg/dL; sweating, tremors, hunger, headache, confusion, slurred speech, perioral tingling.低血糖：<70 mg/dL；出汗、顫抖、飢餓、頭痛、意識混亂、口齒不清、口周麻刺。
  • Treat at once with fast sugar (1/2 cup juice, 2-3 glucose tablets, 1 tsp honey), then complex carbohydrate plus protein; if unconscious, glucose paste on gums, glucagon, IV dextrose in hospital.立即給快速糖（1/2 杯果汁、2–3 顆葡萄糖錠、1 茶匙蜂蜜），再給複合碳水加蛋白質；昏迷則牙齦塗糖膏、glucagon、院內靜脈葡萄糖。
  • Hyperglycemia: over 200 mg/dL; polyuria, polydipsia, blurred vision. Sick-day rules: always give insulin, test glucose every 4 hours, ketones each void, fluids, rest, call provider if vomiting, fruity breath, deep fast breathing, decreased LOC.高血糖：>200 mg/dL；多尿、多渴、視力模糊。生病日原則：照打胰島素、至少每 4 小時測血糖、每次排尿驗酮、多喝水、休息；嘔吐、水果味呼吸、深快呼吸、意識下降須通知醫師。
PDF p.469, 470

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA)糖尿病酮酸中毒

  • Severe insulin deficiency: glucose over 300 mg/dL, positive serum and urine ketones, metabolic acidosis; Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath, lethargy.嚴重胰島素缺乏：血糖 >300 mg/dL、血尿酮陽性、代謝性酸中毒；Kussmaul 呼吸、水果味呼吸、嗜睡。
  • First: restore volume with IV 0.9% or 0.45% saline; then IV regular insulin; dextrose added when glucose falls.首要：以靜脈 0.9% 或 0.45% 生理食鹽水補充血容量；再給靜脈常規胰島素；血糖降低後加葡萄糖。
  • Monitor potassium closely (falls with insulin); give potassium only if child is voiding; watch for fluid overload and cerebral edema; give oxygen as prescribed.密切監測鉀（胰島素使鉀下降）；有排尿才補鉀；留意體液過多與腦水腫；依醫囑給氧。
PDF p.470, 471

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Fever 38.0 C (100.4 F) in an infant under 1 month: emergency.未滿 1 個月嬰兒體溫 38.0°C：緊急。 PDF p.465
  2. Never give aspirin to a febrile child (Reye syndrome).發燒孩童勿給阿斯匹靈（雷氏症候群）。 PDF p.465, 473
  3. PKU: phenylalanine over 20 mg/dL; normal 0-2; avoid aspartame and high-protein foods.PKU：苯丙胺酸 >20 mg/dL；正常 0–2；避免阿斯巴甜與高蛋白食物。 PDF p.466, 467, 472
  4. Hypoglycemia is under 70 mg/dL: give fast carbohydrate immediately, do not delay to recheck.低血糖 <70 mg/dL：立即給快速碳水，勿延遲。 PDF p.469, 473
  5. Do not withhold insulin during illness; test ketones; push fluids.生病時不可停胰島素；驗尿酮；多補水。 PDF p.469, 470, 472
  6. DKA: glucose over 300, ketones, Kussmaul breathing; initial treatment is IV normal saline, not dextrose or potassium.DKA：血糖 >300、酮體、Kussmaul 呼吸；初始治療為靜脈生理食鹽水，非葡萄糖或鉀。 PDF p.470, 472
  7. Before IV potassium check urine output (void, adequate renal function).靜脈給鉀前先確認尿量。 PDF p.466, 472
  8. Fluid deficit resolving: capillary refill under 2 sec, urine output at least 1 mL/kg/hr, adequate tears, specific gravity normal.脫水改善：微血管再充填 <2 秒、尿量 ≥1 mL/kg/hr、有淚、尿比重正常。 PDF p.466, 473
  9. Exercise: extra 10-15 g carbohydrate per 30-45 minutes; do not alter insulin amount or timing without provider.運動：每 30–45 分鐘多補 10–15 g 碳水；勿自行改胰島素劑量或時間。 PDF p.469, 472
  10. NPH insulin is never given IV; regular insulin is IV insulin.NPH 絕不可靜脈注射；靜脈用常規胰島素。 PDF p.470, 472
  11. BMI percentile: overweight 85th-95th, obese above 95th.BMI 百分位：過重 85–95th，肥胖 >95th。 PDF p.467
  12. Ketone testing when ill or glucose persistently over 200 mg/dL; second-voided urine is most accurate.生病或血糖持續 >200 mg/dL 時驗酮；第二次排尿最準確。 PDF p.469

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Hypo = cold, clammy, shaky; Hyper = hot, dry, sweet-smelling (fruity breath).低血糖＝冷汗顫抖；高血糖＝皮膚熱乾、水果味呼吸。 PDF p.470

34 Gastrointestinal Problems腸胃問題

Pediatric GI disorders from vomiting/diarrhea to congenital anomalies (cleft lip/palate, TEF, pyloric stenosis, Hirschsprung, imperforate anus, abdominal wall defects), intussusception, appendicitis, celiac disease, hepatitis, poisonings (lead, acetaminophen, aspirin, corrosives) and parasites.小兒腸胃疾病：嘔吐與腹瀉、先天異常（唇顎裂、食道閉鎖與氣管食道瘻管、幽門狹窄、巨結腸症、肛門閉鎖、腹壁缺損）、腸套疊、闌尾炎、乳糜瀉、肝炎、中毒（鉛、乙醯胺酚、阿斯匹靈、腐蝕劑）與寄生蟲。

Vomiting and diarrhea嘔吐與腹瀉

  • Vomiting risks: dehydration, electrolyte loss, metabolic alkalosis, aspiration. Position on side, monitor I&O, small frequent oral rehydration, antiemetics as ordered.嘔吐風險：脫水、電解質流失、代謝性鹼中毒、吸入。側臥、監測輸出入、少量頻繁口服補液、依醫囑給止吐藥。
  • Projectile vomiting suggests pyloric stenosis or increased ICP; report blood in vomitus, forceful vomiting, abdominal pain.噴射狀嘔吐提示幽門狹窄或顱內壓升高；嘔血、劇烈嘔吐、腹痛須通報。
  • Diarrhea risks: dehydration and metabolic acidosis, especially under 5 years; rotavirus is severe at 3-24 months and nosocomial.腹瀉風險：脫水與代謝性酸中毒，尤其 5 歲以下；輪狀病毒在 3–24 個月最嚴重且可院內感染。
  • Enteric isolation, handwashing, skin care; ORS (Pedialyte) for mild-moderate; avoid carbonated drinks and apple juice; NPO plus IV for severe; give IV potassium only if voiding.腸道隔離、洗手、皮膚護理；輕中度用口服補液鹽（Pedialyte）；避免碳酸飲料與蘋果汁；重度禁食加靜脈輸液；有排尿才給靜脈鉀。
PDF p.475, 476

Cleft lip and palate唇裂與顎裂

  • Failure of tissues to fuse; folic acid before pregnancy lowers risk. Lip repair at 3-6 months; palate repair around 1 year. Risk of otitis media and hearing loss.組織未融合；孕前補葉酸可降低風險。唇裂 3–6 個月修補；顎裂約 1 歲修補。易中耳炎與聽力損失。
  • Feeding: upright, formula to side/back of mouth, small amounts, burp often, special nipples; ESSR (enlarge nipple, stimulate suck, swallow, rest).餵食：直立、奶流向口腔側後方、少量、常拍嗝、特殊奶嘴；ESSR（放大奶嘴、刺激吸吮、吞嚥、休息）。
  • After lip repair: protect suture line, keep clean, back-lying, no prone or on repair side, elbow restraints removed every 1-2 hours.唇裂術後：保護縫線、保持清潔乾燥、仰臥、避免趴或壓術側、肘部約束每 1–2 小時鬆開。
  • After palate repair: nothing hard in mouth (no suction, straws, spoons, pacifiers, tongue depressor, thermometer); watch airway.顎裂術後：口中不放硬物（不抽吸、吸管、湯匙、奶嘴、壓舌板、體溫計）；注意呼吸道。
PDF p.476, 477

Esophageal atresia/TEF and GER食道閉鎖/氣管食道瘻管與胃食道逆流

  • EA/TEF signs: frothy saliva, drooling, the 3 Cs (coughing, choking, cyanosis) with feeding, abdominal distention, respiratory distress.食道閉鎖/瘻管徵象：口鼻泡沫唾液、流口水、餵食時 3C（咳、嗆、發紺）、腹脹、呼吸窘迫。
  • Preop: NPO, upright at least 30 degrees, suction blind pouch, IV fluids, antibiotics. Postop: watch for anastomotic leak, esophagogram before feeds; G-tube feeds around day 5-7.術前：禁食、上半身抬高至少 30 度、抽吸盲袋、靜脈輸液、抗生素。術後：留意吻合處滲漏、進食前做食道攝影；約第 5–7 天經胃造瘻餵食。
  • GER: regurgitation, poor weight gain, irritability, respiratory problems; complications include esophagitis, strictures, FTT, aspiration pneumonia.GER：溢奶、體重增加差、易怒、呼吸問題；併發症有食道炎、狹窄、生長遲滯、吸入性肺炎。
  • Upright 20-30 minutes after feeds (not infant seat); small frequent feedings, thicken with rice cereal, burp often; supine for sleep; PPIs/H2 blockers.餵後直立 20–30 分鐘（避免半臥嬰兒座椅）；少量多餐、可加米糊增稠、常拍嗝；睡眠仰臥；使用 PPI/H2 阻斷劑。
  • Avoid fatty foods, chocolate, tomato, carbonated and citrus drinks, spicy foods, vigorous play after eating.避免油膩、巧克力、番茄、碳酸與柑橘飲料、辛辣食物、餐後劇烈活動。
PDF p.478, 479, 480

Pyloric stenosis, lactose intolerance, celiac disease幽門狹窄、乳糖不耐、乳糜瀉

  • Pyloric stenosis: first weeks of life; projectile non-bilious vomiting after feeds, hungry, visible peristaltic waves, olive-shaped mass; dehydration and metabolic alkalosis.幽門狹窄：出生數週內；餵食後噴射狀非膽汁嘔吐、仍飢餓、可見蠕動波、橄欖狀腫塊；脫水與代謝性鹼中毒。
  • Pyloromyotomy: correct fluids/electrolytes first, NPO, NG decompression; postop small frequent feeds advanced gradually.幽門肌切開術：先矯正水與電解質、禁食、NG 減壓；術後少量頻繁餵食逐步增加。
  • Lactose intolerance: lactase deficiency; bloating, cramps, diarrhea, flatus after dairy; use enzyme tablets, soy formula, hard cheese/yogurt; supplement calcium and vitamin D.乳糖不耐：缺乏乳糖酶；進食乳製品後腹脹、絞痛、腹瀉、排氣；使用酵素錠、豆基配方、硬起司/優格；補充鈣與維生素 D。
  • Celiac disease: gluten (wheat, barley, rye, oats) damages villi; steatorrhea, distention, muscle wasting, anemia; onset 1-5 years.乳糜瀉：麩質（小麥、大麥、裸麥、燕麥）損傷絨毛；脂肪便、腹脹、肌肉萎縮、貧血；1–5 歲發病。
  • Lifelong gluten-free diet (corn, rice, millet allowed) plus iron, folic acid, vitamins A, D, E, K; celiac crisis from fasting, infection or gluten: profuse diarrhea, dehydration, acidosis.終身無麩質飲食（可吃玉米、米、小米）並補充鐵、葉酸、維生素 A、D、E、K；乳糜瀉危象由禁食、感染或麩質誘發：大量水瀉、脫水、酸中毒。
PDF p.480, 481

Appendicitis闌尾炎

  • Pain starts periumbilical then localizes to RLQ at McBurney point; rebound tenderness, rigidity, low-grade fever, anorexia/nausea/vomiting after pain, elevated WBC.疼痛起於臍周後移至右下腹 McBurney 點；反彈痛、僵硬、低燒、疼痛後才厭食噁心嘔吐、白血球升高。
  • Sudden relief of pain followed by worsening suggests perforation and peritonitis (fever, distention, tachycardia, pallor).疼痛突然緩解後又加劇提示穿孔與腹膜炎（發燒、腹脹、心跳快、蒼白）。
  • Preop: NPO, IV fluids, antibiotics, position of comfort, ice if prescribed; NO heat, laxatives or enemas.術前：禁食、靜脈輸液、抗生素、舒適姿勢、依醫囑冰敷；禁熱敷、瀉劑、灌腸。
  • Postop: monitor temperature, incision, drain; right side-lying or low semi-Fowler with legs flexed; NG suction; advance diet when bowel sounds return.術後：監測體溫、傷口、引流；右側臥或低半坐臥並屈膝；NG 抽吸；腸音恢復後漸進飲食。
PDF p.481, 482

Hirschsprung, intussusception, abdominal wall defects, hernia巨結腸症、腸套疊、腹壁缺損、疝氣

  • Hirschsprung: absent ganglion cells; newborn fails to pass meconium, abdominal distention, bile vomiting; later ribbon-like foul stools; enterocolitis is the serious complication (fever, explosive diarrhea). Biopsy diagnoses.巨結腸症：缺乏神經節細胞；新生兒胎便未排、腹脹、膽汁嘔吐；之後絲帶狀惡臭便；腸炎為嚴重併發症（發燒、爆發性水瀉）。切片診斷。
  • Hirschsprung care: no rectal temperatures, measure girth, staged surgery with temporary colostomy; stoma should be red and moist.巨結腸症照護：不量肛溫、量腹圍、分期手術含暫時性結腸造口；造口應紅潤濕潤。
  • Intussusception: colicky pain with knees drawn up, currant-jelly stool, sausage-shaped mass; hydrostatic (air/fluid) reduction if no perforation or shock; normal brown stool means reduction.腸套疊：陣發性絞痛屈膝、果醬樣血便、香腸狀腫塊；無穿孔休克可行水（空氣）壓灌腸整復；排出正常棕色便代表已復位。
  • Omphalocele: covered sac, saline gauze plus plastic wrap, monitor temperature. Gastroschisis: no membrane, lateral to cord, loosely cover with saline pads, surgery within hours, prolonged ileus.臍膨出：有囊膜，生理食鹽水紗布加塑膠膜、監測體溫。腹裂：無膜、位於臍側，生理食鹽水墊鬆覆蓋、數小時內手術、常有長期腸阻塞。
  • Incarcerated hernia (irritable, tender, nonreducible, distended) is an emergency. Hydrocele post-op: ice, scrotal support, no tub bath, no straddle toys 2-4 weeks.嵌頓疝氣（易怒、壓痛、無法復位、腹脹）屬緊急。陰囊水腫術後：冰敷、陰囊托、避免盆浴、2–4 週不騎跨玩具。
PDF p.482, 483, 484, 485

Constipation, IBS, imperforate anus便秘、腸躁症、肛門閉鎖

  • Constipation/encopresis: fiber and fluids, less milk/sugar, enemas to clear impaction (watch hypernatremia, hyperphosphatemia), toilet sitting 5-10 minutes after meals, treatment 3-6 months.便秘/大便失禁：高纖高水分、減少牛奶與糖、灌腸清除糞塊（留意高血鈉、高血磷）、餐後如廁坐 5–10 分鐘、治療 3–6 個月。
  • IBS: diffuse pain, alternating constipation/diarrhea with mucus; reassure, moderate fiber low fat, anticholinergics.腸躁症：瀰漫性腹痛、便祕腹瀉交替含黏液；安撫、中等纖維低脂飲食、抗膽鹼藥。
  • Imperforate anus: no meconium, absent anus, anal membrane or fistula; stool in urine/vagina indicates fistula.肛門閉鎖：無胎便、無肛門、肛膜或瘻管；尿或陰道有糞便代表瘻管。
  • Postop: side-lying prone with hips elevated, or legs suspended; no rectal temperatures; anal dilation only with provider-supplied dilator, 1-2 cm, water-soluble lubricant.術後：側俯臥抬高臀部，或腿懸吊成 90 度；不量肛溫；僅用醫師提供之擴張器、插入 1–2 公分、水溶性潤滑劑。
PDF p.485, 486

Hepatitis肝炎

  • HAV: fecal-oral; vaccine 2 doses from 12 months; enteric precautions at least 1 week after jaundice; may return to school 1 week after jaundice onset.A 肝：糞口傳染；12 個月起接種 2 劑疫苗；黃疸後至少 1 週腸道隔離；黃疸起 1 週後可返校。
  • HBV: mostly perinatal; vaccine before discharge then at 1 and 6 months; HBIG for newborns of HBsAg-positive mothers; can cause cirrhosis and liver cancer.B 肝：多為周產期傳染；出院前接種，之後 1 與 6 個月；母親 HBsAg 陽性新生兒給 HBIG；可致肝硬化與肝癌。
  • HCV parenteral and often chronic; HDV only with HBV; HEV uncommon, no chronic state.C 肝經血液傳染且常慢性化；D 肝僅與 B 肝併發；E 肝罕見且不慢性化。
  • Phases: anicteric prodrome 5-7 days (anorexia, malaise, RUQ pain); icteric phase (jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, pruritus).分期：無黃疸前驅期 5–7 天（厭食、倦怠、右上腹痛）；黃疸期（黃疸、深色尿、灰白便、搔癢）。
  • Handwashing, standard and enteric precautions, bleach 1/4 cup per gallon for diaper surfaces, low-fat diet, caution with medications.洗手、標準與腸道隔離、尿布區以 1/4 杯漂白水兌 1 加侖水消毒、低脂飲食、用藥需謹慎。
PDF p.486, 487

Poisonings and lead中毒與鉛中毒

  • Poisoning first steps: ABCs, stop exposure, identify agent/amount, prevent absorption, call Poison Control.中毒首要：ABC、終止暴露、辨識毒物與量、阻止吸收、聯絡毒物中心。
  • Lead: hand-to-mouth from paint chips/dust/pottery; CNS most affected; screen at 1-2 years; levels under 5 mcg/dL rescreen yearly, 20-44 treatment, 45-69 within 48 hr, 70 or more immediate.鉛：經手口接觸漆片/灰塵/陶器；中樞神經最受影響；1–2 歲篩檢；<5 mcg/dL 每年複查，20–44 治療，45–69 於 48 小時內，≥70 立即處理。
  • Chelation: calcium disodium EDTA, succimer (oral), BAL (peanut oil: contraindicated with peanut allergy, G6PD deficiency, and iron). Ensure urine output first; monitor kidneys.螯合治療：calcium disodium EDTA、succimer（口服）、BAL（花生油製劑：花生過敏、G6PD 缺乏、併用鐵劑者禁用）。先確認尿量；監測腎功能。
  • Acetaminophen toxic at 150 mg/kg or more; stages: GI symptoms, latent 24-36 h, hepatic injury; antidote N-acetylcysteine; charcoal if under 4 hours; do not use charcoal with NAC.乙醯胺酚毒性劑量 ≥150 mg/kg；階段：腸胃症狀、24–36 小時潛伏期、肝損傷；解毒劑 N-acetylcysteine；<4 小時可給活性碳；活性碳不與 NAC 併用。
  • Aspirin: tinnitus, hyperpnea, fever, metabolic acidosis; charcoal, IV fluids, sodium bicarbonate, cooling, dialysis if needed.阿斯匹靈：耳鳴、過度換氣、發燒、代謝性酸中毒；活性碳、靜脈輸液、碳酸氫鈉、降溫、必要時透析。
  • Corrosives: dilute with water/milk (up to 4 oz), do NOT induce vomiting or neutralize.腐蝕劑：以水/牛奶稀釋（最多 4 盎司）、不可催吐、不可中和。
PDF p.487, 488, 489

Intestinal parasites腸道寄生蟲

  • Giardiasis: protozoa in daycare; diarrhea, steatorrhea, cramps, FTT; 3 or more stool samples.梨形鞭毛蟲症：日托常見；腹瀉、脂肪便、絞痛、生長遲滯；需 ≥3 次糞便檢體。
  • Pinworms: intense perianal itching, restless sleep; tape test in morning; flashlight inspection 2-3 hours after sleep.蟯蟲：肛門劇癢、睡眠不安；晨間透明膠帶採檢；入睡後 2–3 小時以手電筒檢查。
  • Treat all family members; repeat medication in 2 weeks; hot-water laundry and meticulous handwashing.全家同時治療；2 週後重複給藥；熱水洗衣並勤洗手。
PDF p.489, 490

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Pyloric stenosis: projectile non-bilious vomiting, olive-shaped mass, metabolic alkalosis.幽門狹窄：噴射狀非膽汁嘔吐、橄欖狀腫塊、代謝性鹼中毒。 PDF p.480
  2. Intussusception: colicky pain, currant jelly stool, sausage-shaped mass; normal brown stool means self-reduction.腸套疊：絞痛、果醬樣便、香腸狀腫塊；排出正常棕色便表示自行復位。 PDF p.483, 484
  3. Appendicitis: never apply heat or give laxatives/enemas; sudden pain relief then worsening means rupture.闌尾炎：禁熱敷、瀉劑、灌腸；疼痛突然緩解後加劇＝破裂。 PDF p.481, 482
  4. Hirschsprung: no rectal temperatures; failure to pass meconium; ribbon-like stools; enterocolitis is serious.巨結腸症：不量肛溫；胎便未排；絲帶狀便；腸炎嚴重。 PDF p.482, 483
  5. Cleft lip repair: back-lying, protect suture line; no prone or repair-side positioning.唇裂修補後：仰臥、保護縫線；避免趴臥或壓術側。 PDF p.477, 490
  6. Palate repair: nothing in the mouth (no straws, spoons, pacifiers, suction).顎裂修補後：口中不放任何物品（吸管、湯匙、奶嘴、抽吸）。 PDF p.477
  7. EA/TEF 3 Cs: coughing, choking, cyanosis with feeds; NPO and upright.EA/TEF 三 C：餵食時咳、嗆、發紺；禁食並抬高上身。 PDF p.478
  8. Gastroschisis: loose saline pads, never wrap tightly around bowel; urgent surgery.腹裂：鬆覆生理食鹽水墊，勿緊包腸管；緊急手術。 PDF p.484
  9. Persistent vomiting leads to metabolic alkalosis; diarrhea leads to metabolic acidosis.持續嘔吐致代謝性鹼中毒；腹瀉致代謝性酸中毒。 PDF p.475, 476
  10. Lead levels: under 5 rescreen; 45-69 manage within 48 h; 70+ immediate; BAL contraindicated in peanut allergy/G6PD.鉛濃度：<5 複查；45–69 於 48 小時內處理；≥70 立即；花生過敏/G6PD 缺乏禁用 BAL。 PDF p.488
  11. Acetaminophen overdose antidote: N-acetylcysteine; toxic dose 150 mg/kg.乙醯胺酚過量解毒劑：N-acetylcysteine；毒性劑量 150 mg/kg。 PDF p.489
  12. Corrosive ingestion: no induced vomiting, no neutralization; dilute with water or milk.腐蝕劑吞食：禁催吐、禁中和；以水或牛奶稀釋。 PDF p.489
  13. Celiac: lifelong avoidance of wheat, barley, rye, oats; corn, rice, millet allowed.乳糜瀉：終身避免小麥、大麥、裸麥、燕麥；可吃玉米、米、小米。 PDF p.481
  14. GER: upright 20-30 min after feeds, thicken with rice cereal, supine for sleep.GER：餵後直立 20–30 分鐘、米糊增稠、睡眠仰臥。 PDF p.479
  15. Pinworm tape test in the morning; treat whole family; repeat in 2 weeks.蟯蟲晨間膠帶法；全家治療；2 週後重複。 PDF p.490

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Hirschsprung = Hold the thermometer (no rectal temps).巨結腸症＝不量肛溫。 PDF p.483
  • Intussusception = currant jelly + sausage + colic.腸套疊＝果醬便＋香腸＋絞痛。 PDF p.483

35 Eye, Ear, and Throat Problems眼耳喉問題

Pediatric strabismus, conjunctivitis, otitis media/externa and myringotomy, tonsillitis with tonsillectomy care, epistaxis and allergic rhinitis. Post-tonsillectomy bleeding recognition and ear/eye medication technique are frequent test points.小兒斜視、結膜炎、中耳炎/外耳炎與鼓膜切開術、扁桃腺炎與扁桃腺切除術照護、流鼻血與過敏性鼻炎。術後出血辨識與耳/眼藥使用技巧為常考重點。

Strabismus斜視

  • Eyes misaligned from extraocular muscle imbalance, congenital defect or poor vision; normal in young infants but not after about 4 months.眼外肌失衡、先天缺陷或視力不佳造成眼位不正；嬰兒早期屬正常，約 4 個月後不應再有。
  • Untreated causes amblyopia (reduced acuity) and permanent vision loss because the brain suppresses the misaligned eye.未治療會造成弱視（視力下降）與永久視力喪失，因大腦抑制偏斜眼。
  • Assess with six cardinal gaze positions, corneal light reflex, cover-uncover test.以六個基本注視方向、角膜光反射、遮蓋-移開測試評估。
  • Signs: crossed eyes, head tilting or closing one eye, impaired depth perception, headaches, diplopia.徵象：眼睛交叉、歪頭或閉一眼、深度知覺受損、頭痛、複視。
  • Treatment: glasses, patching the good eye, surgery if needed, follow-up visits.治療：配戴眼鏡、遮蓋好眼、必要時手術、定期追蹤。
PDF p.495

Conjunctivitis結膜炎

  • Viral, bacterial or allergic; viral and bacterial forms are very contagious. Signs: itching, burning, redness, edema, discharge.病毒、細菌或過敏性；病毒與細菌性傳染力強。徵象：癢、灼熱、紅、水腫、分泌物。
  • Viral resolves in 7-14 days (antivirals only for herpes simplex or varicella zoster); antibiotics do not treat viruses.病毒性 7–14 天自癒（僅單純疱疹或水痘帶狀疱疹用抗病毒藥）；抗生素對病毒無效。
  • Bacterial: topical antibiotic drops/ointment shorten course and spread; allergic: remove allergen, antihistamine drops.細菌性：外用抗生素眼藥水/藥膏縮短病程與傳播；過敏性：去除過敏原、抗組織胺眼藥水。
  • Do not touch dropper tip to eye or lashes; handwashing; no sharing towels; no eye rubbing; discard contact lenses and eye makeup.滴管尖端勿碰眼睛或睫毛；勤洗手；不共用毛巾；不揉眼；丟棄隱形眼鏡與眼妝。
  • Chlamydial conjunctivitis in a child who is not sexually active requires evaluation for sexual abuse.未有性行為孩童出現披衣菌結膜炎，須評估是否遭性侵。
PDF p.495, 496

Otitis media中耳炎

  • Blocked eustachian tube; children's tubes are shorter, wider, straighter. Often follows RSV, influenza or group A strep infections.耳咽管阻塞；兒童耳咽管較短、寬、直。常繼發於 RSV、流感或 A 群鏈球菌感染。
  • Prevention: upright feeding, immunizations, breastfeeding for at least 6 months, avoid smoke and allergens.預防：直立餵食、按時接種、至少哺乳 6 個月、避免菸害與過敏原。
  • Signs: fever, ear pain, irritability, pulling the ear, head rolling, purulent drainage; red, opaque, bulging, immobile tympanic membrane.徵象：發燒、耳痛、易怒、拉耳朵、搖頭、膿性耳漏；鼓膜紅、混濁、膨出、不動。
  • Care: fluids, limit chewing, lie with affected ear down, heat or cold as prescribed, acetaminophen/ibuprofen, complete antibiotics; watchful waiting up to 72 hours may be used in healthy older infants.照護：補充水分、少咀嚼、患耳朝下側臥、依醫囑冷熱敷、乙醯胺酚/ibuprofen、完成抗生素；健康大嬰兒可觀察至 72 小時。
  • Screen for hearing loss; otitis externa (swimmer's ear): pain on pinna/tragus manipulation, topical antibiotics.須篩檢聽力；外耳炎（游泳者耳）：拉動耳廓/耳屏疼痛、外用抗生素。
  • Ear drops: under 3 years pull earlobe down and back; over 3 years pull pinna up and back.滴耳藥：3 歲以下耳垂向下向後拉；3 歲以上耳廓向上向後拉。
PDF p.496, 497

Myringotomy and tympanostomy tubes鼓膜切開與通氣管

  • Incision in tympanic membrane drains fluid; tubes equalize pressure and ventilate.鼓膜切開引流中耳積液；通氣管平衡壓力並通氣。
  • Keep ears dry; earplugs for bathing, shampooing, swimming; no diving or submerging.保持耳朵乾燥；洗澡洗頭游泳戴耳塞；不可潛水或浸入水中。
  • No nose blowing for 7-10 days; analgesics for discomfort.7–10 天內不可擤鼻；疼痛給止痛藥。
  • Tubes fall out in 6-12 months (small white spool-shaped); not an emergency but notify provider.通氣管 6–12 個月自行脫落（白色小捲軸狀）；非緊急但須通知醫師。
PDF p.497

Tonsillitis and adenoiditis扁桃腺炎與腺樣體炎

  • Viral, bacterial (group A strep) or fungal; enlarged tonsils/adenoids cause snoring, mouth breathing, nasal speech, obstructive sleep apnea.病毒、細菌（A 群鏈球菌）或黴菌；扁桃腺/腺樣體腫大造成打鼾、口呼吸、鼻音、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止。
  • Signs: sore throat, bright red tonsils with exudate, dysphagia, fever, bad breath, cough.徵象：喉嚨痛、扁桃腺鮮紅有滲出物、吞嚥困難、發燒、口臭、咳嗽。
  • Preop: check for active infection, bleeding/clotting studies (PT), loose teeth, prepare for sore throat.術前：檢查有無感染、出凝血檢查（PT）、鬆動牙齒、告知術後喉痛。
  • Surgery depends on infections per year and obstructive disturbance.手術依每年感染次數與呼吸阻塞程度決定。
PDF p.497

Post-tonsillectomy care扁桃腺切除術後照護

  • Position prone or side-lying; suction equipment ready but do not suction unless obstruction.採俯臥或側臥；備抽吸設備但除非阻塞勿抽吸。
  • Bleeding signs: frequent swallowing or throat clearing; bright red vomit; turn child to side and notify provider.出血徵象：頻繁吞嚥或清喉嚨；嘔吐鮮紅血；側臥並通知醫師。
  • Avoid coughing, throat clearing, nose blowing; ice collar and analgesics; antiemetics.避免咳嗽、清喉嚨、擤鼻；冰領與止痛；止吐藥。
  • Clear, cool, noncitrus, noncarbonated fluids; avoid red/purple/brown liquids and milk products initially; no straws or sharp objects.給清澈、冰涼、非柑橘、非碳酸飲料；避免紅/紫/棕色液體與初期乳製品；不用吸管或尖銳物。
  • Mild fever, bad breath, ear pain for a few days; report bleeding, persistent earache or fever; normal activity in 1-2 weeks.數日內可有輕微發燒、口臭、耳痛；出血、持續耳痛或發燒須通報；1–2 週恢復活動。
PDF p.497, 498

Epistaxis and allergic rhinitis流鼻血與過敏性鼻炎

  • Epistaxis from trauma, foreign body, nose picking; recurrent/severe bleeding suggests underlying disease.鼻出血來自外傷、異物、挖鼻；反覆或嚴重出血提示潛在疾病。
  • First aid: sit up, lean forward, continuous pressure with thumb and finger at least 10 minutes, ice to bridge, ED if uncontrolled.急救：坐起前傾、拇指食指持續加壓至少 10 分鐘、鼻梁冰敷、無法止血送急診。
  • Allergic rhinitis: itchy watery eyes, clear drainage, dark circles, pale nasal mucosa, cobblestoning; test for allergies, eczema, asthma.過敏性鼻炎：眼癢流淚、清水鼻涕、黑眼圈、鼻黏膜蒼白、鵝卵石樣咽部；評估過敏、濕疹、氣喘。
  • Treat with trigger avoidance, antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids.治療：避開誘發物、抗組織胺、鼻用類固醇。
PDF p.498

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Post-tonsillectomy bright red vomit or frequent swallowing = bleeding: turn to side, notify provider.扁桃腺術後嘔鮮紅血或頻繁吞嚥＝出血：側臥並通知醫師。 PDF p.498, 499
  2. Prone or side-lying after tonsillectomy; avoid suctioning unless obstructed.扁桃腺術後俯臥或側臥；除非阻塞勿抽吸。 PDF p.497, 499
  3. Check PT/clotting studies before tonsillectomy.扁桃腺手術前確認 PT/凝血檢查。 PDF p.497, 499
  4. Avoid red, purple, brown fluids, milk products, straws after tonsillectomy.術後避免紅紫棕色液體、乳製品、吸管。 PDF p.498
  5. Chlamydial conjunctivitis in a child: investigate sexual abuse.孩童披衣菌結膜炎：調查是否性侵。 PDF p.495, 498
  6. Never share towels or washcloths with bacterial conjunctivitis.細菌性結膜炎不可共用毛巾。 PDF p.496, 499
  7. Complete the full antibiotic course for otitis media.中耳炎須吃完整個抗生素療程。 PDF p.496, 499
  8. Ear drops: under 3 years pull lobe down/back; over 3 years pull up/back.滴耳：3 歲以下向下向後；3 歲以上向上向後。 PDF p.497
  9. Strabismus not corrected early leads to amblyopia; treat with patching the good eye.斜視未早期矯正致弱視；遮蓋好眼治療。 PDF p.495
  10. Tympanostomy tubes: keep ears dry, no nose blowing 7-10 days.通氣管：耳朵保持乾燥、7–10 天不擤鼻。 PDF p.497
  11. Epistaxis: sit up, lean forward, pinch 10 minutes; do not lie back.鼻出血：坐起前傾、捏鼻 10 分鐘；勿仰躺。 PDF p.498
  12. Toddlers with strabismus tilt the head or close an eye.斜視幼兒會歪頭或閉一眼。 PDF p.495, 499

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Ear drops direction: Under 3 = Down; Over 3 = Up.滴耳方向：3 歲以下往下；3 歲以上往上。 PDF p.497

36 Respiratory Problems呼吸問題

Pediatric airway and lung disorders: epiglottitis, croup, bronchitis, bronchiolitis/RSV, pneumonia, asthma, cystic fibrosis, SIDS, foreign body aspiration and tuberculosis. Airway protection, recognizing emergencies and correct positioning/medication teaching dominate the testing.小兒呼吸道與肺部疾病：會厭炎、哮吼、支氣管炎、細支氣管炎/RSV、肺炎、氣喘、囊性纖維化、嬰兒猝死症、異物吸入與結核病。重點為保護呼吸道、辨識緊急狀況，以及正確擺位與用藥衛教。

Epiglottitis會厭炎

  • Bacterial (usually H. influenzae type b), age 2-8, abrupt onset, winter; emergency that can obstruct the airway completely. Hib vaccine lowers risk.細菌性（多為 Hib），2–8 歲，突發、冬季；可迅速完全阻塞呼吸道的急症。Hib 疫苗可降低風險。
  • Classic signs: tripod position, drooling, stridor, muffled voice, high fever, dysphagia, agitation, no spontaneous cough, cherry-red swollen epiglottis.典型徵象：三腳架姿勢、流口水、喘鳴、聲音悶啞、高燒、吞嚥困難、躁動、無自發性咳嗽、櫻桃紅腫脹會厭。
  • Do NOT examine the throat, culture, take oral temperature, or agitate the child until the airway is secured (risk of spasm and total occlusion).在呼吸道確保前，不可檢視咽喉、採喉頭培養、量口溫或使孩童躁動（可能痙攣致完全阻塞）。
  • Keep child with parent, never leave unattended; humidified oxygen, pulse oximetry, lateral neck film, ready intubation/tracheostomy equipment.與家長在一起，不可獨留；給濕化氧氣、監測血氧、頸部側位 X 光、備妥插管/氣切設備。
PDF p.503, 504

Croup (laryngotracheobronchitis)哮吼（喉氣管支氣管炎）

  • Usually viral (parainfluenza 2 and 3, RSV, influenza) but can also be bacterial; under 5 years, gradual onset after URI.多為病毒性（副流感 2、3 型、RSV、流感），但也可能是細菌性；好發於 5 歲以下，常於上呼吸道感染後逐漸發生。
  • Stages (Box 36.1): I low fever, hoarseness, seal-bark cough, inspiratory stridor; II continuous stridor, retractions; III restlessness, pallor, tachypnea, hypoxia; IV cyanosis, apnea.分期（框 36.1）：I 低燒、聲音沙啞、犬吠樣咳嗽、吸氣性喘鳴；II 持續喘鳴、凹陷；III 躁動、蒼白、呼吸急促、缺氧；IV 發紺、呼吸暫停。
  • Cool mist/humidified air, HOB elevated, fluids, corticosteroids, nebulized racemic epinephrine, heliox; antibiotics only if bacterial; no cough/cold medicines.涼霧/濕化空氣、抬高床頭、補水、類固醇、racemic epinephrine 噴霧、氦氧混合氣；細菌感染才用抗生素；避免咳嗽與感冒藥。
  • Home: cool vaporizer, cool night air, or open freezer air.居家：冷霧機、夜間冷空氣或冷凍庫開門冷空氣。
  • Bronchitis: usually viral; dry hacking cough worse at night becoming productive in 2-3 days; supportive care, cool humidified air, fluids.支氣管炎：多為病毒性；夜間加劇的乾咳，2–3 天後轉為有痰；支持療法、涼濕空氣、補水。
PDF p.504, 505

Bronchiolitis and RSV細支氣管炎與 RSV

  • RSV is the common cause of bronchiolitis; spread by droplet and contact; fall to spring; worst under 6 months; high-risk: chronic disease, immunocompromised.RSV 為常見病因；經飛沫與接觸傳播；秋至春季；6 個月以下最嚴重；高危險：慢性病、免疫低下。
  • Signs: rhinorrhea, cough, wheezing, fever; progression to air hunger, retractions, cyanosis; severe: rate over 70/min, apnea, decreased breath sounds, listlessness.徵象：流鼻水、咳嗽、喘鳴、發燒；進展至空氣飢餓、凹陷、發紺；嚴重：呼吸 >70/分、呼吸暫停、呼吸音減弱、嗜睡。
  • Single room, contact + droplet + standard precautions; don't assign nurse to other high-risk children.單人房、接觸+飛沫+標準防護；照護者勿同時照顧其他高危兒。
  • Position 30-40 degrees with neck slightly extended; humidified O2, pulse oximetry, fluids, suction before feeding; palivizumab for high-risk infants.擺位抬高 30–40 度、頸稍伸展；濕化氧氣、血氧監測、補水、餵食前抽吸；高危嬰兒給 palivizumab。
  • No honey cough remedies under 1 year (botulism); cough suppressants used cautiously.1 歲以下不可用含蜂蜜止咳品（肉毒桿菌）；止咳藥謹慎使用。
  • Table 36.1: cannula 22-40% (can eat/talk), mask higher, tent 30-50% (access poor), hood/face tent up to 100%.表 36.1：鼻導管 22–40%（可進食說話）、面罩較高、氧氣帳 30–50%（接近困難）、氧罩/面罩最高 100%。
PDF p.505, 506

Pneumonia肺炎

  • Viral most common; mycoplasma/chlamydia (atypical) ages 5-12 fall-winter; bacterial often needs hospitalization; aspiration pneumonia from food/secretions; pneumococcal vaccine prevents.病毒性最常見；黴漿菌/披衣菌（非典型）5–12 歲、秋冬；細菌性常需住院；吸入性肺炎由食物/分泌物引起；肺炎鏈球菌疫苗可預防。
  • Bacterial: abrupt fever, infant irritability/poor feeding/cyanosis; older child chest pain, headache; diminished breath sounds, crackles.細菌性：突發發燒；嬰兒易怒、餵食差、發紺；較大兒童胸痛、頭痛；呼吸音減弱、囉音。
  • Blood cultures then antibiotics (IV in hospital), O2 and pulse oximetry, cool humidified air, suction, CPT every 4 hours, bed rest, lie on affected side, fluids carefully.先抽血培養再給抗生素（住院多靜脈）、給氧與血氧監測、涼濕空氣、抽吸、每 4 小時胸腔物理治療、臥床休息、患側臥、小心補水。
  • Monitor temperature (febrile seizures); isolation for pneumococcal/staph; chest tube for empyema; thoracentesis.監測體溫（熱性痙攣）；肺炎鏈球菌/葡萄球菌需隔離；膿胸放胸管；胸腔穿刺。
  • Viral/atypical pneumonia: symptomatic care, recovery 7-10 days for atypical.病毒性/非典型肺炎：症狀治療，非典型約 7–10 天恢復。
PDF p.506, 507

Asthma氣喘

  • Chronic airway inflammation with bronchospasm, mucus, edema; early and late reactions; triggers in Box 36.4 (allergens, smoke, cold air, exercise, infection, emotions, aspirin/NSAIDs, beta blockers, sulfites).氣道慢性發炎，支氣管痙攣、黏液、水腫；有立即與延遲反應；誘發因子見框 36.4（過敏原、菸、冷空氣、運動、感染、情緒、阿斯匹靈/NSAID、乙型阻斷劑、亞硫酸鹽）。
  • Attack: wheeze, cough, dyspnea, retractions, prolonged expiration, short phrases, tripod posture; SILENT CHEST and ineffective cough mean severe obstruction; status asthmaticus unresponsive to beta-agonists is an emergency.發作：喘鳴、咳嗽、呼吸困難、凹陷、呼氣延長、短句說話、三腳架姿勢；「無聲胸」與無效咳嗽代表嚴重阻塞；對乙型作用劑無反應的重積性氣喘為急症。
  • Severity (Table 36.2): mild intermittent, mild persistent, moderate persistent, severe persistent by symptom frequency and FEV1 (over 80%, over 80%, 60-80%, 60% or less).嚴重度（表 36.2）：輕度間歇、輕度持續、中度持續、重度持續；依症狀頻率與 FEV1（>80%、>80%、60–80%、≤60%）。
  • Quick-relief: SABA, anticholinergics, systemic steroids. Controllers: inhaled steroids, LABA (never alone), leukotriene modifiers, cromolyn, monoclonal antibody.速效藥：SABA、抗膽鹼、全身性類固醇。控制藥：吸入類固醇、LABA（不可單用）、白三烯調節劑、cromolyn、單株抗體。
  • Use a spacer with inhaled steroids, rinse mouth (thrush); monitor growth; peak flow personal best; decreased PEF warns of exacerbation; CPT not during acute attack.吸入類固醇使用吸藥輔助器並漱口（預防鵝口瘡）；監測生長；峰值流速個人最佳值；PEF 下降警示惡化；急性發作時不做胸腔物理治療。
  • Acute ED care: humidified O2, rescue meds, IV access, corticosteroids, chest x-ray, ABG as needed.急診處置：濕化氧氣、速效藥、建立靜脈、類固醇、胸部 X 光、必要時動脈血氣。
  • Home: remove allergens, avoid cold air and infections, annual flu vaccine from 6 months, inform school.居家：移除過敏原、避免冷空氣與感染、6 個月起每年流感疫苗、通知學校。
PDF p.507, 508, 509, 510

Cystic fibrosis囊性纖維化

  • Autosomal recessive exocrine gland disorder: thick mucus obstructs lungs, pancreas, intestines, reproductive tract; high sweat sodium and chloride; CFTR modulators exist.體染色體隱性外分泌腺疾病：濃稠黏液阻塞肺、胰、腸、生殖道；汗液鈉氯升高；有 CFTR 調節藥。
  • Sweat chloride: under 40 mEq/L normal; over 60 positive; 40-60 repeat (over 40 diagnostic under 3 months). Also newborn screening (IRT), 72-hour stool fat.汗液氯：<40 mEq/L 正常；>60 陽性；40–60 需重測（3 個月以下 >40 即診斷）。另有新生兒篩檢（IRT）、72 小時糞便脂肪。
  • Lungs: chronic infection, wheeze, clubbing, barrel chest, pneumonia, pulmonary hypertension/cor pulmonale, pneumothorax, hemoptysis. GI: meconium ileus (earliest), frothy foul stools, DIOS, FTT, low vitamins A D E K, rectal prolapse, diabetes risk.肺部：慢性感染、喘鳴、杵狀指、桶狀胸、肺炎、肺高壓/肺心症、氣胸、咳血。腸胃：胎便性腸阻塞（最早）、泡沫惡臭便、遠端腸阻塞症候群、生長遲滯、維生素 A D E K 缺乏、直腸脫垂、糖尿病風險。
  • Skin tastes salty; risk of dehydration in heat; delayed puberty, infertility.皮膚嚐起來鹹；高溫易脫水；青春期延遲、不孕。
  • Respiratory care: CPT on waking and evening (not right after meals), bronchodilator before CPT, huffing, Flutter, vest, exercise, antibiotics; careful with oxygen (CO2 retention).呼吸照護：起床與晚間胸腔物理治療（餐後不做）、治療前給支氣管擴張劑、哈氣技巧、Flutter、背心、運動、抗生素；給氧小心（CO2 滯留）。
  • GI care: high calorie/protein diet, extra vitamins, pancreatic enzymes within 30 minutes of meals and snacks (not NPO), do not crush enteric-coated capsules; extra salt in heat.腸胃照護：高熱量高蛋白飲食、補充維生素、餐點與點心 30 分鐘內給胰臟酵素（禁食不給）、腸溶膠囊不可壓碎；高溫時多補鹽。
PDF p.510, 511, 512, 513

SIDS嬰兒猝死症

  • Unexplained death of infant under 1 year, peak 2-4 months, winter, higher in males; lower with breastfeeding and pacifier use.1 歲以下嬰兒不明原因死亡，高峰 2–4 個月、冬季、男嬰較多；哺乳與使用奶嘴者較低。
  • Risks: prone sleep, soft bedding, sofa sleeping, overheating, co-sleeping, maternal smoking/substance use, tobacco smoke exposure.危險因子：趴睡、柔軟寢具、睡沙發、過熱、同床、母親吸菸/物質濫用、二手菸。
  • Prevention: supine for sleep, firm mattress, no toys or loose items in crib; tummy time while awake and varied head position to prevent plagiocephaly.預防：仰睡、硬床墊、嬰兒床不放玩具或鬆軟物；清醒時趴玩並變換頭位以預防斜頭畸形。
  • Support grieving parents.支持悲傷的父母。
PDF p.513

Foreign body aspiration and tuberculosis異物吸入與結核病

  • Round foods (hot dogs, grapes, peanuts, popcorn, candy) are common; signs choking, cough, stridor, wheeze, cyanosis; abdominal thrusts per AHA guidelines; endoscopic removal then humidified air.圓形食物（熱狗、葡萄、花生、爆米花、糖果）常見；徵象嗆咳、喘鳴、發紺；依 AHA 指引腹部推擠；內視鏡取出後給濕化空氣。
  • Prevention: keep small objects/balloons away, avoid small round foods; teach caregivers emergency measures.預防：小物件/氣球放遠、避免小而圓的食物；教導照顧者緊急處理。
  • TB: droplet transmission, mainly from household contact; Mantoux positive 2-12 weeks after infection, does not confirm active disease; sputum or gastric washings culture is definitive; don't test with measles vaccine.結核：飛沫傳染，多來自家人接觸；感染後 2–12 週 Mantoux 陽性，不代表活動性；痰或胃洗液培養為確診；不與麻疹疫苗同時測試。
  • Latent TB: isoniazid 9 months (12 if HIV). Active: isoniazid + rifampin + pyrazinamide 2 months then isoniazid + rifampin 4 months; DOT; orange-red body fluids; N95 and respiratory isolation.潛伏結核：isoniazid 9 個月（HIV 為 12 個月）。活動性：isoniazid + rifampin + pyrazinamide 2 個月，再 isoniazid + rifampin 4 個月；直接觀察治療；體液橘紅色；N95 與呼吸道隔離。
PDF p.513, 514, 515

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Epiglottitis: tripod, drooling, stridor, muffled voice. Never visualize throat or agitate; secure airway first.會厭炎：三腳架、流口水、喘鳴、聲音悶啞。不可檢視咽喉或使其躁動；先確保呼吸道。 PDF p.503, 504
  2. Silent chest in asthma = severe obstruction/impending respiratory failure.氣喘「無聲胸」＝嚴重阻塞/即將呼吸衰竭。 PDF p.508
  3. Quick-relief asthma drug: short-acting beta agonist; LABA never without inhaled steroid.氣喘速效藥：短效乙型作用劑；LABA 不可無吸入類固醇單用。 PDF p.509
  4. Spacer and mouth rinse with inhaled corticosteroids to prevent thrush.吸入類固醇用輔助器並漱口以預防鵝口瘡。 PDF p.510
  5. CF: sweat chloride over 60 mEq/L is positive; meconium ileus earliest GI sign.CF：汗液氯 >60 mEq/L 為陽性；胎便性腸阻塞為最早腸胃表現。 PDF p.511, 512
  6. CF enzymes: give with meals/snacks within 30 minutes, never crush enteric-coated capsules; extra salt in heat.CF 酵素：餐點30 分鐘內給予、腸溶膠囊不可壓碎；高溫多補鹽。 PDF p.512
  7. CF vitamins A, D, E, K deficiency; high-calorie high-protein diet.CF 缺乏維生素 A D E K；高熱量高蛋白飲食。 PDF p.511, 512
  8. RSV: contact/droplet precautions, single room, position 30-40 degrees, palivizumab for high risk.RSV：接觸/飛沫防護、單人房、抬高 30–40 度、高危給 palivizumab。 PDF p.505, 506
  9. No honey for infants under 1 year (botulism).1 歲以下嬰兒不可給蜂蜜（肉毒桿菌）。 PDF p.506
  10. SIDS: supine sleep, no soft bedding, no co-sleeping, no smoke exposure.SIDS：仰睡、無柔軟寢具、不同床、避免菸害。 PDF p.513
  11. Positive Mantoux does not mean active TB; sputum/gastric culture confirms; delay TST around measles vaccine.Mantoux 陽性不等於活動性 TB；痰/胃液培養確診；麻疹疫苗時避免同時測。 PDF p.515
  12. TB meds turn body fluids orange-red; isoniazid 9 months for latent infection.結核藥使體液呈橘紅色；潛伏感染 isoniazid 9 個月。 PDF p.515
  13. Bacterial pneumonia: blood cultures before antibiotics; lie on affected side; monitor for febrile seizures.細菌性肺炎：先抽血培養再給抗生素；患側臥；留意熱性痙攣。 PDF p.507
  14. Foreign body: round foods; abdominal thrusts; post-endoscopy watch airway edema.異物：圓形食物；腹部推擠；內視鏡後留意氣道水腫。 PDF p.514

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Epiglottitis 4 Ds: Drooling, Dysphagia, Dysphonia, Distress (plus tripod).會厭炎 4D：流口水、吞嚥困難、聲音改變、呼吸窘迫（加三腳架）。 PDF p.503
  • Croup = barking seal cough with inspiratory stridor; epiglottitis = no cough, muffled, toxic.哮吼＝犬吠樣咳嗽加吸氣喘鳴；會厭炎＝無咳嗽、聲音悶、中毒外觀。 PDF p.503, 504

37 Cardiovascular Problems心血管問題（兒科）

Pediatric cardiovascular nursing: hyperlipidemia, heart failure (HF) and digoxin/diuretic care, congenital heart defects grouped by blood-flow effect, cardiac catheterization and surgery care, rheumatic fever, and Kawasaki disease.兒童心血管護理：高血脂、心衰竭（HF）與毛地黃/利尿劑照護、依血流影響分類的先天性心臟缺損、心導管與心臟手術護理、風濕熱與川崎病。

Hyperlipidemia in children兒童高血脂

  • Ages 2-19: total cholesterol <170 mg/dL acceptable, 170-199 borderline, >=200 high.2-19歲：總膽固醇 <170 mg/dL 為可接受，170-199 為臨界，≥200 為偏高。
  • LDL <110 acceptable, 110-129 borderline, >=130 high; HDL >45 acceptable, <40 low.LDL <110 可接受，110-129 臨界，≥130 偏高；HDL >45 可接受，<40 偏低。
  • Triglycerides: <100 mg/dL (age <=9) or <130 mg/dL (age >=10) is acceptable.三酸甘油酯：9歲以下 <100 mg/dL，10歲以上 <130 mg/dL 為可接受。
  • Childhood hyperlipidemia tends to persist and raises later cardiac event risk; any elevation warrants cardiology referral.兒童期高血脂常持續至成年並增加心臟事件風險；任何異常升高皆應轉介心臟科。
  • Treatment centers on diet, physical activity and behavior change.治療以飲食、身體活動與行為改變為主。
PDF p.520

Heart failure: assessment心衰竭：評估

  • HF = heart cannot meet the body's metabolic/oxygen needs; in children usually from congenital defects causing volume or pressure overload; both sides typically fail together.HF指心臟無法供應身體代謝與氧需求；兒童多因先天缺損造成容積或壓力負荷過重，通常左右心同時衰竭。
  • Early signs: tachycardia (even at rest), tachypnea, profuse scalp sweating in infants, fatigue, irritability, sudden weight gain, respiratory distress.早期徵象：休息時心跳過速、呼吸過速、嬰兒頭皮大量出汗、疲倦易怒、體重突然增加、呼吸窘迫。
  • Left-sided: crackles, cough, dyspnea, grunting, nasal flaring, retractions, orthopnea. Right-sided: hepatosplenomegaly, JVD, peripheral/periorbital edema, ascites, oliguria, weight gain.左心衰：囉音、咳嗽、呼吸困難、呻吟、鼻翼搧動、肋間凹陷。右心衰：肝脾腫大、頸靜脈怒張、周邊/眼周水腫、腹水、少尿、體重增加。
PDF p.520, 521

Heart failure: nursing care and medications心衰竭：護理與藥物

  • Count apical pulse and respirations for a full minute; strict I&O (weigh diapers); daily weight, same scale/time; 0.5 kg (1 lb) gain in a day suggests fluid retention.心尖脈與呼吸需測滿1分鐘；嚴格I&O（秤尿布）；每日同一體重計、同一時間量體重，一天增加0.5 kg代表液體滯留。
  • Semi-Fowler position, cool humidified oxygen, neutral thermal environment, cluster care for rest, small frequent feedings.半坐臥、冷濕化氧氣、維持中性溫度、集中護理讓其休息、少量多餐。
  • Digoxin: hold if apical rate <90-110 (infants/young children) or <70 (older children); therapeutic level 0.8-2 ng/mL; toxicity signs are anorexia, poor feeding, N/V, bradycardia, dysrhythmias.毛地黃：心尖脈嬰幼兒 <90-110、較大兒童 <70 時暫停給藥；治療濃度0.8-2 ng/mL；中毒徵象為厭食、拒食、噁心嘔吐、心搏過緩、心律不整。
  • Furosemide causes hypokalemia (K+ <3.5), which potentiates digoxin toxicity; give potassium only if indicated and renal function is adequate.furosemide可致低血鉀（K+ <3.5），會加重毛地黃中毒；需有適應症且腎功能良好才補鉀。
  • ACE inhibitors: watch for hypotension, renal dysfunction, cough.ACE抑制劑：注意低血壓、腎功能異常、咳嗽。
  • Parents learn digoxin home care and CPR.需教導家長在家給予毛地黃及CPR。
PDF p.521, 522

Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow肺血流增加之缺損

  • Left-to-right shunts (ASD, VSD, PDA, AV canal): blood moves from high-pressure left side to right; signs of HF.左向右分流（ASD、VSD、PDA、房室管缺損）：血液由高壓左側流向右側，出現HF徵象。
  • ASD: opening between atria; may be asymptomatic; closed by catheter or open repair, usually before school age.ASD：心房間開口；可無症狀；可經心導管或開心手術修補，多在學齡前完成。
  • AV canal defect: incomplete endocardial cushion fusion; most common defect in Down syndrome.房室管缺損：心內膜墊融合不全；唐氏症最常見之心臟缺損。
  • PDA: machinery-like murmur, widened pulse pressure, bounding pulses; indomethacin closes it in premature infants; prostaglandin E keeps it open in ductal-dependent lesions.PDA：機械樣雜音、脈壓增寬、脈搏洪大；indomethacin可使早產兒導管關閉；導管依賴型缺損用前列腺素E維持導管開放。
  • VSD: many small/moderate defects close spontaneously in the first year; HF common.VSD：許多小至中型缺損在第一年自行閉合；常見HF。
PDF p.522, 523

Obstructive defects阻塞性缺損

  • Aortic stenosis: narrowed aortic valve; LV hypertrophy; children have activity intolerance, chest pain, dizziness; treated with balloon dilation or valvotomy.主動脈瓣狹窄：瓣膜狹窄、左心室肥大；兒童活動耐受不良、胸痛、頭暈；以氣球擴張或瓣膜切開術治療。
  • Coarctation of the aorta: BP higher in arms than legs, bounding arm pulses, weak/absent femoral pulses, cool legs; headache, epistaxis, dizziness.主動脈縮窄：上肢血壓高於下肢、上肢脈搏洪大、股動脈脈搏弱或消失、下肢冰冷；頭痛、流鼻血、頭暈。
  • Coarctation repair is outside the heart: thoracotomy, no cardiopulmonary bypass.縮窄修補位於心臟外：開胸，不需體外循環。
  • Pulmonary stenosis: right ventricular hypertrophy, decreased pulmonary flow; severe cases cyanotic in newborns; treated by dilation or valvotomy.肺動脈瓣狹窄：右心室肥大、肺血流減少；嚴重者新生兒發紺；以擴張或瓣膜切開治療。
PDF p.523, 524

Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow肺血流減少之缺損

  • Right-to-left shunts cause hypoxemia and cyanosis.右向左分流造成低血氧與發紺。
  • Tetralogy of Fallot: VSD, pulmonary stenosis, overriding aorta, RV hypertrophy.法洛氏四重症：VSD、肺動脈狹窄、主動脈騎跨、右心室肥大。
  • Tet spells occur with crying, feeding, defecating; older children squat and develop clubbing and poor growth.哭泣、餵食、排便時可出現缺氧發作（tet spell）；較大兒童會蹲踞、杵狀指、生長遲緩。
  • Management: palliative shunt in infants who cannot have primary repair; complete repair in the first year via sternotomy and bypass.處置：無法一次修補的嬰兒先做姑息性分流；第一年內以胸骨切開與體外循環完全修補。
  • Tricuspid atresia: no RA-to-RV connection; blood passes through ASD/PFO and VSD; cyanosis, clubbing.三尖瓣閉鎖：右心房與右心室無相通；血液經ASD/PFO與VSD；發紺、杵狀指。
PDF p.524

Mixed defects混合性缺損

  • Hypoplastic left heart: hypoplastic LV and aortic atresia; deteriorates as the ductus closes; needs prostaglandin E1 and ventilation before surgery.左心發育不全：左心室發育不良與主動脈閉鎖；導管關閉後急速惡化；術前需前列腺素E1與呼吸器。
  • Transposition of great arteries: aorta from RV, pulmonary artery from LV; severe cyanosis if little mixing; PGE1 and balloon atrial septostomy; arterial switch repair.大動脈轉位：主動脈出自右心室、肺動脈出自左心室；混合少則重度發紺；使用PGE1與氣球心房中膈造口；動脈調換術修補。
  • Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection: pulmonary veins fail to reach LA; rapid decline with obstruction; repaired in early infancy.全肺靜脈異位連接：肺靜脈未接左心房；阻塞時快速惡化；嬰兒早期修補。
  • Truncus arteriosus: single vessel overrides both ventricles; HF and variable cyanosis; repair in first months.永存動脈幹：單一血管跨接兩心室；HF與不等程度發紺；數月內修補。
  • General defect care: monitor respiratory status, reverse Trendelenburg for work of breathing, watch for hypercyanotic spells, daily weight, high-calorie nutrition.缺損一般照護：監測呼吸、以反Trendelenburg減少呼吸功、注意缺氧發作、每日體重、高熱量營養。
PDF p.525, 526

Cardiac catheterization and cardiac surgery心導管檢查與心臟手術

  • Pre-procedure: accurate height/weight, iodine allergy, signs of infection, mark and record distal pulses, baseline O2 saturation.術前：測準確身高體重、碘過敏史、感染徵象、標記並記錄遠端脈搏、基礎血氧。
  • Post-procedure: monitor 4 hours; check pulses, color and warmth below site (coolness = arterial obstruction); keep leg flat 4-6 h (venous) or 6-8 h (arterial).術後：監測4小時；檢查穿刺處以下脈搏、顏色與溫度（變冷＝動脈阻塞）；靜脈入路平躺4-6小時、動脈入路6-8小時。
  • If bleeding: apply continuous direct pressure at or just above the site and report.若出血：於穿刺處或其上方持續直接加壓並通報。
  • Cardiac surgery postop: watch temperature and sepsis, aseptic technique, pain control, rest, early parent contact.心臟手術後：監測體溫與敗血症、無菌技術、止痛、休息、盡早親子接觸。
  • Home care after surgery: avoid crowds 2 weeks, no falls risk activities 2-4 weeks, no lotions/powders on incision, no new foods for infants, no PE for 2 months, dental visits with antibiotic notice.術後居家：2週避免人群、2-4週避免易跌倒活動、傷口勿擦乳液或粉、嬰兒不加新食物、2個月不上體育課、看牙需告知心臟病史。
PDF p.525, 526, 527

Rheumatic fever風濕熱

  • Autoimmune inflammation appearing 2-6 weeks after untreated/partly treated group A beta-hemolytic strep pharyngitis; mitral valve most affected.未治療或不完全治療之A群乙型溶血性鏈球菌咽炎後2-6週發生的自體免疫發炎；最常侵犯二尖瓣。
  • Jones: major = carditis, polyarthritis, chorea, erythema marginatum, subcutaneous nodules; minor = fever, arthralgia, raised ESR/CRP, prolonged PR. Need 2 major or 1 major + 2 minor plus evidence of strep (ASO titer).Jones準則：主要＝心臟炎、多發性關節炎、舞蹈症、環形紅斑、皮下結節；次要＝發燒、關節痛、ESR/CRP升高、PR間期延長。需2主要或1主要+2次要，加上鏈球菌感染證據（ASO）。
  • Care: bed rest in acute phase, antibiotics, anti-inflammatories after diagnosis confirmed, seizure precautions for chorea, long-term antibiotic prophylaxis.照護：急性期臥床、抗生素、確診後才給抗發炎藥、舞蹈症時癲癇防護、長期抗生素預防。
PDF p.526, 527

Kawasaki disease川崎病

  • Acute systemic vasculitis of unknown cause; coronary aneurysm is the major complication.原因不明的急性全身性血管炎；主要併發症為冠狀動脈瘤。
  • Acute: fever, conjunctival hyperemia, cracked red lips/strawberry tongue, swollen hands/feet with red palms/soles, rash, cervical lymphadenopathy, irritability.急性期：發燒、結膜充血、嘴唇乾裂紅腫/草莓舌、手足腫脹與掌蹠紅斑、皮疹、頸部淋巴結腫大、易怒。
  • Subacute: peeling fingertips/toes, joint pain, thrombocytosis. Convalescent: looks normal, labs still abnormal.亞急性期：指趾脫皮、關節痛、血小板增多。恢復期：外觀正常，檢驗仍異常。
  • Treatment: high-dose IVIG (blood product) plus aspirin; delay MMR/varicella vaccines 11 months after IVIG; no aspirin if exposed to chickenpox or flu.治療：高劑量IVIG（血液製品）加阿斯匹靈；IVIG後11個月內延後MMR/水痘疫苗；接觸水痘或流感時避免阿斯匹靈。
PDF p.528

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Early HF signs in infants: tachycardia, tachypnea, scalp sweating, fatigue, sudden weight gain.嬰兒HF早期徵象：心跳過速、呼吸過速、頭皮出汗、疲倦、體重突增。 PDF p.520
  2. Hold digoxin if apical pulse <90-110 (infant/young child) or <70 (older child); therapeutic 0.8-2 ng/mL.心尖脈嬰幼兒 <90-110、較大兒童 <70 時暫停毛地黃；治療濃度0.8-2 ng/mL。 PDF p.521
  3. Hypokalemia from furosemide increases digoxin toxicity risk.furosemide造成的低血鉀增加毛地黃中毒風險。 PDF p.521
  4. Do not repeat a digoxin dose if the child vomits; do not double missed doses; give 1 h before or 2 h after feeds; never mix in food.嘔吐後勿補給毛地黃；漏服勿加倍；餵食前1小時或後2小時給藥；勿混入食物。 PDF p.522
  5. Weigh diapers to measure infant urine output accurately.以秤尿布方式準確測量嬰兒尿量。 PDF p.520, 521
  6. Tet spell: calm infant, knee-chest position, 100% O2, morphine, IV fluids, notify provider.缺氧發作：安撫、膝胸臥位、100%氧氣、嗎啡、靜脈輸液、通知醫師。 PDF p.524
  7. Coarctation: higher BP in arms than legs, weak femoral pulses.主動脈縮窄：上肢血壓高於下肢、股動脈脈搏弱。 PDF p.523
  8. PDA: machinery murmur, bounding pulses, wide pulse pressure.PDA：機械樣雜音、脈搏洪大、脈壓增寬。 PDF p.523
  9. AV canal defect is the most common cardiac defect in Down syndrome.房室管缺損為唐氏症最常見心臟缺損。 PDF p.522
  10. Ductal-dependent lesions (hypoplastic left heart, TGA) need prostaglandin E1 to keep the ductus open.導管依賴型缺損（左心發育不全、大動脈轉位）需前列腺素E1維持導管開放。 PDF p.525
  11. After cardiac catheterization: coolness or absent pulses distal to the site = arterial obstruction; bleeding = direct pressure and call.心導管後：穿刺遠端冰冷或脈搏消失＝動脈阻塞；出血＝直接加壓並通報。 PDF p.526
  12. After cardiac surgery: no lotions/powders on incision, avoid crowds 2 weeks.心臟手術後：傷口不擦乳液/粉、2週避免人群。 PDF p.527
  13. Rheumatic fever: ask about sore throat/fever in prior 2 months; ASO titer confirms strep; Jones criteria; do not give salicylates before diagnosis (masks arthritis).風濕熱：詢問前2個月咽痛/發燒史；ASO確認鏈球菌；Jones準則；確診前不給水楊酸（會掩蓋關節炎）。 PDF p.527
  14. Kawasaki acute stage: conjunctival hyperemia, strawberry tongue, swollen red hands/feet; desquamation comes later (subacute).川崎病急性期：結膜充血、草莓舌、手足紅腫；脫皮出現較晚（亞急性）。 PDF p.528
  15. Kawasaki: IVIG + aspirin; delay MMR/varicella 11 months after IVIG.川崎病：IVIG+阿斯匹靈；IVIG後延後MMR/水痘疫苗11個月。 PDF p.528

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Tetralogy of Fallot = 'PROV': Pulmonary stenosis, Right ventricular hypertrophy, Overriding aorta, VSD.法洛氏四重症記憶「PROV」：肺動脈狹窄、右心室肥大、主動脈騎跨、VSD。 PDF p.524
  • Rheumatic fever major criteria 'J-O-N-E-S': Joints, O (heart), Nodules, Erythema marginatum, Sydenham chorea.風濕熱主要準則「JONES」：關節炎、心臟炎(O)、結節、環形紅斑、舞蹈症(Sydenham)。 PDF p.527

38 Renal and Genitourinary Problems腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

Pediatric renal and genitourinary disorders: UTI, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, hemolytic-uremic syndrome, vesicoureteral reflux, enuresis, and congenital genital/urinary anomalies (cryptorchidism, hypospadias/epispadias, bladder exstrophy).兒童腎臟與泌尿生殖疾病：泌尿道感染、腎絲球腎炎、腎病症候群、溶血性尿毒症候群、膀胱輸尿管逆流、遺尿，以及先天性泌尿生殖異常（隱睪症、尿道下裂/上裂、膀胱外翻）。

Urinary tract infection泌尿道感染

  • Bacteria from skin or gut flora invade the urinary tract.皮膚或腸道菌叢細菌侵入泌尿道。
  • Uncircumcised infants have higher UTI risk than circumcised infants.未包皮環切的嬰兒UTI風險較高。
  • Teach front-to-back wiping; asymptomatic bacteriuria can occur, so screen and treat when infection is suspected.教導由前往後擦拭；可能有無症狀菌尿，懷疑感染時須篩檢並治療。
PDF p.533

Glomerulonephritis腎絲球腎炎

  • Immune (antigen-antibody) inflammatory injury of glomeruli, typically after group A beta-hemolytic strep: pharyngitis 1-2 weeks before, or skin infection 3-6 weeks before.腎絲球之免疫（抗原抗體）發炎損傷，多見於A群乙型溶血性鏈球菌感染後：咽炎後1-2週，或皮膚感染後3-6週。
  • Findings: periorbital/facial edema worse in the morning, decreased urine, cola-colored urine (hematuria), hypertension, proteinuria, elevated BUN/creatinine, elevated ASO titer.表現：晨間較明顯的眼周/臉部水腫、尿量減少、可樂色尿（血尿）、高血壓、蛋白尿、BUN/肌酸酐上升、ASO升高。
  • Complications: kidney failure, hypertensive encephalopathy, pulmonary edema, heart failure, seizures.併發症：腎衰竭、高血壓腦病變、肺水腫、心衰竭、癲癇。
  • Care: VS, I&O, urine characteristics, daily weight (same time, scale, clothing), limited activity, sodium (and potassium if oliguric) restriction, diuretics, antihypertensives, antibiotics for persistent strep, seizure precautions.照護：生命徵象、I&O、尿液性狀、每日體重（同時間、同磅秤、同衣著）、限制活動、限鈉（少尿時限鉀）、利尿劑、降壓藥、持續鏈球菌感染給抗生素、癲癇防護。
  • Daily weight is the most useful measure of fluid balance; teach parents to treat sore throat, URI and skin infections promptly.每日體重是評估體液平衡最有用的方法；教導家長及早處理喉嚨痛、上呼吸道與皮膚感染。
PDF p.533, 534

Nephrotic syndrome腎病症候群

  • Classic tetrad: massive proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia, edema.典型四聯：大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白血症、高血脂、水腫。
  • Findings: weight gain, periorbital edema worse in morning, leg/labial/scrotal edema, ascites, dark frothy urine, normal or low BP, lethargy, pallor.表現：體重增加、晨間眼周水腫、腿/陰唇/陰囊水腫、腹水、深色泡沫尿、血壓正常或偏低、倦怠、蒼白。
  • Goals: reduce urinary protein loss, reduce edema, prevent infection.目標：減少尿蛋白流失、減輕水腫、預防感染。
  • Treatment: corticosteroids started at diagnosis, immunosuppressants for relapse/non-response, diuretics, salt-poor albumin for severe edema; sodium restriction during massive edema.治療：確診即開始類固醇；復發/無反應加免疫抑制劑；利尿劑；嚴重水腫用低鹽白蛋白；大量水腫時限鈉。
  • Monitor urine specific gravity and protein; teach home urine protein testing, infection signs, avoiding infectious contacts.監測尿比重與蛋白；教導居家尿蛋白檢測、感染徵象、避免接觸感染者。
PDF p.534, 535

Hemolytic-uremic syndrome (HUS)溶血性尿毒症候群

  • Acute kidney injury in infants and children 6 months-5 years, linked to bacterial toxins, chemicals and viruses.6個月至5歲嬰幼兒的急性腎損傷，與細菌毒素、化學物質、病毒有關。
  • Triad: hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, kidney failure; also CNS signs, hemorrhagic findings, oliguria/anuria.三聯徵：溶血性貧血、血小板低下、腎衰竭；並有中樞神經症狀、出血表現、少尿/無尿。
  • Labs: high BUN/creatinine, low Hgb/Hct, high reticulocytes, proteinuria, hematuria, casts.檢驗：BUN/肌酸酐高、Hgb/Hct低、網狀紅血球高、蛋白尿、血尿、尿圓柱。
  • Care: strict fluid balance, fluid restriction if anuric, dialysis if worsening, infection prevention, nutrition, blood transfusion cautiously to avoid fluid overload.照護：嚴格體液平衡、無尿時限水、惡化時透析、預防感染、營養、謹慎輸血避免液體過量。
PDF p.535

Vesicoureteral reflux膀胱輸尿管逆流

  • Urine flows backward from bladder to ureters/kidneys; primary type from faulty ureter-bladder valve, secondary from bladder outlet blockage.尿液由膀胱逆流至輸尿管/腎臟；原發性為輸尿管膀胱瓣膜缺陷，續發性為膀胱出口阻塞。
  • Risk: bladder exstrophy, family history, neurogenic bladder (e.g., spina bifida).危險因子：膀胱外翻、家族史、神經性膀胱（如脊柱裂）。
  • Diagnosis: ultrasound, voiding cystourethrogram; recurrent UTI is the common presentation.診斷：超音波、排尿性膀胱尿道攝影；常見表現為反覆UTI。
  • Treatment: prophylactic antibiotics, Deflux injection, or surgical repair; teach fluids, avoid juice/soda, warm towel for discomfort.治療：預防性抗生素、Deflux注射或手術修補；教導多喝水、避免果汁與汽水、溫毛巾緩解不適。
PDF p.535, 536

Enuresis遺尿症

  • Diagnosed in children older than 5 who wet at least twice weekly for 3 months; the child cannot control it.5歲以上、每週至少2次且持續3個月的尿濕；孩子無法控制。
  • Primary: never dry; nocturnal enuresis is common and usually outgrown. Secondary: wetting after established continence; check for UTI, diabetes.原發性：從未乾爽；夜間遺尿常見，多會自行好轉。續發性：已控制後又發生；需排除UTI、糖尿病。
  • Care: urinalysis/culture, limit fluids at night, void before bed, reward systems, conditioning (alarms), desmopressin or anticholinergics.照護：尿液分析/培養、夜間限水、睡前排尿、獎勵制度、行為制約（警報器）、desmopressin或抗膽鹼藥。
PDF p.536

Cryptorchidism隱睪症

  • One or both testes not descended into the scrotum; not palpable or easily guided down.單側或雙側睪丸未下降至陰囊；摸不到或無法輕易推入。
  • Observe for spontaneous descent in the first 6 months; surgical correction (orchiopexy) usually at 6-12 months.前6個月觀察是否自然下降；睪丸固定術通常於6-12個月進行。
  • Postop: monitor bleeding, infection, pain; teach home care and activity limits; offer counseling about fertility.術後：監測出血、感染、疼痛；教導居家照護與活動限制；提供生育力諮詢。
PDF p.536, 537

Epispadias and hypospadias尿道上裂與下裂

  • Epispadias: urethral opening on dorsal penis (often with bladder exstrophy). Hypospadias: opening on ventral side below glans.尿道上裂：開口在陰莖背側（常伴膀胱外翻）。尿道下裂：開口在龜頭下腹側。
  • Do not circumcise newborns; foreskin may be needed for repair. Surgery at 6-12 months, before toilet training.新生兒勿行包皮環切，包皮可能用於重建。手術於6-12個月，在如廁訓練前進行。
  • Postop: pressure dressing, stent/diversion, encourage fluids, monitor I&O, report no urine for 1 hour (kinked stent or sediment), anticholinergics for bladder spasms, antibiotics, no tub bath until stent removed.術後：加壓敷料、導管/支架、鼓勵飲水、監測I&O、1小時無尿須通報（支架扭曲或沉積物）、抗膽鹼藥治膀胱痙攣、抗生素、支架拔除前不盆浴。
PDF p.537

Bladder exstrophy and STIs膀胱外翻與性傳染病

  • Bladder protrudes through a lower abdominal wall defect; epispadias and vesicoureteral reflux are associated; closure in first days of life.膀胱經下腹壁缺損外露；伴尿道上裂與膀胱輸尿管逆流；出生後數日內閉合。
  • Protect exposed mucosa with sterile nonadherent covering (e.g., plastic wrap) to keep it moist; never petroleum jelly or dry gauze.以無菌不沾黏敷料（如塑膠膜）覆蓋保持濕潤；不可用凡士林或乾紗布。
  • Monitor urine output, infection, renal labs; give antibiotics; support parents.監測尿量、感染、腎功能檢驗；給抗生素；支持家長。
  • STI screening for selected children/adolescents follows CDC guidelines.特定兒童與青少年依CDC指引進行STI篩檢。
PDF p.537, 538

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Glomerulonephritis follows group A strep (pharyngitis 1-2 weeks; skin 3-6 weeks): cola-colored urine, periorbital edema, hypertension, high ASO.腎絲球腎炎發生於A群鏈球菌感染後（咽炎1-2週；皮膚3-6週）：可樂色尿、眼周水腫、高血壓、ASO升高。 PDF p.533
  2. Daily weight (same time, scale, clothing) is the best measure of fluid balance.每日體重（同時間、同磅秤、同衣著）是評估體液平衡最佳指標。 PDF p.534
  3. Glomerulonephritis complications: hypertensive encephalopathy, seizures, pulmonary edema, heart failure, kidney failure.腎絲球腎炎併發症：高血壓腦病變、癲癇、肺水腫、心衰竭、腎衰竭。 PDF p.533, 534
  4. Nephrotic syndrome: massive proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia, edema; BP normal or low (unlike GN).腎病症候群：大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白、高血脂、水腫；血壓正常或偏低（不同於腎絲球腎炎）。 PDF p.535
  5. Nephrotic syndrome: steroids immediately at diagnosis, watch for infection; teach urine protein testing.腎病症候群：確診即給類固醇，注意感染；教導尿蛋白檢測。 PDF p.535
  6. HUS triad: hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, acute kidney injury; ages 6 months-5 years.HUS三聯徵：溶血性貧血、血小板低下、急性腎損傷；好發6個月至5歲。 PDF p.535
  7. Anuric HUS child: restrict fluids, restrict potassium; transfuse cautiously; PD does not need an AV fistula.無尿HUS兒童：限水、限鉀；謹慎輸血；腹膜透析不需動靜脈瘻管。 PDF p.535
  8. Vesicoureteral reflux presents as recurrent UTI; diagnose with voiding cystourethrogram.膀胱輸尿管逆流表現為反覆UTI；以排尿性膀胱尿道攝影診斷。 PDF p.536
  9. Enuresis: evaluate for UTI/diabetes first; nocturnal enuresis is usually outgrown; desmopressin or anticholinergic may help.遺尿：先排除UTI/糖尿病；夜間遺尿多會自行好轉；desmopressin或抗膽鹼藥可輔助。 PDF p.536
  10. Cryptorchidism: watch 6 months; orchiopexy at 6-12 months.隱睪症：觀察6個月；6-12個月行睪丸固定術。 PDF p.536
  11. Hypospadias/epispadias: no newborn circumcision; surgery 6-12 months.尿道下裂/上裂：新生兒不可包皮環切；6-12個月手術。 PDF p.537
  12. After hypospadias repair, no urine for 1 hour must be reported (stent kink/obstruction).尿道下裂術後1小時無尿須通報（支架扭曲或阻塞）。 PDF p.537
  13. Bladder exstrophy: cover mucosa with nonadherent plastic wrap/sterile nonadherent dressing; no petroleum jelly.膀胱外翻：以無菌不沾黏敷料/塑膠膜覆蓋黏膜；勿用凡士林。 PDF p.538

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Epispadias = 'Epi' on top (dorsal); Hypospadias = 'Hypo' below (ventral).Epispadias 的 Epi＝上方（背側）；Hypospadias 的 Hypo＝下方（腹側）。 PDF p.537
  • GN = 'hypertensive, hematuria, high' (volume overloaded); nephrotic = 'low' (low albumin, low-normal BP, big proteinuria).腎絲球腎炎＝高血壓、血尿、容積過多；腎病症候群＝低白蛋白、血壓偏低/正常、大量蛋白尿。 PDF p.534, 535

39 Neurological and Cognitive Problems神經與認知問題（兒科）

Pediatric neurological and cognitive disorders: cerebral palsy, head injury and increased ICP, hydrocephalus and shunts, meningitis, submersion injury, Reye's syndrome, seizures, neural tube defects, ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and intellectual disability.兒童神經與認知疾病：腦性麻痺、頭部外傷與顱內壓上升、水腦與分流管、腦膜炎、溺水、Reye症候群、癲癇、神經管缺損、ADHD、自閉症類群與智能障礙。

Cerebral palsy腦性麻痺

  • Impaired movement, posture and muscle tone from a motor-system abnormality; spastic (upper motor neuron) is most common; athetoid, ataxic, mixed are less common.因運動系統異常導致動作、姿勢與肌張力受損；以痙攣型（上運動神經元）最常見；另有手足徐動型、運動失調型、混合型。
  • Signs: irritability, feeding problems, abnormal tone, delayed milestones, primitive reflexes (Moro, tonic neck) persisting past 6 months, opisthotonos, seizures.徵象：易怒、餵食困難、肌張力異常、發展遲緩、原始反射（Moro、頸張力）6個月後仍存在、角弓反張、癲癇。
  • Care: interprofessional team (PT, OT, speech), early intervention, assistive devices, safe environment/helmet, seizure precautions, upright after meals, muscle relaxants, parent support.照護：跨專業團隊（物理/職能/語言治療）、早期介入、輔具、安全環境/安全帽、癲癇防護、餐後保持直立、肌肉鬆弛劑、家長支持。
  • Communicate and play according to developmental, not chronological, age.溝通與遊戲依發展年齡而非實際年齡。
PDF p.542

Head injury and increased ICP頭部外傷與顱內壓上升

  • Closed head injury (blunt trauma, shaken baby) is more serious due to ICP rise in a closed vault; open injury involves fracture/penetration.閉鎖性頭傷（鈍傷、嬰兒搖晃症候群）因顱腔封閉易使ICP升高而更嚴重；開放性涉及骨折或穿透。
  • Level of consciousness is the earliest and most sensitive indicator of neurological change.意識程度是神經狀態變化最早、最敏感的指標。
  • Early ICP: irritability, high-pitched cry, bulging fontanel, Macewen sign, setting-sun eyes (infants); headache, vomiting, diplopia, seizures (children).早期ICP：嬰兒易怒、高頻哭聲、囟門膨出、Macewen徵象、日落眼；兒童頭痛、嘔吐、複視、癲癇。
  • Late ICP: marked drop in LOC, bradycardia, pupil changes, decorticate or decerebrate posturing, Cheyne-Stokes respirations, coma.晚期ICP：意識明顯下降、心搏過緩、瞳孔改變、去皮質/去大腦僵直、陳施氏呼吸、昏迷。
  • Immobilize neck if spinal injury suspected; once ruled out, HOB 15-30 degrees with head midline; minimize stimuli; withhold sedatives acutely.疑脊椎損傷先固定頸部；排除後床頭抬高15-30度、頭保持中線；減少刺激；急性期不給鎮靜劑。
  • Clear nose/ear drainage: test for glucose (positive = CSF leak, notify PHCP); no nasal suctioning with skull fracture.鼻/耳流出液測葡萄糖（陽性＝腦脊髓液漏，立即通報）；顱骨骨折者禁止經鼻抽吸。
  • Epidural hematoma: unequal, dilated nonreactive pupil is a neurosurgical emergency. Brainstem signs: irregular respirations, wide pulse/BP swings, sluggish or unequal pupils.硬膜外血腫：單側瞳孔放大且無反應為神經外科急症。腦幹受壓徵象：呼吸不規則、脈搏/血壓大幅波動、瞳孔遲鈍或不等大。
  • Osmotic diuretics or corticosteroids reduce edema; careful IV fluids avoid overhydration.渗透性利尿劑或類固醇減輕腦水腫；謹慎靜脈輸液避免過量。
PDF p.542, 543, 544

Hydrocephalus and shunts水腦與分流管

  • CSF absorption/production imbalance; communicating (absorption problem) vs noncommunicating (obstructive).腦脊髓液吸收/產生失衡；交通性（吸收問題）與非交通性（阻塞性）。
  • Infants: enlarging head, tense bulging non-pulsating fontanel, separated sutures, setting-sun eyes, frontal bossing, dilated scalp veins, irritability, poor feeding. Children: headache on waking, vomiting, ataxia, papilledema. Late: high shrill cry, seizures.嬰兒：頭圍增大、囟門緊繃膨出無搏動、縫合分離、日落眼、前額突出、頭皮靜脈擴張、易怒、拒食。兒童：晨起頭痛、嘔吐、運動失調、視乳突水腫。晚期：高尖哭聲、癲癇。
  • VP shunt drains CSF to peritoneum; VA shunt to right atrium; endoscopic third ventriculostomy is an alternative; revisions needed with growth.腦室腹腔分流（VP）將腦脊髓液引流至腹腔；腦室心房分流（VA）至右心房；內視鏡第三腦室造瘻為替代方式；成長後需修正。
  • Preop: I&O, small frequent feeds, reposition head often with egg-crate to prevent pressure sores.術前：I&O、少量多餐、經常變換頭部位置並用蛋盒型墊防壓瘡。
  • Postop: position on unoperated side, flat if prescribed to avoid rapid CSF drop, monitor head circumference, infection, ICP; teach shunt malfunction signs (infant: irritable, lethargic, poor feeding, shrill cry; toddler: headache, poor appetite; older: LOC change).術後：側臥於未手術側、依醫囑平躺以免腦脊髓液驟降、測頭圍、監測感染與ICP；教導分流管故障徵象（嬰兒：易怒、嗜睡、拒食、尖哭；幼兒：頭痛、食慾差；較大兒童：意識改變）。
PDF p.544, 545

Meningitis腦膜炎

  • CNS infection (bacterial or viral); bacterial causes: H. influenzae b, S. pneumoniae, N. meningitidis (droplet spread, epidemic).中樞神經感染（細菌或病毒）；細菌性病原：b型流感嗜血桿菌、肺炎鏈球菌、腦膜炎雙球菌（飛沫傳播、可流行）。
  • Bacterial CSF: cloudy, high pressure, high WBC, high protein, low glucose (via lumbar puncture).細菌性腦脊髓液：混濁、壓力高、WBC高、蛋白高、葡萄糖低（腰椎穿刺）。
  • Signs: fever, headache, vomiting, nuchal rigidity, high shrill cry, bulging fontanel, positive Kernig and Brudzinski, petechial/purpuric rash (meningococcal).徵象：發燒、頭痛、嘔吐、頸部僵硬、高尖哭聲、囟門膨出、Kernig與Brudzinski陽性、瘀點/紫斑（腦膜炎雙球菌）。
  • Respiratory (droplet) isolation until 24 hours after antibiotics started; give antibiotics promptly after cultures/LP; watch for SIADH, seizures, hearing loss; prophylaxis for close contacts.呼吸（飛沫）隔離至抗生素開始後24小時；採檢/腰穿後立即給抗生素；注意SIADH、癲癇、聽力喪失；密切接觸者預防性投藥。
  • Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine from age 2 months helps prevent meningitis.自2個月起接種肺炎鏈球菌結合疫苗可預防腦膜炎。
PDF p.545, 546

Submersion injury溺水

  • Hypoxia is the main problem; cerebral cells suffer irreversible damage after 4-6 minutes; aspiration and hypothermia add risk.缺氧為主要問題；腦細胞缺氧4-6分鐘後造成不可逆損傷；另有吸入與低體溫風險。
  • Prognosis good if submerged <5 min with responsiveness, reactive pupils, normal rhythm; poor if >10 min and no response to CPR within 25 min.浸水<5分鐘且有反應、瞳孔有反應、心律正常則預後佳；>10分鐘且CPR 25分鐘無反應預後極差。
  • Support ventilation/circulation; respiratory compromise and cerebral edema can appear 24 hours later; watch for aspiration pneumonia; teach water supervision.維持通氣與循環；24小時後仍可能出現呼吸惡化與腦水腫；注意吸入性肺炎；教導水域看護。
PDF p.546

Reye's syndromeReye症候群

  • Acute encephalopathy with cerebral edema and fatty liver after a viral illness (influenza, varicella) 4-7 days earlier.病毒感染（流感、水痘）後4-7天出現的急性腦病變，伴腦水腫與脂肪肝。
  • Avoid aspirin/salicylates in febrile or viral illness; use acetaminophen or ibuprofen.發燒或病毒感染時避免阿斯匹靈/水楊酸類；改用acetaminophen或ibuprofen。
  • Signs: fever, vomiting, lethargy, progressive neurological decline, elevated ammonia, coagulopathy.徵象：發燒、嘔吐、嗜睡、神經狀態進行性惡化、血氨升高、凝血異常。
  • Care: quiet dim environment, neuro checks, ICP monitoring, liver function, I&O, bleeding precautions.照護：安靜昏暗環境、神經評估、ICP監測、肝功能、I&O、出血監測。
PDF p.546, 547

Seizure disorders癲癇

  • Excessive disorganized neuronal discharge; generalized (tonic-clonic, absence, myoclonic, atonic) or partial (simple, complex).神經元過度且無序放電；全身性（強直陣攣、失神、肌躍型、失張力）或局部性（單純、複雜）。
  • During seizure: protect airway, time it, ease to floor and side-lying, cushion head, loosen clothing, clear hazards, never restrain or put anything in the mouth, stay with child.發作時：保護呼吸道、計時、協助躺地並側臥、墊頭、鬆開衣物、清除危險物、勿約束、勿放任何物入口、陪伴在旁。
  • Bedside: suction and oxygen. Postictal: disoriented and sleepy.床邊備吸引與氧氣。發作後：定向力障礙、嗜睡。
  • Home: medical ID, swim with a companion, helmet for biking/skating, take medications on schedule.居家：配戴醫療識別、游泳需有同伴、騎車/溜冰戴安全帽、規律服藥。
PDF p.547

Neural tube defects神經管缺損

  • Failure of neural tube closure; folic acid in childbearing years/pregnancy lowers risk; associated clubfoot, hip dislocation, hydrocephalus.神經管閉合不全；育齡期與孕期補充葉酸可降低風險；常合併內翻足、髖關節脫位、水腦。
  • Spina bifida occulta: vertebral arches fail to close, usually no deficits. Meningocele: meninges and CSF sac, cord not involved. Myelomeningocele: cord/nerve roots in sac, neurological deficits.隱性脊柱裂：椎弓未閉合，通常無神經缺損。脊髓膜膨出：腦膜與腦脊髓液囊，脊髓未受累。脊髓脊膜膨出：脊髓/神經根在囊內，有神經缺損。
  • Myelomeningocele findings: visible defect, flaccid leg paralysis, bladder/bowel dysfunction, hip deformity, hydrocephalus.脊髓脊膜膨出表現：可見缺損、下肢弛緩性麻痺、膀胱/腸道功能異常、髖關節變形、水腦。
  • Care: sterile moist nonadherent saline dressing on sac, aseptic technique, prone positioning (head turned for feeds), measure head circumference, antibiotics, watch for infection.照護：囊上覆蓋無菌濕潤不沾黏生理食鹽水敷料、無菌技術、俯臥（餵食時頭轉向一側）、測頭圍、抗生素、監測感染。
  • Long-term: bladder program/clean intermittent catheterization, antispasmodics, bowel program with fiber and fluids, latex allergy precautions.長期：膀胱計畫/間歇導尿、抗痙攣藥、高纖多水排便計畫、乳膠過敏防護。
PDF p.547, 548

ADHD注意力不足過動症

  • Developmentally inappropriate inattention, overactivity and impulsivity; diagnosed from parent/teacher reports and tools.發展上不適當的注意力不足、過動與衝動；依家長/老師報告與評估工具診斷。
  • Signs: fidgeting, distractibility, not following instructions, shifting tasks, excessive talking, interrupting, risk taking.徵象：坐立不安、易分心、不遵從指示、常轉換任務、多話、打斷他人、冒險行為。
  • Care: behavioral therapy, consistent routine at home/school, safety, self-esteem; stimulants may cause appetite loss, weight loss, nervousness, tics, insomnia, raised BP.照護：行為治療、家庭/學校一致作息、安全、提升自尊；興奮劑可能造成食慾下降、體重減輕、緊張、抽動、失眠、血壓升高。
PDF p.548

Autism spectrum and intellectual disability自閉症類群與智能障礙

  • ASD: impaired social interaction and communication with restricted, repetitive behaviors; usually noticed by age 3; M-CHAT-R screens toddlers.ASD：社交互動與溝通受損並有侷限重複行為；多於3歲前被察覺；M-CHAT-R用於幼兒篩檢。
  • Signs: little social play or comfort-seeking, echolalia/monotone, no gestures, fixation on objects, rigid routines, rocking, head banging, self-injury.徵象：少社交遊戲或尋求安慰、仿說/單調語調、缺乏手勢、執著物品、堅持常規、搖晃、撞頭、自傷。
  • Care: keep routines, use the child's communication method, avoid demands, prevent self-injury; safe environment is priority; refer and support parents.照護：維持常規、使用孩子的溝通方式、避免提出要求、預防自傷；安全環境為優先；轉介並支持家長。
  • Intellectual disability: subaverage intellect plus adaptive deficits; Down syndrome is trisomy 21. Care: multidisciplinary services, self-care skills, communication, play, safety, family support.智能障礙：智力低於平均並合併適應功能缺陷；唐氏症為第21對染色體三體。照護：多專業服務、生活自理訓練、溝通、遊戲、安全、家庭支持。
PDF p.548, 549

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Level of consciousness is the earliest indicator of neurological change.意識程度是神經變化最早的指標。 PDF p.543
  2. Late ICP signs: bradycardia, decreased LOC, pupil changes, posturing, Cheyne-Stokes, coma.晚期ICP徵象：心搏過緩、意識下降、瞳孔改變、僵直姿勢、陳施氏呼吸、昏迷。 PDF p.543
  3. Decorticate = flexion (arms flexed on chest); decerebrate = rigid extension and pronation (midbrain).去皮質＝屈曲（手臂彎向胸前）；去大腦＝僵硬伸直與旋前（中腦）。 PDF p.543
  4. Head injury: HOB 15-30 degrees only after spinal injury ruled out; keep head midline; withhold sedatives.頭部外傷：排除脊椎損傷後才抬高床頭15-30度；頭保持中線；不給鎮靜劑。 PDF p.543
  5. Basilar skull fracture: no nasal suctioning; glucose-positive nasal/ear drainage = CSF leak.顱底骨折：不可經鼻抽吸；鼻/耳液葡萄糖陽性＝腦脊髓液漏。 PDF p.544
  6. One dilated nonreactive pupil may signal epidural hematoma, a neurosurgical emergency.單側瞳孔放大無反應可能為硬膜外血腫，屬神經外科急症。 PDF p.544
  7. Shunt malfunction: infant irritable/lethargic/poor feeding/shrill cry; toddler headache and poor appetite; older child LOC change.分流管故障：嬰兒易怒/嗜睡/拒食/尖哭；幼兒頭痛與食慾差；較大兒童意識改變。 PDF p.545
  8. Post-shunt: lie on unoperated side; raise HOB 15-30 degrees if ICP rises.分流術後：躺在未手術側；ICP上升時床頭抬高15-30度。 PDF p.545
  9. Bacterial meningitis CSF: cloudy, high protein, low glucose, high WBC and pressure.細菌性腦膜炎腦脊髓液：混濁、蛋白高、葡萄糖低、WBC與壓力高。 PDF p.545
  10. Kernig (cannot extend leg with thigh flexed) and Brudzinski signs indicate meningeal irritation.Kernig徵象（大腿屈曲時無法伸直小腿）與Brudzinski徵象代表腦膜刺激。 PDF p.546
  11. Droplet isolation for meningitis until 24 hours after antibiotics; give antibiotics right after LP/cultures.腦膜炎飛沫隔離至抗生素後24小時；腰穿/採檢後立即給抗生素。 PDF p.546
  12. No aspirin for children with viral illness, varicella or influenza (Reye's).病毒感染、水痘或流感的兒童不可使用阿斯匹靈（Reye症候群）。 PDF p.546
  13. Seizure: never put anything in the mouth, never restrain; protect airway, side-lying, time it; bedside suction and oxygen.癲癇：口內不放任何物品、不約束；保護呼吸道、側臥、計時；床邊備吸引與氧氣。 PDF p.547
  14. Myelomeningocele sac: sterile moist nonadherent saline dressing, prone position; high latex allergy risk.脊髓脊膜膨出囊：無菌濕潤不沾黏食鹽水敷料、俯臥；乳膠過敏風險高。 PDF p.548
  15. Folic acid before and during pregnancy reduces neural tube defects.孕前與孕期補充葉酸可減少神經管缺損。 PDF p.547
  16. Autism: maintain routine and safety; avoid placing demands; M-CHAT-R screening.自閉症：維持常規與安全；避免提出要求；使用M-CHAT-R篩檢。 PDF p.549

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Decorticate: 'toward the core' (arms flex to chest). Decerebrate: arms extended 'away', rigid.去皮質（Decorticate）：手臂向「核心」彎向胸前；去大腦（Decerebrate）：手臂伸直遠離。 PDF p.543
  • Cushing triad of late ICP: hypertension (widened pulse pressure), bradycardia, irregular respirations.晚期ICP庫欣三聯徵：高血壓（脈壓增寬）、心搏過緩、呼吸不規則。 PDF p.543, 544

40 Musculoskeletal Problems肌肉骨骼問題（兒科）

Pediatric musculoskeletal disorders: developmental dysplasia of the hip, clubfoot, scoliosis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, Marfan syndrome, Legg-Calve-Perthes disease, fractures with traction and casts, and osteomyelitis.兒童肌肉骨骼疾病：發展性髖關節發育不良、內翻足、脊柱側彎、幼年特發性關節炎、馬凡氏症候群、Legg-Calve-Perthes病、骨折與牽引/石膏、骨髓炎。

Developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH)發展性髖關節發育不良（DDH）

  • Femoral head seated improperly in the acetabulum; degrees: acetabular dysplasia (mildest), subluxation, dislocation.股骨頭未正確位於髖臼；程度：髖臼發育不良（最輕）、半脫位、脫位。
  • Neonate: ligament laxity; positive Ortolani (click as head relocates) and Barlow (head dislocates) tests.新生兒：韌帶鬆弛；Ortolani陽性（股骨頭復位時有彈響）、Barlow陽性（股骨頭脫出）。
  • Infant: shortened leg (Galeazzi/Allis), limited hip abduction, asymmetric gluteal folds.嬰兒：患側肢體縮短（Galeazzi/Allis徵象）、髖外展受限、臀紋不對稱。
  • Older child: shorter leg, positive Trendelenburg (pelvis drops on the normal side), prominent greater trochanter, waddling gait/lordosis if bilateral.較大兒童：患肢較短、Trendelenburg陽性（健側骨盆下垂）、大轉子突出、雙側者鴨步/腰椎前凸。
  • 0-6 months: Pavlik harness (flexion, abduction), worn 23 h/day, removed only for bathing, 6-12 weeks.0-6個月：Pavlik吊帶（屈曲、外展），每天配戴23小時，僅洗澡時取下，6-12週。
  • 6-18 months: traction then closed/open reduction and hip spica cast 6-12 weeks, then brace ~6 weeks; older child needs surgery.6-18個月：牽引後閉鎖/開放復位並打髖人字石膏6-12週，再用支架約6週；較大兒童需手術。
PDF p.554, 555

Congenital clubfoot先天性內翻足

  • Forefoot adduction, midfoot supination, hindfoot varus, ankle equinus; may be unilateral or bilateral.前足內收、中足旋後、後足內翻、踝馬蹄足；可單側或雙側。
