  • Terms: varus = inward, valgus = outward, equinus = plantar flexion (toes lower), calcaneus = dorsiflexion.名詞：varus＝內翻、valgus＝外翻、equinus＝蹠屈（腳趾低於腳跟）、calcaneus＝背屈。
  • Goal: painless, stable plantigrade foot; follow-up to skeletal maturity.目標：無痛、穩定的蹠行足；追蹤至骨骼成熟。
  • Start treatment soon after birth: weekly manipulation and casting 8-12 weeks, then splint; surgery if alignment not achieved by 6-12 weeks of age.出生後盡早治療：每週手法矯正與石膏8-12週，之後夾板；6-12週齡未矯正則手術。
  • Monitor pain and toe neurovascular status; report impairment immediately.監測疼痛與腳趾神經血管狀態；有異常立即通報。
PDF p.555, 556

Idiopathic scoliosis特發性脊柱側彎

  • Three-dimensional spine deformity with lateral curve and rotation; found in preadolescent growth spurt, so screen then.三度空間脊柱變形，含側彎與旋轉；於青春期前生長快速期發現，故需在此時篩檢。
  • Adam's forward-bend test shows rib/flank asymmetry; also uneven shoulders, hips, rib hump; X-ray confirms.Adam前彎測試可見肋骨/腰側不對稱；另有肩、髖不等高、肋骨隆起；X光確診。
  • Brace 16-23 h/day slows progression (not curative); check skin, keep clean/dry, no lotion/powder, soft clothing underneath, exercises, address body image.背架每日16-23小時，減緩進展（非治癒）；檢查皮膚、保持清潔乾燥、不擦乳液/粉、內穿柔軟衣物、運動、處理身體心像。
  • Spinal fusion postop: logroll, keep alignment, neurovascular checks, pulmonary hygiene, pain control, watch for incontinence/infection.脊椎融合術後：軸線翻身、維持排列、神經血管評估、肺部衛生、止痛、注意失禁/感染。
  • Superior mesenteric artery syndrome: vomiting and abdominal distention after fusion; notify the provider.腸繫膜上動脈症候群：融合術後嘔吐與腹脹；通知醫師。
PDF p.556

Juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA)幼年特發性關節炎

  • Autoimmune joint inflammation; no cure; care preserves function and limits deformity via an interprofessional team.自體免疫性關節發炎；無法治癒；由跨專業團隊保存功能並減少變形。
  • Findings: stiff, swollen, warm, tender joints, morning stiffness and after inactivity; uveitis may cause blindness; no definitive test (ESR, WBC may be raised).表現：關節僵硬、腫脹、發熱、壓痛；晨僵與休息後僵硬；葡萄膜炎可致失明；無決定性檢驗（ESR、WBC可能升高）。
  • Meds: intra-articular steroids for few joints; short low-dose oral steroids; DMARDs and biologics (anti-TNF) second line.藥物：少數關節用關節內類固醇；短期低劑量口服類固醇；DMARDs與生物製劑（抗TNF）為第二線。
  • Care: ROM, heat/cold, splinting in neutral position, isometric exercises during flares, PT/OT, regular eye exams, support normal ADLs.照護：關節活動、冷熱敷、中立位夾板、發作期做等長運動、PT/OT、定期眼科檢查、鼓勵一般日常活動。
PDF p.556, 557

Marfan syndrome馬凡氏症候群

  • Connective tissue disorder (fibrillin-1 gene) affecting skeletal, cardiovascular and ocular systems; no cure.結締組織疾病（fibrillin-1基因），影響骨骼、心血管與眼睛；無法治癒。
  • Tall thin build, long limbs and slender fingers, spinal curvature, vision and heart problems.高瘦體型、長肢細指、脊柱彎曲、視力與心臟問題。
  • Care: regular eye exams, monitor spine, heart-rate-slowing drugs to protect aorta, avoid competitive and contact sports, antibiotic prophylaxis before dental work, possible aortic root surgery.照護：定期眼科檢查、監測脊柱、減慢心率藥物保護主動脈、避免競技與接觸性運動、牙科處置前預防性抗生素、可能需主動脈根部手術。
PDF p.557

Legg-Calve-Perthes diseaseLegg-Calve-Perthes病

  • Temporary loss of blood supply to the femoral head causes bone death and growth arrest.股骨頭血供暫時中斷，造成骨壞死與生長停止。
  • Signs: limp, hip/groin/thigh/knee pain or stiffness, limited ROM.徵象：跛行、髖/鼠蹊/大腿/膝痛或僵硬、關節活動受限。
  • Care: PT stretching, crutches to avoid weight bearing, bed rest/traction if severe, casting, night brace, hip surgery.照護：物理治療伸展、拐杖避免患髖承重、重症臥床/牽引、石膏、夜間支架、髖部手術。
PDF p.557, 558

Fractures, traction and casts骨折、牽引與石膏

  • Fractures in infancy are rare: investigate for child abuse and bone disease.嬰兒期骨折少見：須調查是否為兒虐或骨骼疾病。
  • Signs: pain, deformity, edema, bruising, spasm, loss of function, crepitus.徵象：疼痛、變形、水腫、瘀青、肌肉痙攣、功能喪失、骨摩擦音。
  • First aid: immobilize, check neurovascular status, cover open wound with sterile dressing, elevate, apply cold, transport.急救：固定、檢查神經血管、開放傷口以無菌敷料覆蓋、抬高、冰敷、送醫。
  • Reduction is closed (manual) or open (internal fixation); retention with traction or cast.復位分閉鎖（手法）與開放（內固定）；以牽引或石膏維持。
  • Traction: Russell, balanced suspension, 90-90; keep prescribed weights hanging freely, ropes in pulleys and unfrayed, neurovascular checks, pin care, prevent immobility complications, provide play.牽引：Russell、平衡懸吊、90-90牽引；依醫囑重量並使重物自由懸空、繩索在滑輪上且無磨損、神經血管評估、針道護理、預防不動併發症、提供遊戲。
  • Cast care: check for pressure/hot spots, petal rough edges, keep clean and dry, no objects inside, isometric exercise; signs of compartment syndrome (pain beyond expected, pallor, numbness, coolness, diminished pulse) = notify PHCP, bivalve cast, possible fasciotomy.石膏照護：檢查壓迫/熱點、邊緣修平、保持乾燥清潔、不塞異物、等長運動；骨筋膜室症候群徵象（疼痛過度、蒼白、麻木、冰冷、脈搏減弱）＝通知醫師、剖開石膏、可能需筋膜切開術。
PDF p.558, 559

Osteomyelitis骨髓炎

  • Bone infection, usually Staphylococcus aureus.骨骼感染，常見金黃色葡萄球菌。
  • Signs: pain, fever, irritability, lethargy, warm tender limb, decreased ROM.徵象：疼痛、發燒、易怒、嗜睡、患肢溫熱壓痛、活動受限。
  • Care: comfort positioning, splint, non-weight bearing; start antibiotics after cultures; long-term IV (PICC); surgery if no response; pain control, PT/OT.照護：舒適擺位、夾板、免承重；採檢後開始抗生素；長期靜脈（PICC）；無效則手術；止痛、PT/OT。
PDF p.559

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Pavlik harness: worn 23 hours/day, removed only for bathing; maintains flexion and abduction.Pavlik吊帶：每天23小時，僅洗澡取下；維持屈曲與外展。 PDF p.554
  2. Ortolani = relocation click; Barlow = dislocation; asymmetrical gluteal folds and limited abduction in infants.Ortolani＝復位彈響；Barlow＝脫位；嬰兒臀紋不對稱與外展受限。 PDF p.554
  3. Positive Trendelenburg sign in older child with DDH.較大兒童DDH：Trendelenburg徵象陽性。 PDF p.554
  4. Clubfoot treatment begins immediately after birth with weekly casting for 8-12 weeks.內翻足出生後立即開始，每週石膏約8-12週。 PDF p.556
  5. Neurovascular compromise in a casted extremity: notify PHCP immediately; prepare for bivalving.石膏肢體神經血管受損：立即通報；準備剖開石膏。 PDF p.556, 559
  6. Scoliosis screening: Adam's forward-bend test during preadolescent growth spurt.脊柱側彎篩檢：青春期前生長期做Adam前彎測試。 PDF p.556
  7. Brace 16-23 h/day; no lotions or powders under brace; soft cloth underneath.背架每天16-23小時；架下不擦乳液/粉；內穿柔軟布料。 PDF p.556
  8. After spinal fusion: logroll; vomiting with abdominal distention = superior mesenteric artery syndrome; call provider.脊椎融合後：軸線翻身；嘔吐加腹脹＝腸繫膜上動脈症候群；通知醫師。 PDF p.556
  9. JIA: morning stiffness, uveitis risk (eye exams); no definitive test.JIA：晨僵、葡萄膜炎風險（需眼科檢查）；無決定性檢驗。 PDF p.557
  10. JIA flares: isometric exercises, neutral splinting, heat/cold.JIA發作期：等長運動、中立位夾板、冷熱敷。 PDF p.557
  11. Marfan: avoid contact/competitive sports; antibiotics before dental work; aortic and eye monitoring.馬凡氏症：避免接觸/競技運動；牙科前預防性抗生素；監測主動脈與眼睛。 PDF p.557
  12. Legg-Calve-Perthes: avascular necrosis of femoral head; crutches, avoid weight bearing.Legg-Calve-Perthes：股骨頭缺血性壞死；用拐杖、避免承重。 PDF p.557, 558
  13. Infant fracture: consider child abuse.嬰兒骨折：須考慮兒虐。 PDF p.558
  14. Traction: weights hang freely, ropes in pulleys; absent distal pulse = emergency, notify provider (do not release traction without order).牽引：重物自由懸空、繩在滑輪上；遠端脈搏消失＝緊急，通知醫師（無醫囑不可放鬆牽引）。 PDF p.558
  15. No lotion/powder, objects, or shoe polish on or in a cast; no heating pad for cold fingers.石膏上或內不使用乳液/粉、異物、鞋油；手指冰冷不可用熱敷墊。 PDF p.559
  16. Osteomyelitis: get cultures before antibiotics; S. aureus most common.骨髓炎：先採檢再給抗生素；以金黃色葡萄球菌最常見。 PDF p.559

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Compartment syndrome '6 Ps': Pain, Pallor, Pulselessness, Paresthesia, Paralysis, Pressure (poikilothermia/coolness).骨筋膜室症候群「6P」：疼痛、蒼白、無脈、感覺異常、麻痺、壓力（及冰冷）。 PDF p.559
  • Ortolani = 'Out to In' (click as head moves into socket); Barlow = 'Out the back' (head pops out).Ortolani＝「入」（股骨頭回到髖臼有彈響）；Barlow＝「出」（股骨頭向後脫出）。 PDF p.554

41 Immune Problems and Infectious Diseases免疫問題與傳染病（兒科）

Pediatric HIV/AIDS (diagnosis, prophylaxis, immunization, home care) and common childhood communicable diseases: measles, roseola, rubella, mumps, varicella, pertussis, diphtheria, polio, scarlet fever, fifth disease, mononucleosis, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, CA-MRSA, influenza and COVID-19, with isolation precautions.兒童HIV/AIDS（診斷、預防性用藥、疫苗、居家照護）與常見兒童傳染病：麻疹、玫瑰疹、德國麻疹、腮腺炎、水痘、百日咳、白喉、小兒麻痺、猩紅熱、第五病、傳染性單核球增多症、落磯山斑疹熱、社區型MRSA、流感與COVID-19，以及隔離措施。

Transmission precautions and HIV/AIDS basics傳染防護與HIV/AIDS基礎

  • Standard precautions for all children; add airborne, droplet or contact precautions by disease (e.g., influenza plus wound infection needs both).所有兒童採標準防護；依疾病加上空氣、飛沫或接觸防護（如流感併傷口感染則需多重）。
  • HIV infects CD4+ T cells, causing progressive immunodeficiency and opportunistic infections.HIV感染CD4+ T細胞，造成進行性免疫缺損與伺機性感染。
  • Spread by blood, semen, vaginal secretions and human milk; vertical (perinatal) or horizontal (sexual, parenteral).經血液、精液、陰道分泌物與母乳傳播；垂直（周產期）或水平（性接觸、血液）。
  • Most common opportunistic infection in children: Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia, often at 3-6 months; cough is a common sign.兒童最常見的伺機性感染：肺囊蟲肺炎（P. jiroveci），常見於3-6個月；咳嗽為常見徵象。
  • Findings: failure to thrive, chronic diarrhea/cough, oral candidiasis, lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly, parotitis, developmental delay or regression.表現：生長遲滯、慢性腹瀉/咳嗽、口腔念珠菌感染、淋巴結腫大、肝脾腫大、腮腺炎、發展遲緩或退化。
PDF p.564, 565

HIV testing, treatment and immunizationHIV檢測、治療與疫苗

  • Under 18 months: use PCR (proviral DNA) or p24 antigen, accurate at 1-4 months; ELISA/Western blot only from 18 months because maternal antibodies cross the placenta.18個月以下：用PCR（前病毒DNA）或p24抗原，1-4個月最準；ELISA/Western blot需18個月後才用，因母體抗體會經胎盤傳給嬰兒。
  • CD4+ counts are age-adjusted; severe suppression <15% or <750/uL (<12 mo), <500 (1-5 y), <200 (6-12 y).CD4+數值需依年齡校正；嚴重抑制為<15%或<750/uL（<12個月）、<500（1-5歲）、<200（6-12歲）。
  • Goals: slow viral replication with combination antiretrovirals, prevent/treat opportunistic infections, nutrition, symptom control; PJP prophylaxis especially in first year of life.目標：以複合抗反轉錄病毒藥物減緩病毒複製、預防/治療伺機性感染、營養、症狀控制；尤其出生第一年給予PJP預防。
  • Immunize all HIV-exposed/infected children; if symptomatic or severely immunosuppressed use only inactivated vaccines (IM influenza yearly, inactivated polio); no measles, varicella or rotavirus vaccine; give VZIG after varicella exposure and immunoglobulin after measles exposure.所有HIV暴露/感染兒童皆應接種疫苗；有症狀或重度免疫抑制時僅用不活化疫苗（每年IM流感、不活化小兒麻痺）；不給麻疹、水痘、輪狀病毒疫苗；水痘暴露後給VZIG，麻疹暴露後給免疫球蛋白。
PDF p.565, 566

HIV home care and adolescent educationHIV居家照護與青少年衛教

  • Frequent handwashing, gloves with body fluids, avoid contagious contacts, keep child home when sick, keep immunizations current.勤洗手、接觸體液戴手套、避免接觸傳染性病人、生病在家休養、疫苗按時接種。
  • Report fever, malaise, weight loss, vomiting, diarrhea, oral lesions; monitor weight; high-calorie, high-protein diet; no raw meat/fish or unwashed produce if immunosuppressed.發燒、倦怠、體重減輕、嘔吐、腹瀉、口腔病灶需通報；監測體重；高熱量高蛋白飲食；免疫低下時避免生肉/魚與未洗蔬果。
  • Dishwasher for utensils; discard unused food/formula after 24 h; fold soiled diapers inward into covered bin; clean spills with bleach 1:10 (bleach:water as 10 water to 1 bleach).餐具用洗碗機清洗；未食用食物/配方奶24小時後丟棄；髒尿布向內摺並放入有蓋垃圾桶；體液外溢以漂白水（水:漂白水=10:1）清理。
  • Adolescents: teach transmission, abstinence, condoms, risk reduction and support resources.青少年：教導傳染途徑、禁慾、保險套、降低風險與支持資源。
PDF p.566

Measles, roseola, rubella, mumps麻疹、玫瑰疹、德國麻疹、腮腺炎

  • Measles (rubeola): the 3 Cs (coryza, cough, conjunctivitis), Koplik spots (blue-white spots with red base on buccal mucosa), rash from face downward; airborne + contact precautions, rest, cool mist, dim lights, vitamin A.麻疹：3C（鼻炎、咳嗽、結膜炎）、Koplik斑（頰黏膜藍白點、紅底）、紅疹由臉向下蔓延；空氣+接觸防護、休息、冷霧、調暗燈光、補充維生素A。
  • Roseola (HHV-6): high fever 3-5 days in a well-looking child, then rose-pink rash after fever breaks; febrile seizures possible; supportive care.玫瑰疹（HHV-6）：外觀良好的孩子高燒3-5天，退燒後出現玫瑰色疹；可能熱痙攣；支持性照護。
  • Rubella: low fever, face-to-body pink maculopapular rash in 1-3 days, soft palate petechiae; airborne/droplet/contact precautions; keep away from pregnant persons.德國麻疹：低燒、1-3天內由臉蔓延全身的粉紅斑丘疹、軟顎瘀點；空氣/飛沫/接觸防護；遠離孕婦。
  • Mumps: parotid swelling, jaw/ear pain with chewing, orchitis, deafness, aseptic meningitis; droplet + contact precautions, soft foods, rest, scrotal support; lethargy/vomiting means evaluate for meningitis.腮腺炎：腮腺腫脹、咀嚼時下顎/耳痛、睪丸炎、耳聾、無菌性腦膜炎；飛沫+接觸防護、軟食、休息、陰囊托高；嗜睡/嘔吐需評估腦膜炎。
PDF p.566, 567, 568

Varicella, pertussis, diphtheria, polio水痘、百日咳、白喉、小兒麻痺

  • Varicella: macules to vesicles to crusts, trunk and scalp first; contagious 1-2 days before rash until all crusted (about 6 days); airborne, droplet and contact precautions; VZIG/IVIG for high-risk exposed children.水痘：斑疹→水泡→結痂，先出現於軀幹與頭皮；出疹前1-2天至全部結痂（約6天）具傳染力；空氣、飛沫與接觸防護；高風險暴露兒童給VZIG/IVIG。
  • Pertussis: cough with loud whoop, cyanosis, tongue protrusion; droplet + contact precautions, antibiotics, avoid cough triggers, hydration, suction/oxygen; contagious in catarrhal stage; infants lack maternal immunity, so Tdap for postpartum parent and close contacts.百日咳：咳嗽伴吸氣哮鳴、發紺、吐舌；飛沫+接觸防護、抗生素、避免誘發咳嗽因素、補水、吸痰/氧氣；卡他期傳染力最強；嬰兒無母體免疫，產後父母與密切接觸者接種Tdap。
  • Diphtheria: sore throat, foul nasal discharge, dense pseudomembrane, bull neck; strict isolation, antitoxin after horse-serum sensitivity test, antibiotics, suction, trach care.白喉：喉嚨痛、惡臭鼻分泌物、厚偽膜、牛頸；嚴格隔離、先做馬血清過敏測試再給抗毒素、抗生素、吸痰、氣切護理。
  • Polio: enterovirus, fecal-oral; fever, stiffness, possible paralysis; enteric and contact precautions, watch respiratory paralysis, PT.小兒麻痺：腸病毒、糞口傳染；發燒、僵硬、可能麻痺；腸道與接觸防護、注意呼吸麻痺、物理治療。
PDF p.568, 569

Scarlet fever, fifth disease, mononucleosis, RMSF猩紅熱、第五病、單核球增多症、落磯山斑疹熱

  • Scarlet fever (group A strep): sandpaper rash sparing face, Pastia lines, strawberry tongue, desquamation of palms/soles; contact + droplet precautions until 24 h of antibiotics.猩紅熱（A群鏈球菌）：砂紙樣疹、臉部不受影響、Pastia線、草莓舌、掌蹠脫皮；接觸+飛沫防護至抗生素24小時後。
  • Fifth disease (parvovirus B19): slapped-cheek rash then lacy rash on extremities; supportive; pregnant contacts should call their provider.第五病（微小病毒B19）：拍打臉頰樣紅斑，之後四肢網狀疹；支持性照護；孕婦接觸者應通知醫師。
  • Mononucleosis (EBV): fever, sore throat, lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly; teach splenic rupture signs (LUQ/left shoulder pain, abdominal pain).傳染性單核球增多症（EBV）：發燒、喉痛、淋巴結腫、肝脾腫大；教導脾破裂徵象（左上腹/左肩/腹痛）。
  • Rocky Mountain spotted fever (tick-borne Rickettsia): fever, headache, rash on wrists/ankles spreading to palms/soles; antibiotics; prevention box on tick bites.落磯山斑疹熱（蜱傳立克次體）：發燒、頭痛、手腕腳踝紅疹並擴及掌蹠；抗生素；蜱咬預防。
  • Tick removal: tweezers at skin, pull straight up steadily, save tick, wash hands; wear light long clothing, DEET/permethrin with caution.移除蜱：鑷子貼近皮膚、穩定向上直拉、保留蜱、洗手；穿淺色長袖長褲、謹慎使用DEET/permethrin。
PDF p.569, 570, 571

CA-MRSA, influenza and COVID-19社區型MRSA、流感與COVID-19

  • CA-MRSA: infection in a healthy person without recent health-care exposure; spread by contact and contaminated items; red, warm, painful, pus-draining skin lesion; can progress to sepsis.CA-MRSA：無近期醫療接觸的健康者感染；經接觸與污染物品傳播；皮膚紅腫熱痛流膿；可進展為敗血症。
  • Prevention: handwashing, no sharing personal items, clean shared equipment, cover wounds; care: assess, drainage and cultures, antibiotics.預防：洗手、不共用個人物品、清潔共用器材、覆蓋傷口；處置：評估、引流與培養、抗生素。
  • Influenza: sudden high fever, aches, cough; annual vaccine, hand hygiene, keep home until fever-free 24 h without antipyretics; antivirals, fluids, rest.流感：突發高燒、痠痛、咳嗽；每年疫苗、手部衛生、無退燒藥下退燒24小時後才返校；抗病毒藥、補水、休息。
  • COVID-19: droplet/airborne + contact precautions; fever and cough common; seek care for breathing difficulty, cyanosis, confusion, inability to keep fluids; watch for pediatric inflammatory multisystem syndrome (Kawasaki-like).COVID-19：飛沫/空氣+接觸防護；常見發燒咳嗽；呼吸困難、發紺、意識混亂、無法進水需就醫；注意兒童多系統發炎症候群（類川崎病）。
  • Immunization schedules follow Chapter 19 and CDC guidance.疫苗時程參照第19章與CDC指引。
PDF p.571, 572

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. P. jiroveci pneumonia is the most common opportunistic infection in HIV-infected children (peak 3-6 months); cough is a key sign.肺囊蟲肺炎為HIV感染兒童最常見伺機性感染（高峰3-6個月）；咳嗽為關鍵徵象。 PDF p.564
  2. Infants <18 months: PCR or p24 antigen, not ELISA (maternal antibodies cross placenta).18個月以下嬰兒：使用PCR或p24抗原，而非ELISA（母體抗體經胎盤）。 PDF p.565
  3. Symptomatic/immunosuppressed HIV child: no live vaccines (measles, varicella, rotavirus); IM inactivated influenza yearly.有症狀/免疫抑制之HIV兒童：不給活性疫苗（麻疹、水痘、輪狀病毒）；每年IM不活化流感疫苗。 PDF p.566
  4. HIV-infected child with fever must stay home; clean body fluid spills with bleach (alcohol ineffective).HIV感染兒童發燒須留在家中；體液外溢用漂白水清理（酒精無效）。 PDF p.566
  5. Measles: Koplik spots, 3 Cs, airborne + contact precautions, vitamin A.麻疹：Koplik斑、3C、空氣+接觸防護、維生素A。 PDF p.566
  6. Roseola: high fever first, rash appears after fever resolves.玫瑰疹：先高燒，退燒後才出疹。 PDF p.567
  7. Rubella: isolate from pregnant persons.德國麻疹：需與孕婦隔離。 PDF p.567
  8. Mumps with lethargy or vomiting: suspect aseptic meningitis, child needs to be seen; orchitis supported with snug underwear.腮腺炎合併嗜睡或嘔吐：懷疑無菌性腦膜炎，需就診；睪丸炎以合身內褲托高。 PDF p.567, 568
  9. Varicella: airborne, droplet and contact precautions; contagious until all lesions crusted; VZIG for susceptible immunocompromised exposures.水痘：空氣、飛沫、接觸防護；全部結痂前具傳染力；易感免疫低下者暴露後給VZIG。 PDF p.568
  10. Pertussis: droplet precautions during catarrhal stage; no isolation needed in convalescence; Tdap for caregivers.百日咳：卡他期飛沫防護；恢復期不需隔離；照顧者接種Tdap。 PDF p.568, 569
  11. Diphtheria antitoxin requires horse-serum sensitivity testing first; pseudomembrane threatens airway.白喉抗毒素需先做馬血清過敏測試；偽膜威脅呼吸道。 PDF p.569
  12. Scarlet fever: sandpaper rash, strawberry tongue, Pastia lines; precautions until 24 h of antibiotics.猩紅熱：砂紙疹、草莓舌、Pastia線；抗生素24小時內仍需防護。 PDF p.569
  13. Fifth disease: slapped-cheek rash; pregnant contacts notify provider.第五病：拍臉頰疹；孕婦接觸者通知醫師。 PDF p.570
  14. Mononucleosis: avoid contact sports; report LUQ or left-shoulder pain (splenic rupture).單核球增多症：避免接觸性運動；左上腹或左肩痛需通報（脾破裂）。 PDF p.570
  15. RMSF: rash on wrists/ankles and palms/soles after tick bite; remove tick with tweezers straight up.落磯山斑疹熱：蜱咬後手腕腳踝及掌蹠出疹；用鑷子垂直向上移除蜱。 PDF p.570, 571
  16. Influenza: return to school after 24 h fever-free without antipyretics.流感：無退燒藥下退燒24小時後才可返校。 PDF p.571, 572

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Measles '3 Cs + K': Coryza, Cough, Conjunctivitis, Koplik spots.麻疹「3C+K」：鼻炎、咳嗽、結膜炎、Koplik斑。 PDF p.566
  • Rash direction: measles and rubella start on the face and go down; scarlet fever spares the face; RMSF starts on wrists/ankles.疹子方向：麻疹與德國麻疹由臉往下；猩紅熱臉部不受影響；RMSF由手腕腳踝開始。 PDF p.566, 567, 569, 570
  • Roseola: 'Rash Only after Fever' (rose rash after fever ends).玫瑰疹：「燒退才疹」。 PDF p.567

42 Pediatric Medication Administration and Calculations兒童給藥與劑量計算

Safe medication administration in children: oral, subcutaneous/IM and IV routes, equipment such as burettes and syringe pumps, weight-based and BSA-based dose calculations, safe-dose checks, and age-appropriate approaches to give medications.兒童安全給藥：口服、皮下/肌肉與靜脈途徑、燒瓶（burette）與注射幫浦等設備、依體重與體表面積計算劑量、安全劑量檢核，以及依年齡的給藥技巧。

Oral medications口服藥物

  • Most pediatric oral drugs are liquids, suspensions or chewables; measure with an oral syringe or suitable device chosen for developmental age.兒童口服藥多為液劑、懸液或咀嚼錠；依發展年齡以口服針筒或適當器具測量。
  • Shake suspensions well and give immediately after measuring so no drug settles out.懸液需充分搖勻，量好後立即給藥，避免藥物沉澱造成劑量不足。
  • Give upright with head elevated to prevent aspiration; hold small child sideways on lap, syringe toward the side/back of the cheek, slowly.採直立、頭抬高以防吸入；小兒側抱於腿上，針筒置於頰側後方，緩慢給予。
  • Check the mouth after tablets; enteric-coated, timed-release tablets and capsules must not be crushed.給錠劑後檢查口腔；腸溶錠、緩釋錠與膠囊不可壓碎。
  • Newborns and infants have immature liver and kidneys, so drug metabolism and elimination are delayed.新生兒與嬰兒肝腎功能未成熟，藥物代謝與排除延遲。
PDF p.578

Medication guidelines for children兒童給藥原則

  • Use two identifiers (name, MRN, birth date); ask parents about allergies and successful methods.使用兩項辨識（姓名、病歷號、生日）；詢問家長過敏史與成功的給藥方式。
  • Do not hide medication in food, milk or formula (may cause refusal and incomplete dose).不要將藥混入食物、牛奶或配方奶（可能導致拒食且劑量不足）。
  • For bad taste: pinch nose and drink through a straw; offer juice or a frozen juice bar afterward.味道不佳時：捏鼻並用吸管喝；服藥後可給果汁或冰棒。
  • Record the most successful method on the care plan.將最成功的給藥方式記錄於護理計畫。
PDF p.579

Subcutaneous and intramuscular injections皮下與肌肉注射

  • Subcutaneous: insulin and some vaccines; sites include lateral upper arm, abdomen, anterior thigh.皮下注射：胰島素與部分疫苗；部位為上臂外側、腹部、大腿前側。
  • Infants: vastus lateralis is the preferred IM site; infant deltoid is not recommended.嬰兒：肌肉注射首選股外側肌；嬰兒不建議用三角肌。
  • IM volumes: vastus lateralis and ventrogluteal 0.5 mL infant, 0.5-2 mL child; deltoid 0.5-1 mL child.肌肉注射量：股外側肌與腹臀肌嬰兒0.5 mL、兒童0.5-2 mL；三角肌兒童0.5-1 mL。
  • Needle 22-25 gauge, about 5/8 to 1 inch; estimate length as half of the pinched muscle; small doses measured to nearest hundredth in a tuberculin syringe.針頭22-25號，約5/8至1吋；長度約為捏起肌肉厚度的一半；小劑量用結核菌素針筒測至百分位。
  • Place an adhesive bandage afterward.注射後貼上膠布。
PDF p.578, 579

Intravenous medications靜脈給藥

  • IV drugs are diluted; assess site for inflammation, infiltration or extravasation before, during and after.靜脈藥物需稀釋；給藥前、中、後評估注射部位有無發炎、滲漏或外滲。
  • Flush with normal saline (3-20 mL by policy) before and after, at the same rate as the drug; include flush volume in intake.給藥前後用生理食鹽水沖洗（依規定3-20 mL），速度與藥物相同；沖洗量計入輸入量。
  • Always use pumps/controllers; burette sets are microdrip (60 gtt/mL), 100-150 mL capacity, in 1-mL increments; label clearly.一律使用幫浦/控制器；burette為微滴型（60 gtt/mL）、容量100-150 mL、刻度1 mL；需清楚標示。
  • Syringe pump connects via Y-connector and delivers over the prescribed time.注射幫浦經Y型接頭連接，於指定時間內輸注。
  • Track 24-hour fluid intake including flushes to prevent overhydration.追蹤24小時輸液量（含沖洗量）以防水分過量。
PDF p.579, 580

Dose calculation by weight and BSA依體重與體表面積計算劑量

  • lb to kg: divide by 2.2; kg to lb: multiply by 2.2 (nearest tenth).磅轉公斤：除以2.2；公斤轉磅：乘以2.2（取至小數點後一位）。
  • Steps: convert weight, compute total daily dose (mg/kg/day x kg), divide by number of doses, compare with safe range.步驟：換算體重、計算每日總量（mg/kg/day x kg）、除以劑數、與安全範圍比較。
  • Example: ceftriaxone 500 mg for a 15 lb (6.8 kg) child; safe 50-75 mg/kg = 340-510 mg, so safe. Ampicillin 850 mg for 36 lb (16.4 kg) at 50 mg/kg = 820 mg, so unsafe.例：15磅（6.8 kg）孩童ceftriaxone 500 mg；安全範圍50-75 mg/kg＝340-510 mg，故安全。36磅（16.4 kg）ampicillin 850 mg，50 mg/kg＝820 mg，故不安全。
  • BSA dosing: dose per m2 x BSA (4 mg/m2 x 1.1 m2 = 4.4 mg); child dose from adult dose = (child BSA / 1.73) x adult dose.體表面積劑量：每m2劑量 x BSA（4 mg/m2 x 1.1 m2＝4.4 mg）；由成人劑量換算＝（兒童BSA/1.73）x 成人劑量。
  • If weight is unavailable in an emergency use a length-based tape (Broselow).緊急且無體重時使用依身長估算的Broselow色碼尺。
PDF p.580, 581

Developmental considerations發展階段考量

  • Infants: perform quickly, then hold and comfort; pacifier allowed.嬰兒：快速執行，之後擁抱安撫；可用奶嘴。
  • Toddlers and preschoolers: brief concrete explanation then perform; accept reasonable aggression; comfort afterward.幼兒與學齡前：簡短具體說明後立即執行；合理接受攻擊行為；事後安撫。
  • School-age: explain, offer some control, therapeutic play, set limits (crying ok, biting not).學齡兒童：說明並給予部分控制權、治療性遊戲、設定界線（可哭不可咬人）。
  • Adolescents: explain, allow control, encourage participation and self-expression.青少年：說明、給予控制權、鼓勵參與與自我表達。
  • Ask parents whether they want to stay present; plan comfort measures before and after.詢問家長是否願意在場；事前事後規劃安撫措施。
PDF p.581, 582

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Never mix medication into food, milk or formula.不可將藥物混入食物、牛奶或配方奶。 PDF p.579
  2. Suspensions: mix well and administer immediately after measuring.懸液：搖勻並於量好後立即給藥。 PDF p.578
  3. Do not crush enteric-coated or timed-release tablets or capsules.不可壓碎腸溶錠、緩釋錠或膠囊。 PDF p.578
  4. Vastus lateralis is the best IM site for infants (deltoid not recommended).嬰兒最佳肌肉注射部位為股外側肌（不建議三角肌）。 PDF p.579
  5. IM volumes: infant 0.5 mL; child 0.5-2 mL (deltoid 0.5-1 mL).肌肉注射量：嬰兒0.5 mL；兒童0.5-2 mL（三角肌0.5-1 mL）。 PDF p.579
  6. Two identifiers before every administration.每次給藥前使用兩項辨識。 PDF p.579
  7. lb to kg: divide by 2.2.磅轉公斤：除以2.2。 PDF p.581
  8. Always check the calculated dose against the safe mg/kg range before giving.給藥前一律以安全mg/kg範圍檢核計算劑量。 PDF p.581
  9. Include IV flush volumes (3-20 mL) in intake; use pumps for all IV fluids and intermittent medications.靜脈沖洗量（3-20 mL）計入輸入量；所有靜脈輸液與間歇藥物使用幫浦。 PDF p.580
  10. Burette sets are microdrip, 60 gtt/mL.Burette為微滴型，60 gtt/mL。 PDF p.580
  11. Assess IV site for infiltration/extravasation before, during, after each IV medication.每次靜脈給藥前、中、後評估有無滲漏/外滲。 PDF p.579
  12. Infants have delayed drug metabolism/elimination due to immature liver and kidneys.嬰兒肝腎未成熟，藥物代謝與排除延遲。 PDF p.578

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Dose formula: Desired / Available x Volume (D/H x Q).劑量公式：所需劑量/現有劑量 x 容量（D/H x Q）。 PDF p.583
  • Pounds to kilograms: 'divide by 2.2'; kilograms to pounds: 'multiply by 2.2' (kilo is bigger number of pounds).磅轉公斤「除2.2」；公斤轉磅「乘2.2」（同重量用磅的數字較大）。 PDF p.581

43 Integumentary Problems皮膚系統問題（成人）

Adult integumentary content: skin anatomy and risk factors, wound healing, diagnostic tests, fungal/viral/bacterial skin infections (Candida, herpes zoster, MRSA, cellulitis), contact dermatitis, bites and stings, frostbite, skin cancer, psoriasis, acne, Stevens-Johnson syndrome and pressure injury.成人皮膚系統：皮膚解剖與危險因子、傷口癒合、診斷檢查、真菌/病毒/細菌性皮膚感染（念珠菌、帶狀疱疹、MRSA、蜂窩性組織炎）、接觸性皮膚炎、咬傷與螫傷、凍傷、皮膚癌、乾癬、痤瘡、史蒂文斯-強生症候群與壓力性損傷。

Skin anatomy, risks and psychosocial impact皮膚解剖、危險因子與心理社會影響

  • Skin is the largest organ: barrier against infection, sensation, thermoregulation, excretion, prevents water loss, vitamin D synthesis, nutrient storage.皮膚是最大器官：感染屏障、感覺、體溫調節、排泄、防止水分流失、合成維生素D、儲存養分。
  • Layers: epidermis, dermis, hypodermis; appendages: nails, hair, sebaceous and sweat glands; acidic pH 4.2-5.6 limits bacterial growth.層次：表皮、真皮、皮下組織；附屬物：指甲、毛髮、皮脂腺與汗腺；pH 4.2-5.6的酸性環境抑制細菌。
  • Risks: sun/tanning, radiation, pollutants, poor hygiene, harsh soaps, long-term glucocorticoids, nutritional deficiency, stress, infection, repeated injury, genetics, systemic illness.危險因子：日曬/日光浴、輻射、污染物、衛生不良、強效肥皂、長期糖皮質激素、營養不良、壓力、感染、反覆損傷、遺傳、全身性疾病。
  • Psychosocial effects: body-image change, low self-esteem, social isolation, pain, activity limits, cost.心理社會影響：身體心像改變、自尊低落、社交孤立、疼痛、活動受限、費用負擔。
PDF p.587

Wound healing傷口癒合

  • Inflammatory phase 3-5 days (edema, pain, redness, warmth); fibroblastic from day 4 for 2-4 weeks (granulation tissue, scar); maturation from ~3 weeks up to 1 year.發炎期3-5天（水腫、疼痛、紅、熱）；纖維母細胞期自第4天起2-4週（肉芽組織、疤痕）；成熟期約3週起可達1年。
  • First intention: edges approximated (sutures). Second: tissue loss fills in gradually. Third: delayed primary closure after being left open for cleaning.第一癒合：傷口緣對合（縫合）。第二癒合：組織缺損逐漸填補。第三癒合：先敞開清創後延遲縫合。
  • Drainage: serous (clear) and serosanguineous (pink) normal; sanguineous and hemorrhagic abnormal; purulent (yellow/gray/green) means infection.引流液：漿液性（清澈）與漿液血性（粉紅）屬正常；血性與出血為異常；膿性（黃/灰/綠）表示感染。
PDF p.587, 588

Diagnostic tests診斷檢查

  • Skin biopsy (punch, excisional, shave): confirm consent, send specimen to pathology; keep dressing on at least 8 h; sutures out in 7-10 days; report drainage, redness.皮膚切片（打孔、切除、削切）：確認同意書、送病理；敷料至少保留8小時；7-10天拆線；通報滲液、紅腫。
  • Skin/wound culture: obtain before antibiotics; viral cultures go on ice; nasal swab screens exposure.皮膚/傷口培養：於抗生素前採檢；病毒培養置冰上；鼻腔拭子篩檢帶菌。
  • Wood's light (UV) identifies superficial infections: darken room, reassure that light is harmless, help adjust afterward.伍氏燈（紫外線）辨識表淺感染：暗室、說明無害、事後協助適應光線。
  • Diascopy: press glass slide on lesion to blanch erythema.玻片壓診：以玻片壓迫病灶使紅斑褪色以便觀察。
PDF p.588

Candida, herpes zoster and MRSA念珠菌、帶狀疱疹與MRSA

  • Candida: superficial yeast infection (skinfolds, perineum, axilla, mouth thrush); risk: immunosuppression, long antibiotics, diabetes, obesity; keep folds clean/dry, mouth care, antifungals.念珠菌：表淺酵母感染（皮膚皺褶、會陰、腋下、口腔鵝口瘡）；危險因子：免疫抑制、長期抗生素、糖尿病、肥胖；保持皺褶乾燥、口腔護理、抗黴菌藥。
  • Shingles: reactivated varicella-zoster in dorsal root ganglia; unilateral segmental vesicles with burning pain; Tzanck smear/viral culture; postherpetic neuralgia possible.帶狀疱疹：水痘帶狀疱疹病毒於背根神經節再活化；單側節段性水泡伴灼痛；Tzanck抹片/病毒培養；可能有疱疹後神經痛。
  • Shingles care: contact precautions while vesicles present; cool environment, air mattress/bed cradle, loose cotton clothes, astringent compresses; antivirals within 3 days; vaccine at age 50+.帶狀疱疹照護：水泡期接觸防護；環境涼爽、氣墊床/床架；寬鬆棉質衣物；收斂濕敷；3天內抗病毒藥；50歲以上接種疫苗。
  • Staff who never had chickenpox or varicella vaccine should not care for shingles clients; watch for Bell's palsy.未得過水痘或未接種水痘疫苗的工作人員不應照護帶狀疱疹病人；注意貝爾氏麻痺。
  • MRSA: folliculitis, furuncles; confirm with culture and sensitivity; standard + contact precautions, antibiotics, monitor for sepsis.MRSA：毛囊炎、癤；以培養與藥敏確認；標準+接觸防護、抗生素、監測敗血症。
PDF p.588, 589, 590

Cellulitis, erysipelas and plant dermatitis蜂窩性組織炎、丹毒與植物性皮膚炎

  • Erysipelas: acute superficial infection of upper skin layers (group A Strep). Cellulitis: dermis and hypodermis (Strep or S. aureus).丹毒：表層皮膚急性感染（A群鏈球菌）。蜂窩性組織炎：真皮與皮下組織（鏈球菌或金黃色葡萄球菌）。
  • Signs: pain, erythema, warmth, edema, fever; rest affected area, warm compresses, culture before antibiotics.徵象：疼痛、紅、熱、水腫、發燒；患部休息、溫敷、抗生素前先採培養。
  • Poison ivy/oak/sumac: urushiol causes papulovesicular itchy dermatitis; wash skin immediately (lather and rinse repeatedly), cool compresses, topical or oral steroids if severe.毒藤/毒橡樹/毒漆樹：urushiol引起丘疹水泡性癢疹；立即清洗皮膚（反覆起泡沖洗）、冷濕敷、嚴重者用外用或口服類固醇。
PDF p.590

Bites, stings and frostbite咬傷、螫傷與凍傷

  • Brown recluse: necrotic wound; ice early and intermittently up to 4 days. Black widow: neurotoxin; ice immediately. Tarantula: remove barbed hairs with sticky tape, irrigate eyes, elevate. Keep tetanus current; call Poison Control.棕色隱士蛛：壞死性傷口；早期間歇冰敷可達4天。黑寡婦蛛：神經毒；立即冰敷。狼蛛：用膠帶黏除倒刺毛、沖洗眼睛、抬高。維持破傷風疫苗；聯絡毒物中心。
  • Bark scorpion: neurotoxic, dangerous in children/elderly; go to ED, antivenom.樹皮蠍：神經毒，對兒童與老人危險；立即就醫，使用抗蛇毒血清。
  • Bee/wasp: scrape stinger off (no tweezers), ice; anaphylaxis needs epinephrine autoinjector IM, then ED; carry two injectors; watch for rebound anaphylaxis.蜜蜂/黃蜂：刮除螫針（勿用鑷子）、冰敷；過敏性休克用腎上腺素自動注射筆肌注後送急診；攜帶兩支；注意二次反應。
  • Snakebite: first move victim away and keep at rest, remove jewelry/constrictions, immobilize limb below heart, keep warm, no caffeine/alcohol, no cutting/sucking/ice, get to hospital for antivenom.蛇咬：先將傷者移離現場並休息、取下首飾/束縛物、肢體固定並低於心臟、保暖、不給咖啡因/酒精、不切開/吸毒/冰敷、儘速就醫給抗蛇毒血清。
  • Frostbite stages: 1st white plaque with hyperemia; 2nd clear blisters; 3rd hemorrhagic blisters/eschar; 4th full-thickness necrosis into muscle/bone.凍傷分級：1度白斑與周圍充血；2度透明水泡；3度出血性水泡/焦痂；4度全層壞死達肌肉/骨。
  • Frostbite care: rewarm rapidly in 40-42 C (104-107.6 F) water, handle gently, no rubbing or dry heat, analgesics, loose dressings, tetanus, monitor compartment syndrome.凍傷處理：以40-42 C（104-107.6 F）溫水快速復溫、動作輕柔、不可搓揉或乾熱、止痛、鬆散敷料、破傷風、監測骨筋膜室症候群。
PDF p.590, 591

Actinic keratosis and skin cancer光化性角化症與皮膚癌

  • Actinic keratosis: rough scaly premalignant lesion from sun exposure, may progress to squamous cell carcinoma.光化性角化症：日曬造成的粗糙鱗屑性癌前病灶，可進展為鱗狀細胞癌。
  • Basal cell: pearly papule with central crater and waxy border, rarely metastasizes. Squamous cell: oozing, crusting lesion, can metastasize. Melanoma: irregular, multicolored, highly metastatic.基底細胞癌：珍珠狀丘疹、中央凹陷、蠟質邊緣，少轉移。鱗狀細胞癌：滲液結痂病灶，可轉移。黑色素瘤：不規則多色、高度轉移。
  • Risks: sun, tanning beds, light skin, age >60, outdoor work, radiation, chemicals; skin biopsy confirms.危險因子：日曬、日光浴床、淺膚色、>60歲、戶外工作、輻射、化學物質；以皮膚切片確診。
  • Teach monthly self-exam, sunscreen reapplication, protective clothing, avoid sun 10 a.m.-4 p.m.; treatment includes cryosurgery, curettage/electrodesiccation, excision.教導每月自我檢查、防曬乳補擦、防護衣物、避開上午10點至下午4點日曬；治療含冷凍、刮除電燒、切除。
PDF p.592, 593

Psoriasis, acne, Stevens-Johnson, pressure injury乾癬、痤瘡、史蒂文斯-強生症候群、壓力性損傷

  • Psoriasis: chronic non-infectious, raised red plaques with silvery-white scales on scalp, knees, elbows, sacrum; nail pitting; Koebner phenomenon; psoriatic arthritis; improvement = fewer, thinner plaques and scales.乾癬：慢性非感染性，頭皮、膝、肘、薦部紅色隆起斑塊覆銀白色鱗屑；指甲點狀凹陷；Koebner現象；乾癬性關節炎；改善＝斑塊變少變薄、鱗屑減少。
  • Psoriasis teaching: don't scratch, keep skin lubricated, cotton clothing, avoid OTC drugs, stress reduction, watch for infection.乾癬衛教：勿抓、保持潤膚、棉質衣物、避免自行用成藥、減壓、注意感染。
  • Acne: comedones, papules, pustules, nodules; don't scrub or squeeze, use noncomedogenic water-based products, follow-up.痤瘡：粉刺、丘疹、膿皰、結節；勿用力搓洗或擠壓、使用不致粉刺的水性產品、定期追蹤。
  • Stevens-Johnson/TEN: drug-induced (sulfonamides, antiseizure drugs, NSAIDs); flu-like prodrome, mucosal/skin erythema, blisters; can involve eyes, airway; stop the causative drug immediately, supportive care.史蒂文斯-強生症候群/TEN：藥物誘發（磺胺類、抗癲癇藥、NSAIDs）；類流感前驅症狀、黏膜/皮膚紅斑水泡；可侵犯眼睛、呼吸道；立即停用致病藥物並支持性照護。
  • Stage 2 pressure injury: partial-thickness dermal loss, shallow open ulcer or blister; stage 1 intact, stage 3 full-thickness, stage 4 exposed bone/tendon/muscle.第2期壓力性損傷：真皮部分皮層缺損、淺開放潰瘍或水泡；第1期皮膚完整、第3期全層、第4期暴露骨/肌腱/肌肉。
PDF p.593, 594

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Obtain skin/wound cultures before starting antibiotics.於抗生素前採集皮膚/傷口培養。 PDF p.588
  2. Normal wound drainage is serous or serosanguineous; purulent drainage signals infection.正常引流為漿液性或漿液血性；膿性代表感染。 PDF p.588
  3. Shingles: contact precautions while vesicles present; staff never infected or vaccinated for varicella must not be assigned.帶狀疱疹：水泡期接觸防護；未得過或未接種水痘疫苗的工作人員不可指派。 PDF p.589
  4. Antivirals started within 3 days of shingles rash reduce pain and postherpetic neuralgia.帶狀疱疹出疹3天內開始抗病毒藥可減輕疼痛與疱疹後神經痛。 PDF p.589
  5. Cellulitis involves dermis/hypodermis; erysipelas is superficial.蜂窩性組織炎侵犯真皮/皮下；丹毒為表淺。 PDF p.590
  6. Poison ivy exposure: wash skin immediately and repeatedly; calamine only if dermatitis develops.接觸毒藤：立即反覆清洗皮膚；出現皮膚炎才用calamine。 PDF p.590
  7. Snakebite first priority: move victim away from snake, rest; then remove jewelry, immobilize limb below heart; no ice, cutting or suction.蛇咬首要：將傷者移離蛇並休息；之後取下首飾、固定肢體低於心臟；不冰敷、不切開、不吸毒。 PDF p.591
  8. Bee stinger: scrape off, no tweezers; anaphylaxis: IM epinephrine then ED; carry two autoinjectors.蜜蜂螫針：刮除、勿用鑷子；過敏性休克：肌注腎上腺素再送急診；攜帶兩支注射筆。 PDF p.591
  9. Brown recluse/black widow bites: apply ice; keep tetanus current; call Poison Control.棕隱士蛛/黑寡婦蛛咬傷：冰敷；維持破傷風疫苗；聯絡毒物中心。 PDF p.590, 591
  10. Frostbite: rewarm in 104-107.6 F (40-42 C) water; never rub or use dry heat; white/blue, hard, numb skin.凍傷：104-107.6 F（40-42 C）溫水復溫；禁搓揉與乾熱；皮膚白/藍、硬、麻木。 PDF p.591
  11. Melanoma: changing mole (color/border), highly metastatic, painless; basal cell: pearly papule, central crater, rarely metastasizes.黑色素瘤：痣的顏色/邊緣改變、高度轉移、無痛；基底細胞癌：珍珠狀丘疹、中央凹陷、少轉移。 PDF p.592
  12. Sun protection: avoid 10 a.m.-4 p.m., reapply sunscreen, monthly skin self-exam.防曬：避開上午10點至下午4點、補擦防曬乳、每月自我檢查皮膚。 PDF p.592, 593
  13. Psoriasis: silvery-white scales; Koebner phenomenon (lesions at injury sites).乾癬：銀白鱗屑；Koebner現象（創傷處長出病灶）。 PDF p.593
  14. Stevens-Johnson: stop the suspected drug immediately; mucous membrane and eye involvement.史蒂文斯-強生症候群：立即停用可疑藥物；黏膜與眼睛受累。 PDF p.593, 594
  15. Stage 2 pressure injury = partial-thickness dermal loss, not full-thickness.第2期壓力性損傷＝真皮部分皮層缺損，非全層。 PDF p.594

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Melanoma ABCDE: Asymmetry, Border irregular, Color varied, Diameter > 6 mm, Evolving.黑色素瘤ABCDE：不對稱、邊界不規則、顏色不均、直徑>6 mm、持續變化。 PDF p.592
  • Pressure injury stages: 1 intact red, 2 partial-thickness, 3 full-thickness fat, 4 muscle/bone exposed.壓力性損傷：1期完整發紅、2期部分皮層、3期全層脂肪、4期暴露肌/骨。 PDF p.594

44 Integumentary Medications皮膚用藥

Dermatologic pharmacology: poison ivy and dermatitis treatments, topical glucocorticoids, drugs for actinic keratosis, sunscreens, psoriasis therapies (topical, systemic, biologic, phototherapy), acne products including isotretinoin and iPLEDGE, and burn products (silver sulfadiazine, mafenide).皮膚科藥理：毒藤與皮膚炎治療、外用糖皮質激素、光化性角化症用藥、防曬乳、乾癬療法（外用、全身、生物製劑、光療）、痤瘡用藥（含isotretinoin與iPLEDGE）、燒傷用藥（silver sulfadiazine、mafenide）。

Poison ivy and dermatitis treatment毒藤與皮膚炎治療

  • Poison ivy: calamine, astringent/antiseptic wet compresses, colloidal oatmeal baths; topical steroids work best before blisters form; oral steroids for severe cases; diphenhydramine may aid sleep.毒藤：calamine、收斂/抗菌濕敷、膠體燕麥浴；外用類固醇於水泡形成前效果最佳；嚴重者口服類固醇；diphenhydramine可助眠。
  • Dermatitis (atopic, contact, stasis) is epidermal inflammation; first-line moisturizer plus topical glucocorticoid; systemic immunosuppressants (azathioprine, cyclosporine, methotrexate) if refractory.皮膚炎（異位性、接觸性、鬱滯性）為表皮發炎；首選保濕劑加外用糖皮質激素；無效時用全身免疫抑制劑（azathioprine、cyclosporine、methotrexate）。
  • Topical tacrolimus/pimecrolimus: burning, itching, sun sensitivity (protect from sun); tacrolimus specifically is linked to a higher risk of skin cancer/lymphoma and, in children, varicella zoster infection.外用tacrolimus/pimecrolimus：灼熱、癢、光敏感（需防曬）；其中tacrolimus本身與皮膚癌/淋巴瘤風險上升有關，兒童使用則可能增加感染帶狀疱疹的風險。
  • Wear gloves for any topical medication or patch and wash hands before and after.使用任何外用藥或貼片時戴手套，前後洗手。
PDF p.598

Topical glucocorticoids外用糖皮質激素

  • Anti-inflammatory, antipruritic, vasoconstrictive; potency depends on concentration, vehicle and occlusion (occlusive dressings increase absorption).抗發炎、止癢、血管收縮；強度依濃度、劑型與是否密封而異（密封敷料增加吸收）。
  • Absorption is higher on scalp, axilla, face, neck, eyelids, perineum; lower on palms, soles, back.頭皮、腋下、臉、頸、眼瞼、會陰吸收較高；手掌、腳底、背部吸收較低。
  • Contraindicated with prior steroid sensitivity or current systemic fungal, viral or bacterial infection.曾對類固醇過敏或目前有全身性黴菌、病毒、細菌感染者禁用。
  • Local effects: burning, dryness, skin thinning/atrophy, striae, purpura, telangiectasia, acneiform eruptions, hypopigmentation, infection overgrowth.局部效應：灼熱、乾燥、皮膚變薄/萎縮、妊娠紋、紫斑、微血管擴張、痤瘡樣疹、色素減退、感染過度生長。
  • Systemic effects: growth retardation in children, adrenal suppression, Cushing syndrome, glaucoma, cataracts.全身效應：兒童生長遲緩、腎上腺抑制、庫欣症候群、青光眼、白內障。
  • Apply sparingly in a thin film on cleaned skin with gloves; no dry occlusive dressing unless prescribed; avoid open areas unless prescribed.戴手套、清潔皮膚後薄薄塗抹；除非醫囑勿用乾性密封敷料；非醫囑勿塗於開放傷口。
PDF p.598, 599

Actinic keratosis medications光化性角化症用藥

  • Drugs: diclofenac 3% gel (NSAID, up to 3 months), fluorouracil (2-6 weeks, sun sensitivity), imiquimod 5% (up to 4 months, also genital warts), ingenol mebutate, aminolevulinic acid.藥物：diclofenac 3%凝膠（NSAID，最長3個月）、fluorouracil（2-6週、光敏感）、imiquimod 5%（最長4個月、亦用於尖濕疣）、ingenol mebutate、aminolevulinic acid。
  • Expected reactions: redness, burning, crusting, swelling; ingenol risk of severe allergy and herpes zoster.預期反應：紅、灼熱、結痂、腫；ingenol有嚴重過敏與帶狀疱疹風險。
  • Lesions are premalignant (squamous cell carcinoma); other treatments: cryotherapy, curettage, excision, laser.病灶為癌前病變（鱗狀細胞癌）；其他治療：冷凍、刮除、切除、雷射。
PDF p.599

Sunscreens防曬乳

  • Organic (chemical) products absorb UV; inorganic (physical) products reflect/scatter UV.有機（化學性）吸收紫外線；無機（物理性）反射/散射紫外線。
  • Use broad-spectrum (UVA and UVB) with SPF at least 15.使用廣譜（UVA與UVB）、SPF至少15。
  • Apply at least 30 minutes before exposure (PABA or padimate O products 2 hours before); reapply every 2-3 hours and after swimming or sweating.曝曬前至少30分鐘塗抹（含PABA或padimate O者需2小時前）；每2-3小時及游泳/流汗後補擦。
  • Avoid PABA if allergic to benzocaine, sulfonamides or thiazides; sunscreens can cause contact dermatitis/photosensitivity.對benzocaine、磺胺類或thiazide過敏者避免含PABA產品；防曬乳可能造成接觸性皮膚炎/光敏感。
  • UV peaks 10 a.m.-4 p.m.; add hat, sunglasses, protective clothing.紫外線於上午10點至下午4點最強；另戴帽、太陽眼鏡、穿防護衣物。
PDF p.600

Psoriasis: topical agents乾癬：外用藥

  • Topical glucocorticoids for mild disease; not on face, groin, axilla or genitalia (atrophy).外用糖皮質激素用於輕度；勿用於臉、鼠蹊、腋下、生殖器（萎縮）。
  • Tazarotene (vitamin A derivative): apply in the evening to dry skin; irritation and sun sensitivity.Tazarotene（維生素A衍生物）：晚上塗於乾燥皮膚；刺激與光敏感。
  • Calcipotriene (vitamin D analog): 1-3 weeks to work; local irritation; rarely hypercalcemia at high doses.Calcipotriene（維生素D類似物）：1-3週見效；局部刺激；高劑量罕見高血鈣。
  • Coal tar: odor, staining, irritation, sun sensitivity, cancer risk at high doses.煤焦油：氣味、染色、刺激、光敏感、高劑量致癌風險。
  • Keratolytics: salicylic acid can cause salicylism (dizziness, tinnitus, hyperpnea, psychological changes), so avoid large areas/open wounds; sulfur promotes peeling.角質溶解劑：salicylic acid可造成水楊酸中毒（頭暈、耳鳴、過度換氣、精神症狀），故避免大面積/開放傷口；硫磺促進脫屑。
PDF p.600

Psoriasis: systemic, biologic and phototherapy乾癬：全身、生物製劑與光療

  • Methotrexate: GI effects, stomatitis, bone marrow depression, hepatotoxic (monitor liver function), teratogenic (wait 3 months after stopping before pregnancy).Methotrexate：胃腸反應、口腔炎、骨髓抑制、肝毒性（監測肝功能）、致畸胎（停藥後3個月才可懷孕）。
  • Acitretin: severe psoriasis only; teratogenic (two contraceptive forms starting 1 month before, continuing 3 years after), hepatotoxic, raises triglycerides, lowers HDL; avoid alcohol, vitamin A, tetracycline.Acitretin：僅用於嚴重乾癬；致畸（治療前1個月起使用兩種避孕、停藥後持續3年）、肝毒性、升高三酸甘油酯、降低HDL；避免酒精、維生素A、四環黴素。
  • Cyclosporine: immunosuppressant, nephrotoxic, for severe disease.Cyclosporine：免疫抑制劑、腎毒性、用於嚴重乾癬。
  • Biologics (TNF-alpha blockers and interleukin inhibitors: adalimumab, etanercept, infliximab, ustekinumab, etc.): screen for TB first; risk of serious infection, hepatitis B reactivation, lymphoma; no live vaccines; no BCG 1 year before/after.生物製劑（TNF-alpha阻斷劑與介白素抑制劑：adalimumab、etanercept、infliximab、ustekinumab等）：先篩檢結核；嚴重感染、B肝再活化、淋巴瘤風險；不可接種活性疫苗；BCG前後1年不接種。
  • Phototherapy: coal tar plus UVB; psoralen with UVA (oral methoxsalen) raises skin cancer and aging risk.光療：煤焦油加UVB；psoralen合併UVA（口服methoxsalen）增加皮膚癌與老化風險。
PDF p.600, 601

Acne: topical agents and oral antibiotics痤瘡：外用藥與口服抗生素

  • Stepwise: mild = gentle cleansing and topical antimicrobials/retinoids; moderate = oral antibiotics and comedolytics; severe = isotretinoin; hormonal options.階段性：輕度＝溫和清潔與外用抗菌/類視黃酮；中度＝口服抗生素與溶粉刺劑；重度＝isotretinoin；可加荷爾蒙療法。
  • Wash and dry skin before applying; wash hands after; keep away from eyes, nose, lips, mucosa, inflamed skin.塗抹前洗淨擦乾皮膚；之後洗手；避開眼、鼻、唇、黏膜、發炎皮膚。
  • Benzoyl peroxide: drying and peeling; reduce frequency if severe irritation. Clindamycin/erythromycin: combine with benzoyl peroxide to prevent resistance. Dapsone topical.Benzoyl peroxide：乾燥脫皮；刺激嚴重時減少頻率。Clindamycin/erythromycin：與benzoyl peroxide併用防抗藥性。外用dapsone。
  • Tretinoin, adapalene, tazarotene: vitamin A derivatives, burning, peeling, UV sensitivity (SPF 15+); stop vitamin A supplements; adapalene benefits at 8-12 weeks, may worsen initially. Azelaic acid: stinging, hypopigmentation in dark skin.Tretinoin、adapalene、tazarotene：維生素A衍生物，灼熱、脫皮、光敏感（SPF 15以上）；停用維生素A補充；adapalene 8-12週見效，初期可能惡化。Azelaic acid：刺痛、深膚色者色素減退。
  • Oral antibiotics (doxycycline, minocycline, tetracycline, erythromycin, etc.) take 3-6 months to improve.口服抗生素（doxycycline、minocycline、tetracycline、erythromycin等）需3-6個月見效。
PDF p.601, 602, 603

Isotretinoin, iPLEDGE and hormonal therapyIsotretinoin、iPLEDGE與荷爾蒙療法

  • Isotretinoin: severe cystic acne unresponsive to other therapy; highly teratogenic; stop vitamin A and tetracyclines.Isotretinoin：用於對其他療法無效的嚴重囊腫性痤瘡；高度致畸；停用維生素A與四環黴素。
  • Effects: dry lips/eyes/skin, nosebleeds, joint/muscle pain, reduced night vision, UV sensitivity, depression (stop if it occurs).副作用：唇/眼/皮膚乾燥、流鼻血、關節/肌肉痛、夜視力下降、光敏感、憂鬱（發生需停藥）。
  • Check triglycerides before and during therapy; avoid alcohol.治療前與治療中監測三酸甘油酯；避免酒精。
  • iPLEDGE: controlled central system ensuring no one starts therapy pregnant or becomes pregnant; strict rules for patient, prescriber, pharmacist, wholesaler.iPLEDGE：集中管控系統，確保開始治療時未懷孕且治療期間不懷孕；病人、處方者、藥師、批發商皆須遵守。
  • Spironolactone and oral contraceptives lower androgen activity; spironolactone is teratogenic and can cause hyperkalemia, breast tenderness, menstrual irregularity.Spironolactone與口服避孕藥降低雄性素活性；spironolactone致畸，可能高血鉀、乳房脹痛、月經不規則。
PDF p.603

Burn products燒傷用藥

  • Silver sulfadiazine: broad antimicrobial (including yeast) to prevent sepsis; does not speed healing; apply 1/16-inch film and keep covered; does not cause acidosis.Silver sulfadiazine：廣效抗菌（含酵母）預防敗血症；不促進癒合；塗1/16吋薄層並保持覆蓋；不會造成酸中毒。
  • Silver sulfadiazine adverse effects: rash, itching, blue-green/gray discoloration, leukopenia, interstitial nephritis; monitor CBC/WBC and report leukopenia.Silver sulfadiazine副作用：皮疹、癢、藍綠/灰色變色、白血球減少、間質性腎炎；監測CBC/WBC並通報白血球低下。
  • Mafenide acetate: penetrates avascular tissue; carbonic anhydrase inhibition causes metabolic acidosis with hyperventilation; painful, so premedicate; bone marrow depression, hemolytic anemia.Mafenide acetate：可穿透無血管組織；抑制碳酸酐酶造成代謝性酸中毒伴過度換氣；疼痛故需先給止痛；骨髓抑制、溶血性貧血。
  • If hyperventilation occurs, notify provider, check ABG/electrolytes; if acidosis, wash off and hold 1-2 days.出現過度換氣須通知醫師、檢查血液氣體/電解質；若酸中毒，洗去並停用1-2天。
  • Other products: bacitracin (first-degree burns only), povidone-iodine, chlorhexidine skin cleanser.其他：bacitracin（僅1度燒傷）、povidone-iodine、chlorhexidine皮膚清潔劑。
PDF p.603, 604

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Topical steroid absorption is highest on scalp, axilla, face, neck, eyelids, perineum; safe on back, palms, soles.外用類固醇吸收最高部位：頭皮、腋下、臉、頸、眼瞼、會陰；背、手掌、腳底較安全。 PDF p.599
  2. Topical steroids: thin film, gloves, no dry occlusive dressing, not on open skin; watch for atrophy, striae and systemic absorption.外用類固醇：薄塗、戴手套、不用乾性密封敷料、不塗開放傷口；注意萎縮、妊娠紋與全身吸收。 PDF p.599
  3. Tacrolimus/pimecrolimus: protect from sun; risk of skin cancer/lymphoma.Tacrolimus/pimecrolimus：避免日曬；皮膚癌/淋巴瘤風險。 PDF p.598
  4. Sunscreen: SPF 15 or higher, broad-spectrum, apply 30 minutes before exposure, reapply every 2-3 hours and after swimming/sweating.防曬乳：SPF 15以上、廣譜、曝曬前30分鐘塗抹、每2-3小時及游泳/流汗後補擦。 PDF p.600
  5. Salicylic acid toxicity (salicylism): tinnitus, dizziness, hyperpnea.Salicylic acid中毒（水楊酸中毒）：耳鳴、頭暈、過度換氣。 PDF p.600
  6. Methotrexate and acitretin are teratogenic; acitretin needs 2 contraceptives (1 month before, 3 years after).Methotrexate與acitretin致畸；acitretin需兩種避孕（前1個月、後3年）。 PDF p.601
  7. Biologics: TB screening before starting; no live vaccines; watch for serious infection.生物製劑：開始前篩檢結核；不可接種活性疫苗；注意嚴重感染。 PDF p.601
  8. Isotretinoin: highly teratogenic (iPLEDGE), measure triglycerides before/during, avoid vitamin A and alcohol, stop if depression.Isotretinoin：高度致畸（iPLEDGE）、治療前後測三酸甘油酯、避免維生素A與酒精、憂鬱時停藥。 PDF p.603
  9. Tretinoin and other retinoids: use sunscreen SPF 15+, stop vitamin A supplements.Tretinoin等類視黃酮：使用SPF 15以上防曬、停用維生素A補充。 PDF p.602
  10. Spironolactone for acne: teratogenic, hyperkalemia.Spironolactone治痤瘡：致畸、高血鉀。 PDF p.603
  11. Silver sulfadiazine: monitor WBC; leukopenia (e.g., 3000/mm3) must be reported; it does not promote healing and does not cause acidosis.Silver sulfadiazine：監測WBC；白血球低下（如3000/mm3）須通報；不促進癒合且不會造成酸中毒。 PDF p.603
  12. Mafenide: metabolic acidosis with hyperventilation; premedicate for pain; monitor ABGs and electrolytes.Mafenide：代謝性酸中毒伴過度換氣；先給止痛；監測血液氣體與電解質。 PDF p.604
  13. Oral antibiotics for acne take 3-6 months to show benefit.痤瘡口服抗生素需3-6個月見效。 PDF p.603

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Retinoid rule 'No A, No Sun, No Baby': stop vitamin A, use sunscreen, avoid pregnancy (isotretinoin, acitretin).類視黃酮三不口訣：不補維生素A、不曬太陽（要防曬）、不懷孕（isotretinoin、acitretin）。 PDF p.601, 603
  • Mafenide = 'Mafenide Makes acidosis' (carbonic anhydrase inhibitor); silver sulfadiazine = 'Silver Shrinks WBCs' (leukopenia).Mafenide＝造成酸中毒（碳酸酐酶抑制）；silver sulfadiazine＝白血球減少。 PDF p.603, 604

45 Oncological and Hematological Problems腫瘤與血液問題

Covers cancer biology, diagnosis, treatment modalities (surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, stem cell transplant), leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma, site-specific cancers and their surgeries, oncological emergencies and anemias. Stress safety precautions for radiation, infection and bleeding, and recognition of emergencies.涵蓋癌症生物學、診斷、治療方式（手術、化療、放療、幹細胞移植）、白血病、淋巴瘤、骨髓瘤、各部位癌症與手術、腫瘤急症及貧血。重點在放射、感染與出血防護，以及急症辨識。

Cancer basics, diagnosis and pain control癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制

  • Cancer is uncontrolled growth of cells that lost normal growth control; it can impair immunity, blood production, GI, motor/sensory and respiratory function.癌症是失去生長控制的細胞不受控增生，可損害免疫、造血、胃腸、運動感覺與呼吸功能。
  • Metastasis: local seeding, bloodborne (most common), lymphatic spread.轉移途徑：局部播種、血行性（最常見）、淋巴性。
  • Solid tumors arise in organs; hematological cancers (leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma) arise from blood-forming tissue.實體腫瘤源自器官；血液癌（白血病、淋巴瘤、多發性骨髓瘤）源自造血組織。
  • Grading (I-IV) describes cell differentiation under the microscope; staging (0-IV) describes size, spread and metastasis. Stage 0 = in situ, stage IV = distant metastasis.分級（I-IV）描述顯微鏡下細胞分化程度；分期（0-IV）描述大小、擴散與轉移。0期=原位癌，IV期=遠處轉移。
  • Risks: chemical, physical (radiation, UV), viral (EBV, HBV, HPV), H. pylori, tobacco, obesity, diet, genetics, age, immunosuppression.危險因子：化學物質、物理因素（輻射、紫外線）、病毒（EBV、HBV、HPV）、幽門螺旋桿菌、菸草、肥胖、飲食、遺傳、年齡、免疫抑制。
  • Early detection: mammography, Pap test, stool occult blood, colonoscopy, breast and testicular self-exam, skin checks, and the nine CAUTION-US warning signs.早期偵測：乳房攝影、子宮頸抹片、糞便潛血、大腸鏡、乳房與睪丸自我檢查、皮膚檢查及CAUTION警訊。
  • Biopsy is the definitive diagnosis; types are needle, incisional, excisional and staging. Frozen section gives results in minutes; permanent paraffin section takes about 24 hours but is clearer.切片為確診方法；類型有針吸、切開、全切除與分期切片。冷凍切片數分鐘出結果；石蠟永久切片約24小時但較清晰。
  • Other tests: CBC, CT/PET, MRI, tumor markers (CEA, alpha-fetoprotein), bone marrow exam, endoscopy; invasive procedures need informed consent.其他檢查：全血球計數、CT/PET、MRI、腫瘤標記（CEA、AFP）、骨髓檢查、內視鏡；侵入性檢查需知情同意。
  • Cancer pain arises from bone destruction, organ obstruction, nerve compression, infiltration, inflammation and anxiety.癌痛源於骨破壞、器官阻塞、神經壓迫、組織浸潤、發炎與焦慮。
  • Pain is what the client says it is. Most cancer pain is controlled with around-the-clock oral opioids; mild pain uses acetaminophen/NSAIDs; severe pain uses morphine, hydromorphone, methadone; neuropathic pain may need anticonvulsants or antidepressants.疼痛以病人主訴為準。多數癌痛可用口服鴉片類藥物定時給予控制；輕度用acetaminophen/NSAIDs；重度用morphine、hydromorphone、methadone；神經痛可用抗癲癇藥或抗憂鬱藥。
  • Use equianalgesic charts when changing routes; add relaxation, imagery, biofeedback, massage, heat/cold.更換給藥途徑時使用等效鎮痛換算表；加入放鬆、意象、生理回饋、按摩與冷熱敷。
PDF p.610, 611, 612

Surgery, chemotherapy and radiation手術、化療與放射治療

  • Surgery types: prophylactic, curative, control (debulking), palliative, reconstructive. Risks include pain, infection, bleeding, thromboembolism and body image grief.手術類型：預防性、根治性、控制性（減積）、緩和性、重建性。風險包括疼痛、感染、出血、血栓與身體意象失落。
  • Chemotherapy is systemic and harms rapidly dividing normal cells (skin, hair, GI lining, sperm, bone marrow); combinations are timed around the nadir. See Chapter 46.化療為全身性，傷害快速分裂的正常細胞（皮膚、毛髮、胃腸黏膜、精子、骨髓）；組合療程依最低點（nadir）安排。詳見第46章。
  • External beam radiation: client is not radioactive; teach skin care (no lotions or powders unless prescribed, mild soap, pat dry, avoid sun, do not wash off markings). Fatigue is the most common side effect.外部放射治療：病人不具放射性；皮膚護理：未經處方不塗乳液粉劑、溫和肥皂、輕拍擦乾、避免日曬、勿洗掉標記。疲倦為最常見副作用。
  • Brachytherapy: sealed source implants make the client radioactive but excreta are not; unsealed source (oral/IV) makes body fluids radioactive for about 48 hours.近接治療：密封式植入使病人具放射性，但排泄物不具放射性；非密封式（口服/靜脈）使體液具放射性約48小時。
  • Sealed implant precautions: private room, sign on door, 30 minutes per caregiver per shift, dosimeter badge, lead shielding, rotate staff, no pregnant staff, no children under 16 or pregnant visitors, visitors 6 feet away and 30 minutes/day, never touch a dislodged source (use long forceps into a lead container).密封植入防護：單人房、門上警示、每位照護者每班30分鐘、佩戴劑量計、鉛屏蔽、輪替人員、懷孕者不可照護、16歲以下兒童與孕婦不可探視、訪客距離6呎且每日30分鐘、掉落放射源不可徒手碰觸（以長夾放入鉛容器）。
  • After implant removal the client is not radioactive; cancer is not contagious.移除植入物後病人不再具放射性；癌症不會傳染。
PDF p.613, 614

Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation造血幹細胞移植

  • BMT or PBSCT replaces marrow destroyed by high-dose chemotherapy or radiation; used for leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma and neuroblastoma.骨髓或周邊血幹細胞移植用以取代被高劑量化放療破壞的骨髓；用於白血病、淋巴瘤、骨髓瘤與神經母細胞瘤。
  • Donor types: autologous (own cells, most common, harvested in remission and frozen), allogeneic (sibling/unrelated), syngeneic (identical twin).捐贈類型：自體（最常見，緩解期採集冷凍）、異體（手足或非親屬）、同基因（同卵雙胞胎）。
  • Steps: harvest (apheresis 4-6 hours, or iliac crest aspiration), conditioning regimen, infusion through central line like a transfusion, then engraftment when WBC, RBC and platelets begin to rise (2-5 weeks).步驟：採集（血球分離4-6小時或髂骨抽取）、前處置（conditioning）、經中央靜脈如輸血般輸注、植入成功時白血球、紅血球、血小板開始回升（2-5週）。
  • Until engraftment the client has no natural immunity: infection, bleeding, neutropenia and thrombocytopenia are the main risks.植入前病人無自然免疫力：主要風險為感染、出血、嗜中性球與血小板低下。
  • Complications: failure to engraft, graft-versus-host disease (allogeneic: donor cells attack recipient), hepatic veno-occlusive disease (RUQ pain, jaundice, ascites, weight gain, hepatomegaly).併發症：植入失敗、移植物抗宿主病（異體：捐贈細胞攻擊受贈者）、肝靜脈阻塞症（右上腹痛、黃疸、腹水、體重增加、肝腫大）。
PDF p.614, 615

Leukemia, Hodgkin's lymphoma and multiple myeloma白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤

  • Leukemia is abnormal, immature leukocyte overproduction in marrow; ALL (children under 15), AML (15-39), CML (fourth decade), CLL (over 50).白血病為骨髓中不成熟白血球異常增生；ALL（15歲以下）、AML（15-39歲）、CML（30多歲，人生第四個十年）、CLL（50歲以上）。
  • Findings: anemia (pallor, fatigue, tachycardia), thrombocytopenia (petechiae, bleeding), fever, enlarged nodes/spleen/liver, bone pain; bone marrow biopsy shows blasts.表現：貧血（蒼白、疲倦、心搏過速）、血小板低下（瘀點、出血）、發燒、淋巴結脾肝腫大、骨痛；骨髓切片可見芽細胞。
  • Infection is a leading cause of death: protective isolation, private room (HEPA if possible), strict hand hygiene, no fresh flowers or plants, neutropenic diet without raw fruits and vegetables, no rectal temperatures or invasive procedures, no live vaccines.感染為主要死因：保護性隔離、單人房（可行時HEPA）、嚴格洗手、不放鮮花植物、嗜中性球低下飲食（不吃生鮮蔬果）、不測肛溫與避免侵入性處置、不打活性疫苗。
  • Bleeding: risk under 50,000/mm3, spontaneous under 20,000/mm3 (may need platelet transfusion); soft toothbrush, electric razor, stool softeners, avoid NSAIDs, no suppositories or enemas, pad side rails.出血：低於50,000/mm3有風險，低於20,000/mm3可能自發性出血（可能需輸血小板）；軟毛牙刷、電動刮鬍刀、軟便劑、避免NSAIDs、不用栓劑灌腸、床欄加墊。
  • Mucositis care (Box 45.8): soft brush, rinse, avoid alcohol or glycerin mouthwash, soft bland warm foods. Fatigue: small frequent high-calorie meals and rest.口腔黏膜炎照護（Box 45.8）：軟毛牙刷、漱口、避免含酒精或甘油漱口水、溫和軟質食物。疲倦：少量多餐高熱量並充分休息。
  • Chemotherapy phases: induction (remission), consolidation (cure), maintenance (stay in remission).化療階段：誘導（緩解）、鞏固（治癒）、維持（保持緩解）。
  • Hodgkin's: Reed-Sternberg cells in nodes; cervical nodes first, fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, painless nodes; PET/CT stage; early stage treated with external radiation, advanced with multiagent chemotherapy; discuss sperm banking.何杰金氏：淋巴結出現Reed-Sternberg細胞；頸部淋巴結先受侵、發燒、盜汗、體重減輕、疲倦；以PET/CT分期；早期以外部放療，晚期多藥化療；討論精子保存。
  • Multiple myeloma: malignant plasma cells destroy bone; bone pain (ribs, spine, pelvis), pathological fractures, hypercalcemia, high uric acid, renal failure, recurrent infection, anemia.多發性骨髓瘤：惡性漿細胞破壞骨骼；肋骨脊椎骨盆疼痛、病理性骨折、高血鈣、高尿酸、腎衰竭、反覆感染、貧血。
  • Urine Bence Jones protein and bone marrow aspirate with immature plasma cells support diagnosis.尿液Bence Jones蛋白與骨髓抽吸出現不成熟漿細胞可輔助診斷。
  • Care: at least 2 L fluid per day, ambulation, handle gently to avoid fractures, IV fluids and diuretics for calcium, bisphosphonates, analgesics, monitor kidney function.照護：每日至少2 L水分、鼓勵活動、輕柔搬動防骨折、靜脈輸液與利尿劑降鈣、雙磷酸鹽、止痛、監測腎功能。
PDF p.615, 616, 617, 618, 619

Testicular, cervical, ovarian, endometrial cancer睪丸癌、子宮頸癌、卵巢癌與子宮內膜癌

  • Testicular cancer (ages 15-40; cryptorchidism risk): painless swelling, heavy 'dragging' feeling; do monthly testicular self-exam after a warm shower; unilateral orchiectomy and possibly retroperitoneal node dissection; offer sperm banking; ice pack first 48 hours.睪丸癌（15-40歲；隱睪症為危險因子）：無痛腫大、下墜感；溫水淋浴後每月自我檢查；單側睪丸切除與可能的腹膜後淋巴結清除；提供精子保存；術後前48小時冰敷。
  • Cervical cancer: HPV, smoking, early intercourse, multiple partners; painless postcoital bleeding and foul discharge; Pap test and HPV vaccine prevent; treatments include laser, cryosurgery (watery discharge several weeks, no tampons or intercourse), conization, hysterectomy and pelvic exenteration.子宮頸癌：HPV、吸菸、初次性行為早、多重性伴侶；無痛性性交後出血與惡臭分泌物；抹片與HPV疫苗可預防；治療包括雷射、冷凍（數週水樣分泌物，避免棉條與性行為）、錐狀切除、子宮切除與骨盆腔臟器切除。
  • After hysterectomy: monitor bleeding (more than one saturated pad per hour is excessive), SCDs, coughing and deep breathing, avoid lifting over 20 lb, no intercourse for 3-6 weeks. Pelvic exenteration: ileal conduit, colostomy, sexual counseling.子宮切除術後：監測出血（每小時浸濕超過一片護墊為過量）、使用間歇壓迫裝置、咳嗽深呼吸、避免提超過20磅、3-6週內不性行為。骨盆臟器切除：迴腸導管、結腸造口、性諮詢。
  • Ovarian cancer: often silent until advanced, bloating, urinary frequency, CA-125; surgery with debulking plus chemotherapy, intraperitoneal chemotherapy.卵巢癌：晚期前常無症狀，腹脹、頻尿、CA-125上升；手術減積加化療、腹腔內化療。
  • Endometrial cancer: postmenopausal abnormal bleeding; risk from estrogen, obesity, nulliparity, diabetes, hypertension; total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy; progesterone for estrogen-dependent tumors.子宮內膜癌：停經後異常出血；危險因子為雌激素、肥胖、未生育、糖尿病、高血壓；全子宮與雙側輸卵管卵巢切除；雌激素依賴型可用黃體素。
PDF p.619, 620, 621, 622

Breast cancer and mastectomy care乳癌與乳房切除術照護

  • Risks: age over 65, family history, early menarche and late menopause, nulliparity, HRT, obesity. Findings: fixed, irregular, painless mass (upper outer quadrant), dimpling, peau d'orange, nipple retraction, axillary nodes.危險因子：年齡大於65歲、家族史、初經早停經晚、未生育、荷爾蒙治療、肥胖。表現：固定、不規則、無痛腫塊（外上象限）、凹陷、橘皮樣皮膚、乳頭內縮、腋下淋巴結腫。
  • Breast self-exam 7-10 days after menses (postmenopausal on a set day monthly); trastuzumab for HER-2 positive tumors.乳房自我檢查於月經後7-10天；停經者每月固定日期；HER-2陽性可用trastuzumab。
  • Procedures: lumpectomy, simple mastectomy, modified radical mastectomy (nodes removed).手術：腫瘤切除術、單純乳房切除術、改良式根治性乳房切除術（含淋巴結）。
  • Postoperative: semi-Fowler's, affected arm elevated above heart, manage Jackson-Pratt drain, deep breathing, monitor for lymphedema and fluid collection.術後：半坐臥、患側手臂高於心臟、管理Jackson-Pratt引流、深呼吸、監測淋巴水腫與積液。
  • No IVs, injections, BP or venipuncture in the affected arm; protect the arm, gloves for gardening, no tight jewelry, no heavy bag, medical alert bracelet.患側手臂不可靜脈注射、注射、量血壓或抽血；保護手臂、園藝戴手套、避免緊束飾物、不提重物、佩戴醫療警示手環。
PDF p.622, 623, 624, 625

GI cancers: esophageal, gastric, pancreatic, colorectal消化道癌：食道、胃、胰臟、大腸

  • Esophageal: dysphagia, odynophagia; smoking, alcohol, reflux, Barrett's; watch aspiration and nutrition.食道癌：吞嚥困難、吞嚥痛；吸菸、酒精、逆流、Barrett食道；注意吸入與營養。
  • Gastric: H. pylori, smoked/salted foods; early indigestion, late weight loss, iron-deficiency anemia, epigastric mass; Billroth I and II or total gastrectomy; postoperative NG drainage bloody then brown then yellow; do not irrigate or remove NG tube; watch dumping, B12 deficiency.胃癌：幽門螺旋桿菌、燻製鹽漬食物；早期消化不良，晚期體重減輕、缺鐵性貧血、上腹腫塊；Billroth I與II或全胃切除；術後鼻胃管引流液先血性再褐色後黃色；勿自行沖洗或拔除；注意傾倒症候群與B12缺乏。
  • Pancreatic: jaundice, clay stools, dark urine, weight loss, glucose intolerance, poor prognosis; Whipple procedure; monitor blood glucose.胰臟癌：黃疸、陶土色便、深色尿、體重減輕、葡萄糖耐受不良、預後差；Whipple手術；監測血糖。
  • Colorectal: blood in stool most common; ascending tumor = diarrhea, descending = constipation or ribbon stool, rectal = alternating; complications: perforation, obstruction, abscess, hemorrhage.大腸直腸癌：糞便帶血最常見；升結腸=腹瀉，降結腸=便祕或細扁糞便，直腸=便祕腹瀉交替；併發症：穿孔、阻塞、膿瘍、出血。
  • Colostomy: stoma should be red or pink, pale means low Hgb/Hct, dark blue/purple/black means ischemia - call surgeon; ascending colostomy liquid stool, descending near-formed; empty pouch at one-third full. Ileostomy: dark green then yellow liquid stool, risk dehydration.結腸造口：造口應紅或粉紅，蒼白表示血紅素/血容比低，暗藍紫黑表示缺血須通知外科；升結腸造口為液狀便，降結腸接近成形；袋子1/3滿時倒空。迴腸造口：深綠後轉黃的液狀便，有脫水風險。
PDF p.624, 625, 626, 627

Lung and laryngeal cancer肺癌與喉癌

  • Lung: smoking and pollutants; SCLC vs NSCLC; cough, hemoptysis, wheezing, hoarseness, weight loss, clubbing; diagnosed with imaging, bronchoscopy and sputum cytology.肺癌：吸菸與污染；小細胞肺癌與非小細胞肺癌；咳嗽、咳血、喘鳴、聲音沙啞、體重減輕、杵狀指；以影像、支氣管鏡與痰液細胞學診斷。
  • Airway is the priority; Fowler's position, oxygen, humidification, high-calorie diet; thoracentesis or pleurodesis for malignant effusion.氣道為優先；採Fowler's臥位、給氧、加濕、高熱量飲食；惡性肋膜積液可行胸腔穿刺或肋膜沾黏術。
  • Surgery: pneumonectomy, lobectomy, segmental resection. After pneumonectomy no chest tube drainage is usually used; fluid fills the space and consolidates, stabilizing the mediastinum. Avoid complete lateral turning per surgeon.手術：全肺、肺葉、肺節切除。全肺切除通常不放胸管引流，積液會填滿並固化，穩定縱膈；依醫囑避免完全側臥。
  • Laryngeal: smoking plus alcohol, persistent hoarseness, painless neck mass, dysphagia; total laryngectomy leaves a permanent stoma.喉癌：吸菸加飲酒、持續聲音沙啞、無痛頸部腫塊、吞嚥困難；全喉切除留下永久性氣切造口。
  • Post-laryngectomy: high Fowler's, suction, airway patency, neck hemorrhage and edema, tube feedings, stoma guard and shower shield, humidity, fluids 3000 mL, medical alert bracelet.喉切除術後：高坐臥、抽吸、維持氣道通暢、監測頸部出血與水腫、管灌飲食、造口護罩與淋浴護罩、增加環境濕度、每日液體3000 mL、佩戴醫療警示手環。
  • Speech options: esophageal speech, electrolarynx, tracheoesophageal fistula prosthesis.語言復健：食道發聲、電子喉、氣管食道瘻管發聲閥。
PDF p.627, 628, 629

Prostate cancer and prostatectomy攝護腺癌與攝護腺切除術

  • Slow-growing adenocarcinoma, risk rises after 50; early silent, later hard nodule on DRE, hematuria, obstruction, bone pain. PSA alone is not a screening test; used to monitor therapy; biopsy diagnoses.生長緩慢的腺癌，50歲後風險上升；早期無症狀，後期直腸指診可摸到硬結節、血尿、阻塞、骨痛。PSA不可單獨作篩檢，用於追蹤治療；切片確診。
  • Treatment: androgen suppression (hot flashes, low libido, osteoporosis), radiation, brachytherapy, orchiectomy, prostatectomy (retropubic, perineal, suprapubic), TURP for palliation.治療：雄激素抑制（熱潮紅、性慾降低、骨質疏鬆）、放療、近接治療、睪丸切除、攝護腺切除（恥骨後、會陰、恥骨上）、TURP用於症狀緩解。
  • Post-TURP: watch for hemorrhage and TUR syndrome (hyponatremia/water intoxication: confusion, bradycardia, hypertension). Use sterile irrigation solution only.TURP後：監測出血與TUR症候群（低血鈉/水中毒：意識混亂、心搏過緩、高血壓）。僅使用無菌沖洗液。
  • CBI with three-way catheter: keep urine pink; bright red with clots = arterial bleeding, increase CBI and call; burgundy = venous, traction may be applied; if obstruction, stop CBI and irrigate 30-50 mL saline if prescribed; do not release traction without order.三腔導尿管膀胱持續灌洗：維持粉紅尿；鮮紅且有血塊=動脈出血，加快灌洗並通知醫師；暗紅=靜脈出血，可能施以導管牽引；阻塞時停止灌洗並依醫囑以30-50 mL生理食鹽水沖洗；未經醫囑不可放鬆牽引。
  • Teach: fluids 2400-3000 mL/day, avoid straining, heavy lifting, Valsalva, intercourse for 2-6 weeks, perineal exercises; urge to void is normal, do not void around catheter (spasm). Avoid rectal tubes, enemas and thermometers after perineal surgery.衛教：每日2400-3000 mL液體、避免用力解便、提重物、Valsalva動作及2-6週內性行為、會陰運動；持續尿意屬正常，不可繞著導管解尿（引起痙攣）。會陰手術後避免肛管、灌腸與肛溫。
PDF p.629, 630, 631, 632

Bladder cancer and urinary diversion膀胱癌與尿路改道

  • Painless hematuria is the most common sign; smoking and industrial chemicals are risks; diagnosis by bladder wash and biopsy.無痛性血尿為最常見徵象；吸菸與工業化學物為危險因子；以膀胱沖洗細胞學與切片診斷。
  • Intravesical chemotherapy: retain 2 hours, rotate position every 15-30 minutes, then void sitting and drink fluids; urine is biohazard; disinfect toilet with bleach for 6 hours.膀胱內化療：留置2小時，每15-30分鐘變換姿勢，之後坐著排尿並多喝水；尿液視為生物危害；6小時內以漂白水消毒馬桶。
  • Surgery: TURBT with fulguration, partial cystectomy (capacity about 60 mL then 200-400 mL), cystectomy with urinary diversion.手術：經尿道膀胱腫瘤切除與電灼、部分膀胱切除（容量約60 mL後增至200-400 mL）、膀胱切除加尿路改道。
  • Diversions: ileal conduit (Bricker, incontinent stoma, needs pouch), Kock and Indiana pouches (continent, self-catheterize every 4-6 hours after building up from 2-3 hours), neobladder, ureterostomy, nephrostomy.改道方式：迴腸導管（Bricker，非節制性造口需戴袋）、Kock與Indiana貯尿囊（節制性，從每2-3小時逐週增加至每4-6小時自我導尿）、新膀胱、輸尿管造口、腎造口。
  • Postop stoma: red and moist, check hourly for 24 hours; dark/dusky = necrosis, call surgeon. Urine output 30-60 mL/hr; report under 30 mL/hr or none for 15 minutes. Peristalsis returns in 3-4 days; NPO until bowel sounds.術後造口：紅且濕潤，前24小時每小時評估；暗沉=壞死須通知外科。尿量30-60 mL/小時；低於30 mL/小時或15分鐘無尿須通報。腸蠕動於3-4天恢復；腸音恢復前禁食。
  • Urinary stoma care: change appliance in the morning, cut barrier no more than 3 mm larger than stoma, empty at one-third full, change every 5-7 days, non-karaya products, vinegar rinse to reduce odor.尿路造口護理：早晨更換裝置、皮膚護板開口不超過造口3 mm、1/3滿時倒空、每5-7天更換、使用非karaya產品、白醋浸泡減少異味。
PDF p.632, 633, 634, 635, 636

Oncological emergencies腫瘤急症

  • Sepsis and DIC: gram-negative sepsis in immunocompromised clients; IV antibiotics, anticoagulants early in DIC, cryoprecipitated clotting factors if hemorrhage dominates.敗血症與DIC：免疫低下病人易發生格蘭氏陰性菌敗血症；靜脈抗生素、DIC早期給抗凝劑、出血為主時給冷凍沉澱凝血因子。
  • SIADH: tumor-produced ADH causes water intoxication and hyponatremia (115-120 mEq/L mild; near 110 seizures, coma); restrict fluids, give sodium, ADH antagonist, treat tumor.SIADH：腫瘤產生ADH造成水中毒與低血鈉（115-120 mEq/L輕度；近110時抽搐昏迷）；限水、補鈉、ADH拮抗劑、治療腫瘤。
  • Spinal cord compression: back pain first, then weakness, numbness, loss of bowel/bladder sensation; give high-dose corticosteroids, immediate radiation or surgery.脊髓壓迫：先背痛，再無力、麻木、大小便感覺喪失；給予高劑量類固醇、立即放療或手術。
  • Hypercalcemia (bone metastasis): fatigue, nausea, constipation, polyuria, weakness, ECG changes; fluids, calcium-lowering drugs, encourage walking, dialysis if severe.高血鈣（骨轉移）：疲倦、噁心、便祕、多尿、無力、心電圖改變；輸液、降鈣藥物、鼓勵走動、嚴重時透析。
  • Superior vena cava syndrome (lung cancer, lymphoma): facial and periorbital edema in the morning, tight collar (Stokes' sign), dyspnea, neck vein distention; semi-Fowler's, steroids, diuretics, mediastinal radiation or stent.上腔靜脈症候群（肺癌、淋巴瘤）：晨起臉部眼周水腫、衣領變緊（Stokes徵象）、呼吸困難、頸靜脈怒張；半坐臥、類固醇、利尿劑、縱膈放療或支架。
  • Tumor lysis syndrome: hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia with hypocalcemia, hyperuricemia leading to AKI; hydrate, diuretics, allopurinol, glucose-insulin for potassium, dialysis if needed, low K and phosphorus diet.腫瘤溶解症候群：高血鉀、高血磷伴低血鈣、高尿酸導致急性腎損傷；補水、利尿劑、allopurinol、葡萄糖加胰島素降鉀、必要時透析、低鉀低磷飲食。
PDF p.636, 637, 638

Anemias貧血

  • Anemia: too few healthy red cells or hemoglobin; fatigue, pallor, dyspnea, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, chest pain, cool extremities.貧血：健康紅血球或血紅素不足；疲倦、蒼白、呼吸困難、心搏過速、心律不整、胸痛、四肢冰冷。
  • Iron deficiency: microcytic, hypochromic, low Hgb/Hct/MCV. Iron between meals with vitamin C; not with milk or antacids; black stools, constipation; liquid iron through straw; Z-track if IM.缺鐵性貧血：小球性低色素、血紅素/血容比/MCV低。鐵劑餐間服用並配維生素C；不與牛奶或制酸劑併服；黑便、便祕；液態鐵用吸管；肌注採Z字形。
  • Vitamin B12 deficiency (pernicious anemia, lack of intrinsic factor): macrocytic, beefy red tongue, paresthesias, gait disturbance; lifelong B12 injections.維生素B12缺乏（惡性貧血，缺乏內在因子）：大球性、牛肉紅舌、感覺異常、步態不穩；需終身注射B12。
  • Folate deficiency: macrocytic, from poor diet, alcoholism, malabsorption, anticonvulsants, pregnancy; give folic acid and folate-rich foods.葉酸缺乏：大球性，因飲食不良、酗酒、吸收不良、抗癲癇藥、懷孕；補充葉酸與富含葉酸食物。
  • Aplastic anemia: pancytopenia from marrow failure; marrow biopsy shows fatty marrow; treat with immunosuppression (ATG), transplant if donor available, bleeding and infection precautions.再生不良性貧血：骨髓衰竭造成全血球低下；骨髓切片呈脂肪化；以免疫抑制（ATG）治療，有合適捐贈者則移植；預防出血與感染。
PDF p.638, 639, 640

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Pain is what the client says; do not undermedicate; around-the-clock oral opioids control most cancer pain.疼痛以病人主訴為準；不可給藥不足；定時口服鴉片類可控制多數癌痛。 PDF p.612
  2. Sealed radiation implant: client emits radiation, excreta do not. Limit caregiver time to 30 min/shift, no pregnant staff, visitors 6 ft away; lost source: long forceps into lead container, never touch.密封放射植入：病人具放射性，排泄物不具。照護者每班30分鐘、孕婦不可照護、訪客距離6呎；放射源掉落以長夾放入鉛容器，絕不徒手碰觸。 PDF p.613, 614
  3. External beam radiation does not make the client radioactive; protect skin, avoid lotions, sun, friction, and do not wash off markings.外部放療不使病人具放射性；保護皮膚，避免乳液、日曬、摩擦，勿洗掉標記。 PDF p.613, 614
  4. Until stem cell engraftment (2-5 weeks) the client has no immunity; main risks are infection, bleeding, GVHD in allogeneic transplants, hepatic veno-occlusive disease.幹細胞植入前（2-5週）病人無免疫力；主要風險為感染、出血、異體移植的GVHD、肝靜脈阻塞症。 PDF p.615
  5. Leukemia: infection is the major cause of death. Protective isolation, no fresh flowers or raw produce, no rectal temps or injections, no live vaccines.白血病：感染為主要死因。保護性隔離、不放鮮花與生食、不測肛溫與注射、不打活性疫苗。 PDF p.616, 617
  6. Platelets under 50,000/mm3 bleeding risk; under 20,000/mm3 spontaneous bleeding and platelet transfusion.血小板低於50,000/mm3有出血風險；低於20,000/mm3自發性出血並可能輸血小板。 PDF p.617
  7. Multiple myeloma: protect from pathological fractures, 2 L fluid per day, watch calcium, uric acid and kidney failure; Bence Jones proteinuria.多發性骨髓瘤：防病理性骨折、每日2 L水分、監測血鈣尿酸與腎衰竭；Bence Jones蛋白尿。 PDF p.618, 619
  8. Testicular self-exam monthly after a warm shower; painless swelling is the key sign.睪丸自我檢查每月一次，溫水淋浴後；無痛性腫大為關鍵徵象。 PDF p.619, 620
  9. After mastectomy: no BP, IV or venipuncture in the affected arm; elevate arm, watch lymphedema.乳房切除術後：患側手臂不可量血壓、靜脈注射或抽血；抬高手臂、注意淋巴水腫。 PDF p.624
  10. Colostomy/urostomy stoma: red/pink healthy; dark blue, purple, black or dusky means ischemia, notify surgeon.結腸/泌尿造口：紅或粉紅為健康；暗藍、紫、黑或暗沉代表缺血，須通知外科。 PDF p.627, 636
  11. Lung or laryngeal cancer: airway is the priority; after laryngectomy keep high Fowler's, suction, tracheostomy stoma permanent.肺癌或喉癌：氣道為優先；喉切除術後高坐臥、抽吸、氣切造口為永久性。 PDF p.628
  12. Post-TURP/prostatectomy CBI: pink urine goal; bright red with clots = arterial bleeding; obstruction: stop CBI, notify surgeon; watch TUR syndrome (hyponatremia).TURP/攝護腺切除術後持續膀胱灌洗：目標粉紅尿；鮮紅含血塊=動脈出血；阻塞時停止灌洗並通知醫師；注意TUR症候群（低血鈉）。 PDF p.630, 631, 632
  13. Urinary diversion: report urine output under 30 mL/hr; stoma should be red and moist.尿路改道：尿量低於30 mL/小時須通報；造口應紅潤濕潤。 PDF p.636
  14. Spinal cord compression: back pain precedes neuro deficits; give high-dose steroids and prepare for radiation. It is an emergency.脊髓壓迫：背痛先於神經缺損；給高劑量類固醇並準備放療；屬急症。 PDF p.637
  15. SIADH: sodium 115-120 mild, near 110 seizures; fluid restriction, sodium, monitor sodium.SIADH：鈉115-120輕度，近110抽搐；限水、補鈉、監測血鈉。 PDF p.636, 637
  16. Tumor lysis syndrome: high K, high phosphorus, low Ca, high uric acid; hydrate, allopurinol, glucose-insulin, dialysis if refractory.腫瘤溶解症候群：高鉀、高磷、低鈣、高尿酸；補水、allopurinol、葡萄糖加胰島素、無效則透析。 PDF p.638
  17. SVC syndrome: facial edema in the morning and tight collar; semi-Fowler's, steroids, radiation.上腔靜脈症候群：晨間臉腫、衣領緊；半坐臥、類固醇、放療。 PDF p.637
  18. Hypercalcemia of malignancy: weakness, constipation, polyuria, ECG changes; fluids and encourage walking.惡性腫瘤高血鈣：無力、便祕、多尿、心電圖改變；輸液並鼓勵走動。 PDF p.637
  19. Iron: between meals with vitamin C, black stools expected. B12 deficiency (pernicious anemia) needs lifelong injections.鐵劑：餐間併維生素C，黑便屬預期。B12缺乏（惡性貧血）需終身注射。 PDF p.638, 639

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • CAUTION-US warning signs: Change in bowel/bladder, A sore that does not heal, Unusual bleeding, Thickening/lump, Indigestion, Obvious wart/mole change, Nagging cough/hoarseness, Unexplained anemia, Sudden weight loss.CAUTION-US癌症警訊：排便排尿習慣改變、傷口不癒、異常出血、增厚或腫塊、消化不良、痣疣明顯變化、持續咳嗽聲啞、不明原因貧血、體重驟降。 PDF p.611
  • Tumor lysis: 'K-P-U up, Ca down' (potassium, phosphate, uric acid rise; calcium falls).腫瘤溶解：鉀、磷、尿酸上升，鈣下降。 PDF p.638

46 Oncological and Hematological Medications腫瘤與血液用藥

Covers chemotherapy drug classes, their cell-cycle targets, signature toxicities, safe handling, extravasation and anaphylaxis management, plus colony-stimulating factors and anemia drugs. Focus on matching each drug to its special adverse effect and the monitoring it needs.涵蓋化療藥物分類、作用週期、特徵性毒性、安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏處置，以及群落刺激因子與貧血藥物。重點在將各藥物對應其特殊不良反應與監測項目。

Antineoplastic basics抗腫瘤藥物基礎

  • Chemotherapy kills or inhibits neoplastic cells for cure, longer survival, or fewer life-threatening complications; normal rapidly dividing cells are also hurt, which causes most side effects.化療殺死或抑制腫瘤細胞，目的為治癒、延長存活或減少危及生命的併發症；正常的快速分裂細胞也會受損，造成多數副作用。
  • Cell cycle phase-specific drugs act only in one phase; phase-nonspecific drugs act in any phase (Fig. 46.1).週期特異性藥物只在特定細胞週期作用；非特異性藥物在任何階段都有效（圖46.1）。
  • Drugs are usually combined, and may be paired with surgery or radiation; IV is the most common route, with oral, intra-arterial, isolated limb perfusion or intracavitary also used.通常合併多種藥物，並可與手術或放療並用；最常見為靜脈給藥，也可口服、動脈內、肢體隔離灌注或體腔內給藥。
  • Dosing is based on body surface area (BSA), so measure current height and weight before each dose.劑量依體表面積(BSA)計算，每次給藥前須測量當前身高與體重。
  • Chemotherapy causes rapid cell death with uric acid release; allopurinol may be given, especially in leukemia and lymphoma.化療造成細胞快速死亡並釋出尿酸；尤其白血病與淋巴瘤可給予allopurinol。
PDF p.651, 652

Side effects and general nursing care副作用與一般護理

  • Common effects: anorexia, nausea/vomiting, mucositis, alopecia, diarrhea, anemia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, infertility and neuropathy.常見副作用：厭食、噁心嘔吐、黏膜炎、落髮、腹瀉、貧血、嗜中性球低下、血小板低下、不孕與神經病變。
  • Monitor CBC, WBC, platelets, uric acid and electrolytes; give antiemetics hours before and 12-48 hours after chemotherapy; encourage at least 2000 mL fluid per day.監測全血球計數、白血球、血小板、尿酸與電解質；化療前數小時及後12-48小時給予止吐劑；每日至少攝取2000 mL液體。
  • Platelets below 50,000/mm3 raise bleeding risk; below 20,000/mm3 spontaneous bleeding may occur. Start bleeding precautions and avoid IM injections and venipunctures where possible.血小板低於50,000/mm3出血風險增加；低於20,000/mm3可能自發性出血。應啟動出血預防措施，盡量避免肌肉注射與靜脈穿刺。
  • ANC = WBC x % neutrophils; ANC below 1000 means neutropenia: hold the drug, notify the oncologist, and start neutropenic precautions (example: ANC 900).ANC=白血球數x嗜中性球百分比；ANC低於1000為嗜中性球低下：暫停給藥、通知腫瘤科醫師並啟動嗜中性球低下防護（例如ANC 900）。
  • Teach: avoid crowds and sick contacts, soft toothbrush, electric razor, no aspirin, no live vaccines, consult the provider before any vaccination, oral hygiene and mouth rinses.衛教：避免人群與感染者、使用軟毛牙刷與電動刮鬍刀、避免阿斯匹靈、不可施打活性疫苗、接種前先詢問醫師、加強口腔衛生。
  • Psychosocial: discuss hair loss and wigs before treatment, hair regrows months after the last dose; teratogenic so contraception is needed; infertility may be permanent, so offer sperm banking or egg preservation.心理社會：治療前討論落髮與假髮，髮量於末次治療後數月長回；具致畸性需避孕；不孕可能不可逆，可提供精子或卵子保存。
PDF p.651, 652, 653

Safe handling, extravasation and anaphylaxis安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏性反應

  • Prepare IV chemotherapy in a biological safety cabinet; wear gloves, gown, eye protection and mask; pregnant nurses should avoid preparing or giving chemotherapy; discard in biohazard containers.在生物安全櫃中調配靜脈化療藥；穿戴手套、隔離衣、護目與口罩；懷孕護理師應避免調配或給藥；廢棄物丟入生物危害容器。
  • Vesicants go through a central line when possible; with a peripheral line, check blood return first.起疱劑盡可能經中央靜脈導管給予；若用周邊靜脈須先確認有回血。
  • Extravasation (pain, redness, swelling, slowed infusion): stop infusion, notify the provider, expect heat or ice depending on the drug and possibly an antidote injected into the site. Never restart in the same vein or speed the flow.藥物外滲（疼痛、紅腫、滴速變慢）：停止輸注、通知醫師，依藥物使用冷敷或熱敷，可能需於局部注射解毒劑；不可在同一條靜脈重新建立或加快滴速。
  • Anaphylaxis signs: dyspnea, chest tightness, urticaria, tachycardia, hypotension, anxiety, cyanosis. Stop the drug, call rapid response, give oxygen, keep IV open with saline, prepare epinephrine and intubation.過敏性休克徵象：呼吸困難、胸悶、蕁麻疹、心搏過速、低血壓、焦慮、發紺。立即停藥、呼叫快速反應小組、給氧、以生理食鹽水維持靜脈通路、備epinephrine與插管。
  • Prevent anaphylaxis: allergy history, test dose if prescribed, stay with the client, have emergency equipment ready.預防：詢問過敏史、依醫囑做測試劑量、全程陪伴病人、備妥急救設備。
PDF p.652, 653

Alkylating agents and antitumor antibiotics烷化劑與抗腫瘤抗生素

  • Alkylating agents (nitrogen mustards, nitrosoureas, platinum compounds) break the DNA helix; they are cell cycle nonspecific.烷化劑（氮芥類、亞硝基脲類、鉑類）破壞DNA雙股螺旋，屬非週期特異性。
  • Busulfan, chlorambucil and mechlorethamine raise uric acid; cisplatin causes ototoxicity, tinnitus, nephrotoxicity, hypokalemia, hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia.Busulfan、chlorambucil、mechlorethamine使尿酸升高；cisplatin造成耳毒性、耳鳴、腎毒性、低鉀、低鈣與低鎂。
  • Cyclophosphamide and ifosfamide cause hemorrhagic cystitis: drink 2-3 L/day; mesna protects against ifosfamide cystitis; oral cyclophosphamide is taken without food.Cyclophosphamide與ifosfamide造成出血性膀胱炎：每日飲水2-3 L；mesna可預防ifosfamide膀胱炎；口服cyclophosphamide宜空腹。
  • Antitumor antibiotics (bleomycin, daunorubicin, doxorubicin, idarubicin) interfere with DNA/RNA synthesis and are nonspecific.抗腫瘤抗生素（bleomycin、daunorubicin、doxorubicin、idarubicin）干擾DNA/RNA合成，屬非特異性。
  • Daunorubicin/doxorubicin/idarubicin: cardiotoxicity, heart failure (crackles, edema, weight gain), ECG changes; dexrazoxane is cardioprotective. Bleomycin: pulmonary toxicity and fibrosis, so follow PFTs and lung sounds.Daunorubicin/doxorubicin/idarubicin：心毒性、心衰竭（囉音、水腫、體重增加）、心電圖變化；dexrazoxane具心臟保護作用。Bleomycin：肺毒性與肺纖維化，需追蹤肺功能與呼吸音。
PDF p.654

Antimetabolites, mitotic inhibitors, topoisomerase inhibitors抗代謝藥、有絲分裂抑制劑、拓樸異構酶抑制劑

  • Antimetabolites act in the S phase: cytarabine, fluorouracil, mercaptopurine and methotrexate; bone marrow depression, stomatitis, diarrhea, alopecia.抗代謝藥作用於S期：cytarabine、fluorouracil、mercaptopurine、methotrexate；骨髓抑制、口腔炎、腹瀉、落髮。
  • Fluorouracil: cerebellar dysfunction (dizziness, weakness, ataxia) and photosensitivity; methotrexate: photosensitivity, hepatotoxicity; give leucovorin rescue with high-dose methotrexate.Fluorouracil：小腦功能異常（頭暈、無力、共濟失調）與光敏感；methotrexate：光敏感、肝毒性；高劑量methotrexate須給leucovorin解救。
  • Vinca alkaloids (vincristine, vinblastine, vinorelbine) act in the M phase: peripheral neuropathy, ptosis, hoarseness, constipation and paralytic ileus; give by minibag, not IV push.長春花生物鹼（vincristine、vinblastine、vinorelbine）作用於M期：周邊神經病變、眼瞼下垂、聲音沙啞、便祕與麻痺性腸阻塞；以小袋稀釋輸注，不可靜脈推注。
  • Taxanes (paclitaxel, docetaxel) are also mitotic inhibitors and can trigger hypersensitivity reactions.紫杉醇類（paclitaxel、docetaxel）亦為有絲分裂抑制劑，可能引發過敏反應。
  • Topoisomerase inhibitors (etoposide, irinotecan, topotecan) act in G2 and S phases: myelosuppression, diarrhea, orthostatic hypotension, hypersensitivity; infuse etoposide slowly over 30-60 minutes.拓樸異構酶抑制劑（etoposide、irinotecan、topotecan）作用於G2與S期：骨髓抑制、腹瀉、姿勢性低血壓、過敏；etoposide須緩慢輸注30-60分鐘。
PDF p.655, 656

Hormonal agents and enzymes荷爾蒙藥物與酵素

  • Hormonal agents block or change hormones in hormone-sensitive tumors: estrogens, antiestrogens (tamoxifen, anastrozole, letrozole), antiandrogens, progestins (megestrol), leuprolide, mitotane, asparaginase.荷爾蒙藥物阻斷或改變荷爾蒙敏感腫瘤的激素環境：雌激素、抗雌激素（tamoxifen、anastrozole、letrozole）、抗雄激素、黃體素（megestrol）、leuprolide、mitotane、asparaginase。
  • Effects: nausea, leukopenia, hot flashes, weight gain, edema, hypertension, thromboembolism, sex-characteristic changes (gynecomastia, masculinizing effects).影響：噁心、白血球低下、熱潮紅、體重增加、水腫、高血壓、血栓栓塞、性徵改變（男性女乳症、女性男性化）。
  • Tamoxifen: hypercalcemia, high cholesterol and triglycerides, venous thromboembolism risk; used to treat and prevent breast cancer. Monitor calcium.Tamoxifen：高血鈣、膽固醇與三酸甘油酯升高、靜脈血栓風險；用於治療及預防乳癌。需監測血鈣。
  • Asparaginase impairs pancreatic function: contraindicated with pancreatitis history; watch nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain. Megestrol: caution with venous thromboembolism history.Asparaginase損害胰臟功能：有胰臟炎病史者禁用；注意噁心、嘔吐、腹痛。Megestrol：有靜脈血栓病史者需謹慎。
PDF p.655, 656, 659, 660

Immunotherapy, targeted therapy, other agents免疫療法、標靶治療與其他藥物

  • Immunomodulators (interleukins, interferons) stimulate the immune system to destroy cancer cells.免疫調節劑（介白素、干擾素）刺激免疫系統辨識並消滅癌細胞。
  • Colony-stimulating factors speed marrow recovery: filgrastim and pegfilgrastim (G-CSF), sargramostim (GM-CSF), epoetin and darbepoetin (erythropoietin).群落刺激因子加速骨髓恢復：filgrastim、pegfilgrastim（G-CSF）、sargramostim（GM-CSF）、epoetin與darbepoetin（紅血球生成素）。
  • Targeted therapy uses monoclonal antibodies (rituximab, trastuzumab, bevacizumab, cetuximab) and small molecule inhibitors (imatinib, erlotinib); monoclonal antibodies can cause allergic reactions.標靶治療包括單株抗體（rituximab、trastuzumab、bevacizumab、cetuximab）與小分子抑制劑（imatinib、erlotinib）；單株抗體可能引起過敏反應。
  • Other agents: altretamine (ovarian cancer), denileukin diftitox and bexarotene (cutaneous T-cell lymphoma), pegaspargase (ALL when asparaginase cannot be used).其他藥物：altretamine（卵巢癌）、denileukin diftitox與bexarotene（皮膚T細胞淋巴瘤）、pegaspargase（無法使用asparaginase的急性淋巴性白血病）。
PDF p.656, 657

Medications for anemia貧血治療藥物

  • Iron-deficiency anemia: iron. Vitamin B12 deficiency: B12. Folate deficiency: folate.缺鐵性貧血：補鐵；維生素B12缺乏：補B12；葉酸缺乏：補葉酸。
  • Acute blood-loss anemia: transfusion of packed red cells, platelets or fresh frozen plasma depending on cause.急性失血性貧血：依原因輸注濃縮紅血球、血小板或新鮮冷凍血漿。
  • Anemia of chronic disease: iron and erythropoietic, leukopoietic and thrombopoietic growth factors.慢性病貧血：鐵劑與紅血球、白血球、血小板生成因子。
PDF p.657

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Dose by BSA: obtain actual current height and weight before every dose, never client-reported values.依BSA給藥：每次給藥前測量實際身高與體重，不可只憑病人自述。 PDF p.651, 659
  2. ANC = WBC x neutrophil %. ANC below 1000: hold chemotherapy, notify oncologist, start neutropenic precautions.ANC=白血球x嗜中性球百分比。ANC低於1000：暫停化療、通知腫瘤科醫師、啟動嗜中性球低下防護。 PDF p.652
  3. Platelets under 50,000/mm3 start bleeding precautions; under 20,000/mm3 spontaneous bleeding risk. Avoid IM injections, aspirin and NSAIDs.血小板低於50,000/mm3啟動出血預防；低於20,000/mm3有自發性出血風險。避免肌肉注射、阿斯匹靈與NSAIDs。 PDF p.651, 652, 653
  4. Extravasation: stop infusion, notify PHCP, heat or ice per drug, antidote into site. Do not flush faster or restart in the same vein.藥物外滲：停止輸注、通知醫師、依藥物冷熱敷、局部注射解毒劑；不可加快沖洗或在同一條靜脈重打。 PDF p.652, 658
  5. Anaphylaxis to chemotherapy: stop infusion first, call rapid response, oxygen, keep IV with saline, epinephrine.化療過敏性休克：先停藥、呼叫快速反應、給氧、生理食鹽水維持靜脈通路、給epinephrine。 PDF p.653
  6. Antiemetics are given several hours before chemotherapy and for 12-48 hours afterward; keep fluids at 2000 mL/day or more.止吐劑於化療前數小時及後12-48小時給予；每日液體至少2000 mL。 PDF p.652
  7. Hyperuricemia from massive cell kill (leukemia, lymphoma): monitor uric acid, give allopurinol; busulfan also raises uric acid.大量細胞死亡造成高尿酸（白血病、淋巴瘤）：監測尿酸、給allopurinol；busulfan亦使尿酸升高。 PDF p.651, 654, 659
  8. Cyclophosphamide/ifosfamide: hemorrhagic cystitis; 2-3 L fluid daily, report hematuria, mesna with ifosfamide.Cyclophosphamide/ifosfamide：出血性膀胱炎；每日飲水2-3 L、通報血尿、ifosfamide併用mesna。 PDF p.654, 660
  9. Cisplatin: ototoxicity, tinnitus, nephrotoxicity, low K, Ca, Mg.Cisplatin：耳毒性、耳鳴、腎毒性、低鉀鈣鎂。 PDF p.654
