  10. Doxorubicin/daunorubicin: cardiotoxicity and heart failure (lung crackles, edema, weight gain, ECG changes). Bleomycin: pulmonary fibrosis, follow PFTs.Doxorubicin/daunorubicin：心毒性與心衰竭（肺囉音、水腫、體重增加、心電圖變化）。Bleomycin：肺纖維化，追蹤肺功能。 PDF p.654, 659, 660
  11. Methotrexate high dose: leucovorin rescue. Fluorouracil/methotrexate: sunscreen and protective clothing; fluorouracil: watch ataxia and stomatitis.高劑量methotrexate：leucovorin解救。Fluorouracil/methotrexate：防曬與保護衣物；fluorouracil注意共濟失調與口腔炎。 PDF p.655
  12. Vincristine: peripheral neuropathy (numbness, tingling, lost Achilles reflex), constipation and paralytic ileus, ptosis; never IV push.Vincristine：周邊神經病變（麻木刺痛、跟腱反射減弱）、便祕與麻痺性腸阻塞、眼瞼下垂；不可靜脈推注。 PDF p.655, 659
  13. Etoposide: orthostatic hypotension; infuse over 30-60 minutes and monitor blood pressure.Etoposide：姿勢性低血壓；輸注30-60分鐘並監測血壓。 PDF p.655, 659
  14. Tamoxifen: monitor calcium (hypercalcemia), lipids, thromboembolism; treats and prevents breast cancer.Tamoxifen：監測血鈣（高血鈣）、血脂、血栓；可治療與預防乳癌。 PDF p.656, 660
  15. Asparaginase contraindicated in pancreatitis; megestrol caution with venous thromboembolism.Asparaginase禁用於胰臟炎；megestrol對靜脈血栓病史者需謹慎。 PDF p.656, 659, 660
  16. No live vaccines for the client or household contacts; check with PHCP before any immunization. Pregnant nurses avoid handling chemotherapy.病人與同住者不可接種活性疫苗；任何接種前先問醫師。懷孕護理師避免接觸化療藥。 PDF p.652, 653, 658

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Phase-specific drugs: S = antimetabolites; M = mitotic inhibitors (vinca, taxanes); G2/S = topoisomerase inhibitors. Nonspecific = Alkylating, Antitumor antibiotics, Hormonal (AAH).週期特異性：S期=抗代謝藥；M期=有絲分裂抑制劑（長春花、紫杉類）；G2/S期=拓樸異構酶抑制劑。非特異性=烷化劑、抗腫瘤抗生素、荷爾蒙（AAH）。 PDF p.652
  • Organ toxicities: Bleomycin = Breath (lungs); Doxorubicin = Dead heart; Cisplatin = Can't hear/kidney; Vincristine = Vincristine nerves; Cyclophosphamide = Cystitis.器官毒性：Bleomycin=肺；Doxorubicin=心；Cisplatin=耳與腎；Vincristine=神經；Cyclophosphamide=膀胱炎。 PDF p.654, 655

47 Endocrine Problems內分泌問題

Covers endocrine anatomy and tests, then pituitary, adrenal, thyroid and parathyroid disorders and their surgeries, followed by diabetes mellitus, insulin therapy, acute (hypoglycemia, DKA, HHS) and chronic complications. Emphasize crisis recognition, lab patterns and priority actions.涵蓋內分泌解剖與檢查，接著為腦下垂體、腎上腺、甲狀腺與副甲狀腺疾病及手術，再到糖尿病、胰島素治療、急性（低血糖、DKA、HHS）與慢性併發症。重點在危象辨識、檢驗模式與優先處置。

Endocrine anatomy and physiology內分泌解剖與生理

  • Endocrine glands: hypothalamus, pituitary, thyroid, parathyroids, adrenals, pancreas, ovaries, testes; they regulate metabolism, stress response, growth, reproduction, fluid and electrolyte balance.內分泌腺體：下視丘、腦下垂體、甲狀腺、副甲狀腺、腎上腺、胰臟、卵巢、睪丸；調控代謝、壓力反應、生長、生殖與水電解質平衡。
  • Pituitary is the master gland: anterior lobe makes ACTH, TSH, FSH, LH, GH, prolactin, MSH; posterior lobe stores oxytocin and ADH (vasopressin) made by the hypothalamus.腦下垂體為主控腺體：前葉分泌ACTH、TSH、FSH、LH、GH、泌乳素、MSH；後葉儲存下視丘製造的oxytocin與ADH（vasopressin）。
  • Adrenal cortex: glucocorticoids (cortisol) and mineralocorticoids (aldosterone: sodium retention, potassium excretion); medulla: epinephrine and norepinephrine.腎上腺皮質：糖皮質素（cortisol）與礦物皮質素（aldosterone：留鈉排鉀）；髓質：epinephrine與norepinephrine。
  • Thyroid makes T3, T4 and calcitonin; parathyroid makes PTH (calcium and phosphorus); pancreas makes insulin and glucagon.甲狀腺分泌T3、T4與降鈣素；副甲狀腺分泌PTH（鈣磷代謝）；胰臟分泌胰島素與升糖素。
  • Negative feedback: rising target-gland hormone suppresses releasing hormones.負回饋：標的腺體荷爾蒙上升會抑制其釋放荷爾蒙。
PDF p.665, 666

Diagnostic tests診斷檢查

  • Stimulation tests check for hypofunction (hormone fails to rise); suppression tests check for hyperfunction (hormone fails to fall). Overnight dexamethasone suppression helps identify Cushing's.刺激試驗檢查功能低下（荷爾蒙未上升）；抑制試驗檢查功能亢進（荷爾蒙未下降）。夜間dexamethasone抑制試驗用於辨別庫欣氏症。
  • Radioactive iodine uptake: about 3-19% at 2-4 hours, 11-30% at 24 hours; high in hyperthyroidism; contraindicated in pregnancy.放射性碘攝取：2-4小時約3-19%、24小時約11-30%；甲亢時升高；懷孕禁用。
  • Total T4 5-12 mcg/dL; free T4 0.8-2.8 ng/dL; TSH 0.5-5.0 mIU/L: high TSH = primary hypothyroidism; low TSH = hyperthyroidism or secondary hypothyroidism.總T4 5-12 mcg/dL；游離T4 0.8-2.8 ng/dL；TSH 0.5-5.0 mIU/L：TSH高=原發性甲低；TSH低=甲亢或次發性甲低。
  • Thyroid scan: avoid iodine-containing meds and contrast; NPO after midnight; contraindicated in pregnancy; fine needle aspiration for cytology.甲狀腺掃描：避免含碘藥物與顯影劑；午夜後禁食；懷孕禁用；細針抽吸做細胞學檢查。
  • HbA1c reflects glucose control over about 90 days, no fasting needed, normal under 6% in adults without diabetes.HbA1c反映約90天血糖控制，無需空腹，無糖尿病成人正常小於6%。
  • 24-hour urine VMA, metanephrines and catecholamines for pheochromocytoma.24小時尿液VMA、甲氧基腎上腺素與兒茶酚胺用於診斷嗜鉻細胞瘤。
PDF p.667, 668

Pituitary problems腦下垂體疾病

  • Hypopituitarism: low GH, gonadotropins, TSH, ACTH or ADH from tumor, trauma, stroke; fatigue, low BP, infertility, headache and visual defects with tumors; replace deficient hormones.腦下垂體功能低下：腫瘤、外傷、中風造成GH、性腺激素、TSH、ACTH或ADH不足；疲倦、低血壓、不孕，腫瘤可致頭痛與視野缺損；補充缺乏荷爾蒙。
  • Acromegaly (excess GH in adults): large hands/feet, jaw protrusion, joint pain, oily skin, sweating, hypertension, heart disease, sleep apnea, hyperglycemia, colon polyps.肢端肥大症（成人GH過多）：手腳增大、下顎突出、關節痛、油性皮膚、多汗、高血壓、心臟病、睡眠呼吸中止、高血糖、大腸息肉。
  • Hypophysectomy: transsphenoidal approach preferred; complications CSF leak, infection, diabetes insipidus, hypopituitarism.腦下垂體切除：偏好經蝶竇途徑；併發症為腦脊髓液漏、感染、尿崩症、腦下垂體功能低下。
  • Postop: HOB elevated, avoid sneezing, coughing, blowing nose, straining; no toothbrush early; report clear nasal drainage (test for glucose), monitor urine output; lifelong ADH, cortisol, thyroid replacement if entire gland removed.術後：抬高床頭，避免打噴嚏、咳嗽、擤鼻、用力；早期不刷牙；通報清澈鼻液（檢測葡萄糖）、監測尿量；全切除需終身補充ADH、cortisol、甲狀腺素。
PDF p.668, 669

Diabetes insipidus and SIADH尿崩症與SIADH

  • Diabetes insipidus: too little ADH (central) or kidney non-response (nephrogenic); large volumes of dilute urine, polydipsia, dehydration, low specific gravity, hypotension, tachycardia.尿崩症：ADH不足（中樞性）或腎臟無反應（腎因性）；大量稀釋尿、多渴、脫水、尿比重低、低血壓、心搏過速。
  • DI care: replace fluids (hypotonic IV), strict I&O, weight, serum osmolality, desmopressin or vasopressin (watch for water intoxication), medical alert bracelet.尿崩症照護：補充水分（低張靜脈輸液）、嚴格記錄出入量、體重、血清滲透壓、desmopressin或vasopressin（注意水中毒）、佩戴醫療警示手環。
  • SIADH: excess ADH causes water retention, dilutional hyponatremia, concentrated scant urine, weight gain without edema, confusion, seizures.SIADH：ADH過多造成水滯留、稀釋性低血鈉、尿少濃縮、無水腫體重增加、意識混亂、抽搐。
  • SIADH care: fluid restriction (800-1000 mL/day if chronic), seizure precautions, HOB no more than 10 degrees, daily weight, hypertonic or normal saline, loop diuretic only if sodium at least 125 mEq/L, vasopressin antagonists.SIADH照護：限水（慢性800-1000 mL/日）、抽搐防護、床頭最高抬高10度、每日體重、高張或生理食鹽水、鈉至少125 mEq/L才用袢利尿劑、vasopressin拮抗劑。
PDF p.669, 670

Adrenal problems: Addison's, Cushing's, Conn's腎上腺疾病：艾迪森氏、庫欣氏、康氏症候群

  • Addison's disease: cortical hypofunction (autoimmune): weakness, weight loss, hypotension, hypoglycemia, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, bronze hyperpigmentation; lifelong glucocorticoid (and often mineralocorticoid) replacement.艾迪森氏病：腎上腺皮質功能低下（自體免疫）：無力、體重減輕、低血壓、低血糖、低血鈉、高血鉀、皮膚古銅色；需終身糖皮質素（常加礦物皮質素）補充。
  • Addisonian crisis: triggered by stress, infection, trauma, surgery, abrupt steroid stop; severe headache, abdominal/back pain, confusion, severe hypotension, shock; give IV hydrocortisone and fluids, bed rest, monitor Na, K, glucose.艾迪森氏危象：由壓力、感染、外傷、手術、驟停類固醇誘發；劇烈頭痛、腹痛背痛、意識混亂、嚴重低血壓、休克；給予靜脈hydrocortisone與輸液、臥床休息、監測鈉鉀血糖。
  • Cushing's: excess cortisol; moon face, buffalo hump, truncal obesity with thin limbs, striae, bruising, hypertension, hyperglycemia, hypernatremia, hypokalemia, infection risk. Cushing's disease = pituitary ACTH source; syndrome includes exogenous steroids.庫欣氏：皮質醇過多；月亮臉、水牛肩、軀幹肥胖四肢細、紫紋、易瘀青、高血壓、高血糖、高血鈉、低血鉀、易感染。庫欣氏病=腦下垂體ACTH來源；症候群含外源性類固醇。
  • Cushing's care: monitor BP, glucose, I&O, weight; protect from infection and thrombi; hypophysectomy or adrenalectomy; stress-dose steroids after surgery.庫欣氏照護：監測血壓、血糖、出入量、體重；預防感染與血栓；腦下垂體或腎上腺切除；術後壓力情況增加類固醇。
  • Conn's (primary hyperaldosteronism): sodium and water retention, potassium loss: hypertension, hypokalemia, alkalosis, weakness, dysrhythmias, tetany; give potassium-sparing diuretics/aldosterone antagonists; adrenalectomy.康氏症（原發性醛固酮過多）：留鈉水、失鉀：高血壓、低血鉀、鹼中毒、無力、心律不整、手足抽搐；給保鉀利尿劑/醛固酮拮抗劑；腎上腺切除。
PDF p.670, 671, 672

Pheochromocytoma and adrenalectomy嗜鉻細胞瘤與腎上腺切除

  • Catecholamine-secreting adrenal medulla tumor: paroxysmal hypertension, severe headache, palpitations, diaphoresis, flushing, tremor, hyperglycemia.分泌兒茶酚胺的腎上腺髓質腫瘤：陣發性高血壓、劇烈頭痛、心悸、盜汗、臉潮紅、顫抖、高血糖。
  • Avoid triggers: abdominal palpation or pressure, smoking, caffeine, sudden position changes; quiet environment; alpha-blockers started 7-10 days before beta-blockers.避免誘因：腹部觸診或壓迫、吸菸、咖啡因、突然變換姿勢；安靜環境；alpha阻斷劑須比beta阻斷劑早7-10天開始。
  • Hypertensive crisis: semi-Fowler's, notify PHCP, oxygen, IV access with slow saline, IV antihypertensives.高血壓危象：半坐臥、通知醫師、給氧、緩慢輸注生理食鹽水保持靜脈通路、靜脈降壓藥。
  • Adrenalectomy: bilateral = lifelong glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid; unilateral = temporary replacement; watch hemorrhage, shock, hypotension, urine output under 30 mL/hr, paralytic ileus, adrenal insufficiency.腎上腺切除：雙側=終身糖皮質素與礦物皮質素補充；單側=暫時補充；注意出血、休克、低血壓、尿量低於30 mL/小時、麻痺性腸阻塞、腎上腺功能不足。
PDF p.672, 673

Thyroid problems甲狀腺疾病

  • Hypothyroidism: low T4, high TSH (primary): fatigue, cold intolerance, weight gain, bradycardia, constipation, dry skin, myxedema; levothyroxine; avoid sedatives and opioids; warmth; watch overdose (tachycardia, chest pain, nervousness).甲狀腺功能低下：T4低、TSH高（原發性）：疲倦、怕冷、體重增加、心搏過緩、便祕、皮膚乾燥、黏液水腫；levothyroxine；避免鎮靜劑與鴉片類；保暖；注意過量（心搏過速、胸痛、緊張）。
  • Myxedema coma: hypotension, bradycardia, hypothermia, hyponatremia, hypoglycemia, respiratory failure; secure airway, IV levothyroxine, IV fluids and glucose, corticosteroids, warm gently.黏液水腫昏迷：低血壓、心搏過緩、體溫過低、低血鈉、低血糖、呼吸衰竭；確保氣道、靜脈levothyroxine、輸液與葡萄糖、皮質類固醇、緩慢保暖。
  • Hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease): T3/T4 high, TSH low; nervousness, tremor, heat intolerance, weight loss, diarrhea, tachycardia, exophthalmos, goiter.甲狀腺功能亢進（葛瑞夫茲氏病）：T3/T4高、TSH低；緊張、顫抖、怕熱、體重減輕、腹瀉、心搏過速、突眼、甲狀腺腫。
  • Treatment: methimazole or propylthiouracil, iodides, propranolol, radioactive iodine, subtotal thyroidectomy; cool quiet environment, high-calorie diet; exophthalmos: HOB up, artificial tears, dark glasses, tape lids at night.治療：methimazole或propylthiouracil、碘劑、propranolol、放射性碘、甲狀腺次全切除；涼爽安靜環境、高熱量飲食；突眼：抬高床頭、人工淚液、深色眼鏡、夜間貼合眼瞼。
  • Thyroid storm: fever, tachycardia, systolic hypertension, agitation, delirium; give antithyroid drugs, iodides, propranolol, glucocorticoids, cooling blanket, acetaminophen (not aspirin).甲狀腺風暴：發燒、心搏過速、收縮壓高、躁動、譫妄；給抗甲狀腺藥、碘劑、propranolol、糖皮質素、降溫毯、acetaminophen（避免阿斯匹靈）。
  • Thyroidectomy postop: semi-Fowler's, support neck, tracheostomy set and suction at bedside, monitor hoarseness, laryngeal nerve damage, bleeding behind the neck, hypocalcemia with tetany (Chvostek, Trousseau), calcium gluconate ready.甲狀腺切除術後：半坐臥、支托頸部、床邊備氣切包與抽吸、監測聲音沙啞、喉返神經損傷、頸後出血、低血鈣手足抽搐（Chvostek、Trousseau徵象）、備calcium gluconate。
PDF p.673, 674, 675

Parathyroid problems副甲狀腺疾病

  • Hypoparathyroidism (often after thyroidectomy): hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, tingling, cramps, positive Chvostek/Trousseau, laryngospasm, seizures.副甲狀腺功能低下（常見於甲狀腺切除後）：低血鈣、高血磷、麻刺感、抽筋、Chvostek/Trousseau陽性、喉痙攣、抽搐。
  • Care: IV calcium gluconate, seizure precautions, tracheostomy set, high-calcium low-phosphorus diet, calcium and vitamin D, phosphate binders.照護：靜脈calcium gluconate、抽搐防護、備氣切包、高鈣低磷飲食、鈣與維生素D、磷結合劑。
  • Hyperparathyroidism: hypercalcemia, low phosphorus, bone pain and fractures, renal stones, constipation, weakness, dysrhythmias.副甲狀腺功能亢進：高血鈣、低血磷、骨痛與骨折、腎結石、便祕、無力、心律不整。
  • Care: fluids, furosemide, IV saline, calcitonin, bisphosphonates, move gently, parathyroidectomy; postop watch hypocalcemic crisis, hoarseness.照護：補水、furosemide、靜脈生理食鹽水、降鈣素、雙磷酸鹽、輕柔移動、副甲狀腺切除；術後注意低血鈣危象與聲音沙啞。
PDF p.676, 677

Diabetes mellitus overview, diet, exercise糖尿病概論、飲食與運動

  • Type 1: nearly absolute insulin deficiency from beta cell destruction (ketosis-prone); type 2: insulin resistance or relative deficiency. Metabolic syndrome: abdominal obesity, hyperglycemia, hypertension, high triglycerides, low HDL.第1型：胰島β細胞破壞造成幾近絕對胰島素缺乏（易酮症）；第2型：胰島素阻抗或相對不足。代謝症候群：腹部肥胖、高血糖、高血壓、高三酸甘油酯、低HDL。
  • Classic signs: polyuria, polydipsia, polyphagia, blurred vision, slow healing, infections; weight loss common in type 1.典型症狀：多尿、多渴、多食、視力模糊、傷口癒合慢、感染；體重減輕多見於第1型。
  • Diet: consistent timing and amounts, carbohydrate counting for intensive insulin therapy.飲食：進食時間與份量一致，強化胰島素治療可用碳水化合物計算。
  • Exercise lowers glucose; check glucose before, during, after; do not exercise if glucose above 250 mg/dL with ketones (type 1); avoid injecting insulin into the limb about to be exercised.運動降血糖；運動前中後監測血糖；血糖大於250 mg/dL且有酮體（第1型）時不運動；避免將胰島素注射於即將運動的肢體。
  • Urine glucose is not reliable for monitoring; test urine ketones during illness or glucose over 250 mg/dL on two checks in type 1.尿糖不可靠，不用於監測；生病或第1型連續兩次血糖大於250 mg/dL時檢測尿酮。
PDF p.677, 678, 679

Insulin therapy and phenomena胰島素治療與現象

  • Insulin treats type 1 and some type 2; never withhold during illness or stress. Know peak times for hypoglycemia risk. Only regular insulin (and rapid-acting) may be given IV.胰島素用於第1型及部分第2型；生病或壓力時不可停用。需了解高峰時間以預防低血糖。僅短效（regular）及速效胰島素可靜脈給予。
  • Local allergy at the site; lipodystrophy from repeated site use: rotate within one anatomical area, sites 1.5 inches apart, not the same site for 2-3 weeks.局部過敏；重複注射同一處造成脂肪營養不良：在同一解剖區輪替，間隔1.5吋，2-3週內不重複同一處。
  • Dawn phenomenon: morning hyperglycemia from GH and cortisol; adjust insulin dose or timing.黎明現象：因生長激素與皮質醇造成晨間高血糖；調整胰島素劑量或時間。
  • Somogyi effect: nighttime hypoglycemia (2-3 a.m.) triggers counterregulatory hormones and morning hyperglycemia; night sweats, headaches, nightmares; decrease insulin or add bedtime snack.蘇木吉效應：夜間2-3點低血糖引發反調節荷爾蒙造成晨間高血糖；盜汗、頭痛、惡夢；減少胰島素或睡前加點心。
  • Insulin pump: continuous basal rate plus meal bolus; rapid or regular insulin; change needle/catheter every 2-3 days; skin sensor monitors glucose. Pancreas transplant is done in limited clients, often with kidney.胰島素幫浦：持續基礎量加餐前大量；速效或短效胰島素；每2-3天更換針頭/導管；皮膚感測器監測血糖。胰臟移植用於少數病人，常與腎臟移植同時。
PDF p.678, 679, 680

Hypoglycemia, DKA and HHS低血糖、酮酸中毒與高滲透壓高血糖狀態

  • Hypoglycemia: glucose under 70 mg/dL; mild (sweating, tremor, tachycardia, hunger), moderate (confusion, slurred speech, irritability), severe (unarousable, seizures). Beta-blockers, older age and frequent episodes cause hypoglycemia unawareness.低血糖：血糖低於70 mg/dL；輕度（出汗、顫抖、心搏過速、飢餓）、中度（混亂、口齒不清、易怒）、重度（無法喚醒、抽搐）。Beta阻斷劑、高齡與頻繁發作可造成低血糖無感。
  • 15/15 rule: give 15 g fast carbohydrate (1/2 cup juice, glucose gel), recheck in 15 minutes, repeat; if altered consciousness give glucagon IM/SC or 25-50 mL of 50% dextrose IV; follow with a complex carbohydrate and protein snack. Never give oral food to a semiconscious client.15/15原則：給15 g速效碳水化合物（1/2杯果汁、葡萄糖膠），15分鐘後複測並重複；意識改變時給glucagon肌注/皮下或靜脈50%葡萄糖25-50 mL；之後給複合碳水加蛋白質點心。意識不清者不可口服進食。
  • DKA (type 1): hyperglycemia, ketosis, acidosis, dehydration; Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath, abdominal pain; glucose over 300, pH under 7.35, HCO3 under 15, ketones positive; sudden onset.DKA（第1型）：高血糖、酮症、酸中毒、脫水；Kussmaul呼吸、水果味呼氣、腹痛；血糖大於300、pH低於7.35、HCO3低於15、酮體陽性；起病急。
  • DKA treatment: fluids first (0.9% or 0.45% saline), then IV regular insulin by pump, replace potassium once urine output adequate (K falls quickly), add dextrose when glucose 250-300 mg/dL, cardiac monitoring, watch for cerebral edema if glucose drops too fast.DKA治療：先補液（0.9%或0.45%食鹽水），再以幫浦靜脈給regular insulin，尿量足夠後補鉀（鉀快速下降），血糖降至250-300 mg/dL時加葡萄糖，心電圖監測，血糖降太快注意腦水腫。
  • HHS (type 2, older): glucose over 800 mg/dL, osmolarity over 350, no ketosis or acidosis, gradual onset, severe dehydration and neurological changes; treat with careful fluids (heart failure risk), electrolytes, insulin.HHS（第2型、老年）：血糖大於800 mg/dL、滲透壓大於350、無酮症或酸中毒、逐漸發作、嚴重脫水與神經症狀；謹慎補液（心衰風險）、電解質、胰島素。
  • Sick-day rules: continue insulin, check glucose and ketones every 3-4 hours, sip fluids every 30-60 minutes, call PHCP if glucose above 250-300, ketonuria over 24 hours, unable to eat or drink for 4 hours.生病期間守則：持續使用胰島素、每3-4小時測血糖與尿酮、每30-60分鐘小口喝水、血糖大於250-300、酮尿超過24小時、4小時無法進食飲水須通知醫師。
PDF p.679, 680, 681, 682

Chronic complications and surgery in diabetes糖尿病慢性併發症與手術照護

  • Retinopathy: microaneurysms, macular edema, retinal detachment, cataracts; laser photocoagulation, vitrectomy; control BP and glucose.視網膜病變：微動脈瘤、黃斑水腫、視網膜剝離、白內障；雷射光凝、玻璃體切除；控制血壓與血糖。
  • Nephropathy: microalbuminuria first; restrict protein, sodium, potassium; avoid nephrotoxic drugs; dialysis or transplant.腎病變：先出現微量白蛋白尿；限制蛋白質、鈉、鉀；避免腎毒性藥物；透析或移植。
  • Neuropathy: peripheral (distal feet), autonomic (orthostatic hypotension, gastroparesis, neurogenic bladder, impotence, hypoglycemia unawareness), focal (cranial nerves III, VI diplopia).神經病變：周邊型（遠端足部）、自主神經型（姿勢性低血壓、胃輕癱、神經性膀胱、陽痿、低血糖無感）、局部型（第III、VI腦神經造成複視）。
  • Foot care: inspect daily, wash with warm water and dry well, no soaks, moisturize but not between toes, cotton socks, well-fitting shoes never barefoot, cut nails straight, no corn treatment or heating pads.足部照護：每日檢查、溫水清洗徹底擦乾、不泡腳、保濕但趾縫不塗、棉襪、合腳鞋且不赤腳、指甲剪平、不自行處理雞眼、不用熱敷墊。
  • Surgery: check with PHCP about withholding oral agents or insulin; metformin may be stopped 48 hours before and restarted after renal function is normal; IV glucose and insulin postoperatively; frequent glucose checks; higher risk for cardiovascular, renal problems and poor healing.手術：向醫師確認口服藥或胰島素是否停用；metformin可能術前48小時停藥，待腎功能正常再恢復；術後給靜脈葡萄糖與胰島素；頻繁監測血糖；心血管、腎臟併發症與傷口癒合不良風險較高。
PDF p.682, 683, 684

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Hypoglycemia (under 70 mg/dL): conscious = 15 g fast carbohydrate, recheck in 15 minutes; unconscious = glucagon IM/SC or IV 50% dextrose; never oral food.低血糖（低於70 mg/dL）：清醒=15 g速效碳水、15分鐘複測；意識不清=glucagon肌注/皮下或靜脈50%葡萄糖；不可口服。 PDF p.680
  2. DKA: fluids first, then insulin infusion; monitor potassium closely (falls with treatment); cerebral edema if glucose drops too fast.DKA：先補液再給胰島素輸注；密切監測血鉀（治療後下降）；血糖降太快會腦水腫。 PDF p.680, 681
  3. DKA vs HHS: DKA glucose over 300, ketones, pH under 7.35, type 1, sudden; HHS glucose over 800, osmolarity over 350, no ketones, type 2, gradual.DKA對HHS：DKA血糖大於300、有酮體、pH低於7.35、第1型、急發；HHS血糖大於800、滲透壓大於350、無酮體、第2型、漸進。 PDF p.681
  4. Never withhold insulin during illness; test ketones when glucose is over 250 mg/dL twice in type 1.生病時不可停胰島素；第1型連續兩次血糖大於250 mg/dL需測尿酮。 PDF p.678, 679
  5. Somogyi: nocturnal hypoglycemia then morning hyperglycemia (reduce insulin); dawn phenomenon: morning hyperglycemia without hypoglycemia (increase insulin or change timing).蘇木吉：夜間低血糖後晨間高血糖（減少胰島素）；黎明現象：無低血糖的晨間高血糖（增加或調整胰島素時間）。 PDF p.678
  6. Only regular and rapid-acting insulin may be given IV; infusions via controller; rotate sites 1.5 inches apart.僅短效與速效胰島素可靜脈給予；以輸液控制器輸注；注射部位輪替相隔1.5吋。 PDF p.678, 681
  7. Addisonian crisis: hypotension, shock, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, hypoglycemia; IV hydrocortisone and fluids. Steroid doses increase during stress; never stop abruptly.艾迪森氏危象：低血壓、休克、低血鈉、高血鉀、低血糖；靜脈hydrocortisone與輸液。壓力時增加類固醇劑量，不可驟停。 PDF p.670, 671
  8. Cushing's: moon face, buffalo hump, hypertension, hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, infection and thrombus risk. Addison's is the opposite: hypotension, hypoglycemia, hyperkalemia, bronze skin.庫欣氏：月亮臉、水牛肩、高血壓、高血糖、低血鉀、感染與血栓風險。艾迪森氏相反：低血壓、低血糖、高血鉀、古銅膚色。 PDF p.670, 671
  9. Pheochromocytoma: no abdominal palpation, avoid smoking and caffeine; alpha-blockers before beta-blockers (7-10 days); crisis = BP can exceed 220/140.嗜鉻細胞瘤：不可觸壓腹部、避免吸菸與咖啡因；alpha阻斷劑先於beta阻斷劑7-10天；危象時血壓可超過220/140。 PDF p.672, 673
  10. Diabetes insipidus: large dilute urine, low specific gravity, dehydration; desmopressin. SIADH: water retention, hyponatremia, fluid restriction, seizure precautions.尿崩症：大量稀釋尿、尿比重低、脫水；desmopressin。SIADH：水滯留、低血鈉、限水、抽搐防護。 PDF p.669, 670
  11. After transsphenoidal hypophysectomy: clear nasal drainage may be CSF leak (check glucose); avoid coughing, sneezing, straining; watch for diabetes insipidus.經蝶竇腦下垂體切除術後：清澈鼻液可能為腦脊液漏（檢測葡萄糖）；避免咳嗽、打噴嚏、用力；注意尿崩症。 PDF p.668, 669
  12. Thyroidectomy: airway first: trachea set and suction at bedside; watch bleeding, hoarseness, hypocalcemia (Chvostek, Trousseau), calcium gluconate.甲狀腺切除術：氣道優先：床邊備氣切包與抽吸；注意出血、聲音沙啞、低血鈣（Chvostek、Trousseau）、備calcium gluconate。 PDF p.675
  13. Thyroid storm: fever, tachycardia, delirium; use acetaminophen, not aspirin; propranolol, iodides, antithyroid drugs.甲狀腺風暴：發燒、心搏過速、譫妄；用acetaminophen而非阿斯匹靈；propranolol、碘劑、抗甲狀腺藥。 PDF p.675
  14. Myxedema coma: hypothermia, bradycardia, hypoglycemia, respiratory failure; avoid sedatives and opioids in hypothyroidism; IV levothyroxine.黏液水腫昏迷：體溫過低、心搏過緩、低血糖、呼吸衰竭；甲低者避免鎮靜劑與鴉片類；靜脈levothyroxine。 PDF p.673, 674
  15. TSH high + T4 low = primary hypothyroidism; TSH low + T4 high = hyperthyroidism.TSH高加T4低=原發性甲低；TSH低加T4高=甲亢。 PDF p.667, 673, 674
  16. Hypoparathyroidism: low calcium, high phosphorus, tetany; hyperparathyroidism: high calcium, low phosphorus, stones, fractures.副甲狀腺低下：低鈣高磷、手足抽搐；亢進：高鈣低磷、結石、骨折。 PDF p.676
  17. HbA1c reflects about 90 days of control; normal under 6% without diabetes; no fasting needed.HbA1c反映約90天控制；無糖尿病正常小於6%；無需空腹。 PDF p.667
  18. Diabetic foot care: never barefoot, no heating pads, inspect daily, cut nails straight across.糖尿病足部照護：不赤腳、不用熱敷墊、每日檢查、指甲剪平。 PDF p.683

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Addison's vs Cushing's: Addison = 'Low everything' (BP, Na, glucose) but K high, skin bronze; Cushing = 'High everything' (BP, glucose, Na) but K low.艾迪森氏=血壓、鈉、血糖低但鉀高、膚色古銅；庫欣氏=血壓、血糖、鈉高但鉀低。 PDF p.670
  • Hypoglycemia 'cold and clammy, need some candy'; hyperglycemia 'hot and dry, sugar high'.低血糖：冷汗濕黏需補糖；高血糖：皮膚熱而乾。 PDF p.679, 680
  • Thyroid: hyper = everything up and 'hot' (tachycardia, weight loss, diarrhea); hypo = everything slow and 'cold' (bradycardia, weight gain, constipation).甲亢=全部加快、怕熱（心搏過速、體重減輕、腹瀉）；甲低=全部變慢、怕冷（心搏過緩、體重增加、便祕）。 PDF p.674

48 Endocrine Medications內分泌藥物

This chapter organizes endocrine drugs by class: pituitary hormones, desmopressin, thyroid and antithyroid agents, calcium/parathyroid agents, corticosteroids, sex hormones, and diabetes drugs including insulin. For each class know the action, the signature adverse effect, what to monitor, and the teaching that prevents harm (e.g., never stop steroids abruptly, draw up regular insulin before NPH).本章依藥物類別整理內分泌用藥：腦下垂體激素、去氨加壓素、甲狀腺與抗甲狀腺藥、鈣/副甲狀腺藥、皮質類固醇、性荷爾蒙，以及含胰島素在內的糖尿病藥物。每一類都要掌握作用、代表性不良反應、監測項目，以及能避免傷害的衛教（例如類固醇不可突然停藥、混合胰島素時先抽取速效/常規型）。

Pituitary hormones and antidiuretic hormone腦下垂體激素與抗利尿激素

  • Growth hormone (somatropin, mecasermin) treats GH deficiency; receptor antagonists/somatostatin analogs (octreotide, lanreotide, pasireotide, pegvisomant) treat acromegaly.生長激素（somatropin、mecasermin）用於生長激素缺乏；受體拮抗劑/體抑素類似物（octreotide、lanreotide、pasireotide、pegvisomant）用於肢端肥大症。
  • GH adverse effects: headache, mild hyperglycemia, hypertension, weight gain, injection-site pain, raised AST/ALT, antibody formation.生長激素不良反應：頭痛、輕度高血糖、高血壓、體重增加、注射部位疼痛、AST/ALT 上升、產生抗體。
  • Monitor children's growth against standards, yearly bone-age studies, vital signs, glucose, liver enzymes and thyroid tests.監測兒童生長曲線、每年骨齡檢查、生命徵象、血糖、肝酵素與甲狀腺功能。
  • Desmopressin (DDAVP) and vasopressin increase renal water reabsorption; used for diabetes insipidus (vasopressin is also used in shock).去氨加壓素（desmopressin）與血管加壓素增加腎臟水分再吸收，用於尿崩症（血管加壓素亦用於休克）。
  • Main risk is water intoxication (drowsiness, listlessness, headache, dyspnea, hypertension): decrease dose. Dehydration/polyuria means the dose may need to increase.主要風險為水中毒（嗜睡、倦怠、頭痛、呼吸喘、高血壓）：需減量；脫水或多尿代表可能需增量。
  • Monitor weight daily, I&O, urine osmolality, electrolytes and BP; teach correct intranasal technique.每日測體重、記錄輸出入量、尿滲透壓、電解質與血壓；教導鼻內給藥技巧。
PDF p.694, 695

Thyroid hormones (levothyroxine, liothyronine)甲狀腺素（levothyroxine、liothyronine）

  • Replace deficient hormone in hypothyroidism and myxedema coma; raise metabolic rate, heat production and oxygen use.補充甲狀腺機能低下與黏液水腫昏迷時不足的荷爾蒙；提高代謝率、產熱與耗氧。
  • Overdose looks like hyperthyroidism: tachycardia, palpitations, chest pain, nervousness, tremor, insomnia, sweating, heat intolerance, weight loss, diarrhea.過量表現如甲亢：心搏過速、心悸、胸痛、緊張、顫抖、失眠、盜汗、不耐熱、體重減輕、腹瀉。
  • Take at the same time every morning on an empty stomach; separate by at least 4 hours from calcium, iron, antacids, multivitamins, bile acid sequestrants, sucralfate.每天同一時間晨起空腹服用；與鈣、鐵、制酸劑、綜合維他命、膽酸結合劑、sucralfate 至少間隔 4 小時。
  • Enhances warfarin, sympathomimetics and antidepressants; decreases effect of insulin, oral hypoglycemics and digoxin; phenytoin/carbamazepine reduce thyroid effect.增強 warfarin、擬交感神經藥與抗憂鬱藥作用；降低胰島素、口服降血糖藥、digoxin 的效果；phenytoin/carbamazepine 會降低甲狀腺素效果。
  • Monitor T3, T4, TSH, pulse, weight; teach client to take pulse and to avoid OTC drugs; wear a MedicAlert bracelet.監測 T3、T4、TSH、脈搏與體重；教導自測脈搏、避免自行使用成藥；佩戴醫療警示手環。
PDF p.695

Antithyroid drugs and thyroid eye disease抗甲狀腺藥與甲狀腺眼病

  • Methimazole and propylthiouracil inhibit hormone synthesis (Graves' disease, hyperthyroidism); potassium iodide/strong iodine (Lugol's) are used about 2 weeks before thyroid surgery.Methimazole 與 propylthiouracil 抑制甲狀腺素合成（Graves 病、甲亢）；碘化鉀/強碘液（Lugol）用於甲狀腺手術前約 2 週。
  • Agranulocytosis (fever, sore throat) is the key adverse effect; also rash, GI upset, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, alopecia. Overdose causes hypothyroidism.關鍵不良反應為顆粒球低下症（發燒、喉嚨痛）；另有皮疹、腸胃不適、白血球/血小板低下、落髮。過量導致甲狀腺機能低下。
  • Iodism: metallic/brassy taste, sore gums and salivary glands, vomiting, abdominal pain, rash.碘中毒：口中金屬味、牙齦與唾液腺疼痛、嘔吐、腹痛、皮疹。
  • Give with meals; never stop abruptly (risk of thyroid storm: fever, flushing, confusion, tachycardia, heart failure). Avoid aspirin and iodine-containing products.與餐同服；不可突然停藥（可能引發甲狀腺風暴：發燒、潮紅、意識混亂、心搏過速、心衰竭）。避免阿斯匹靈與含碘產品。
  • Teprotumumab reduces swelling, bulging and double vision in thyroid eye disease.Teprotumumab 可減輕甲狀腺眼病的腫脹、突眼與複視。
PDF p.695, 696

Calcium and parathyroid-related drugs鈣與副甲狀腺相關藥物

  • Hypoparathyroidism (low Ca, tetany) is treated with calcium and vitamin D; hyperparathyroidism/hypercalcemia uses agents such as cinacalcet, calcitonin, bisphosphonates.副甲狀腺功能低下（低血鈣、手足抽搐）以鈣與維生素 D 治療；副甲狀腺功能亢進/高血鈣用 cinacalcet、calcitonin、雙磷酸鹽等。
  • Calcium with digoxin raises digoxin toxicity risk; oral calcium lowers tetracycline absorption.鈣合併 digoxin 會增加 digoxin 中毒風險；口服鈣降低 tetracycline 吸收。
  • Alendronate: swallow whole with plain water at least 30 minutes before breakfast and stay upright 30 minutes.Alendronate：早餐前至少 30 分鐘以白開水整顆吞服，並保持直立至少 30 分鐘。
  • Calcitonin nasal spray: alternate nostrils. Calcium supplements: adequate vitamin D, fluids and fiber (constipation); give other drugs 1 hour apart.Calcitonin 鼻噴劑：左右鼻孔交替。鈣補充劑：維生素 D 充足、多喝水與纖維（預防便秘）；其他藥物間隔 1 小時。
  • Hypercalcemia signs: renal stones, polyuria, polydipsia, anorexia, nausea, constipation; clients on antihypercalcemics limit calcium-rich foods.高血鈣徵象：腎結石、多尿、多渴、厭食、噁心、便秘；使用降鈣藥者需減少高鈣食物。
PDF p.696

Corticosteroids: mineralocorticoids and glucocorticoids皮質類固醇：礦物皮質素與糖皮質素

  • Fludrocortisone (mineralocorticoid) retains Na and water and excretes K: replacement in Addison's disease; adverse effects edema, hypertension, hypokalemia, heart failure. Encourage high-potassium diet.Fludrocortisone（礦物皮質素）留鈉留水、排鉀：用於 Addison 氏病替代治療；不良反應水腫、高血壓、低血鉀、心衰竭。建議高鉀飲食。
  • Glucocorticoids (prednisone, hydrocortisone, dexamethasone, methylprednisolone, etc.) are anti-inflammatory/immunosuppressive.糖皮質素（prednisone、hydrocortisone、dexamethasone、methylprednisolone 等）具抗發炎與免疫抑制作用。
  • Adverse effects: hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, fluid retention, infection risk with masked signs, osteoporosis, moon face, buffalo hump, mood swings or psychosis, cataracts, GI ulcers, growth retardation in children.不良反應：高血糖、低血鉀、水分滯留、感染風險且徵象被掩蓋、骨質疏鬆、月亮臉、水牛肩、情緒波動或精神病、白內障、胃潰瘍、兒童生長遲緩。
  • Take in the early morning with food; never stop abruptly (adrenal insufficiency); extra dose may be needed during stress or surgery; no live vaccines; avoid infected people.清晨隨食物服用；不可突然停藥（腎上腺功能不全）；壓力或手術時可能需追加劑量；不可接種活病毒疫苗；避免接觸感染者。
  • Monitor glucose, electrolytes, I&O, weight, BP; NSAIDs/aspirin plus steroids raise GI bleeding risk; barbiturates, phenytoin, rifampin reduce prednisone effect.監測血糖、電解質、輸出入、體重、血壓；NSAIDs/阿斯匹靈合併類固醇增加消化道出血風險；巴比妥類、phenytoin、rifampin 降低 prednisone 效果。
PDF p.697, 698

Androgens, estrogens and progestins雄性激素、雌激素與黃體素

  • Androgens (testosterone products, methyltestosterone): virilization, priapism, edema, acne, hepatotoxicity, hypercalcemia; enhance warfarin; may lower insulin needs; avoid in prostate/breast cancer.雄性激素（睪固酮製劑、methyltestosterone）：男性化、陰莖異常勃起、水腫、痤瘡、肝毒性、高血鈣；增強 warfarin；可能降低胰島素需求；前列腺癌/乳癌避免使用。
  • Report priapism, fluid retention, jaundice/RUQ pain; give with meals; use nonhormonal contraception.出現陰莖異常勃起、水腫、黃疸/右上腹痛須通報；隨餐服用；使用非荷爾蒙避孕。
  • Estrogens: contraindicated in breast/endometrial cancer, thromboembolism, pregnancy, lactation; adverse effects thromboembolism, stroke, MI, hypertension, migraine, nausea, edema.雌激素：乳癌/子宮內膜癌、血栓栓塞、懷孕、哺乳為禁忌；不良反應血栓栓塞、中風、心肌梗塞、高血壓、偏頭痛、噁心、水腫。
  • Progestins: contraindicated with thromboembolic disorders; avoid in breast tumors and liver disease. Teach no smoking, routine breast/pelvic exams, BP and weight monitoring.黃體素：血栓栓塞疾病禁用；乳房腫瘤與肝病避免使用。衛教戒菸、定期乳房與骨盆檢查、監測血壓與體重。
  • Barbiturates, phenytoin and rifampin reduce estrogen effectiveness.巴比妥類、phenytoin、rifampin 降低雌激素效果。
PDF p.698, 699

Oral and injectable antidiabetic drugs (non-insulin)口服與非胰島素注射降血糖藥

  • Metformin (biguanide): lowers hepatic glucose output; GI upset, lactic acidosis risk; little hypoglycemia. Hold before and 48 hours after IV contrast; check creatinine before resuming.Metformin（雙胍類）：減少肝臟葡萄糖輸出；腸胃不適、乳酸中毒風險；低血糖少見。靜脈注射顯影劑前及後 48 小時暫停，恢復前檢查肌酸酐。
  • Sulfonylureas (glimepiride, glipizide, glyburide) and meglitinides (repaglinide, nateglinide): increase insulin secretion; hypoglycemia, weight gain; sulfonylureas can cause a disulfiram-like reaction with alcohol; meglitinides taken right before/with the meal and skipped if meal skipped.磺醯脲類與格列奈類（repaglinide、nateglinide）：促進胰島素分泌；低血糖、體重增加；磺醯脲類與酒精可產生類 disulfiram 反應；格列奈類於餐前/餐時服用，不進食則不服。
  • Thiazolidinediones (pioglitazone): heart failure, fractures, bladder cancer, ovulation; alpha-glucosidase inhibitors (acarbose, miglitol): flatulence, give with first bite of meal.噻唑烷二酮（pioglitazone）：心衰竭、骨折、膀胱癌、恢復排卵；α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制劑（acarbose、miglitol）：脹氣，隨第一口飯服用。
  • DPP-4 inhibitors (-gliptins): pancreatitis, hypersensitivity. SGLT-2 inhibitors (-gliflozins): genital mycotic infection, orthostatic hypotension, weight loss.DPP-4 抑制劑（-gliptin）：胰臟炎、過敏。SGLT-2 抑制劑（-gliflozin）：生殖器黴菌感染、姿位性低血壓、體重下降。
  • GLP-1 agonists (semaglutide, dulaglutide, exenatide): slow gastric emptying, appetite suppression; nausea, pancreatitis, thyroid C-cell tumor warning (semaglutide); not for type 1; give other oral drugs 1 hour before.GLP-1 受體促效劑（semaglutide、dulaglutide、exenatide）：延緩胃排空、抑制食慾；噁心、胰臟炎、甲狀腺 C 細胞腫瘤警示（semaglutide）；不適用第一型；其他口服藥於注射前 1 小時服用。
  • Pramlintide (amylin mimetic) for insulin users: severe hypoglycemia risk, nausea; oral drugs 1 hour before or 2 hours after. Sympathomimetics, steroids, thiazides, phenytoin raise glucose; beta blockers mask hypoglycemia.Pramlintide（類澱粉素）用於使用胰島素者：嚴重低血糖風險、噁心；口服藥於注射前 1 小時或後 2 小時服用。擬交感藥、類固醇、thiazide、phenytoin 使血糖升高；β 阻斷劑掩蓋低血糖症狀。
PDF p.699, 700, 703

Insulin and glucagon胰島素與升糖素

  • Onset/peak/duration: lispro 15-30 min/0.5-2.5 h/3-6 h; aspart 10-20 min/1-3 h/3-5 h; regular 30-60 min/1-5 h/6-10 h; NPH 60-120 min/6-14 h/16-24 h; glargine no peak, 18-24 h; detemir 12-24 h peak; degludec no peak, >40 h.起效/高峰/持續：lispro 15-30 分/0.5-2.5 小時/3-6 小時；aspart 10-20 分/1-3 小時/3-5 小時；常規型 30-60 分/1-5 小時/6-10 小時；NPH 60-120 分/6-14 小時/16-24 小時；glargine 無高峰、18-24 小時；detemir 高峰 12-24 小時；degludec 無高峰、>40 小時。
  • Mixing: draw up clear (regular/short) first, then cloudy NPH ("RN"); only NPH is cloudy and must be rolled, not shaken; inject air into both vials; use mixed dose within 5-15 minutes; glargine is never mixed.混合：先抽透明（常規/速效），再抽混濁的 NPH（口訣 RN）；只有 NPH 混濁，需滾動不可劇烈搖晃；兩瓶都先注入空氣；混合後 5-15 分鐘內使用；glargine 不可混合。
  • Storage: unopened vials refrigerated, never frozen; vial in use may stay at room temperature if used within about 1 month; give at room temperature; avoid heat/sunlight.保存：未開封瓶冷藏、不可冷凍；使用中且約 1 個月內用完可置室溫；注射時為室溫；避免高溫與日照。
  • Sites: abdomen absorbs fastest/most even; rotate within one area, 1-1.5 inch apart, not same site for 2-3 weeks; heat, massage, exercise raise absorption (hypoglycemia); scar tissue delays it. Angle 45-90 degrees (45-60 if thin).部位：腹部吸收最快且均勻；同一區域輪替，間距 1-1.5 吋，2-3 週不重複同一點；熱敷、按摩、運動加速吸收（低血糖）；疤痕組織延遲吸收。角度 45-90 度（消瘦者 45-60 度）。
  • U-100 is standard; only regular insulin comes as U-500 (severe resistance, special syringe). Pens need a new needle each injection. Aspiration generally not needed.標準濃度 U-100；僅常規型有 U-500（嚴重胰島素阻抗，需專用針筒）。筆型注射每次換新針頭。一般不需回抽。
  • Glucagon raises glucose by liver glycogenolysis; SC/IM/IV for insulin hypoglycemia when client cannot swallow; effect within 5-20 minutes; also used for beta blocker overdose; teach family.升糖素經肝醣分解升高血糖；病人無法吞嚥時以皮下/肌肉/靜脈給予，5-20 分鐘起效；亦用於 β 阻斷劑過量；需教導家屬。
PDF p.701, 702, 703

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Never stop corticosteroids abruptly: risk of acute adrenal insufficiency. Dose taper schedules; extra dose may be needed under stress.皮質類固醇不可突然停藥：恐致急性腎上腺功能不全；需依遞減計畫，壓力時可能需追加劑量。 PDF p.697, 698
  2. Glucocorticoids mask infection and raise glucose; no live-virus vaccines.糖皮質素會掩蓋感染徵象並升高血糖；不可接種活病毒疫苗。 PDF p.697, 698
  3. Methimazole: agranulocytosis. Fever or sore throat means call the PHCP.Methimazole：顆粒球低下症；發燒或喉嚨痛須通知醫師。 PDF p.696
  4. Abrupt antithyroid withdrawal can trigger thyroid storm (fever, tachycardia, confusion, flushing, HF).抗甲狀腺藥突然停用可能引發甲狀腺風暴（發燒、心搏過速、意識混亂、潮紅、心衰竭）。 PDF p.696
  5. Levothyroxine: morning, empty stomach, same time daily; separate from calcium/iron/antacids by 4 hours; report tachycardia, chest pain, palpitations, sweating (toxicity).Levothyroxine：晨起空腹、每天同一時間；與鈣/鐵/制酸劑間隔 4 小時；出現心搏過速、胸痛、心悸、盜汗（中毒）須通報。 PDF p.695
  6. Desmopressin: water intoxication signs (headache, drowsiness, dyspnea) mean dose too high; dehydration means dose may be too low.去氨加壓素：水中毒徵象（頭痛、嗜睡、呼吸喘）代表劑量過高；脫水可能代表劑量不足。 PDF p.694
  7. Metformin: hold for IV contrast and 48 hours after; early lactic acidosis signs are unusual somnolence, hyperventilation, myalgia, malaise.Metformin：靜脈顯影劑前及後 48 小時暫停；乳酸中毒早期徵象為異常嗜睡、過度換氣、肌痛、倦怠。 PDF p.700, 701, 705
  8. Regular (clear) insulin is drawn up before NPH (cloudy); glargine is never mixed; do not freeze insulin.先抽常規型（透明）再抽 NPH（混濁）；glargine 不可混合；胰島素不可冷凍。 PDF p.702
  9. Heat, massage or exercise at the injection site speeds absorption and can cause hypoglycemia.注射部位熱敷、按摩或運動會加速吸收而導致低血糖。 PDF p.701
  10. Sulfonylurea + alcohol: disulfiram-like reaction (flushing, palpitations, nausea) and added hypoglycemia.磺醯脲類 + 酒精：類 disulfiram 反應（潮紅、心悸、噁心）並加重低血糖。 PDF p.699, 705
  11. Beta blockers mask hypoglycemia signs; steroids, thiazides, phenytoin, estrogen raise glucose.β 阻斷劑掩蓋低血糖徵象；類固醇、thiazide、phenytoin、雌激素使血糖升高。 PDF p.699
  12. GLP-1 agonists are not for type 1 diabetes and are not a substitute for insulin; query the order.GLP-1 促效劑不適用第一型糖尿病，也不可取代胰島素；應向醫師確認醫囑。 PDF p.702, 703, 705
  13. Pramlintide: oral meds 1 hour before or 2 hours after; risk of severe hypoglycemia with insulin.Pramlintide：口服藥於注射前 1 小時或後 2 小時；與胰島素併用有嚴重低血糖風險。 PDF p.703
  14. Glucagon is for the semiconscious/unconscious hypoglycemic client who cannot take liquids; works in 5-20 minutes.升糖素用於半昏迷/昏迷、無法飲水的低血糖病人；5-20 分鐘起效。 PDF p.703
  15. Alendronate: upright 30 minutes, plain water, 30 minutes before breakfast.Alendronate：餐前 30 分鐘以白開水服用並直立 30 分鐘。 PDF p.696, 705
  16. Estrogens: thromboembolism, stroke, MI; teach no smoking. Androgens: report priapism.雌激素：血栓栓塞、中風、心肌梗塞；教導戒菸。雄性激素：陰莖異常勃起須通報。 PDF p.698, 699

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • RN: draw up Regular before NPH when mixing insulin.RN 口訣：混合胰島素先抽 Regular 再抽 NPH。 PDF p.705
  • Steroid effects 'CUSHINGOID': moon face, buffalo hump, hyperglycemia, infection, osteoporosis, mood changes, GI ulcer.類固醇副作用「Cushingoid」：月亮臉、水牛肩、高血糖、感染、骨質疏鬆、情緒變化、胃潰瘍。 PDF p.697
  • Thyroid drug overdose = hyper (fast, hot, shaky); antithyroid overdose = hypo (slow, cold, tired).甲狀腺素過量=甲亢（快、熱、抖）；抗甲狀腺藥過量=甲低（慢、冷、累）。 PDF p.695, 696
  • -gliptin = DPP-4 (pancreatitis); -gliflozin = SGLT-2 (genital yeast infection, dehydration); -glutide/-tide = GLP-1 (nausea, pancreatitis).-gliptin=DPP-4（胰臟炎）；-gliflozin=SGLT-2（生殖器黴菌感染、脫水）；-glutide/-tide=GLP-1（噁心、胰臟炎）。 PDF p.700

49 Gastrointestinal Problems胃腸道問題

This chapter reviews GI anatomy, diagnostic tests with pre/post-procedure care, and the major GI, liver, biliary and pancreatic disorders. Focus on red flags (bleeding, perforation/peritonitis, encephalopathy, shock after paracentesis), diet teaching, and priority nursing actions.本章複習消化道解剖、各項檢查的檢查前後護理，以及主要的胃腸、肝膽與胰臟疾病。重點為危險徵象（出血、穿孔/腹膜炎、肝腦病變、腹腔穿刺後休克）、飲食衛教與優先護理處置。

GI anatomy and physiology胃腸道解剖與生理

  • The GI tract digests food, absorbs nutrients, excretes waste, and hosts bacteria that make vitamin K and some B vitamins.消化道負責消化食物、吸收養分、排泄廢物，腸道菌群合成維生素 K 與部分 B 群維生素。
  • Stomach: HCl, pepsin, intrinsic factor (from parietal cells, needed for B12), gastrin controls acidity; lower esophageal sphincter prevents reflux, pylorus controls emptying.胃：鹽酸、胃蛋白酶、內在因子（壁細胞分泌，吸收 B12 所需）、胃泌素調節酸度；下食道括約肌防逆流，幽門控制排空。
  • Small intestine: duodenum, jejunum, ileum; large intestine absorbs water; ileocecal valve prevents backflow into the ileum.小腸：十二指腸、空腸、迴腸；大腸吸收水分；迴盲瓣防止內容物回流至迴腸。
  • Liver: Kupffer cells, bile production (500-1000 mL/day), stores vitamins A, D, B and iron. Gallbladder stores bile; cholecystokinin contracts it after fatty meals.肝臟：庫佛氏細胞、產膽汁（每日 500-1000 mL）、儲存維生素 A、D、B 與鐵。膽囊儲存膽汁；高脂食物刺激 cholecystokinin 使膽囊收縮。
  • Pancreas: exocrine enzymes and bicarbonate; endocrine insulin, glucagon, somatostatin.胰臟：外分泌酵素與碳酸氫鈉；內分泌胰島素、升糖素、體抑素。

Diagnostic procedures: endoscopy and imaging診斷檢查：內視鏡與影像

  • Barium swallow: NPO 4-8 h; afterward fluids, possible laxative, chalky white stools 24-72 h; barium can cause obstruction.上消化道鋇劑檢查：禁食 4-8 小時；檢查後多喝水、可能給瀉劑，糞便呈灰白色 24-72 小時；鋇劑可能造成阻塞。
  • EGD: consent, NPO 6-8 h, left side position; afterward NPO until gag reflex returns; watch for perforation (pain, bleeding, fever, difficulty swallowing).上消化道內視鏡：需同意書、禁食 6-8 小時、左側臥；檢查後禁食至嘔吐反射恢復；監測穿孔（疼痛、出血、發燒、吞嚥困難）。
  • Colonoscopy: bowel prep and clear liquids the day before (avoid red/orange/purple), NPO 4-6 h; afterward left lateral, expect flatus; watch for perforation/peritonitis; bowel prep causes fluid/electrolyte shifts.大腸鏡：前一天腸道準備與清流質（避免紅、橙、紫色），禁食 4-6 小時；檢查後左側臥、排氣屬正常；監測穿孔/腹膜炎；腸道準備可致水分電解質失衡。
  • ERCP: NPO 6-8 h, consent, avoid anticoagulants/NSAIDs, ask about contrast allergy; afterward check gag reflex, perforation/peritonitis, liver and pancreatic enzymes. MRCP is the noninvasive alternative.ERCP：禁食 6-8 小時、同意書、避免抗凝血劑/NSAIDs、詢問顯影劑過敏；檢查後確認嘔吐反射、監測穿孔/腹膜炎、肝與胰臟酵素。MRCP 為非侵入性替代。
  • Capsule endoscopy: bowel prep, clear liquids evening before, brief NPO; gastric analysis requires fasting 8-12 h and no tobacco/gum 24 h.膠囊內視鏡：腸道準備、前一晚清流質、短暫禁食；胃液分析需禁食 8-12 小時，24 小時內不可抽菸/嚼口香糖。
  • CT: NPO at least 4 h, ask about contrast allergy, push fluids afterward to protect kidneys.電腦斷層：至少禁食 4 小時、詢問顯影劑過敏、檢查後多喝水保護腎臟。

Paracentesis, liver biopsy, stool and laboratory tests腹腔穿刺、肝臟切片、糞便與實驗室檢查

  • Paracentesis prep: consent, vitals, weight, void, girth, upright position. After: monitor BP/pulse and mental status for shock from rapid vasodilation, bleeding, hematuria, weight and girth loss.腹腔穿刺前：同意書、生命徵象、體重、排尿、腹圍、直坐姿。檢查後：監測血壓/脈搏與意識（快速血管擴張致休克）、出血、血尿、體重與腹圍減少。
  • Liver biopsy: NPO 8-12 h, check PT/PTT/platelets, hold breath after expiration during needle; afterward lie on RIGHT side with pillow under costal margin for 2 h, bed rest 12-14 h; dyspnea/cyanosis signals pneumothorax.肝臟切片：禁食 8-12 小時、檢查 PT/PTT/血小板、穿刺時吐氣後閉氣；術後右側臥並於肋緣下墊枕 2 小時、臥床 12-14 小時；呼吸困難/發紺提示氣胸。
  • Urea breath test detects H. pylori (hold antibiotics/bismuth 1 month, PPIs/sucralfate 1 week, H2RAs 24 h).尿素呼氣試驗偵測幽門螺旋桿菌（抗生素/鉍劑停 1 個月、PPI/sucralfate 停 1 週、H2 阻斷劑停 24 小時）。
  • Liver tests: ALP 38-126 U/L, AST 0-35, ALT 4-36, PT 11-12.5 s, PTT 30-40 s, INR 0.8-1.2, ammonia 10-80 mcg/dL, total bilirubin 0.3-1.0 mg/dL, amylase 60-120 Somogyi units/dL, lipase 0-160 U/L.肝功能：ALP 38-126 U/L、AST 0-35、ALT 4-36、PT 11-12.5 秒、PTT 30-40 秒、INR 0.8-1.2、氨 10-80 mcg/dL、總膽紅素 0.3-1.0 mg/dL、澱粉酶 60-120 Somogyi 單位/dL、脂肪酶 0-160 U/L。
  • Prolonged PT with low platelets before biopsy: notify PHCP and start bleeding precautions.切片前 PT 延長且血小板低：通知醫師並採取出血防護。
  • Signs of perforation/peritonitis: guarding, rigid distended abdomen, rebound tenderness, absent bowel sounds, fever, tachycardia, hypotension.穿孔/腹膜炎徵象：腹部防衛、僵硬脹大、反彈痛、腸音消失、發燒、心搏過速、低血壓。

GERD, gastritis, hiatal hernia胃食道逆流、胃炎、食道裂孔疝氣

  • GERD: incompetent LES; heartburn, regurgitation, chronic night cough, hoarseness, dysphagia. Avoid peppermint, chocolate, caffeine, fatty food, alcohol, citrus, tomato, smoking.胃食道逆流：下食道括約肌鬆弛；燒心、逆流、夜間慢性咳嗽、聲音沙啞、吞嚥困難。避免薄荷、巧克力、咖啡因、油膩、酒精、柑橘、番茄與抽菸。
  • GERD teaching: small meals, no food 2 h before bed, stay upright 2-3 h after eating, raise head of bed 6-8 inches; avoid anticholinergics, NSAIDs, calcium channel blockers. Fundoplication if refractory.衛教：少量多餐、睡前 2 小時不進食、餐後直立 2-3 小時、床頭抬高 6-8 吋；避免抗膽鹼藥、NSAIDs、鈣離子阻斷劑。難治時做胃底折疊術。
  • Acute gastritis: NSAIDs, alcohol, H. pylori; watch for hemorrhagic gastritis (hematemesis, tachycardia, hypotension). Chronic gastritis can cause B12 deficiency.急性胃炎：NSAIDs、酒精、H. pylori；注意出血性胃炎（吐血、心搏過速、低血壓）。慢性胃炎可致 B12 缺乏。
  • Hiatal hernia: stomach herniates through diaphragm; symptoms worse lying down; small frequent meals, do not recline for 1 hour after eating; complications include strangulation.食道裂孔疝氣：胃經橫膈膜突入胸腔；平躺時症狀加重；少量多餐、餐後 1 小時內勿平躺；併發症含絞扼。
PDF p.719, 722, 723

Peptic ulcer disease, gastric surgery and dumping syndrome消化性潰瘍、胃部手術與傾倒症候群

  • Gastric ulcer: pain 1-2 h after meals, worsened by food, hematemesis more common. Duodenal ulcer: pain 2-5 h after meals/night, relieved by food, melena more common.胃潰瘍：餐後 1-2 小時痛、進食加重、較常吐血。十二指腸潰瘍：餐後 2-5 小時或夜間痛、進食緩解、較常黑便。
  • Risks: H. pylori, NSAIDs, smoking, alcohol, steroids, stress. Avoid caffeinated and decaffeinated coffee, alcohol, aspirin/NSAIDs. Complications: hemorrhage, perforation, obstruction.危險因子：H. pylori、NSAIDs、抽菸、酒精、類固醇、壓力。避免含咖啡因與去咖啡因咖啡、酒精、阿斯匹靈/NSAIDs。併發症：出血、穿孔、阻塞。
  • Active bleeding: stabilize airway/circulation, two large-bore IVs, NPO, monitor Hgb/Hct and coagulation, type and cross, transfusion, vasoconstrictive drugs.活動性出血：穩定呼吸道與循環、兩條大管徑靜脈管路、禁食、監測 Hgb/Hct 與凝血、血型交叉、輸血、血管收縮藥。
  • Surgeries: vagotomy, antrectomy, Billroth I (gastroduodenostomy), Billroth II (gastrojejunostomy), pyloroplasty. Post-op: Fowler's, NG suction, NPO 1-3 days; do not irrigate or reposition the NG tube without order.手術：迷走神經切斷、胃竇切除、Billroth I（胃十二指腸吻合）、Billroth II（胃空腸吻合）、幽門成形。術後：半坐臥、鼻胃管抽吸、禁食 1-3 天；無醫囑不可沖洗或移動鼻胃管。
  • Post-op complications: hemorrhage, dumping syndrome, hypoglycemia, bile reflux gastritis, B12 deficiency.術後併發症：出血、傾倒症候群、低血糖、膽汁逆流性胃炎、B12 缺乏。
  • Dumping syndrome (about 30 min after eating): nausea, fullness, cramping, diarrhea, palpitations, sweating, dizziness. Prevent: 5-6 small meals, high-protein/complex carbs, limit sugar, no fluids with meals, lie down 20-30 min after.傾倒症候群（進食後約 30 分鐘）：噁心、飽脹、絞痛、腹瀉、心悸、冒汗、頭暈。預防：一天 5-6 小餐、高蛋白與複合碳水、限制糖、餐中不喝水、餐後平躺 20-30 分鐘。

Bariatric surgery and biliary disease減重手術與膽道疾病

  • Bariatric surgery: psychological screening, lifelong lifestyle change; anastomotic leak (abdominal pain, restlessness, unexplained tachycardia, oliguria) is the most serious complication.減重手術：心理評估、需終身改變生活型態；吻合口漏（腹痛、躁動、不明原因心搏過速、少尿）為最嚴重併發症。
  • Post-bariatric diet: 1-ounce clear liquids, then puree, liquids/puree for about 6 weeks; eat slowly; supplements calcium, iron, multivitamin, B12; avoid high sugar/fat.術後飲食：先 30 mL 清流質，再進展至泥狀食物，流質/泥狀約 6 週；細嚼慢嚥；補充鈣、鐵、綜合維他命、B12；避免高糖高脂。
  • Cholecystitis: RUQ pain radiating to right shoulder after fatty meal, Murphy's sign, fever, nausea; biliary obstruction causes jaundice, dark foamy urine, clay stools, pruritus.膽囊炎：高脂餐後右上腹痛並放射至右肩、Murphy 氏徵象、發燒、噁心；膽道阻塞出現黃疸、深色泡沫尿、陶土色便、搔癢。
  • Treatment: NPO, NG decompression, antiemetics, analgesics, antispasmodics; cholecystectomy usually laparoscopic. Post-op: cough/deep breathe, splint, early ambulation.治療：禁食、鼻胃管減壓、止吐、止痛、解痙；膽囊切除常為腹腔鏡。術後：咳嗽深呼吸、按壓傷口、早期下床。
  • T-tube: drainage bag below gallbladder level, semi-Fowler's, report sudden increase in bile or foul purulent drainage; no irrigation/clamping without order.T 型管：引流袋低於膽囊高度、半坐臥、膽汁突然增加或惡臭膿性引流須通報；無醫囑不可沖洗/夾閉。

Cirrhosis and esophageal varices肝硬化與食道靜脈曲張

  • Cirrhosis: chronic hepatocyte destruction and scarring (hepatitis C, alcohol, NAFLD/NASH). Complications: portal hypertension, ascites, varices, coagulopathy, jaundice, encephalopathy, hepatorenal syndrome.肝硬化：肝細胞慢性破壞與纖維化（C 肝、酒精、非酒精性脂肪肝）。併發症：門脈高壓、腹水、靜脈曲張、凝血障礙、黃疸、肝腦病變、肝腎症候群。
  • Encephalopathy: ammonia not detoxified; asterixis, altered LOC, fetor hepaticus. Give lactulose (lowers bowel pH, ammonia excretion) and antibiotics; avoid opioids, sedatives, barbiturates, hepatotoxins; alcohol abstinence.肝腦病變：氨無法代謝；撲翼樣顫抖、意識改變、肝臭。給予 lactulose（降低腸道 pH、排出氨）與抗生素；避免鴉片類、鎮靜劑、巴比妥與肝毒性物質；戒酒。
  • Care: HOB elevated, Na and fluid restriction, diuretics, daily weight and abdominal girth, vitamin K/B complex, monitor coagulation and electrolytes, paracentesis if needed.照護：抬高床頭、限鈉限水、利尿劑、每日體重與腹圍、維生素 K/B 群、監測凝血與電解質、必要時腹腔穿刺。
  • Varices: dilated esophageal veins from portal hypertension; rupture = life-threatening hematemesis/melena/shock. NPO, oxygen, IV fluids, blood, monitor Hgb/Hct, vasoconstrictors, endoscopic sclerotherapy or band ligation.靜脈曲張：門脈高壓使食道靜脈擴張；破裂會危及生命（吐血、黑便、休克）。禁食、氧氣、靜脈輸液、輸血、監測 Hgb/Hct、血管收縮藥、內視鏡硬化或套扎。
  • Balloon tamponade is uncomfortable and rarely used; shunts include portacaval, distal splenorenal, mesocaval, and TIPS.氣囊填塞不舒適且少用；分流手術包含門腔、遠端脾腎、腸繫膜腔靜脈分流與 TIPS。

Viral hepatitis A to E病毒性肝炎 A 至 E

  • Stages: preicteric (flu-like, anorexia, most transmissible), icteric (jaundice, dark urine, clay stools, pruritus), posticteric (recovery, 6-8 weeks).分期：黃疸前期（類流感、厭食、傳染力最強）、黃疸期（黃疸、深色尿、陶土便、搔癢）、黃疸後期（恢復，約 6-8 週）。
  • Hepatitis A: fecal-oral, incubation 15-50 days, anti-HAV IgM = acute; vaccine 2 doses 6 months apart; immune globulin within 2 weeks of exposure.A 肝：糞口傳染，潛伏期 15-50 天，anti-HAV IgM 代表急性感染；疫苗兩劑間隔 6 個月；暴露後 2 週內給免疫球蛋白。
  • Hepatitis B: blood/body fluids, incubation 60-180 days; HBsAg diagnostic, persisting beyond 6 months = chronic/carrier; anti-HBs = recovery/immunity; vaccine and HBIG.B 肝：血液/體液傳染，潛伏期 60-180 天；HBsAg 為診斷指標，6 個月後仍存在=慢性/帶原；anti-HBs=康復/免疫；疫苗與 HBIG。
  • Hepatitis C: blood, IV drug use, transfusions, born 1945-1965; anti-HCV; leads to chronic liver disease and carcinoma. Hepatitis D needs HBV to replicate. Hepatitis E: waterborne, high mortality in third-trimester pregnancy.C 肝：血液、靜脈藥癮、輸血、1945-1965 年出生者；anti-HCV；可致慢性肝病與肝癌。D 肝需有 B 肝才可複製。E 肝：水源傳染，孕晚期死亡率高。
  • Home care: strict handwashing, personal items not shared, no food preparation for others, avoid alcohol and hepatotoxic OTC drugs (acetaminophen, sedatives), small high-carbohydrate low-fat meals, no blood donation.居家：嚴格洗手、個人用品不共用、不為他人備餐、避免酒精與肝毒性成藥（acetaminophen、鎮靜劑）、少量多餐高碳水低脂、不可捐血。

Pancreatitis胰臟炎

  • Causes: alcohol, gallstones, trauma, hyperlipidemia, hypercalcemia. Acute: sudden epigastric/LUQ pain radiating to back, worse after fatty meal/lying flat, N/V, low-grade fever.病因：酒精、膽結石、外傷、高血脂、高血鈣。急性：突發上腹/左上腹痛放射至背部，油膩餐後或平躺加重、噁心嘔吐、低燒。
  • Labs: elevated serum lipase and amylase, WBC, glucose, bilirubin. Cullen's sign (periumbilical) and Turner's sign (flank bruising).檢驗：血清脂肪酶與澱粉酶、WBC、血糖、膽紅素升高。Cullen 徵象（臍周瘀斑）與 Turner 徵象（側腹瘀斑）。
  • Acute care: NPO, IV fluids, NG for vomiting/ileus, opioids for pain, H2RA/PPI, parenteral or nasojejunal feeding, watch for shock, avoid alcohol.急性期：禁食、靜脈輸液、嘔吐/腸阻塞時鼻胃管、止痛用鴉片類、H2 阻斷劑/PPI、腸外或鼻空腸餵食、注意休克、戒酒。
  • Chronic: steatorrhea, weight loss, diabetes; pancreatic enzymes with meals, small high-calorie low-fat meals, no alcohol/caffeine, insulin if needed.慢性：脂肪瀉、體重減輕、糖尿病；餐時給胰酵素、少量高熱量低脂餐、不喝酒/咖啡因、必要時用胰島素。

IBS, ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease腸躁症、潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症

  • IBS: functional; increase fiber, 8-10 cups fluid, probiotics; lubiprostone/linaclotide for constipation-predominant, alosetron for diarrhea-predominant.腸躁症：功能性；增加纖維、每日 8-10 杯水、益生菌；便秘型用 lubiprostone/linaclotide，腹瀉型用 alosetron。
  • Ulcerative colitis: starts in rectum and moves proximally; severe bloody mucus diarrhea, anemia, dehydration; acute phase NPO/IV or TPN, then low-fiber high-protein diet; avoid dairy, raw produce, nuts, caffeine, alcohol; salicylates, steroids, immunosuppressants.潰瘍性結腸炎：由直腸向上蔓延；嚴重血便黏液便、貧血、脫水；急性期禁食/靜脈或全靜脈營養，之後低纖高蛋白飲食；避免乳製品、生鮮蔬果、堅果、咖啡因、酒精；水楊酸製劑、類固醇、免疫抑制劑。
  • Surgery: restorative proctocolectomy with ileal pouch-anal anastomosis (two-stage, temporary ileostomy) or total proctocolectomy with permanent ileostomy.手術：迴腸袋肛門吻合重建性大腸直腸切除（兩階段、暫時性迴腸造口）或全大腸直腸切除合併永久性迴腸造口。
  • Stoma: pink to bright red and shiny is normal; pale pink = low Hgb/Hct; purple-black = compromised circulation, notify PHCP immediately. Empty pouch when one-third full.造口：粉紅至鮮紅濕潤為正常；蒼白代表 Hgb/Hct 低；紫黑代表血流受損，須立即通知醫師。袋子三分之一滿即排空。
  • Crohn's: any GI segment, usually terminal ileum, fistulas, strictures, cramping after meals, worse malnutrition; surgery avoided because recurrence is common.克隆氏症：可發生於任何消化道、多在末端迴腸，有瘻管、狹窄、餐後絞痛、營養不良更嚴重；因復發率高盡量避免手術。

Appendicitis, diverticular disease, hemorrhoids闌尾炎、憩室疾病、痔瘡

  • Appendicitis: periumbilical pain moving to RLQ, maximal at McBurney's point, rebound tenderness, low-grade fever, high WBC. No heat, laxatives or enemas; pain that suddenly stops may mean rupture.闌尾炎：臍周痛轉移至右下腹、McBurney 點最痛、反彈痛、低燒、WBC 升高。不可熱敷、不給瀉劑或灌腸。
  • Pre-op: NPO, IV fluids, antibiotics, right side-lying or semi-Fowler's, ice pack if prescribed. Post-op: if ruptured, drain/open wound, semi-Fowler's with legs flexed, antibiotics, early ambulation.術前：禁食、靜脈輸液、抗生素、右側臥或半坐臥、必要時冰敷。術後：若破裂有引流/開放傷口、半坐臥雙腿屈曲、抗生素、早期下床。
  • Diverticulitis: LLQ pain, fever, N/V, blood in stool; bed rest, NPO or clear liquids, low-fiber during flare then high-fiber; fluids 2500-3000 mL; avoid straining, seeds/nuts/popcorn; watch for perforation, abscess, fistula.憩室炎：左下腹痛、發燒、噁心嘔吐、血便；臥床休息、禁食或清流質、發炎期低纖維，緩解後高纖維；水分 2500-3000 mL；避免用力、種子/堅果/爆米花；注意穿孔、膿瘍、瘻管。
  • Hemorrhoids: bright red bleeding with defecation; high fiber, fluids, stool softeners, sitz baths, witch hazel.痔瘡：排便時鮮紅色出血；高纖維、多喝水、軟便劑、坐浴、金縷梅。
  • Post-hemorrhoidectomy: prone/side-lying, ice packs, watch urinary retention, first bowel movement painful (vasovagal risk, stay nearby), short sitting periods, sitz baths 3-4 times daily.痔瘡切除術後：俯臥/側臥、冰敷、注意尿滯留、第一次排便會痛（可能迷走神經反應，需有人在旁）、縮短久坐、每日坐浴 3-4 次。
PDF p.732, 733, 734

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Paracentesis: rapid fluid removal can drop abdominal pressure and cause vasodilation and shock; monitor BP and pulse closely.腹腔穿刺：快速引流使腹壓下降、血管擴張而致休克；密切監測血壓與脈搏。 PDF p.717
  2. After any endoscopy do not give food or fluids until the gag reflex returns (aspiration risk).任何內視鏡檢查後，嘔吐反射恢復前不可給予飲食（吸入風險）。 PDF p.717, 715
  3. Liver biopsy: lie on RIGHT side with pillow under costal margin; dyspnea, cyanosis, restlessness = pneumothorax; check PT/PTT/platelets first.肝臟切片：右側臥並墊枕；呼吸困難、發紺、躁動=氣胸；事先檢查 PT/PTT/血小板。 PDF p.718
  4. Do not irrigate or remove the NG tube after gastric surgery without an order (anastomosis disruption).胃部手術後無醫囑不可沖洗或拔除鼻胃管（可能破壞吻合口）。 PDF p.721
  5. Upper GI bleed: ABCs, oxygen, two large-bore IVs, NPO, monitor Hgb/Hct, coagulation; ruptured varices are life-threatening.上消化道出血：ABC、氧氣、兩條大管徑靜脈管路、禁食、監測 Hgb/Hct 與凝血；食道靜脈曲張破裂可致命。 PDF p.720, 726
  6. Gastric ulcer pain occurs soon after eating; duodenal ulcer pain occurs hours later and is relieved by food.胃潰瘍餐後不久疼痛；十二指腸潰瘍數小時後疼痛、進食緩解。 PDF p.720
  7. Dumping syndrome ~30 minutes after eating: small meals, limit sugar, no fluids with meals, lie down after.傾倒症候群約於餐後 30 分鐘：少量餐、限糖、餐中不喝水、餐後躺下。 PDF p.721, 722
  8. Anastomotic leak (pain, restlessness, unexplained tachycardia, oliguria) is the deadliest complication of gastric bypass.吻合口漏（疼痛、躁動、不明原因心搏過速、少尿）是胃繞道術最致命的併發症。 PDF p.722
  9. Cirrhosis with encephalopathy: lactulose, avoid sedatives/opioids, watch asterixis and ammonia (normal 10-80 mcg/dL).肝硬化合併肝腦病變：使用 lactulose、避免鎮靜劑/鴉片類、觀察撲翼樣顫抖與氨值（正常 10-80 mcg/dL）。 PDF p.725, 726
  10. Cirrhosis: daily weight and abdominal girth, sodium restriction; low vitamin K/clotting factors cause bleeding.肝硬化：每日體重與腹圍、限鈉；維生素 K 與凝血因子不足會出血。 PDF p.724, 725, 726
  11. HBsAg present > 6 months = chronic/carrier; anti-HBs = immunity; hepatitis D occurs only with hepatitis B.HBsAg 超過 6 個月=慢性/帶原；anti-HBs=免疫；D 肝只在 B 肝存在時發生。 PDF p.728, 729
  12. Handwashing is the key to preventing all hepatitis; hepatitis A prevented by vaccine/immune globulin; client avoids acetaminophen and alcohol.洗手是預防各型肝炎的關鍵；A 肝可用疫苗/免疫球蛋白預防；病人避免 acetaminophen 與酒精。 PDF p.728, 729
  13. Pancreatitis: elevated lipase/amylase, NPO, IV fluids, opioids for pain, Cullen's and Turner's signs; avoid alcohol.胰臟炎：脂肪酶/澱粉酶升高、禁食、靜脈輸液、鴉片類止痛、Cullen 與 Turner 徵象；戒酒。 PDF p.730
  14. Purple-black stoma = ischemia: notify PHCP immediately.造口呈紫黑色=缺血：立即通知醫師。 PDF p.732
  15. Appendicitis: never apply heat or give laxatives/enemas; heat may cause rupture and peritonitis.闌尾炎：不可熱敷、不給瀉劑或灌腸；熱敷可能造成破裂與腹膜炎。 PDF p.733
  16. Diverticulitis: low-fiber during flare, high-fiber afterward; avoid straining and seeds/nuts; watch for perforation.憩室炎：發作期低纖維、緩解後高纖維；避免用力與種子/堅果；注意穿孔。 PDF p.733, 734
  17. Signs of peritonitis (rigid abdomen, rebound tenderness, absent bowel sounds, fever, tachycardia) need immediate PHCP notification.腹膜炎徵象（腹部僵硬、反彈痛、腸音消失、發燒、心搏過速）須立即通知醫師。 PDF p.716

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Gastric ulcer: 'Gastric = Greater pain with food, Hematemesis'; Duodenal: 'Duodenal = Dull relief with food, Dark stools (melena)'.胃潰瘍：進食後痛加重、吐血；十二指腸潰瘍：進食緩解、黑便。 PDF p.720
  • Cullen = Umbilicus (periumbilical); Turner = flank.Cullen=臍周；Turner=側腹。 PDF p.730
  • Cirrhosis ammonia 'ASH': Asterixis, Sedatives avoided, Hepatic encephalopathy -> lactulose.肝硬化氨升高：有撲翼樣顫抖、避免鎮靜劑、肝腦病變 -> 使用 lactulose。 PDF p.725, 726
  • Hepatitis: A = Alimentary (fecal-oral), B/C/D = Blood, E = Enteric/water.肝炎：A=糞口，B/C/D=血液，E=腸道/水源。 PDF p.727, 729

50 Gastrointestinal Medications胃腸道藥物

This chapter covers drugs for acid-related disease (antacids, protectants, H2 blockers, PPIs, H. pylori regimens), motility (metoclopramide), liver, pancreas and bowel disease (lactulose, pancrelipase, IBD and IBS drugs), and symptom relief (antiemetics, laxatives, antidiarrheals). Know each class's action, signature adverse effect, timing relative to meals and interactions.本章涵蓋治療胃酸相關疾病的藥物（制酸劑、保護劑、H2 阻斷劑、質子幫浦抑制劑、H. pylori 療程）、腸胃蠕動藥（metoclopramide）、肝胰與腸道疾病用藥（lactulose、胰酵素、IBD 與 IBS 用藥），以及症狀緩解藥（止吐、瀉劑、止瀉）。需熟記各類別的作用、代表性不良反應、與餐的時間關係及交互作用。

Antacids制酸劑

  • Neutralize gastric acid, inactivate pepsin; do not coat the ulcer. Goal: gastric pH above 5. Used for PUD and GERD.中和胃酸、使胃蛋白酶失活；不會覆蓋潰瘍面。目標胃內 pH 高於 5。用於消化性潰瘍與胃食道逆流。
  • Chew tablets thoroughly then drink water or milk; shake liquids; take regularly (e.g., 1 and 3 hours after meals and at bedtime); separate from other drugs by 1 hour.錠劑嚼碎後搭配水或牛奶；液體先搖勻；規律服用（如餐後 1、3 小時與睡前）；與其他藥物間隔 1 小時。
  • Aluminum: constipation, can cause hypophosphatemia, contains sodium (caution in HTN/HF), reduces tetracycline, warfarin, digoxin.鋁製劑：便秘、可致低血磷、含鈉（高血壓/心衰竭慎用）、降低 tetracycline、warfarin、digoxin 吸收。
  • Magnesium: diarrhea; avoid in intestinal obstruction, appendicitis, undiagnosed abdominal pain; accumulates in renal impairment. Often combined with aluminum.鎂製劑：腹瀉；腸阻塞、闌尾炎、不明腹痛禁用；腎功能不全會蓄積。常與鋁製劑併用。
  • Calcium carbonate: acid rebound, belching, constipation, milk-alkali syndrome. Sodium bicarbonate: gas, systemic alkalosis in renal impairment, caution in HTN/HF.碳酸鈣：酸反彈、打嗝、便秘、乳鹼症候群。碳酸氫鈉：脹氣、腎功能不全時全身性鹼中毒、高血壓/心衰竭慎用。
PDF p.744, 745

Gastric protectants (misoprostol, sucralfate)胃黏膜保護劑（misoprostol、sucralfate）

  • Misoprostol: prostaglandin that reduces acid and maintains mucosal blood flow; prevents NSAID/aspirin ulcers; take with meals; diarrhea and abdominal pain; contraindicated in pregnancy.Misoprostol：前列腺素類，降低胃酸並維持黏膜血流；預防 NSAID/阿斯匹靈潰瘍；隨餐服用；腹瀉與腹痛；懷孕禁用。
  • Sucralfate: forms a protective barrier on the ulcer; give on an empty stomach (1 hour before meals); constipation; separate at least 2 hours from warfarin, phenytoin, theophylline, digoxin and some antibiotics.Sucralfate：在潰瘍面形成保護屏障；空腹（餐前 1 小時）服用；便秘；與 warfarin、phenytoin、theophylline、digoxin 及部分抗生素至少間隔 2 小時。
PDF p.744

H2-receptor antagonistsH2 受體拮抗劑

  • Cimetidine, famotidine, nizatidine suppress acid secretion; heal GERD, prevent stress ulcers and ulcer recurrence; use caution in renal/hepatic impairment and reduce dose in renal impairment.Cimetidine、famotidine、nizatidine 抑制胃酸分泌；治療胃食道逆流、預防壓力性潰瘍與潰瘍復發；腎/肝功能不全慎用，腎功能不全需減量。
  • Cimetidine: crosses blood-brain barrier (confusion, agitation, psychosis, especially elderly); inhibits liver enzymes, raising warfarin, phenytoin, theophylline, lidocaine levels (reduce doses).Cimetidine：可通過血腦障壁（意識混亂、躁動、精神症狀，尤其老年人）；抑制肝酵素使 warfarin、phenytoin、theophylline、lidocaine 濃度上升（需減量）。
  • IV cimetidine can cause hypotension and dysrhythmias. Antacids lower oral absorption: separate by at least 1 hour. Famotidine and nizatidine need not be taken with food.靜脈注射 cimetidine 可引起低血壓與心律不整。制酸劑降低口服吸收，間隔至少 1 小時。Famotidine 與 nizatidine 不需與食物併服。
PDF p.744, 745

Proton pump inhibitors and H. pylori therapy質子幫浦抑制劑與 H. pylori 治療

  • PPIs (omeprazole, esomeprazole, lansoprazole, pantoprazole, rabeprazole, dexlansoprazole) strongly suppress acid; used for active ulcers, erosive esophagitis, hypersecretory states.PPI（omeprazole、esomeprazole、lansoprazole、pantoprazole、rabeprazole、dexlansoprazole）強力抑制胃酸；用於活動性潰瘍、糜爛性食道炎、胃酸過度分泌。
  • Common effects: headache, diarrhea, abdominal pain, nausea.常見副作用：頭痛、腹瀉、腹痛、噁心。
  • H. pylori: one antibiotic alone fails because of resistance; use triple therapy (PPI + amoxicillin + clarithromycin, or PPI + metronidazole + clarithromycin) or quadruple therapy (PPI + metronidazole + tetracycline + bismuth subsalicylate) if triple fails.H. pylori：單一抗生素易產生抗藥性而無效；使用三合一療法（PPI + amoxicillin + clarithromycin，或 PPI + metronidazole + clarithromycin），失敗時用四合一療法（PPI + metronidazole + tetracycline + 次水楊酸鉍）。
PDF p.745, 746

Prokinetic agent (metoclopramide)促進腸胃蠕動藥（metoclopramide）

  • Increases upper GI motility and gastric emptying; used for GERD, paralytic ileus and as an antiemetic. Give 30 minutes before meals and at bedtime.增加上消化道蠕動與胃排空；用於胃食道逆流、麻痺性腸阻塞及止吐。餐前 30 分鐘與睡前服用。
  • Adverse effects: restlessness, drowsiness, dizziness, extrapyramidal/parkinsonian reactions (stop drug), insomnia, headache.不良反應：不安、嗜睡、頭暈、錐體外徑/類巴金森反應（需停藥）、失眠、頭痛。
  • Contraindicated in mechanical obstruction, perforation, GI hemorrhage, and pheochromocytoma (hypertensive crisis). Anticholinergics and opioids antagonize it; alcohol and sedatives add CNS depression.機械性阻塞、穿孔、消化道出血與嗜鉻細胞瘤（高血壓危象）禁用。抗膽鹼藥與鴉片類拮抗其作用；酒精與鎮靜劑增加中樞抑制。
PDF p.745, 746

Bile acid sequestrants, lactulose and pancreatic enzymes膽酸結合劑、lactulose 與胰酵素

  • Cholestyramine, colestipol, colesevelam bind bile salts in the gut for hypercholesterolemia and itching from biliary obstruction; constipation, bloating, impaction; use caution in bowel obstruction; mix powders with juice, add fiber/stool softener.Cholestyramine、colestipol、colesevelam 在腸道結合膽鹽，用於高膽固醇與膽道阻塞搔癢；便秘、脹氣、糞便嵌塞；腸阻塞慎用；粉劑混果汁，並增加纖維/軟便劑。
  • Lactulose lowers ammonia in hepatic encephalopathy by promoting peristalsis and ammonia excretion; given orally or rectally; expect diarrhea (2-3 soft stools); monitor I&O and dehydration.Lactulose 促進腸蠕動與氨排出以降低肝腦病變的氨；可口服或灌腸；預期腹瀉（約 2-3 次軟便）；監測輸出入與脫水。
  • Pancrelipase replaces pancreatic enzymes (reduces fatty stools); take with all meals and snacks; calcium carbonate/magnesium hydroxide products interfere; cramps, nausea, diarrhea.Pancrelipase 補充胰酵素（減少脂肪便）；隨所有餐點與點心服用；含碳酸鈣/氫氧化鎂產品會干擾；絞痛、噁心、腹瀉。
PDF p.746, 747

Inflammatory bowel disease and IBS drugs發炎性腸道疾病與腸躁症藥物

  • IBD (Crohn's, ulcerative colitis): 5-ASAs (sulfasalazine, mesalamine, balsalazide, olsalazine) - nausea, rash, arthralgia, blood disorders; corticosteroids (budesonide, prednisone); immunosuppressants (azathioprine, mercaptopurine, cyclosporine, tacrolimus); biologics (infliximab, adalimumab, certolizumab, natalizumab); antimicrobials (metronidazole, ciprofloxacin, rifaximin).IBD（克隆氏症、潰瘍性結腸炎）：5-ASA（sulfasalazine、mesalamine、balsalazide、olsalazine）-噁心、皮疹、關節痛、血液異常；類固醇（budesonide、prednisone）；免疫抑制劑（azathioprine、mercaptopurine、cyclosporine、tacrolimus）；生物製劑（infliximab、adalimumab、certolizumab、natalizumab）；抗微生物藥（metronidazole、ciprofloxacin、rifaximin）。
  • IBS-C: bulk-forming laxatives with full glass of water, lubiprostone (with food and water), linaclotide (30 minutes before breakfast).便秘型腸躁症：纖維性瀉劑搭配一大杯水、lubiprostone（與食物及水併服）、linaclotide（早餐前 30 分鐘）。
  • IBS-D: alosetron (serotonin antagonist) can cause constipation, impaction, obstruction, perforation, ischemic colitis; stop immediately if serious effects; strict risk program. Also antidiarrheals.腹瀉型腸躁症：alosetron（血清素拮抗劑）可致便秘、嵌塞、阻塞、穿孔、缺血性結腸炎；出現嚴重反應需立即停藥；需嚴格風險管控。亦可用止瀉藥。
PDF p.747, 748

Antiemetics止吐藥

  • Choice depends on cause. Classes: serotonin antagonists (ondansetron, granisetron, palonosetron), NK-1 antagonists (aprepitant, fosaprepitant, rolapitant), phenothiazines (prochlorperazine, promethazine, chlorpromazine), antihistamines (meclizine, dimenhydrinate, diphenhydramine, hydroxyzine), scopolamine patch, dexamethasone, lorazepam, dronabinol, metoclopramide, haloperidol.依原因選藥。類別：血清素拮抗劑（ondansetron、granisetron、palonosetron）、NK-1 拮抗劑（aprepitant、fosaprepitant、rolapitant）、吩噻嗪類（prochlorperazine、promethazine、chlorpromazine）、抗組織胺（meclizine、dimenhydrinate、diphenhydramine、hydroxyzine）、scopolamine 貼片、dexamethasone、lorazepam、dronabinol、metoclopramide、haloperidol。
  • Cause drowsiness: priority is protecting from injury. Monitor vital signs, I&O, dehydration and electrolytes; limit odors; clear liquids only while nauseated.會造成嗜睡：優先保護病人避免受傷。監測生命徵象、輸出入、脫水與電解質；減少氣味；噁心期間僅給清流質。
PDF p.748

Laxatives and antidiarrheals瀉劑與止瀉藥

  • Bulk-forming (psyllium, methylcellulose, polycarbophil): water into stool; need adequate fluids; contraindicated in obstruction. Stimulants (bisacodyl, senna). Emollient (docusate) softens stool and avoids straining. Osmotics (magnesium hydroxide/citrate, sodium phosphates, polyethylene glycol, lactulose).膨脹性（psyllium、methylcellulose、polycarbophil）：使糞便吸水；需足夠水分；阻塞時禁用。刺激性（bisacodyl、senna）。潤滑軟便劑（docusate）軟化糞便避免用力。滲透性（氫氧化鎂/檸檬酸鎂、磷酸鈉、聚乙二醇、lactulose）。
  • All laxatives: risk of dehydration and electrolyte imbalance; long-term use can cause dependency; increase fluids as directed.各類瀉劑：有脫水與電解質失衡風險；長期使用可能依賴；依醫囑增加水分。
  • Antidiarrheals: treat cause, replace fluids/electrolytes. Opioids (diphenoxylate with atropine, loperamide) slow motility but worsen diarrhea from poisons, infections or bacterial toxins. Also bismuth subsalicylate and anticholinergic antispasmodics (dicyclomine, glycopyrrolate).止瀉藥：治療原因並補充水分/電解質。鴉片類（diphenoxylate/atropine、loperamide）降低蠕動，但中毒、感染、細菌毒素引起的腹瀉會因此惡化。另有次水楊酸鉍與抗膽鹼解痙藥（dicyclomine、glycopyrrolate）。
PDF p.748

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Allow 1 hour between antacids and other medications to avoid interactions.制酸劑與其他藥物間隔 1 小時以避免交互作用。 PDF p.744
  2. Sucralfate on an empty stomach; separate 2 hours from warfarin, phenytoin, theophylline, digoxin; causes constipation.Sucralfate 空腹服用；與 warfarin、phenytoin、theophylline、digoxin 間隔 2 小時；會便秘。 PDF p.744
  3. Misoprostol is contraindicated in pregnancy.Misoprostol 懷孕禁用。 PDF p.744
  4. Cimetidine: CNS confusion, inhibits liver metabolism (reduce warfarin, phenytoin, theophylline, lidocaine doses).Cimetidine：中樞神經混亂、抑制肝代謝（需減少 warfarin、phenytoin、theophylline、lidocaine 劑量）。 PDF p.745
  5. Aluminum antacid: constipation and hypophosphatemia; magnesium antacid: diarrhea; magnesium accumulates in renal impairment.鋁制酸劑：便秘與低血磷；鎂制酸劑：腹瀉；腎功能不全時鎂會蓄積。 PDF p.745
  6. H. pylori needs combination therapy (PPI plus two antibiotics, or quadruple with bismuth).H. pylori 需合併療法（PPI 加兩種抗生素，或含鉍的四合一）。 PDF p.746
  7. Metoclopramide: parkinsonian/extrapyramidal reactions mean stop the drug; contraindicated in obstruction, perforation, GI bleeding.Metoclopramide：出現類巴金森/錐體外徑反應需停藥；阻塞、穿孔、消化道出血禁用。 PDF p.746
  8. Bile acid sequestrants worsen constipation or obstruction; use cautiously.膽酸結合劑會加重便秘或阻塞；需謹慎使用。 PDF p.747
  9. Lactulose: diarrhea means it is working; monitor ammonia (10-80 mcg/dL), I&O, dehydration.Lactulose：腹瀉代表有效；監測氨值（10-80 mcg/dL）、輸出入與脫水。 PDF p.747
  10. Pancrelipase must be taken with all meals and snacks.Pancrelipase 必須與所有餐點與點心一起服用。 PDF p.747
  11. Alosetron: serious constipation, obstruction, perforation, ischemic colitis; stop immediately.Alosetron：嚴重便秘、阻塞、穿孔、缺血性結腸炎；須立即停藥。 PDF p.748
  12. Opioid antidiarrheals are harmful when diarrhea is caused by infection, poisons or toxins.腹瀉由感染、毒物或毒素引起時，鴉片類止瀉藥有害。 PDF p.748
  13. Antiemetics cause drowsiness: protect the client from injury.止吐藥會致嗜睡：保護病人避免受傷。 PDF p.748
  14. Bulk-forming laxatives contraindicated in bowel obstruction; clients need adequate fluids.膨脹性瀉劑在腸阻塞時禁用；需有足夠水分。 PDF p.748

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Antacid metals: Aluminum and Calcium Constipate; Magnesium Moves (diarrhea).制酸劑金屬：鋁與鈣便秘；鎂拉肚子。 PDF p.745
  • -prazole = PPI; -tidine = H2 blocker; -setron = serotonin antiemetic.-prazole=PPI；-tidine=H2 阻斷劑；-setron=血清素止吐藥。 PDF p.745, 748
  • Sucralfate = 'Sticks' to ulcer, give empty stomach; Misoprostol = no pregnancy.Sucralfate 黏附潰瘍面、空腹服用；misoprostol 孕婦禁用。 PDF p.744

51 Respiratory Problems呼吸系統問題

This chapter covers respiratory anatomy, diagnostic tests (bronchoscopy, thoracentesis, V/Q scan, CT angiography, TB skin test), chest trauma, asthma, COPD, pneumonia and other infections, pleural disorders, pulmonary embolism, and tuberculosis. Gas exchange and perfusion are the priority concepts: position upright, give oxygen, and recognize life-threatening changes.本章涵蓋呼吸系統解剖、診斷檢查（支氣管鏡、胸腔穿刺、V/Q 掃描、CT 肺動脈攝影、結核菌素試驗）、胸部外傷、氣喘、COPD、肺炎與其他感染、胸膜疾病、肺栓塞與結核病。優先概念為氣體交換與灌流：採直立姿勢、給氧並辨識危及生命的變化。

Respiratory anatomy and physiology呼吸系統解剖與生理

  • Functions: supply oxygen, remove CO2, plus acid-base balance, speech, smell, water and heat balance.功能：供氧、排出二氧化碳，另維持酸鹼平衡、發聲、嗅覺、水分與熱平衡。
  • Right mainstem bronchus is wider, shorter, more vertical; right lung has 3 lobes, left lung 2. Trachea branches at the carina.右主支氣管較寬、短且垂直；右肺 3 葉、左肺 2 葉。氣管於隆凸分叉。
  • Alveoli are the gas exchange units; type 2 alveolar cells make surfactant, which lowers surface tension and prevents collapse. Terminal bronchioles lack cartilage and cilia.肺泡為氣體交換單位；第二型肺泡細胞分泌表面張力素，降低表面張力防止塌陷。終末細支氣管無軟骨與纖毛。
  • Diaphragm descends on inspiration creating negative pressure; expiration is passive recoil. Gas exchange needs matched ventilation and perfusion.吸氣時橫膈下降形成負壓；呼氣為被動回彈。氣體交換需要通氣與灌流相配。
  • Parietal pleura lines the chest wall; visceral pleura covers the lung; pleural fluid lubricates.壁層胸膜覆蓋胸壁；臟層胸膜覆蓋肺；胸膜液具潤滑作用。
PDF p.755, 756

Diagnostic tests: imaging, sputum, scopes診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡

  • Chest x-ray: remove metal objects, ask about pregnancy. Sputum: early morning, rinse mouth, deep cough, collect before antibiotics (about 15 mL); saliva is not sputum.胸部 X 光：移除金屬物，詢問懷孕。痰液：清晨、先漱口、深咳、於使用抗生素前採集（約 15 mL）；唾液不是痰。
  • Bronchoscopy: consent, NPO, check coagulation, local spray; afterward semi-Fowler's, NPO until gag reflex returns, watch for bloody sputum, bronchospasm, perforation (facial/neck crepitus), hypoxemia, pneumothorax.支氣管鏡：同意書、禁食、檢查凝血、局部噴劑；術後半坐臥、嘔吐反射恢復前禁食、監測血痰、支氣管痙攣、穿孔（臉頸皮下氣腫）、低血氧、氣胸。
  • Pulmonary angiography: assess iodine/seafood allergy; afterward no BP in injection arm for 24 h, check neurovascular status and site bleeding.肺動脈攝影：評估碘/海鮮過敏；術後該側肢體 24 小時不量血壓、檢查神經血管狀態與穿刺處出血。
  • Spiral CT and CT pulmonary angiography are preferred for PE (contrast, renal function); V/Q scan used with renal impairment or contrast allergy; encourage fluids.螺旋 CT 與 CT 肺動脈攝影為肺栓塞首選（顯影劑、腎功能）；腎功能不全或顯影劑過敏者做 V/Q 掃描；鼓勵多喝水。
  • D-dimer: high sensitivity, low specificity; normal < 50 ng/mL. Pulmonary function tests: hold bronchodilators if prescribed, no heavy meal or smoking 4-6 h.D-dimer：高敏感性、低特異性；正常 < 50 ng/mL。肺功能檢查：依醫囑停用支氣管擴張劑，檢查前 4-6 小時不吃大餐或抽菸。
  • Do not suction before drawing an ABG (it depletes oxygen and distorts results).抽動脈血氣前不可抽吸（會消耗氧氣、影響結果）。
PDF p.756, 757, 758, 759

Thoracentesis and lung biopsy胸腔穿刺與肺活檢

  • Thoracentesis removes fluid or air from the pleural space: check coagulation, sit upright leaning on a bedside table (or lie toward the unaffected side), do not cough or move.胸腔穿刺移除胸腔積液或空氣：檢查凝血、坐直倚靠床邊桌（或向健側臥），不可咳嗽或移動。
  • After: monitor respiratory status, pressure dressing, bleeding/crepitus; watch for pneumothorax, air embolism, pulmonary edema; review chest x-ray.術後：監測呼吸、壓迫敷料、出血/皮下氣腫；觀察氣胸、空氣栓塞、肺水腫；檢視胸部 X 光。
  • Lung biopsy: NPO, sedation, remain still; afterward dressing, watch for respiratory distress, pneumothorax, air emboli.肺活檢：禁食、鎮靜、保持不動；術後敷料、觀察呼吸窘迫、氣胸、空氣栓塞。
PDF p.757, 758

Chest injuries and pneumothorax胸部外傷與氣胸

  • Rib fracture: pain, shallow breathing, high pneumonia risk; Fowler's, analgesia, self-splint with pillow (no external binders), nerve block if severe.肋骨骨折：疼痛、淺呼吸、肺炎風險高；半坐臥、止痛、以枕頭自行按壓（不用外部束縛）、嚴重時神經阻斷。
  • Flail chest: paradoxical movement of a chest segment, severe pain, dyspnea, cyanosis, tachycardia, hypotension; oxygen, analgesia, Fowler's, intubation with PEEP if respiratory failure.連枷胸：胸壁一段反常運動、劇痛、呼吸困難、發紺、心搏過速、低血壓；給氧、止痛、半坐臥、呼吸衰竭時插管並用 PEEP。
  • Pulmonary contusion: interstitial/alveolar hemorrhage, hypoxemia, hemoptysis; ARDS is the major complication.肺挫傷：間質/肺泡出血、低血氧、咳血；主要併發症為急性呼吸窘迫症候群。
  • Pneumothorax: absent/diminished breath sounds on affected side, unilateral decreased chest expansion, sharp pain, crepitus; open pneumothorax has sucking sound; tension pneumothorax shows tracheal deviation to the unaffected side, distended neck veins, hypotension.氣胸：患側呼吸音消失/減弱、單側胸廓擴張減少、尖銳疼痛、皮下氣腫；開放性氣胸有吸吮聲；張力性氣胸氣管偏向健側、頸靜脈怒張、低血壓。
  • Interventions: nonporous dressing for open wound, oxygen, Fowler's, chest tube until lung re-expands, monitor drainage and subcutaneous emphysema.處置：開放傷口用不透氣敷料、給氧、半坐臥、置放胸管至肺完全擴張、監測引流與皮下氣腫。
PDF p.759, 760, 761

Asthma氣喘

  • Chronic airway inflammation with hyperresponsiveness and reversible obstruction; triggers include allergens, exercise, infection, irritants, cold air, aspirin, NSAIDs, beta blockers, sulfites, GERD, stress.慢性氣道發炎伴隨高反應性與可逆性阻塞；誘因包含過敏原、運動、感染、刺激物、冷空氣、阿斯匹靈、NSAIDs、β 阻斷劑、亞硫酸鹽、胃食道逆流、壓力。
  • Findings: wheeze, prolonged expiration, accessory muscle use, tachypnea, tachycardia, pulsus paradoxus, diaphoresis, decreased SpO2; silent chest means impending respiratory failure.表現：喘鳴、呼氣延長、使用輔助肌、呼吸急促、心搏過速、奇脈、盜汗、血氧下降；呼吸音消失（靜默胸）代表即將呼吸衰竭。
  • Acute episode: high-Fowler's/sitting, oxygen, stay with client, bronchodilators, corticosteroids, magnesium sulfate, IV fluids, auscultate before/during/after.急性發作：高坐臥/坐姿、給氧、陪伴病人、支氣管擴張劑、類固醇、硫酸鎂、靜脈輸液、治療前中後聽診。
  • Status asthmaticus is life-threatening and refractory to treatment. Teach peak flow use, spacer, trigger avoidance, action plan, MedicAlert.氣喘重積狀態危及生命且對治療反應不佳。衛教尖峰流速計、吸入輔助器、避開誘因、行動計畫、醫療警示手環。
PDF p.761, 762

COPD (chronic bronchitis and emphysema)慢性阻塞性肺病（慢性支氣管炎與肺氣腫）

  • Progressive, not fully reversible airflow limitation; complications include pulmonary hypertension and cor pulmonale. Findings: cough, sputum, exertional dyspnea, barrel chest, prolonged expiration, clubbing, orthopnea, weight loss.進行性、不完全可逆的氣流受限；併發症含肺高壓與肺心症。表現：咳嗽、痰、運動時呼吸困難、桶狀胸、呼氣延長、杵狀指、端坐呼吸、體重下降。
  • ABGs show chronic respiratory acidosis with hypoxemia; uncompensated respiratory acidosis suggests acute exacerbation.動脈血氣顯示慢性呼吸性酸中毒伴低血氧；未代償的呼吸性酸中毒提示急性惡化。
  • Give oxygen at the lowest concentration per ABG/SpO2; pursed-lip and diaphragmatic breathing, tripod position, chest physiotherapy, fluids up to 3000 mL/day, high-calorie high-protein small meals.依血氣與血氧給最低有效濃度氧氣；噘嘴與橫膈式呼吸、三腳架姿勢、胸部物理治療、每日水分可達 3000 mL、高熱量高蛋白少量多餐。
  • Meds: bronchodilators, corticosteroids for exacerbations, mucolytics, antibiotics for infection. Teach stopping smoking, avoiding infection/crowds, immunizations, wet dusting.藥物：支氣管擴張劑、惡化時用類固醇、黏液溶解劑、感染時抗生素。衛教戒菸、避免感染/人群、疫苗、濕布擦拭灰塵。
PDF p.762, 763

Pneumonia, influenza, COVID-19, SARS, Legionnaire's肺炎、流感、COVID-19、SARS、退伍軍人症

  • Pneumonia: fever, chills, pleuritic pain, productive cough, crackles/rhonchi, hypoxia, mental status change in older adults; sputum culture, high WBC; CXR consolidation.肺炎：發燒、畏寒、胸膜性疼痛、有痰咳嗽、囉音/鼾音、低血氧、老年人意識改變；痰培養、WBC 升高；胸片實變。
  • Care: oxygen, semi-Fowler's, cough/deep breathing/incentive spirometer, chest physiotherapy, fluids up to 3 L/day, high-calorie diet, antibiotics, hand hygiene; pneumococcal vaccine teaching.照護：給氧、半坐臥、咳嗽/深呼吸/誘發性肺量計、胸部物理治療、每日水分可達 3 L、高熱量飲食、抗生素、手部衛生；肺炎鏈球菌疫苗衛教。
  • Influenza: abrupt fever, chills, myalgia, headache, cough; annual vaccine (contraindicated with egg allergy per book), rest, fluids, antivirals, droplet hygiene.流感：突發發燒、畏寒、肌痛、頭痛、咳嗽；每年接種疫苗（書中指出蛋過敏者禁用）、休息、補水、抗病毒藥、飛沫衛生。
  • COVID-19: spread by droplets even without symptoms; symptoms 2-14 days after exposure incl. new loss of taste/smell; droplet (+/- contact) precautions; emergency signs: trouble breathing, persistent chest pain, confusion, cyanosis.COVID-19：即使無症狀也可經飛沫傳染；暴露後 2-14 天出現症狀，含新發味嗅覺喪失；飛沫（必要時接觸）隔離；急症徵象：呼吸困難、持續胸痛、意識混亂、發紺。
  • SARS: coronavirus, fever, aches, then dry cough/dyspnea after 2-7 days. Legionnaire's: Legionella from contaminated water sources, flu-like with high fever, dry cough, diarrhea; not person-to-person.SARS：冠狀病毒，發燒、痠痛，2-7 天後出現乾咳與呼吸困難。退伍軍人症：Legionella 來自受汙染水源，類流感高燒、乾咳、腹瀉；不會人傳人。
PDF p.763, 764, 765, 766

Pleural effusion, empyema, pleurisy胸腔積液、膿胸、胸膜炎

  • Pleural effusion: pleuritic pain, dyspnea, decreased chest wall movement, dry cough, decreased breath sounds/friction rub, mediastinal shift away from fluid if > 250 mL; Fowler's, thoracentesis; pleurodesis/pleurectomy if recurrent.胸腔積液：胸膜性疼痛、呼吸困難、胸壁活動減少、乾咳、呼吸音減弱/摩擦音、積液 >250 mL 時縱膈偏離積液側；半坐臥、胸腔穿刺；反覆發生則做胸膜沾黏術/胸膜切除術。
  • Empyema: pus in pleural space; fever, night sweats, chest pain, weight loss; antibiotics, thoracentesis/chest tube drainage, decortication if thickened.膿胸：胸腔內膿液；發燒、盜汗、胸痛、體重下降；抗生素、胸腔穿刺/胸管引流、胸膜增厚時行剝離術。
  • Pleurisy: knife-like pain worse on deep breath, friction rub; analgesics, hot/cold applications, lie on the affected side to splint.胸膜炎：深呼吸時刀割樣痛、胸膜摩擦音；止痛藥、冷熱敷、患側臥以支撐固定。
PDF p.766, 767

Pulmonary embolism and other lung diseases肺栓塞與其他肺部疾病

  • PE: thrombus (usually deep vein) travels to a pulmonary artery. Risks: immobility, surgery, obesity, pregnancy, HF, estrogen, long-bone fracture (fat emboli).肺栓塞：血栓（多來自深部靜脈）流至肺動脈。危險因子：不動、手術、肥胖、懷孕、心衰竭、雌激素、長骨骨折（脂肪栓塞）。
  • Signs: sudden dyspnea, pleuritic/chest pain, tachypnea, tachycardia, hypotension, cyanosis, anxiety/impending doom, hemoptysis, distended neck veins, petechiae over chest/axilla.徵象：突發呼吸困難、胸膜性/胸痛、呼吸急促、心搏過速、低血壓、發紺、焦慮/瀕死感、咳血、頸靜脈怒張、胸腋瘀點。
  • Action: elevate HOB, oxygen, call rapid response and PHCP, prepare ABG, labs, scan, heparin; monitor vitals and lung sounds; support client.處置：抬高床頭、給氧、呼叫快速反應小組與醫師、準備血氣、檢驗、影像、heparin；監測生命徵象與呼吸音；提供支持。
  • Histoplasmosis: inhaled spores from soil/bird droppings; mask and wet floor before sweeping barns; watch nephrotoxicity of antifungals. Sarcoidosis: granulomas, steroids. Occupational lung disease: prevention with respiratory protection.組織漿菌症：吸入土壤/鳥糞孢子；清掃穀倉前戴口罩並先噴濕地面；注意抗黴菌藥腎毒性。類肉瘤病：肉芽腫、使用類固醇。職業性肺病：以呼吸防護預防。
PDF p.767, 768

Tuberculosis結核病

  • Mycobacterium tuberculosis, acid-fast, airborne droplet nuclei; mainly upper lobes; noncompliance leads to MDR-TB; risk after 2-3 weeks of treatment falls greatly.結核分枝桿菌，抗酸性、經空氣飛沫核傳染；多侵犯上肺葉；不遵從治療導致多重抗藥結核；治療 2-3 週後傳染力大幅下降。
  • Signs: fatigue, anorexia, weight loss, low-grade fever, night sweats, persistent cough with mucoid/bloody sputum; upper-lobe infiltrates and calcification on x-ray.徵象：疲倦、厭食、體重減輕、低燒、盜汗、持續咳嗽伴黏液/血痰；X 光上肺葉浸潤與鈣化。
  • Tests: TST (read at 48-72 h, induration in mm; positive means exposure, not active disease; BCG gives positive; confirm with chest x-ray), QuantiFERON-TB Gold, sputum acid-fast smear and culture (up to 6 weeks).檢查：結核菌素試驗（48-72 小時判讀硬結 mm；陽性代表曾暴露，非活動性疾病；BCG 可呈陽性；需胸部 X 光確認）、QuantiFERON-TB Gold、痰液抗酸染色與培養（最多 6 週）。
  • Hospital: airborne isolation, negative-pressure room with door closed, at least 6 air exchanges per hour, N95/particulate respirator for staff, surgical mask on client when transported.住院：空氣隔離、負壓病室門須關閉、每小時至少 6 次換氣、工作人員戴 N95/呼吸防護具、病人外出需戴外科口罩。
  • Teaching: take medication exactly as prescribed, up to 12 months; sputum cultures every 2-4 weeks, three negative cultures = not infectious; cover cough, handwashing, nutrition (iron, protein, vitamin C), notify public health department.衛教：嚴格按時服藥，最長達 12 個月；每 2-4 週痰培養，三次陰性即無傳染力；掩口咳嗽、洗手、營養（鐵、蛋白質、維生素 C）、通報公共衛生單位。
PDF p.768, 769, 770, 771

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Silent chest in acute asthma means impending respiratory failure.急性氣喘發作時呼吸音消失（靜默胸）代表即將呼吸衰竭。 PDF p.761
  2. Tension pneumothorax: tracheal deviation to the unaffected side, distended neck veins, hypotension, absent breath sounds; chest tube.張力性氣胸：氣管偏向健側、頸靜脈怒張、低血壓、呼吸音消失；需胸管。 PDF p.760, 761
  3. Open chest wound: apply a nonporous dressing.開放性胸部傷口：覆蓋不透氣敷料。 PDF p.760
  4. Flail chest shows paradoxical chest movement; treat pain, oxygen, PEEP for respiratory failure.連枷胸呈反常呼吸；需止痛、給氧，呼吸衰竭用 PEEP。 PDF p.760
  5. Uncompensated respiratory acidosis in COPD suggests acute exacerbation; use lowest oxygen concentration guided by ABG/SpO2.COPD 出現未代償呼吸性酸中毒提示急性惡化；依血氣/血氧使用最低有效氧濃度。 PDF p.762, 763
  6. Pulmonary embolism: sudden dyspnea, chest pain, anxiety, tachycardia; HOB up, oxygen, rapid response, heparin; CT angiography is preferred test.肺栓塞：突發呼吸困難、胸痛、焦慮、心搏過速；抬高床頭、給氧、快速反應、heparin；CT 肺動脈攝影為首選檢查。 PDF p.759, 767, 768
  7. D-dimer: sensitive but not specific; normal < 50 ng/mL.D-dimer：敏感但非特異；正常 < 50 ng/mL。 PDF p.759
  8. After bronchoscopy keep NPO until gag reflex returns; watch for bronchospasm, hemorrhage, pneumothorax, crepitus.支氣管鏡後嘔吐反射恢復前禁食；監測支氣管痙攣、出血、氣胸、皮下氣腫。 PDF p.757
  9. Thoracentesis: monitor for pneumothorax, air embolism, pulmonary edema; check coagulation first.胸腔穿刺：監測氣胸、空氣栓塞、肺水腫；事先檢查凝血。 PDF p.757, 758
  10. Do not suction before an ABG draw.抽動脈血氣前不可抽吸。 PDF p.759
  11. TB skin test: read 48-72 hours; positive result means exposure; BCG causes positive; needs chest x-ray.結核菌素試驗：48-72 小時判讀；陽性代表曾暴露；BCG 可致陽性；需做胸部 X 光。 PDF p.769, 770
  12. Active TB: airborne precautions, negative-pressure room, N95 for staff, mask on client in transit.活動性結核：空氣隔離、負壓病室、工作人員戴 N95、病人外出戴口罩。 PDF p.770
  13. TB medication continues up to 12 months; noncompliance causes MDR-TB; three negative sputum cultures end infectiousness.結核藥物最長持續 12 個月；不遵從導致多重抗藥；三次痰培養陰性代表無傳染力。 PDF p.769, 771
  14. Legionnaire's disease is not spread person-to-person; COVID-19 and influenza use droplet precautions.退伍軍人症不會人傳人；COVID-19 與流感採飛沫隔離。 PDF p.765, 766
  15. Pleural effusion > 250 mL causes mediastinal shift away from the fluid.胸腔積液 > 250 mL 使縱膈偏離積液側。 PDF p.766
  16. Rib fractures: self-splint with a pillow, avoid external binders; pneumonia risk is high.肋骨骨折：以枕頭自行按壓，避免外部束縛；肺炎風險高。 PDF p.759

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Asthma triggers 'ASA, NSAIDs, beta-blockers' (the three drug classes to avoid).氣喘誘發藥物：阿斯匹靈、NSAIDs、β 阻斷劑（三類須避免）。 PDF p.762
  • Tension pneumothorax: tracheal deviation AWAY from the injured (affected) side; effusion pushes mediastinum away from fluid.張力性氣胸氣管偏向健側（遠離患側）；積液使縱膈偏離積液側。 PDF p.760, 766
  • TB: 'N95 + negative pressure + 6 air changes per hour'.結核：N95 + 負壓 + 每小時 6 次換氣。 PDF p.770
  • PE triad to remember: sudden dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain, tachycardia in a client at risk for DVT.肺栓塞三要點：DVT 高風險者出現突發呼吸困難、胸膜性胸痛、心搏過速。 PDF p.767

52 Respiratory Medications呼吸系統藥物

This chapter covers inhalation devices and each respiratory drug class (bronchodilators, anticholinergics, corticosteroids, leukotriene modifiers, mast cell stabilizers, omalizumab, antihistamines, decongestants, expectorants/mucolytics, antitussives, opioid antagonists), then tuberculosis drugs and influenza/COVID-19 prevention and treatment. Focus on class action, key adverse effects, monitoring, and client teaching.本章涵蓋吸入裝置與各類呼吸系統藥物(支氣管擴張劑、抗膽鹼藥、類固醇、白三烯調節劑、肥大細胞穩定劑、omalizumab、抗組織胺、解鼻充血劑、化痰/黏液溶解劑、鎮咳劑、鴉片類拮抗劑),以及抗結核藥物和流感/COVID-19的預防與治療。重點為藥物分類的作用、主要不良反應、監測與衛教。

Inhalation devices and order of administration吸入裝置與給藥順序

  • MDI uses a propellant to push out drug; a spacer improves lung delivery and reduces mouth/throat deposition.定量噴霧吸入器(MDI)以推進劑噴出藥物;使用間隔器可增加肺部沉積並減少口咽殘留。
  • DPI has no propellant but needs a strong, fast inhalation.乾粉吸入器(DPI)不含推進劑,但需要用力且快速吸氣。
