  • Nebulizer turns liquid drug into a fine mist via mask or mouthpiece using air or oxygen under pressure.噴霧器以加壓空氣或氧氣將藥液變成細霧,經面罩或口含嘴給藥。
  • Give the bronchodilator first, corticosteroid second so airways are open for the steroid.先給支氣管擴張劑,再給類固醇,讓氣道先擴張使類固醇更有效。
  • Wait 5 minutes between two different inhaled drugs; wait 1-2 minutes between repeat puffs of the same drug.兩種不同吸入藥之間間隔5分鐘;同一藥物第二劑間隔1-2分鐘。
  • Technique: breathe out, activate while inhaling slowly about 5 seconds, hold breath 10-15 seconds; sip water before/after to reduce cough and bad taste.技巧:先吐氣,緩慢吸入並噴藥約5秒,閉氣10-15秒;吸入前後喝幾口水可減少咳嗽與口中異味。
PDF p.778, 779, 780

Bronchodilators: beta2 agonists and methylxanthines支氣管擴張劑:β2受體促效劑與甲基黃嘌呤

  • Beta2 agonists (albuterol, salmeterol, formoterol, terbutaline) relax bronchial smooth muscle; theophylline/aminophylline also stimulate CNS and cause diuresis.β2促效劑(albuterol、salmeterol、formoterol、terbutaline)放鬆支氣管平滑肌;theophylline/aminophylline另會刺激中樞神經並利尿。
  • Adverse effects: tachycardia, palpitations, dysrhythmias, tremor, nervousness, seizures, nausea, hyperglycemia, dry mouth, paradoxical bronchospasm.不良反應:心搏過速、心悸、心律不整、顫抖、神經質、癲癇、噁心、高血糖、口乾、反常性支氣管痙攣。
  • Contraindicated in hypersensitivity, peptic ulcer disease, severe cardiac disease/dysrhythmias, uncontrolled hypertension, high stroke risk, hyperthyroidism, or uncontrolled seizure disorder; caution only for milder, controlled hypertension, diabetes, or narrow-angle glaucoma.禁忌:過敏、消化性潰瘍、嚴重心臟病/心律不整、未控制的高血壓、高中風風險、甲狀腺機能亢進、未控制的癲癇;僅在輕度、已控制的高血壓、糖尿病或狹角性青光眼時才屬於謹慎使用。
  • Therapeutic theophylline level 10-20 mcg/mL (55.5-111 mcmol/L); toxic above 20; early toxicity = restlessness, tremor, palpitations, tachycardia.Theophylline治療濃度10-20 mcg/mL(55.5-111 mcmol/L);超過20即可能中毒;早期徵象為躁動、顫抖、心悸、心搏過速。
  • Interactions: theophylline raises digoxin toxicity risk; beta blockers, cimetidine, erythromycin raise theophylline levels; barbiturates and carbamazepine lower them.交互作用:theophylline增加digoxin毒性風險;β阻斷劑、cimetidine、erythromycin使theophylline濃度升高;巴比妥類與carbamazepine使其降低。
  • Teach: do not crush enteric-coated/sustained-release forms, avoid caffeine (coffee, tea, cola, chocolate), take with/after meals, carry rescue inhaler, stop smoking, check pulse. IV theophylline via infusion pump, slowly.衛教:緩釋/腸溶錠不可磨碎、避免咖啡因(咖啡、茶、可樂、巧克力)、隨餐或餐後服用、隨身攜帶急救吸入器、戒菸、監測脈搏。IV theophylline須以輸液幫浦緩慢給予。
PDF p.778, 779, 780

Anticholinergics, corticosteroids, leukotriene modifiers抗膽鹼藥、類固醇與白三烯調節劑

  • Inhaled anticholinergics (ipratropium, tiotropium, aclidinium, umeclidinium) block muscarinic receptors to prevent bronchoconstriction; used in COPD and exercise-induced bronchospasm.吸入型抗膽鹼藥(ipratropium、tiotropium、aclidinium、umeclidinium)阻斷蕈毒鹼受體以防支氣管收縮;用於COPD與運動誘發支氣管痙攣。
  • Dry mouth and pharyngeal irritation are common (sugarless candy helps); systemic effects are rare: blurred vision, glaucoma, urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia.常見口乾與咽部刺激(含無糖糖果可緩解);全身性作用少見:視力模糊、青光眼、尿滯留、便秘、心搏過速。
  • Some ipratropium products contain soy lecithin: avoid in peanut allergy.部分ipratropium產品含大豆卵磷脂,花生過敏者應避免。
  • Inhaled/oral glucocorticoids reduce airway inflammation and edema (see Chapter 48).吸入或口服糖皮質素可減輕氣道發炎與水腫(見第48章)。
  • Leukotriene modifiers (montelukast, zafirlukast, zileuton) are for chronic asthma prophylaxis, NOT acute attacks; monitor liver function; watch for depression, suicidal thinking, hallucinations.白三烯調節劑(montelukast、zafirlukast、zileuton)用於氣喘長期預防,不用於急性發作;需監測肝功能;注意憂鬱、自殺意念與幻覺。
  • Teach: take zafirlukast 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals; effect needs 48-72 hours of regular use; do not stop even when symptom-free.衛教:zafirlukast餐前1小時或餐後2小時服用;需規律使用48-72小時才見效;無症狀時也不可自行停藥。
PDF p.779, 780

Mast cell stabilizer and omalizumab肥大細胞穩定劑與omalizumab

  • Cromolyn sodium stabilizes mast cells to prevent mediator release; for allergic rhinitis, asthma, exercise-induced bronchospasm (prophylaxis).Cromolyn sodium穩定肥大細胞、防止介質釋放;用於過敏性鼻炎、氣喘及運動誘發支氣管痙攣的預防。
  • Adverse effects: cough, sneezing, nasal stinging, bronchospasm after inhalation, unpleasant taste. Do not stop abruptly (rebound asthma).不良反應:吸入後咳嗽、打噴嚏、鼻刺痛、支氣管痙攣、口中異味。不可突然停藥(反彈性氣喘發作)。
  • Omalizumab is an anti-IgE monoclonal antibody given subcutaneously every 2-4 weeks for allergic asthma; dose based on IgE level and weight.Omalizumab為抗IgE單株抗體,每2-4週皮下注射,用於過敏性氣喘;劑量依血清IgE與體重調整。
  • Risk of anaphylaxis: have emergency drugs available at first dose; avoid live vaccines; do not stop other asthma drugs; improvement is gradual.有過敏性休克風險:首次給藥需備妥急救藥物;避免活性疫苗;不可自行停其他氣喘藥;改善是漸進的。
  • Other adverse effects: injection site reactions, URI, sinusitis, headache, malignancy.其他不良反應:注射部位反應、上呼吸道感染、鼻竇炎、頭痛、惡性腫瘤。
PDF p.780, 781

Antihistamines, decongestants, expectorants, antitussives抗組織胺、解鼻充血劑、化痰藥與鎮咳劑

  • H1 antihistamines (diphenhydramine, loratadine, cetirizine) block histamine; first-generation cause sedation, dry secretions, urinary retention, blurred vision; avoid with alcohol/CNS depressants; avoid diphenhydramine in narrow-angle glaucoma.H1抗組織胺(diphenhydramine、loratadine、cetirizine)阻斷組織胺;第一代易致嗜睡、分泌物變乾、尿滯留、視力模糊;避免與酒精/中樞抑制劑併用;狹角性青光眼避免diphenhydramine。
  • Antihistamines: use caution in COPD (drying); give IM deep in large muscle, never subcutaneous; motion sickness dose 30 min before event.抗組織胺:COPD者慎用(乾燥作用);肌肉注射須打在大肌肉,不可皮下注射;暈車藥於事前30分鐘服用。
  • Decongestants (pseudoephedrine, phenylephrine, oxymetazoline): cause hypertension, palpitations, insomnia, hyperglycemia; do not use longer than 48 hours (rebound congestion).解鼻充血劑(pseudoephedrine、phenylephrine、oxymetazoline):可致高血壓、心悸、失眠、高血糖;使用勿超過48小時(反彈性鼻塞)。
  • Guaifenesin (expectorant): take with a full glass of water; fluids up to 3000 mL/day unless contraindicated.Guaifenesin(化痰藥):以一整杯水服用;除非禁忌,每日液體攝取可達3000 mL。
  • Acetylcysteine (mucolytic): avoid in asthma (increases airway resistance); give bronchodilator 5 min before; do not mix in nebulizer; also antidote for acetaminophen overdose.Acetylcysteine(黏液溶解劑):氣喘者避免(增加氣道阻力);支氣管擴張劑先給,間隔5分鐘;噴霧時不與其他藥混合;亦為acetaminophen過量的解毒劑。
  • Antitussives (codeine, hydrocodone, benzonatate, dextromethorphan) suppress medullary cough center for dry irritating cough; avoid in head injury/post-craniotomy and with CNS depressants; avoid cough suppression in COPD.鎮咳劑(codeine、hydrocodone、benzonatate、dextromethorphan)抑制延腦咳嗽中樞,用於乾咳;頭部外傷/開顱術後及併用中樞抑制劑者避免;COPD者避免抑制咳嗽。
  • Call provider if cough lasts over 1 week or with fever or rash.咳嗽超過1週或伴隨發燒、皮疹應通知醫療人員。
PDF p.781, 782, 783

Opioid antagonists鴉片類拮抗劑

  • Naloxone reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression; do not use for non-opioid respiratory depression.Naloxone逆轉鴉片類引起的呼吸抑制;非鴉片類引起的呼吸抑制不使用。
  • Respiratory depression can recur if the opioid outlasts naloxone, so monitor closely and re-dose as needed.若鴉片類作用時間比naloxone長,呼吸抑制可能復發,需密切監測並視需要再給藥。
  • IV doses titrated every 2-5 minutes; keep oxygen and resuscitation equipment at bedside.IV劑量每2-5分鐘調整;床邊備氧氣與急救設備。
  • Adverse effects: nausea, vomiting, tremor, sweating, hypertension, tachycardia (withdrawal-type effects).不良反應:噁心、嘔吐、顫抖、出汗、高血壓、心搏過速(類戒斷反應)。
PDF p.783

Tuberculosis therapy principles and first-line drugs結核病治療原則與第一線藥物

  • Multidrug therapy for active TB lasts 6-9 months (longer if immunosuppressed); transmission risk falls greatly after 2-3 weeks; sputum cultures usually negative by 3 months; exposed persons get isoniazid for 9-12 months.活動性結核採多重藥物治療6-9個月(免疫抑制者更久);治療2-3週後傳染力大幅降低;多數3個月後痰培養轉陰;暴露者以isoniazid預防9-12個月。
  • Nonadherence causes multidrug-resistant TB; use DOT/VDOT; take on an empty stomach (1 hour before/2 hours after meals), no antacids, no alcohol; all first-line drugs can harm the liver.不遵從服藥會產生多重抗藥性結核;可採直接觀察治療(DOT/VDOT);空腹服用(餐前1小時或餐後2小時),避免抗酸劑與酒精;所有第一線藥物皆可能傷肝。
  • First-line: isoniazid, rifampin, ethambutol, pyrazinamide.第一線藥物:isoniazid、rifampin、ethambutol、pyrazinamide。
  • Isoniazid: hepatitis (anorexia, dark urine, jaundice, fatigue), peripheral neuritis; give pyridoxine (B6); raises phenytoin levels; avoid tyramine foods (aged cheese, tuna); check baseline and ongoing liver enzymes.Isoniazid:肝炎(厭食、尿液變深、黃疸、疲倦)、周邊神經炎;給予pyridoxine(B6);使phenytoin濃度上升;避免含酪胺食物(陳年乳酪、鮪魚);需基線與持續追蹤肝酵素。
  • Rifampin: red-orange secretions (urine, sweat, tears, feces; stains soft contacts), hepatotoxicity; lowers effect of oral contraceptives, warfarin, oral hypoglycemics, digoxin, phenytoin, verapamil.Rifampin:體液呈橘紅色(尿、汗、淚、糞便;軟式隱形眼鏡會染色)、肝毒性;降低口服避孕藥、warfarin、口服降血糖藥、digoxin、phenytoin、verapamil的效果。
  • Ethambutol: optic neuritis (decreased acuity, red-green color confusion) - report immediately; raises uric acid; contraindicated under age 13 per book; give once daily with food.Ethambutol:視神經炎(視力下降、紅綠色辨識困難),須立即通報;升高尿酸;依本書不適用13歲以下兒童;每日一次隨餐服用。
  • Pyrazinamide: hepatotoxicity, raised uric acid (gout, joint pain), photosensitivity; can make diabetes harder to control.Pyrazinamide:肝毒性、尿酸升高(痛風、關節痛)、光敏感;可能使糖尿病更難控制。
PDF p.783, 784, 785, 786

Second-line TB drugs第二線結核藥物

  • Rifabutin: neutropenia, uveitis (eye pain, blurred vision), hepatitis, flu-like syndrome, red-orange secretions; use non-hormonal contraception; used for MAC in HIV.Rifabutin:嗜中性球低下、葡萄膜炎(眼痛、視力模糊)、肝炎、類流感症候群、橘紅色體液;應使用非荷爾蒙避孕;用於HIV患者的MAC感染。
  • Rifapentine: pulmonary TB only; hepatotoxicity, red-orange secretions, interacts with warfarin and oral contraceptives; baseline LFTs.Rifapentine:僅用於肺結核;肝毒性、橘紅色體液,與warfarin及口服避孕藥有交互作用;需基線肝功能。
  • Capreomycin (IM, MDR-TB): nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, neuromuscular blockade; baseline audiometry; avoid with aminoglycosides/loop diuretics.Capreomycin(肌肉注射,用於MDR-TB):腎毒性、耳毒性、神經肌肉阻斷;需基線聽力檢查;避免與胺基糖苷類/袢利尿劑併用。
  • Aminoglycosides/fluoroquinolones (streptomycin, amikacin, levofloxacin): nephro-, oto-, neurotoxicity; audiometry every 1-2 months; hydrate; monitor BUN/creatinine, peak and trough.胺基糖苷類/氟喹諾酮類(streptomycin、amikacin、levofloxacin):腎、耳、神經毒性;每1-2個月聽力檢查;維持水分;監測BUN/肌酐及波峰/波谷濃度。
  • Ethionamide: GI upset, metallic taste, orthostatic hypotension, hepatotoxicity; give pyridoxine; watch glucose.Ethionamide:胃腸不適、金屬味、姿勢性低血壓、肝毒性;給予pyridoxine;注意血糖。
  • Aminosalicylic acid: GI irritation, crystalluria (push fluids), blood dyscrasias; discard if purplish-brown.Aminosalicylic acid:胃腸刺激、結晶尿(多喝水)、血液病變;若變紫褐色須丟棄。
  • Cycloserine: CNS toxicity, seizures, depression/suicidal thoughts; avoid alcohol; peak level 2 hours after dose 25-35 mcg/mL; weekly levels.Cycloserine:中樞神經毒性、癲癇、憂鬱/自殺意念;避免酒精;給藥後2小時峰值25-35 mcg/mL;每週監測濃度。
  • Streptomycin toxicity: nephro (urine output change), neuro (numbness, twitching), vestibular (vertigo), auditory (tinnitus, permanent hearing loss).Streptomycin毒性:腎(尿量改變)、神經(麻木、抽動)、前庭(眩暈)、聽覺(耳鳴、永久性聽損)。
PDF p.786, 787, 788, 789

Influenza, pneumococcal and COVID-19流感、肺炎鏈球菌與COVID-19

  • Annual flu vaccine for all without contraindication; inactivated IM vaccine (deltoid) is safe in pregnancy and from 6 months; cannot cause influenza; antibodies take about 2 weeks.無禁忌者每年接種流感疫苗;不活化肌肉注射疫苗(三角肌)可用於孕婦及6個月以上嬰兒;不會引起流感;抗體約2週產生。
  • Live nasal vaccine: only healthy ages 2-49; not for pregnancy, long-term aspirin in children, asthma, diabetes, heart/kidney/lung disease; virus shed up to 2 days.活性鼻噴疫苗:僅限2-49歲健康者;孕婦、長期服用aspirin的兒童、氣喘、糖尿病、心/腎/肺疾病者不可用;病毒可排出約2天。
  • Inactivated vaccine contraindications: hypersensitivity, Guillain-Barre syndrome, febrile illness, under 6 months.不活化疫苗禁忌:過敏、格林-巴利症候群、發燒疾病、未滿6個月。
  • Antivirals (oseltamivir, zanamivir, peramivir, amantadine, rimantadine): start within 2 days of symptoms, finish the course; do not replace vaccination and may not stop transmission.抗病毒藥(oseltamivir、zanamivir、peramivir、amantadine、rimantadine):症狀出現2天內開始並完成療程;不能取代疫苗,也不一定能阻止傳染。
  • Amantadine/rimantadine: CNS effects, orthostatic hypotension; oseltamivir: insomnia, diarrhea; zanamivir: ENT infection, cough, bronchitis.Amantadine/rimantadine:中樞神經作用、姿勢性低血壓;oseltamivir:失眠、腹瀉;zanamivir:耳鼻喉感染、咳嗽、支氣管炎。
  • COVID-19: follow vaccination and boosters; consult the current NIH treatment guidelines for up-to-date therapy.COVID-19:依建議接種疫苗與追加劑;治療請隨時查閱最新NIH治療指引。
PDF p.789, 790, 791

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Bronchodilator before corticosteroid; wait 5 minutes between different inhaled drugs, 1-2 minutes between same-drug puffs.先支氣管擴張劑、後類固醇;不同吸入藥間隔5分鐘,同藥重複劑量間隔1-2分鐘。 PDF p.778
  2. Therapeutic theophylline 10-20 mcg/mL; >20 toxic (restlessness, tremor, tachycardia, palpitations); avoid caffeine.Theophylline治療濃度10-20 mcg/mL;>20中毒(躁動、顫抖、心搏過速、心悸);避免咖啡因。 PDF p.779, 780
  3. Theophylline + beta2 agonist together may cause dysrhythmias; theophylline raises digoxin toxicity risk.Theophylline併用β2促效劑可能導致心律不整;theophylline增加digoxin中毒風險。 PDF p.778
  4. Leukotriene modifiers prevent, they do not treat acute asthma; monitor liver function and mood/suicidal thoughts.白三烯調節劑為預防用藥,不治療急性氣喘;監測肝功能與情緒/自殺意念。 PDF p.780
  5. Cromolyn can cause bronchospasm; do not stop abruptly (rebound attack).Cromolyn可能引起支氣管痙攣;不可突然停藥(反彈性發作)。 PDF p.780
  6. Omalizumab: anaphylaxis risk (lip/tongue swelling, dyspnea) - have emergency meds ready at first dose; no live vaccines.Omalizumab:有過敏性休克風險(嘴唇/舌頭腫脹、呼吸困難),首次給藥備妥急救藥;避免活性疫苗。 PDF p.780, 781
  7. Decongestants max 48 hours because of rebound congestion; caution in hypertension, cardiac disease, diabetes, hyperthyroidism.解鼻充血劑最長使用48小時(反彈性鼻塞);高血壓、心臟病、糖尿病、甲狀腺亢進者慎用。 PDF p.782
  8. Acetylcysteine: avoid in asthma; also antidote for acetaminophen overdose.Acetylcysteine:氣喘者避免;亦為acetaminophen過量的解毒劑。 PDF p.782
  9. Naloxone: have resuscitation equipment ready; effect may wear off before the opioid, so respiratory depression can return.Naloxone:備妥急救設備;藥效可能比鴉片類先消退,呼吸抑制可能復發。 PDF p.783
  10. Isoniazid: hepatitis and peripheral neuritis; give pyridoxine (B6); report jaundice, dark urine, anorexia, fatigue; no alcohol; avoid tyramine foods.Isoniazid:肝炎與周邊神經炎;給予B6;通報黃疸、尿液變深、厭食、疲倦;禁酒;避免含酪胺食物。 PDF p.784, 785
  11. Rifampin turns urine, sweat, tears, feces red-orange (harmless, stains soft contacts); reduces oral contraceptive effectiveness.Rifampin使尿液、汗液、淚液、糞便呈橘紅色(無害,會染色軟式隱形眼鏡);降低口服避孕藥效果。 PDF p.785
  12. Ethambutol: report any visual change (red-green discrimination, decreased acuity) immediately - optic neuritis.Ethambutol:任何視覺改變(紅綠辨色困難、視力下降)須立即通報(視神經炎)。 PDF p.785, 786
  13. Streptomycin/aminoglycosides/capreomycin: ototoxicity, nephrotoxicity; baseline and repeated audiometry; report tinnitus, hearing loss, vertigo.Streptomycin/胺基糖苷類/capreomycin:耳毒性、腎毒性;基線及定期聽力檢查;通報耳鳴、聽力下降、眩暈。 PDF p.787, 788, 789
  14. Never skip TB doses: nonadherence creates multidrug-resistant TB; DOT improves adherence.結核藥物不可漏服:不遵從會產生多重抗藥性結核;DOT可提升遵從性。 PDF p.783, 784
  15. Influenza antivirals work best within 2 days of symptom onset and do not replace the vaccine.流感抗病毒藥在症狀出現2天內使用效果最佳,且不能取代疫苗。 PDF p.790, 791
  16. Live attenuated nasal flu vaccine is not for pregnancy or people with chronic lung/heart disease or asthma.活性減毒鼻噴流感疫苗不適用於孕婦或患有慢性肺/心臟病、氣喘者。 PDF p.790

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • RIPE for first-line TB drugs: Rifampin, Isoniazid, Pyrazinamide, Ethambutol.RIPE記憶第一線結核藥:Rifampin、Isoniazid、Pyrazinamide、Ethambutol。 PDF p.783
  • Ethambutol = Eyes (optic neuritis); Isoniazid = Impairs nerves and liver (B6); Rifampin = Red-orange fluids; Streptomycin = Sound (ears).Ethambutol=眼睛(視神經炎);Isoniazid=神經與肝(補B6);Rifampin=橘紅體液;Streptomycin=聽力(耳)。 PDF p.784, 785, 786, 789
  • Theophylline toxicity: nervous, shaky, racing heart (above 20 mcg/mL).Theophylline中毒:緊張、顫抖、心跳加快(>20 mcg/mL)。 PDF p.780
  • Bronchodilator first (open the door), steroid second (deliver inside).先擴張劑(先開門),再類固醇(再送進去)。 PDF p.778

53 Cardiovascular Problems心血管問題

This chapter reviews cardiac anatomy and conduction, diagnostic tests and procedures, cardiac surgery, dysrhythmias with defibrillation/cardioversion/pacemakers, coronary artery disease, angina, MI, heart failure, inflammatory heart disease, valvular disease, cardiomyopathy, vascular and arterial disorders, aneurysms, and hypertension. Priorities: recognize life-threatening rhythms, perfusion problems, and post-procedure complications.本章涵蓋心臟解剖與傳導系統、診斷檢查與處置、心臟手術、心律不整(含去顫/電擊/節律器)、冠狀動脈疾病、心絞痛、心肌梗塞、心衰竭、心臟發炎性疾病、瓣膜疾病、心肌病變、血管與動脈疾病、動脈瘤及高血壓。重點為辨識致命性心律、灌流問題及術後併發症。

Anatomy and physiology解剖與生理

  • Heart wall: epicardium (outer), myocardium (muscle), endocardium (inner lining). Pericardial space holds 5-20 mL fluid.心壁分三層:心外膜、心肌層、心內膜。心包腔內含5-20 mL液體。
  • Valves: tricuspid and mitral (AV valves) close at start of ventricular contraction; pulmonic and aortic (semilunar) open during contraction.瓣膜:三尖瓣與二尖瓣(房室瓣)於心室收縮開始時關閉;肺動脈瓣與主動脈瓣(半月瓣)於收縮時開啟。
  • Conduction: SA node 60-100/min, AV node 40-60/min as backup, Purkinje fibers 20-40/min.傳導:竇房結60-100次/分;房室結備援40-60次/分;浦金氏纖維20-40次/分。
  • Coronary arteries: RCA supplies SA/AV nodes and inferior wall; LAD supplies anterior wall, septum and apex; circumflex supplies lateral and posterior wall.冠狀動脈:右冠狀動脈供應竇房結/房室結與下壁;左前降支供應前壁、中隔與心尖;迴旋支供應側壁與後壁。
  • S1 = AV valves closing (loudest at apex); S2 = semilunar valves closing; S3 suggests heart failure/regurgitation (normal under 30); S4 suggests stiff ventricle.S1為房室瓣關閉(心尖最清楚);S2為半月瓣關閉;S3提示心衰竭/逆流(30歲以下可正常);S4提示心室僵硬。
  • Sympathetic (norepinephrine) raises HR, contractility and vasoconstriction; parasympathetic (acetylcholine) lowers HR. Baroreceptors in aortic arch and carotid sinuses regulate BP.交感神經(norepinephrine)使心率、收縮力與血管收縮增加;副交感(acetylcholine)使心率下降。壓力感受器位於主動脈弓與頸動脈竇,調節血壓。
  • Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone: renin makes angiotensin I, converted to II in lungs; AII causes vasoconstriction and aldosterone-driven Na/water retention.腎素-血管收縮素-醛固酮系統:腎素產生血管收縮素I,於肺轉成II;AII引起血管收縮與醛固酮造成鈉水滯留。
PDF p.799, 800, 801

Laboratory diagnostic tests實驗室檢查

  • Troponin I rises within 3 hours and stays elevated 7-10 days (normal <0.35 ng/mL; troponin T <0.1). High-sensitivity troponin detects injury in 60-90 minutes.Troponin I於3小時內上升,持續7-10天(正常<0.35 ng/mL;troponin T<0.1)。高敏感度troponin可在60-90分鐘偵測損傷。
  • CK-MB (2-6 ng/mL) rises within hours, peaks at 18 hours; myoglobin rises in 2 hours, declines by 7 hours but is not cardiac specific.CK-MB(2-6 ng/mL)數小時內上升,18小時達高峰;肌紅素2小時上升、7小時後下降,但非心臟特異。
  • BNP normally <100 ng/mL; higher means more severe heart failure. hsCRP <1 mg/L low risk, >3 mg/L high risk.BNP正常<100 ng/mL;越高代表心衰竭越嚴重。hsCRP<1 mg/L低風險,>3 mg/L高風險。
  • Hypokalemia: flat/inverted T, U wave, ST depression, ventricular dysrhythmias, digoxin toxicity risk. Hyperkalemia: tall peaked T, wide QRS, flat P, asystole.低血鉀:T波平坦/倒置、U波、ST下降、心室心律不整、增加digoxin中毒風險。高血鉀:高尖T波、QRS變寬、P波消失、心搏停止。
  • Hypocalcemia prolongs ST/QT; hypercalcemia shortens ST, AV block; low magnesium causes VT/VF; high Mg gives weakness, hypotension, bradycardia.低血鈣使ST/QT延長;高血鈣使ST縮短、房室傳導阻滯;低血鎂可致VT/VF;高血鎂致無力、低血壓、心搏過緩。
  • WBC rises after MI; BUN rises in HF/cardiogenic shock; coagulation factors rise after MI; elevated Lp(a) and homocysteine raise CVD risk.MI後白血球上升;心衰竭/心因性休克時BUN上升;MI後凝血因子上升;Lp(a)與同半胱胺酸升高增加心血管風險。
PDF p.801, 802

Diagnostic procedures, cardiac catheterization and revascularization診斷處置、心導管與血運重建

  • ECG basics: PR 0.12-0.20 s, QRS 0.04-0.10 s, QT 0.32-0.40 s; each small box 0.04 s, large 0.20 s. Holter records 24+ hours.心電圖基礎:PR 0.12-0.20秒、QRS 0.04-0.10秒、QT 0.32-0.40秒;小格0.04秒、大格0.20秒。Holter監測24小時以上。
  • Stress test: avoid smoking, alcohol, caffeine; beta/calcium blockers usually held that day, theophylline 12 hours before; dipyridamole/dobutamine if cannot exercise.運動負荷測試:避免吸菸、酒精、咖啡因;當天通常停用β阻斷劑/鈣通道阻斷劑,theophylline於前12小時停用;無法運動者用dipyridamole/dobutamine。
  • MRI: screen for pacemaker/metal. TEE is invasive (prepare like endoscopy).MRI:檢查有無節律器/金屬。經食道超音波(TEE)為侵入性,準備類似內視鏡。
  • Cardiac cath pre-procedure: consent, check iodine/seafood allergy, NPO (solids 6-8 h, liquids 4 h), baseline pulses and weight; hold metformin 24 hours before and until renal function reviewed (about 48 hours after).心導管術前:同意書、確認碘/海鮮過敏、禁食(固體6-8小時、液體4小時)、記錄基線脈搏與體重;metformin術前24小時停用,待腎功能確認後(約術後48小時)恢復。
  • Post-cath: vitals and rhythm q30 min x 2 hours; check distal pulses, color, warmth; cool/pale limb or lost pulse = emergency (clot). Bleeding: manual pressure. Extremity straight 4-6 h, bed rest 6-12 h, HOB no more than 15 degrees if no closure device; push fluids to flush dye.心導管術後:前2小時每30分鐘監測生命徵象與心律;檢查遠端脈搏、顏色、溫度;肢體冰冷蒼白或脈搏消失為急症(血栓)。出血時手動加壓。無縫合裝置時肢體伸直4-6小時、臥床6-12小時,床頭≤15度;鼓勵補充水分以排除顯影劑。
  • PTCA balloon dilates artery; complications: dissection, rupture, embolization, spasm, MI, reocclusion. Stents need antiplatelets (clopidogrel + aspirin) for months; IV nitroglycerin may prevent spasm.PTCA以球囊擴張血管;併發症:剝離、破裂、栓塞、痙攣、心肌梗塞、再阻塞。支架術後需抗血小板藥(clopidogrel+aspirin)數月;IV nitroglycerin可預防痙攣。
  • Other options: laser angioplasty, atherectomy, transmyocardial revascularization, IVUS, CAC score >300 high risk.其他:雷射血管成形術、粥狀斑塊切除術、經心肌雷射血管重建術、血管內超音波;冠狀動脈鈣化分數>300為高風險。
PDF p.802, 803, 804, 805, 806

CABG and heart transplant冠狀動脈繞道手術與心臟移植

  • CABG uses saphenous vein or internal mammary artery; MIDCAB for LAD lesions needs no sternotomy or bypass pump.冠狀動脈繞道術使用隱靜脈或內乳動脈;MIDCAB用於左前降支病灶,不需胸骨切開或體外循環。
  • Pre-op: teach splinting, coughing, incentive spirometer, tubes/ventilator; diuretics stopped 2-3 days, digoxin 12 hours, aspirin/anticoagulants 1 week before.術前:教導按壓傷口、咳嗽、誘發性肺量計、管路/呼吸器;利尿劑術前2-3天、digoxin術前12小時、aspirin/抗凝血劑術前1週停用。
  • Post-op: chest tube drainage over 100-150 mL/hr reported; keep K+ 4-5 mEq/L; fluids 1500-2000 mL; rewarm no faster than 1.8 degrees per hour; ground equipment for epicardial wires (microshock).術後:胸管引流量>100-150 mL/小時需通報;維持鉀4-5 mEq/L;液體限制1500-2000 mL;回溫速度每小時不超過1.8度;心外膜導線設備須接地(防微電擊)。
  • Tamponade signs: sudden stop of heavy mediastinal drainage, JVD with clear lungs, equalized pressures, pulsus paradoxus. Anginal pain suggests graft failure.心包填塞徵象:大量縱隔引流突然停止、頸靜脈怒張但肺部清晰、壓力趨於相等、奇脈。心絞痛樣疼痛提示移植血管失敗。
  • Recovery: stop activity if BP drops 10-20 mm Hg or pulse rises over 10; sternum heals 6-8 weeks; avoid pushing/pulling 6 weeks; infection if WBC/fever persists after 3-4 days.恢復:血壓下降10-20 mm Hg或脈搏增加>10次應停止活動;胸骨約6-8週癒合;6週內避免推拉;3-4天後仍發燒/白血球高提示感染。
  • Heart transplant: lifelong immunosuppression, infection risk, denervated heart (no angina, resting rate about 100, slow response to exercise), two P waves on ECG, rejection signs: hypotension, dysrhythmias, fatigue; biopsies for surveillance.心臟移植:終身免疫抑制、感染風險、心臟去神經(無心絞痛、靜止心率約100、運動反應慢)、心電圖有兩種P波、排斥徵象:低血壓、心律不整、疲倦;定期心內膜切片。
PDF p.806, 807, 808

Cardiac dysrhythmias心律不整

  • Estimate rate with 6-second strip x 10. Normal sinus rhythm: regular, 60-100, normal PR and QRS.以6秒心電圖條帶QRS數x10估算心率。正常竇性心律:規則、60-100次/分、PR與QRS正常。
  • Sinus bradycardia (<60): treat if symptomatic with oxygen, atropine (avoid extra doses), then transcutaneous pacing; hold causative drugs.竇性心搏過緩(<60):有症狀時給氧、atropine(避免多餘劑量),再用經皮節律器;暫停可疑藥物。
  • Sinus tachycardia (100-180): find and treat the cause.竇性心搏過速(100-180):找出並治療原因。
  • Atrial fibrillation: 350-600 chaotic atrial impulses, no P waves, fibrillatory waves, thrombus/stroke risk; give anticoagulants, rate control, cardioversion (anticoagulate 4-6 weeks and TEE first, hold digoxin 48 h).心房顫動:每分鐘350-600次紊亂心房衝動、無P波、有顫動波、有血栓/中風風險;給予抗凝血劑、控制心室率、電擊(術前抗凝4-6週並做TEE,停digoxin 48小時)。
  • PVCs: check O2 sat and K+; notify provider for chest pain, increased frequency, multifocal, R-on-T, or runs of VT. Bigeminy, trigeminy, couplets described.PVC:檢查血氧與鉀;若胸痛、頻率增加、多源性、R-on-T或連續VT需通知醫師。依序有二聯、三聯、成對等型態。
  • VT (140-250/min): stable = oxygen plus antidysrhythmics; unstable with pulse = synchronized cardioversion; pulseless = defibrillation and CPR.VT(140-250次/分):穩定時給氧與抗心律不整藥;不穩定但有脈搏=同步電擊;無脈搏=去顫與CPR。
  • VF: no cardiac output, unconscious, no pulse; fatal in 3-5 minutes; CPR then immediate defibrillation, 2 minutes CPR between shocks.VF:無心輸出量、意識喪失、無脈搏;3-5分鐘內致命;CPR並立即去顫,每次電擊間CPR 2分鐘。
  • Sudden loss of complexes: assess the client first (asystole vs lead displacement) before touching equipment.心電圖波形突然消失:先評估個案(心搏停止或電極脫落),再處理儀器。
PDF p.808, 809, 810, 811

Dysrhythmia management: cardioversion, defibrillation, AICD, pacemakers心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器

  • Vagal maneuvers (carotid massage, Valsalva) for supraventricular tachycardia; need monitor, defibrillator ready, record strips.迷走神經刺激(頸動脈按摩、Valsalva)用於上心室心搏過速;需心電監測、備妥去顫器並記錄心電圖。
  • Cardioversion is synchronized (to R wave) with lower energy; sedate, consent if elective; turn off oxygen; clear everyone; after: airway first, then vitals, rhythm, chest burns.電擊(同步於R波)使用較低能量;給予鎮靜、擇期需同意書;關閉氧氣;確認無人接觸;術後先確保呼吸道,再評估生命徵象、心律與胸部灼傷。
  • Defibrillation is asynchronous for pulseless VT/VF: 120-200 J biphasic or 360 J monophasic; resume CPR immediately; confirm rhythm after placing pads; do not delay for drugs.去顫為非同步,用於無脈搏VT/VF:雙相120-200 J或單相360 J;立即恢復CPR;貼電擊板後先確認心律;不因給藥而延遲。
  • Pad placement: right of sternum 3rd ICS and left midaxillary 5th ICS; avoid breast tissue, medication patches, implanted devices; AED: stop CPR during analysis, shocks only for pulseless VT/VF.電擊板位置:胸骨右側第3肋間與左腋中線第5肋間;避開乳房組織、藥物貼片與植入裝置;AED:分析時停止CPR,僅對無脈搏VT/VF放電。
  • AICD delivers 25-30 J up to 4 times; client sits or lies down after a shock, keeps a log, avoids strong magnetic fields, contact sports, MRI/diathermy; carry ID card.AICD放電25-30 J、最多4次;被電擊後應坐下或躺下、記錄日誌、避免強磁場、接觸性運動、MRI/透熱療法;隨身攜帶識別卡。
  • Pacemakers: demand (senses, paces if rate too low) vs fixed rate; spike before P = atrial pacing, before QRS = ventricular; capture = spike followed by depolarization.節律器:需求型(感知後才起搏)與固定頻率型;P波前尖峰=心房起搏、QRS前尖峰=心室起搏;有後續去極化即為起搏成功(capture)。
  • Transcutaneous pacing: do not take pulse/BP on left side; lack of capture = check skin contact then raise current. Temporary wires: insulate, ground equipment to prevent microshock.經皮起搏:勿測左側脈搏/血壓;失去capture時先檢查皮膚接觸,再提高電流。暫時性導線:絕緣、設備接地以防微電擊。
  • Permanent pacemaker: limit operative arm movement, report fever/swelling, dizziness, edema; battery 10 years (lithium); use cell phone on opposite side; avoid strong electromagnetic fields.永久性節律器:限制術側手臂活動、通報發燒/腫脹、頭暈、水腫;鋰電池約10年;手機用對側耳朵;避免強電磁場。
PDF p.812, 813, 814, 815

Coronary artery disease and angina冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛

  • CAD = atherosclerosis narrowing coronaries; significant when left main lumen reduced 50% or a major branch 75%.CAD為粥狀硬化使冠狀動脈狹窄;左主幹管徑減少50%或主要分支減少75%即有意義。
  • Ischemia: ST depression/T inversion; infarction: ST elevation, then T inversion and Q wave. Manage risk factors, diet low in calories, sodium, cholesterol and fat.缺血:ST下降/T波倒置;梗塞:ST上升,繼而T波倒置與Q波。控制危險因子,低熱量、低鈉、低膽固醇、低脂飲食。
  • Angina is O2 supply-demand imbalance. Stable: exertion, relieved by rest/NTG. Unstable: unpredictable, >15 min, escalating, may not respond to NTG. Variant (Prinzmetal): coronary spasm at rest, ST elevation.心絞痛為氧供需失衡。穩定型:運動誘發、休息/NTG可緩解。不穩定型:不可預測、>15分鐘、逐漸加重、NTG可能無效。變異型(Prinzmetal):冠狀動脈痙攣、休息時發作、ST上升。
  • Angina pain: substernal, squeezing, radiates to arm/jaw/back, usually <5 min (up to 15-20), relieved by rest or NTG; troponin normal.心絞痛疼痛:胸骨下壓榨感、放射至手臂/下顎/背部,通常<5分鐘(最長15-20分鐘),休息或NTG緩解;troponin正常。
  • Acute angina: stop activity, oxygen, monitor, NTG, semi-Fowler, 12-lead ECG, IV access; at home call EMS if NTG fails (aspirin may be chewed).急性心絞痛:停止活動、給氧、監測、NTG、半坐臥、12導程心電圖、建立靜脈管路;居家NTG無效應叫救護車(可嚼服aspirin)。
  • Medications: nitrates, calcium channel blockers (variant angina; avoid grapefruit juice), beta blockers, statins, antiplatelets.藥物:硝酸鹽、鈣通道阻斷劑(變異型心絞痛;避免葡萄柚汁)、β阻斷劑、statin、抗血小板藥。
PDF p.814, 815, 816, 817

Myocardial infarction心肌梗塞

  • Evolves over hours; blue swollen area by 6 hours, gray with yellow streaks at 48 hours, granulation 8-10 days, scar 2-3 months. LAD = anterior/septal; circumflex = lateral/posterior; RCA = inferior.梗塞數小時內進展;6小時呈藍色腫脹、48小時灰色帶黃紋、8-10天形成肉芽組織、2-3個月形成疤痕。LAD=前壁/中隔;迴旋支=側壁/後壁;RCA=下壁。
  • Pain: crushing substernal, radiates to jaw/back/left arm, lasts 30+ minutes, not relieved by rest or NTG (opioids needed); nausea, diaphoresis, dyspnea, doom; women/older adults may present atypically (fatigue, dyspnea, confusion).疼痛:胸骨下壓榨痛、放射至下顎/背/左臂、持續30分鐘以上、休息或NTG無法緩解(需鴉片類);噁心、冒汗、呼吸困難、瀕死感;女性/老年人可能症狀不典型(疲倦、呼吸困難、意識混亂)。
  • Labs: troponin 3 h-7-10 days; CK-MB peaks 18 h, normal in 48-72 h; myoglobin 2 h; WBC up day 2. ECG: STEMI, T inversion, Q waves persist.檢驗:troponin 3小時起、持續7-10天;CK-MB 18小時達高峰、48-72小時恢復;肌紅素2小時;白血球第2天上升。心電圖:STEMI、T波倒置、Q波持續存在。
  • Acute care: morphine is priority for pain (reduces O2 demand), oxygen, NTG, monitor, semi-Fowler, IV, 12-lead ECG, beta blockers, thrombolytics within 6 hours if no emergent cath/PTCA.急性期:疼痛處置首選morphine(降低耗氧)、給氧、NTG、監測、半坐臥、靜脈管路、12導程心電圖、β阻斷劑,若無緊急心導管/PTCA則6小時內給血栓溶解劑。
  • If SBP <100 or 25 mm Hg below prior, lower HOB and notify provider. Watch for poor output (cool, clammy, weak pulses), HF, dysrhythmias (PVCs, tachycardia in first hours).若收縮壓<100或比先前低25 mm Hg,降低床頭並通知醫師。注意輸出不足(冰冷濕黏、脈搏弱)、心衰竭、心律不整(最初數小時PVC、心搏過速)。
  • Complications: dysrhythmias, HF, pulmonary edema, cardiogenic shock, pericarditis, mitral insufficiency, ventricular rupture, Dressler syndrome.併發症:心律不整、心衰竭、肺水腫、心因性休克、心包炎、二尖瓣閉鎖不全、心室破裂、Dressler症候群。
  • Recovery: progressive activity (dangle, chair 30 min x3, ambulation), ACE inhibitor/ARB, aspirin, clopidogrel, lipid-lowering drugs; cardiac rehabilitation.恢復期:漸進活動(床邊垂腿、下床坐椅30分鐘x3、步行)、ACE抑制劑/ARB、aspirin、clopidogrel、降血脂藥;心臟復健。
PDF p.817, 818

Heart failure and pulmonary edema心衰竭與肺水腫

  • HF = inability to maintain output for metabolic needs. Systolic (HFrEF) = poor ejection; diastolic (HFpEF) = poor filling. Left failure often first; compensation (tachycardia, vasoconstriction, Na/water retention, hypertrophy) eventually harms.心衰竭為心輸出量無法滿足代謝需求。收縮性(HFrEF)=射血差;舒張性(HFpEF)=充填差。多始於左心衰竭;代償機制(心搏過速、血管收縮、鈉水滯留、肥厚)終致傷害。
  • Left HF: pulmonary congestion - dyspnea, crackles, cough, PND, nocturia. Right HF: systemic - dependent edema, JVD, hepatomegaly, abdominal distention, weight gain.左心衰竭:肺部鬱血-呼吸困難、囉音、咳嗽、夜間陣發性呼吸困難、夜尿。右心衰竭:全身性-下垂性水腫、頸靜脈怒張、肝腫大、腹脹、體重增加。
  • Acute pulmonary edema: severe dyspnea, crackles/wheezing, pink frothy sputum, anxiety, cold clammy skin, cyanosis, SpO2 low.急性肺水腫:嚴重呼吸困難、囉音/喘鳴、粉紅泡沫痰、焦慮、皮膚冰冷濕黏、發紺、血氧低。
  • Emergency: high-Fowler, stay with client, get help, oxygen, IV access, furosemide, morphine IV, Foley, prepare for intubation.急救:高坐臥、陪伴個案、呼叫協助、給氧、靜脈管路、furosemide、IV morphine、導尿、準備插管。
  • Home teaching: daily weights, report edema/weight gain, low sodium/fat/cholesterol diet, potassium foods (except with K-sparing diuretics), spread fluids and hard candy for thirst, avoid isometrics, caffeine and OTC drugs, balance rest and activity.居家衛教:每日量體重、通報水腫/體重增加、低鈉低脂低膽固醇飲食、攝取高鉀食物(使用保鉀利尿劑除外)、液體分散攝取並含硬糖止渴、避免等長運動、咖啡因與成藥、活動與休息平衡。
  • Typical medications: digoxin, diuretics, ACE inhibitors, low-dose beta blockers, vasodilators.常用藥物:digoxin、利尿劑、ACE抑制劑、低劑量β阻斷劑、血管擴張劑。
PDF p.818, 819, 820

Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞

  • Pericarditis: sharp pleuritic chest pain worse supine/inspiration, relieved leaning forward, friction rub, fever, ST elevation, AF; give NSAIDs/steroids, oxygen, sit upright leaning forward; watch for tamponade.心包炎:尖銳的胸膜性胸痛、平躺/吸氣時加重、前傾可緩解、心包摩擦音、發燒、ST上升、心房顫動;給NSAIDs/類固醇、氧氣、前傾坐姿;注意心包填塞。
  • Myocarditis: fever, dyspnea, tachycardia, friction rub, gallop, murmur, HF signs; treat with analgesics, antibiotics, digoxin, antidysrhythmics.心肌炎:發燒、呼吸困難、心搏過速、摩擦音、奔馬律、雜音、心衰竭徵象;予止痛劑、抗生素、digoxin、抗心律不整藥。
  • Endocarditis: risk with IV drug use, prosthetic valves, dental/invasive procedures; signs: fever, murmur, petechiae, splinter hemorrhages, Osler nodes (tender), Janeway lesions (nontender), clubbing, embolic events.心內膜炎:風險包括靜脈藥物濫用、人工瓣膜、牙科/侵入性處置;徵象:發燒、雜音、瘀點、甲下線狀出血、Osler結節(有壓痛)、Janeway病灶(無壓痛)、杵狀指、栓塞事件。
  • Endocarditis care: IV antibiotics, blood cultures, watch for splenic (left shoulder pain), renal (flank pain, hematuria), CNS (confusion, aphasia), pulmonary emboli; teach oral hygiene with soft brush, prophylactic antibiotics before dental work, temperature daily for 6 weeks.心內膜炎處置:IV抗生素、血液培養、監測脾栓塞(左肩痛)、腎栓塞(側腹痛、血尿)、中樞栓塞(意識混亂、失語)、肺栓塞;教導軟毛牙刷口腔衛生、牙科前預防性抗生素、6週內每日量體溫。
  • Tamponade: fluid in pericardium restricts filling (20-50 mL rapid can be acute). Signs: pulsus paradoxus, JVD with clear lungs, muffled heart sounds, narrowing pulse pressure, hypotension, rising CVP.心包填塞:心包液體限制心室充填(快速累積20-50 mL即可急性發作)。徵象:奇脈、頸靜脈怒張但肺清晰、心音遙遠、脈壓變窄、低血壓、中心靜脈壓上升。
  • Tamponade care: ICU hemodynamic monitoring, IV fluids, pericardiocentesis; success = clear lungs, normal JVD, lower CVP, higher BP.填塞處置:加護病房血行動力監測、靜脈輸液、心包穿刺;成功指標:肺清晰、頸靜脈正常、CVP下降、血壓上升。
PDF p.820, 821, 822

Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病

  • Stenosis = valve will not open fully; insufficiency/regurgitation = will not close. Aortic stenosis: exertional dyspnea, angina, syncope, harsh systolic murmur; aortic insufficiency: blowing diastolic murmur.狹窄=瓣膜無法完全開啟;閉鎖不全/逆流=無法完全關閉。主動脈狹窄:運動時呼吸困難、心絞痛、昏厥、粗糙收縮期雜音;主動脈閉鎖不全:吹風樣舒張期雜音。
  • Mechanical valve: durable, lifelong anticoagulation; bioprosthetic (pig/cow/human): less durable, often no long-term anticoagulant. Teach oral hygiene, prophylactic antibiotics, MedicAlert; stop anticoagulants about 72 hours before surgery.機械瓣膜:耐久,需終身抗凝;生物瓣膜(豬/牛/人):較不耐用,多不需長期抗凝。教導口腔衛生、預防性抗生素、MedicAlert手環;手術前約72小時停抗凝劑。
  • Cardiomyopathy: dilated (dilated chambers, HF, emboli), hypertrophic (thick septum, sudden death; avoid digoxin/nitrates if obstructed), restrictive (stiff walls, right HF).心肌病變:擴張型(腔室擴大、心衰竭、栓塞)、肥厚型(中隔肥厚、猝死;阻塞型避免digoxin/硝酸鹽)、限制型(心壁僵硬、右心衰竭)。
  • Thrombophlebitis/DVT: calf pain, warmth, swelling; Homans sign unreliable; bed rest, elevate leg, no massage, no knee gatch/pillow under knees, antiembolism stockings, heparin (aPTT) then warfarin (INR); watch for PE (dyspnea, chest pain).血栓性靜脈炎/DVT:小腿疼痛、發熱、腫脹;Homans徵象不可靠;臥床、抬高肢體、不按摩、勿用膝下枕/膝部支架、抗栓襪、heparin(aPTT)後接warfarin(INR);注意肺栓塞(呼吸困難、胸痛)。
  • Superficial phlebitis: warm moist soaks. Venous insufficiency: edema, brown stasis dermatitis, ulcers at lateral malleolus; leg elevation, compression stockings (put on before rising), Unna boot (saline only, no povidone-iodine/peroxide, check for arterial occlusion).表淺靜脈炎:溫濕敷。靜脈功能不全:水腫、棕色鬱積性皮膚炎、外踝潰瘍;抬腿、壓力襪(起床前穿上)、Unna boot(僅用生理食鹽水,不用優碘/雙氧水,注意動脈阻塞)。
  • Varicose veins: aching legs, Trendelenburg test (veins fill from proximal end); stockings, leg elevation, sclerotherapy, laser, stripping.靜脈曲張:腿部酸痛、Trendelenburg測試(靜脈由近端充盈);穿彈性襪、抬腿、硬化療法、雷射、靜脈剝除。
PDF p.822, 823, 824, 825, 826

Arterial disorders, aneurysms, embolectomy, hypertension動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓

  • PAD: intermittent claudication, rest pain relieved by dependency, cool gray-blue skin, hair loss, thick nails, elevational pallor/dependent rubor, absent pulses, ulcers on toes. Keep legs level or slightly dependent (not above heart), walk to claudication then rest, no heat, no smoking/caffeine, no crossing legs.周邊動脈疾病:間歇性跛行、下垂可緩解的休息痛、皮膚冰冷灰藍、掉毛、趾甲增厚、抬高蒼白/下垂潮紅、脈搏消失、趾部潰瘍。腿部保持水平或略下垂(不高於心臟)、走到跛行再休息、不可直接加熱、戒菸與咖啡因、勿翹腳。
  • After arterial bypass: warmth, redness, edema expected (increased flow); sharp pain increase or lost pulse = graft occlusion (call immediately); keep leg straight, avoid hip/knee flexion; watch BP (hypotension and hypertension both harmful).動脈繞道術後:溫熱、發紅、水腫為預期(血流增加);疼痛突然加劇或脈搏消失=移植血管阻塞(立即通報);肢體伸直、避免髖/膝彎曲;注意血壓(過低或過高皆有害)。
  • Raynaud: vasospasm with cold/stress, white-blue-red color change; avoid cold, smoking, injury; vasodilators. Buerger: smokers, claudication, rest pain, ulcers; same care.雷諾氏症:受冷/壓力引發血管痙攣、白-藍-紅變色;避免寒冷、吸菸、受傷;血管擴張劑。Buerger病:吸菸者、跛行、休息痛、潰瘍;照護同上。
  • Aortic aneurysm: fusiform, saccular, dissecting, false. AAA: pulsating abdominal mass, bruit; do NOT palpate deeply. Rupture: severe abdominal/back pain, flank hematoma, hypotension, shock. Thoracic: hoarseness, dysphagia, back pain.主動脈瘤:梭狀、囊狀、剝離、假性。腹主動脈瘤:搏動性腹部腫塊、血管雜音;不可深壓觸診。破裂:劇烈腹/背痛、側腹血腫、低血壓、休克。胸主動脈瘤:聲音沙啞、吞嚥困難、背痛。
  • AAA repair post-op: check pulses distal to graft, HOB max 45 degrees, NG suction, urine output hourly (report <30-50 mL/hr, rising BUN/creatinine = acute kidney injury), no lifting >15-20 lb for 6-12 weeks.腹主動脈瘤術後:檢查移植血管遠端脈搏、床頭最高45度、鼻胃管抽吸、每小時尿量(<30-50 mL/hr、BUN/肌酐上升=急性腎損傷需通報)、6-12週內不提超過15-20磅重物。
  • Embolectomy: baseline pulses, bed cradle, extremity slightly dependent; watch reperfusion compartment swelling (pain on passive movement, tense muscle, numbness).取栓術:基線脈搏、床架、肢體略下垂;注意再灌流造成肌肉腫脹(被動活動疼痛、肌肉緊繃、麻木)。
  • Vena cava filter traps emboli to prevent PE; held anticoagulants pre-op per provider.下腔靜脈濾器可攔截栓子以預防肺栓塞;術前依醫囑停用抗凝劑。
  • BP categories: normal <120/<80; elevated 120-129/<80; stage 1 130-139 or 80-89; stage 2 >=140 or >=90. Higher value classifies.血壓分類:正常<120/<80;偏高120-129/<80;第1期130-139或80-89;第2期>=140或>=90。取較高者分類。
  • Lifestyle: sodium about 2 g/day, weight loss, exercise (no isometrics/heavy lifting), limit alcohol/caffeine, stop smoking; drugs lifelong, never stop for side effects without calling.生活型態:鈉約2 g/天、減重、運動(避免等長/重量訓練)、限制酒精/咖啡因、戒菸;藥物需終身服用,有副作用先聯絡醫療人員,勿自行停藥。
  • Hypertensive crisis: SBP >180 and/or DBP >120 with headache, confusion, blurred vision; IV antihypertensives, BP q5 min, HOB 45 degrees, airway, Foley, I&O, watch for hypotension.高血壓危象:收縮壓>180和/或舒張壓>120伴頭痛、意識混亂、視力模糊;IV降壓藥、每5分鐘量血壓、床頭45度、維持呼吸道、導尿、記錄輸出入、注意低血壓。
PDF p.826, 827, 828, 829, 830, 831, 832, 833

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Cardiac cath: withhold metformin 24 h before and until renal function is confirmed (about 48 h after); check allergy to iodine/seafood; post-procedure check distal pulse and bleeding.心導管:metformin術前24小時停用,待腎功能確認後(約術後48小時)再用;確認碘/海鮮過敏;術後檢查遠端脈搏與出血。 PDF p.804, 805
  2. Cool, pale, pulseless or numb extremity after cath or arterial surgery = possible clot, emergency.心導管或動脈手術後肢體冰冷、蒼白、無脈或麻木=可能血栓,屬急症。 PDF p.805
  3. Symptomatic sinus bradycardia: oxygen, atropine, then transcutaneous pacing; avoid repeated atropine.有症狀的竇性心搏過緩:給氧、atropine,再用經皮節律器;避免重複給atropine。 PDF p.809, 835
  4. VF/pulseless VT: CPR, immediate defibrillation (120-200 J biphasic, 360 J monophasic), unsynchronized, confirm rhythm; fatal in 3-5 minutes.VF/無脈搏VT:CPR、立即去顫(雙相120-200 J、單相360 J)、非同步、確認心律;3-5分鐘內致命。 PDF p.811, 812, 836
  5. Cardioversion is synchronized to the R wave to avoid the T wave; before: anticoagulation 4-6 weeks plus TEE for AF, hold digoxin 48 h; after: airway first.電擊與R波同步以避開T波;術前:心房顫動需抗凝4-6週加TEE、停digoxin 48小時;術後先確保呼吸道。 PDF p.812, 837
  6. Before shocking: turn off oxygen, clear everyone (check 3 times).放電前:關閉氧氣、確認無人接觸(檢查三次)。 PDF p.812
  7. R-on-T PVC, multifocal PVCs, runs of VT, or PVCs with chest pain: notify provider; first check BP and SpO2.R-on-T PVC、多源性PVC、連續VT或PVC合併胸痛:通知醫師;先檢查血壓與血氧。 PDF p.810, 836
  8. Atrial fibrillation: no P waves, fibrillatory waves, anticoagulate for stroke risk; rapid rate drops cardiac output (syncope, dizziness, palpitations).心房顫動:無P波、有顫動波、需抗凝預防中風;速率快使心輸出量下降(昏厥、頭暈、心悸)。 PDF p.809, 836
  9. MI: crushing pain over 30 minutes unrelieved by rest or NTG; morphine is priority analgesic; troponin rises in 3 hours; thrombolytics within 6 hours if no emergent cath.MI:壓榨痛超過30分鐘、休息或NTG無效;morphine為優先止痛;troponin 3小時上升;若無緊急心導管則6小時內給血栓溶解劑。 PDF p.817, 818
  10. Troponin and enzymes are normal in stable angina; elevated in MI.穩定型心絞痛troponin與酵素正常;MI時升高。 PDF p.816, 817
  11. Women and older adults often have atypical MI symptoms (fatigue, dyspnea, confusion, NSTEMI).女性與老年人MI常症狀不典型(疲倦、呼吸困難、意識混亂、NSTEMI)。 PDF p.818
  12. Acute pulmonary edema: high-Fowler, oxygen, furosemide, morphine, Foley; crackles and pink frothy sputum; do not delay for transport.急性肺水腫:高坐臥、給氧、furosemide、morphine、導尿;囉音與粉紅泡沫痰;勿因轉送而延遲處置。 PDF p.819, 820, 835
  13. Left HF signs are pulmonary; right HF signs are systemic (edema, JVD, hepatomegaly).左心衰竭徵象在肺部;右心衰竭徵象在全身(水腫、頸靜脈怒張、肝腫大)。 PDF p.819
  14. Tamponade: JVD with clear lungs, muffled heart sounds, pulsus paradoxus, narrow pulse pressure; pericardiocentesis. Sudden stop of mediastinal drainage after cardiac surgery is a warning.心包填塞:頸靜脈怒張但肺清晰、心音遙遠、奇脈、脈壓變窄;心包穿刺。心臟手術後縱隔引流突然停止為警訊。 PDF p.807, 821
  15. Endocarditis: Osler nodes (tender), Janeway lesions (nontender), splinter hemorrhages; prophylactic antibiotics before dental work for prosthetic valves.心內膜炎:Osler結節(痛)、Janeway病灶(不痛)、甲下線狀出血;人工瓣膜者牙科前預防性抗生素。 PDF p.821, 822, 824
  16. DVT: no massage, no knee gatch or pillow under knees; heparin with aPTT, warfarin with INR; watch for PE.DVT:不按摩、勿用膝部支架或膝下枕;heparin監測aPTT、warfarin監測INR;注意肺栓塞。 PDF p.824
  17. PAD: do not elevate legs above heart; no heat; walk until claudication then rest. Venous insufficiency: elevate legs.周邊動脈疾病:腿不可高於心臟;不可加熱;走到跛行後休息。靜脈功能不全:需抬腿。 PDF p.826, 827
  18. AAA: do not palpate deeply; rupture = severe back/abdominal pain, shock; post-op urine output under 30 mL/hr and rising creatinine = acute kidney injury, call provider.腹主動脈瘤:不可深壓觸診;破裂=劇烈背/腹痛、休克;術後尿量<30 mL/hr與肌酐上升=急性腎損傷,通知醫師。 PDF p.829, 837
  19. Hypertensive crisis: SBP >180 and/or DBP >120; IV antihypertensives; BP every 5 minutes; HOB 45 degrees.高血壓危象:收縮壓>180和/或舒張壓>120;IV降壓藥;每5分鐘量血壓;床頭45度。 PDF p.832, 833

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Coronary territories: LAD = anterior (Left Anterior); RCA = inferior, SA and AV nodes; circumflex = lateral/posterior.冠狀動脈供血區:LAD=前壁;RCA=下壁、竇房結與房室結;迴旋支=側/後壁。 PDF p.800, 817
  • Rate by 6-second strip: count QRS in 6 seconds x 10.6秒條帶法:6秒內QRS數x10。 PDF p.809
  • Angina = relieved by rest/NTG, short, normal troponin; MI = unrelieved, 30+ min, troponin up.心絞痛=休息/NTG緩解、短暫、troponin正常;MI=無法緩解、30分鐘以上、troponin升高。 PDF p.816, 817
  • Left HF = Lungs; Right HF = Rest of the body (edema, JVD, liver).左心衰竭=肺(Lung);右心衰竭=全身其餘(水腫、頸靜脈、肝)。 PDF p.819
  • Osler nodes are Ouch (painful); Janeway lesions are not.Osler結節會痛;Janeway病灶不痛。 PDF p.821
  • Beck triad of tamponade: hypotension, JVD, muffled heart sounds.心包填塞Beck三聯徵:低血壓、頸靜脈怒張、心音遙遠。 PDF p.821

54 Cardiovascular Medications心血管藥物

Organized by drug class: anticoagulants, thrombolytics, antiplatelets, inotropes, digoxin, diuretics, antihypertensives (alpha blockers, central agents, ACE inhibitors/ARBs, beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators), nitrates, antidysrhythmics, adrenergic agonists, and lipid-lowering drugs. For each class know the action, key adverse effects, monitoring parameter, antidote, and teaching.依藥物分類整理:抗凝血劑、血栓溶解劑、抗血小板藥、強心劑、digoxin、利尿劑、降血壓藥(α阻斷劑、中樞作用劑、ACE抑制劑/ARB、β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑、血管擴張劑)、硝酸鹽、抗心律不整藥、腎上腺素促效劑及降血脂藥。每類需掌握作用、主要不良反應、監測指標、解毒劑與衛教。

Anticoagulants抗凝血劑

  • Prevent clot formation/extension; used in MI, unstable angina, AF, DVT, PE, mechanical valves. Contraindicated with active bleeding (except DIC), bleeding disorders, ulcers, severe liver/kidney disease, hemorrhagic brain injury.預防血栓形成與延伸;用於心肌梗塞、不穩定型心絞痛、心房顫動、DVT、肺栓塞、機械瓣膜。活動性出血(DIC除外)、出血性疾病、潰瘍、嚴重肝腎疾病、出血性腦傷為禁忌。
  • Heparin blocks thrombin conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin; does not dissolve existing clots. Normal aPTT 30-40 s; therapeutic 1.5-2.5 x normal; check every 4-6 hours initially. Antidote: protamine sulfate.Heparin阻止凝血酶將纖維蛋白原轉為纖維蛋白;不會溶解已有血栓。aPTT正常30-40秒,治療目標為正常值1.5-2.5倍;起始時每4-6小時監測。解毒劑:protamine sulfate。
  • Subcutaneous heparin: abdomen, 5/8-inch needle, 90 degrees, do not aspirate or rub. Continuous IV via infusion pump. Monitor platelets (thrombocytopenia).皮下注射heparin:腹部、5/8吋針頭、90度角,不回抽、不按揉。持續靜脈滴注須用輸液幫浦。監測血小板(血小板低下)。
  • Enoxaparin (low-molecular-weight heparin): give to recumbent client in abdominal wall, do not expel air bubble or aspirate; anti-Xa therapeutic 0.5-1.2 IU/mL; antidote protamine. Rivaroxaban is oral once daily.Enoxaparin(低分子量肝素):個案平躺、注射於腹壁,不排除預充針筒氣泡、不回抽;抗Xa治療範圍0.5-1.2 IU/mL;解毒劑protamine。Rivaroxaban為口服每日一次。
  • Warfarin antagonizes vitamin K (factors II, VII, IX, X); monitored by PT (normal 11-12.5 s) and INR (normal 0.81-1.2). Goal INR 2-3 standard, 3-4.5 high-dose. Antidote: phytonadione (vitamin K). Heparin bridge until INR therapeutic.Warfarin拮抗維生素K(因子II、VII、IX、X);以PT(正常11-12.5秒)與INR(正常0.81-1.2)監測。標準目標INR 2-3,高強度3-4.5。解毒劑:phytonadione(維生素K)。INR達標前以heparin銜接。
  • Dabigatran: direct thrombin inhibitor for nonvalvular AF, fixed twice-daily dose, no routine blood monitoring.Dabigatran:直接凝血酶抑制劑,用於非瓣膜性心房顫動,固定每日兩次,無需常規抽血監測。
  • Avoid with anticoagulants: NSAIDs, salicylates, ginkgo/ginseng, corticosteroids, macrolides, fluoroquinolones, phenytoin, sulfonamides, cimetidine, allopurinol, oral hypoglycemics; keep vitamin K intake consistent (green leafy vegetables).與抗凝血劑併用應避免:NSAIDs、水楊酸類、銀杏/人蔘、類固醇、巨環類、氟喹諾酮、phenytoin、磺胺類、cimetidine、allopurinol、口服降血糖藥;維生素K攝取量需穩定(深綠色蔬菜)。
PDF p.841, 842

Thrombolytics and antiplatelets血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥

  • Thrombolytics (alteplase, reteplase, tenecteplase) activate plasminogen to plasmin; used early in MI (within 4-6 hours of onset), arterial/venous thrombosis, PE, ischemic stroke, occluded catheters.血栓溶解劑(alteplase、reteplase、tenecteplase)活化纖溶酶原成纖溶酶;用於MI早期(發作4-6小時內)、動靜脈血栓、肺栓塞、缺血性中風、導管阻塞。
  • Contraindications: active bleeding, prior hemorrhagic stroke, intracranial problems/surgery within 2 months, major surgery within 10 days, uncontrolled hypertension, prolonged CPR.禁忌:活動性出血、曾有出血性中風、顱內問題/2個月內顱內或脊椎手術、10天內大手術、血壓失控、近期長時間CPR。
  • Main risk is bleeding; also dysrhythmias and allergy. Monitor aPTT, PT, fibrinogen, Hct, platelets, neuro status; avoid injections/venipuncture; direct pressure 20-30 min; handle gently. Antidote: aminocaproic acid.主要風險為出血,另有心律不整與過敏。監測aPTT、PT、纖維蛋白原、血比容、血小板與神經狀態;避免注射/抽血;穿刺處直接加壓20-30分鐘;輕柔搬動。解毒劑:aminocaproic acid。
  • Antiplatelets (aspirin, clopidogrel, ticagrelor, cilostazol, dipyridamole, abciximab, eptifibatide, tirofiban) inhibit aggregation; used after MI, stents, revascularization, stroke. Adverse: bruising, GI bleeding, tarry stools, hematuria.抗血小板藥(aspirin、clopidogrel、ticagrelor、cilostazol、dipyridamole、abciximab、eptifibatide、tirofiban)抑制血小板聚集;用於MI後、支架、血管重建、中風。不良反應:瘀斑、消化道出血、黑便、血尿。
PDF p.843

Inotropes and digoxin強心劑與digoxin

  • IV inotropes (dobutamine, dopamine, milrinone) for short-term advanced heart failure; use infusion pump and continuous ECG; stop if BP drops or dysrhythmias occur; watch potassium, liver enzymes, platelets.靜脈強心劑(dobutamine、dopamine、milrinone)用於晚期心衰竭短期處置;使用輸液幫浦與持續心電圖;血壓下降或出現心律不整時停止;注意鉀、肝酵素、血小板。
  • Digoxin: positive inotrope, negative chronotrope and dromotrope (slows AV conduction); second-line for HF, used for AF/flutter rate control; contraindicated in ventricular dysrhythmias and 2nd/3rd-degree block.Digoxin:正性肌力、負性變時與負性傳導作用(減慢房室傳導);為心衰竭第二線用藥,用於心房顫動/撲動心室率控制;心室心律不整與二、三度房室傳導阻滯禁用。
  • Therapeutic level 0.5-2.0 ng/mL (0.63-2.56 nmol/L); low end preferred. Toxicity: anorexia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea first, then bradycardia/dysrhythmias and visual changes (blurred, yellow-green vision, halos).治療濃度0.5-2.0 ng/mL(0.63-2.56 nmol/L),偏低端較佳。中毒:先出現食慾不振、噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉,後出現心搏過緩/心律不整與視覺異常(模糊、黃綠視、光暈)。
  • Risk factors: hypokalemia (K below 3.5), hypomagnesemia, hypercalcemia, hypothyroidism, renal disease, older age, K-wasting diuretics, corticosteroids. Antidote: digoxin immune Fab.風險因素:低血鉀(<3.5)、低血鎂、高血鈣、甲狀腺機能低下、腎病、高齡、排鉀利尿劑、類固醇。解毒劑:digoxin immune Fab。
  • Check apical pulse for a full minute; hold and call if below 60/min. Teach pulse taking (report <60 or >100), eat potassium-rich foods, avoid OTC drugs.測心尖脈搏滿一分鐘;低於60次/分應暫停並通知醫師。教導自測脈搏(<60或>100通報)、攝取高鉀食物、避免自行服用成藥。
PDF p.843, 844, 845

Diuretics利尿劑

  • Thiazides (hydrochlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, metolazone): act on distal tubule; for hypertension and edema; need normal renal function. Adverse: hypokalemia, hyponatremia, hypercalcemia, hyperglycemia, hyperuricemia, photosensitivity; sulfa-based.Thiazide類(hydrochlorothiazide、chlorthalidone、metolazone):作用於遠曲小管;用於高血壓與水腫;腎功能須正常。不良反應:低血鉀、低血鈉、高血鈣、高血糖、高尿酸、光敏感;含磺胺結構。
  • Thiazide teaching: take in morning, rise slowly, sunscreen, potassium-rich foods, watch digoxin/lithium toxicity.Thiazide衛教:早晨服用、緩慢起身、防曬、攝取高鉀食物、注意digoxin/lithium毒性。
  • Loop diuretics (furosemide, bumetanide, torsemide): potent, act on loop of Henle; for pulmonary edema, HF, hypertension. Adverse: hypokalemia, hyponatremia, hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, ototoxicity, hyperuricemia. Give IV furosemide slowly over 1-2 minutes.袢利尿劑(furosemide、bumetanide、torsemide):作用強,作用於亨利氏環;用於肺水腫、心衰竭、高血壓。不良反應:低血鉀、低血鈉、低血鈣、低血鎂、耳毒性、高尿酸。IV furosemide須於1-2分鐘緩慢推注。
  • Potassium-sparing diuretics (spironolactone, eplerenone, amiloride, triamterene): primary concern is hyperkalemia (K above 5.0; peaked T waves). Avoid salt substitutes, K supplements; caution with ACE inhibitors.保鉀利尿劑(spironolactone、eplerenone、amiloride、triamterene):主要顧慮為高血鉀(K>5.0;T波高尖)。避免鹽代用品與鉀補充劑;與ACE抑制劑併用需謹慎。
PDF p.845, 846, 847

Alpha blockers, central sympatholytics, ACE inhibitors, ARBsα阻斷劑、中樞交感神經抑制劑、ACE抑制劑與ARB

  • Peripheral alpha blockers (doxazosin, prazosin, terazosin): vasodilation; adverse orthostatic hypotension, reflex tachycardia, fluid retention. Rise slowly, limit salt.周邊α阻斷劑(doxazosin、prazosin、terazosin):血管擴張;不良反應為姿勢性低血壓、反射性心搏過速、水分滯留。緩慢起身、限鹽。
  • Central agents (clonidine, methyldopa, guanfacine): adverse dry mouth, drowsiness, bradycardia, depression, edema; never stop abruptly (rebound hypertension); monitor liver function.中樞作用劑(clonidine、methyldopa、guanfacine):不良反應為口乾、嗜睡、心搏過緩、憂鬱、水腫;不可突然停藥(反彈性高血壓);監測肝功能。
  • ACE inhibitors (-pril) block angiotensin I to II; ARBs (-sartan) block AII receptors. Used for hypertension, HF, post-MI protection.ACE抑制劑(-pril)阻斷血管收縮素I轉換為II;ARB(-sartan)阻斷血管收縮素II受體。用於高血壓、心衰竭、MI後心臟保護。
  • Adverse: persistent dry cough (ACE inhibitors), hyperkalemia, hypotension, taste change; captopril may cause bruising/neutropenia and is taken 20-60 minutes before meals.不良反應:持續乾咳(ACE抑制劑)、高血鉀、低血壓、味覺改變;captopril可能引起瘀斑/嗜中性球低下,須餐前20-60分鐘服用。
  • Avoid potassium supplements and K-sparing diuretics; monitor BUN, creatinine, K+; do not stop abruptly; report cough that persists.避免鉀補充劑與保鉀利尿劑;監測BUN、肌酐、鉀;不可突然停藥;持續咳嗽應通報。
PDF p.847, 848

Nitrates (antianginals)硝酸鹽類(抗心絞痛藥)

  • Vasodilate, lowering preload and afterload and myocardial oxygen demand. Contraindicated with significant hypotension, increased ICP, severe anemia, and erectile dysfunction drugs (PDE5 inhibitors).血管擴張,降低前負荷、後負荷與心肌耗氧。顯著低血壓、顱內壓升高、嚴重貧血及使用勃起功能障礙藥物(PDE5抑制劑)者禁用。
  • Adverse: headache (use acetaminophen), orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, flushing, reflex tachycardia.不良反應:頭痛(可用acetaminophen)、姿勢性低血壓、頭暈、臉潮紅、反射性心搏過速。
  • Sublingual: sit down, dissolve under tongue, do not swallow; at home 1 tablet and call EMS if pain not relieved; in hospital 1 tablet every 5 minutes up to 3 doses, check BP before each, notify provider if pain persists.舌下含片:坐下、含於舌下溶解、不吞服;居家1錠,疼痛未緩解立即叫救護車;住院每5分鐘1錠,最多3錠,每次給藥前測血壓,仍疼痛通知醫師。
  • Store in dark tightly closed bottle; tablets can expire within 6 months of opening; a burning/stinging sensation suggests potency.存放於深色緊閉瓶中;開瓶後約6個月內可能失效;刺痛或灼熱感表示藥效仍在。
  • Patch: hairless site, rotate daily, remove after 12-14 hours for a 10-12 hour nitrate-free period (prevents tolerance); not on chest where defibrillator pads go; wear gloves for ointment/patch. Do not crush sustained-release forms; avoid abrupt withdrawal.貼片:無毛部位、每日輪換,12-14小時後移除,保留10-12小時無藥期(防止耐受);不貼於除顫電擊板位置的胸部;塗抹藥膏/貼片時戴手套。緩釋劑型不可磨碎;避免突然停藥。
PDF p.848, 849

Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilatorsβ阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑

  • Beta blockers (-olol): lower HR, BP, contractility; nonselective (propranolol, carvedilol, labetalol, nadolol) vs cardioselective (metoprolol, atenolol, bisoprolol, esmolol). Contraindicated in asthma, bradycardia, decompensated HF; caution in diabetes (mask hypoglycemia).β阻斷劑(-olol):降低心率、血壓與收縮力;非選擇性(propranolol、carvedilol、labetalol、nadolol)與心臟選擇性(metoprolol、atenolol、bisoprolol、esmolol)。氣喘、心搏過緩、失代償心衰竭禁用;糖尿病慎用(掩蓋低血糖)。
  • Beta blocker care: hold if pulse/BP outside parameters; report wheezing, dizziness; do not stop abruptly (rebound tachycardia, angina); avoid cold/decongestant OTCs.β阻斷劑護理:脈搏/血壓超出參數時暫停給藥;通報喘鳴、頭暈;不可突然停藥(反彈性心搏過速、心絞痛);避免感冒藥/解鼻充血劑。
  • Calcium channel blockers (amlodipine, nifedipine, diltiazem, verapamil): vasodilate and reduce contractility; adverse bradycardia, hypotension, peripheral edema, constipation, headache, flushing. Caution in HF, AV block; do not crush sustained-release.鈣離子通道阻斷劑(amlodipine、nifedipine、diltiazem、verapamil):血管擴張並降低收縮力;不良反應:心搏過緩、低血壓、周邊水腫、便祕、頭痛、臉潮紅。心衰竭、房室傳導阻滯慎用;緩釋劑不可磨碎。
  • Peripheral vasodilators (pentoxifylline, CCBs, alpha blockers) for vasospasm like Raynaud's; response may take up to 3 months; no smoking, avoid alcohol and aspirin unless approved.周邊血管擴張劑(pentoxifylline、鈣通道阻斷劑、α阻斷劑)用於血管痙攣如雷諾氏症;療效可能需3個月;不可吸菸,避免酒精,未經許可不用aspirin。
  • Direct arteriolar vasodilators (hydralazine, nitroprusside, diazoxide, fenoldopam): for severe hypertension/emergencies; hypotension, reflex tachycardia, edema.直接作用小動脈血管擴張劑(hydralazine、nitroprusside、diazoxide、fenoldopam):用於嚴重高血壓/高血壓急症;低血壓、反射性心搏過速、水腫。
  • Nitroprusside: risk of cyanide/thiocyanate toxicity; protect from light with dark bag; discard if red, green or blue. Nesiritide (BNP) for decompensated HF: hypotension; monitor BP, rhythm, urine output, weight.Nitroprusside:有氰化物/硫氰酸鹽中毒風險;以深色袋避光;若呈紅、綠、藍色須丟棄。Nesiritide(BNP)用於失代償心衰竭:低血壓;監測血壓、心律、尿量、體重。
PDF p.849, 850, 851

Antidysrhythmics and adrenergic agonists抗心律不整藥與腎上腺素促效劑

  • Class I sodium channel blockers: IA (procainamide, quinidine, disopyramide), IB (lidocaine, mexiletine, phenytoin), IC (flecainide, propafenone); adverse hypotension, HF, proarrhythmia, GI upset.第I類鈉離子通道阻斷劑:IA(procainamide、quinidine、disopyramide)、IB(lidocaine、mexiletine、phenytoin)、IC(flecainide、propafenone);不良反應:低血壓、心衰竭、致心律不整、胃腸不適。
  • Class II beta blockers; Class III potassium channel blockers (amiodarone, dofetilide, ibutilide, sotalol) prolong QT, risk torsades de pointes; Class IV calcium channel blockers (verapamil, diltiazem). Others: adenosine, digoxin.第II類為β阻斷劑;第III類鉀離子通道阻斷劑(amiodarone、dofetilide、ibutilide、sotalol)延長QT間期,有torsades de pointes風險;第IV類為鈣離子通道阻斷劑(verapamil、diltiazem)。其他:adenosine、digoxin。
  • Amiodarone: pulmonary fibrosis, photosensitivity, blue-gray skin, corneal deposits, hypothyroidism, neuropathy; monitor ECG, lungs, thyroid; use sunscreen.Amiodarone:肺纖維化、光敏感、皮膚藍灰色、角膜沉積、甲狀腺機能低下、神經病變;監測心電圖、肺部、甲狀腺;使用防曬。
  • General care: continuous cardiac monitoring, IV via infusion pump, check lidocaine vial is not the local-anesthetic (epinephrine/preservative) form, give oral antidysrhythmics without food (mexiletine may be with food), rise slowly, limit fluid/salt, fiber for constipation.一般護理:持續心臟監測、IV使用輸液幫浦、確認lidocaine非含epinephrine/防腐劑的局部麻醉劑型、口服抗心律不整藥不與食物併服(mexiletine可隨餐)、緩慢起身、限水限鹽、增加纖維預防便祕。
  • Adrenergic agonists: dobutamine (beta; HF, cardiac output), dopamine (alpha/beta; BP and renal flow), epinephrine (cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, asthma), norepinephrine (vasoconstriction in shock/hypotension). Adverse dysrhythmias, tachycardia, angina; give via large vein; monitor ECG, urine output.腎上腺素促效劑:dobutamine(β;心衰竭、增加心輸出量)、dopamine(α/β;升血壓與腎血流)、epinephrine(心跳停止、過敏性休克、氣喘)、norepinephrine(休克/低血壓時血管收縮)。不良反應:心律不整、心搏過速、心絞痛;經大靜脈給予;監測心電圖與尿量。
PDF p.851, 852

Antilipemic medications降血脂藥

  • Bile sequestrants (cholestyramine, colestipol, colesevelam): bind bile acids; constipation, bloating; mix gritty powder in juice/water, take with plenty of fluid; may raise triglycerides.膽酸結合劑(cholestyramine、colestipol、colesevelam):結合膽酸;便祕、腹脹;粉末需以果汁/水充分混合,並多喝水;可能升高三酸甘油酯。
  • Statins (atorvastatin, simvastatin, lovastatin, rosuvastatin, pravastatin): monitor liver enzymes; report unexplained muscle pain immediately (myopathy/rhabdomyolysis); annual eye exam; avoid with gemfibrozil.Statin類(atorvastatin、simvastatin、lovastatin、rosuvastatin、pravastatin):監測肝酵素;不明原因肌肉痛須立即通報(肌病變/橫紋肌溶解);每年眼科檢查;避免與gemfibrozil併用。
  • Gemfibrozil competes for protein binding with anticoagulants (monitor INR, lower anticoagulant dose); with statins raises myositis/rhabdomyolysis risk.Gemfibrozil與抗凝血劑競爭蛋白結合(監測INR、降低抗凝劑劑量);與statin併用增加肌炎/橫紋肌溶解風險。
  • Nicotinic acid (niacin): flushing, GI upset, elevated liver enzymes, hyperglycemia, hyperuricemia; take with meals; aspirin or NSAID 30 minutes before reduces flushing; do not use OTC niacin without provider.菸鹼酸:臉潮紅、胃腸不適、肝酵素升高、高血糖、高尿酸;隨餐服用;服藥前30分鐘服aspirin或NSAID可減輕潮紅;未經醫師同意不可自行服用成藥菸鹼酸。
  • Lifestyle: restrict fats, cholesterol, carbohydrates, alcohol; exercise; lipid levels take weeks to fall.生活型態:限制脂肪、膽固醇、碳水化合物與酒精;規律運動;血脂需數週才會下降。
PDF p.853, 854

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Bleeding is the primary concern with anticoagulants, thrombolytics, and antiplatelets.抗凝血劑、血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥的首要顧慮為出血。 PDF p.843
  2. Heparin: aPTT 1.5-2.5 x normal (normal 30-40 s, so about 60-80 s); antidote protamine sulfate; monitor platelets.Heparin:aPTT為正常1.5-2.5倍(正常30-40秒,約60-80秒);解毒劑protamine sulfate;監測血小板。 PDF p.841, 856
  3. Warfarin: INR 2-3 standard; antidote phytonadione (vitamin K); avoid aspirin/NSAIDs, alcohol; consistent vitamin K intake.Warfarin:標準INR 2-3;解毒劑phytonadione(維生素K);避免aspirin/NSAID與酒精;維持穩定的維生素K攝取。 PDF p.842, 856
  4. Enoxaparin: anti-Xa 0.5-1.2 IU/mL; do not expel air bubble; protamine reverses.Enoxaparin:抗Xa 0.5-1.2 IU/mL;不排除針筒氣泡;可用protamine逆轉。 PDF p.842
  5. Thrombolytic antidote is aminocaproic acid; check for neurological change, occult blood in all excretions; stridor/urticaria/hypotension means anaphylaxis - stop infusion, call rapid response.血栓溶解劑解毒劑為aminocaproic acid;監測神經變化與所有排泄物潛血;喘鳴/蕁麻疹/低血壓代表過敏性休克,應停止輸注並呼叫快速反應小組。 PDF p.843, 855, 857
  6. Digoxin level 0.5-2.0 ng/mL; hold if apical pulse below 60; toxicity: GI symptoms, bradycardia, yellow-green vision; hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypercalcemia increase risk; antidote digoxin immune Fab.Digoxin濃度0.5-2.0 ng/mL;心尖脈<60暫停;中毒:胃腸症狀、心搏過緩、黃綠視;低鉀、低鎂、高鈣增加風險;解毒劑digoxin immune Fab。 PDF p.844, 845
  7. Always assess the client (pulse, BP) before the monitor or additional tests when dizziness occurs after an IV antidysrhythmic.靜脈抗心律不整藥後出現頭暈,應先評估個案(脈搏、血壓),再處理儀器或其他檢查。 PDF p.854, 856
  8. Potassium-sparing diuretics: hyperkalemia (K above 5.0); avoid salt substitutes. Loop and thiazide diuretics: hypokalemia.保鉀利尿劑:高血鉀(K>5.0);避免鹽代用品。袢利尿劑與thiazide:低血鉀。 PDF p.845, 846
  9. Thiazides are sulfa-based: caution with sulfa allergy; cause hypokalemia, hypercalcemia, hyperglycemia, hyperuricemia.Thiazide含磺胺結構:磺胺過敏者慎用;可致低血鉀、高血鈣、高血糖、高尿酸。 PDF p.845, 857
  10. IV furosemide push slowly over 1-2 minutes to avoid ototoxicity.IV furosemide須1-2分鐘緩慢推注,避免耳毒性。 PDF p.846
  11. ACE inhibitor: persistent dry cough, hyperkalemia; ARBs do not usually cause cough; never combine with K supplements or K-sparing diuretics.ACE抑制劑:持續乾咳、高血鉀;ARB通常不引起咳嗽;不可併用鉀補充劑或保鉀利尿劑。 PDF p.847, 848
  12. Do not abruptly stop clonidine, beta blockers, ACE inhibitors, CCBs: rebound hypertension/tachycardia/angina.不可突然停用clonidine、β阻斷劑、ACE抑制劑、鈣通道阻斷劑:會造成反彈性高血壓/心搏過速/心絞痛。 PDF p.847, 848, 849, 850
  13. Nitroglycerin: in hospital 1 SL tablet q5 min x 3 with BP check; call provider if pain persists; no PDE5 inhibitors; tablets expire; patch-free 10-12 hours daily.Nitroglycerin:住院每5分鐘舌下1錠、共3錠並檢查血壓;疼痛持續通知醫師;不可併用PDE5抑制劑;藥片會過期;每日留10-12小時無貼片期。 PDF p.848, 849
  14. Beta blockers: contraindicated in asthma (wheezing = bronchospasm), mask hypoglycemia signs, hold for low HR/BP.β阻斷劑:氣喘禁用(喘鳴代表支氣管痙攣)、掩蓋低血糖徵象、心率/血壓偏低時暫停給藥。 PDF p.849, 850, 854
  15. Amiodarone and dofetilide prolong QT (torsades de pointes); amiodarone also pulmonary fibrosis, hypothyroidism, photosensitivity.Amiodarone與dofetilide延長QT(torsades de pointes);amiodarone另有肺纖維化、甲狀腺機能低下、光敏感。 PDF p.852
  16. Sodium nitroprusside: cyanide/thiocyanate toxicity, protect from light, discard if red/green/blue.Nitroprusside:氰化物/硫氰酸鹽中毒、需避光、呈紅綠藍色須丟棄。 PDF p.851
  17. Statins/lipid drugs: report unexplained muscle pain immediately; gemfibrozil + statin raises rhabdomyolysis risk; OTC niacin can harm the liver.Statin/降血脂藥:不明原因肌肉痛立即通報;gemfibrozil併用statin增加橫紋肌溶解風險;成藥菸鹼酸可能傷肝。 PDF p.853, 854, 857

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Antidotes: Heparin = Protamine sulfate; Warfarin = phytonadione (vitamin K); Thrombolytics = aminocaproic acid; Digoxin = digoxin immune Fab.解毒劑:Heparin=Protamine;Warfarin=phytonadione(維生素K);血栓溶解劑=aminocaproic acid;Digoxin=digoxin immune Fab。 PDF p.841, 842, 843, 845
  • Digoxin toxicity order: GI first (anorexia, N/V, diarrhea), then heart rate and vision changes; think low K, low Mg, high Ca.Digoxin中毒順序:先胃腸症狀(厭食、噁心嘔吐、腹瀉),再出現心率與視覺變化;記住低鉀、低鎂、高鈣。 PDF p.845
  • -pril = cough (ACE inhibitors); -sartan = no cough (ARBs); -olol = beta blocker (slow heart); -dipine = dihydropyridine CCB causing edema; verapamil (a non-dihydropyridine CCB, so it is not a '-dipine') is more linked to constipation.-pril=咳嗽(ACE抑制劑);-sartan=不咳(ARB);-olol=β阻斷劑(心跳變慢);-dipine=雙氫吡啶類鈣通道阻斷劑,易致水腫;verapamil(屬非雙氫吡啶類鈣通道阻斷劑,藥名並非以-dipine結尾)則較易引起便祕。 PDF p.847, 849, 850
  • Loops lose K, Ca, Mg; thiazides lose K but keep Ca (hypercalcemia); spironolactone spares K (hyperkalemia).袢利尿劑流失鉀、鈣、鎂;thiazide流失鉀但留鈣(高血鈣);spironolactone保鉀(高血鉀)。 PDF p.845, 846

55 Renal and Urinary Problems腎臟與泌尿問題

This chapter reviews kidney anatomy and physiology, renal diagnostic tests, acute kidney injury (AKI), chronic kidney disease (CKD), dialysis, kidney transplantation, and common urinary and genitourinary disorders such as UTI, calculi, BPH and trauma. Priority themes are fluid and electrolyte balance (especially potassium), protecting dialysis access, and recognizing complications early.本章涵蓋腎臟解剖生理、腎功能檢查、急性腎損傷(AKI)、慢性腎臟病(CKD)、透析、腎臟移植，以及泌尿道感染、結石、攝護腺肥大與外傷等常見泌尿生殖疾病。重點在於體液與電解質平衡(尤其是鉀)、保護透析通路，以及及早辨識併發症。

Kidney anatomy and physiology腎臟解剖與生理

  • Nephron (glomerulus + tubules) is the functional unit; the glomerulus filters, the PCT reabsorbs most water/electrolytes, the loop of Henle concentrates urine, the DCT fine-tunes sodium/water.腎元(腎絲球+腎小管)為功能單位；腎絲球過濾，近曲小管再吸收大部分水與電解質，亨利氏環濃縮尿液，遠曲小管調節鈉與水。
  • Kidney functions: acid-base balance, waste excretion, fluid/electrolyte control, drug excretion, renin (BP), erythropoietin (RBC), activation of vitamin D.腎臟功能：酸鹼平衡、排除廢物、體液電解質調控、藥物排泄、分泌腎素(血壓)與紅血球生成素(RBC)、活化維生素D。
  • ADH from the posterior pituitary makes the distal tubule/collecting duct permeable to water; lack of ADH causes diabetes insipidus.ADH由腦下垂體後葉釋放，使遠端小管與集尿管對水通透；缺乏ADH則造成尿崩症。
  • Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone: low BP/flow releases renin, then angiotensin II (vasoconstriction) and aldosterone (retain Na+/water, excrete K+).腎素-血管張力素-醛固酮系統：低血壓或低流量釋放腎素，生成血管張力素II(血管收縮)與醛固酮(保鈉保水、排鉀)。
  • Kidneys control bicarbonate and lungs control carbonic acid; normal pH 7.35-7.45 with a 20:1 bicarbonate:carbonic acid ratio.腎臟調控碳酸氫根，肺調控碳酸；正常pH 7.35-7.45，碳酸氫根與碳酸比為20:1。
  • Bladder capacity about 1 L; normal adult urine output about 1500 mL/day. The prostate surrounds the urethra.膀胱容量約1公升；成人正常尿量約1500 mL/天。攝護腺環繞尿道。
PDF p.862, 863

Diagnostic tests診斷檢查

  • Serum creatinine 0.6-1.2 mg/dL (M), 0.5-1.1 (F) reflects GFR; it rises only after about 50% of function is lost. BUN 10-20 mg/dL can rise with dehydration, high protein, GI bleeding, steroids.血清肌酸酐0.6-1.2 mg/dL(男)、0.5-1.1(女)反映GFR，約喪失50%功能後才上升。BUN 10-20 mg/dL，脫水、高蛋白、消化道出血、類固醇亦可升高。
  • BUN/creatinine ratio: decreased with fluid volume deficit, obstructive uropathy, catabolic state and high-protein diet; increased with fluid volume excess (per book).BUN/肌酸酐比值：體液不足、阻塞性泌尿道疾病、分解代謝狀態及高蛋白飲食時下降；體液過多時上升（依本書）。
  • Urinalysis: specific gravity 1.003-1.030, pH 4-8; glucose, ketones, protein, blood, casts normally negative. Use first morning void, 10-15 mL.尿液分析：比重1.003-1.030、pH 4-8；糖、酮體、蛋白、血、圓柱體正常為陰性。留取晨間第一次尿10-15 mL。
  • 24-hour urine: discard the first void at start, collect all urine for 24 h, include the final void, keep on ice/refrigerated.24小時尿液：起始時排尿並丟棄，之後收集全部尿液，結束時最後一次排尿也加入，檢體需冰存。
  • Creatinine clearance best estimates GFR (about 125 mL/min young adult; falls about 10% per decade). Urine culture: clean-catch midstream sample.肌酸酐清除率最能估算GFR(年輕成人約125 mL/分，每十年約降10%)。尿液培養：中段尿清潔收集。
  • IV urography/contrast: check iodine/shellfish allergy and pregnancy, encourage fluids, watch urine output because dye is nephrotoxic.靜脈腎盂攝影/顯影劑：確認碘/海鮮過敏與懷孕，鼓勵飲水並監測尿量，顯影劑具腎毒性。
  • Cystoscopy with biopsy: expect pink-tinged urine and burning; report bright red urine, clots, fever. Renal biopsy: prone positioning, check coagulation, bed rest supine 2-6 h, watch for hypotension/tachycardia, hematuria.膀胱鏡切片：術後可有粉紅尿與灼熱感；出現鮮紅尿、血塊、發燒需通報。腎臟切片：俯臥、檢查凝血、術後仰臥臥床2-6小時，監測低血壓/心搏過速與血尿。
PDF p.863, 864, 865, 866, 867

Acute kidney injury (AKI)急性腎損傷

  • AKI is abrupt, potentially reversible loss of kidney function. Causes: prerenal (hypoperfusion), intrarenal (ATN, nephrotoxins), postrenal (obstruction).AKI為突發且可能可逆的腎功能喪失。病因：腎前性(灌流不足)、腎內性(急性腎小管壞死、腎毒物)、腎後性(阻塞)。
  • Phases: onset, oliguric (<400 mL/day, 8-15 days), diuretic (4-5 L/day), recovery (may take 1-2 years).分期：起始期、少尿期(<400 mL/天，8-15天)、利尿期(4-5 L/天)、恢復期(可達1-2年)。
  • Oliguric phase: fluid overload, hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypocalcemia, metabolic acidosis (Kussmaul), uremia, pericarditis; restrict fluids to measured output plus about 400-1000 mL.少尿期：體液過多、高血鉀、高血磷、低血鈣、代謝性酸中毒(庫斯毛氏呼吸)、尿毒症、心包炎；液體限制為前日尿量加約400-1000 mL。
  • Diuretic phase: risk of hypovolemia, hypotension, hypokalemia, hyponatremia; replace fluids/electrolytes.利尿期：易低血容量、低血壓、低血鉀、低血鈉；需補充液體與電解質。
  • Monitor hourly I&O, daily weight (gain 0.25-0.5 kg/day = retention), labs, lung sounds; low-moderate protein, high carbohydrate diet; avoid nephrotoxins (aminoglycosides, NSAIDs, contrast).監測每小時輸出入量、每日體重(增加0.25-0.5公斤/天代表水分滯留)、檢驗值、肺音；低至中蛋白高醣飲食；避免腎毒性藥物(胺基糖苷類、NSAIDs、顯影劑)。
  • Dialysis or CRRT may be needed for fluid overload, azotemia, or severe acidosis.體液過量、氮血症或嚴重酸中毒時可能需透析或連續性腎臟替代療法(CRRT)。
PDF p.867, 868, 869

Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群

  • CKD: progressive irreversible loss, GFR <=60 mL/min for 3 months or more. Stages: >90 at risk, 60-89 mild, 30-59 moderate, 15-29 severe, <15 ESRD.CKD：漸進不可逆，GFR≦60 mL/分且持續3個月以上。分期：>90高風險、60-89輕度、30-59中度、15-29重度、<15末期(ESRD)。
  • Main causes: diabetes, hypertension, chronic obstruction, recurrent infection, autoimmune disease, following AKI.主要原因：糖尿病、高血壓、慢性阻塞、反覆感染、自體免疫疾病、AKI後續。
  • Anemia (low erythropoietin): give epoetin/darbepoetin, folic acid, iron; transfuse only when necessary.貧血(紅血球生成素不足)：給予epoetin/darbepoetin、葉酸、鐵劑；僅在必要時輸血。
  • Hyperkalemia: telemetry; low-K diet; sodium polystyrene sulfonate; IV calcium gluconate (protect heart), regular insulin + 50% dextrose, sodium bicarbonate; avoid spironolactone/triamterene.高血鉀：連續心電圖監測；低鉀飲食；聚苯乙烯磺酸鈉；靜脈葡萄糖酸鈣(保護心肌)、常規胰島素+50%葡萄糖、碳酸氫鈉；避免spironolactone/triamterene。
  • Hyperphosphatemia/hypocalcemia: phosphate binders with meals, activated vitamin D, calcium; hypermagnesemia: avoid Mg antacids/laxatives.高血磷/低血鈣：隨餐服用磷結合劑、活化維生素D、鈣；高血鎂：避免含鎂制酸劑與瀉劑。
  • Other problems: hypertension, hypervolemia (restrict Na/fluid), GI bleeding, pruritus (uremic frost late), neuropathy, bone disease/fractures, infection risk, psychosocial stress.其他問題：高血壓、體液過多(限鈉限水)、消化道出血、搔癢(尿霜為晚期)、神經病變、骨病與骨折、感染風險、心理社會壓力。
  • Uremic syndrome: nitrogenous waste buildup; limit protein (high quality), sodium, potassium, phosphate; monitor for altered LOC, stomatitis, N/V.尿毒症候群：含氮廢物蓄積；限制蛋白質(高品質)、鈉、鉀、磷；監測意識改變、口腔炎、噁心嘔吐。
PDF p.869, 870, 871, 872, 873

Hemodialysis and vascular access血液透析與血管通路

  • Hemodialysis uses diffusion, osmosis and ultrafiltration across a semipermeable membrane; removes urea, creatinine, excess fluid and corrects electrolytes.血液透析利用擴散、滲透與超過濾，透過半透膜清除尿素、肌酸酐、多餘水分並矯正電解質。
  • Before dialysis: weigh, check vitals/labs; hold antihypertensives and dialyzable drugs (water-soluble vitamins, some antibiotics, digoxin) until after treatment. After: watch for hypotension, bleeding (heparin), hypovolemia.透析前：量體重、生命徵象與檢驗值；降血壓藥及可被透析的藥物(水溶性維生素、部分抗生素、digoxin)延至透析後給予。透析後：留意低血壓、出血(肝素)與低血容量。
  • AV fistula is the access of choice (matures 4-6 weeks); AV graft usable after about 2 weeks; temporary subclavian/femoral catheters; external shunt usable immediately.動靜脈瘻管為首選通路(成熟需4-6週)；人工血管約2週後可用；暫時性鎖骨下/股靜脈導管；外部分流管可立即使用。
  • Access arm: no BP, venipuncture, IV or injections; check thrill and bruit; teach hand exercises (fistula).通路手臂：不量血壓、不抽血、不打點滴或注射；檢查震顫與血管雜音；教導手部運動(瘻管)。
  • Femoral catheter: client should not sit up more than 45 degrees. Arterial steal syndrome: hand ischemia distal to the access, with pain, pallor and a diminished pulse (coolness of the tubing/extremity instead points to access clotting, not steal syndrome).股靜脈導管：病人坐起不超過45度。動脈竊血症候群：通路遠端手部缺血，表現為疼痛、蒼白與脈搏減弱(管路或肢體發冷則多提示通路栓塞，而非竊血症候群)。
  • Complications: air embolus, disequilibrium syndrome, hypotension, hemorrhage, sepsis, hepatitis, electrolyte shifts.併發症：空氣栓塞、失衡症候群、低血壓、出血、敗血症、肝炎、電解質變化。
PDF p.873, 874, 875, 876

Peritoneal dialysis腹膜透析

  • The peritoneum is the membrane; Tenckhoff catheter placed 3-5 cm below the umbilicus; one exchange = fill (10-20 min, 1-2 L), dwell, drain.以腹膜為透析膜；Tenckhoff導管置於臍下3-5 cm；一次交換=灌入(10-20分鐘、1-2 L)、留置、引流。
  • Contraindications: peritonitis, recent abdominal surgery, adhesions, other GI problems such as diverticulosis.禁忌：腹膜炎、近期腹部手術、腹腔沾黏、憩室症等腸胃問題。
  • Higher dextrose concentration pulls more fluid; do not extend dwell beyond order (hyperglycemia). Warm the dialysate to reduce cramping.葡萄糖濃度越高脫水越多；留置時間不可超過醫囑(高血糖風險)。將透析液加溫以減少腹部絞痛。
  • Outflow less than inflow: retained fluid counts as intake. Cloudy outflow = peritonitis; bloody (after first exchanges) = vascular complication; brown = bowel perforation; urine-colored = bladder perforation.引流量少於灌入量：滯留量算為攝入。混濁=腹膜炎；(初期後)血性=血管併發症；棕色=腸穿孔；尿色=膀胱穿孔。
  • Poor outflow: usually constipation, then catheter migration, kinks, fibrin; reposition, check tubing, keep bag below abdomen.引流不良：最常因便秘，其次導管移位、管路扭折、纖維蛋白塊；調整姿勢、檢查管路、引流袋置於腹部下方。
  • Types: CAPD (manual, 4 exchanges/day), automated (CCPD, IPD, NPD) with a cycler. Peritonitis prevention: strict sterile technique, keep dressing dry.種類：連續性可攜式(CAPD，手動、每日4次)、自動化(CCPD、IPD、NPD)使用循環機。預防腹膜炎：嚴守無菌技術、敷料保持乾燥。
PDF p.876, 877, 878, 879

Kidney transplantation腎臟移植

  • Living related donor is the most desirable; recipient takes immunosuppressants for life. Dialysis completed within 24 h before surgery; strict asepsis.活體親屬捐贈最理想；受贈者需終生服用免疫抑制劑。手術前24小時內完成透析；嚴格無菌。
  • Kidney placed in the iliac fossa; own kidneys usually left in place. Monitor hourly urine output; abrupt drop must be reported; IV replacement based on urine output for 12-24 h.新腎置於髂窩；原腎通常保留。每小時監測尿量，突然減少須通報；前12-24小時依尿量補充輸液。
  • Urinary catheter 3-5 days; initial urine may be pink/bloody; report gross hematuria with clots.導尿管留置3-5天；初期尿可呈粉紅或血尿；肉眼血尿合併血塊須通報。
  • Rejection signs: fever >100 F (37.8 C), pain/tenderness over graft, weight gain 2-3 lb (0.9-1.4 kg) in 24 h, edema, hypertension, rising BUN/creatinine.排斥徵象：體溫>100°F(37.8°C)、移植腎處疼痛壓痛、24小時增重2-3磅(0.9-1.4公斤)、水腫、高血壓、BUN/肌酸酐上升。
  • Hyperacute rejection within 48 h (remove kidney); acute within first week or later (increase immunosuppression); chronic over months-years.超急性排斥於48小時內(切除移植腎)；急性排斥多於一週內或其後(加強免疫抑制)；慢性排斥於數月至數年。
  • Teach: never miss immunosuppressants, avoid infection exposure and contact sports, avoid prolonged sitting.衛教：不可漏服免疫抑制劑、避免接觸感染源與接觸性運動、避免久坐。
PDF p.879, 880, 881

Urinary tract infections and inflammation泌尿道感染與發炎

  • Cystitis: E. coli most common; frequency, urgency, dysuria, cloudy foul urine, hematuria. In older adults altered mentation may be the only sign.膀胱炎：最常見為大腸桿菌；頻尿、急尿、解尿灼痛、混濁惡臭尿、血尿。老年人可能僅表現意識混亂。
  • Collect culture before antibiotics; fluids up to 3000 mL/day; complete full antibiotic course; keep urine acidic; avoid caffeine/alcohol.使用抗生素前先送尿培養；每日飲水可達3000 mL；完成整個療程；維持酸性尿；避免咖啡因與酒精。
  • Prevention: wipe front to back, void every 2-3 h, void after intercourse, avoid bubble baths, cotton underwear.預防：由前往後擦拭、每2-3小時排尿、性行為後排尿、避免泡泡浴、穿棉質內褲。
  • Urethritis: commonly STI (gonorrhea, chlamydia); treat partners, abstinence until treated; chlamydia can cause sterility.尿道炎：常與性傳染病(淋病、披衣菌)相關；伴侶需治療，治療完成前禁止性行為；披衣菌可致不孕。
  • Acute pyelonephritis: fever, chills, flank pain, CVA tenderness, pyuria; fluids to 3000 mL/day, antibiotics, warm compresses. Chronic: scarring, can lead to CKD.急性腎盂腎炎：發燒寒顫、腰痛、肋脊角叩痛、膿尿；每日飲水達3000 mL、抗生素、溫敷。慢性者造成腎臟疤痕，可進展為CKD。
PDF p.881, 882, 883

Polycystic kidney, hydronephrosis, calculi, tumors多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤

  • Adult polycystic kidney disease: autosomal dominant, symptoms at 30-40 y; flank pain, hematuria, hypertension, recurrent UTI; avoid NSAIDs/aspirin; genetic counseling.成人多囊腎：體染色體顯性，30-40歲發病；腰痛、血尿、高血壓、反覆泌尿道感染；避免NSAIDs/阿斯匹靈；遺傳諮詢。
  • Hydronephrosis: obstruction with distended renal pelvis; after relief watch for diuresis and dehydration.水腎：阻塞造成腎盂擴張；阻塞解除後留意利尿與脫水。
  • Renal calculi: severe colicky flank pain radiating to groin, hematuria, N/V; strain all urine, send stones for analysis, fluids up to 3000 mL/day, scheduled analgesics, ambulation.腎結石：劇烈絞痛由腰部放射至鼠蹊、血尿、噁心嘔吐；過濾所有尿液並送結石分析、每日飲水至3000 mL、定時給予止痛、鼓勵走動。
  • Diet by stone type: limit purines, calcium or oxalate as indicated.依結石種類調整飲食：限制普林、鈣或草酸。
  • Treatment: ESWL (watch for obstruction, bleeding, hematoma), percutaneous lithotripsy, ureterolithotomy, nephrectomy. Do not irrigate nephrostomy tube unless prescribed.治療：體外震波碎石(留意阻塞、出血、血腫)、經皮碎石、輸尿管切開取石、腎切除。除非醫囑否則不沖洗腎造口管。
  • Renal tumor: painless gross hematuria, flank pain, mass; radical nephrectomy care: monitor bleeding, adrenal insufficiency, urine 30-50 mL/h.腎腫瘤：無痛性肉眼血尿、腰痛、腫塊；根治性腎切除術後：監測出血、腎上腺功能不足、尿量30-50 mL/小時。
PDF p.883, 884, 885, 886

Epididymitis, prostatitis, BPH and bladder trauma副睪炎、攝護腺炎、BPH與膀胱外傷

  • Epididymitis: scrotal pain/swelling, fever; bed rest with scrotal elevation, cold compresses, antibiotics (partner if STI).副睪炎：陰囊疼痛腫脹、發燒；臥床並抬高陰囊、冷敷、抗生素(性傳染病時伴侶亦需治療)。
  • Bacterial prostatitis: acutely ill, fever, perineal/low back pain, tender warm prostate; antibiotics, sitz baths, stool softeners; avoid spicy food, caffeine, alcohol.細菌性攝護腺炎：急性病容、發燒、會陰與下背痛、攝護腺壓痛發熱；抗生素、坐浴、軟便劑；避免辛辣、咖啡因、酒精。
  • BPH: weak stream (early), hesitancy, nocturia, retention, overflow dribbling; avoid anticholinergics, antihistamines, decongestants; fluids 2000-3000 mL/day.BPH：尿流細弱(早期)、遲疑、夜尿、尿滯留、溢流性滴尿；避免抗膽鹼藥、抗組織胺、解充血劑；每日飲水2000-3000 mL。
  • Bladder trauma (often pelvic fracture): hematuria, suprapubic pain, anuria; if blood at meatus, do NOT catheterize until retrograde urethrogram/ureterogram.膀胱外傷(常因骨盆骨折)：血尿、恥骨上疼痛、無尿；若尿道口有血，在逆行尿道/輸尿管攝影前勿導尿。
PDF p.886, 887, 888

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Serum creatinine rises only after about 50% of kidney function is lost; creatinine clearance is the best GFR estimate (normal ~125 mL/min, ~65 at age 65).血清肌酸酐需喪失約50%腎功能才上升；肌酸酐清除率最能估算GFR(正常約125 mL/分，65歲約65)。 PDF p.864, 865
  2. AKI oliguric phase: urine <400 mL/day, hyperkalemia, fluid overload, acidosis; diuretic phase: urine 4-5 L/day, risk of dehydration and hypokalemia.AKI少尿期：尿量<400 mL/天、高血鉀、體液過多、酸中毒；利尿期：尿量4-5 L/天，注意脫水與低血鉀。 PDF p.867, 868
  3. Hyperkalemia in kidney disease: place on telemetry; calcium gluconate protects the heart, insulin + dextrose shifts K+ into cells, sodium polystyrene sulfonate and dialysis remove it.腎病高血鉀：給予心電圖監測；葡萄糖酸鈣保護心臟、胰島素+葡萄糖使鉀進入細胞、聚苯乙烯磺酸鈉與透析排除鉀。 PDF p.870, 871
  4. Daily weight gain of 0.5-1 lb/day (0.25-0.5 kg) indicates fluid retention; weigh same scale, same clothes, same time.每日增重0.5-1磅(0.25-0.5公斤)代表水分滯留；固定體重計、衣著與時間。 PDF p.868
  5. Contrast dye and aminoglycosides/NSAIDs are nephrotoxic; hydrate and monitor urine output and creatinine.顯影劑、胺基糖苷類與NSAIDs具腎毒性；需補充水分並監測尿量與肌酸酐。 PDF p.866, 867
  6. Never take BP, draw blood, start IVs or give injections in the arm with a fistula/graft; check for thrill and bruit; absent thrill/bruit = notify PHCP immediately.有瘻管/人工血管的手臂不可量血壓、抽血、打點滴或注射；檢查震顫與雜音；無震顫/雜音需立即通報。 PDF p.875, 876
  7. Air embolism during hemodialysis: stop dialysis (do not reinfuse), turn client left side with head down, give oxygen, call PHCP/rapid response.血液透析中空氣栓塞：停止透析(不回輸血液)、左側臥頭低足高、給氧、通知醫師與快速反應小組。 PDF p.876
  8. Hold antihypertensives and dialyzable drugs (digoxin, water-soluble vitamins, some antibiotics) until after hemodialysis.降血壓藥與可被透析的藥物(digoxin、水溶性維生素、部分抗生素)延至血液透析後給予。 PDF p.873
  9. Peritoneal dialysis outflow: cloudy = peritonitis (early sign); brown = bowel perforation; urine-colored = bladder perforation; constipation is the main cause of poor outflow.腹膜透析引流液：混濁=腹膜炎(早期徵象)；棕色=腸穿孔；尿色=膀胱穿孔；便秘是引流不良主因。 PDF p.878, 879
  10. Kidney transplant: report abrupt fall in urine output, fever, graft tenderness, 2-3 lb gain in 24 h (rejection); immunosuppressants for life.腎移植：尿量突然減少、發燒、移植腎壓痛、24小時增重2-3磅(排斥)須通報；終生服用免疫抑制劑。 PDF p.880, 881
  11. Strain all urine in renal calculi; fluids up to 3000 mL/day; severe sudden flank pain radiating to groin = renal colic.腎結石須過濾所有尿液；每日飲水至3000 mL；突發劇烈腰痛放射至鼠蹊為腎絞痛。 PDF p.884, 885
  12. Altered mental status may be the only sign of UTI in older adults; obtain culture before antibiotics.老年人泌尿道感染可能僅表現意識改變；使用抗生素前先採尿培養。 PDF p.881
  13. Blood at the urethral meatus after trauma: do not insert a urinary catheter until urethral injury is ruled out.外傷後尿道口見血：排除尿道損傷前不可導尿。 PDF p.888
  14. After renal biopsy: supine bed rest 2-6 h, watch for hypotension, tachycardia, falling Hgb/Hct, hematuria; avoid heavy lifting 1-2 weeks.腎臟切片後：仰臥臥床2-6小時，監測低血壓、心搏過速、Hgb/Hct下降與血尿；1-2週避免提重物。 PDF p.867
  15. Avoid anticholinergics, antihistamines and decongestants in BPH because they cause urinary retention.BPH避免使用抗膽鹼藥、抗組織胺與解充血劑，因可造成尿滯留。 PDF p.887

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Kidney stones: Strain urine, push Fluids, scheduled Analgesics, Ambulate.腎結石口訣：過濾尿液、補充水分、定時止痛、鼓勵走動。 PDF p.884, 885
  • AKI phases: O-O-D-R = Onset, Oliguric (K+ high), Diuretic (K+ low, dehydration), Recovery.AKI分期口訣O-O-D-R：起始、少尿(鉀高)、利尿(鉀低、脫水)、恢復。 PDF p.867, 868

56 Renal and Urinary Medications腎臟與泌尿用藥

Drug classes used for urinary infections, bladder dysfunction, transplant rejection prevention, anemia of kidney disease and benign prostatic hyperplasia. For each class know the action, key adverse effects, monitoring or antidote, and teaching points.涵蓋泌尿道感染、膀胱功能異常、預防移植排斥、腎病貧血與良性攝護腺增生的藥物類別。每類需熟記作用機轉、主要不良反應、監測或解毒劑與衛教重點。

Urinary tract antiseptics (fosfomycin, methenamine, nitrofurantoin)泌尿道抗菌劑(fosfomycin、methenamine、nitrofurantoin)

  • Action: inhibit bacterial growth in urine only; no useful blood or tissue levels, so not for infections outside the urinary tract.作用：僅在尿液中抑制細菌生長；血液與組織濃度不足，不適用泌尿道以外感染。
  • Fosfomycin (福斯黴素): granules dissolved in about 120 mL cold water, drink all; drugs that speed GI motility lower absorption.Fosfomycin(福斯黴素)：顆粒溶於約120 mL冷水並全部喝完；促腸蠕動藥物會降低吸收。
  • Methenamine (烏洛托品): for chronic UTI prophylaxis; needs acidic urine (pH 5.5 or lower); avoid alkalinizing antacids and sulfonamides (crystalluria); avoid in renal impairment and liver dysfunction (ammonia); high fluid intake dilutes effect.Methenamine(烏洛托品)：用於慢性泌尿道感染預防；需酸性尿(pH≦5.5)；避免鹼化制酸劑與磺胺類(結晶尿)；腎功能不全與肝功能異常者禁用(產生氨)；大量飲水會稀釋療效。
  • Nitrofurantoin (呋喃妥因): take with food/milk; may turn urine harmless brown; adverse effects include pulmonary reaction (dyspnea, cough, fever, chills; stop drug), peripheral neuropathy, blood dyscrasias (agranulocytosis, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, megaloblastic anemia), hypersensitivity; contraindicated in renal impairment; avoid antacids.Nitrofurantoin(呋喃妥因)：隨餐或牛奶服用；尿液可變棕色(無害)；不良反應包括肺部反應(呼吸困難、咳嗽、發燒、寒顫，需停藥)、週邊神經病變、血球異常(顆粒球低下、白血球低下、血小板低下、巨母紅血球性貧血)、過敏；腎功能不全禁用；避免制酸劑。
PDF p.896

Fluoroquinolones氟喹諾酮類

  • Action: inhibit bacterial DNA synthesis enzymes; broad spectrum. Examples: ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin, ofloxacin.作用：抑制細菌DNA合成酵素；廣效。例如ciprofloxacin、levofloxacin、ofloxacin。
  • Adverse effects: tendinitis/tendon rupture (Achilles; higher risk age >60, corticosteroids, transplant), CNS effects (dizziness, confusion, hallucinations, depression), photosensitivity, GI upset, crystalluria.不良反應：肌腱炎/肌腱斷裂(以阿基里斯腱最常見；>60歲、使用類固醇、移植者風險高)、中樞神經症狀(頭暈、混亂、幻覺、憂鬱)、光敏感、腸胃不適、結晶尿。
  • Teaching: full glass of water, urine output at least 1200-1500 mL/day, sun protection, report CNS or tendon pain; infuse IV slowly over 60 min.衛教：以一整杯水服用、每日尿量至少1200-1500 mL、防曬、出現中樞症狀或肌腱疼痛需通報；靜脈輸注需60分鐘緩慢給予。
  • Use cautiously in hepatic, renal or CNS disorders.肝、腎或中樞神經疾病者小心使用。
PDF p.897

Sulfonamides (trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole)磺胺類(trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole)

  • Action: block folic acid synthesis; TMP-SMX blocks two sequential steps so is more effective than either alone. Used mainly for acute UTI.作用：阻斷葉酸合成；TMP-SMX阻斷兩個連續步驟，療效優於單用。主要用於急性泌尿道感染。
  • Adverse effects: rash (withhold and report), Stevens-Johnson syndrome, photosensitivity, hemolytic anemia, agranulocytosis, thrombocytopenia (report sore throat or fever).不良反應：皮疹(需停藥並通報)、史蒂文斯-強生症候群、光敏感、溶血性貧血、顆粒球低下、血小板低下(出現喉嚨痛或發燒需通報)。
  • Contraindicated with sulfa/sulfonylurea/thiazide/loop diuretic hypersensitivity, infants <2 months, pregnancy and lactation.對磺胺、磺醯脲、噻嗪或袢利尿劑過敏、2個月以下嬰兒、孕婦及哺乳者禁用。
  • Potentiates warfarin, phenytoin and oral hypoglycemics. Teach: empty stomach, 8-10 glasses of water, urine output at least 1200 mL/day, finish course, sunscreen.增強warfarin、phenytoin及口服降血糖藥效果。衛教：空腹服用、每日飲水8-10杯、尿量至少1200 mL、完成療程、防曬。
PDF p.897, 898

Urinary analgesics, anticholinergics/antispasmodics, cholinergics泌尿道止痛劑、抗膽鹼/解痙劑與膽鹼劑

  • Phenazopyridine (苯偶氮吡啶): relieves urinary pain only, given with an antibiotic; turns urine, tears and contact lenses red-orange; contraindicated in renal/hepatic disease; interferes with urine glucose/ketone tests.Phenazopyridine(苯偶氮吡啶)：僅緩解泌尿道疼痛，需併用抗生素；使尿液、淚液及隱形眼鏡呈紅橙色；腎或肝疾病禁用；干擾尿糖與尿酮檢驗。
