  • Anticholinergics for overactive bladder (oxybutynin 奧昔布寧, tolterodine, solifenacin, darifenacin, trospium, fesoterodine): dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, urinary retention, tachycardia, confusion in elderly.膀胱過動症抗膽鹼藥(oxybutynin、tolterodine、solifenacin、darifenacin、trospium、fesoterodine)：口乾、便秘、視力模糊、尿滯留、心搏過速、老年人混亂。
  • Contraindicated in glaucoma (angle-closure; book also warns open-angle), GI/GU obstruction, severe colitis, myasthenia gravis. Do not crush extended-release forms; sugarless gum/candy for dry mouth.青光眼、胃腸/泌尿道阻塞、嚴重結腸炎、重症肌無力者禁用(本書亦提醒開角型青光眼)。長效劑型不可磨碎或咀嚼；口乾可用無糖口香糖/糖果。
  • Bethanechol (貝胆鹼): cholinergic that increases bladder tone for nonobstructive retention/neurogenic bladder; give on empty stomach; never IM or IV.Bethanechol(貝胆鹼)：膽鹼劑，增加膀胱張力，用於非阻塞性尿滯留/神經性膀胱；空腹服用；不可肌肉或靜脈注射。
  • Bethanechol adverse effects: hypotension, bradycardia, bronchoconstriction, flushing, salivation, cramps. Antidote for cholinergic overdose: atropine sulfate. Contraindicated with urinary obstruction/stricture.Bethanechol不良反應：低血壓、心搏過緩、支氣管收縮、潮紅、流涎、腹絞痛。膽鹼過量解毒劑：atropine sulfate。尿道阻塞/狹窄者禁用。
PDF p.898, 899

Immunosuppressants: calcineurin inhibitors and mTOR inhibitors免疫抑制劑：鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑與mTOR抑制劑

  • Cyclosporine (環孢素): calcineurin inhibitor blocking IL-2 production; nephrotoxicity, hypertension, tremor, hirsutism, gingival changes, infection, lymphoma, hyperkalemia, hyperglycemia. Monitor blood levels, BUN, creatinine, K+, glucose, LFTs.Cyclosporine(環孢素)：鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑，阻斷IL-2；腎毒性、高血壓、顫抖、多毛、感染、淋巴瘤、高血鉀、高血糖。監測血中濃度、BUN、肌酸酐、鉀、血糖、肝功能。
  • Cyclosporine interactions: grapefruit juice, ketoconazole, erythromycin, amphotericin B raise levels; phenytoin, phenobarbital, rifampin, TMP-SMX lower levels. Mix liquid with milk/chocolate milk/orange juice in a glass container, not plastic.Cyclosporine交互作用：葡萄柚汁、ketoconazole、erythromycin、amphotericin B使濃度升高；phenytoin、phenobarbital、rifampin、TMP-SMX使濃度降低。液劑以牛奶/巧克力牛奶/柳橙汁混合並使用玻璃容器。
  • Contraindicated in pregnancy (embryotoxic), live vaccines, active infection such as varicella/zoster.懷孕(胚胎毒性)、活病毒疫苗、活動性感染(如水痘/帶狀疱疹)時禁用。
  • Tacrolimus (他克莫司): more potent but more toxic than cyclosporine; nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, hyperglycemia (monitor glucose), hyperkalemia, infection.Tacrolimus(他克莫司)：比cyclosporine強效但毒性較高；腎毒性、神經毒性、高血糖(需監測血糖)、高血鉀、感染。
  • Sirolimus (西羅莫司) and everolimus (依維莫司): mTOR inhibitors; infection, renal injury, raised cholesterol/triglycerides, lymphocele, rash, acne, anemia, thrombocytopenia, hypokalemia, edema; no grapefruit juice; avoid crowds and live vaccines.Sirolimus與everolimus：mTOR抑制劑；感染、腎損傷、膽固醇/三酸甘油酯升高、淋巴囊腫、皮疹、粉刺、貧血、血小板低下、低血鉀、水腫；勿喝葡萄柚汁；避免人群與活疫苗。
PDF p.899, 900

Immunosuppressants: steroids, antimetabolites and antibodies免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體

  • Prednisone: glucocorticoid; hyperglycemia and hypokalemia (monitor glucose and K+).Prednisone：糖皮質素；高血糖與低血鉀(監測血糖與鉀)。
  • Azathioprine (硫唑嘌呤): bone marrow suppression (neutropenia, thrombocytopenia), neoplasm risk, contraindicated in pregnancy; monitor CBC, platelets, liver enzymes.Azathioprine(硫唑嘌呤)：骨髓抑制(嗜中性白血球及血小板低下)、腫瘤風險、懷孕禁用；監測全血球、血小板、肝酵素。
  • Mycophenolate mofetil (黴酚酸酯): diarrhea, vomiting, severe neutropenia, sepsis, malignancy; absorption reduced by Mg/Al antacids and cholestyramine; empty stomach, do not open/crush capsules; contraindicated in pregnancy/lactation.Mycophenolate mofetil(黴酚酸酯)：腹瀉、嘔吐、嚴重嗜中性白血球低下、敗血症、惡性腫瘤；鎂/鋁制酸劑與cholestyramine降低吸收；空腹服用、膠囊不可打開或磨碎；懷孕與哺乳禁用。
  • Basiliximab (巴利昔單抗): IL-2 receptor antibody for induction, IV within 2 h before transplant; headache, tremor, GI distress, edema, slow wound healing.Basiliximab(巴利昔單抗)：IL-2受體抗體，用於誘導，移植前2小時內靜脈給予；頭痛、顫抖、腸胃不適、水腫、傷口癒合慢。
  • Antithymocyte globulin, equine: treats acute rejection; intradermal skin test before first dose; monitor platelets; risk of infectious agent transmission.馬抗胸腺細胞球蛋白：用於治療急性排斥；首次使用前做皮內試驗；監測血小板；有傳播感染原風險。
  • All immunosuppressants: take at the same time daily, never skip, report fever, sore throat, bleeding/bruising, mouth sores promptly.所有免疫抑制劑：每天固定時間服用、不可漏服，出現發燒、喉嚨痛、出血/瘀青、口腔潰瘍須立即通報。
PDF p.900, 901

Hematopoietic growth factors造血生長因子

  • Erythropoietic agents (epoetin alfa 阿法依泊汀, darbepoetin alfa): treat anemia of CKD; effect in 1-2 weeks, Hct normal in 2-3 months.紅血球生成素類(epoetin alfa、darbepoetin alfa)：治療CKD貧血；1-2週見效，2-3個月血比容恢復正常。
  • Major adverse effect hypertension; also thrombosis, stroke, MI, heart failure. Monitor BP, Hgb/Hct, iron stores.主要不良反應為高血壓；另有血栓、中風、心肌梗塞、心衰竭。監測血壓、Hgb/Hct與鐵儲存。
  • Leukopoietic agents (filgrastim 非格司亭, pegfilgrastim, sargramostim): raise WBC in chemotherapy neutropenia; bone pain, leukocytosis, raised uric acid, splenomegaly.白血球生成素類(filgrastim、pegfilgrastim、sargramostim)：用於化療引起的嗜中性白血球低下；骨痛、白血球增多、尿酸升高、脾腫大。
  • Thrombopoietic agent: raises platelets; fluid retention, dysrhythmias, visual blurring, papilledema.血小板生成素類：提升血小板；水分滯留、心律不整、視力模糊、視乳頭水腫。
PDF p.901

Medications for benign prostatic hyperplasia良性攝護腺增生用藥

  • Alpha blockers (tamsulosin 坦索羅辛, alfuzosin, doxazosin, terazosin, silodosin): relax prostate and bladder neck smooth muscle; dizziness, orthostatic hypotension, retrograde ejaculation.α阻斷劑(tamsulosin、alfuzosin、doxazosin、terazosin、silodosin)：放鬆攝護腺與膀胱頸平滑肌；頭暈、姿位性低血壓、逆行性射精。
  • 5-alpha-reductase inhibitors (finasteride 非那雄胺, dutasteride): shrink the prostate; may take up to 6 months; retrograde ejaculation.5-α還原酶抑制劑(finasteride、dutasteride)：縮小攝護腺；最久需6個月見效；逆行性射精。
  • Avoid decongestants, antihistamines, anticholinergics that cause urinary retention in BPH.BPH應避免會造成尿滯留的解充血劑、抗組織胺與抗膽鹼藥。
PDF p.901

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Nitrofurantoin: cough, fever, chills, dyspnea = pulmonary reaction, stop drug and report; brown urine is harmless; contraindicated in renal impairment.Nitrofurantoin：咳嗽、發燒、寒顫、呼吸困難=肺部反應，需停藥並通報；棕色尿無害；腎功能不全禁用。 PDF p.896
  2. Methenamine works only in acidic urine (pH 5.5 or lower): avoid sodium bicarbonate antacids, sulfonamides, and excess fluids.Methenamine僅在酸性尿(pH≦5.5)有效：避免碳酸氫鈉制酸劑、磺胺類與過量飲水。 PDF p.896
  3. Fluoroquinolones: tendon rupture risk (age >60, steroids, transplant) and CNS toxicity; stop and report tendon pain, dizziness, blurred vision, depression.氟喹諾酮：肌腱斷裂風險(>60歲、類固醇、移植)與中樞毒性；肌腱疼痛、頭暈、視力模糊、憂鬱需停藥並通報。 PDF p.897
  4. Sulfonamides: withhold and report rash (possible Stevens-Johnson), sore throat or fever; keep urine output >=1200 mL/day (8-10 glasses water).磺胺類：出現皮疹(可能史蒂文斯-強生)、喉嚨痛或發燒須停藥並通報；尿量維持≧1200 mL/天(喝水8-10杯)。 PDF p.897, 898
  5. Phenazopyridine turns urine, tears and contact lenses orange-red and treats pain only; give with an antibiotic.Phenazopyridine使尿液、淚液與隱形眼鏡呈橙紅色，僅治療疼痛；需併用抗生素。 PDF p.898
  6. Anticholinergic bladder drugs are contraindicated or risky in glaucoma, obstruction, myasthenia gravis; expect dry mouth and constipation.抗膽鹼膀胱藥在青光眼、阻塞、重症肌無力時禁用或高風險；預期有口乾與便秘。 PDF p.898
  7. Bethanechol: never IM/IV; contraindicated in urinary obstruction; antidote for cholinergic toxicity is atropine sulfate.Bethanechol：不可肌肉/靜脈注射；尿路阻塞禁用；膽鹼中毒解毒劑為atropine sulfate。 PDF p.898, 899
  8. Cyclosporine/tacrolimus: nephrotoxic; monitor drug levels, BUN, creatinine, K+, glucose; no grapefruit juice; take at same time daily.Cyclosporine/tacrolimus具腎毒性；監測血中濃度、BUN、肌酸酐、鉀、血糖；禁喝葡萄柚汁；每日固定時間服用。 PDF p.899, 900
  9. Immunosuppressed clients: report fever, sore throat, bruising; avoid live vaccines, crowds and sick contacts; lifelong therapy.免疫抑制病人：發燒、喉嚨痛、瘀青需通報；避免活疫苗、人群與病人接觸；需終生服藥。 PDF p.899, 900
  10. Azathioprine and mycophenolate: bone marrow suppression, contraindicated in pregnancy; monitor CBC.Azathioprine與mycophenolate：骨髓抑制、懷孕禁用；監測全血球計數。 PDF p.900
  11. Antithymocyte globulin requires intradermal skin test first; basiliximab is given within 2 h before transplant.抗胸腺細胞球蛋白需先做皮內試驗；basiliximab於移植前2小時內給予。 PDF p.900, 901
  12. Epoetin/darbepoetin: monitor blood pressure (hypertension is the major adverse effect), thrombosis risk.Epoetin/darbepoetin：監測血壓(高血壓為主要不良反應)與血栓風險。 PDF p.901
  13. Alpha blockers for BPH cause orthostatic hypotension and dizziness: rise slowly; finasteride can take up to 6 months.BPH的α阻斷劑會造成姿位性低血壓與頭暈：緩慢起身；finasteride最久需6個月才見效。 PDF p.901

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Cholinergic overdose = SLUDGE/DUMBBELS (salivation, lacrimation, urination, defecation, GI cramps, emesis, bradycardia): antidote atropine.膽鹼過量=SLUDGE(流涎、流淚、排尿、排便、腹絞痛、嘔吐、心搏過緩)：解毒劑atropine。 PDF p.899
  • Anticholinergic effects: 'can't see, can't pee, can't spit, can't poop.'抗膽鹼作用：視力模糊、尿滯留、口乾、便秘。 PDF p.898

57 Eye and Ear Problems眼與耳問題

Covers eye and ear anatomy, diagnostic tests, refractive errors, cataract, glaucoma, retinal detachment, macular degeneration, eye trauma and infections, then hearing loss, otitis, mastoiditis, otosclerosis, labyrinthitis, Meniere's disease and ear trauma. Safety and sensory perception are the priority concepts: protect from injury, prevent increased intraocular pressure, and recognize emergencies.涵蓋眼耳解剖、診斷檢查、屈光不正、白內障、青光眼、視網膜剝離、黃斑部病變、眼外傷與感染，以及聽力損失、中耳炎、乳突炎、耳硬化症、迷路炎、梅尼爾氏症與耳外傷。重點為安全與感覺知覺：預防受傷、避免眼壓升高、辨識緊急狀況。

Eye anatomy and diagnostic tests眼睛解剖與檢查

  • Layers: fibrous (cornea, sclera), uveal (choroid, ciliary body, iris), retina. Rods = peripheral/night vision; cones = color/central vision; fovea = sharpest vision; optic disc = blind spot.眼球分層：纖維層(角膜、鞏膜)、葡萄膜(脈絡膜、睫狀體、虹膜)、視網膜。桿細胞=周邊/夜視；錐細胞=色覺/中心視力；中央小凹=最敏銳視力；視神經盤=盲點。
  • Aqueous humor is made by the ciliary body and drains through the canal of Schlemm; poor drainage raises IOP (normal 10-21 mm Hg, higher in the morning).房水由睫狀體產生，經許萊姆氏管排出；引流不良使眼壓升高(正常10-21 mmHg，早晨較高)。
  • Cranial nerves: II optic (sight); III, IV, VI eye movement.腦神經：II視神經(視覺)；III、IV、VI眼球運動。
  • Fluorescein angiography: allergy check, dilating drops, yellow skin and bright green/orange urine for up to 2 days, sunglasses.螢光眼底血管攝影：確認過敏、散瞳、皮膚黃染及尿液亮綠/橙色最多2天、需戴太陽眼鏡。
  • Tonometry measures IOP (contact type needs topical anesthetic; do not rub eye after). Slit lamp, corneal staining (green = epithelial defect), ultrasound, CT, MRI.眼壓測量(接觸式需局部麻醉，之後勿揉眼)。裂隙燈、角膜染色(綠色=上皮缺損)、超音波、CT、MRI。
PDF p.909, 910, 911

Refractive errors, blindness and cataract屈光不正、失明與白內障

  • Myopia: images fall in front of retina; hyperopia and presbyopia: behind retina; astigmatism: irregular cornea. Corrections: glasses, contacts, LASIK, PRK, corneal ring.近視：成像於視網膜前；遠視與老花：成像於視網膜後；散光：角膜曲度不規則。矯正：眼鏡、隱形眼鏡、LASIK、PRK、角膜環。
  • Legal blindness: best corrected acuity 20/200 or worse in better eye, or visual field <=20 degrees.法定失明：較佳眼矯正後視力≦20/200，或視野≦20度。
  • Helping the blind client: speak normally, announce yourself, orient to room, clock positions for food, let client hold your elbow (client one step behind), white cane with red tip.協助視障者：正常音量說話、先表明身分、環境導向、以時鐘位置描述食物、讓病人扶護理師手肘(落後一步)、白底紅頭手杖。
  • Cataract: lens opacity; blurred vision, decreased color perception, glare; late: white pupil, absent red reflex; painless gradual loss.白內障：水晶體混濁；視力模糊、色覺下降、眩光；晚期：瞳孔變白、紅光反射消失；無痛、漸進性視力喪失。
  • Surgery one eye at a time (phacoemulsification/extracapsular, with lens implant). Post-op: HOB 30-45, lie on back or non-operative side, eye shield at night.一次手術一眼(超音波乳化/囊外摘除併人工水晶體)。術後：床頭抬高30-45度、平躺或健側臥、夜間戴眼罩。
  • Avoid bending, straining, coughing, rubbing eye, lifting >5 lb (2.25 kg); prevent constipation. Report decreased vision, severe pain, redness, discharge.避免彎腰、用力、咳嗽、揉眼、提>5磅(2.25公斤)；預防便秘。視力下降、劇痛、紅腫、分泌物增加需通報。
PDF p.911, 912, 913

Glaucoma青光眼

  • Glaucoma: raised IOP damages the optic nerve; peripheral vision lost first ('tunnel vision') while central vision stays until late.青光眼：眼壓升高損傷視神經；先喪失周邊視野(隧道視野)，中心視力至晚期才受影響。
  • Primary open-angle (most common): painless, gradual. Angle-closure: sudden severe eye pain, halos around lights, blurred vision, red eye, nausea/vomiting = emergency.原發性開角型(最常見)：無痛、漸進。閉角型：突發劇烈眼痛、燈光暈輪、視力模糊、紅眼、噁心嘔吐=急症。
  • Treatment: miotics, carbonic anhydrase inhibitors, beta blockers lower IOP; peripheral iridectomy for angle-closure; trabeculectomy when medical therapy fails.治療：縮瞳劑、碳酸酐酶抑制劑、β阻斷劑降眼壓；閉角型行周邊虹膜切開術；藥物失敗時行小梁切除術。
  • Teach lifelong medication, MedicAlert bracelet, avoid anticholinergic/atropine-like drugs, check OTC drugs with provider, report eye pain, halos, vision change.衛教：終生用藥、佩戴醫療警示手環、避免抗膽鹼/類阿托品藥物、OTC藥品先詢問醫師、眼痛、暈輪與視力改變需通報。
PDF p.913

Retinal detachment, macular degeneration, tumors視網膜剝離、黃斑部病變與腫瘤

  • Retinal detachment: flashes of light, floaters, curtain over vision, painless visual field loss; emergency.視網膜剝離：閃光、飛蚊、如簾幕遮住視野、無痛視野缺損；屬緊急。
  • Immediate care: bed rest, patch both eyes as prescribed, position per detachment location, avoid jerky head movement, speak before approaching.立即處置：臥床、依醫囑雙眼包紮、依剝離位置擺位、避免快速轉頭、接近前先出聲。
  • Repairs: laser, cryosurgery, diathermy, scleral buckling, gas or silicone oil. Post-op: monitor hemorrhage, sudden sharp pain, prevent vomiting/straining, limit reading 3-5 weeks, dark glasses, avoid bending from waist.修補：雷射、冷凍、電燒、鞏膜扣壓、注入氣體或矽油。術後：監測出血、突發劇痛，預防嘔吐與用力，閱讀限制3-5週，戴墨鏡，避免彎腰。
  • Macular degeneration: loss of central vision, distortion; dry (atrophic, common) vs wet (exudative, faster). Maximize remaining vision; laser/photodynamic therapy.黃斑部病變：中心視力喪失與扭曲；乾性(萎縮型、較常見)與濕性(滲出型、進展較快)。最大化殘餘視力；雷射/光動力療法。
  • Ocular melanoma: most common adult malignant eye tumor; enucleation or radioactive plaque. After enucleation: monitor dressing for bright red bleeding, emotional support, prosthesis in about 1 month.眼黑色素瘤：成人最常見惡性眼腫瘤；眼球摘除或放射性敷貼。眼球摘除後：觀察敷料有無鮮紅出血、情緒支持，約1個月後裝義眼。
PDF p.913, 914, 915

Eye injuries and donation眼外傷與眼角膜捐贈

  • Hyphema: blood in anterior chamber; semi-Fowler's rest, avoid sudden eye movement, cycloplegic drops, eye shield.前房出血：前房積血；半坐臥休息、避免突然眼動、睫狀肌麻痺劑、眼罩。
  • Contusion: apply ice immediately; full eye exam. Foreign body: look up, irrigate/remove with moist applicator.挫傷：立即冰敷並做完整眼科檢查。異物：向上看，以濕棉棒或沖洗移除。
  • Penetrating object: never remove; cover with cup/shield, cover both eyes, no pressure, do not let client bend or lie flat; no MRI.穿透性異物：不可拔除；以杯狀護罩覆蓋、雙眼遮蓋、不可加壓，避免彎腰或平躺；禁做MRI。
  • Chemical burn: flush with water at least 15-20 minutes immediately, check pH, continue irrigation until pH acceptable.化學灼傷：立即以清水沖洗至少15-20分鐘，測pH，持續沖洗至pH正常。
  • Corneal transplant rejection signs RSVP: Redness, Swelling, decreased Vision, Pain; treat with topical corticosteroids. Wear shield at night for 1 month.角膜移植排斥徵象RSVP：紅、腫、視力下降、疼痛；以局部類固醇治療。夜間戴眼罩1個月。
PDF p.915, 916

Eyelid infections眼瞼感染與發炎

  • Blepharitis: chronic lid margin inflammation; lid hygiene, warm compresses, possible antibiotics or steroids.眼瞼緣炎：慢性眼瞼緣發炎；眼瞼清潔、溫敷、可能使用抗生素或類固醇。
  • Hordeolum (stye): painful red lump from infected gland; warm wet compress, do not squeeze, no makeup or contacts.麥粒腫：腺體感染的紅痛腫塊；溫濕敷、不可擠壓、避免化妝與隱形眼鏡。
  • Chalazion: painless firm lump from blocked gland; warm compresses, do not squeeze.霰粒腫：腺體阻塞的無痛硬塊；溫敷、不可擠壓。
PDF p.916, 917

Ear anatomy, tests and hearing loss耳朵解剖、檢查與聽力損失

  • External ear (pinna to tympanic membrane), middle ear (malleus, incus, stapes; eustachian tube equalizes pressure), inner ear (cochlea = hearing, semicircular canals = balance, CN VIII).外耳(耳廓至鼓膜)、中耳(錘骨、砧骨、鐙骨；耳咽管平衡壓力)、內耳(耳蝸=聽覺、半規管=平衡、第八對腦神經)。
  • Tests: audiometry (pure tone, speech), electronystagmography (NPO 3 h, avoid caffeine 24-48 h, ears irrigated with cool/warm water, nausea possible), tomography, MRI.檢查：聽力檢查(純音、語音)、眼震電圖(禁食3小時、24-48小時避免咖啡因、以冷熱水沖洗耳朵可能噁心)、斷層攝影、MRI。
  • Conductive loss: blocked sound in outer/middle ear, often correctable. Sensorineural: inner ear/CN VIII damage, often permanent. Mixed: both. Central: brain interpretation.傳導性：外耳/中耳阻礙聲音，常可矯正。感覺神經性：內耳/第八對腦神經受損，多為永久。混合型：兩者皆有。中樞性：腦部解讀障礙。
  • Hearing aids help conductive loss (amplify only); cochlear implant for sensorineural loss. Hearing aid care: turn off before removal, keep dry, remove battery when unused.助聽器適用傳導性聽損(僅放大聲音)；人工電子耳用於感覺神經性聽損。助聽器護理：取下前先關閉、保持乾燥、不用時取出電池。
  • Communication: face the client, lower pitch, normal volume (do not shout), reduce noise, rephrase, get attention first.溝通：面對病人、降低音調、正常音量(不要大叫)、減少噪音、換句話說、先引起注意。
  • Presbycusis: age-related bilateral sensorineural loss; hears sound but cannot understand words. No cotton-tipped applicators in the ear canal.老年性聽損：老化造成的雙側感覺神經性聽損；聽得見聲音但聽不清字句。不可用棉花棒掏耳朵。
PDF p.917, 918, 919, 920

Middle ear infection, mastoiditis, otosclerosis中耳炎、乳突炎與耳硬化症

  • Chronic otitis media: debris removal, myringoplasty, mastoidectomy. Post-op: hearing reduced from packing, operative ear up, avoid forceful coughing.慢性中耳炎：清除碎屑、鼓膜成形術、乳突切除術。術後：因填塞聽力暫時下降、患耳朝上、避免用力咳嗽。
  • Myringotomy teaching: avoid straining, straws, air travel, getting head wet; blow nose one side at a time with mouth open; cotton with petroleum jelly in ear.鼓膜切開術衛教：避免用力、吸管、搭飛機、頭部進水；擤鼻一次一側且張口；耳內放塗凡士林棉球。
  • Mastoiditis: swelling and pain behind ear, low-grade fever, immobile dull tympanic membrane; complications meningitis, brain abscess, CN VI and VII damage. Monitor for stiff neck and vomiting.乳突炎：耳後腫痛、低燒、鼓膜暗淡不動；併發腦膜炎、腦膿瘍、第VI與VII對腦神經受損。監測頸部僵硬與嘔吐。
  • Otosclerosis: stapes fixation, slowly progressive bilateral conductive loss, tinnitus, Schwartze's sign (pink tympanic membrane); stapedectomy.耳硬化症：鐙骨固定，緩慢進行性雙側傳導性聽損、耳鳴、Schwartze徵象(鼓膜粉紅)；鐙骨切除術。
  • Stapedectomy post-op: hearing worse initially (up to 6 weeks), avoid sneezing, nose blowing, straining, pressure changes; assess facial nerve, vertigo; move head slowly.鐙骨切除術後：初期聽力更差(可長達6週)，避免打噴嚏、擤鼻、用力、壓力變化；評估顏面神經與眩暈；緩慢轉頭。
PDF p.920, 921, 922

Labyrinthitis, Meniere's disease, acoustic neuroma, trauma, cerumen迷路炎、梅尼爾氏症、聽神經瘤、外傷與耳垢

  • Labyrinthitis: vertigo, tinnitus, nystagmus, hearing loss, nausea; watch for meningitis (headache, stiff neck, lethargy); bed rest in dark room, antibiotics, antiemetics.迷路炎：眩暈、耳鳴、眼震、聽力下降、噁心；注意腦膜炎(頭痛、頸僵、嗜睡)；於暗室臥床、抗生素、止吐劑。
  • Meniere's disease: triad of tinnitus, vertigo, unilateral sensorineural hearing loss, plus ear fullness; safety is the priority.梅尼爾氏症：耳鳴、眩暈、單側感覺神經性聽損三聯症，另有耳悶；安全為優先。
  • Meniere's care: low-sodium diet and fluid restriction, stop smoking, avoid flickering TV, diuretics, antihistamines, antiemetics, vestibular rehab, move head slowly.梅尼爾氏症照護：低鈉飲食與限水、戒菸、避免閃爍電視、利尿劑、抗組織胺、止吐劑、前庭復健、緩慢轉頭。
  • Acoustic neuroma: benign tumor of CN VIII; begins with tinnitus and sensorineural loss; craniotomy, preserve facial nerve.聽神經瘤：第八對腦神經良性腫瘤；始於耳鳴與感覺神經性聽損；顱骨切開術，保留顏面神經。
  • Ear trauma: tympanic membrane perforations usually heal; avoid forceful nose blowing and non-pressurized flights.耳外傷：鼓膜穿孔多可自癒；避免用力擤鼻與搭乘非加壓飛機。
  • Cerumen: soften with glycerin/mineral oil/hydrogen peroxide then irrigate (max 50-70 mL); irrigation contraindicated with perforation or otitis. Never use ear candles. Insects: kill with mineral oil first; vegetable matter expands with water.耳垢：先以甘油/礦物油/雙氧水軟化後沖洗(最多50-70 mL)；鼓膜穿孔或中耳炎禁止沖洗。禁用耳燭。昆蟲：先以礦物油殺死；植物性異物遇水會膨脹。
PDF p.922, 923, 924

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Acute angle-closure glaucoma is an emergency: sudden severe eye pain, halos, blurred vision, nausea/vomiting; lower IOP promptly.急性閉角型青光眼為急症：突發劇烈眼痛、暈輪、視力模糊、噁心嘔吐；需儘速降眼壓。 PDF p.913
  2. Normal IOP is 10-21 mm Hg; glaucoma clients must avoid atropine-like (anticholinergic) drugs and use medication for life.正常眼壓10-21 mmHg；青光眼病人避免類阿托品(抗膽鹼)藥並終生用藥。 PDF p.911, 913
  3. Retinal detachment: flashes, floaters, curtain over vision; bed rest, patch eyes, avoid jerky head movement.視網膜剝離：閃光、飛蚊、簾幕感；臥床、遮眼、避免快速轉頭。 PDF p.913, 914
  4. Penetrating eye injury: do NOT remove object, shield without pressure, cover both eyes, keep client upright/still, no MRI.眼睛穿透傷：不可拔除異物，無壓力護罩、雙眼遮蓋、病人保持直立/靜止，禁做MRI。 PDF p.915
  5. Chemical eye splash: irrigate immediately with water for at least 15-20 minutes, then ED; check pH.眼睛化學濺傷：立即以清水沖洗至少15-20分鐘後送急診；測pH。 PDF p.915, 916
  6. After cataract surgery: avoid bending, straining, coughing, rubbing; report severe pain, decreased vision, redness, discharge.白內障術後：避免彎腰、用力、咳嗽、揉眼；劇痛、視力下降、紅腫、分泌物需通報。 PDF p.912, 913
  7. Corneal graft rejection RSVP: Redness, Swelling, decreased Vision, Pain.角膜移植排斥RSVP：紅、腫、視力下降、疼痛。 PDF p.916
  8. Hyphema: semi-Fowler's, restrict activity and reading, cycloplegics to rest the eye.前房出血：半坐臥、限制活動與閱讀、睫狀肌麻痺劑讓眼睛休息。 PDF p.915
  9. Fluorescein angiography: skin yellow, urine bright green/orange up to 2 days; check dye allergy.螢光眼底攝影：皮膚黃染、尿液亮綠/橙色最多2天；確認染劑過敏。 PDF p.910
  10. Hearing loss: conductive (outer/middle ear; hearing aids help) vs sensorineural (inner ear/CN VIII; often permanent).聽損：傳導性(外/中耳，助聽器有幫助)與感覺神經性(內耳/CN VIII，常永久)。 PDF p.918, 919
  11. Do not irrigate the ear if tympanic membrane perforation is suspected; warm irrigant to 37 C (98.6 F) and aim at canal wall.懷疑鼓膜穿孔時不可沖洗耳朵；沖洗液加溫至37°C(98.6°F)並朝向耳道壁。 PDF p.923, 924
  12. Mastoiditis/labyrinthitis: monitor for meningitis (stiff neck, headache, vomiting, lethargy).乳突炎/迷路炎：監測腦膜炎(頸僵、頭痛、嘔吐、嗜睡)。 PDF p.921, 922
  13. Meniere's disease: tinnitus + vertigo + sensorineural hearing loss; priority is safety; low sodium and fluid restriction.梅尼爾氏症：耳鳴+眩暈+感覺神經性聽損；優先為安全；低鈉與限水。 PDF p.922, 923
  14. Never use cotton-tipped applicators or ear candles in ear canal.耳道內不可使用棉花棒或耳燭。 PDF p.920, 924

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • RSVP = corneal graft rejection signs: Redness, Swelling, Vision decrease, Pain.RSVP=角膜移植排斥：紅、腫、視力下降、疼痛。 PDF p.916
  • Cataract/retinal detachment post-op: avoid bending, straining, coughing, sneezing, lifting (anything that raises IOP).白內障/視網膜剝離術後：避免彎腰、用力、咳嗽、打噴嚏、提重物(任何升高眼壓之行為)。 PDF p.912, 914

58 Eye and Ear Medications眼耳用藥

Covers correct instillation of eye and ear medications and the drug classes used: mydriatics/cycloplegics, anti-infectives, anti-inflammatories, topical anesthetics, lubricants, glaucoma drugs, macular degeneration drugs, otic preparations and ototoxic drugs. Know each class's action, adverse effects, contraindications and the key safety teaching.涵蓋眼藥與耳藥的正確給藥方式，以及散瞳/睫狀肌麻痺劑、抗感染藥、消炎藥、局部麻醉劑、潤滑劑、青光眼藥物、黃斑部病變藥物、耳用製劑與耳毒性藥物。需熟記各類作用、不良反應、禁忌與重要衛教。

Ophthalmic administration眼用藥物給藥

  • Wash hands, wear gloves, place drops in the lower conjunctival sac (never on the cornea), do not touch the dropper to the eye; separate bottle per client.洗手、戴手套，將藥液滴入下結膜囊(不可直接滴在角膜)，滴管不可碰到眼睛；每位病人專用藥瓶。
  • After instilling, press the inner canthus/nasolacrimal duct 30-60 seconds and close eye gently (do not squeeze) to reduce systemic absorption.滴藥後壓住內眼角/鼻淚管30-60秒並輕閉眼(勿用力擠眼)，以減少全身吸收。
  • Order: drops before ointment; glucocorticoid before other drugs; wait 3-5 min between drops of the same drug and 5-10 min between different drugs.順序：先滴眼藥水再擠藥膏；類固醇先於其他藥物；同藥多滴間隔3-5分鐘，不同藥物間隔5-10分鐘。
  • Ointment: thin ribbon along lower conjunctival sac from inner to outer canthus, tube not touching eye; vision blurs, best at bedtime.藥膏：沿下結膜囊由內眥向外眥擠一細條，管口不碰眼睛；會暫時視力模糊，最好睡前使用。
  • Monitor pulse and BP with ophthalmic beta blockers; mydriatic/cycloplegic use means no driving; sunglasses for photophobia; atropine drops in infants may cause abdominal distention.使用眼用β阻斷劑需監測脈搏與血壓；散瞳/睫狀肌麻痺後不可開車；畏光戴太陽眼鏡；嬰兒使用atropine眼藥可能造成腹脹。
  • Older client with tremor: involve caregiver, home care nurse or adaptive bottle-positioning device. Missed dose: take when remembered unless next dose due in 1-2 h.手抖的老年人：請照顧者、居家護理師協助或使用瓶口定位輔具。漏用：想起即用，除非1-2小時內需下一次用藥。
PDF p.931, 932

Mydriatics, cycloplegics and anticholinergics散瞳劑、睫狀肌麻痺劑與抗膽鹼藥

  • Action: dilate the pupil (mydriasis) and paralyze the ciliary muscle (cycloplegia) for exams and surgery. Examples: atropine, cyclopentolate, homatropine, phenylephrine, scopolamine, tropicamide.作用：散瞳並麻痺睫狀肌，用於檢查與手術。例：atropine、cyclopentolate、homatropine、phenylephrine、scopolamine、tropicamide。
  • Side/adverse effects: tachycardia, photophobia, conjunctivitis, dermatitis, raised BP; a temporary burning on instillation is also expected. Atropine toxicity: dry mouth, blurred vision, fever, tachycardia, urinary retention, constipation, confusion, hallucinations, worsening glaucoma.副作用/不良反應：心搏過速、畏光、結膜炎、皮膚炎、血壓上升；滴藥時也可能有暫時性灼熱感。Atropine中毒：口乾、視力模糊、發燒、心搏過速、尿滯留、便秘、混亂、幻覺、青光眼惡化。
  • Contraindicated in glaucoma, cardiac dysrhythmias, or cerebral atherosclerosis (risk of raised IOP/cardiac strain); use with caution in older clients and those with prostatic hypertrophy, diabetes, or parkinsonism.青光眼、心律不整或腦動脈硬化病人禁用(升高眼壓/心臟負擔風險)；老年人、攝護腺肥大、糖尿病或帕金森氏症者須小心使用。
  • Teach: no driving or hazardous activity for 24 h, sunglasses, report eye pain, vision loss, flushing, difficulty breathing.衛教：24小時內不可開車或從事危險活動、戴太陽眼鏡、眼痛、視力喪失、潮紅或呼吸困難需通報。
PDF p.933

Anti-infective, anti-inflammatory, anesthetic and lubricant eye drugs抗感染、消炎、麻醉與潤滑眼藥

  • Anti-infectives (bacitracin, erythromycin, gentamicin, tobramycin, moxifloxacin, natamycin antifungal, ganciclovir antiviral, sulfacetamide): superinfection, local irritation; complete the course, clean exudate first, hand hygiene.抗感染藥(bacitracin、erythromycin、gentamicin、tobramycin、moxifloxacin、抗黴菌natamycin、抗病毒ganciclovir、sulfacetamide)：重複感染、局部刺激；需完成療程、先清除分泌物、勤洗手。
  • Anti-inflammatories: corticosteroids (dexamethasone, prednisolone), NSAIDs (ketorolac, diclofenac, nepafenac), mast cell stabilizers (cromolyn, olopatadine). Steroid effects: cataracts, raised IOP/glaucoma, delayed healing, masks infection; not for abrasions or wounds.消炎藥：皮質類固醇(dexamethasone、prednisolone)、NSAIDs(ketorolac、diclofenac、nepafenac)、肥大細胞穩定劑(cromolyn、olopatadine)。類固醇副作用：白內障、眼壓升高/青光眼、延遲癒合、掩蓋感染；不可用於角膜擦傷或傷口。
  • Topical anesthetics (tetracaine): stinging, loss of corneal blink reflex; never for home or self use; do not rub eye; patch until reflex returns.局部麻醉劑(tetracaine)：刺痛、角膜眨眼反射消失；不可居家或自行使用；勿揉眼；以眼罩保護至反射恢復。
  • Lubricants (carboxymethylcellulose, hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, polyvinyl alcohol, petrolatum ointment): for dry eye, unconscious or anesthetized clients; may burn on instillation; watch for preservative allergy.潤滑劑(carboxymethylcellulose、hydroxypropyl methylcellulose、polyvinyl alcohol、凡士林藥膏)：用於乾眼、昏迷或麻醉病人；滴入時可能灼熱；留意防腐劑過敏。
PDF p.933, 934

Glaucoma: miotics and beta blockers青光眼：縮瞳劑與β阻斷劑

  • Miotics/cholinergic agonists (pilocarpine, carbachol, echothiophate): constrict pupil, contract ciliary muscle, increase aqueous outflow. Side effects: myopia, headache, eye pain, poor vision in dim light.縮瞳劑/膽鹼促效劑(pilocarpine、carbachol、echothiophate)：縮瞳、睫狀肌收縮、增加房水排出。副作用：近視、頭痛、眼痛、暗處視力差。
  • Systemic cholinergic effects: flushing, sweating, salivation, diarrhea, urinary frequency, bronchospasm; toxicity: bradycardia, hypotension, syncope, seizures. Antidote: atropine sulfate.全身膽鹼效應：潮紅、流汗、流涎、腹瀉、頻尿、支氣管痙攣；中毒：心搏過緩、低血壓、昏厥、癲癇。解毒劑：atropine sulfate。
  • Contraindicated with retinal detachment, iris-lens adhesions, inflammation; caution with asthma, bradycardia, ulcers, parkinsonism.視網膜剝離、虹膜與水晶體沾黏、發炎時禁用；氣喘、心搏過緩、潰瘍、帕金森氏症者小心。
  • Beta blockers (timolol, betaxolol, carteolol, levobunolol, metipranolol): reduce aqueous production without changing pupil size.β阻斷劑(timolol、betaxolol、carteolol、levobunolol、metipranolol)：減少房水生成，不影響瞳孔大小。
  • Beta blocker risks: bradycardia, hypotension, bronchospasm; contraindicated in asthma/COPD; hold and call if pulse <=60 or systolic BP <90; may mask hypoglycemia in diabetics.β阻斷劑風險：心搏過緩、低血壓、支氣管痙攣；氣喘/COPD禁用；脈搏≦60或收縮壓<90應暫停並通報；糖尿病人可能掩蓋低血糖。
  • Do not stop glaucoma drugs abruptly; change positions slowly.不可突然停用青光眼藥物；改變姿勢要緩慢。
PDF p.934, 935, 936

Glaucoma: carbonic anhydrase inhibitors, osmotics, other agents青光眼：碳酸酐酶抑制劑、滲透劑與其他藥物

  • Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (dorzolamide, brinzolamide; oral acetazolamide) decrease aqueous humor formation; contraindicated in sulfonamide allergy; caution in severe renal/liver disease.碳酸酐酶抑制劑(dorzolamide、brinzolamide；口服acetazolamide)減少房水生成；磺胺過敏禁用；嚴重腎/肝病者小心。
  • Adverse effects: paresthesias, GI upset, polyuria, hypokalemia, renal calculi, photosensitivity, lethargy, depression. Monitor K+, I&O, weight; increase fluids; no contact lenses during or within 15 minutes of drops.不良反應：感覺異常、腸胃不適、多尿、低血鉀、腎結石、光敏感、嗜睡、憂鬱。監測鉀、輸出入量、體重；增加水分；滴藥期間及滴後15分鐘內勿戴隱形眼鏡。
  • Ocusert: pilocarpine wafer replaced every 7 days, stored in refrigerator, check presence at bedtime and on arising; may leak, migrate or be lost.Ocusert：pilocarpine藥片每7天更換、冷藏保存、睡前與起床時檢查是否在位；可能漏藥、移位或遺失。
  • Osmotic agents (mannitol): emergency IOP reduction and peri-operative; headache, N/V, dehydration, disorientation, electrolyte imbalance; monitor I&O, weight, orientation.滲透劑(mannitol)：緊急降眼壓及手術前後使用；頭痛、噁心嘔吐、脫水、定向力障礙、電解質失衡；監測輸出入量、體重與定向力。
  • Other glaucoma agents in Box 58.5: prostaglandin analogs (latanoprost, bimatoprost, travoprost), alpha-2 agonists (brimonidine, apraclonidine), rho kinase inhibitor (netarsudil).方塊58.5其他青光眼藥物：前列腺素類似物(latanoprost、bimatoprost、travoprost)、α2促效劑(brimonidine、apraclonidine)、Rho激酶抑制劑(netarsudil)。
PDF p.935, 936

Macular degeneration medications黃斑部病變藥物

  • Wet (neovascular) ARMD is faster and treated with anti-VEGF agents (ranibizumab, bevacizumab, aflibercept, pegaptanib) and verteporfin photodynamic therapy; dry ARMD is more common and slow.濕性(新生血管)黃斑部病變進展較快，使用抗VEGF藥物(ranibizumab、bevacizumab、aflibercept、pegaptanib)與verteporfin光動力療法；乾性較常見且進展慢。
  • Adverse effects: endophthalmitis, blurred vision, cataract, corneal edema, conjunctival hemorrhage, raised IOP, reduced acuity.不良反應：眼內炎、視力模糊、白內障、角膜水腫、結膜出血、眼壓升高、視力下降。
  • Teach administration and when to notify the provider (pain, vision loss, redness).教導用藥方式及何時通報(疼痛、視力喪失、紅腫)。
PDF p.936, 937

Otic administration and ototoxic drugs耳用給藥與耳毒性藥物

  • Adults: pull pinna up and back; children under 3 y: down and back (older children up and back). Tilt the head away from the affected ear, instill the drops, then gently rock the head back and forth about 5 times to help the medication travel down the canal.成人：耳廓向上向後拉；3歲以下兒童：向下向後拉(年齡較大兒童則向上向後拉)。頭偏向健側後滴入藥液，再輕輕前後搖動頭部約5次，幫助藥液流到耳道深處。
  • Irrigation requires a prescription and visible tympanic membrane; warm to 37 C (98.6 F); aim at canal wall; client ear up with emesis basin and fall precautions; never irrigate if perforation suspected.沖洗需有醫囑且可見鼓膜；加溫至37°C(98.6°F)；朝耳道壁沖；病人患耳朝上，備嘔吐盆與防跌；懷疑穿孔時禁止沖洗。
  • Ototoxic drugs: aminoglycosides (gentamicin, amikacin, streptomycin, tobramycin, neomycin), vancomycin, loop diuretics (furosemide, ethacrynic acid), cisplatin, aspirin, NSAIDs, quinine, sildenafil.耳毒性藥物：胺基糖苷類(gentamicin、amikacin、streptomycin、tobramycin、neomycin)、vancomycin、袢利尿劑(furosemide、ethacrynic acid)、cisplatin、阿斯匹靈、NSAIDs、quinine、sildenafil。
  • Anti-infective ear drops (ofloxacin, ciprofloxacin, gentamicin otic, acetic acid): overgrowth of resistant organisms; keep ears dry; finish course; report dizziness, fever, sore throat.抗感染耳藥(ofloxacin、ciprofloxacin、gentamicin耳劑、acetic acid)：抗藥菌過度生長；保持耳朵乾燥；完成療程；頭暈、發燒、喉嚨痛需通報。
PDF p.937, 938

Antihistamines, decongestants and ceruminolytics抗組織胺、解充血劑與耳垢軟化劑

  • Antihistamines/decongestants reduce mucosal edema to open the eustachian tube; drowsiness, blurred vision, dry mouth; hypertensive clients check with provider first.抗組織胺/解充血劑減輕黏膜水腫以打開耳咽管；嗜睡、視力模糊、口乾；高血壓病人需先詢問醫師。
  • Carbamide peroxide emulsifies cerumen; irritation, redness, swelling; insert cotton plug after drops; irrigate gently with warm water 30 minutes later; mineral oil for chronic impaction.Carbamide peroxide乳化耳垢；刺激、紅腫；滴藥後塞棉球；30分鐘後以溫水輕柔沖洗；慢性耳垢可用礦物油。
  • Do not exceed prescribed frequency; avoid touching ear with dropper; notify provider if redness, pain, or swelling persists.勿超過處方頻率；滴管勿碰耳朵；紅腫疼痛持續需通報。
PDF p.938

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Instill eye drops in the lower conjunctival sac, never on the cornea; press nasolacrimal duct 30-60 s to limit systemic absorption.眼藥水滴在下結膜囊，不可滴在角膜；壓迫鼻淚管30-60秒以減少全身吸收。 PDF p.931, 932
  2. Give eye drops before ointment; separate different eye drugs by 5-10 minutes; glucocorticoid first.先滴眼藥水再擠藥膏；不同眼藥間隔5-10分鐘；類固醇先給。 PDF p.931, 932
  3. Mydriatics/cycloplegics are contraindicated in glaucoma (raise IOP); no driving 24 h.散瞳/睫狀肌麻痺劑青光眼禁用(升高眼壓)；24小時內不可開車。 PDF p.933
  4. Atropine-like drugs raise IOP: glaucoma clients must avoid them; antidote for cholinergic (miotic) toxicity is atropine sulfate.類阿托品藥物升高眼壓：青光眼病人須避免；膽鹼類(縮瞳劑)中毒解毒劑為atropine sulfate。 PDF p.935
  5. Ophthalmic beta blockers: check pulse and BP; hold if pulse <=60 or SBP <90; contraindicated in asthma/COPD.眼用β阻斷劑：測脈搏與血壓；脈搏≦60或收縮壓<90暫停；氣喘/COPD禁用。 PDF p.935
  6. Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors: sulfonamide allergy contraindication; monitor K+, renal stones, increase fluids.碳酸酐酶抑制劑：磺胺過敏禁用；監測鉀、腎結石，增加水分。 PDF p.936
  7. Topical steroids (dexamethasone) can cause cataracts and glaucoma, mask infection, and must not be used for abrasions.局部類固醇(dexamethasone)可造成白內障與青光眼、掩蓋感染，不可用於擦傷。 PDF p.934, 935
  8. Topical anesthetics are never for home use; protect the anesthetized eye until the blink reflex returns.局部麻醉劑不可居家使用；麻醉後眼睛需保護至眨眼反射恢復。 PDF p.934
  9. Glaucoma drugs are lifelong; never stop abruptly.青光眼藥物需終生使用，不可突然停藥。 PDF p.936
  10. Ear irrigation: contraindicated if perforation suspected; warm to 37 C; aim at canal wall, not eardrum.耳朵沖洗：懷疑穿孔禁用；加溫至37°C；朝耳道壁沖，不直射鼓膜。 PDF p.937
  11. Ear drops: adults pull pinna up and back; children under 3 down and back.耳滴劑：成人耳廓向上向後拉；3歲以下向下向後拉。 PDF p.937
  12. Ototoxic drugs: aminoglycosides, loop diuretics, vancomycin, cisplatin, aspirin/NSAIDs, quinine: monitor hearing, tinnitus.耳毒性藥物：胺基糖苷類、袢利尿劑、vancomycin、cisplatin、阿斯匹靈/NSAIDs、quinine：監測聽力與耳鳴。 PDF p.937
  13. Atropine eye drops in infants may cause abdominal distention; record bowel movements and auscultate bowel sounds.嬰兒使用atropine眼藥水可能腹脹；記錄排便並聽診腸音。 PDF p.932
  14. Ocusert pilocarpine disk: replace every 7 days, refrigerate, check position at bedtime and on arising.Ocusert pilocarpine藥片：每7天更換、冷藏、睡前與起床時檢查位置。 PDF p.936

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Glaucoma drug action: Miotics open outflow; Beta blockers and Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors reduce production; Osmotics shrink vitreous.青光眼藥物作用：縮瞳劑增加排出；β阻斷劑與碳酸酐酶抑制劑減少生成；滲透劑縮減玻璃體。 PDF p.934, 935, 936
  • Atropine toxicity: 'dry as a bone, red as a beet, blind as a bat, mad as a hatter, hot as a hare.'Atropine中毒：口乾皮乾、臉紅、視力模糊、精神錯亂、發燒。 PDF p.933

59 Neurological Problems神經系統問題

Covers brain and spinal cord anatomy, neurological diagnostic tests, assessment (LOC, pupils, posturing, GCS), the unconscious client, increased ICP, head injury, craniotomy, aneurysm, seizures, stroke, and major neurological diseases (MS, myasthenia gravis, Parkinson's, trigeminal neuralgia, Bell's palsy, Guillain-Barre, ALS, encephalitis, West Nile, meningitis). Priority themes: airway, ICP control, neuro checks and safety.涵蓋腦與脊髓解剖、神經診斷檢查、神經評估（意識程度、瞳孔、姿勢、GCS）、昏迷病人照護、顱內壓上升、頭部外傷、開顱術、動脈瘤、癲癇、中風，以及多發性硬化症、重症肌無力、帕金森氏症、三叉神經痛、貝爾氏麻痺、格林-巴利症候群、ALS、腦炎、西尼羅病毒與腦膜炎。重點：呼吸道、顱內壓控制、神經檢查與安全。

Anatomy and physiology解剖與生理

  • Each cerebral hemisphere senses and controls the opposite side of the body.每側大腦半球感覺並控制身體對側。
  • Lobes: frontal (Broca's speech, judgment, memory), parietal (touch, pain, spatial perception), temporal (hearing, Wernicke's comprehension), occipital (vision); limbic system governs emotion and memory.額葉（Broca語言區、判斷、記憶）、頂葉（觸痛覺、空間感）、顳葉（聽覺、Wernicke理解區）、枕葉（視覺）；邊緣系統負責情緒與記憶。
  • Hypothalamus regulates temperature, appetite, sleep, fluid balance; pons holds respiratory centers; medulla controls heart rate, breathing, vomiting, swallowing; cerebellum coordinates movement, posture and balance.下視丘調節體溫、食慾、睡眠、體液；橋腦有呼吸中樞；延腦控制心跳、呼吸、嘔吐、吞嚥；小腦協調動作、姿勢與平衡。
  • CSF: pressure 6-25 cm H2O, volume 125-150 mL, about 500 mL produced daily; circle of Willis supplies the brain via carotid and vertebral arteries.腦脊髓液：壓力6-25 cm H2O、總量125-150 mL、每日約產生500 mL；威利氏環由頸動脈與椎動脈供血。
  • Sympathetic (adrenergic, norepinephrine) raises HR/BP and dilates pupils; parasympathetic (cholinergic, acetylcholine) slows HR and increases secretions.交感（腎上腺素性、正腎上腺素）使心跳血壓上升、瞳孔放大；副交感（膽鹼性、乙醯膽鹼）使心跳減慢、分泌增加。
  • Neurons do not regenerate after the neonatal period; peripheral axon repair is slow and needs an intact neurolemma.神經元出生後不再再生；周邊軸突修復緩慢且需神經鞘完整。
PDF p.943, 944

Diagnostic tests診斷檢查

  • CT: check iodine/shellfish allergy and renal function; consider holding metformin with iodinated contrast; encourage fluids afterward.電腦斷層：評估碘/貝類過敏與腎功能；使用含碘顯影劑時考慮暫停metformin；檢查後鼓勵補充水分。
  • MRI: remove all metal; no pacemaker, implanted defibrillator or certain implants; saline lock instead of IV pump; watch for pulse oximeter burns.核磁共振：移除所有金屬；有心律調節器、植入式去顫器等者不可做；用生理食鹽水留置針取代點滴幫浦；注意血氧夾灼傷。
  • Lumbar puncture (L3-L4): contraindicated with increased ICP (herniation risk); lateral knee-chest position; afterward lie flat as prescribed, increase fluids, monitor for headache and CSF leak.腰椎穿刺（L3-L4）：顱內壓上升者禁忌（腦疝風險）；側臥屈膝抱胸；術後依醫囑平躺、增加水分、監測頭痛與腦脊髓液滲漏。
  • Cerebral angiography: assess allergies and renal function, NPO 4-6 h, mark pulses; afterward bed rest ~12 h, check neurovascular status of the limb, and watch for neck swelling or trouble swallowing.腦血管攝影：評估過敏與腎功能、禁食4-6小時、標記脈搏；術後臥床約12小時、監測肢體神經血管狀態，注意頸部腫脹或吞嚥困難。
  • EEG: wash hair, withhold caffeine (and possibly antiseizure drugs) 24-48 h as prescribed; wash hair afterward.腦電圖：先洗髮，依醫囑24-48小時前避免咖啡因（可能含抗癲癇藥）；檢查後洗髮。
  • Caloric testing tests CN VIII/brainstem; normal response is vertigo and nystagmus within 20-30 seconds; absent or disconjugate movement suggests brainstem damage.冷熱水試驗評估第八對腦神經/腦幹；正常為20-30秒內出現眩暈與眼震；無反應或雙眼不協調提示腦幹損傷。
PDF p.944, 945, 946

Neurological assessment and GCS神經評估與昏迷指數

  • Level of consciousness is the earliest and most sensitive indicator of neurological change.意識程度是神經狀態最早也最敏感的指標。
  • Pupils: unilateral dilation = CN III compression; midposition fixed = midbrain; pinpoint = pons or opioids; bilateral fixed dilated = ominous.瞳孔：單側放大＝第三對腦神經受壓；中位固定＝中腦；針尖樣＝橋腦或鴉片類；雙側放大固定＝嚴重不良徵兆。
  • Decorticate (flexor) posturing = cortex dysfunction; decerebrate (extensor) = brainstem lesion; flaccid = no response.去皮質（屈曲）姿勢＝大腦皮質功能不良；去大腦（伸直）姿勢＝腦幹病灶；鬆弛＝無反應。
  • Respiratory patterns: Cheyne-Stokes (hemispheres/metabolic), neurogenic hyperventilation (midbrain/pons), apneustic (pons), cluster, ataxic (medulla).呼吸型態：陳施氏（大腦/代謝）、神經性過度換氣（中腦/橋腦）、長吸式（橋腦）、群集式、運動失調式（延腦）。
  • Babinski is abnormal after age 2; loss of corneal reflex = CN V; loss of gag = CN IX and X.兩歲以後巴賓斯基反射陽性為異常；角膜反射消失＝第五對腦神經；嘔吐反射消失＝第九、十對。
  • Meningeal irritation: nuchal rigidity, Kernig's and Brudzinski's signs, photophobia, severe headache, fever.腦膜刺激：頸項僵硬、Kernig氏與Brudzinski氏徵象、畏光、劇烈頭痛、發燒。
  • GCS ranges 3-15 (eye 1-4, verbal 1-5, motor 1-6); below 8 indicates coma.GCS範圍3-15分（睜眼1-4、語言1-5、運動1-6）；低於8分表示昏迷。
PDF p.946, 947, 948

Unconscious client and increased ICP昏迷病人與顱內壓上升

  • Care of the unconscious client: airway and ventilation first, semi-Fowler's, turn every 2 h, NPO until swallow/gag returns, eye care, ROM, footboard, assume the client can hear.昏迷照護：首重呼吸道與通氣、半坐臥、每2小時翻身、吞嚥/嘔吐反射恢復前禁食、眼部護理、關節活動、腳板防垂足、假設病人聽得見。
  • Early sign of rising ICP: decreased LOC; later: headache, vomiting, pupil changes, rising systolic BP with widening pulse pressure, bradycardia, irregular respirations (Cushing's triad), fever, posturing, seizures.ICP上升早期：意識下降；後期：頭痛、嘔吐、瞳孔變化、收縮壓升高與脈搏壓增寬、心搏過緩、呼吸不規則（庫欣三徵）、發燒、姿勢異常、癲癇。
  • Interventions: HOB 30-40 degrees, head midline, avoid hip/neck flexion, Trendelenburg and Valsalva; limit fluids (~1200 mL/day), quiet environment, prevent shivering and hypoxia; avoid morphine.處置：床頭抬高30-40度、頭部正中、避免髖/頸屈曲、頭低腳高位與Valsalva；限水（約1200 mL/日）、安靜環境、預防寒顫與缺氧；避免嗎啡。
  • Mechanical ventilation with PaCO2 30-35 mm Hg causes cerebral vasoconstriction and lowers ICP.機械通氣維持PaCO2 30-35 mm Hg可使腦血管收縮、降低顱內壓。
  • Medications: antiseizure, antipyretics/muscle relaxants, BP control (notify if SBP <100 or >150), corticosteroids (taper slowly), IV fluids by pump, osmotic diuretics (monitor renal function).藥物：抗癲癇藥、退燒藥/肌肉鬆弛劑、血壓控制（收縮壓<100或>150通知醫師）、類固醇（需緩慢減量）、點滴使用幫浦、滲透性利尿劑（監測腎功能）。
  • Hyperthermia (>105 F / 40.6 C) raises cerebral metabolism; cool with fluids, baths, fans or cooling blanket and prevent shivering. VP shunt diverts CSF to the peritoneum; watch for shunt failure and infection.高熱（>105°F/40.6°C）增加腦代謝；以輸液、冷水浴、風扇或降溫毯降溫並防寒顫。腦室腹腔分流將腦脊髓液導入腹腔；注意分流失效與感染。
PDF p.948, 949, 950

Head injury and craniotomy頭部外傷與開顱術

  • Epidural hematoma: arterial, rapid, lucid interval then coma; surgical emergency. Subdural: venous, slower. Concussion, contusion and skull fractures are other injury types.硬腦膜外血腫：動脈出血、進展快、有清醒期後昏迷，為外科急症。硬腦膜下血腫：靜脈出血、較慢。另有腦震盪、腦挫傷與顱骨骨折。
  • CSF leak from nose/ear: halo (ring) sign and glucose-positive; do not suction the nose, clean the ear or let the client blow the nose; apply loose dry sterile dressing and notify the PHCP.鼻/耳漏出腦脊髓液：出現暈環徵並葡萄糖陽性；勿經鼻抽吸、清潔耳道或擤鼻；以鬆的乾燥無菌敷料覆蓋並通知醫師。
  • Head injury care: patent airway, HOB elevated, avoid neck flexion and coughing, seizure precautions, monitor neuro status and for infection; give opioids cautiously.頭部外傷照護：維持呼吸道、抬高床頭、避免頸屈曲與咳嗽、癲癇預防、監測神經狀態與感染；鴉片類藥物須謹慎。
  • Craniotomy complications: increased ICP, hemorrhage, CSF obstruction, DI, SIADH, infection. Monitor neuro status every 30-60 min, drain output (report >30-50 mL per shift), fluid restriction ~1500 mL/day.開顱術併發症：ICP上升、出血、腦脊髓液阻塞、尿崩症、抗利尿激素分泌不當症候群、感染。每30-60分鐘監測神經狀態、引流量（每班>30-50 mL需通報）、限水約1500 mL/日。
  • Positioning after surgery follows prescription: bone flap removal - turn to the nonoperative side; posterior fossa - side-lying; infratentorial - flat or HOB 30-45 per order; supratentorial - HOB 30 degrees.術後擺位依醫囑：骨瓣移除－翻向非手術側；後顱窩－側臥；幕下手術－平躺或依醫囑抬高30-45度；幕上手術－床頭抬高30度。
  • Periorbital edema and ecchymosis may be expected after craniotomy; use ice packs as prescribed.開顱術後可預期眼周水腫與瘀青；依醫囑冰敷。
PDF p.950, 951, 952, 953

Cerebral aneurysm and seizures腦動脈瘤與癲癇

  • Aneurysm precautions: bed rest, semi-Fowler's or side-lying, dark quiet room, limited visitors, avoid Valsalva (stool softeners), no rectal temperatures, prevent hypertension, DVT prophylaxis, antiseizure drugs.動脈瘤預防措施：臥床休息、半坐臥或側臥、昏暗安靜、限制訪客、避免Valsalva（給軟便劑）、勿測肛溫、預防高血壓、預防深部靜脈栓塞、抗癲癇藥。
  • Seizure types: tonic-clonic (tonic 10-20 s then clonic ~30 s), absence (brief staring, children), myoclonic, atonic, simple partial (conscious), complex partial (temporal lobe, altered awareness).癲癇類型：強直-陣攣（強直10-20秒後陣攣約30秒）、失神（短暫凝視、常見於兒童）、肌躁、失張力、單純局部（意識清楚）、複雜局部（顳葉、意識改變）。
  • During a seizure: note time, protect the head, lower to the floor, side-lying, loosen clothing, suction/oxygen ready, stay with client; do NOT restrain or place anything in the mouth.發作時：記錄時間、保護頭部、移至地板、側臥、鬆開衣物、備好抽吸/氧氣、陪伴；勿約束或放入口中物品。
  • Status epilepticus: rapid succession of seizures without recovery of consciousness; an emergency with risk of brain damage.癲癇重積狀態：連續發作而意識未恢復；屬急症，可致腦損傷。
  • Teaching: lifelong medication with level monitoring, avoid alcohol, stress, fatigue and strobe lights, wear a medical ID bracelet.衛教：終生服藥並監測血中濃度、避免酒精、壓力、疲勞與閃光、配戴醫療警示手環。
PDF p.952, 953, 954

Stroke (brain attack)中風（腦中風）

  • Ischemic (thrombotic, embolic) vs hemorrhagic; type must be confirmed by CT because symptoms overlap and treatment differs. TIA is a warning sign.缺血性（血栓、栓塞）與出血性；症狀相似但治療不同，需以CT確認類型。短暫性腦缺血發作為警訊。
  • Check fingerstick glucose to rule out hypoglycemia; airway is always the priority; deficits appear on the side opposite the lesion.測指尖血糖排除低血糖；呼吸道永遠優先；缺損出現在病灶對側。
  • Left-brain stroke: right hemiplegia, aphasia, slow cautious, aware of deficits. Right-brain stroke: left hemiplegia, neglect, impulsive, poor judgment, denies problems.左腦中風：右側偏癱、失語、緩慢謹慎、知道自己缺損。右腦中風：左側偏癱、忽略症、衝動、判斷力差、否認問題。
  • Expressive aphasia (Broca's) - understands but cannot speak; receptive (Wernicke's) - cannot understand. Use one-step directions, picture boards, allow time.表達性失語（Broca）－聽得懂但說不出；接受性失語（Wernicke）－聽不懂。使用單一步驟指令、圖卡、給予時間。
  • Acute phase: keep BP around 150/100 for perfusion, HOB 15-30 degrees, side-lying, suction orally and not longer than 10 seconds, ICP risk highest in first 72 hours.急性期：血壓維持約150/100以保持腦灌流、床頭15-30度、側臥、經口抽吸且不超過10秒、前72小時為ICP高風險期。
  • Post-acute: position 2 h on unaffected side and 20 min on affected side, passive ROM, swallow evaluation, thickened fluids, chin-down, food on the unaffected side.急性期後：健側臥2小時、患側臥20分鐘、被動關節活動、吞嚥評估、增稠液體、下巴微收、食物放健側。
  • Homonymous hemianopsia and neglect: approach from the unaffected side, place items in the intact visual field, teach head turning to scan.同側偏盲與忽略症：從健側接近、物品放在可視野、教導轉頭掃視。
PDF p.954, 955, 956

MS, myasthenia gravis, Parkinson's多發性硬化症、重症肌無力、帕金森氏症

  • MS: demyelination, remissions and exacerbations; fatigue, ataxia, spasticity, diplopia, bladder/bowel problems; avoid heat, fatigue, stress and infection; IV glucocorticoids for flare-ups.多發性硬化症：去髓鞘、緩解與惡化交替；疲倦、運動失調、痙攣、複視、膀胱/腸道問題；避免熱、疲勞、壓力與感染；急性發作用靜脈類固醇。
  • Myasthenia gravis: weakness worse with activity, ptosis, diplopia, dysphagia; respiratory failure risk; plan activity at peak strength; anticholinesterase drugs on time.重症肌無力：活動後無力加重、眼瞼下垂、複視、吞嚥困難；有呼吸衰竭風險；在肌力高峰安排活動；按時給予抗膽鹼酯酶藥。
  • Myasthenic crisis = too little medication (strength improves with edrophonium); cholinergic crisis = too much (cramps, diarrhea, miosis, bradycardia, secretions; edrophonium worsens weakness); antidote atropine.肌無力危象＝藥量不足（給edrophonium會改善）；膽鹼性危象＝藥量過多（腹絞痛、腹瀉、瞳孔縮小、心搏過緩、分泌物多；edrophonium使無力加重）；解毒劑為atropine。
  • Edrophonium test: keep atropine and emergency equipment available (risk of ventricular fibrillation/arrest).Edrophonium試驗：備妥atropine與急救設備（有心室顫動/心跳停止風險）。
  • Parkinson's: dopamine depletion; bradykinesia, resting pill-rolling tremor, rigidity, masklike face, shuffling gait, drooling.帕金森氏症：多巴胺缺乏；動作遲緩、靜止性搓丸樣顫抖、僵硬、面具臉、拖曳步態、流口水。
  • Parkinson's care: high-calorie, high-protein, high-fiber soft diet, 2000 mL fluids, low-heeled shoes, lift feet, avoid rushing; avoid vitamin B6-rich foods with levodopa and avoid MAO inhibitors.帕金森照護：高熱量高蛋白高纖軟食、水分2000 mL、低跟鞋、抬腳走路、勿催促；使用levodopa時避免高維生素B6食物，避免MAO抑制劑。
PDF p.957, 958, 959

Cranial nerve and neuromuscular disorders腦神經與神經肌肉疾病

  • Trigeminal neuralgia (CN V): severe sharp facial pain triggered by cold, washing, chewing; avoid temperature extremes, chew on unaffected side; surgical options include microvascular decompression and rhizotomy.三叉神經痛（第五對）：因冷、洗臉、咀嚼誘發的劇烈刺痛；避免冷熱、用健側咀嚼；手術包括微血管減壓與神經根切斷術。
  • Bell's palsy (CN VII): one-sided facial paralysis, loss of taste, cannot close eyelid; protect the eye from dryness, facial exercises, chew on the unaffected side; usually recovers in weeks.貝爾氏麻痺（第七對）：單側顏面麻痺、味覺喪失、眼瞼無法閉合；保護眼睛防乾燥、臉部運動、用健側咀嚼；通常數週內恢復。
  • Guillain-Barre: follows infection by days to weeks; ascending symmetric weakness, paresthesias, CSF protein elevated; main danger is respiratory failure and dysrhythmias; recovery is slow.格林-巴利症候群：感染後數日至數週發生；上行性對稱無力、感覺異常、腦脊髓液蛋白升高；主要危險為呼吸衰竭與心律不整；恢復緩慢。
  • ALS: progressive motor neuron disease, sensory, autonomic and mental status spared; weakness, atrophy, fasciculations, dysphagia, dysarthria; supportive care and advance directives.ALS：進行性運動神經元疾病，感覺、自律神經與心智不受影響；無力、萎縮、肌束顫動、吞嚥與構音困難；支持性照護與預立醫囑。
PDF p.959, 960

CNS infections中樞神經感染

  • Encephalitis: brain inflammation, usually viral (HSV-1, arboviruses); fever, altered LOC, signs of ICP; acyclovir for herpes encephalitis; HOB 30-45 degrees.腦炎：腦實質發炎，多為病毒（HSV-1、蟲媒病毒）；發燒、意識改變、ICP徵象；疱疹性腦炎用acyclovir；床頭抬高30-45度。
  • West Nile virus: mosquito-borne, symptoms 3-14 days after bite, many asymptomatic; care is supportive; prevent with DEET, long sleeves, eliminating standing water.西尼羅病毒：蚊媒傳播、被叮咬後3-14天發病、許多人無症狀；以支持性照護；以DEET、長袖與清除積水預防。
  • Meningitis: fever, nuchal rigidity, photophobia, positive Kernig and Brudzinski; CSF cloudy with high protein and WBC and low glucose; meningococcal rash is red macular.腦膜炎：發燒、頸僵硬、畏光、Kernig與Brudzinski陽性；腦脊髓液混濁、蛋白與白血球升高、葡萄糖降低；腦膜炎雙球菌有紅色斑疹。
  • Meningitis care: droplet/isolation precautions for bacterial types, seizure precautions, quiet dim room, HOB 30 degrees, avoid neck/hip flexion, antibiotics and analgesics.腦膜炎照護：細菌性採飛沫/隔離預防、癲癇預防、安靜昏暗環境、床頭30度、避免頸/髖過度屈曲、給予抗生素與止痛藥。
PDF p.960, 961

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Change in level of consciousness is the earliest, most sensitive sign of increased ICP.意識程度改變是ICP上升最早且最敏感的徵象。 PDF p.947, 948
  2. Late ICP signs (Cushing's triad): rising systolic BP with widened pulse pressure, bradycardia, irregular respirations.ICP晚期徵象（庫欣三徵）：收縮壓升高且脈搏壓增寬、心搏過緩、呼吸不規則。 PDF p.948, 949
  3. Increased ICP: HOB 30-40 degrees, avoid Trendelenburg, neck/hip flexion, Valsalva, coughing; avoid morphine; PaCO2 30-35 mm Hg.ICP上升：床頭30-40度，避免頭低位、頸/髖屈曲、Valsalva、咳嗽；避免嗎啡；PaCO2 30-35 mm Hg。 PDF p.949
  4. Lumbar puncture is contraindicated with increased ICP (herniation).顱內壓上升者禁做腰椎穿刺（腦疝）。 PDF p.945
  5. GCS below 8 = coma; range 3-15.GCS低於8分＝昏迷；範圍3-15。 PDF p.948
  6. Epidural hematoma: arterial bleed, lucid interval, then rapid deterioration; surgical emergency.硬腦膜外血腫：動脈出血、清醒期後急速惡化；為外科急症。 PDF p.951
  7. CSF leak: halo sign and glucose-positive; no nasal suction, no nose blowing; loose sterile dry dressing.腦脊髓液漏：暈環徵與葡萄糖陽性；勿經鼻抽吸、擤鼻；鬆敷乾燥無菌敷料。 PDF p.951
  8. Seizure: protect head, side-lying, never restrain or put objects in the mouth, record time and characteristics.癲癇發作：保護頭部、側臥、絕不約束或放物入口、記錄時間與特徵。 PDF p.953
  9. Stroke: airway first, check glucose, confirm type by CT; BP about 150/100 in acute stroke; ICP risk highest in the first 72 hours.中風：先顧呼吸道、測血糖、CT確認類型；急性期血壓約150/100；前72小時ICP風險最高。 PDF p.955, 956
  10. Stroke feeding: sit upright, chin slightly flexed, food in the back of the mouth on the unaffected side, thickened fluids; never suction nasally or over 10 seconds.中風進食：坐直、下巴微收、食物置口腔後方健側、增稠液體；勿經鼻抽吸且不超過10秒。 PDF p.956
  11. Myasthenic crisis (undermedicated) vs cholinergic crisis (overmedicated): withhold anticholinesterase and give atropine in cholinergic crisis; edrophonium differentiates.肌無力危象（藥量不足）與膽鹼性危象（藥量過多）：膽鹼性危象停用抗膽鹼酯酶並給atropine；edrophonium可區分。 PDF p.958
  12. Guillain-Barre: respiratory failure is the major concern; keep intubation equipment and ECG monitoring available.格林-巴利：主要顧慮為呼吸衰竭；備妥插管設備與心電圖監測。 PDF p.960
  13. Parkinson's: avoid vitamin B6-rich foods with levodopa and avoid MAO inhibitors (hypertensive crisis).帕金森：使用levodopa時避免高維生素B6食物，避免MAO抑制劑（高血壓危象）。 PDF p.959
  14. Aneurysm precautions: quiet, dim room, no straining, no rectal temperatures, prevent hypertension.動脈瘤預防措施：安靜昏暗、勿用力解便、勿測肛溫、預防高血壓。 PDF p.952, 953
  15. Meningitis: CSF cloudy, high protein/WBC, low glucose; positive Kernig/Brudzinski; isolation for bacterial types.腦膜炎：腦脊髓液混濁、蛋白/白血球高、葡萄糖低；Kernig/Brudzinski陽性；細菌性需隔離。 PDF p.961
  16. Pupils: unilateral dilated = CN III compression; bilateral fixed dilated = ominous; pinpoint = pons or opioids.瞳孔：單側放大＝第三對受壓；雙側固定放大＝嚴重；針尖＝橋腦或鴉片類。 PDF p.947

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Right brain = Risky (impulsive, neglect, left-sided deficits); Left brain = Language (aphasia, slow and cautious, right-sided deficits).右腦＝冒險（衝動、忽略症、左側缺損）；左腦＝語言（失語、緩慢謹慎、右側缺損）。 PDF p.955
  • Cholinergic crisis = SLUDGE/DUMBELS signs (salivation, lacrimation, urination, defecation, GI cramps, emesis) - too much drug; myasthenic crisis = too little.膽鹼性危象＝SLUDGE症狀（流涎、流淚、排尿、排便、腸胃絞痛、嘔吐）－藥過量；肌無力危象＝藥不足。 PDF p.958
  • Cushing's triad: high BP (wide pulse pressure), low HR, irregular respirations.庫欣三徵：高血壓（脈搏壓增寬）、心搏過慢、呼吸不規則。 PDF p.948, 949

60 Neurological Medications神經系統藥物

Drug classes used in neurological care: antimyasthenics, multiple sclerosis agents, antiparkinsonians, antiseizure drugs, CNS stimulants, NSAIDs and acetaminophen, opioids and antagonists, and osmotic diuretics. Focus on actions, toxicity signs, serum levels, antidotes and teaching.涵蓋神經照護常用藥物類別：抗肌無力藥、多發性硬化症用藥、抗帕金森藥、抗癲癇藥、中樞神經興奮劑、NSAID與acetaminophen、鴉片類與拮抗劑、滲透性利尿劑。重點為作用、毒性徵象、血中濃度、解毒劑與衛教。

Antimyasthenic (anticholinesterase) drugs抗肌無力藥（抗膽鹼酯酶）

  • Class/examples: neostigmine, pyridostigmine (treatment); edrophonium (diagnosis, distinguishes myasthenic from cholinergic crisis).類別/例：neostigmine、pyridostigmine（治療）；edrophonium（診斷，區分肌無力與膽鹼性危象）。
  • Action: block acetylcholine breakdown at the neuromuscular junction, improving strength.作用：阻斷神經肌肉接合處乙醯膽鹼分解，增進肌力。
  • Adverse effects (overdose = cholinergic crisis): abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, miosis, blurred vision, bradycardia, bronchospasm, increased secretions, sweating, hypotension, facial twitching.不良反應（過量＝膽鹼性危象）：腹絞痛、噁心嘔吐、腹瀉、瞳孔縮小、視力模糊、心搏過緩、支氣管痙攣、分泌物增加、出汗、低血壓、臉部抽動。
  • Antidote: atropine sulfate; keep atropine and resuscitation equipment ready during edrophonium use.解毒劑：atropine sulfate；使用edrophonium時備妥atropine與急救設備。
  • Nursing: give on time (lifelong), with a little food; meal 45-60 min after dose to reduce aspiration risk; assess strength, reflexes, gait; MedicAlert bracelet.護理：準時服用（終生）、搭配少量食物；服藥後45-60分鐘再進餐以降低吸入風險；評估肌力、反射、步態；配戴醫療警示手環。
PDF p.969

Multiple sclerosis medications多發性硬化症藥物

  • Disease-modifying immunomodulators: interferon beta, glatiramer, dimethyl fumarate, fingolimod, teriflunomide, cladribine; reduce relapses and lesions.疾病修飾免疫調節劑：interferon beta、glatiramer、dimethyl fumarate、fingolimod、teriflunomide、cladribine；減少復發與病灶。
  • Immunomodulator adverse effects: flu-like reactions, hepatotoxicity, myelosuppression, injection-site reactions, depression.免疫調節劑不良反應：類流感反應、肝毒性、骨髓抑制、注射部位反應、憂鬱。
  • Immunosuppressants (mitoxantrone) and monoclonal antibodies (alemtuzumab, natalizumab, ocrelizumab, ofatumumab): myelosuppression, cardiotoxicity, fetal harm, alopecia, GI injury.免疫抑制劑（mitoxantrone）與單株抗體（alemtuzumab、natalizumab、ocrelizumab、ofatumumab）：骨髓抑制、心毒性、胎兒傷害、落髮、胃腸黏膜損傷。
  • Acute relapse: high-dose IV glucocorticoid (methylprednisolone) or IV immune globulin.急性復發：高劑量靜脈類固醇（methylprednisolone）或靜脈免疫球蛋白。
  • Symptom drugs: psyllium/docusate (bowel), memantine (cognition), fluoxetine/sertraline (depression), amantadine/modafinil (fatigue), gabapentin/carbamazepine (neuropathic pain), dalfampridine (walking speed).症狀用藥：psyllium/docusate（腸道）、memantine（認知）、fluoxetine/sertraline（憂鬱）、amantadine/modafinil（疲倦）、gabapentin/carbamazepine（神經痛）、dalfampridine（行走速度）。
PDF p.969, 970

Antiparkinsonian drugs抗帕金森藥

  • Dopaminergics (carbidopa-levodopa, pramipexole, ropinirole, bromocriptine, amantadine, apomorphine, selegiline, rasagiline): increase dopamine activity; contraindicated in significant cardiac, renal or psychiatric disease.多巴胺類（carbidopa-levodopa、pramipexole、ropinirole、bromocriptine、amantadine、apomorphine、selegiline、rasagiline）：增加多巴胺作用；重度心、腎或精神疾病者禁用。
  • Adverse effects: dyskinesia, orthostatic hypotension, nausea/vomiting, hallucinations, confusion, depression, urinary retention, constipation, insomnia.不良反應：異動症、姿位性低血壓、噁心嘔吐、幻覺、意識混亂、憂鬱、尿滯留、便秘、失眠。
  • Carbidopa-levodopa with MAO inhibitor antidepressant can cause hypertensive crisis; avoid excess vitamin B6; spread protein across meals; urine and sweat may darken (harmless); do not stop abruptly.carbidopa-levodopa與MAO抑制劑類抗憂鬱藥併用可致高血壓危象；避免過量維生素B6；蛋白質平均分配於各餐；尿與汗可能變色（無害）；勿突然停藥。
  • Diabetic clients should not rely on urine glucose testing with levodopa.糖尿病病人使用levodopa時勿以尿糖檢測。
  • Anticholinergics (benztropine, trihexyphenidyl): reduce tremor and drooling; little effect on rigidity/bradykinesia; contraindicated in glaucoma.抗膽鹼藥（benztropine、trihexyphenidyl）：減少顫抖與流口水；對僵硬與動作遲緩效果小；青光眼禁用。
  • Anticholinergic effects: dry mouth, blurred vision, tachycardia, constipation, urinary retention, confusion, photophobia; use ice chips/sugarless candy, sunglasses, fluids and fiber; abrupt stop worsens parkinsonism.抗膽鹼副作用：口乾、視力模糊、心搏過速、便秘、尿滯留、意識混亂、畏光；以冰塊/無糖糖果、太陽眼鏡、水分與纖維緩解；突然停藥使症狀加重。
  • COMT inhibitors (entacapone, opicapone, tolcapone) block peripheral dopamine metabolism and extend levodopa effect.COMT抑制劑（entacapone、opicapone、tolcapone）阻斷周邊多巴胺代謝，延長levodopa效果。
PDF p.970, 971

Antiseizure drugs抗癲癇藥

  • Action: depress abnormal neuronal discharge and prevent spread. Monitor serum levels, liver and renal function, signs of toxicity (CNS depression, ataxia, nystagmus, visual disturbance). Seizure precautions.作用：抑制異常神經放電並防止擴散。監測血中濃度、肝腎功能與毒性徵象（中樞抑制、運動失調、眼震、視覺障礙）。癲癇預防措施。
  • Therapeutic ranges: phenytoin 10-20 mcg/mL, carbamazepine 3-14, divalproex 50-100, phenobarbital 15-40, ethosuximide 40-100 mcg/mL; clonazepam 20-80 and lorazepam 50-240 ng/mL.治療濃度：phenytoin 10-20 mcg/mL、carbamazepine 3-14、divalproex 50-100、phenobarbital 15-40、ethosuximide 40-100 mcg/mL；clonazepam 20-80、lorazepam 50-240 ng/mL。
  • Hydantoins (phenytoin, fosphenytoin): gingival hyperplasia, nystagmus, ataxia, hirsutism, blood dyscrasias, hyperglycemia, teratogenic, may reduce birth control effectiveness. IV: normal saline only (dextrose precipitates), inline filter, no faster than 25-50 mg/min (hypotension, dysrhythmias); separate tube feedings.乙內醯脲類（phenytoin、fosphenytoin）：牙齦增生、眼震、運動失調、多毛、血液惡病質、高血糖、致畸胎、可能降低避孕藥效果。靜脈：僅用生理食鹽水（葡萄糖會沈澱）、使用過濾器、速率不超過25-50 mg/分（低血壓、心律不整）；與管灌飲食分開給藥。
  • Barbiturates (phenobarbital): tonic-clonic and status epilepticus; sedation, respiratory depression, hypotension, tolerance.巴比妥類（phenobarbital）：強直-陣攣與癲癇重積；鎮靜、呼吸抑制、低血壓、耐受性。
  • Benzodiazepines (diazepam, lorazepam, clonazepam, clorazepate): status epilepticus, absence; sedation, dependence, hepatotoxicity, blood dyscrasias; IV slowly; antidote flumazenil but avoid in increased ICP or status epilepticus treated with benzodiazepines.苯二氮平類（diazepam、lorazepam、clonazepam、clorazepate）：癲癇重積、失神發作；鎮靜、依賴、肝毒性、血液惡病質；靜脈緩慢給予；解毒劑flumazenil，但顱內壓升高或以苯二氮平治療的癲癇重積者避免使用。
  • Succinimides (ethosuximide): absence seizures; GI upset, blood dyscrasias.Succinimide類（ethosuximide）：失神發作；腸胃不適、血液惡病質。
  • Valproates (valproic acid, divalproex): pancreatitis, hepatotoxicity, thrombocytopenia, teratogenic (neural tube defects).Valproate類（valproic acid、divalproex）：胰臟炎、肝毒性、血小板低下、致畸胎（神經管缺損）。
  • Carbamazepine (iminostilbene): also trigeminal neuralgia; drowsiness, rash, agranulocytosis/aplastic anemia - report sore throat, bruising, fever; check CBC.Carbamazepine（亞胺芪類）：亦用於三叉神經痛；嗜睡、皮疹、顆粒球缺乏/再生不良性貧血－喉嚨痛、瘀青、發燒須通報；監測CBC。
  • Education: never stop abruptly, avoid alcohol, take with food but not milk/antacids, soft toothbrush and dental care, medical ID.衛教：勿突然停藥、避免酒精、隨食物服用但避免牛奶/制酸劑、軟毛牙刷與牙科檢查、配戴醫療警示。
PDF p.971, 972, 973

CNS stimulants中樞神經興奮劑

  • Examples: amphetamines, methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, lisdexamfetamine, atomoxetine, caffeine; anorexiants (phentermine). Used for narcolepsy, ADHD, adjunct for obesity.例：安非他命類、methylphenidate、dexmethylphenidate、lisdexamfetamine、atomoxetine、咖啡因；食慾抑制劑（phentermine）。用於猝睡症、ADHD、肥胖輔助。
  • Adverse effects: irritability, insomnia, tachycardia, hypertension, dysrhythmias, anorexia/weight loss, psychosis, dependence.不良反應：易怒、失眠、心搏過速、高血壓、心律不整、厭食/體重減輕、精神病症狀、依賴。
  • Nursing: monitor vital signs, CBC, growth in children; give before meals, last dose at least 6 h before bedtime; do not crush long-acting forms; avoid caffeine; do not stop abruptly; effect in ADHD in 3-4 weeks.護理：監測生命徵象、CBC、兒童生長；餐前服用、最後一劑在睡前至少6小時；長效劑型勿壓碎；避免咖啡因；勿突然停藥；ADHD約3-4週見效。
PDF p.973, 974

NSAIDs, aspirin and acetaminophenNSAID、阿斯匹靈與acetaminophen

  • NSAIDs/aspirin inhibit prostaglandin synthesis: analgesic, antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, antiplatelet. Examples: ibuprofen, naproxen, ketorolac, diclofenac, indomethacin, meloxicam; celecoxib (COX-2).NSAID/aspirin抑制前列腺素合成：止痛、退燒、抗發炎、抗血小板。例：ibuprofen、naproxen、ketorolac、diclofenac、indomethacin、meloxicam；celecoxib（COX-2）。
  • Adverse effects: GI irritation/bleeding, renal impairment, fluid retention, tinnitus (salicylism), cardiovascular thrombotic events, blood dyscrasias. Monitor salicylate level with high doses.不良反應：胃腸刺激/出血、腎功能下降、水腫、耳鳴（水楊酸中毒）、心血管血栓事件、血液惡病質。大劑量時監測水楊酸濃度。
  • Avoid in anticoagulant therapy and liver/renal disease; do not combine aspirin with another NSAID; children with flu/varicella: no aspirin (Reye's syndrome); stop aspirin 3-7 days before surgery as prescribed.抗凝血治療與肝腎疾病者避免；aspirin不與其他NSAID併用；兒童流感/水痘勿用aspirin（雷氏症候群）；依醫囑術前3-7天停aspirin。
  • Teach: take with food/milk, sit upright 20-30 min after aspirin, do not crush enteric-coated tablets, avoid alcohol, watch for tarry stools and bruising.衛教：隨食物/牛奶服用、服aspirin後坐直20-30分鐘、腸溶錠勿壓碎、避免酒精、注意黑便與瘀青。
  • Acetaminophen: analgesic and antipyretic; hepatotoxicity risk above 4000 mg/day; antidote acetylcysteine; avoid in liver disease and alcoholism; self-use no longer than 10 days (adult) / 5 days (child); monitor liver enzymes.Acetaminophen：止痛退燒；每日超過4000 mg有肝毒性風險；解毒劑acetylcysteine；肝病與酗酒者避免；自行使用成人不超過10天、兒童5天；監測肝酵素。
PDF p.974, 975

Opioids and opioid antagonists鴉片類與鴉片拮抗劑

  • Examples: morphine, hydromorphone, fentanyl, methadone, oxycodone, codeine, tapentadol. Act on opioid receptors; cause sedation, euphoria, dependence.例：morphine、hydromorphone、fentanyl、methadone、oxycodone、codeine、tapentadol。作用於鴉片受體；造成鎮靜、欣快、依賴。
  • Adverse effects: respiratory depression, orthostatic hypotension, urinary retention, nausea/vomiting, constipation, sedation, confusion, cough suppression, miosis.不良反應：呼吸抑制、姿位性低血壓、尿滯留、噁心嘔吐、便秘、鎮靜、意識混亂、咳嗽抑制、瞳孔縮小。
  • Hold dose if adult respiratory rate <12 (unless ventilated or terminal as prescribed) or bradycardia; give 30-60 min before painful activity; encourage turning, deep breathing; manage constipation.成人呼吸<12次/分（除非有呼吸支持或依醫囑末期）或心搏過緩時暫停給藥；疼痛活動前30-60分鐘給藥；鼓勵翻身深呼吸；處理便秘。
  • Opioid antagonists (naloxone, naltrexone, methylnaltrexone, naloxegol, alvimopan): reverse opioid respiratory depression.鴉片拮抗劑（naloxone、naltrexone、methylnaltrexone、naloxegol、alvimopan）：逆轉鴉片所致呼吸抑制。
  • After naloxone: check BP, pulse, respirations every 5 min then taper, cardiac monitor, stay with client; its short half-life means overdose signs can return.給予naloxone後：每5分鐘測血壓、脈搏、呼吸後逐漸延長、心電監測、不離開病人；因半衰期短，過量症狀可能再發。
PDF p.975, 976

Osmotic diuretics (mannitol)滲透性利尿劑（mannitol）

  • Action: raises osmotic pressure of filtrate; used to lower ICP and intraocular pressure and for oliguria.作用：提高濾液滲透壓；用於降低顱內壓與眼壓、少尿。
  • Adverse effects: fluid and electrolyte imbalance, pulmonary edema, hyponatremia, dehydration, headache, tachycardia.不良反應：體液電解質失衡、肺水腫、低血鈉、脫水、頭痛、心搏過速。
  • Monitor weight, urine output, electrolytes, lungs, neuro status; do not use mannitol vials with crystals; change position slowly.監測體重、尿量、電解質、肺部、神經狀態；有結晶之mannitol瓶勿使用；緩慢改變姿勢。
PDF p.976, 977

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Cholinergic crisis (anticholinesterase overdose): cramps, diarrhea, miosis, bradycardia, secretions; withhold drug and give atropine.膽鹼性危象（抗膽鹼酯酶過量）：絞痛、腹瀉、瞳孔縮小、心搏過緩、分泌物多；停藥並給atropine。 PDF p.969, 970
  2. Edrophonium: improvement = myasthenic crisis (needs more drug); worsening = cholinergic crisis. Have atropine and resuscitation equipment ready.Edrophonium：改善＝肌無力危象（需加藥）；惡化＝膽鹼性危象。備妥atropine與急救設備。 PDF p.969, 978
  3. Phenytoin therapeutic level 10-20 mcg/mL; nystagmus above 20, ataxia and slurred speech above 30.Phenytoin治療濃度10-20 mcg/mL；超過20出現眼震、超過30出現運動失調與口齒不清。 PDF p.972, 978
  4. IV phenytoin: normal saline only, inline filter, max 25-50 mg/min; fast infusion causes hypotension and dysrhythmias.靜脈phenytoin：僅用生理食鹽水、過濾器、最快25-50 mg/分；過快造成低血壓與心律不整。 PDF p.972
  5. Phenytoin: gingival hyperplasia - good oral hygiene; may decrease birth control effectiveness; teratogenic.Phenytoin：牙齦增生－保持口腔衛生；可能降低避孕藥效果；致畸胎。 PDF p.972
  6. Carbamazepine: agranulocytosis/aplastic anemia; low WBC is the adverse-effect lab finding.Carbamazepine：顆粒球缺乏/再生不良性貧血；白血球過低為不良反應檢驗發現。 PDF p.973, 979
  7. Valproate: hepatotoxicity, pancreatitis, thrombocytopenia, neural tube defects.Valproate：肝毒性、胰臟炎、血小板低下、神經管缺損。 PDF p.973
  8. Flumazenil reverses benzodiazepines but avoid with increased ICP or seizure disorders treated with benzodiazepines.Flumazenil可逆轉苯二氮平，但顱內壓升高或以苯二氮平控制癲癇者避免。 PDF p.973
  9. Carbidopa-levodopa: avoid MAOIs (hypertensive crisis), limit vitamin B6, spread protein; dyskinesia is a key adverse effect; never stop abruptly.Carbidopa-levodopa：避免MAO抑制劑（高血壓危象）、限制維生素B6、蛋白質分散；異動症為重要副作用；勿突然停藥。 PDF p.970, 971
  10. Anticholinergics are contraindicated in glaucoma; cause dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention.抗膽鹼藥青光眼禁用；造成口乾、便秘、尿滯留。 PDF p.971
  11. Acetaminophen: max 4000 mg/day, liver toxicity (elevated bilirubin/enzymes), antidote acetylcysteine.Acetaminophen：每日上限4000 mg、肝毒性（膽紅素/酵素上升）、解毒劑acetylcysteine。 PDF p.975, 979
  12. Aspirin toxicity (salicylism): tinnitus is the classic early sign; no aspirin in children with viral illness (Reye's).Aspirin中毒（水楊酸中毒）：耳鳴為典型早期徵象；病毒感染兒童勿用aspirin（雷氏症候群）。 PDF p.974, 975, 979
  13. Opioids: hold and notify if respirations <12; keep naloxone available; constipation is expected; naloxone half-life is short.鴉片類：呼吸<12次/分暫停給藥並通報；備妥naloxone；便秘為預期副作用；naloxone半衰期短。 PDF p.976
  14. Mannitol: do not use if crystals in vial; monitor for pulmonary edema, electrolytes and urine output.Mannitol：瓶內有結晶勿使用；監測肺水腫、電解質與尿量。 PDF p.977
  15. Stimulants: give last dose 6 h before bed, no caffeine, monitor growth in children.興奮劑：最後一劑睡前至少6小時、避免咖啡因、監測兒童生長。 PDF p.974

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Phenytoin toxicity ladder: 10-20 therapeutic, >20 nystagmus, >30 ataxia/slurred speech.Phenytoin中毒階梯：10-20治療範圍、>20眼震、>30運動失調/口齒不清。 PDF p.972, 978
  • Anticholinergic effects: dry as a bone (mouth), blind as a bat (blurred vision), red-flushed, constipated, can't pee.抗膽鹼副作用：口乾、視力模糊、皮膚潮紅、便秘、尿滯留。 PDF p.971

61 Musculoskeletal Problems肌肉骨骼問題

Musculoskeletal anatomy and bone healing, diagnostic tests, soft tissue injuries, fractures with casts, traction and fixation, fracture complications, assistive devices, hip and knee surgery, dislocation, disc herniation, amputation, rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis and gout. Priorities are neurovascular checks, safe mobility and recognition of emergencies such as compartment syndrome and fat embolism.涵蓋肌肉骨骼解剖與骨癒合、診斷檢查、軟組織損傷、骨折與石膏、牽引與固定、骨折併發症、輔具、髖/膝手術、脫位、椎間盤突出、截肢、類風濕性關節炎、退化性關節炎、骨質疏鬆與痛風。重點為神經血管評估、安全活動，以及辨識腔室症候群與脂肪栓塞等急症。

Anatomy, bone healing and risk factors解剖、骨癒合與危險因子

  • Bones: spongy bone handles multidirectional force; compact bone resists longitudinal force; length growth stops at ages 18-25; bone resorption speeds with aging.骨骼：海綿骨承受多方向力量；緻密骨抗縱向力；長度生長在18-25歲停止；老化後骨質吸收加速。
  • Joints: synarthrosis (fixed), amphiarthrosis (slightly movable), diarthrosis (synovial, free movement); synovial fluid lubricates and cushions.關節：不動關節、微動關節、滑動關節（可自由活動）；滑液潤滑與緩衝。
  • Muscle contraction needs ATP and calcium; acetylcholine from the motor end plate starts it and acetylcholinesterase breaks it down.肌肉收縮需要ATP與鈣；運動終板釋放乙醯膽鹼啟動，乙醯膽鹼酯酶分解之。
  • Bone healing stages: hematoma, granulation tissue, callus formation, ossification/remodeling, healing complete.骨癒合階段：血腫、肉芽組織、骨痂形成、骨化/重塑、癒合完成。
  • Risk factors: falls, calcium deficiency, postmenopause, obesity, medications, hyperuricemia, infection, autoimmune and neoplastic disease.危險因子：跌倒、缺鈣、停經後、肥胖、藥物、高尿酸、感染、自體免疫與腫瘤疾病。
PDF p.982, 983

Diagnostic tests診斷檢查

  • X-ray/MRI: support the injured limb above and below the joint, give analgesia first, remove metal, screen for pregnancy; no pacemaker or magnetic implants for MRI.X光/MRI：支托受傷肢體上下關節、事先給止痛、移除金屬、詢問懷孕；MRI不可有心律調節器或磁性植入物。
  • Arthrocentesis: consent, compression bandage, ice, rest joint 8-24 h; report fever or swelling; steroid injection may raise glucose in diabetics.關節穿刺：同意書、壓縮繃帶、冰敷、關節休息8-24小時；發燒或腫脹要通報；類固醇注射可能使糖尿病人血糖升高。
  • Arthroscopy: fast 8-12 h, consent, neurovascular checks, compression bandage 2-4 days, elevate and ice; report fever, redness, drainage >3 days.關節鏡：禁食8-12小時、同意書、神經血管評估、壓縮繃帶2-4天、抬高與冰敷；發燒、紅腫、引流超過3天要通報。
  • DXA measures bone density (minimal radiation); bone scan uses IV radioisotope, drink 32 oz fluid, void before scanning; no special precautions afterward.DXA測骨密度（輻射極少）；骨掃描靜脈注射放射性同位素，需喝32盎司水、掃描前排尿；之後無特殊防護。
  • Biopsy: monitor bleeding, hematoma, infection, elevate site 24 h. EMG: needle insertion is uncomfortable; no stimulants or sedatives 24 h before.切片：監測出血、血腫、感染、抬高部位24小時。肌電圖：針刺不適；檢查前24小時避免興奮劑或鎮靜劑。
PDF p.983, 984, 985

Soft tissue injuries軟組織損傷

  • Strain = overstretched muscle/tendon; sprain = stretched or torn ligament (twisting). Manage with RICE: rest, ice, compression, elevation.拉傷＝肌肉/肌腱過度拉扯；扭傷＝韌帶拉傷或撕裂（扭轉）。以RICE處置：休息、冰敷、加壓、抬高。
  • Moderate sprains may need casting; severe ligament damage needs surgery.中度扭傷可能需石膏；嚴重韌帶損傷需手術。
  • Rotator cuff tear: shoulder pain and inability to hold arm abducted (drop-arm); NSAIDs, PT, sling, ice/heat; surgery if complete tear.旋轉肌袖撕裂：肩痛且無法維持手臂外展（落臂試驗）；NSAID、物理治療、吊帶、冷熱敷；完全撕裂需手術。
PDF p.985

Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏

  • Findings: pain, deformity, crepitus, swelling, loss of function, spasm, neurovascular compromise. Immobilize first and check neurovascular status; cover an open fracture with a sterile dressing and splint.表現：疼痛、變形、骨擦音、腫脹、功能喪失、痙攣、神經血管受損。先固定並評估神經血管；開放性骨折以無菌敷料覆蓋並夾板固定。
  • Closed reduction is manual; open reduction (ORIF) is surgical with plates, screws, pins or rods. External fixators need pin care and stability checks.閉鎖性復位為手法；開放性復位（ORIF）為手術並用鋼板、螺釘、鋼釘或髓內釘。外固定器需針孔護理與穩定性檢查。
  • Traction: weights hang freely, never touch the floor; do not remove weights without order; ropes move freely in pulleys; keep alignment.牽引：重量自由懸吊、不碰地；未經醫囑勿移除重量；繩索在滑輪中順暢；維持對位。
  • Skeletal traction 25-40 lb with pin site care; skin traction (Buck's) not more than 8-10 lb, foot of bed raised; balanced suspension keeps ~20 degree thigh angle.骨骼牽引25-40磅並做針孔護理；皮膚牽引（Buck氏）不超過8-10磅、抬高床尾；平衡懸吊維持大腿約20度。
  • Plaster cast dries 24-72 h (synthetic ~20 min); handle with palms; cool hair dryer only; keep dry; elevate; turn every 1-2 h; do not insert objects.石膏：乾燥需24-72小時（合成約20分鐘）；以手掌托持；僅用冷風吹風機；保持乾燥；抬高；每1-2小時翻動；勿塞入物品。
  • Watch for circulation problems (pain, swelling, discoloration, tingling, coolness, weak pulse) and infection (fever, hot spots, odor).注意循環障礙（疼痛、腫脹、變色、刺痛、冰冷、脈搏弱）與感染（發燒、熱點、異味）。
PDF p.985, 986, 987, 988

Complications of fractures骨折併發症

  • Fat embolism: restlessness, sudden dyspnea, chest pain, cough, hypoxemia, crackles, confusion; give oxygen, notify PHCP, prepare for ventilation.脂肪栓塞：躁動、突發呼吸困難、胸痛、咳嗽、低血氧、囉音、意識混亂；給氧、通知醫師、準備呼吸器。
  • Acute compartment syndrome: pain unrelieved or worse, pain on passive movement, paresthesia, pallor; pulselessness is late; irreversible damage after 4-6 h; loosen dressings/bivalve cast, fasciotomy.急性腔室症候群：疼痛無法緩解或加劇、被動活動疼痛、感覺異常、蒼白；無脈為晚期；4-6小時後可能不可逆；鬆開敷料/剖開石膏、筋膜切開術。
  • Osteomyelitis: fever >101 F, local pain, leukocytosis, high ESR; long-term IV antibiotics, surgery if resistant.骨髓炎：發燒>101°F、局部疼痛、白血球與ESR升高；長期靜脈抗生素、抗藥者需手術。
  • Avascular necrosis: blood supply interrupted causing bone death; report pain/numbness.缺血性壞死：血供中斷導致骨壞死；疼痛/麻木需通報。
PDF p.989, 990

Crutches, canes and walkers拐杖、手杖與助行器

  • Crutches fit: 2-3 finger widths below axilla, elbows flexed 20-30 degrees; never bear weight on axillae (brachial plexus injury); crutches placed 6-10 in diagonally forward; stand on affected side when assisting.拐杖合適度：腋下留2-3指寬、肘彎20-30度；腋下勿承重（臂神經叢損傷）；拐杖置於斜前6-10吋；協助時站在患側。
  • Gaits: 2-point (partial weight, bilateral prostheses), 3-point (no/partial weight on one leg), 4-point (weight bearing both), swing-to/swing-through (strong arms).步態：兩點（部分承重）、三點（患肢不/部分承重）、四點（雙腳可承重）、擺至/擺過（手臂有力）。
  • Stairs: up with the good leg first (up with the good); down with crutches and the affected leg first (down with the bad).樓梯：上樓先出健腿；下樓先出拐杖與患腿。
  • Cane in hand on the unaffected side, handle at greater trochanter, 4-6 in from the foot; walker - all four points flat before weight bearing.手杖拿在健側手、握把與大轉子同高、距足側4-6吋；助行器－四腳著地後再承重。
PDF p.990, 991

Hip fracture, knee replacement, dislocation髖骨折、膝關節置換與脫位

  • Intracapsular hip fracture: poor blood supply, treated with replacement or ORIF; extracapsular: traction then ORIF/nail.囊內髖骨折：血供差，以置換或ORIF處理；囊外：牽引後ORIF/髓內釘。
  • Post-hip surgery: avoid hip flexion >90 degrees, adduction/crossing legs, internal rotation; avoid low chairs; keep leg aligned; monitor delirium, DVT, infection and neurovascular status.髖部術後：避免髖屈曲>90度、內收/翹腳、內旋；避免低椅；維持肢體排列；監測譫妄、深部靜脈栓塞、感染與神經血管。
  • Total knee replacement: CPM as prescribed, analgesia before CPM, weight bearing with device as tolerated, avoid dangling leg; tranexamic acid reduces blood loss.全膝關節置換：依醫囑使用CPM、CPM前給止痛、使用輔具依耐受承重、避免下垂；tranexamic acid減少失血。
  • Dislocation: asymmetry, pain, swelling; risks neurovascular compromise and avascular necrosis; reduce promptly then immobilize.脫位：不對稱、疼痛、腫脹；風險為神經血管受損與缺血性壞死；及早復位後固定。
PDF p.991, 992

Disc herniation and disc surgery椎間盤突出與手術

  • Cervical herniation (C5-C6, C6-C7): pain to shoulder/arm, paresthesia; collar, heat/ice, bed rest, avoid neck flexion/rotation.頸椎突出（C5-C6、C6-C7）：疼痛放射至肩臂、感覺異常；頸圈、冷熱敷、臥床、避免頸屈曲/旋轉。
  • Lumbar herniation (L4-L5, L5-S1): back pain radiating down leg (sciatica), worse with bending, lifting, coughing; sleep on side with pillow between flexed knees; neurological deterioration or bowel/bladder dysfunction needs urgent care.腰椎突出（L4-L5、L5-S1）：下背痛放射至腿（坐骨神經痛）、彎腰、提重物、咳嗽加劇；側臥並屈膝間夾枕；神經惡化或大小便功能異常需緊急處理。
  • After cervical surgery: watch breathing, hoarseness (laryngeal nerve), hematoma; after lumbar surgery: sensation/movement of legs, urinary retention, ileus, CSF leak (clear drainage, glucose-positive), logroll.頸椎術後：觀察呼吸、聲音沙啞（喉返神經）、血腫；腰椎術後：下肢感覺活動、尿滯留、腸阻塞、腦脊髓液漏（清澈、葡萄糖陽性）、軸線翻身。
PDF p.992, 993

Amputation截肢

  • Complications: hemorrhage, infection, phantom pain, flexion contractures; diabetics prone to wound separation and infection.併發症：出血、感染、幻肢痛、屈曲攣縮；糖尿病人易傷口裂開與感染。
  • Never place a pillow under the residual limb (risk of hip flexion contracture); for the first 24 h elevate the foot of the bed, not a pillow, to reduce edema, then keep the bed flat; prone positioning as prescribed after 24-48 h; wrap with elastic bandage or shrinker, and rewrap immediately if it slips.殘肢下勿墊枕頭（避免髖屈曲攣縮）；最初24小時應抬高床尾而非用枕頭以減少腫脹，之後維持床平；24-48小時後依醫囑採俯臥；以彈性繃帶或殘肢套包紮，鬆脫時立即重新包紮。
  • Above-knee: prevent external rotation with trochanter roll; below-knee: do not let limb hang, avoid long sitting.膝上截肢：以轉子捲防外旋；膝下截肢：殘肢勿下垂、避免久坐。
  • Traumatic amputation: call 911, direct pressure, elevate, wrap part in a sealed bag placed in ice water (not directly on ice).外傷性截肢：呼叫119、直接加壓、抬高、離斷部位裝密封袋置於冰水中（不直接接觸冰）。
PDF p.993, 994

Rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, gout類風濕性關節炎、退化性關節炎、骨質疏鬆與痛風

  • RA: systemic autoimmune inflammation, morning stiffness >30 min, symmetric joint deformity, elevated ESR, positive rheumatoid factor; NSAIDs, DMARDs, glucocorticoids; balance rest and activity, heat/cold, joint protection.類風濕性關節炎：全身性自體免疫發炎、晨僵>30分鐘、對稱性關節變形、ESR升高、類風濕因子陽性；NSAID、DMARD、類固醇；休息與活動平衡、冷熱敷、保護關節。
  • OA: cartilage loss in weight-bearing joints; pain worse after activity, relieved by rest; Heberden and Bouchard nodes; acetaminophen first, weight control; joint replacement when other measures fail.退化性關節炎：負重關節軟骨流失；活動後痛加劇、休息緩解；Heberden與Bouchard結節；首選acetaminophen、控制體重；其他方法無效時行關節置換。
  • Osteoporosis: demineralization, silent until fracture; kyphosis, height loss; calcium, vitamin D, protein; weight-bearing exercise; avoid alcohol/smoking/coffee; fall prevention.骨質疏鬆：骨質流失、骨折前無症狀；駝背、身高變矮；補充鈣、維生素D、蛋白質；負重運動；避免酒精/吸菸/咖啡；預防跌倒。
  • Gout: uric acid crystals, acute great-toe pain, tophi, renal stones; low-purine diet (avoid organ meats, wine, aged cheese), fluids 2000 mL/day, avoid alcohol and starvation diets, uric acid normal 2.7-8.5 mg/dL.痛風：尿酸結晶、大拇趾急性劇痛、痛風石、腎結石；低普林飲食（避免內臟、酒、陳年起司）、水分2000 mL/日、避免酒精與飢餓飲食，尿酸正常2.7-8.5 mg/dL。
PDF p.995, 996, 997

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Compartment syndrome: pain out of proportion/unrelieved, pain on passive stretch, paresthesia; pulselessness is late; notify PHCP immediately, loosen constrictive dressing/cast.腔室症候群：疼痛與傷勢不成比例/無法緩解、被動拉伸痛、感覺異常；無脈為晚期；立即通知醫師、鬆開束縛敷料/石膏。 PDF p.989
  2. Fat embolism: sudden dyspnea, chest pain, restlessness/confusion, hypoxemia, crackles after long-bone fracture; give oxygen, notify PHCP.脂肪栓塞：長骨骨折後突發呼吸困難、胸痛、躁動/意識混亂、低血氧、囉音；給氧並通知醫師。 PDF p.989
  3. Neurovascular checks: color, temperature, pulses, capillary refill, movement, sensation distal to injury or cast.神經血管評估：傷處或石膏遠端顏色、溫度、脈搏、微血管充填、活動、感覺。 PDF p.986, 989
  4. Wet plaster cast: palms only, 24-72 h to dry, cool dryer only, nothing inside cast; hot spot suggests infection.濕石膏：僅用手掌、24-72小時乾燥、僅冷風、勿塞物；熱點提示感染。 PDF p.988, 989
  5. Traction weights must hang freely; never lift or remove without order; Buck's traction max 8-10 lb.牽引重量需自由懸吊；未經醫囑勿提起或移除；Buck氏牽引最多8-10磅。 PDF p.987, 988
  6. Skeletal traction pin site: purulent drainage = infection; mild serous drainage and slight redness expected.骨骼牽引針孔：膿性分泌物＝感染；輕微漿液性分泌物與微紅屬預期。 PDF p.988
  7. Hip surgery precautions: no flexion >90 degrees, no crossing legs, no internal rotation, avoid low chairs.髖部手術注意：勿屈曲>90度、勿翹腳、勿內旋、避免低椅。 PDF p.991
  8. Crutches: 2-3 finger widths from axilla; axillary weight causes brachial plexus damage; up with good leg, down with bad.拐杖：腋下2-3指寬；腋下承重造成臂神經叢損傷；上樓先健腿、下樓先患腿。 PDF p.990
  9. Cane goes on the unaffected side and moves with the affected leg.手杖放健側並與患腿同時移動。 PDF p.990
  10. Amputation: never place a pillow under the residual limb (hip flexion contracture risk) - elevate the foot of the bed instead for the first 24 h; rewrap immediately with elastic bandage if it slips; prone positioning after 24-48 h also helps prevent hip contracture.截肢：殘肢下勿墊枕頭（避免髖屈曲攣縮）－最初24小時應改以抬高床尾；彈性繃帶鬆脫須立即重新包紮；24-48小時後俯臥亦有助預防髖攣縮。 PDF p.993, 994
  11. Disc surgery: logroll, watch for CSF leak, hoarseness after cervical surgery, bowel/bladder dysfunction.椎間盤手術：軸線翻身、注意腦脊髓液漏、頸椎術後聲音沙啞、大小便功能異常。 PDF p.993
  12. RA: morning stiffness >30 min, positive rheumatoid factor (<60 IU/mL normal), elevated ESR.類風濕性關節炎：晨僵>30分鐘、類風濕因子陽性（<60 IU/mL為正常）、ESR升高。 PDF p.995
  13. Osteoarthritis pain worsens with activity and improves with rest; RA stiffness improves with activity.退化性關節炎活動後疼痛加劇、休息緩解；類風濕晨僵活動後改善。 PDF p.995, 996
  14. Osteoporosis risk: age, female/postmenopausal, low calcium, smoking, alcohol, sedentary lifestyle, steroids, anticonvulsants.骨質疏鬆危險因子：年齡、女性/停經後、低鈣、吸菸、酒精、久坐、類固醇、抗癲癇藥。 PDF p.996, 997
  15. Gout: elevated uric acid; low-purine diet, fluids 2000 mL/day, avoid alcohol.痛風：尿酸升高；低普林飲食、水分2000 mL/日、避免酒精。 PDF p.997
  16. Open fracture: cover with sterile dressing and splint before moving; at the scene keep victim still and do not reduce.開放性骨折：移動前以無菌敷料覆蓋並夾板固定；現場讓傷者保持不動且勿自行復位。 PDF p.986, 998
  17. Radioisotope bone scan: drink fluids, void before scan; no radiation precautions afterward.骨掃描：多喝水、掃描前排尿；之後無需輻射防護。 PDF p.984, 985

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • RICE for sprains/strains: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.扭傷/拉傷RICE：休息、冰敷、加壓、抬高。 PDF p.985
  • Compartment syndrome 6 Ps: pain, pallor, paresthesia, paralysis, pulselessness (late), pressure/poikilothermia.腔室症候群6P：疼痛、蒼白、感覺異常、麻痺、無脈（晚期）、壓力/皮溫改變。 PDF p.989
  • Crutch stairs: 'Up with the good, down with the bad.'拐杖上下樓：上樓先健腿、下樓先患腿。 PDF p.990

62 Musculoskeletal Medications肌肉骨骼系統藥物

Drug classes for musculoskeletal conditions: skeletal muscle relaxants, antigout drugs, antiarthritic agents (DMARDs and biologics), osteoporosis drugs and analgesics for musculoskeletal pain. Know each class's action, signature toxicity, monitoring labs and patient teaching.肌肉骨骼疾病用藥類別：骨骼肌鬆弛劑、抗痛風藥、抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）、骨質疏鬆藥物與肌肉骨骼疼痛止痛藥。需掌握各類別作用、特徵性毒性、監測檢驗與衛教。

Skeletal muscle relaxants骨骼肌鬆弛劑

  • Examples: baclofen, carisoprodol, chlorzoxazone, cyclobenzaprine, dantrolene, diazepam, metaxalone, methocarbamol, orphenadrine, tizanidine.例：baclofen、carisoprodol、chlorzoxazone、cyclobenzaprine、dantrolene、diazepam、metaxalone、methocarbamol、orphenadrine、tizanidine。
  • Action: central (depress spinal/brain neurons) or peripheral (dantrolene blocks calcium release in muscle); relieve spasm and spasticity.作用：中樞性（抑制脊髓/腦神經元）或周邊性（dantrolene阻斷肌肉鈣釋放）；緩解痙攣與痙直。
  • Adverse effects: drowsiness, dizziness, hypotension, weakness, dry mouth, GI upset, photosensitivity, hepatotoxicity. Avoid alcohol and other CNS depressants; no driving; take with food; monitor LFTs.不良反應：嗜睡、頭暈、低血壓、無力、口乾、腸胃不適、光敏感、肝毒性。避免酒精與其他中樞抑制劑；勿開車；隨餐服用；監測肝功能。
  • Baclofen: drowsiness, constipation, urinary retention; intrathecal pump - keep refill appointments, abrupt withdrawal can be life-threatening.Baclofen：嗜睡、便秘、尿滯留；脊髓腔幫浦－按時回診補藥，突然停藥可致命。
  • Cyclobenzaprine: contraindicated within 14 days of MAOIs and in cardiac disorders; anticholinergic (caution with urinary retention, angle-closure glaucoma); short-term use 2-3 weeks. Orphenadrine has similar anticholinergic effects.Cyclobenzaprine：MAO抑制劑14天內及心臟疾病者禁用；有抗膽鹼作用（尿滯留、閉角型青光眼慎用）；短期使用2-3週。Orphenadrine有類似抗膽鹼作用。
  • Dantrolene: most serious effect is liver damage (check LFTs before and during), GI bleeding, photosensitivity; report rash, tarry stools, jaundice.Dantrolene：最嚴重為肝損傷（治療前後檢查肝功能）、消化道出血、光敏感；皮疹、黑便、黃疸需通報。
  • Methocarbamol: IV form can cause hypotension, bradycardia, seizures if rapid, extravasation injury; urine may turn brown, black or green. Chlorzoxazone: urine orange/red, hepatotoxic. Diazepam: sedation. Tizanidine and metaxalone: liver damage.Methocarbamol：靜脈過快可致低血壓、心搏過緩、癲癇，注意外滲；尿液可能變棕、黑或綠。Chlorzoxazone：尿液橘/紅、肝毒性。Diazepam：鎮靜。Tizanidine與metaxalone：肝損傷。
PDF p.1005, 1006

Antigout medications抗痛風藥

  • Allopurinol and febuxostat reduce uric acid production; probenecid increases uric acid excretion (uricosuric); colchicine, NSAIDs and glucocorticoids treat acute attacks.Allopurinol與febuxostat減少尿酸生成；probenecid促進尿酸排泄（排尿酸藥）；colchicine、NSAID與類固醇治療急性發作。
  • Adverse effects: headache, GI upset, bone marrow depression, rash, flushing, uric acid stones, sore gums, metallic taste.不良反應：頭痛、腸胃不適、骨髓抑制、皮疹、潮紅、尿酸結石、牙齦痛、金屬味。
