  • Teaching: fluids 2000-3000 mL/day, avoid alcohol, caffeine and high-purine foods (organ meats, sardines, salmon, scallops, gravy); take with food; no aspirin (raises uric acid).衛教：水分2000-3000 mL/日、避免酒精、咖啡因與高普林食物（內臟、沙丁魚、鮭魚、干貝、肉汁）；隨餐服用；避免aspirin（升高尿酸）。
  • Allopurinol: raises warfarin and oral hypoglycemic effect; avoid large vitamin C doses (stones); rare hypersensitivity (rash, fever, eosinophilia, liver/kidney changes) - withhold and report; sun protection and annual eye exam.Allopurinol：增強warfarin與口服降血糖藥效果；避免大量維生素C（結石）；罕見過敏症候群（皮疹、發燒、嗜酸性球增多、肝腎異常）－停藥並通報；防曬並每年眼科檢查。
  • Colchicine: caution in older, debilitated, cardiac, renal or GI disease; if nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or abdominal pain develop, withhold and notify PHCP.Colchicine：老年、體弱、心、腎或胃腸疾病者慎用；出現噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉或腹痛時停藥並通報。
  • Monitor serum uric acid, I&O, CBC, renal and liver function.監測血清尿酸、輸出入量、CBC、腎與肝功能。
PDF p.1006, 1007

Antiarthritic medications (DMARDs and biologics)抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）

  • RA therapy: NSAIDs, glucocorticoids, conventional DMARDs and biologic DMARDs; early aggressive treatment preserves joints.類風濕性關節炎治療：NSAID、類固醇、傳統DMARD與生物性DMARD；早期積極治療可保護關節。
  • Conventional DMARDs: methotrexate, leflunomide, hydroxychloroquine, azathioprine, cyclosporine, sulfasalazine, penicillamine; risks: infection, neutropenia, low platelets, liver damage.傳統DMARD：methotrexate、leflunomide、hydroxychloroquine、azathioprine、cyclosporine、sulfasalazine、penicillamine；風險：感染、嗜中性球低下、血小板低下、肝損傷。
  • Biologics: abatacept, adalimumab, anakinra, etanercept, infliximab, rituximab (tofacitinib is a JAK inhibitor): injection-site reactions, serious infection/TB, malignancy risk.生物製劑：abatacept、adalimumab、anakinra、etanercept、infliximab、rituximab（tofacitinib為JAK抑制劑）：注射部位反應、嚴重感染/結核、惡性腫瘤風險。
  • Drug-specific: methotrexate - hepatic fibrosis, marrow suppression, GI ulcers, pneumonitis; hydroxychloroquine - retinal damage (report vision changes); cyclosporine - nephrotoxicity; azathioprine - hepatitis, blood dyscrasias; leflunomide - hepatotoxic, reversible hair loss; etanercept - heart failure risk, demyelination; adalimumab - neurological injury signs; infliximab - infusion reactions and hepatotoxicity.藥物特點：methotrexate－肝纖維化、骨髓抑制、胃腸潰瘍、肺炎；hydroxychloroquine－視網膜損傷（視覺改變需通報）；cyclosporine－腎毒性；azathioprine－肝炎、血液惡病質；leflunomide－肝毒性、可逆性落髮；etanercept－心衰竭風險、去髓鞘；adalimumab－神經損傷徵象；infliximab－輸注反應與肝毒性。
  • Gold salts: toxicity = pruritus, rash, metallic taste, stomatitis, diarrhea; antidote dimercaprol.金鹽：毒性＝搔癢、皮疹、金屬味、口腔炎、腹瀉；解毒劑dimercaprol。
  • Nursing: baseline and ongoing WBC, neutrophil, platelet counts; teach infection signs; no live vaccines without PHCP approval; tofacitinib contraindicated with active infection, recent live vaccine, hepatic impairment, lactation.護理：基礎與持續監測WBC、嗜中性球、血小板；教導感染徵象；未經醫師同意勿接種活性疫苗；tofacitinib於活動性感染、近期活性疫苗、肝功能不全、哺乳期禁用。
PDF p.1007, 1008, 1009

Osteoporosis medications骨質疏鬆藥物

  • Calcium and vitamin D support bone; antiresorptives: bisphosphonates, raloxifene, calcitonin, denosumab; anabolic: teriparatide, abaloparatide, romosozumab.鈣與維生素D支持骨骼；抗骨吸收：雙磷酸鹽、raloxifene、calcitonin、denosumab；促進骨形成：teriparatide、abaloparatide、romosozumab。
  • Bisphosphonates (alendronate, risedronate, ibandronate, pamidronate, zoledronic acid): morning on empty stomach with a full glass of water, stay upright 30 min (60 min ibandronate); risk esophagitis, muscle pain, ocular problems; contraindicated with esophageal disorders or inability to stay upright.雙磷酸鹽（alendronate、risedronate、ibandronate、pamidronate、zoledronic acid）：早晨空腹以一整杯水服用、保持直立30分鐘（ibandronate為60分鐘）；風險為食道炎、肌肉痛、眼部問題；食道疾病或無法直立者禁用。
  • Raloxifene: avoid with history of venous thromboembolism; stop 72 h before prolonged immobilization; avoid long periods of restricted activity such as travel.Raloxifene：有靜脈血栓病史者避免；長時間不動前72小時停藥；避免旅途等長期不動。
  • Calcitonin-salmon: inhibits osteoclasts; alternate nostrils for nasal form; monitor for hypocalcemia.Calcitonin-salmon：抑制蝕骨細胞；鼻噴劑輪流使用左右鼻孔；監測低血鈣。
  • Teriparatide: PTH analog stimulating osteoblasts, for high fracture risk, associated with bone cancer concern; abaloparatide: contraindicated with hypercalcemia/hyperparathyroidism, watch orthostatic hypotension within 4 h; romosozumab: MI and stroke risk; denosumab: monoclonal antibody.Teriparatide：PTH類似物刺激造骨細胞，用於高骨折風險者，與骨癌疑慮相關；abaloparatide：高血鈣/副甲狀腺機能亢進者禁用，4小時內注意姿位性低血壓；romosozumab：心肌梗塞與中風風險；denosumab：單株抗體。
PDF p.1009, 1010

Medications for musculoskeletal pain肌肉骨骼疼痛用藥

  • First-line: NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen, aspirin, diclofenac, meloxicam, indomethacin, celecoxib) and acetaminophen.第一線：NSAID（ibuprofen、naproxen、aspirin、diclofenac、meloxicam、indomethacin、celecoxib）與acetaminophen。
  • Adjuncts: skeletal muscle relaxants, antidepressants, opioids as needed (see chapters 60 and 69).輔助：骨骼肌鬆弛劑、抗憂鬱藥、必要時鴉片類（見第60、69章）。
  • NSAID cautions: GI bleeding, renal impairment, take with food; acetaminophen: liver toxicity above 4000 mg/day.NSAID注意：胃腸出血、腎功能受損、隨餐服用；acetaminophen：每日超過4000 mg有肝毒性。
PDF p.1010

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Baclofen intrathecal pump: missed refill causes abrupt withdrawal that can be life-threatening.Baclofen脊髓腔幫浦：未回診補藥導致突然停藥，可能危及生命。 PDF p.1005
  2. Cyclobenzaprine: contraindicated with MAOIs (within 14 days) and in cardiac disease; anticholinergic - caution in glaucoma and urinary retention; use 2-3 weeks only.Cyclobenzaprine：禁與MAO抑制劑（14天內）併用、心臟疾病者禁用；抗膽鹼－青光眼與尿滯留慎用；僅用2-3週。 PDF p.1006, 1012
  3. Dantrolene: hepatotoxicity - monitor liver function tests before and during therapy.Dantrolene：肝毒性－治療前後監測肝功能。 PDF p.1006, 1012
  4. IV methocarbamol: hypotension and bradycardia; give slowly; watch for extravasation.靜脈methocarbamol：低血壓與心搏過緩；緩慢給予；注意外滲。 PDF p.1006, 1012
  5. All muscle relaxants: avoid alcohol/CNS depressants and driving; fall and safety risk.所有肌肉鬆弛劑：避免酒精/中樞抑制劑與開車；跌倒與安全風險。 PDF p.1005, 1006
  6. Gout drugs: fluids 2000-3000 mL/day, low-purine diet, no aspirin; allopurinol - stop and report rash or fever.抗痛風藥：水分2000-3000 mL/日、低普林飲食、避免aspirin；allopurinol－出現皮疹或發燒須停藥並通報。 PDF p.1007
  7. Colchicine: stop and notify PHCP for nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain; caution in renal, cardiac, GI disease.Colchicine：噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、腹痛時停藥並通報；腎、心、胃腸疾病者慎用。 PDF p.1007
  8. Allopurinol: avoid large vitamin C doses; potentiates warfarin.Allopurinol：避免大量維生素C；增強warfarin效果。 PDF p.1007
  9. DMARDs/biologics: monitor CBC (neutrophils, WBC, platelets), infection risk, TB, no live vaccines.DMARD/生物製劑：監測CBC（嗜中性球、WBC、血小板）、感染風險、結核、避免活性疫苗。 PDF p.1007, 1008
  10. Hydroxychloroquine: retinal damage; methotrexate: hepatic fibrosis, marrow suppression; cyclosporine: nephrotoxicity; gold toxicity antidote dimercaprol.Hydroxychloroquine：視網膜損傷；methotrexate：肝纖維化、骨髓抑制；cyclosporine：腎毒性；金中毒解毒劑dimercaprol。 PDF p.1007, 1008
  11. Bisphosphonates: morning, empty stomach, full glass of water, upright at least 30 min (60 min ibandronate); contraindicated with esophageal disorders.雙磷酸鹽：早晨空腹、一整杯水、至少直立30分鐘（ibandronate為60分鐘）；食道疾病者禁用。 PDF p.1009
  12. Raloxifene: stop 72 h before prolonged immobilization; contraindicated with history of venous thrombosis.Raloxifene：長期不動前72小時停藥；有靜脈血栓病史者禁用。 PDF p.1009
  13. Teriparatide and abaloparatide: anabolic bone agents; abaloparatide - orthostatic hypotension within 4 h, contraindicated in hypercalcemia.Teriparatide與abaloparatide：促骨形成；abaloparatide－4小時內姿位性低血壓、高血鈣者禁用。 PDF p.1009, 1010
  14. Acetaminophen and NSAIDs are first-line for musculoskeletal pain.Acetaminophen與NSAID為肌肉骨骼疼痛第一線用藥。 PDF p.1010

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Bisphosphonate rule: 'Up, Water, Empty' - upright 30 min, full glass of water, empty stomach in the morning.雙磷酸鹽口訣：直立、一整杯水、空腹（早晨）。 PDF p.1009
  • Allopurinol 'blocks production', probenecid 'pushes it out', colchicine 'calms the attack'.Allopurinol＝阻止生成；probenecid＝促進排出；colchicine＝緩解發作。 PDF p.1006, 1007

63 Immune Problems免疫問題

Immune system function, humoral vs cellular response, immunity types, immune lab tests (ANA, anti-dsDNA, HIV tests, CD4 count), skin testing, hypersensitivity, anaphylaxis, latex allergy, immunodeficiency, autoimmune diseases (SLE, scleroderma, polyarteritis nodosa, pemphigus, Goodpasture's), Lyme disease, HIV/AIDS, Kaposi's sarcoma and posttransplant immunosuppression.免疫系統功能、體液與細胞性免疫反應、免疫類型、免疫檢驗（ANA、anti-dsDNA、HIV檢測、CD4計數）、皮膚試驗、過敏反應、類過敏性休克、乳膠過敏、免疫不全、自體免疫疾病（SLE、硬皮症、結節性多動脈炎、天疱瘡、Goodpasture氏症候群）、萊姆病、HIV/AIDS、卡波西氏肉瘤與移植後免疫抑制。

Immune function, response and immunity免疫功能、反應與免疫類型

  • The immune system defends against outside microbes and removes dead or damaged cells.免疫系統抵禦外來微生物並清除死亡或受損細胞。
  • T and B lymphocytes arise in bone marrow; T cells include helper, suppressor and cytotoxic types.T與B淋巴球源自骨髓；T細胞包括輔助型、抑制型與細胞毒性型。
  • Humoral (B cell, antibody) response is immediate and protects against acute bacterial and viral infection.體液性（B細胞、抗體）反應迅速，防禦急性細菌與病毒感染。
  • Cellular response is delayed (delayed hypersensitivity); involved in slow bacterial infections, autoimmunity, some allergies and graft rejection.細胞性反應延遲（遲發型過敏）；與緩慢細菌感染、自體免疫、部分過敏及移植排斥有關。
  • Innate immunity is present at birth (barriers, inflammation); acquired immunity is passive (maternal antibodies, serum) or active (disease, immunization).先天免疫出生即有（屏障、發炎）；後天免疫分被動（母體抗體、血清）與主動（疾病、疫苗）。
PDF p.1015

Laboratory studies and skin testing檢驗與皮膚試驗

  • ANA: negative at 1:40 dilution; positive in most SLE (also scleroderma, RA) but not diagnostic alone; false positives occur.ANA：1:40稀釋時為陰性；多數SLE為陽性（硬皮症、RA亦可）但不能單獨診斷；可有偽陽性。
  • Anti-dsDNA: specific to SLE, tracks disease activity; normal under 70 U/mL by ELISA.Anti-dsDNA：對SLE具特異性、可追蹤疾病活性；ELISA正常小於70 U/mL。
  • CD4+ count: normal 500-1600 cells/uL; 200-499 immune problems; below 200 severe (AIDS criteria). CD4:CD8 ratio normally about 2:1.CD4+計數：正常500-1600 cells/µL；200-499免疫出現問題；低於200為嚴重（AIDS標準）。CD4:CD8比值正常約2:1。
  • HIV testing: maintain confidentiality; reactive screening test needs confirmation; viral load measures HIV RNA; p24 antigen assay; oral test uses oral transmucosal fluid and needs blood confirmation.HIV檢測：保密；篩檢陽性需確認；病毒量測HIV RNA；p24抗原檢驗；口腔試驗用口腔黏膜滲出液，陽性需血液確認。
  • Skin testing: stop systemic steroids/antihistamines 5 days prior as prescribed; consent; observe 30 min; anaphylaxis equipment ready; measure wheal and erythema (1+ about 0.5 cm to 4+ about 2.0 cm); record site, date, time.皮膚試驗：依醫囑前5天停用全身性類固醇/抗組織胺；同意書；觀察30分鐘；備妥過敏性休克急救設備；測量風團與紅暈（1+約0.5 cm至4+約2.0 cm）；記錄部位、日期、時間。
PDF p.1015, 1016, 1017

Hypersensitivity, anaphylaxis and latex allergy過敏、過敏性休克與乳膠過敏

  • Allergy: abnormal response to normally harmless substances, often on second exposure; manage with allergen identification, antihistamines, anti-inflammatories, corticosteroids, desensitization.過敏：對一般無害物質的異常反應，常於再次接觸時出現；處置包括辨識過敏原、抗組織胺、抗發炎藥、類固醇、減敏治療。
  • Anaphylaxis (type I, IgE-mediated): airway compromise, stridor, wheeze, hypotension, urticaria, angioedema, GI cramps, sense of doom.過敏性休克（第一型、IgE媒介）：呼吸道受阻、喘鳴、哮鳴、低血壓、蕁麻疹、血管性水腫、腹絞痛、瀕死感。
  • Anaphylaxis actions: assess airway/breathing, stay with client, call PHCP and rapid response, stop the suspect infusion, start IV normal saline, oxygen, raise HOB if BP normal, prepare epinephrine and diphenhydramine, intubation equipment ready.過敏性休克處置：評估呼吸道/呼吸、不離開病人、呼叫醫師與快速反應小組、停止可疑輸注、建立靜脈輸注生理食鹽水、給氧、血壓正常時抬高床頭、準備epinephrine與diphenhydramine、備妥插管設備。
  • Latex allergy: type I (anaphylaxis) or type IV delayed contact dermatitis (6-48 h); risk groups: health care workers, rubber industry, multiple surgeries, spina bifida, frequent glove users; cross-reactive foods: banana, kiwi, avocado, chestnut, tropical fruits.乳膠過敏：第一型（過敏性休克）或第四型遲發接觸性皮膚炎（6-48小時）；高風險：醫療人員、橡膠工業、多次手術、脊柱裂、常戴手套者；交叉反應食物：香蕉、奇異果、酪梨、栗子、熱帶水果。
  • Latex precautions: ask about allergy, nonlatex gloves, latex-safe cart, glass ampules/avoid rubber-stopper vials, cloth barrier under BP cuff, MedicAlert bracelet, epinephrine pen.乳膠防護：詢問過敏史、使用無乳膠手套、備乳膠安全物品車、使用玻璃安瓿/避免橡膠瓶塞、血壓計袖套下墊布、醫療警示手環、攜帶epinephrine筆。
PDF p.1017, 1018, 1019

Immunodeficiency and autoimmune disease免疫不全與自體免疫疾病

  • Immunodeficiency (primary or secondary): infection is the priority concern; strict asepsis, balanced diet, infection prevention teaching, MedicAlert.免疫不全（原發或續發）：感染為首要顧慮；嚴格無菌技術、均衡飲食、感染預防衛教、醫療警示。
  • SLE: malar (butterfly) rash, discoid rash, photosensitivity, oral ulcers, joint pain, fatigue, anemia; positive ANA, anti-dsDNA, high ESR/CRP; lupus nephritis early (proteinuria, red cell casts, monitor BUN/creatinine).SLE：蝶形紅斑、盤狀疹、光敏感、口腔潰瘍、關節痛、疲倦、貧血；ANA與anti-dsDNA陽性、ESR/CRP升高；狼瘡腎炎早期（蛋白尿、紅血球圓柱、監測BUN/肌酸酐）。
  • SLE care: avoid sun/UV, mild soap, pace activity, avoid hot baths and long inactivity, corticosteroids, NSAIDs, hydroxychloroquine, plasmapheresis, emotional support.SLE照護：避免日曬/紫外線、溫和肥皂、活動節奏、避免熱水澡與久不活動、類固醇、NSAID、hydroxychloroquine、血漿置換、情緒支持。
  • Scleroderma: taut shiny skin, pitting hand edema, dysphagia, contractures; small frequent meals, sit up 1-2 h after meals, constant room temperature, avoid fingersticks and cold extremes, no smoking, corticosteroids.硬皮症：皮膚緊繃光亮、手部凹陷性水腫、吞嚥困難、攣縮；少量多餐、餐後直坐1-2小時、室溫恆定、避免指尖採血與極端低溫、戒菸、類固醇。
  • Polyarteritis nodosa: systemic vasculitis; fever, severe abdominal pain, bloody diarrhea, high ESR; renal/cardiac involvement; treated like SLE.結節性多動脈炎：全身性血管炎；發燒、劇烈腹痛、血便、ESR升高；腎臟/心臟受累；治療類似SLE。
  • Pemphigus: autoimmune flaccid bullae, Nikolsky's sign, oral lesions, infection risk; corticosteroids, cytotoxics, antibiotics for secondary infection, oral hygiene.天疱瘡：自體免疫鬆弛性水泡、Nikolsky氏徵象、口腔病灶、感染風險；類固醇、細胞毒性藥物、續發感染用抗生素、口腔衛生。
  • Goodpasture's: antibodies against glomerular and alveolar basement membranes; hemoptysis, hematuria, dyspnea, edema, HTN; corticosteroids, plasmapheresis, azathioprine, stop smoking.Goodpasture氏症候群：針對腎絲球與肺泡基底膜的自體抗體；咳血、血尿、呼吸困難、水腫、高血壓；類固醇、血漿置換、azathioprine、戒菸。
PDF p.1019, 1020, 1021

Lyme disease萊姆病

  • Caused by Borrelia burgdorferi from tick bite; the ring-shaped rash (erythema migrans) does not always occur and may appear away from the bite.由蜱（壁蝨）叮咬傳播的Borrelia burgdorferi所致；環狀紅斑（移行性紅斑）不一定出現，可出現在非叮咬處。
  • Stage 1: red papule/ring rash, flu-like symptoms; stage 2 (weeks): joint pain, meningitis, facial palsy, cardiac dysrhythmias; stage 3: large-joint arthritis.第一期：紅丘疹/環狀紅斑、類流感症狀；第二期（數週）：關節痛、腦膜炎、顏面麻痺、心律不整；第三期：大關節關節炎。
  • Remove tick with tweezers close to the skin, pull steadily upward, clean with antiseptic; do not burn it. Blood test reliable 4-6 weeks after bite.以鑷子貼近皮膚夾住蜱並穩定向上拔除、以消毒劑清潔；勿燒灼。血液檢驗於叮咬後4-6週較可靠。
  • Treatment: doxycycline, cefuroxime or amoxicillin; erythromycin if penicillin-allergic; start promptly.治療：doxycycline、cefuroxime或amoxicillin；青黴素過敏者用erythromycin；及早開始。
  • Prevention: DEET repellent, long sleeves/pants, light-colored clothing, tuck pants into socks, permethrin on gear, tick checks, stay in trail center.預防：DEET驅蟲劑、長袖長褲、淺色衣物、褲管塞入襪內、裝備噴permethrin、檢查蜱蟲、走在步道中央。
PDF p.1022

HIV/AIDSHIV/愛滋病

  • HIV destroys CD4 T cells; AIDS is diagnosed with CD4 <200 or an AIDS-defining opportunistic infection/cancer; long incubation period; now a chronic illness.HIV破壞CD4 T細胞；CD4<200或出現AIDS定義之伺機性感染/癌症即診斷AIDS；潛伏期長；現為慢性疾病。
  • Findings: fever, malaise, weight loss, night sweats, lymphadenopathy >3 months, diarrhea, leukopenia, opportunistic infections.表現：發燒、倦怠、體重減輕、盜汗、淋巴結腫大>3個月、腹瀉、白血球低下、伺機性感染。
  • Opportunistic: Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia (major cause of death), candidiasis, CMV, herpes, TB, toxoplasmosis, PML; Kaposi's sarcoma, lymphomas, invasive cervical cancer.伺機性：肺囊蟲肺炎（主要死因）、念珠菌、CMV、疱疹、結核、弓漿蟲、進行性多灶性白質腦病；卡波西氏肉瘤、淋巴瘤、侵襲性子宮頸癌。
  • Labs: decreased CD4, reduced CD4:CD8 ratio, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, increased IgG/IgA, anergy; viral load measures therapy effectiveness.檢驗：CD4下降、CD4:CD8比值降低、淋巴球減少、血小板低下、IgG/IgA上升、無反應性；病毒量評估治療效果。
  • Nursing: respiratory support, standard precautions, protective measures when immunosuppressed, skin care, nutrition, fluid balance, psychosocial support, confidentiality.護理：呼吸支持、標準防護、免疫低下時保護措施、皮膚護理、營養、體液平衡、心理社會支持、保密。
  • Kaposi's sarcoma: raised purplish/red-brown lesions on skin and organs; radiation, chemotherapy, antivirals, keep lesions clean; use gown and gloves for bathing/linen if draining.卡波西氏肉瘤：皮膚與內臟紫紅/紅褐色隆起病灶；放射、化療、抗病毒藥、保持病灶清潔；有滲液時沐浴/換床單穿隔離衣與戴手套。
PDF p.1023, 1024

Posttransplantation immunodeficiency移植後免疫不全

  • Lifelong immunosuppressants prevent organ rejection but create secondary immunodeficiency.終生免疫抑制劑可預防器官排斥，但造成續發性免疫不全。
  • Monitor renal and hepatic function, CBC with differential, body secretions for blood; assess for opportunistic infection and rejection.監測腎肝功能、CBC與分類、體液是否有血；評估伺機性感染與排斥。
  • High-risk: history of malignancy, recent TB, herpes zoster or varicella exposure.高風險：惡性腫瘤病史、近期結核、帶狀疱疹或水痘暴露。
  • Use strict asepsis, protective isolation as needed, and teach infection and rejection signs plus medication adherence.嚴格無菌技術、必要時保護性隔離，並教導感染與排斥徵象及規則服藥。
PDF p.1024, 1025

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Anaphylaxis: airway first, stay with client, stop the causative infusion, call rapid response, IV NS, oxygen, epinephrine, diphenhydramine; HOB up if BP normal.過敏性休克：先顧呼吸道、不離開病人、停止致敏輸注、呼叫快速反應、靜脈生理食鹽水、給氧、epinephrine、diphenhydramine；血壓正常時抬高床頭。 PDF p.1018
  2. Skin testing: observe 30 min with anaphylaxis equipment; hold steroids/antihistamines 5 days prior; measure (not estimate) wheal.皮膚試驗：觀察30分鐘並備急救設備；前5天停類固醇/抗組織胺；測量（非估計）風團。 PDF p.1017
  3. Latex allergy: nonlatex gloves, latex-safe cart, avoid rubber-stoppered vials; cross-reaction with banana, kiwi, avocado, chestnut.乳膠過敏：無乳膠手套、乳膠安全車、避免橡膠瓶塞藥瓶；與香蕉、奇異果、酪梨、栗子交叉反應。 PDF p.1018, 1019
  4. Immunodeficiency priority: protect from infection (strict asepsis).免疫不全首要：預防感染（嚴格無菌技術）。 PDF p.1019
  5. SLE: butterfly rash, photosensitivity, positive ANA and anti-dsDNA; monitor for lupus nephritis (BUN, creatinine, proteinuria).SLE：蝶形紅斑、光敏感、ANA與anti-dsDNA陽性；監測狼瘡腎炎（BUN、肌酸酐、蛋白尿）。 PDF p.1020
  6. SLE fatigue teaching: avoid hot baths and long inactivity, schedule exercise when not fatigued, conserve energy, avoid sun.SLE疲倦衛教：避免熱水澡與久不活動、不疲倦時運動、節省體力、避免日曬。 PDF p.1020, 1026
  7. Scleroderma: sit upright 1-2 h after meals, avoid fingersticks and cold, constant room temperature, corticosteroids.硬皮症：餐後直坐1-2小時、避免指尖採血與寒冷、室溫恆定、類固醇。 PDF p.1021
  8. Pemphigus: flaccid blisters, positive Nikolsky's sign; risk of infection; corticosteroids.天疱瘡：鬆弛性水泡、Nikolsky氏徵象陽性；感染風險；類固醇。 PDF p.1021
  9. Goodpasture's: lung plus kidney involvement (hemoptysis, hematuria); plasmapheresis; stop smoking.Goodpasture氏：肺與腎受累（咳血、血尿）；血漿置換；戒菸。 PDF p.1021, 1022
  10. Lyme disease: remove tick with tweezers, do not burn; test 4-6 weeks after bite; treat with doxycycline/cefuroxime/amoxicillin early.萊姆病：以鑷子拔蜱、勿燒灼；叮咬後4-6週檢驗；及早以doxycycline/cefuroxime/amoxicillin治療。 PDF p.1022
  11. CD4 normal 500-1600 cells/uL; <200 = AIDS criterion; viral load assesses treatment effectiveness.CD4正常500-1600 cells/µL；<200＝AIDS標準；病毒量評估治療效果。 PDF p.1016, 1024
  12. PCP (Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia) is a major cause of death in AIDS; Kaposi's sarcoma = purplish skin lesions, confirmed by punch biopsy.肺囊蟲肺炎為AIDS主要死因之一；卡波西氏肉瘤＝紫紅皮膚病灶、以穿刺切片確診。 PDF p.1023, 1028
  13. HIV confidentiality: positive tests need confirmation and state reporting per protocol.HIV保密：陽性結果需確認並依規定通報。 PDF p.1016, 1017
  14. Posttransplant: lifelong immunosuppression, strict asepsis, teach rejection and infection signs.移植後：終生免疫抑制、嚴格無菌、教導排斥與感染徵象。 PDF p.1024, 1025
  15. Draining Kaposi's lesions: gown and gloves for contact with drainage.卡波西氏病灶有滲液：接觸滲液時穿隔離衣並戴手套。 PDF p.1025, 1027

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Type I hypersensitivity = IgE on mast cells, immediate histamine release; type IV = delayed T-cell (6-48 h), e.g., latex contact dermatitis.第一型過敏＝肥大細胞上IgE、立即釋放組織胺；第四型＝延遲T細胞反應（6-48小時），如乳膠接觸性皮膚炎。 PDF p.1019
  • CD4 ladder: >500 healthy, 200-499 problems, <200 AIDS.CD4階梯：>500健康、200-499出現問題、<200為AIDS。 PDF p.1016

64 Immune Medications免疫藥物

This chapter groups the drugs used for HIV/AIDS, transplant and autoimmune immunosuppression, and bacterial/fungal/viral infections. For each class, know the action, signature adverse effects, the lab or sign to monitor, and the teaching points. Many NCLEX items simply ask 'which adverse effect goes with which drug class'.本章依藥物類別整理 HIV/AIDS 用藥、移植與自體免疫疾病的免疫抑制劑，以及抗細菌、抗黴菌、抗病毒藥物。每一類都要記住作用、代表性不良反應、需監測的檢驗或徵象，以及衛教重點。NCLEX 常考「哪個不良反應對應哪一類藥」。

HIV/AIDS drugs: overview and HAARTHIV/AIDS 藥物：總覽與 HAART

  • Drug classes: NRTIs, NNRTIs, protease inhibitors (PIs), integrase inhibitors, fusion inhibitor (enfuvirtide) and the CCR5 antagonist maraviroc.藥物類別：核苷(酸)類逆轉錄酶抑制劑 NRTI、非核苷類 NNRTI、蛋白酶抑制劑 PI、整合酶抑制劑、融合抑制劑 enfuvirtide，以及 CCR5 拮抗劑 maraviroc。
  • NRTIs and NNRTIs block reverse transcriptase; PIs block the enzyme protease; fusion inhibitors block HIV binding/entry into cells; maraviroc binds CCR5 and blocks viral entry; integrase inhibitors stop viral replication.NRTI 與 NNRTI 抑制逆轉錄酶；PI 抑制蛋白酶；融合抑制劑阻止 HIV 與細胞結合；maraviroc 結合 CCR5 阻斷病毒進入；整合酶抑制劑阻止病毒複製。
  • Standard therapy is 3-4 drugs together (HAART). It is not a cure, but it delays or reverses immune loss and prolongs life.標準治療是同時使用 3–4 種藥物（HAART）。它不能治癒，但可延緩或逆轉免疫功能喪失並延長壽命。
  • Other drugs treat complications and opportunistic infections; the client with HIV/AIDS is at high risk of opportunistic infection.其他藥物用於治療併發症與伺機性感染；HIV/AIDS 客戶有高度伺機性感染風險。
PDF p.1031, 1032, 1033

NRTIs (nucleoside/nucleotide RT inhibitors)NRTI 類藥物

  • Abacavir: nausea; watch for hypersensitivity (fever, rash, N/V/D, malaise, sore throat, cough, dyspnea).Abacavir：噁心；監測過敏反應（發燒、皮疹、噁心嘔吐腹瀉、倦怠、喉痛、咳嗽、呼吸困難）。
  • Didanosine: peripheral neuropathy, hepatotoxicity, pancreatitis (rising serum amylase may mean drug must be stopped).Didanosine：周邊神經病變、肝毒性、胰臟炎（血清澱粉酶上升可能需停藥）。
  • Stavudine: peripheral neuropathy and pancreatitis; check gait and paresthesias.Stavudine：周邊神經病變與胰臟炎；評估步態與感覺異常。
  • Zidovudine and lamivudine/zidovudine: anemia, neutropenia/leukopenia, myopathy; combinations may add lactic acidosis with severe hepatomegaly.Zidovudine 及 lamivudine/zidovudine：貧血、嗜中性球/白血球減少、肌病變；複方可能併有乳酸中毒與嚴重肝腫大。
  • Emtricitabine: headache, diarrhea, nausea, rash, palm/sole hyperpigmentation, lactic acidosis. Lamivudine: nausea, nasal congestion. Tenofovir: nausea and vomiting.Emtricitabine：頭痛、腹瀉、噁心、皮疹、手掌腳底色素沉著、乳酸中毒。Lamivudine：噁心、鼻塞。Tenofovir：噁心嘔吐。
PDF p.1031, 1032

NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase, fusion, CCR5NNRTI、PI、整合酶、融合與 CCR5 抑制劑

  • NNRTIs: rash is the common theme; nevirapine can cause Stevens-Johnson syndrome and hepatitis; efavirenz causes dizziness, confusion, abnormal dreams; etravirine adds hypertension and neuropathy.NNRTI：共通特徵是皮疹；nevirapine 可致 Stevens-Johnson 症候群與肝炎；efavirenz 造成頭暈、意識混亂、怪夢；etravirine 另有高血壓與神經病變。
  • Protease inhibitors (-navir): GI upset, altered taste, circumoral paresthesia, hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia, fat redistribution, liver effects.蛋白酶抑制劑（-navir）：腸胃不適、味覺改變、口周感覺異常、高血糖、高血脂、脂肪重新分佈、肝功能異常。
  • Specific PIs: indinavir causes kidney stones/nephritis and hyperbilirubinemia; tipranavir is hepatotoxic; saquinavir causes photosensitivity; atazanavir raises bleeding risk in hemophilia.特定 PI：indinavir 造成腎結石/腎炎與高膽紅素血症；tipranavir 有肝毒性；saquinavir 造成光敏感；atazanavir 使血友病患出血風險增加。
  • Integrase inhibitors (-gravir): nausea, diarrhea, headache, fatigue; dolutegravir: hypersensitivity and liver problems.整合酶抑制劑（-gravir）：噁心、腹瀉、頭痛、疲倦；dolutegravir 可致過敏與肝問題。
  • Enfuvirtide (fusion inhibitor, injected): injection-site reactions, fatigue, insomnia, peripheral neuropathy. Maraviroc: cough, fever, rash, upper respiratory infection, liver injury, cardiovascular events.Enfuvirtide（注射）：注射部位反應、疲倦、失眠、周邊神經病變。Maraviroc：咳嗽、發燒、皮疹、上呼吸道感染、肝損傷、心血管事件。
PDF p.1032, 1033

Treatment of opportunistic infections伺機性感染用藥

  • Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and toxoplasma encephalitis: sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim (also pentamidine, atovaquone).肺囊蟲肺炎與弓形蟲腦炎：sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim（亦可用 pentamidine、atovaquone）。
  • Antifungals (amphotericin B, fluconazole, itraconazole, ketoconazole, voriconazole): candidiasis and cryptococcal meningitis.抗黴菌藥（amphotericin B、fluconazole、itraconazole、ketoconazole、voriconazole）：念珠菌感染與隱球菌腦膜炎。
  • Antivirals (acyclovir, ganciclovir, foscarnet, valacyclovir): CMV retinitis, herpes simplex, varicella-zoster.抗病毒藥（acyclovir、ganciclovir、foscarnet、valacyclovir）：CMV 視網膜炎、單純疱疹、水痘帶狀疱疹。
  • Fever during pentamidine therapy in AIDS suggests a new infection because the drug can cause leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and anemia.AIDS 客戶使用 pentamidine 時發燒，應考慮新的感染，因藥物可造成白血球、血小板減少與貧血。
PDF p.1032, 1033, 1035

Immunosuppressants免疫抑制劑

  • Uses: prevent organ/tissue rejection after transplant and treat autoimmune disease (e.g., lupus). Classes: calcineurin inhibitors, cytotoxic drugs, antibodies, mTOR/other drugs, glucocorticoids.用途：預防移植排斥並治療自體免疫疾病（如狼瘡）。類別：calcineurin 抑制劑、細胞毒性藥、抗體、mTOR/其他、糖皮質激素。
  • Cyclosporine: nephrotoxicity, infection, hypertension, hirsutism. Tacrolimus: nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, hyperkalemia, hyperglycemia, hypertension, gum hyperplasia.Cyclosporine：腎毒性、感染、高血壓、多毛。Tacrolimus：腎毒性、神經毒性、高血鉀、高血糖、高血壓、牙齦增生。
  • Azathioprine: neutropenia, thrombocytopenia (renal transplant). Cyclophosphamide: neutropenia, hemorrhagic cystitis. Methotrexate: hepatic fibrosis/cirrhosis, bone marrow suppression, stomatitis, renal damage.Azathioprine：嗜中性球與血小板減少（腎移植）。Cyclophosphamide：嗜中性球減少、出血性膀胱炎。Methotrexate：肝纖維化/肝硬化、骨髓抑制、口腔潰瘍、腎損傷。
  • Mycophenolate: diarrhea, vomiting, neutropenia, sepsis, lymphoma risk. Basiliximab: severe acute hypersensitivity, including anaphylaxis. Antithymocyte/lymphocyte immune globulin and muromonab-CD3: fever, chills, leukopenia, skin reactions, and anaphylactoid reactions.Mycophenolate：腹瀉、嘔吐、嗜中性球減少、敗血症、淋巴瘤風險。Basiliximab：嚴重急性過敏反應，包括過敏性休克。抗胸腺細胞/淋巴細胞球蛋白與 muromonab-CD3：發燒、畏寒、白血球減少、皮膚反應，以及類過敏反應。
  • Sirolimus: infection, elevated cholesterol/triglycerides, renal injury, rash, anemia, thrombocytopenia, hypokalemia. Everolimus: mouth sores, edema, infection.Sirolimus：感染、膽固醇與三酸甘油酯上升、腎損傷、皮疹、貧血、血小板減少、低血鉀。Everolimus：口腔潰瘍、水腫、感染。
  • Monitor all immunosuppressed clients closely for signs of infection.所有免疫抑制客戶都要密切監測感染徵象。
PDF p.1033

Antimicrobials: classes and adverse effects抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應

  • Aminoglycosides (-mycin/-micin, e.g., gentamicin, amikacin): ototoxicity, nephrotoxicity, confusion, GI irritation, palpitations, BP changes, hypersensitivity. Report hearing loss at once.胺基糖苷類（如 gentamicin、amikacin）：耳毒性、腎毒性、意識混亂、腸胃刺激、心悸、血壓變化、過敏。聽力減退須立即通報。
  • Cephalosporins (cef-/ceph-): GI upset, pseudomembranous colitis, nephrotoxicity, superinfection. Fluoroquinolones (-floxacin): CNS effects, photosensitivity, tendinopathy, GI effects.頭孢菌素類：腸胃不適、偽膜性結腸炎、腎毒性、二重感染。氟喹諾酮類（-floxacin）：中樞神經效應、光敏感、肌腱病變、腸胃效應。
  • Macrolides (-thromycin) and lincosamides (clindamycin): GI effects, pseudomembranous colitis, superinfection.大環內酯類（-thromycin）與林可醯胺類（clindamycin）：腸胃效應、偽膜性結腸炎、二重感染。
  • Penicillins: hypersensitivity/anaphylaxis, GI effects, sore mouth, furry tongue, superinfection. Sulfonamides: nephrotoxicity, hepatotoxicity, bone marrow suppression, rash/photosensitivity, neurologic symptoms.青黴素類：過敏/過敏性休克、腸胃效應、口腔痛、毛舌、二重感染。磺胺類：腎毒性、肝毒性、骨髓抑制、皮疹/光敏感、神經症狀。
  • Tetracyclines (-cycline): tooth staining and bone damage, photosensitivity, hepatotoxicity, GI effects. Aztreonam: GI, hepatotoxicity, allergy.四環黴素類（-cycline）：牙齒染色與骨骼傷害、光敏感、肝毒性、腸胃效應。Aztreonam：腸胃、肝毒性、過敏。
  • Antifungals: GI effects, headache, rash, anemia, hepatotoxicity, hearing loss, peripheral neuritis. Ketoconazole: give with food, avoid alcohol, antacids 2 h apart, avoid sun, monitor liver function.抗黴菌藥：腸胃效應、頭痛、皮疹、貧血、肝毒性、聽力喪失、周邊神經炎。Ketoconazole：隨餐服用、避免酒精、制酸劑間隔 2 小時、避免日曬、監測肝功能。
PDF p.1034, 1035

Nursing considerations for antimicrobials抗微生物藥護理考量

  • Assess for allergies before the first dose and review baseline labs; monitor labs during therapy.首次給藥前評估過敏史並檢視基準檢驗值；治療期間持續監測。
  • Report adverse effects to the primary health care provider; monitor intake and output and encourage fluids unless contraindicated.通報不良反應給醫師；監測輸入輸出量，除非禁忌否則鼓勵飲水。
  • Institute safety precautions for CNS effects; teach how to take the drug and to finish the full course.因可能有中樞神經效應，採取安全措施；教導用藥方式並強調完成整個療程。
  • Severe diarrhea on a cephalosporin: contact precautions, monitor fluid/electrolytes, oral fluids (avoid caffeine, sugar, fatty/spicy food), ask the provider about probiotics and antidiarrheals.使用頭孢菌素後嚴重腹瀉：接觸隔離、監測體液電解質、口服補液（避免咖啡因、高糖、油膩辛辣）、詢問醫師是否使用益生菌與止瀉藥。
  • Immunizations are covered in Chapter 19.疫苗接種請見第 19 章。
PDF p.1033, 1035

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Didanosine: pancreatitis. Serum amylase rising to 1.5-2x normal may require stopping the drug; also hepatotoxic.Didanosine：胰臟炎。血清澱粉酶升到正常 1.5–2 倍可能需停藥；亦有肝毒性。 PDF p.1031, 1036
  2. Stavudine and didanosine: peripheral neuropathy; assess gait and paresthesia.Stavudine 與 didanosine：周邊神經病變；評估步態與麻木感。 PDF p.1031, 1036
  3. Abacavir: hypersensitivity reaction (fever, rash, GI, respiratory symptoms) is the red flag.Abacavir：過敏反應（發燒、皮疹、腸胃與呼吸症狀）為警訊。 PDF p.1031
  4. Zidovudine: anemia and leukopenia (the lamivudine/zidovudine combination can also add neutropenia); monitor CBC.Zidovudine：貧血與白血球減少（與 lamivudine 併用時可能再併發嗜中性球減少）；監測全血球計數。 PDF p.1031
  5. NRTI combos: lactic acidosis with severe hepatomegaly.NRTI 複方：乳酸中毒併嚴重肝腫大。 PDF p.1031
  6. Nevirapine: rash can progress to Stevens-Johnson syndrome; also hepatitis.Nevirapine：皮疹可進展為 Stevens-Johnson 症候群；亦可能肝炎。 PDF p.1032
  7. Protease inhibitors: hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia, fat redistribution; indinavir causes kidney stones (hydrate).蛋白酶抑制劑：高血糖、高血脂、脂肪重新分佈；indinavir 造成腎結石（需充足補水）。 PDF p.1032
  8. HAART is not a cure; it is lifelong, combination therapy.HAART 非治癒，是終身的合併療法。 PDF p.1031
  9. Cyclosporine and tacrolimus: nephrotoxicity and hypertension; a headache in a client on cyclosporine should prompt a BP check.Cyclosporine 與 tacrolimus：腎毒性與高血壓；服用 cyclosporine 者頭痛應先量血壓。 PDF p.1033, 1036
  10. Tacrolimus: also hyperkalemia and hyperglycemia.Tacrolimus：亦可致高血鉀與高血糖。 PDF p.1033
  11. Cyclophosphamide: hemorrhagic cystitis (hydrate). Methotrexate: liver, marrow, mucosa, kidney.Cyclophosphamide：出血性膀胱炎（須補水）。Methotrexate：肝、骨髓、黏膜、腎。 PDF p.1033
  12. Basiliximab and antithymocyte globulin: anaphylaxis risk; monitor during infusion.Basiliximab 與抗胸腺細胞球蛋白：有過敏性休克風險；輸注期間監測。 PDF p.1033
  13. Aminoglycosides: ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity. Report hearing loss, tinnitus, or decreased urine output immediately.胺基糖苷類：耳毒性與腎毒性。聽力減退、耳鳴或尿量減少須立即通報。 PDF p.1034, 1036, 1037
  14. Tetracyclines: teeth staining; avoid in pregnancy and young children; photosensitivity.四環黴素類：牙齒染色；孕婦與幼童避免；光敏感。 PDF p.1034
  15. Cephalosporins/clindamycin/macrolides: severe diarrhea may be pseudomembranous colitis (C. difficile) - contact precautions.頭孢菌素/clindamycin/大環內酯類：嚴重腹瀉可能是偽膜性結腸炎（C. difficile）——接觸隔離。 PDF p.1034, 1035
  16. Ketoconazole: hepatotoxic; give with food, avoid alcohol, sun and antacids.Ketoconazole：肝毒性；隨餐服用，避免酒精、日曬與制酸劑。 PDF p.1035, 1036
  17. Always check allergies first (especially penicillins and sulfonamides) and complete the entire antibiotic course.務必先確認過敏史（尤其青黴素與磺胺類），並完成整個抗生素療程。 PDF p.1035

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Drug-name stems: -navir = protease inhibitor; -vir (acyclovir etc.) = antiviral; -gravir = integrase inhibitor; -floxacin = fluoroquinolone; -cycline = tetracycline; -mycin/-micin = aminoglycoside (macrolides end -thromycin); cef-/ceph- = cephalosporin; -azole = antifungal.藥名字尾：-navir＝蛋白酶抑制劑；-vir＝抗病毒；-gravir＝整合酶抑制劑；-floxacin＝氟喹諾酮；-cycline＝四環黴素；-mycin/-micin＝胺基糖苷（大環內酯為 -thromycin）；cef-/ceph-＝頭孢菌素；-azole＝抗黴菌。 PDF p.1032, 1034
  • Ototoxic/nephrotoxic pair for aminoglycosides: 'Ears and Kidneys'. Neuropathy pair: 'd4T and ddI hurt the nerves and pancreas' (stavudine, didanosine).胺基糖苷「耳與腎」。周邊神經病變與胰臟炎：stavudine、didanosine（d4T、ddI）。 PDF p.1031, 1034

65 Foundations of Psychiatric Mental Health Nursing精神健康護理基礎

This chapter covers the nurse-client relationship and its phases, therapeutic communication, coping and defense mechanisms, legal rights and admission types, and the major treatment modalities. Therapeutic communication and client rights are among the most frequently tested psychosocial topics.本章涵蓋護病關係及其階段、治療性溝通、因應與防衛機轉、法律權利與入院類型，以及主要治療模式。治療性溝通與病人權利是心理社會整合領域最常考的主題。

The therapeutic nurse-client relationship治療性護病關係

  • Core qualities: genuineness, respect, empathic understanding; holistic care that respects culture and spirituality.核心特質：真誠、尊重、同理；以整體觀照護並尊重文化與靈性。
  • Boundaries and limits define the relationship; honesty builds trust; confidentiality limits sharing to the interprofessional team.界線與限制定義護病關係；誠實建立信任；保密僅限於跨專業團隊內分享。
  • Goal: help the client develop problem-solving and coping skills.目標：協助客戶發展解決問題與因應能力。
  • Family is viewed as a collaborator (maintain confidentiality) and should be educated about the illness and symptom management.家屬視為合作夥伴（仍須保密），並需接受疾病與症狀處理的衛教。
PDF p.1040, 1041

Phases of the relationship護病關係的階段

  • Preinteraction: before first contact; prepare the environment and examine your own biases.互動前期：首次接觸前；準備環境並檢視自身偏見。
  • Orientation: introduce yourself by name and role, set purpose and time frame (contract), build trust, collect data, discuss termination in advance.導入期：自我介紹姓名與角色、說明目的與時間架構（契約）、建立信任、收集資料、預先討論結束關係。
  • Working: explore concerns, problem-solve, identify coping strategies, encourage self-direction.工作期：探索問題、解決問題、找出因應策略、鼓勵自我導向。
  • Termination: prepare from the first meeting, evaluate goals, expect anger, distancing, return of symptoms or dependency, refer to community resources.結束期：從初次接觸就預先準備、評估目標、預期憤怒、疏離、症狀復發或依賴，並轉介社區資源。
PDF p.1040, 1041

Therapeutic communication治療性溝通

  • Communication is verbal and nonverbal; messages pass through personal filters; anxiety impairs it (Fig. 65.1).溝通包含語言與非語言；訊息會經過個人過濾；焦慮會妨礙溝通（圖 65.1）。
  • Therapeutic techniques: active listening, broad openings, clarifying, exploring, focusing, informing, offering self, open-ended questions, paraphrasing, reflecting, restating, silence, summarizing, validating.治療性技巧：主動傾聽、廣泛開場、澄清、探索、聚焦、提供資訊、陪伴、開放式問句、換句話說、反映、重述、沉默、摘要、確認。
  • Nontherapeutic: approval/disapproval, excessive or closed-ended questions, changing the subject, disagreeing, false reassurance, giving advice, minimizing feelings, parroting, placing feelings on hold, value judgments, 'why' questions.非治療性：贊同/不贊同、過多或封閉式問句、轉移話題、反對、錯誤安慰、給建議、貶低感受、鸚鵡式複述、擱置感受、價值判斷、問「為什麼」。
PDF p.1041, 1042

Mental health and mental health problems心理健康與心理健康問題

  • Mental health is lifelong adaptation to internal and external change: in touch with reality, relates to others, solves conflicts, resilient.心理健康是對內外環境變化的終身適應：與現實接觸、能與人相處、解決衝突、具復原力。
  • Mental health lies on a continuum up to serious mental illness with major functional impairment.心理健康是一個連續譜，另一端是造成功能嚴重損害的重大精神疾病。
  • Features of illness: distorted self-concept, non-reality-based thinking, impaired meaning/purpose, poor self-care, ineffective coping, impaired relationships.疾病特徵：自我概念扭曲、思考脫離現實、失去意義感、自我照顧不足、因應無效、人際關係受損。
PDF p.1042, 1043

Coping and defense mechanisms因應與防衛機轉

  • Coping is any effort to reduce anxiety; defense mechanisms protect the ego as anxiety rises.因應是任何減輕焦慮的努力；焦慮升高時防衛機轉保護自我。
  • Interventions: identify the source of anxiety first, then explore ways to reduce it; assess whether defenses help or add distress.處置：先找出焦慮來源，再探索減輕方式；評估防衛是否有效或增加困擾。
  • Never argue with or criticize a defense; do not remove it until healthier coping exists.勿與客戶爭論或批評其防衛機轉；在建立較健康的因應前不要拿掉。
  • Table 65.2 defenses: compensation, conversion, denial, displacement, dissociation, identification, intellectualization, introjection, isolation, projection, rationalization, reaction formation, regression, repression.表 65.2 防衛機轉：補償、轉化、否認、替代、解離、認同、理智化、內射、隔離、投射、合理化、反向作用、退化、潛抑。
PDF p.1043, 1044

DSM and dual diagnosisDSM 與雙重診斷

  • The DSM from the American Psychiatric Association gives diagnostic criteria used in clinical, research and educational settings.美國精神醫學會的 DSM 提供臨床、研究與教育使用的診斷準則。
  • Dual diagnosis (comorbidity) means a mental health problem plus a substance-related problem.雙重診斷（共病）指同時有精神健康問題與物質相關問題。
PDF p.1044

Admissions, rights, confidentiality and release入院、權利、保密與出院

  • Voluntary: client seeks care, keeps full civil rights, and may request release; detaining a voluntary client without legal grounds is false imprisonment.自願入院：客戶自行求助，保有完整公民權，可要求出院；無法律依據扣留自願病人構成非法拘禁。
  • Involuntary: needed for danger to self/others or need for treatment; client keeps right to informed consent and to refuse treatment except in immediate danger; legal counsel, hearing, possible 72-hour hold, least restrictive setting.非自願入院：因對自己/他人有危險或需治療；仍保有知情同意與拒絕治療的權利（立即危險除外）；有法律代表、聽證、可能 72 小時留置、最少限制環境。
  • HIPAA protects confidentiality; release only with informed consent, except emergencies; there is a duty to warn an identified intended victim.HIPAA 保障隱私；除緊急情況外須經知情同意才能揭露；對明確的被威脅對象有警告義務。
  • Competence is presumed unless declared otherwise by a separate legal hearing. Conditional release and aftercare case managers support community reintegration; writ of habeas corpus allows judicial discharge hearing.除非經另行法律聽證宣告，否則視為有行為能力。條件式出院與出院後個案管理協助重返社區；人身保護令可要求司法出院聽證。
PDF p.1044, 1045, 1046

Treatment modalities治療模式

  • Milieu therapy: safe therapeutic environment, safety first, all team members valued, community meetings and activity groups.環境治療：安全的治療性環境，安全為首要，所有團隊成員同樣重要，含社區會議與活動團體。
  • Interpersonal psychotherapy: supportive, reeducative, reconstructive levels.人際心理治療：支持性、再教育性、重建性三個層次。
  • Behavior therapy: operant conditioning (reinforcers), classical conditioning, desensitization, aversion therapy, modeling. Cognitive therapy: identify and correct distorted thoughts.行為治療：操作制約（增強物）、古典制約、系統減敏、嫌惡治療、示範。認知治療：辨識並矯正扭曲的想法。
  • Group therapy (5-8 members): initial stage superficial talk and norms; working stage real work; termination begins at first meeting and explores feelings about ending.團體治療（5–8 人）：初期為表淺交談與建立規範；工作期處理實質問題；結束從首次聚會就開始並探討結束的感受。
  • Self-help groups (AA, Al-Anon, NA, Gamblers Anonymous) rely on peer experience; family therapy treats the family as the unit and the symptomatic member as a signal.自助團體（AA、Al-Anon、NA、嗜賭者匿名會）仰賴同儕經驗；家族治療以家庭為單位，症狀成員代表整個家庭的問題。
PDF p.1046, 1047, 1048

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Use feeling-focused, open-ended, client-centered responses (restating, reflecting, exploring); avoid 'why', advice, false reassurance, and changing the subject.使用聚焦感受、開放式、以客戶為中心的回應（重述、反映、探索）；避免問「為什麼」、給建議、錯誤安慰與轉移話題。 PDF p.1042
  2. Safety is the priority in the milieu; physical safety precedes other goals.環境治療中安全為首要；身體安全優先於其他目標。 PDF p.1046
  3. Voluntary clients may request discharge; notify the provider first. Holding them without legal grounds is false imprisonment.自願入院客戶可要求出院；先通知醫師。無法律依據扣留即非法拘禁。 PDF p.1045, 1046, 1049
  4. Restraining a voluntary client without criteria risks assault, battery and false imprisonment.對未達條件的自願客戶使用約束，可能構成恐嚇、傷害與非法拘禁。 PDF p.1049
  5. Involuntary clients retain the right to refuse treatment unless in immediate danger; they have legal counsel and the right to a hearing and the least restrictive setting.非自願客戶除非有立即危險，否則保有拒絕治療的權利；有法律代表、聽證權與最少限制環境。 PDF p.1045
  6. Duty to warn: tell an identified intended victim of a threat; otherwise do not disclose without informed consent.警告義務：對明確的被威脅對象須告知；其餘情況未經知情同意不得揭露。 PDF p.1045
  7. Confidentiality: respond politely but firmly that you cannot discuss any client.保密：禮貌而堅定地回應無法討論任何客戶。 PDF p.1045, 1049
  8. Do not take away a defense mechanism until more adaptive coping is established; do not criticize it.在建立較適應的因應之前不要拿掉防衛機轉；不要批評。 PDF p.1043, 1044
  9. Priority in coping: identify the anxiety source first, then explore ways to reduce it.因應優先順序：先找出焦慮來源，再探索減輕方式。 PDF p.1043
  10. Orientation phase: introduce self, set the contract and time frame, and discuss termination early.導入期：自我介紹、訂定契約與時間架構、及早討論結束。 PDF p.1040
  11. Working phase: address the client's feelings that may block adaptive coping.工作期：處理可能妨礙適應性因應的感受。 PDF p.1049, 1050
  12. Termination begins at the first contact; expect anger, distancing, symptom return or dependency.結束階段從初次接觸即開始；預期憤怒、疏離、症狀復發或依賴。 PDF p.1040, 1041
  13. Group termination: evaluate the experience and explore feelings about separation.團體結束期：評估經驗並探討對分離的感受。 PDF p.1047, 1048, 1050
  14. Cognitive therapy targets dysfunctional thoughts/beliefs; first step of the 12-step program is admitting a problem exists.認知治療針對失功能的想法與信念；12 步驟計畫的第一步是承認有問題。 PDF p.1048, 1049

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Defense mechanism memory hooks: Projection = 'blame it on you'; Displacement = 'kick the dog'; Reaction formation = 'opposite of what I feel'; Regression = 'act like a child'; Rationalization = 'excuses'; Repression = 'forgotten unconsciously'; Denial = 'it isn't true'; Intellectualization = 'facts without feelings'.防衛機轉口訣：投射＝怪別人；替代＝遷怒對象；反向作用＝表現與內心相反；退化＝像小孩；合理化＝找藉口；潛抑＝無意識遺忘；否認＝不承認；理智化＝只談事實不談感受。 PDF p.1044
  • Therapeutic = Open, Reflect, Clarify, Silence; Non-therapeutic = Why, Advice, Reassure, Change subject.治療性：開放、反映、澄清、沉默；非治療性：為什麼、建議、安慰、轉移話題。 PDF p.1042

66 Mental Health Problems精神健康問題

This chapter reviews anxiety and related disorders (GAD, panic, PTSD, phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders), mood disorders (bipolar, depression, ECT), schizophrenia, personality disorders, and dementia/Alzheimer disease. Priorities are safety, therapeutic communication, reality-based interaction, and recognizing key signs of each disorder.本章涵蓋焦慮及相關疾患（GAD、恐慌、PTSD、畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患）、情感性疾患（雙相、憂鬱、電痙攣治療）、思覺失調症、人格疾患，以及失智症/阿茲海默症。重點為安全、治療性溝通、以現實為基礎的互動，以及辨識各疾患的關鍵表現。

Anxiety: levels and general nursing care焦慮：程度與一般護理

  • Mild: heightened perception, motivates learning. Moderate: narrowed focus, selective inattention, can still learn; tachycardia, sweating, mild tremor.輕度：感知增強，促進學習。中度：注意力縮窄、選擇性忽略，仍可學習；心跳加快、流汗、輕微顫抖。
  • Severe: very narrow field, scattered details, no learning or problem-solving; sympathetic symptoms, hyperventilation; needs direction.重度：視野極窄、專注於零碎細節，無法學習或解決問題；交感症狀、換氣過度；需要引導。
  • Panic: terror, disorganization, distorted reality, cannot communicate; prolonged panic can cause exhaustion.恐慌：恐懼、思緒紊亂、扭曲現實、無法溝通；持續太久可致衰竭。
  • First action: decrease stimuli and provide a calm, quiet environment; recognize anxiety, establish trust, protect the client, do not criticize coping, do not force anxiety-provoking situations.首要措施：減少刺激並提供平靜安靜環境；辨識焦慮、建立信任、保護客戶、不批評因應方式、不強迫面對引發焦慮的情境。
  • Mild-moderate: identify source, talk, problem-solve, gross motor exercise. Severe-panic: stay with client, calm low-pitched voice, short simple statements, walk with the client, medications as prescribed.輕中度：找出來源、談論感受、解決問題、大肌肉運動。重度至恐慌：陪伴、平穩低沉聲音、簡短語句、陪同走動、依醫囑給藥。
PDF p.1055, 1056

GAD and panic attacks廣泛性焦慮與恐慌發作

  • GAD: excessive worry on most days for 6 months or more with 3+ symptoms (restless, easily tired, poor concentration, irritable, muscle tension, sleep problems), not due to substances or medical cause (Box 66.1).GAD：多數日子過度擔憂達 6 個月以上，並有 3 項以上症狀（坐立不安、易疲倦、注意力差、易怒、肌肉緊繃、睡眠問題），且非物質或醫療因素所致（方框 66.1）。
  • Panic attack: sudden intense dread lasting about 5-30 minutes with choking sensation, pounding heart, chest pain, dizziness, paresthesias, fear of dying.恐慌發作：突發強烈恐懼約 5–30 分鐘，伴窒息感、心悸、胸痛、頭暈、麻木、瀕死恐懼。
  • Stay with the client, treat physical symptoms, use cognitive restructuring to replace distorted thoughts, give antianxiety drugs if prescribed.陪伴客戶、處理身體症狀、用認知重建取代扭曲想法、依醫囑給抗焦慮藥。
PDF p.1056, 1057

PTSD, trauma-informed care and moral injury創傷後壓力症、創傷知情照護與道德傷害

  • PTSD follows trauma (disaster, combat, assault, abuse): re-experiencing (flashbacks, nightmares), avoidance, hyperarousal (startle, hypervigilance, irritability), guilt, detachment.PTSD 發生於創傷後（災難、戰爭、暴力、虐待）：再經歷（閃回、夢魘）、迴避、過度警覺（驚嚇反應、警戒、易怒）、罪惡感、疏離。
  • During a flashback: ensure safety, stay calm, reassure that the client is safe, do not startle. Monitor suicide risk, teach stress management, include family and support groups.閃回時：確保安全、保持冷靜、告知客戶安全、避免驚嚇。監測自殺風險、教導壓力管理、納入家屬與支持團體。
  • Evidence-based treatments: medication, CBT, prolonged exposure, EMDR.實證治療：藥物、認知行為治療、延長暴露治療、眼動減敏與歷程更新（EMDR）。
  • Trauma-informed care asks 'what happened to you?' rather than 'what is wrong with you?'; avoid restraints/coercion, collaborate, peer support, empowerment, cultural respect.創傷知情照護問的是「你經歷了什麼？」而非「你哪裡不對勁？」；避免約束與強制，強調合作、同儕支持、賦權與文化尊重。
  • Moral injury: distress from acts that violate one's moral beliefs (guilt, shame, disgust, anger, inability to self-forgive); not currently a mental disorder; fear-based hyperarousal is not characteristic. Assess depression and self-harm first; use nonjudgmental approach, group therapy, cognitive processing therapy.道德傷害：因違背自身道德信念的行為而痛苦（罪惡感、羞愧、厭惡、憤怒、無法自我原諒）；目前不屬精神疾病；恐懼性過度警覺不是其特徵。優先評估憂鬱與自傷；採不批判態度、團體治療、認知處理治療。
PDF p.1057, 1058

Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患

  • Specific phobia: irrational fear with avoidance; stay with the client, never force contact; teach relaxation; gradual desensitization (Box 66.2).特定畏懼症：非理性恐懼並迴避；陪伴、絕不強迫接觸；教導放鬆；漸進式減敏（方框 66.2）。
  • OCD: obsessions (intrusive thoughts) and compulsions (rituals) that reduce anxiety. Do not interrupt rituals unless unsafe; allow time, set limits, schedule distractions, written contract, reinforce non-ritual behavior (Box 66.3).強迫症：強迫思考（侵入性想法）與強迫行為（儀式）以降低焦慮。除非危險否則不打斷儀式；給予時間、設限、安排分散活動、書面契約、強化非儀式行為（方框 66.3）。
  • Related: hoarding, skin-picking, trichotillomania.相關疾患：囤積症、摳皮症、拔毛症。
  • Somatic symptom disorder: physical complaints without findings, anxiety redirected into body, secondary gain. Allow a limited time to discuss complaints, do not reinforce them, assess any new complaint, explore anxiety.身體症狀疾患：無器質證據的身體不適，焦慮轉移至身體，有次級獲益。限定時間討論不適、不強化症狀、評估任何新主訴、探索焦慮。
  • Conversion disorder: sudden neurological deficit (blindness, paralysis, mutism) without organic cause, 'la belle indifference'; symptoms reduce anxiety; rule out physical causes first.轉化症：突發神經功能缺損（失明、癱瘓、失語）但無器質原因，常有「泰然漠視」；症狀可減輕焦慮；須先排除生理原因。
  • Dissociative disorders: DID (host and alters, sudden switching), dissociative amnesia (localized, selective, generalized), depersonalization/derealization (reality testing intact). Orient, build trust, simple routines, let client set pace.解離疾患：DID（主人格與次人格，突然轉換）、解離性失憶（局部、選擇性、廣泛性）、人格解體/現實解體（現實感仍完整）。給予定向、建立信任、簡單作息、依客戶步調進行。
PDF p.1058, 1059, 1060

Bipolar disorder and mania雙相疾患與躁症

  • Types: bipolar I (mania to depression), bipolar II (hypomania plus severe depression), cyclothymic, mixed features.類型：雙相 I 型（躁症到憂鬱）、II 型（輕躁加重度憂鬱）、循環性情感疾患、混合特徵。
  • Lithium: toxic, needs regular serum level monitoring; keep sodium intake steady and fluids 2-3 L/day. Atypical antipsychotics also used; avoid antianxiety agents if substance abuse history.鋰鹽：有毒性，需定期監測血中濃度；維持穩定鈉攝取與每日 2–3 公升水分。亦使用非典型抗精神病藥；有物質濫用史者避免抗焦慮藥。
  • Mania signs: flight of ideas, pressured speech, grandiosity, little sleep, excessive spending, distractibility, euphoria/irritability (Box 66.5).躁症表現：意念飛躍、言語急迫、誇大、睡眠極少、過度消費、分心、欣快或易怒（方框 66.5）。
  • Interventions: safety first, low stimulation, private room, short calm interactions, do not argue, redirect grandiosity, high-calorie finger foods, rest, solitary or gross-motor non-competitive activities, set limits.處置：安全為先、低刺激、單人房、簡短平穩互動、不爭辯、轉移誇大想法、高熱量手指食物、休息、獨自或非競爭性大肌肉活動、設限。
  • Manipulation: clear consistent limits, nonpunitive follow-through, avoid power struggles. Aggression: de-escalation, respect space, calm assertive tone (Box 66.6).操弄行為：清楚一致的限制、非懲罰性執行、避免權力鬥爭。攻擊行為：降級技巧、尊重個人空間、平穩而果斷的語氣（方框 66.6）。
PDF p.1060, 1061, 1062

Depression and ECT憂鬱症與電痙攣治療

  • Major depression: depressed mood or anhedonia plus changes in appetite/weight, sleep, energy, concentration, worthlessness/guilt, thoughts of death for most days; rule out hypothyroidism and substances.重度憂鬱：多數日子出現情緒低落或失去興趣，加上食慾/體重、睡眠、精力、專注力改變、無價值感/罪惡感、死亡念頭；須排除甲狀腺低下與物質。
  • Ask directly about self-harm. Suicide plan: one-to-one supervision, remove harmful objects. If an antidepressant begins to lift energy, watch closely - the client may now have energy to act.直接詢問自傷念頭。有自殺計畫：一對一監視、移除危險物品。抗憂鬱藥開始增加精力時要密切觀察——客戶可能有力氣執行自殺。
  • Depression care: structured, achievable, simple activities, begin one-to-one then small groups, stay with client at meals, monitor hygiene, sleep, nutrition (Box 66.7).憂鬱症照護：結構化、可達成的簡單活動，先一對一再進入小團體，用餐陪伴，監測衛生、睡眠與營養（方框 66.7）。
  • ECT: for severe/psychotic depression, suicidal, catatonia, treatment-resistant mania; course of 6-12 treatments every 2-5 days. Needs informed consent, NPO (after midnight or at least 4 h), void, remove dentures/hairpins/lenses.ECT：用於重度/精神病性憂鬱、自殺、僵直症、難治性躁症；療程 6–12 次、每 2–5 天一次。需知情同意、禁食（午夜後或至少 4 小時）、排尿、取下假牙/髮夾/隱形眼鏡。
  • During ECT: anesthetic and muscle relaxant, oxygen, bite guard, seizure 15-70 seconds. After: recovery area with suction/O2, orient the client, expect confusion and short-term memory loss. Risk clients: recent MI, stroke, intracranial mass.ECT 進行中：麻醉與肌肉鬆弛劑、給氧、咬合器、痙攣 15–70 秒。術後：於備有抽吸與氧氣的恢復區，持續定向，預期意識混亂與短期記憶喪失。高風險：近期心肌梗塞、中風、顱內腫塊。
PDF p.1062, 1063, 1064

Schizophrenia思覺失調症

  • Symptom domains: positive (hallucinations, delusions, disorganized speech, bizarre behavior), negative (blunted affect, anhedonia, avolition, alogia), cognitive, mood (Fig. 66.1).症狀向度：陽性（幻覺、妄想、語言紊亂、怪異行為）、陰性（情感鈍化、失樂症、動機缺乏、言語貧乏）、認知、情緒（圖 66.1）。
  • Motor: catatonic posturing/excitement, waxy flexibility, echopraxia. Thought: loose associations, thought blocking, neologisms, word salad, echolalia, clang association (Boxes 66.9, 66.10, 66.13).動作：僵直姿勢/興奮、蠟樣屈曲、仿作。思考：聯想鬆散、思考中斷、新語症、字詞沙拉、仿說、音韻聯想（方框 66.9、66.10、66.13）。
  • Delusions: reference, persecution, grandeur, somatic. Do not argue or try to convince; express feelings; reality-based topics; validate real parts (Box 66.11).妄想：關係、被害、誇大、身體妄想。不爭辯或說服；表達感受；談現實話題；肯定真實部分（方框 66.11）。
  • Hallucinations: ask directly, do not treat as real or deny the experience, reduce stimuli, concrete activity, avoid touch; safety first - check for command hallucinations (Box 66.12).幻覺：直接詢問、不當作真實也不否定經驗、降低刺激、安排具體活動、避免碰觸；安全為先——確認是否有命令式幻覺（方框 66.12）。
  • Care: safe, simple, structured routine; brief frequent contact; do not whisper; tell client when leaving; initially no choices; monitor suicide risk; withdrawn/catatonic clients: sit quietly with open-ended questions (Box 66.14).照護：安全、簡單、有結構的作息；簡短頻繁接觸；不要耳語；離開時告知；初期不提供選擇；監測自殺風險；退縮/僵直者：安靜陪坐並使用開放式問句（方框 66.14）。
PDF p.1064, 1065, 1066, 1067

Personality disorders人格疾患

  • Inflexible maladaptive patterns, reality testing usually intact but poor insight; impulsivity, acting out, impaired judgment and relationships.僵化不適應的模式，現實感通常完整但缺乏病識感；衝動、行動化、判斷與人際受損。
  • Cluster A (odd): schizoid, schizotypal, paranoid. Paranoid: do not whisper or laugh in front of client; be honest, brief frequent contact, keep commitments (Box 66.15).A 群（怪異）：類分裂型、思覺失調型、猜疑型。猜疑型：勿在客戶面前耳語或笑；誠實、簡短頻繁接觸、遵守承諾（方框 66.15）。
  • Cluster B (dramatic): histrionic, narcissistic, antisocial (no remorse, manipulative), borderline (unstable relationships, self-harm, splitting, fear of abandonment).B 群（戲劇化）：做作型、自戀型、反社會型（無悔意、操弄）、邊緣型（關係不穩、自傷、分裂、害怕被遺棄）。
  • Cluster C (anxious): obsessive-compulsive personality, avoidant (fear of rejection, social isolation), dependent.C 群（焦慮）：強迫型人格、逃避型（怕被拒絕、社交孤立）、依賴型。
  • Care: safety, consistent team response, limits, written behavioral contract, identify splitting, encourage talking not acting out, praise nonmanipulative behavior.照護：安全、團隊一致回應、設限、書面行為契約、辨識分裂、鼓勵說出而非行動化、讚美非操弄行為。
PDF p.1067, 1068, 1069

Dementia and Alzheimer disease失智症與阿茲海默症

  • Dementia: progressive intellectual decline with memory loss, poor judgment, self-care deficit; rule out reversible physiological causes first. Alzheimer is the most common type, irreversible.失智症：進行性智能退化，記憶喪失、判斷力差、自我照顧缺損；須先排除可逆的生理原因。阿茲海默症最常見且不可逆。
  • Stages: mild (forgetfulness), moderate (confusion), moderate-severe (ambulatory dementia), late (end stage). Aphasia, agnosia, apraxia, amnesia (Box 66.16).分期：輕度（健忘）、中度（意識混亂）、中重度（能行走的失智）、末期。失語、失認、失用、失憶（方框 66.16）。
  • Safety is the priority: clutter-free environment, close supervision, secured doors, ID bracelet, lower water-heater temperature, remove throw rugs.安全為首要：整潔無雜物、密切監督、鎖好門、識別手環、調低熱水溫度、移除地毯。
  • Sundowning: evening worsening. Use indirect light, consistent routine, afternoon rest, avoid hypnotics, allow safe wandering.日落症候群：傍晚症狀加重。使用間接光源、固定作息、午後休息、避免安眠藥、允許在安全處走動。
  • Communication: face the client, short simple sentences, one question or direction at a time, repeat without rephrasing, allow time, don't argue; support caregivers.溝通：面對客戶、短而簡單的句子、一次一個問題或指令、重複但不改述、給時間、不爭辯；支持照顧者。
  • Neurodevelopmental disorders (autism, ADHD) are covered in Chapter 39.神經發展疾患（自閉症、ADHD）請見第 39 章。
PDF p.1069, 1070, 1071

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Anxious client: first action is to reduce stimuli and provide a calm, quiet environment; stay with the client in severe anxiety/panic.焦慮客戶：首要行動是降低刺激並提供平靜環境；重度焦慮/恐慌時陪伴客戶。 PDF p.1056
  2. Severe anxiety and panic block learning; teach only when anxiety is mild-moderate.重度焦慮與恐慌無法學習；僅在輕中度焦慮時衛教。 PDF p.1055
  3. Never force a phobic client into contact with the feared object; use gradual desensitization.絕不強迫畏懼症客戶接觸害怕的對象；使用漸進式減敏。 PDF p.1058
  4. OCD: do not interrupt rituals unless unsafe; allow time and set limits.強迫症：除非不安全否則不打斷儀式；給予時間並設限。 PDF p.1059
  5. Conversion disorder: sudden deficit without organic cause, calm indifference; rule out physical illness; do not reinforce the symptom.轉化症：無器質原因的突發缺損、泰然漠視；先排除生理疾病；不強化症狀。 PDF p.1059, 1073
  6. Somatic symptom disorder: allow a limited time to discuss complaints; do not stop it completely.身體症狀疾患：限定時間討論不適；不要完全禁止。 PDF p.1060
  7. PTSD flashback: ensure safety, stay calm, don't startle, remind client they are safe.PTSD 閃回：確保安全、保持冷靜、不要驚嚇、提醒客戶是安全的。 PDF p.1057
  8. Mania: low stimulation, do not argue, set limits, finger foods, non-competitive solitary activities; safety of client and others is the immediate priority.躁症：低刺激、不爭辯、設限、手指食物、非競爭性獨自活動；客戶與他人安全為首要。 PDF p.1061, 1062, 1072, 1074
  9. Lithium requires regular serum level checks, steady sodium and 2-3 L fluid daily to avoid toxicity.鋰鹽需定期監測血中濃度，並維持穩定鈉攝取與每日 2–3 公升水分以避免中毒。 PDF p.1061
  10. Depression: ask directly about suicidal thoughts; increased energy after starting an antidepressant is a warning sign.憂鬱症：直接詢問自殺念頭；開始抗憂鬱藥後精力增加為警訊。 PDF p.1062, 1064
  11. ECT: informed consent, NPO, expect transient confusion and short-term memory loss; seizure lasts 15-70 seconds; 6-12 treatments.ECT：知情同意、禁食、預期暫時性意識混亂與短期記憶喪失；痙攣 15–70 秒；6–12 次療程。 PDF p.1062, 1063, 1064
  12. Hallucinations: first priority is safety; check for command hallucinations to harm self/others.幻覺：首要為安全；確認有無傷害自己/他人的命令式幻覺。 PDF p.1067
  13. Delusions: don't argue or confirm; respond to the feeling and refocus on reality.妄想：不爭辯也不附和；回應其感受並導回現實。 PDF p.1066, 1067, 1073
  14. Paranoid client: do not whisper or laugh in front of them; be honest and keep promises.猜疑型客戶：勿在其面前耳語或笑；誠實並信守承諾。 PDF p.1068
  15. Borderline: splitting, self-harm, fear of abandonment; consistent team and limits.邊緣型：分裂、自傷、害怕被遺棄；團隊一致並設限。 PDF p.1069
  16. Alzheimer: safety first; one direction at a time; avoid hypnotics; sundowning management; support caregivers.阿茲海默：安全為先；一次一個指令；避免安眠藥；處理日落症候群；支持照顧者。 PDF p.1070, 1071
  17. Delirium/confusion at night: indirect light, no TV, consistent routine.夜間譫妄/混亂：間接光源、關掉電視、固定作息。 PDF p.1071, 1073

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Anxiety levels: Mild = motivates; Moderate = narrows; Severe = scattered; Panic = terror. Learning stops at severe.焦慮程度：輕度＝激勵；中度＝縮窄；重度＝零散；恐慌＝恐懼。重度起學習停止。 PDF p.1055
  • Schizophrenia '4 A's' (Bleuler): Affect (blunted), Associations (loose), Ambivalence, Autism (withdrawal). Positive symptoms = 'added' (hallucinations/delusions); negative = 'lost' (motivation, pleasure, speech).思覺失調「4A」：情感、聯想、矛盾、自閉。陽性症狀＝「多出來」（幻覺/妄想）；陰性＝「少了」（動機、愉悅、言語）。 PDF p.1064
  • Personality clusters: A = Odd (Weird), B = Dramatic (Wild), C = Anxious (Worried). 'ABC = Weird, Wild, Worried'.人格群：A＝怪異；B＝戲劇化；C＝焦慮。口訣：怪、狂、怕。 PDF p.1067, 1068, 1069

67 Addictions成癮

This chapter covers eating disorders (compulsive overeating, anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa) and substance use disorders, including alcohol use and withdrawal, delirium tremens, and intoxication, overdose and withdrawal from CNS depressants, stimulants, opioids, hallucinogens, inhalants and marijuana. Safety, withdrawal recognition, and non-judgmental limit setting are the main test themes.本章涵蓋飲食疾患（強迫性暴食、神經性厭食症、神經性暴食症）與物質使用疾患，包括酒精使用與戒斷、震顫譫妄，以及中樞神經抑制劑、興奮劑、鴉片類、迷幻劑、吸入劑與大麻的中毒、過量與戒斷。主要考點為安全、戒斷辨識與不批判的設限。

Eating disorders: types and assessment飲食疾患：類型與評估

  • Compulsive overeating: binge-like eating without purging, done secretly, relieves tension but brings guilt and depression; repeated failed diets.強迫性暴食：暴食但不催吐，常偷偷進行，可緩解緊張但帶來罪惡感與憂鬱；多次節食失敗。
  • Anorexia nervosa: intense fear of obesity, distorted body image, refusal to eat, compulsive exercise, perfectionism; can be fatal (starvation, suicide, cardiomyopathy, electrolyte imbalance).神經性厭食症：極度害怕肥胖、身體意象扭曲、拒食、強迫運動、完美主義；可致命（飢餓、自殺、心肌病變、電解質失衡）。
  • Anorexia physical findings: low temperature, pulse and BP, constipation, lanugo, dry scaly skin, amenorrhea (3+ cycles), electrolyte imbalance, bone loss, tooth and gum damage.厭食症生理表現：體溫、脈搏、血壓偏低、便秘、胎毛、皮膚乾燥脫屑、閉經（連續 3 次以上）、電解質失衡、骨質流失、牙齒與牙齦受損。
  • Bulimia nervosa: binge followed by purging (vomiting, laxatives, diuretics, starvation); usually normal weight; secret eating, low self-esteem, electrolyte imbalance, dental erosion.神經性暴食症：暴食後催吐（嘔吐、瀉藥、利尿劑、禁食）；體重通常正常；偷偷進食、自尊低、電解質失衡、牙齒侵蝕。
  • Cycle of eating disorders is shown in Fig. 67.1 (dieting, loss of control, binge, purge).飲食疾患循環見圖 67.1（節食、失控、暴食、催吐）。
PDF p.1077, 1078

Nursing care for eating disorders飲食疾患護理

  • Build trust in a one-to-one relationship; accepting, nonjudgmental; explore feelings about body and eating; behavior modification; individual, group and family therapy.在一對一關係中建立信任；接納、不批判；探索對身體與飲食的感受；行為修正；個別、團體與家族治療。
  • Set a daily nutrition plan, supervise meals and a period afterward, time-limit meals, pleasant relaxed setting, monitor intake and output.訂定每日營養計畫、督導用餐及餐後一段時間、限制用餐時間、營造愉快放鬆環境、監測輸入輸出量。
  • Below 75% of ideal body weight: immediate inpatient medical stabilization.體重低於理想體重 75%：須立即住院做醫療穩定。
  • Weigh daily, same time, same scale, after voiding, same clothing. Monitor and restore fluids and electrolytes; assess and limit activity; assess suicide risk; give antidepressants if prescribed.每日同時間、同一磅秤、排尿後、穿相同衣物測體重。監測並矯正體液電解質；評估並限制活動；評估自殺風險；依醫囑給抗憂鬱藥。
PDF p.1078

Substance use disorders: concepts物質使用疾患：基本概念

  • Dependence: repeated use leading to tolerance, withdrawal and compulsive use; larger amounts than intended; failed attempts to cut down.依賴：反覆使用導致耐受、戒斷與強迫使用；用量超過預期；減量失敗。
  • Tolerance: needing more for the same effect. Withdrawal: symptoms when blood levels fall in a dependent person.耐受：需要更多劑量才有相同效果。戒斷：依賴者血中濃度下降時出現的症狀。
  • Screening tools: CAGE (Cut down, Annoyed, Guilty, Eye-opener), MAST, DAST.篩檢工具：CAGE（減量、被煩擾、罪惡感、晨間飲酒）、MAST、DAST。
  • Dysfunctional behaviors: denial, rationalization, projection, manipulation, impulsiveness, anger, low self-esteem, depression.失功能行為：否認、合理化、投射、操弄、衝動、憤怒、低自尊、憂鬱。
  • Codependency: the significant other enables use (paying bills, bailing out, calling in sick); address it with the family.共依附：重要他人縱容使用（付帳單、保釋、代請病假）；需與家屬一起處理。
PDF p.1078, 1079

Alcohol use disorder酒精使用疾患

  • Alcohol is a CNS depressant. Signs: slurred speech, unsteady gait, confusion, blackouts, morning drinking, increased tolerance; intoxication BAC 0.1% (100 mg/dL) or more.酒精為中樞神經抑制劑。表現：口齒不清、步態不穩、意識混亂、斷片、晨間飲酒、耐受性增加；中毒 BAC 達 0.1%（100 mg/dL）以上。
  • Assess type, amount, duration and time of last drink.評估酒類、飲用量、時間長度與最後一次飲酒時間。
  • Complications: thiamine deficiency (Wernicke encephalopathy, Korsakoff), B-vitamin neuropathy, hepatitis, cirrhosis, esophagitis, gastritis, pancreatitis, anemia, cardiac disease, brain damage.併發症：硫胺素缺乏（Wernicke 腦病變、Korsakoff）、B 群缺乏神經病變、肝炎、肝硬化、食道炎、胃炎、胰臟炎、貧血、心臟疾病、腦損傷。
  • Dealing with the client: direct focus on the substance use, firm consistent limits, hold accountable, motivational interviewing, group and support groups (Boxes 67.3, 67.4).與客戶互動：將焦點放在物質使用、堅定一致的限制、要求負責、動機式晤談、團體與支持團體（方框 67.3、67.4）。
PDF p.1079, 1080, 1081

Alcohol withdrawal and delirium tremens酒精戒斷與震顫譫妄

  • Onset within hours of stopping; peaks 24-48 hours; untreated can progress to seizures and delirium tremens (DTs). Use CIWA to assess.停酒後數小時內開始；24–48 小時達高峰；未治療可進展為痙攣與震顫譫妄（DTs）。使用 CIWA 評估。
  • Signs: hypertension, tachycardia, tremors, sweating, nausea/vomiting, anxiety, agitation, tactile/auditory/visual disturbances, headache, disorientation.表現：高血壓、心搏過速、顫抖、流汗、噁心嘔吐、焦慮、躁動、觸覺/聽覺/視覺異常、頭痛、定向感障礙。
  • DTs peak 48-72 hours, last 2-3 days; fever 100-103 F (37.8-39.4 C), hallucinations, fluctuating consciousness; a medical emergency (death from MI, collapse, electrolyte imbalance, aspiration, suicide).DTs 於 48–72 小時達高峰，持續 2–3 天；發燒 100–103°F（37.8–39.4°C）、幻覺、意識波動；屬醫療急症（可因心肌梗塞、循環衰竭、電解質失衡、吸入性肺炎、自殺致死）。
  • Care: medications as prescribed, VS and neuro checks (every 15 min in severe withdrawal), one-to-one supervision, seizure precautions, quiet low-stimulation room, frequent orientation, monitor glucose/magnesium/electrolytes, small frequent high-carbohydrate meals, I&O.照護：依醫囑給藥、生命徵象與神經學檢查（嚴重戒斷每 15 分鐘）、一對一監視、癲癇預防、安靜低刺激環境、頻繁定向、監測血糖/鎂/電解質、少量多餐高碳水飲食、記錄輸入輸出。
PDF p.1080, 1081

CNS depressants, stimulants and opioids中樞神經抑制劑、興奮劑與鴉片類

  • CNS depressants (alcohol, benzodiazepines, barbiturates): overdose causes respiratory/cardiovascular depression, coma, seizures. Flumazenil reverses benzodiazepine overdose. Withdrawal is treated with a titrated similar drug; abrupt withdrawal can be fatal.中樞神經抑制劑（酒精、苯二氮平類、巴比妥類）：過量造成呼吸/循環抑制、昏迷、痙攣。Flumazenil 可逆轉苯二氮平類過量。戒斷以逐漸調整的類似藥物治療；突然戒斷可能致命。
  • Stimulants (amphetamines, cocaine, crack): euphoria, dilated pupils, hypertension, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, paranoia; overdose can cause hyperpyrexia, seizures, stroke, MI. Withdrawal: depression and suicidal ideation, fatigue, hypersomnia.興奮劑（安非他命、古柯鹼、快克）：欣快、瞳孔放大、高血壓、心搏過速、心律不整、妄想；過量可致高熱、痙攣、中風、心肌梗塞。戒斷：憂鬱與自殺意念、疲倦、嗜睡。
  • Opioids: intoxication has constricted pupils, bradypnea, hypotension, drowsiness. Overdose: respiratory depression, coma. Naloxone (e.g., nasal spray) is the antagonist. Withdrawal (COWS): dilated pupils, rhinorrhea, lacrimation, yawning, piloerection, diarrhea, body aches.鴉片類：中毒時瞳孔縮小、呼吸過慢、低血壓、嗜睡。過量：呼吸抑制、昏迷。Naloxone（如鼻噴劑）為拮抗劑。戒斷（COWS）：瞳孔放大、流鼻水、流淚、打哈欠、起雞皮疙瘩、腹瀉、身體痠痛。
  • Opioid overdose crisis (Box 67.5): risk factors include prior overdose, high doses, co-prescribed benzodiazepines, respiratory disease, alcohol use; use screening tools such as the Opioid Risk Tool.鴉片類過量危機（方框 67.5）：風險因子包括曾過量、高劑量、併用苯二氮平類、呼吸疾病、飲酒；使用 Opioid Risk Tool 等篩檢工具。
PDF p.1081, 1082, 1083

Hallucinogens, inhalants, marijuana and club drugs迷幻劑、吸入劑、大麻與俱樂部藥物

  • Hallucinogens (LSD, mescaline, psilocybin, PCP): low stimulation, speak slowly and quietly, treat anxiety. PCP overdose: psychosis, hypertensive crisis, hyperthermia, seizures, respiratory arrest; acidify urine. Flashbacks can occur - safety is the priority.迷幻劑（LSD、仙人掌毒鹼、裸蓋菇素、PCP）：低刺激、緩慢輕聲說話、處理焦慮。PCP 過量：精神病、高血壓危象、高體溫、痙攣、呼吸停止；酸化尿液。可能出現閃回——安全為先。
  • Inhalants (butane, paint thinner, glue, nitrous oxide): euphoria then drowsiness; can damage the nervous system and cause death; supportive care.吸入劑（丁烷、油漆稀釋劑、膠水、笑氣）：先欣快後嗜睡；可損傷神經系統並致死；支持性照護。
  • Marijuana: heightened sensations, red eyes, dry mouth, increased appetite, tachycardia; long-term amotivation, memory loss, respiratory problems.大麻：感覺增強、眼睛紅、口乾、食慾增加、心搏過速；長期使用導致動機缺乏、記憶喪失、呼吸問題。
  • Club drugs (MDMA, GHB, methamphetamine, ketamine): hyperthermia, rhabdomyolysis, kidney failure, hepatotoxicity, psychosis, cardiovascular collapse. Nicotine: patches, inhalers, bupropion.俱樂部藥物（MDMA、GHB、甲基安非他命、氯胺酮）：高體溫、橫紋肌溶解、腎衰竭、肝毒性、精神病、心血管衰竭。尼古丁：貼片、吸入器、bupropion。
PDF p.1082, 1084

Withdrawal care, dual diagnosis, impaired nurses戒斷照護、雙重診斷與受損護理師

  • Withdrawal care: seizure precautions, hydration, hourly vital signs with cardiac monitoring, I&O, orientation, minimal stimuli, remove hazards, one-to-one if needed, drug screens (Box 67.6).戒斷照護：癲癇預防、補水、每小時生命徵象與心臟監測、輸入輸出、定向、最少刺激、移除危險物、必要時一對一、藥物篩檢（方框 67.6）。
  • Be accepting, hold client accountable, set limits on manipulation, teach assertiveness, encourage groups and 12-step programs (AA, NA, Al-Anon, Alateen, Nar-Anon, halfway houses).接納、要求客戶負責、對操弄設限、教導自我肯定、鼓勵團體與 12 步驟計畫（AA、NA、Al-Anon、Alateen、Nar-Anon、中途之家）。
  • Dual diagnosis: substance use can mask or trigger psychiatric illness; true separation requires sustained abstinence.雙重診斷：物質使用可能掩蓋或誘發精神疾病；需持續戒斷才能區分。
  • Impaired nurse red flags: frequent unwitnessed wastage, giving maximum doses, clients with poor pain relief, always volunteering for narcotic keys, seeking low-supervision shifts. Nurses must report; recovery programs through the Board of Nursing.受損護理師警訊：常見未被見證的丟棄藥物、報告給予最大劑量、病人止痛效果差、總是主動拿管制藥鑰匙、選擇少監督的班別。護理師有義務通報；可透過護理委員會的復健方案返回工作。
PDF p.1084, 1085

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Alcohol withdrawal: hypertension, tachycardia, tremor, diaphoresis, agitation, hallucinations. Peak 24-48 h; DTs at 48-72 h.酒精戒斷：高血壓、心搏過速、顫抖、盜汗、躁動、幻覺。24–48 小時高峰；DTs 於 48–72 小時。 PDF p.1080, 1086, 1087
  2. DTs are a medical emergency: seizure precautions, one-to-one, VS/neuro checks, electrolytes (including magnesium and glucose).DTs 為醫療急症：癲癇預防、一對一、生命徵象/神經學檢查、電解質（含鎂與血糖）。 PDF p.1080, 1081
  3. Use CIWA for alcohol withdrawal and COWS for opioid withdrawal.酒精戒斷用 CIWA，鴉片類戒斷用 COWS。 PDF p.1080, 1081
  4. Abrupt withdrawal of CNS depressants can be fatal; treat with a carefully titrated similar drug.突然停用中樞神經抑制劑可能致命；以謹慎調整的類似藥物治療。 PDF p.1081
  5. Flumazenil reverses benzodiazepine overdose; naloxone reverses opioid overdose.Flumazenil 逆轉苯二氮平類過量；naloxone 逆轉鴉片類過量。 PDF p.1081, 1083
  6. Opioid intoxication: pinpoint pupils, slow breathing. Opioid withdrawal: dilated pupils, rhinorrhea, yawning, piloerection, diarrhea.鴉片類中毒：針尖瞳孔、呼吸慢。鴉片類戒斷：瞳孔放大、流鼻水、打哈欠、雞皮疙瘩、腹瀉。 PDF p.1082
  7. Stimulant withdrawal: severe depression and suicidal ideation - monitor closely.興奮劑戒斷：嚴重憂鬱與自殺意念——須密切監測。 PDF p.1081, 1082
  8. Hallucinogen flashbacks can occur long after use; safety first, low stimuli.迷幻劑閃回可在使用後長期發生；安全為先、低刺激。 PDF p.1084
  9. Anorexia: weight below 75% ideal needs inpatient medical stabilization; limit rigorous exercise without humiliating, offer alternatives.厭食症：體重低於理想 75% 需住院醫療穩定；限制劇烈運動但不羞辱，並提供替代活動。 PDF p.1078, 1087
  10. Bulimia: normal weight, dental erosion, electrolyte imbalance; anorexia: lanugo, bradycardia, hypotension, amenorrhea.暴食症：體重正常、牙齒侵蝕、電解質失衡；厭食症：胎毛、心搏過慢、低血壓、閉經。 PDF p.1077, 1078, 1087
  11. Anorexia care: supervise meals and after-meal period, weigh consistently, do not place with infection-risk roommate or one who needs to be 'managed'.厭食症照護：督導用餐與餐後、一致測體重，勿與有感染風險或需被照顧的病人同房。 PDF p.1078, 1088
  12. CAGE questionnaire: Cut down, Annoyed, Guilty, Eye-opener.CAGE 問卷：減量、被煩擾、罪惡感、晨間飲酒。 PDF p.1079
  13. Wernicke/Korsakoff arise from thiamine deficiency in chronic alcohol use.慢性酒精使用造成硫胺素缺乏，導致 Wernicke/Korsakoff。 PDF p.1080
  14. A voluntary client who wants to leave AMA cannot be physically held; notify the PHCP/supervisor (false imprisonment otherwise).要求離院（AMA）的自願客戶不可被強制留下；通知醫師/主管（否則為非法拘禁）。 PDF p.1086, 1087
  15. Al-Anon benefit: spouse recognizes the partner is responsible for the drinking and that abuse is undeserved.Al-Anon 的助益：配偶了解飲酒責任在伴侶，且不應承受暴力。 PDF p.1087
  16. Report impaired colleagues; do not cover for them.通報受損同事；不要包庇。 PDF p.1085

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • CAGE = Cut down, Annoyed, Guilty, Eye-opener (2 or more yes answers suggests a problem).CAGE＝減量、被煩擾、罪惡感、晨間飲酒（答「是」兩題以上提示有問題）。 PDF p.1079
  • Opioid intoxication vs withdrawal: 'Intoxication = slow and small (pupils, breathing); withdrawal = wet and wide (rhinorrhea, dilated pupils, diarrhea)'.鴉片類：中毒＝慢而小（呼吸、瞳孔）；戒斷＝濕而大（流鼻水、瞳孔放大、腹瀉）。 PDF p.1082
  • Alcohol withdrawal timeline: 6-24 h tremor/anxiety, 24-48 h seizures risk, 48-72 h DTs (approximate memory aid; chapter text gives peak 24-48 h and DTs 48-72 h).酒精戒斷時間軸：6–24 小時顫抖/焦慮、24–48 小時痙攣風險、48–72 小時 DTs（輔助記憶，章節明載高峰 24–48 小時、DTs 48–72 小時）。 PDF p.1080

68 Crisis Theory and Intervention危機理論與介入

This chapter covers crisis phases and types, grief and loss, COVID-19 coping, suicide risk, anger and violence (including restraint and seclusion rules), bullying, family violence, child and elder abuse, child abduction, and rape/sexual assault. Safety, direct assessment, mandatory reporting, and non-judgmental support are the recurring priorities.本章涵蓋危機的階段與類型、悲傷與失落、COVID-19 因應、自殺風險、憤怒與暴力（含約束與隔離規範）、霸凌、家庭暴力、兒童與老人虐待、兒童誘拐，以及強暴與性侵害。反覆出現的優先事項為安全、直接評估、強制通報與不批判的支持。

Crisis: phases, types and intervention危機：階段、類型與介入

  • Crisis is a temporary state of severe emotional disorganization after a threatening event; problem-solving ability is inadequate; it is not itself a mental illness.危機是遭遇威脅事件後暫時性的嚴重情緒失序；解決問題能力不足；本身並非精神疾病。
  • Phases: 1 precipitating event; 2 perceived threat and rising anxiety; 3 failed coping, disorganization, physical symptoms; 4 mobilizing resources, goal is return to at least precrisis functioning.階段：1 誘發事件；2 感知威脅、焦慮上升；3 因應失敗、失序、出現身體症狀；4 動員資源，目標是回到至少危機前的功能。
  • Types (Box 68.1): maturational (developmental, e.g., retirement), situational (external, e.g., job loss, death, divorce), adventitious (disaster, war, violent crime).類型（方框 68.1）：成熟性（發展，如退休）、情境性（外在，如失業、死亡、離婚）、意外性（災難、戰爭、暴力犯罪）。
  • Intervention is immediate, supportive, goal-directed: acknowledge feelings, validate, link event meaning to crisis, explore and try new coping.介入是立即、支持性且目標導向：承認感受、確認、連結事件意義與危機、探索並嘗試新的因應。
  • Initial assessment: ask what led the client to seek help now (precipitating event) before asking about supports and coping.初步評估：先詢問促使客戶此時求助的原因（誘發事件），再詢問支持系統與因應方式。
PDF p.1090, 1091, 1101

Grief, loss and the nurse's role悲傷、失落與護理角色

  • Grief is the natural response to loss. Three-stage response (Box 68.2): shock/disbelief; experiencing the loss (anger, guilt, bargaining, depression); reintegration.悲傷是對失落的自然反應。三階段反應（方框 68.2）：震驚與難以置信；經歷失落（憤怒、罪惡感、討價還價、憂鬱）；重新整合。
  • Types: normal, anticipatory, disenfranchised (cannot be openly acknowledged), dysfunctional (prolonged, no progress), and child grief by developmental level.類型：正常、預期性、被剝奪的（無法公開承認）、失功能（持續且無進展），以及依發展階段的兒童悲傷。
  • Loss: actual, perceived (only felt by the person), anticipatory. Mourning = outward social expression, shaped by culture/religion. Bereavement = grief plus mourning.失落：實際、感知（僅當事人感受）、預期。哀悼＝外在的社會表達，受文化/宗教影響。喪親＝悲傷加哀悼。
  • Children's grief (Box 68.3): infants react to caregiver loss; toddlers/preschoolers see death as reversible and may regress; 5-9 years begin to see it as permanent and may feel responsible; adolescents see it as permanent with strong reactions.兒童悲傷（方框 68.3）：嬰兒對照顧者失去有反應；幼兒/學齡前視死亡為可逆且可能退化；5–9 歲開始理解永久性並可能覺得自己有責任；青少年理解永久性且情緒強烈。
  • Nurse's role: trusting, nonjudgmental environment; listen, silence, touch if appropriate; be honest, do not abandon; respect culture; avoid personal opinions; acknowledge own feelings (Box 68.4).護理角色：建立信任、不批判的環境；傾聽、沉默、適當時給予碰觸；誠實並不離棄；尊重文化；避免個人意見；承認自己的感受（方框 68.4）。
PDF p.1090, 1091, 1092

COVID-19 copingCOVID-19 因應

  • The pandemic is a real threat to physical and emotional well-being; expect anxiety, fear of the unknown, isolation stress, grief, survival guilt, depression, suicide risk.疫情是對身心健康的真實威脅；預期焦慮、對未知的恐懼、隔離壓力、悲傷、倖存者罪惡感、憂鬱與自殺風險。
  • Moral injury is a concern for health care workers forced into impossible choices and for families unable to be with loved ones.道德傷害是醫療人員被迫做艱難抉擇、以及家屬無法陪伴親人時的重要議題。
  • Interventions: assess for stress, depression and suicidality; foster hope and resilience; cognitive reappraisal; list what can be controlled; safety behaviors (distancing, handwashing, masks); limit media; stay connected; eat, sleep, exercise.處置：評估壓力、憂鬱與自殺風險；培養希望與復原力；認知重新評價；列出可控制的事；安全行為（保持距離、洗手、戴口罩）；限制媒體接觸；保持聯繫；規律飲食、睡眠與運動。
PDF p.1091, 1092

Suicidal behavior自殺行為

  • Always consider suicide in a depressed client. Risk groups: prior attempts, family history, adolescents, older adults, disabled/terminally ill, personality disorders, dementia, depression/psychosis, substance abuse, bullied, abuse history, past hospitalizations.憂鬱客戶一律要考慮自殺。高風險族群：曾嘗試自殺、家族史、青少年、老年人、身心障礙/末期病人、人格疾患、失智、憂鬱/精神病、物質濫用、被霸凌、受虐史、曾住院。
  • Cues (Box 68.5): giving away possessions, will/insurance changes, canceling plans, statements of intent, asking about lethal means, sudden calm or improvement.警訊（方框 68.5）：送出財物、修改遺囑/保險、取消約定、表達意圖、詢問致命工具、突然平靜或好轉。
  • Assess plan, means and timing, prior attempts and increasing lethality, hallucinations (command), substance use, recent losses, isolation (Box 68.6).評估計畫、方法與時間、過去嘗試與致命性增加、幻覺（命令式）、物質使用、近期失落、孤立（方框 68.6）。
  • Interventions: ask directly; suicide precautions; document every 15 min; remove harmful objects; never leave alone (one-to-one for those at risk); nonjudgmental; support systems; staff accompany off unit; check visitors' items.處置：直接詢問；自殺防範；每 15 分鐘記錄；移除危險物；絕不單獨留置（高風險者一對一）；不批判；找出支持系統；離開病房需工作人員陪同；檢查訪客物品。
PDF p.1093

Anger, aggression, restraints and seclusion憤怒、攻擊、約束與隔離

  • Warning signs of violence: history of violence, poor impulse control, raised voice, threats, pacing, muscle rigidity, flushed face, glaring.暴力警訊：暴力史、衝動控制差、提高音量、威脅、踱步、肌肉僵硬、臉紅、怒視。
  • De-escalation: low-stimuli safe setting, calm clear voice, large personal space, nonaggressive posture, listen, acknowledge anger, clear options and limits, problem-solve. Use least restrictive measures first.降級：低刺激安全環境、平穩清楚語氣、保持較大個人空間、非攻擊性姿勢、傾聽、承認憤怒、給予清楚選項與限制、一起解決問題。先使用最少限制措施。
  • Restraints/seclusion: never for punishment or staff convenience; only when behavior is physically harmful and less restrictive measures fail; document the behavior.約束/隔離：絕不用於懲罰或方便工作人員；僅在行為造成身體傷害且較少限制措施無效時使用；須記錄行為。
  • PHCP prescription is normally required (specifying type, duration, release criteria); in an emergency the nurse may act and then obtain the order promptly; face-to-face evaluation within 1 hour; one-to-one observation; assess needs every 15-30 min.通常須醫囑（註明種類、時間長度與解除條件）；緊急時護理師可先處置再儘快取得醫囑；1 小時內須面對面評估；一對一觀察；每 15–30 分鐘評估需求。
PDF p.1093, 1094

Bullying霸凌

  • Bullying is repeated aggressive acts by someone using power over another (physical, relational, verbal, cyberbullying).霸凌是以權力壓制他人的重複攻擊行為（身體、關係、言語、網路霸凌）。
  • Victims can develop depression, low self-esteem, isolation, self-harm, suicide.受害者可能出現憂鬱、低自尊、孤立、自傷與自殺。
  • Nurse's role: observe for signs and educate teachers, administrators and parents.護理角色：觀察徵象並教育老師、行政人員與家長。
PDF p.1094

Family violence家庭暴力

  • Cycle of violence (Fig. 68.1): tension building, acute battering, honeymoon/calm with undoing behavior; victim blames self, isolation is common.暴力循環（圖 68.1）：張力累積、急性毆打、蜜月/平靜期（含補償行為）；受害者自責，常見孤立。
  • Types (Box 68.7): physical, sexual, emotional violence, physical/developmental/educational neglect, economic exploitation. Children and older adults are most vulnerable.類型（方框 68.7）：身體、性、情緒暴力，身體/發展/教育忽視，經濟剝削。兒童與老人最脆弱。
  • Care: private, confidential, nonjudgmental assessment; assess injuries, suicide and homicide potential, substance use; help make a specific safety plan and give hotline/shelter information; report suspected child/elder abuse; accurate records.照護：在隱密、保密、不批判的情況下評估；評估傷勢、自殺與他殺風險、物質使用；協助訂定具體安全計畫並提供熱線/庇護所資訊；通報疑似兒童/老人虐待；正確記錄。
  • Abuser traits: low self-esteem, dependency, history of childhood abuse, sees victim as property. Offer therapy to both victim and abuser.施虐者特徵：自尊低、依賴性強、童年受虐史、視受害者為財產。對受害者與施虐者都提供治療。
PDF p.1095, 1096

Child abduction, child abuse, latchkey children兒童誘拐、兒童虐待與鑰匙兒童

  • Child abduction: by strangers or a non-custodial parent; teach children safety rules (don't go alone, tell an adult, say no, no secrets, don't accept gifts, go to a clerk if lost, know name/address/phone). Watch for PTSD after abduction.兒童誘拐：陌生人或無監護權的父母所為；教導兒童安全守則（不單獨外出、告知大人、說不、不保守秘密、不收禮物、走失找店員、記得姓名/地址/電話）。誘拐後留意 PTSD。
  • Child abuse includes neglect and physical, sexual, emotional maltreatment. Shaken baby: subdural hemorrhage, retinal hemorrhages, bulging fontanel, decreased consciousness (rising ICP), usually no external signs.兒童虐待包含忽視與身體、性、情緒傷害。嬰兒搖晃症候群：硬腦膜下出血、視網膜出血、囟門膨出、意識下降（顱內壓上升），常無外傷。
  • Physical abuse cues (Box 68.9): unexplained bruises, burns, fractures, spiral fractures, bald spots, apprehensive child, lack of crying with strangers. Neglect: poor hygiene, hunger, inadequate weight gain.身體虐待線索（方框 68.9）：不明瘀青、燒燙傷、骨折、螺旋骨折、禿斑、畏縮、對陌生人不哭。忽視：衛生差、飢餓、體重增加不足。
  • Nurses are legally required to report suspected child abuse; protect the child, document objectively, support the family and refer to resources.護理師依法必須通報疑似兒童虐待；保護兒童、客觀記錄、支持家庭並轉介資源。
  • Latchkey children lack adult supervision; teach self-care skills and refer to after-school programs.鑰匙兒童缺乏成人監督；教導自我照顧技能並轉介課後方案。
PDF p.1096, 1097

Elder abuse老人虐待

  • Forms: physical, emotional, sexual abuse, neglect, economic exploitation; risk is highest for dependent elders with illness, immobility or confusion; caregiver stress and family violence history contribute.形式：身體、情緒、性虐待、忽視、經濟剝削；依賴的老人（疾病、行動不便、意識混亂）風險最高；照顧者壓力與家庭暴力史為促成因素。
  • Signs: fractures, bruises, pressure sores, burns, torn underclothing, dehydration, malnutrition, missing glasses/dentures, medication overdose, unpaid bills.徵象：骨折、瘀青、壓瘡、燒傷、內衣破損、脫水、營養不良、缺少眼鏡/假牙、藥物過量、帳單未付。
  • Care: treat injuries, ask if someone is harming them, report to authorities, separate from abuser if possible and contact adult protective services, least restrictive placement, caregiver respite/counseling.照護：治療傷勢、詢問是否有人傷害、通報主管機關、可能時與施虐者分開並聯絡成人保護服務、採最少限制的安置、為照顧者提供喘息或諮商。
PDF p.1097, 1098

Rape and sexual assault強暴與性侵害

  • Rape = sexual act through force/coercion without consent. Includes acquaintance, statutory, same-gender and marital rape. The victim is not legally required to report.強暴＝以強迫或脅迫未經同意進行性行為。包含熟人、法定、同性與婚內強暴。受害者無法律上報案義務。
  • Responses: shame, humiliation, anger, fear of not being believed, self-blame. Rape trauma syndrome: sleep disturbance, nightmares, fear, somatic complaints, relationship disruption; see PTSD.反應：羞愧、屈辱、憤怒、害怕不被相信、自責。強暴創傷症候群：睡眠障礙、夢魘、恐懼、身體不適、關係受損；參見 PTSD。
  • ED care: private quiet area, stay with the victim, treat injuries, written consent, explain why not to shower/douche/change clothes before exam, preserve evidence, offer shower afterward, refer to SADV nurse and support groups.急診照護：安靜隱私區域、陪伴受害者、治療傷勢、書面同意、解釋檢查前不可淋浴/沖洗/換衣、保存證據、檢查後提供淋浴、轉介 SADV 護理師與支持團體。
  • Reinforce that surviving was what mattered: the victim did what was necessary to stay alive. Respond to feelings with open-ended therapeutic communication.強調存活最重要：受害者做了讓自己活下來所需的事。以開放式治療性溝通回應感受。
PDF p.1098, 1099

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. A client in crisis is not necessarily mentally ill; responses are individual. Goal: return to at least precrisis functioning.處於危機的客戶不一定有精神疾病；反應因人而異。目標：回到至少危機前的功能。 PDF p.1090, 1101
  2. Situational crisis = external life event (death, job loss, divorce); adventitious crisis = disaster, violence, rape, war.情境性危機＝外在生活事件（死亡、失業、離婚）；意外性危機＝災難、暴力、強暴、戰爭。 PDF p.1091, 1101
  3. In crisis assessment, first identify the precipitating event ('What led you to seek help now?').危機評估先找出誘發事件（「是什麼讓你現在來求助？」）。 PDF p.1101
  4. Ask directly about suicide: 'Are you thinking of hurting yourself?'; assess plan, means, timing.直接詢問自殺：「你有想傷害自己嗎？」；評估計畫、方法與時間。 PDF p.1093, 1100
  5. Sudden calm or improvement in a depressed client may signal a decision to attempt suicide - increase precautions.憂鬱客戶突然平靜或好轉，可能代表已決定自殺——應加強防範。 PDF p.1093, 1102
  6. Giving away possessions is a suicide cue.送出財物是自殺警訊。 PDF p.1093, 1102
  7. After a suicide attempt: one-to-one constant supervision; treat physical injury first (airway/bleeding) in the ED.自殺未遂後：一對一持續監視；急診先處理生理傷害（呼吸道/出血）。 PDF p.1093, 1102
  8. Escalating aggression: acknowledge behavior, quiet area, safe distance, least restrictive first; confinement only in the crisis period.攻擊行為升高：承認行為、移至安靜區域、保持安全距離、先用最少限制措施；僅於危機期才使用隔離。 PDF p.1094, 1101
  9. Restraints/seclusion: never as punishment; PHCP order; face-to-face evaluation within 1 hour; one-to-one observation; check needs every 15-30 min.約束/隔離：不得作為懲罰；需醫囑；1 小時內面對面評估；一對一觀察；每 15–30 分鐘評估需求。 PDF p.1094
  10. Mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse and elder abuse; document objectively.疑似兒童與老人虐待須強制通報；客觀記錄。 PDF p.1096, 1097, 1098
  11. Shaken baby syndrome: retinal hemorrhage, bulging fontanel, decreasing LOC (increased ICP), few external signs.嬰兒搖晃症候群：視網膜出血、囟門膨出、意識下降（顱內壓上升）、外傷少。 PDF p.1096, 1097
  12. Family violence discharge: give specific safety plan and shelter/hotline information, not just 'leave' or 'call the police'.家暴出院指導：提供具體安全計畫與庇護所/熱線資訊，而非僅叫對方離開或報警。 PDF p.1095, 1102
  13. Cycle of violence: tension-building, acute battering, honeymoon (loving, contrite).暴力循環：張力累積、急性毆打、蜜月期（討好、悔過）。 PDF p.1095
  14. Rape victim: stay with the victim, private area, do not bathe/douche/change clothes before exam, preserve evidence, written consent.強暴受害者：陪伴、隱私空間、檢查前不可洗澡/沖洗/更衣、保存證據、書面同意。 PDF p.1099
  15. Grief stages: shock/disbelief, experiencing the loss, reintegration; respond to feelings and do not give false reassurance.悲傷階段：震驚與難以置信、經歷失落、重新整合；回應感受，不給錯誤安慰。 PDF p.1091, 1102
