  16. Children under about 5 may view death as reversible; 5-9 begin to see it as permanent and may feel responsible.約 5 歲以下兒童可能視死亡為可逆；5–9 歲開始理解永久性並可能覺得自己有責任。 PDF p.1091

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Suicide warning: 'SAD PERSONS'-style recall - Sex (male), Age, Depression, Previous attempt, Ethanol, Rational thinking loss, Social support lacking, Organized plan, No spouse, Sickness (external mnemonic, not from the chapter).自殺風險記憶法「SAD PERSONS」：性別（男）、年齡、憂鬱、曾嘗試、酒精、理性喪失、缺乏支持、有計畫、無配偶、疾病（外部口訣，非本章內容）。 PDF p.1093
  • Crisis priority: Safety first, then feelings, then problem-solving. For violence: least restrictive first (talk, space, quiet area, medicate) before seclusion/restraint.危機優先順序：先安全，再感受，後解決問題。暴力處理：先最少限制（談話、空間、安靜區、用藥），再隔離/約束。 PDF p.1094

69 Psychotherapeutic Medications精神科治療藥物

This chapter reviews the major psychotropic drug classes by action, adverse effects, antidote or monitoring, and nursing teaching: antidepressants (SSRIs, SNRIs, TCAs, MAOIs), mood stabilizers (lithium), anxiolytics, sedative-hypnotics, antipsychotics, drugs for alcohol and opioid use disorders, ADHD stimulants, and Alzheimer drugs. Expect NCLEX items on lithium levels, tyramine and hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, extrapyramidal effects, NMS, and safe tapering.本章依藥物類別整理精神科藥物的作用、重要不良反應、解毒劑或監測項目及護理衛教：抗憂鬱劑（SSRI、SNRI、TCA、MAOI）、情緒穩定劑（鋰鹽）、抗焦慮藥、鎮靜安眠藥、抗精神病藥、酒精與鴉片類使用障礙用藥、ADHD 刺激劑及阿茲海默症用藥。NCLEX 常考鋰鹽濃度、酪胺與高血壓危象、血清素症候群、錐體外症狀、NMS 及安全減藥。

SSRIs and SNRIs選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRI）與 SNRI

  • Action: block serotonin reuptake; first-line for depression with anxiety or agitation. Examples: citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine, sertraline. SNRIs (venlafaxine, duloxetine) also block norepinephrine.作用：抑制血清素再吸收，為合併焦慮或躁動之憂鬱症的首選。例：citalopram、escitalopram、fluoxetine、paroxetine、sertraline；SNRI（venlafaxine、duloxetine）另可抑制正腎上腺素再吸收。
  • Fewer anticholinergic effects than TCAs. Common effects: insomnia or somnolence, nervousness, tremor, weight change, decreased libido, BP changes, dry mouth.抗膽鹼作用比 TCA 少。常見副作用：失眠或嗜睡、神經質、顫抖、體重改變、性慾下降、血壓變化、口乾。
  • Serotonin syndrome (excess serotonin, especially SSRI + MAOI or OTC cold medicines/St. John's wort): restlessness, tachycardia, fever, high BP, delirium, myoclonus, rigidity, seizures, abdominal pain/diarrhea.血清素症候群（SSRI 合併 MAOI、感冒成藥或聖約翰草）：躁動、心搏過速、發燒、高血壓、譫妄、肌躍症、僵硬、抽搐、腹痛腹瀉。
  • Teaching: give with food or a snack; takes 2-4 weeks for full effect; avoid alcohol; do not stop abruptly (discontinuation syndrome: GI upset, movement disorders, insomnia, sensory disturbance); ibuprofen/NSAIDs raise upper GI bleeding risk.衛教：隨餐或點心服用；2–4 週才達完整療效；避免酒精；不可驟停（停藥症候群：腸胃不適、動作異常、失眠、感覺異常）；併用 ibuprofen／NSAID 會增加上消化道出血風險。
  • Monitor suicidality closely, especially when mood and energy begin to improve; monitor WBC/neutrophils, liver and renal function with long-term use; interacts with digoxin and warfarin; extra caution in children, adolescents, older adults, and pregnancy.密切監測自殺風險，特別是情緒與精力開始改善時；長期使用需監測白血球／嗜中性球及肝腎功能；可與 digoxin、warfarin 交互作用；兒童、青少年、老年人及孕婦需特別謹慎。
PDF p.1106, 1107

Tricyclic Antidepressants (TCAs)三環抗憂鬱劑（TCA）

  • Action: block norepinephrine and serotonin reuptake. Examples: amitriptyline, imipramine, nortriptyline, doxepin; clomipramine is used for OCD.作用：抑制正腎上腺素與血清素再吸收。例：amitriptyline、imipramine、nortriptyline、doxepin；clomipramine 用於強迫症。
  • Anticholinergic effects: dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, urinary retention; also orthostatic hypotension, tachycardia/dysrhythmias, sedation, lowered seizure threshold.抗膽鹼作用：口乾、視力模糊、便秘、尿滯留；另有姿勢性低血壓、心搏過速／心律不整、鎮靜、降低癲癇閾值。
  • Cardiac toxicity: obtain ECG before and periodically during therapy. Overdose is life-threatening: airway, oxygen, cardiac monitoring, ECG, activated charcoal/lavage if within 2 hours, IV fluids.心臟毒性：治療前及期間定期做心電圖。過量可致命：維持呼吸道、給氧、心電監視、心電圖、2 小時內可做洗胃／活性碳、靜脈輸液。
  • Give the whole daily dose at bedtime (sedating). Teach slow position changes, high-fiber diet and fluids, oral hygiene/hard candy for dry mouth, no alcohol/OTC cold meds, taper gradually.每日全量於睡前服用（有鎮靜作用）。衛教緩慢改變姿勢、高纖與多喝水、口腔衛生及硬糖緩解口乾、避免酒精與非處方感冒藥、需逐步減藥。
  • Concurrent MAOI can cause hypertensive crisis; alcohol/antihistamines add CNS depression; may reduce antihypertensive effect. Therapeutic effect takes 2-4 weeks. Watch for suicide risk as energy returns.併用 MAOI 可致高血壓危象；酒精與抗組織胺加重中樞抑制；可能降低降血壓藥效果。療效需 2–4 週。精力恢復時留意自殺風險。
PDF p.1107, 1108

Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (MAOIs)單胺氧化酶抑制劑（MAOI）

  • Action: inhibit MAO, raising dopamine, norepinephrine, serotonin and tyramine levels. Examples: isocarboxazid, phenelzine, selegiline, tranylcypromine. Reserved for depression not responding to other therapy.作用：抑制 MAO，使多巴胺、正腎上腺素、血清素及酪胺升高。例：isocarboxazid、phenelzine、selegiline、tranylcypromine。用於其他治療無效的憂鬱症。
  • Hypertensive crisis: severe hypertension, occipital headache, neck stiffness, N/V, sweating, fever, dilated pupils, palpitations, chest pain. Antidote: IV phentolamine.高血壓危象：嚴重高血壓、後枕部頭痛、頸部僵硬、噁心嘔吐、冒汗、發燒、瞳孔放大、心悸、胸痛。解毒劑：靜脈注射 phentolamine。
  • Avoid tyramine-rich foods: aged cheese, wine/beer, sausage/salami, sauerkraut, soy sauce, avocado, banana, figs, raisins, yogurt, sour cream, liver, caffeine/chocolate. Avoid amphetamines, decongestants, other antidepressants, levodopa, meperidine/opioids.避免高酪胺食物：陳年乳酪、紅酒／啤酒、香腸／臘腸、酸菜、醬油、酪梨、香蕉、無花果、葡萄乾、優格、酸奶油、肝臟、咖啡因／巧克力。避免安非他命、鼻充血劑、其他抗憂鬱劑、levodopa、meperidine／鴉片類。
  • Teaching: BP monitoring; report headache, neck stiffness or palpitations immediately; change positions slowly; carry a MedicAlert card; take in the morning (insomnia); missed dose may be taken within 3 hours; benefit may need up to 3 weeks; taper gradually.衛教：監測血壓；頭痛、頸部僵硬或心悸立即通報；緩慢改變姿勢；隨身攜帶醫療警示卡；早上服用（避免失眠）；漏服 3 小時內可補服；療效最多需 3 週；需逐步減藥。
PDF p.1108, 1109

Atypical Antidepressants and Other Mood Stabilizers非典型抗憂鬱劑與其他情緒穩定劑

  • Atypical antidepressants listed: bupropion, mirtazapine, trazodone, nefazodone, vortioxetine, brexanolone. Bupropion lowers seizure threshold; seizures signal excess dose.非典型抗憂鬱劑：bupropion、mirtazapine、trazodone、nefazodone、vortioxetine、brexanolone。bupropion 降低癲癇閾值，出現抽搐表示劑量過高。
  • Other mood stabilizers: anticonvulsants (valproate, carbamazepine, lamotrigine, oxcarbazepine, gabapentin) and atypical antipsychotics (olanzapine, quetiapine, risperidone, aripiprazole, ziprasidone, etc.).其他情緒穩定劑：抗癲癇藥（valproate、carbamazepine、lamotrigine、oxcarbazepine、gabapentin）及非典型抗精神病藥（olanzapine、quetiapine、risperidone、aripiprazole、ziprasidone 等）。
PDF p.1107, 1109

Lithium鋰鹽

  • Therapeutic serum level 0.6-1.2 mEq/L; margin to toxicity is narrow. Draw level in the morning 12 hours after the last dose; check frequently at start, then every 1-2 months or when behavior changes.治療血中濃度 0.6–1.2 mEq/L，與中毒濃度很接近。於末次給藥後 12 小時的早晨抽血；起始時頻繁檢測，之後每 1–2 個月或行為改變時檢測。
  • Levels rise with low sodium intake, dehydration, sweating, vomiting/diarrhea, diuretics, NSAIDs, fluoxetine. Never give diuretics with lithium. Keep fluids 6-8 glasses/day and normal salt intake.低鈉攝取、脫水、大量流汗、嘔吐腹瀉、利尿劑、NSAID、fluoxetine 會使濃度上升。鋰鹽期間不可給利尿劑。每日飲水 6–8 杯並維持正常鹽分攝取。
  • Expected effects: polyuria, polydipsia, fine hand tremor, nausea, soft stools, weight gain, hypothyroidism/goiter. Baseline ECG, renal and thyroid tests needed. Crosses the placenta (fetal toxicity).預期副作用：多尿、多渴、手部細微顫抖、噁心、軟便、體重增加、甲狀腺低下／甲狀腺腫。治療前需基礎心電圖、腎功能及甲狀腺檢查。可通過胎盤（胎兒毒性）。
  • Toxicity begins at about 1.5 mEq/L. Mild (1.5): lethargy, coarse tremor, mild ataxia. Moderate (1.5-2.0): vomiting, severe diarrhea, slurred speech, tinnitus, blurred vision. Severe (>2.0): nystagmus, fasciculations, hyperreflexia, oliguria, seizures, coma.約 1.5 mEq/L 開始中毒。輕度（1.5）：倦怠、粗顫、輕度共濟失調。中度（1.5–2.0）：嘔吐、嚴重腹瀉、言語不清、耳鳴、視力模糊。重度（>2.0）：眼球震顫、肌束顫動、反射亢進、少尿、抽搐、昏迷。
  • Toxicity actions: withhold lithium, notify provider, monitor VS, LOC and ECG, obtain lithium, electrolytes, BUN/creatinine, CBC; seizure and suicide precautions. Missed dose: take within 2 hours, otherwise skip. Do not stop abruptly.中毒處置：停藥並通知醫師，監測生命徵象、意識與心電圖，抽鋰濃度、電解質、BUN／肌酸酐、全血球計數；採取抽搐與自殺防範。漏服 2 小時內可補服，否則跳過。不可驟停。
PDF p.1109, 1110

Benzodiazepines, Buspirone, Barbiturates and Sedative-Hypnotics苯二氮平類、buspirone、巴比妥類與鎮靜安眠藥

  • Benzodiazepines (alprazolam, lorazepam, diazepam, clonazepam, midazolam...) enhance GABA: anxiolytic, sedative, muscle relaxant, anticonvulsant. Contraindicated in acute narrow-angle glaucoma; cautious use in older adults and liver impairment; short-term use.苯二氮平類（alprazolam、lorazepam、diazepam、clonazepam、midazolam 等）增強 GABA：抗焦慮、鎮靜、肌肉鬆弛、抗痙攣。急性窄角青光眼禁用；老年人與肝功能不全者慎用；宜短期使用。
  • Adverse effects: sedation, dizziness, hypotension, amnesia, slurred speech, paradoxical excitement (older adults). Antidote for overdose: flumazenil IV (acts within about 5 minutes; may cause agitation or seizures).不良反應：鎮靜、頭暈、低血壓、失憶、言語不清、老年人矛盾性興奮。過量解毒劑：flumazenil 靜脈注射（約 5 分鐘起效）。
  • Never stop abruptly (seizures). Taper over 2-6 weeks; withdrawal: restlessness, irritability, insomnia, tremor, cramps, sweating, vomiting, seizures. Avoid alcohol; fall precautions.不可驟停（抽搐）。應在 2–6 週內逐步減量；戒斷症狀：不安、易怒、失眠、顫抖、痙攣、冒汗、嘔吐、抽搐。避免酒精；防跌。
  • Buspirone is a non-benzodiazepine anxiolytic; effective when anxiety signs such as rapid heartbeat and tension are absent after several weeks; no sedation or dependence.buspirone 為非苯二氮平類抗焦慮藥，數週後心跳加速、緊張等焦慮表現消失代表有效；無明顯鎮靜與依賴。
  • Barbiturates (phenobarbital, pentobarbital) and hypnotics (zolpidem, eszopiclone, zaleplon, ramelteon, chloral hydrate): depress the CNS via GABA. Overdose: respiratory depression, hypotension, shock, coma. Withdrawal within 24 hours in dependent clients: tremor, delirium, seizures. Avoid alcohol; take 30 minutes before bed; morning hangover possible.巴比妥類（phenobarbital、pentobarbital）及安眠藥（zolpidem、eszopiclone、zaleplon、ramelteon、chloral hydrate）經 GABA 抑制中樞。過量：呼吸抑制、低血壓、休克、昏迷。依賴者 24 小時內可出現戒斷：顫抖、譫妄、抽搐。避免酒精；睡前 30 分鐘服用；隔日可能宿醉感。
PDF p.1110, 1111, 1112

Antipsychotics and Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）

  • Block dopamine receptors. Typical (haloperidol, chlorpromazine, fluphenazine): better for positive symptoms (hallucinations, delusions, aggression). Atypical (risperidone, olanzapine, clozapine, quetiapine, aripiprazole): also help negative symptoms (apathy, avolition, alogia).阻斷多巴胺受體。典型藥（haloperidol、chlorpromazine、fluphenazine）對陽性症狀（幻覺、妄想、攻擊）較有效；非典型藥（risperidone、olanzapine、clozapine、quetiapine、aripiprazole）對陰性症狀（冷漠、無意志、言語貧乏）亦有效。
  • Extrapyramidal effects: parkinsonism (tremor, rigidity, shuffling gait, drooling), dystonia (oculogyric crisis, grimacing, torso twisting), akathisia (restlessness), tardive dyskinesia (tongue protrusion, chewing, involuntary movements).錐體外症狀：類帕金森氏症（顫抖、僵硬、拖曳步態、流口水）、急性肌張力不全（眼動危象、扮鬼臉、軀幹扭曲）、靜坐不能（坐立不安）、遲發性運動障礙（吐舌、咀嚼、不自主運動）。
  • Other effects: anticholinergic effects, orthostatic hypotension, photosensitivity, weight gain and hyperglycemia, agranulocytosis (sore throat, fever, malaise; clozapine: stop if WBC < 3000/mm3), jaundice, impaired temperature regulation, gynecomastia/lactation.其他：抗膽鹼作用、姿勢性低血壓、光敏感、體重增加與高血糖、顆粒性白血球缺乏（喉嚨痛、發燒、不適；clozapine 白血球 < 3000/mm3 須停藥）、黃疸、體溫調節受損、男性女乳症／泌乳。
  • Teaching: onset in 7-10 days, full effect 3-6 weeks; sunscreen and protective clothing; rise slowly; no alcohol; dilute liquid concentrate in juice, avoid skin contact; urine may turn pink to red-brown; taper gradually; long-acting injectables help adherence; monitor glucose and urine output.衛教：7–10 天見初效、3–6 週完整療效；使用防曬與防護衣物；緩慢改變姿勢；避免酒精；濃縮液以果汁稀釋並避免接觸皮膚；尿液可能變粉紅至紅褐色；需逐步減藥；長效針劑可提升服藥順從性；監測血糖與尿量。
  • NMS (rare, life-threatening; usually with first-generation drugs, at start, dose increase or switch): hyperpyrexia, severe muscle rigidity, autonomic instability (labile BP, tachycardia, diaphoresis, drooling), altered LOC, dysphagia, elevated WBC, CPK and LFTs.NMS（罕見、危及生命；多見於第一代藥物，開始、增量或換藥時）：高熱、嚴重肌肉僵硬、自律神經不穩（血壓波動、心搏過速、冒汗、流口水）、意識改變、吞嚥困難、白血球、CPK 及肝功能升高。
  • NMS actions: stop the drug, notify provider, VS and LOC monitoring, seizure precautions, antipyretics and cooling blanket, IV fluids/electrolytes; watch for DVT and rhabdomyolysis.NMS 處置：停藥、通知醫師、監測生命徵象與意識、抽搐防範、退燒藥及冷卻毯、靜脈輸液與電解質；注意深部靜脈栓塞與橫紋肌溶解。
PDF p.1112, 1113, 1114

Alcohol Withdrawal and Alcohol Use Disorder Drugs酒精戒斷與酒精使用障礙用藥

  • Benzodiazepines (chlordiazepoxide, diazepam, lorazepam, oxazepam) are the most effective for withdrawal: stabilize vital signs and reduce seizure and delirium tremens risk; long half-life agents give best protection.苯二氮平類（chlordiazepoxide、diazepam、lorazepam、oxazepam）為戒斷首選：穩定生命徵象、降低抽搐與震顫譫妄風險；長半衰期藥物保護最佳。
  • Atenolol/propranolol and clonidine reduce autonomic symptoms but only as adjuncts to benzodiazepines.atenolol／propranolol 與 clonidine 可減少自律神經症狀，但只能作為苯二氮平的輔助。
  • Thiamine (B1) IM then oral to prevent Wernicke's encephalopathy; also folic acid, multivitamin, magnesium if low.先肌肉注射再口服 thiamine（B1）預防 Wernicke 腦病變；另補葉酸、綜合維他命，鎂低時補鎂。
  • Maintaining abstinence (only after withdrawal is over): naltrexone blocks the pleasurable effect of alcohol; acamprosate reduces discomfort of abstinence; disulfiram causes a severe reaction if alcohol is ingested.維持戒酒（須戒斷結束後才用）：naltrexone 阻斷飲酒愉悅感；acamprosate 減輕戒酒不適；disulfiram 一旦飲酒會引起嚴重反應。
  • Disulfiram reaction: flushing, throbbing headache, nausea/vomiting, sweating, hypotension, tachycardia; begins within minutes, lasts 30 min-2 hr. Abstain at least 12 hours before first dose; avoid alcohol in cough medicines, mouthwash, aftershave, vinegar, rubbing alcohol; effect can persist several days after stopping.disulfiram 反應：臉潮紅、搏動性頭痛、噁心嘔吐、冒汗、低血壓、心搏過速；數分鐘內出現，持續 30 分鐘至 2 小時。首次用藥前至少戒酒 12 小時；避免含酒精之咳嗽藥、漱口水、刮鬍水、醋、消毒酒精；停藥後數天仍可能反應。
PDF p.1114

Opioid Use Disorder Drugs鴉片類使用障礙用藥

  • Methadone: full opioid agonist replacing the abused opioid; prevents withdrawal; given only under close supervision (overdose risk: bradypnea, cyanosis, stupor, coma).methadone：完全鴉片類促效劑，取代濫用的鴉片；預防戒斷；須嚴密監督使用（過量風險：呼吸過慢、發紺、木僵、昏迷）。
  • Buprenorphine: partial agonist-antagonist for maintenance or detox; can be prescribed in general medical settings; low overdose and abuse potential but suppresses cravings.buprenorphine：部分促效／拮抗劑，用於維持治療或戒毒；可於一般醫療場所開立；濫用與過量風險低但可抑制渴求。
  • Naltrexone: opioid antagonist used after detoxification to block euphoria and discourage relapse.naltrexone：鴉片類拮抗劑，戒毒後使用，阻斷欣快感以防復發。
  • Clonidine decreases autonomic withdrawal symptoms (fatigue, dizziness, dry mouth).clonidine 減輕自律神經戒斷症狀（疲倦、頭暈、口乾）。
PDF p.1114, 1115

ADHD Stimulants and Alzheimer DrugsADHD 刺激劑與阿茲海默症藥物

  • ADHD CNS stimulants (methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, amphetamine salts, lisdexamfetamine; also atomoxetine, guanfacine) calm children and lengthen attention span. Effects: tachycardia, high BP, anorexia and weight loss, insomnia, agitation.ADHD 中樞刺激劑（methylphenidate、dexmethylphenidate、安非他命鹽類、lisdexamfetamine；另有 atomoxetine、guanfacine）使兒童穩定並延長專注。副作用：心搏過速、高血壓、食慾不振與體重下降、失眠、躁動。
  • Nursing: baseline ECG, BP, height and weight; last dose at least 6 hours before bedtime (14 hours for extended release); avoid OTC drugs; drug holidays may be used; benefit takes weeks.護理：基礎心電圖、血壓、身高體重；最後一劑至少於睡前 6 小時（長效劑型 14 小時）；避免非處方藥；可安排藥物假期；療效需數週。
  • Cholinesterase inhibitors for mild to moderate Alzheimer disease: donepezil (bradycardia), galantamine (bronchoconstriction; caution in asthma/COPD), rivastigmine (give with food; caution in ulcer, bradycardia, sick sinus, urinary obstruction). Common: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, anorexia, weight loss.輕中度阿茲海默症之膽鹼酯酶抑制劑：donepezil（心搏過緩）、galantamine（支氣管收縮；氣喘／COPD 慎用）、rivastigmine（隨餐服用；潰瘍、心搏過緩、病竇症候群、尿路阻塞者慎用）。常見：噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、食慾不振、體重下降。
  • Memantine: NMDA antagonist for moderate to severe disease; dizziness, headache, confusion, constipation; avoid with amantadine or ketamine; urine-alkalinizing drugs (sodium bicarbonate) and renal impairment raise levels.memantine：NMDA 受體拮抗劑，用於中重度；副作用頭暈、頭痛、混亂、便秘；避免與 amantadine 或 ketamine 併用；鹼化尿液藥物（碳酸氫鈉）及腎功能不全會使濃度上升。
PDF p.1115, 1116

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Lithium therapeutic range 0.6-1.2 mEq/L; toxicity signs begin at 1.5 mEq/L; at 2.5 mEq/L with vomiting, diarrhea, tinnitus, blurred vision and tremor, treat as toxic.鋰鹽治療濃度 0.6–1.2 mEq/L；1.5 mEq/L 開始出現中毒症狀；2.5 mEq/L 並有嘔吐、腹瀉、耳鳴、視力模糊、顫抖，視為中毒。 PDF p.1109, 1110, 1116
  2. Lithium: maintain 6-8 glasses of water and adequate sodium; no diuretics or NSAIDs; draw level 12 hours after the last dose.鋰鹽：每日喝水 6–8 杯並維持足夠鈉攝取；避免利尿劑與 NSAID；於末次給藥 12 小時後抽血。 PDF p.1109, 1110
  3. MAOI plus tyramine foods (aged cheese, wine, cured meats, soy sauce, sauerkraut, avocado, banana) can cause hypertensive crisis; antidote is IV phentolamine; report headache and neck stiffness at once.MAOI 加高酪胺食物（陳年乳酪、酒、醃肉、醬油、酸菜、酪梨、香蕉）可致高血壓危象；解毒劑為靜脈 phentolamine；頭痛與頸部僵硬須立即通報。 PDF p.1108, 1109
  4. Never combine SSRIs with MAOIs (serotonin syndrome); OTC cold medicines and St. John's wort also raise risk.SSRI 絕不可與 MAOI 併用（血清素症候群）；非處方感冒藥與聖約翰草亦增加風險。 PDF p.1106, 1107
  5. Antidepressants take 2-4 weeks for full effect (MAOI up to 3 weeks); monitor for suicide as energy improves before mood; do not stop abruptly.抗憂鬱劑需 2–4 週才達療效（MAOI 最多 3 週）；精力先於情緒改善時須留意自殺風險；不可驟停。 PDF p.1107, 1108, 1116
  6. TCA overdose: ABCs, oxygen, cardiac monitor and ECG, charcoal/lavage if within 2 hours, IV fluids. Baseline ECG for all TCA clients.TCA 過量：維持 ABC、給氧、心電監視與心電圖、2 小時內活性碳／洗胃、靜脈輸液。所有 TCA 使用者需基礎心電圖。 PDF p.1107
  7. Bupropion excess presents as seizures; TCAs and bupropion lower seizure threshold.bupropion 過量表現為抽搐；TCA 與 bupropion 皆降低癲癇閾值。 PDF p.1107, 1117
  8. Benzodiazepine antidote is flumazenil; abrupt withdrawal can cause seizures, so taper over 2-6 weeks.苯二氮平解毒劑為 flumazenil；驟停可致抽搐，應 2–6 週逐步減量。 PDF p.1111
  9. Avoid alcohol with all CNS depressants (benzodiazepines, barbiturates, hypnotics, antipsychotics, TCAs).所有中樞抑制劑（苯二氮平、巴比妥、安眠藥、抗精神病藥、TCA）皆須避免酒精。 PDF p.1111, 1112, 1113
  10. Clozapine: monitor WBC for agranulocytosis; interrupt therapy if WBC falls below 3000/mm3.clozapine：監測白血球以防顆粒性白血球缺乏；低於 3000/mm3 須中斷治療。 PDF p.1117, 1118
  11. Tardive dyskinesia (tongue protrusion, chewing, grimacing) is a late antipsychotic effect; dystonia and akathisia occur earlier; assess for EPS regularly.遲發性運動障礙（吐舌、咀嚼、扮鬼臉）為抗精神病藥晚期副作用；肌張力不全與靜坐不能較早出現；需定期評估錐體外症狀。 PDF p.1113, 1117
  12. NMS red flags: high fever, lead-pipe rigidity, autonomic instability, altered LOC, elevated CPK and WBC; stop the drug, cool, IV fluids.NMS 警訊：高熱、鉛管樣僵硬、自律神經不穩、意識改變、CPK 與白血球升高；停藥、降溫、靜脈輸液。 PDF p.1113, 1114
  13. Disulfiram: abstain from alcohol at least 12 hours before the first dose and avoid alcohol-containing products (mouthwash, cough syrup, vinegar, aftershave).disulfiram：首次用藥前至少戒酒 12 小時，並避免含酒精產品（漱口水、咳嗽糖漿、醋、刮鬍水）。 PDF p.1114
  14. Naltrexone and acamprosate are started only after withdrawal is over; benzodiazepines are first-line for alcohol withdrawal; give thiamine to prevent Wernicke encephalopathy.naltrexone 與 acamprosate 須戒斷結束後才開始；酒精戒斷首選苯二氮平；給 thiamine 預防 Wernicke 腦病變。 PDF p.1114
  15. Methadone is a full agonist, buprenorphine a partial agonist-antagonist, naltrexone an antagonist for opioid use disorder.鴉片類使用障礙：methadone 為完全促效劑，buprenorphine 為部分促效／拮抗劑，naltrexone 為拮抗劑。 PDF p.1114, 1115
  16. ADHD stimulants: last dose 6 hours before bedtime (14 hours for extended release); monitor BP, ECG, height and weight.ADHD 刺激劑：最後一劑於睡前至少 6 小時（長效 14 小時）；監測血壓、心電圖、身高體重。 PDF p.1115
  17. Donepezil slows the heart rate; galantamine can bronchoconstrict; rivastigmine with food; memantine is an NMDA antagonist for moderate to severe disease.donepezil 會減慢心率；galantamine 可致支氣管收縮；rivastigmine 隨餐；memantine 為 NMDA 拮抗劑，用於中重度。 PDF p.1115, 1116

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • Lithium toxicity ladder: 1.5 = coarse tremor and lethargy; 2.0 = GI upset, slurred speech, tinnitus; above 2.0 = seizures and coma. 'Lithium needs Na and H2O to leave.'鋰中毒階梯：1.5＝粗顫與倦怠；2.0＝腸胃不適、言語不清、耳鳴；>2.0＝抽搐昏迷。記憶：鋰鹽需要鈉與水才排得出去。 PDF p.1110
  • TCA anticholinergic effects: 'dry as a bone, blind as a bat, red as a beet (flushed), mad as a hatter, full as a flask (retention)'.TCA 抗膽鹼效應口訣：乾如骨（口乾）、盲如蝙蝠（視力模糊）、紅如甜菜（潮紅）、瘋如帽匠（混亂）、滿如燒瓶（尿滯留／便秘）。 PDF p.1107
  • Antipsychotic EPS: 'Fast to slow' timing - dystonia (hours-days), akathisia, parkinsonism, then tardive dyskinesia (months-years).錐體外症狀出現時間由快到慢：肌張力不全（數小時至數天）→靜坐不能→類帕金森→遲發性運動障礙（數月至數年）。 PDF p.1113
  • NMS = 'FEVER': Fever, Encephalopathy, Vitals unstable, Elevated enzymes (CPK), Rigidity.NMS 口訣 FEVER：發燒、腦病變、生命徵象不穩、酵素升高（CPK）、僵硬。 PDF p.1113, 1114

70 Complex Care複雜照護

This broad chapter covers high-acuity nursing skills and emergencies: IV therapy and central lines, parenteral nutrition, blood transfusion, GI/airway/chest tubes, burns, oncologic and endocrine emergencies, respiratory and cardiovascular crises, hemodynamic monitoring, neurological injury, sedation, anaphylaxis, shock and sepsis. NCLEX prioritizes airway, perfusion, early recognition of complications, and knowing when to stop an infusion or call the provider.本章涵蓋高急性度照護技能與急症：靜脈治療與中心靜脈導管、全靜脈營養、輸血、胃腸／氣道／胸管、燒傷、腫瘤與內分泌急症、呼吸與心血管危象、血行動力學監測、神經損傷、鎮靜、過敏性休克、休克與敗血症。NCLEX 重視呼吸道、灌流、及早辨識併發症，以及何時停止輸注並通知醫師。

IV Therapy, Devices and Central Lines靜脈輸液、裝置與中心靜脈導管

  • Isotonic fluids (NS, LR) expand extracellular volume; hypotonic fluids move water into cells (give slowly); hypertonic fluids pull water out of cells; colloids pull fluid into the vascular space (second line). LR is avoided in kidney injury (contains potassium) and caution in severe liver disease.等張液（NS、LR）擴增細胞外液；低張液使水進入細胞（需緩慢）；高張液將水拉出細胞；膠體液將水拉入血管內（第二線）。LR 含鉀，腎損傷者避免，嚴重肝病慎用。
  • Gauge: smaller number = larger lumen. 16-18 for rapid fluids, blood, surgery; 20-22 for lipids; 22-24 standard; 24-26 fragile veins. Macrodrip 10-20 gtt/mL; microdrip 60 gtt/mL for slow rates (<50 mL/hr) or potent drugs.管徑：號數越小管腔越大。16–18 G 用於快速輸液、輸血、手術；20–22 G 用於脂肪乳劑；22–24 G 為一般；24–26 G 用於脆弱血管。大滴管 10–20 gtt/mL；微滴管 60 gtt/mL 用於慢速（<50 mL/hr）或強效藥。
  • Site and care: use forearm veins, start distally, avoid legs in adults, edematous, paralyzed, mastectomy-side or dialysis-fistula arms. Change site every 72-96 hours, tubing every 96 hours, hang no solution longer than 24 hours; label with date and time, not marker on plastic bags.部位與照護：優先前臂靜脈、由遠端開始；成人避免下肢、水腫、癱瘓、乳房切除側、透析瘻管手臂。每 72–96 小時更換部位，管路每 96 小時更換，溶液掛置不超過 24 小時；貼標籤註明日期時間，勿在塑膠袋上直接用麥克筆書寫。
  • Complications: air embolism (clamp, left side-lying Trendelenburg, notify); circulatory overload (slow infusion, raise head, oxygen, notify); infiltration (stop, remove, elevate, compress; do not rub); phlebitis (remove, warm compress, restart in other arm); hematoma; infection; catheter embolism (tourniquet proximal).併發症：空氣栓塞（夾管、左側臥頭低、通報）；循環超載（減慢輸注、抬高床頭、給氧、通報）；滲漏（停止、拔除、抬高、冷／熱敷，勿搓揉）；靜脈炎（拔除、溫濕敷、改對側手臂）；血腫；感染；導管斷裂栓塞（近端綁止血帶）。
  • Central lines (PICC, tunneled Hickman/Broviac/Groshong, implanted port with Huber needle) allow hyperosmolar solutions and long-term therapy; confirm position by x-ray. For tubing changes use Trendelenburg and Valsalva to prevent air embolism.中心靜脈導管（PICC、隧道式 Hickman／Broviac／Groshong、植入式port須用 Huber 針）可輸注高滲液與長期治療；以 X 光確認位置。換管時採頭低位並做 Valsalva 動作以防空氣栓塞。
  • Epidural catheter: assess VS, LOC, lower-extremity motor/sensory function; if aspiration returns more than 1 mL clear fluid or blood do not inject and notify the anesthesia provider. PCA is locked with a lockout interval and verified by two RNs.硬膜外導管：評估生命徵象、意識及下肢運動感覺；若回抽超過 1 mL 澄清液或血液，勿注藥並通知麻醉人員。PCA 上鎖、設鎖定間隔並由兩位 RN 核對。
PDF p.1124, 1125, 1126, 1127, 1128, 1129, 1130, 1131, 1132, 1133

Parenteral Nutrition (PN)靜脈營養（PN）

  • PN supplies dextrose, amino acids, lipids, vitamins, minerals, electrolytes; hypertonic. PPN goes through peripheral line or midline; TPN needs a central vein. Use only when enteral feeding is not possible.PN 提供葡萄糖、胺基酸、脂肪、維生素、礦物質、電解質，屬高張液。PPN 經周邊或中線導管；TPN 須經中心靜脈。僅在無法腸道營養時使用。
  • Lipids are isotonic, contain egg yolk (check egg allergy), need a 1.2-micron filter, start at 1 mL/min, check VS every 10 minutes for 30 minutes; stop for chest/back pain, dyspnea, fever, flushing. Do not use if emulsion has separated.脂肪乳劑為等張、含蛋黃（確認蛋過敏）、需 1.2 微米濾器，起始 1 mL/min，前 30 分鐘每 10 分鐘測生命徵象；若胸背痛、呼吸困難、發燒、潮紅則停止。乳劑分層則不可使用。
  • If the PN bag runs out, infuse D10W at the same rate to prevent hypoglycemia. Taper gradually over 1-2 hours when stopping; never stop abruptly. Do not give blood or IV drugs through the PN line.PN 袋用完時，以相同速率輸注 10% 葡萄糖預防低血糖。停止時 1–2 小時逐步減量，不可驟停。勿由 PN 管路輸血或給藥。
  • Monitor glucose about every 4 hours (hyperglycemia > 200 mg/dL), daily weight, I&O, electrolytes, liver and renal function. Refeeding syndrome in malnourished clients: low K, Mg, phosphate. Solutions refrigerated, used within 24 hours; discard if cloudy.約每 4 小時監測血糖（高血糖 > 200 mg/dL）、每日體重、出入量、電解質、肝腎功能。營養不良者留意再餵食症候群：低鉀、低鎂、低磷。溶液冷藏、24 小時內使用，混濁則丟棄。
  • Complications: infection (sterile technique, culture catheter tip), air embolism, pneumothorax (confirm placement by x-ray before starting), hypervolemia, hyper/hypoglycemia. Home teaching: report weight gain > 3 lb/week, arm swelling, catheter leaking.併發症：感染（無菌技術、導管尖端培養）、空氣栓塞、氣胸（開始前以 X 光確認位置）、容積過多、高／低血糖。居家衛教：每週體重增加 > 3 磅、手臂腫脹、導管滲漏須通報。
PDF p.1133, 1134, 1135, 1136, 1137

Blood Products and Transfusion Reactions血液製品與輸血反應

  • PRBCs (1 unit raises Hgb about 1 g/dL, Hct 3%, infuse 2-4 hours); platelets (give rapidly 15-30 min, +5000-10,000/mm3 per unit); FFP (clotting factors, within 2 hours of thaw); cryoprecipitate (factor VIII, fibrinogen); granulocytes for refractory infection.濃縮紅血球（1 單位約升 Hgb 1 g/dL、Hct 3%，輸注 2–4 小時）；血小板（15–30 分鐘快速輸注，每單位升 5000–10,000/mm3）；新鮮冷凍血漿（凝血因子，解凍後 2 小時內）；冷凍沉澱品（第 VIII 因子、纖維蛋白原）；顆粒球用於難治感染。
  • Compatibility: O negative = universal RBC donor, AB positive = universal recipient. Two licensed nurses verify the client with two identifiers, order, blood tag and ABO/Rh at the bedside. Use 18-19 G, normal saline only, blood tubing with filter, no meds added.相容性：O 型陰性為萬能供血者，AB 型陽性為萬能受血者。兩位合格護理師於床邊以兩種辨識資料核對個案、醫囑、血袋標籤及 ABO／Rh。使用 18–19 G、僅用生理食鹽水、含濾器血液管路，不加藥。
  • Start slowly and stay with the client for the first 15 minutes (most critical); check VS before, at 15 minutes, then every 30-60 minutes. Start within 20-30 minutes of blood bank release; each unit within 4 hours. Fever before transfusion: hold and notify provider.緩慢開始並於前 15 分鐘陪伴個案（最關鍵）；輸血前、15 分鐘、之後每 30–60 分鐘測生命徵象。血庫領出後 20–30 分鐘內開始；每單位 4 小時內輸完。輸血前發燒：暫緩並通知醫師。
  • Suspected reaction (chills, back pain, hives, dyspnea, hypotension): STOP the transfusion, change tubing down to IV site, keep line open with saline, check VS, notify provider and blood bank, stay with client, collect urine, return bag and tubing to blood bank.疑似反應（寒顫、背痛、蕁麻疹、呼吸困難、低血壓）：立即停止輸血，更換自針頭以下管路並以生理食鹽水維持通路，測生命徵象，通知醫師與血庫，陪伴個案，留尿檢體，血袋與管路送回血庫。
  • Other complications: circulatory overload (slow, upright, O2, diuretic); septicemia (cultures, antibiotics); hypocalcemia/citrate toxicity with massive transfusion; hyperkalemia with old blood; iron overload (deferoxamine); hepatitis C most common transmitted disease.其他併發症：循環超載（減速、坐起、給氧、利尿劑）；敗血症（培養、抗生素）；大量輸血之低血鈣／檸檬酸中毒；舊血之高血鉀；鐵過載（deferoxamine）；最常傳播之疾病為 C 型肝炎。
PDF p.1137, 1138, 1139, 1140, 1141, 1142

Gastrointestinal Tubes and Tube Feeding胃腸管路與管灌飲食

  • NG tubes decompress, feed, medicate, or lavage. Levin is single lumen; Salem sump is double lumen with an air vent that must not be clamped and stays above stomach level. Measure NEX (nose-earlobe-xiphoid); confirm by x-ray before first use.鼻胃管用於減壓、灌食、給藥或灌洗。Levin 為單腔；Salem sump 為雙腔，空氣通氣孔不可夾閉並維持高於胃的位置。以 NEX（鼻–耳垂–劍突）測量長度；首次使用前以 X 光確認。
  • Before every feeding or medication check placement (aspirate, pH of 3.5 or lower) and residual; hold feeding if residual > 100 mL (agency policy) or no bowel sounds. High-Fowler's for feeding; semi-Fowler's at all times for continuous feeds; flush 30-50 mL.每次灌食或給藥前確認位置（抽吸、pH 3.5 以下）與殘留量；殘留 > 100 mL（依院規）或無腸蠕動音則暫停。灌食採高坐臥位；持續灌食全程至少半坐臥；沖洗 30–50 mL。
  • Complications: aspiration (verify placement, HOB up), diarrhea (room-temperature, slow, fiber formula), clogged tube (liquid meds, flush), vomiting (stop feeding, side-lying, suction).併發症：吸入（確認位置、抬高床頭）、腹瀉（室溫、慢速、含纖維配方）、管路阻塞（液態藥物、沖洗）、嘔吐（停灌、側臥、抽吸）。
  • Intestinal tubes (Cantor single lumen, Miller-Abbott double lumen) have a tungsten bag; position on the right side, do not tape until final position. Esophageal balloon tubes (Sengstaken-Blakemore, Minnesota) tamponade varices: keep scissors at bedside and cut tubes if respiratory distress, watch for esophageal rupture.腸管（單腔 Cantor、雙腔 Miller-Abbott）末端含鎢袋；右側臥以利通過幽門，到達最終位置前不固定膠帶。食道氣囊管（Sengstaken-Blakemore、Minnesota）壓迫靜脈曲張：床邊備剪刀，呼吸窘迫時剪斷管路，留意食道破裂。
  • Lavage tubes (Lavacuator, Ewald) remove toxic substances from the stomach. Gastrostomy/jejunostomy sites: clean skin, dressing changes, check for leakage.灌洗管（Lavacuator、Ewald）用於移除胃內毒物。胃造口／空腸造口：清潔皮膚、更換敷料、檢查滲漏。
PDF p.1142, 1143, 1144, 1145, 1146

Endotracheal and Tracheostomy Tubes氣管內管與氣切管

  • Confirm ET placement with end-tidal CO2 detector, bilateral breath sounds and gastric auscultation, then chest x-ray (tip 1-2 cm above carina). Absent left breath sounds suggest right main-stem intubation. Cuff pressure should not exceed 20 mm Hg per text (minimal leak or occlusive technique).以呼氣末 CO2 偵測、雙側呼吸音與胃部聽診確認氣管內管位置，再以 X 光確認（尖端距隆突 1–2 公分）。左側呼吸音消失提示管入右主支氣管。依本書氣囊壓不超過 20 mm Hg（最小漏氣或封閉技術）。
  • Oral tube: move to opposite side of mouth daily with two providers; secure, suction only when needed; keep Ambu bag at bedside. Extubation: hyperoxygenate and suction, deflate cuff, remove at peak inspiration, assess voice and stridor (laryngeal edema).經口管：每日由兩人換至口腔另一側；固定、必要時才抽吸；床邊備 Ambu 袋。拔管：給高濃度氧並抽吸，放氣囊、於吸氣高峰拔除，評估發聲與喘鳴（喉頭水腫）。
  • Tracheostomy: keep obturator, spare same-size tube and Ambu bag at bedside; humidified oxygen; cuff inflated for meals and 1 hour after if eating; never cap a tube until cuff deflated and inner cannula removed; cuffed fenestrated tube is not used for weaning.氣切：床邊備閉塞器、同尺寸備用管及 Ambu 袋；給予加濕氧；進食時及餐後 1 小時氣囊充氣；氣囊未放氣且內管未移除前不可蓋上塞子；有氣囊開窗管不用於脫離。
  • Complications: tracheomalacia, tracheal stenosis, tracheoesophageal fistula, tracheoinnominate artery fistula (pulsating tube/bleeding: direct pressure, emergency), obstruction, dislodgement within 72 hours of surgery (ventilate with Ambu and call rapid response).併發症：氣管軟化、氣管狹窄、氣管食道瘻管、氣管無名動脈瘻管（管子搏動／出血：直接加壓、緊急處理）、阻塞、術後 72 小時內脫出（以 Ambu 通氣並呼叫快速反應團隊）。
PDF p.1146, 1147, 1148, 1149

Chest Tube Drainage Systems胸管引流系統

  • Three chambers: collection (notify if > 70-100 mL/hr or bright red/sudden increase), water seal (fluctuates with breathing; continuous bubbling = air leak), suction control (gentle bubbling expected in wet system; dry system uses orange float).三個腔室：收集腔（> 70–100 mL/hr 或鮮紅色／驟增須通報）、水封腔（隨呼吸擺動；持續冒泡＝漏氣）、抽吸控制腔（濕式系統應有輕柔氣泡；乾式用橘色浮標）。
  • Keep system below chest level, tubing free of kinks and dependent loops, occlusive dressing, all connections secure. Do not strip or milk tubes without order; never clamp without a prescription.系統保持低於胸部、管路無扭曲與下垂圈、密閉敷料、接頭牢固。無醫囑不可擠壓管路；無處方不可夾管。
  • Absent fluctuation means kinked/obstructed tube or lung re-expansion. If system cracks, put tube end in sterile water and replace. If tube pulled out: pinch skin opening, apply an occlusive sterile dressing secured with overlapping tape, and call the provider immediately. Keep clamp and sterile occlusive dressing at bedside.水封腔不再擺動表示管路扭曲／阻塞或肺已復張。系統破裂時將管端置入無菌水再更換系統。若管路被拉出：捏緊皮膚開口、貼密閉無菌敷料並以重疊膠帶固定，立即通知醫師。床邊備夾子與無菌密閉敷料。
PDF p.1149, 1150, 1151, 1152, 1153

Burn Injuries燒傷

  • Major burn: 25% or more TBSA in adults (10% in children). Rule of nines estimates extent. Depth: superficial (red, painful, no blisters), superficial partial (blisters, wet, painful), deep partial (red/dry/white areas), full thickness (leathery, painless, eschar).重度燒傷：成人 TBSA 25% 以上（兒童 10%）。以九分法估計範圍。深度：淺層（紅、痛、無水泡）、淺部分層（水泡、濕、痛）、深部分層（紅／乾／白色區）、全層（皮革樣、無痛、焦痂）。
  • Airway first: inhalation injury signs include facial burns, singed nasal hair, hoarseness, sooty sputum, stridor. Give 100% oxygen by nonrebreather; carbon monoxide has 200 times the affinity for hemoglobin; continue until carboxyhemoglobin < 15%.先顧呼吸道：吸入性損傷徵象包括臉部燒傷、鼻毛燒焦、聲音嘶啞、含煙灰痰、喘鳴。以非再吸入面罩給 100% 氧；一氧化碳與血紅素親和力為氧的 200 倍；持續至碳氧血紅素 < 15%。
  • Emergent phase: fluid shift with hypovolemia, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, hemoconcentration. Parkland formula 4 mL x kg x %TBSA (half in first 8 hours, from time of injury). Titrate to urine output 30-50 mL/hr, the best indicator of perfusion. IV opioids, not IM/oral; NPO, NG tube, tetanus prophylaxis.急性期：液體移位造成低血容、低鈉、高鉀、血液濃縮。Parkland 公式 4 mL x 公斤 x %TBSA（前 8 小時給一半，自受傷時間起算）。依尿量 30–50 mL/hr 調整，為最佳灌流指標。使用靜脈鴉片類止痛，非肌肉／口服；禁食、置鼻胃管、破傷風預防。
  • Circumferential burns: elevate extremities, check pulses and capillary refill; escharotomy (bedside) or fasciotomy (OR) for compartment syndrome. Diuretics generally avoided. Protective isolation, stress ulcer prophylaxis, expect 15-20 lb weight gain in 72 hours.環狀燒傷：抬高肢體、檢查脈搏與微血管充填；因腔室症候群行焦痂切開術（床邊）或筋膜切開術（開刀房）。一般避免利尿劑。保護性隔離、預防壓力性潰瘍；72 小時內預期增重 15–20 磅。
  • Acute phase: wound care, debridement, hydrotherapy under 30 minutes, high protein/calorie diet (> 5000 calories for major burns), grafts. Autograft immobilized 3-7 days, watch for bleeding beneath graft; donor site heals in 7-14 days. Splinting and pressure garments 23 hours/day for 18-24 months in rehabilitation.急性後期：傷口護理、清創、水療 30 分鐘內、高蛋白高熱量飲食（重度燒傷 > 5000 大卡）、植皮。自體植皮固定 3–7 天，注意皮下出血；供皮區 7–14 天癒合。復健期夾板與壓力衣每日穿 23 小時，持續 18–24 個月。

Oncologic Emergencies and DKA/HHS腫瘤急症與 DKA／HHS

  • Sepsis/DIC in cancer: strict asepsis, IV antibiotics, anticoagulants early, cryoprecipitate when bleeding dominates. SIADH: water retention, Na 115-120 mild, near 110 seizures; fluid restriction and ADH antagonist.癌症敗血症／DIC：嚴格無菌、靜脈抗生素、早期抗凝劑、出血為主時給冷凍沉澱品。SIADH：水滯留，鈉 115–120 為輕度，近 110 會抽搐；限水並給 ADH 拮抗劑。
  • Spinal cord compression: back pain precedes deficits; high-dose corticosteroids, radiation. Hypercalcemia: fatigue, constipation, polyuria, ECG change; fluids, calcium-lowering drugs, mobility. SVC syndrome: facial/neck edema, collar tightness (Stokes' sign), semi-Fowler's, steroids, radiation, stent.脊髓壓迫：背痛先於神經缺損；大劑量皮質類固醇、放射治療。高血鈣：疲倦、便秘、多尿、心電圖變化；輸液、降鈣藥物、活動。上腔靜脈症候群：臉頸水腫、領口變緊（Stokes 徵象）、半坐臥、類固醇、放療、支架。
  • Tumor lysis syndrome: hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypocalcemia, hyperuricemia; hydration, allopurinol, low K/phosphorus diet, insulin and glucose, dialysis if refractory.腫瘤溶解症候群：高血鉀、高血磷、低血鈣、高尿酸；水分補充、allopurinol、低鉀低磷飲食、胰島素加葡萄糖、無效時透析。
  • DKA: type 1, rapid onset, glucose > 300, pH < 7.35, HCO3 < 15, ketones, Kussmaul respirations. Treat with isotonic fluids, IV regular insulin on a pump, potassium replacement once urine output adequate; add dextrose when glucose reaches 250-300 mg/dL. Watch for cerebral edema and hypokalemia.DKA：第 1 型、急性發作、血糖 > 300、pH < 7.35、HCO3 < 15、酮體、Kussmaul 呼吸。處置：等張輸液、幫浦靜脈速效胰島素、尿量足夠後補鉀；血糖降至 250–300 mg/dL 時加入葡萄糖。留意腦水腫與低血鉀。
  • HHS: type 2, gradual, glucose > 800, osmolality > 350, no ketosis, pH > 7.4. Rehydrate carefully (older adults, heart failure); insulin less critical.HHS：第 2 型、漸進發作、血糖 > 800、滲透壓 > 350、無酮症、pH > 7.4。小心補液（老年人、心衰竭）；胰島素重要性較低。

GI Bleeding, Varices and Respiratory Support消化道出血、食道靜脈曲張與呼吸支持

  • Esophageal varices: portal hypertension; hematemesis, melena, ascites, shock signs. NPO, IV fluids, blood, vasoconstrictors, banding/sclerotherapy, balloon tamponade, TIPS. Upper GI bleed: PPIs/H2 blockers; Hgb/Hct may lag 24-72 hours.食道靜脈曲張：門脈高壓；吐血、黑便、腹水、休克徵象。禁食、輸液、輸血、血管收縮藥、結紮／硬化治療、氣囊壓迫、TIPS。上消化道出血：PPI／H2 阻斷劑；Hgb／Hct 可能延遲 24–72 小時下降。
  • Chest physiotherapy: contraindicated with unstable VS, increased ICP, rib fractures, chest incisions; do before meals or 2-3 hours after; stop if pain or cyanosis.胸腔物理治療：生命徵象不穩、顱內壓升高、肋骨骨折、胸部傷口為禁忌；餐前或餐後 2–3 小時進行；疼痛或發紺即停止。
  • Oxygen devices: nasal cannula 1-6 L/min (24-44%); simple mask 5-8 L/min (40-60%); Venturi precise FiO2; partial rebreather 6-15 L/min (70-90%); nonrebreather 60-100% with bag two-thirds full; COPD with chronic hypercapnia often needs low-flow 1-2 L/min.氧療裝置：鼻導管 1–6 L/min（24–44%）；簡單面罩 5–8 L/min（40–60%）；Venturi 面罩可精準控制 FiO2；部分再吸入面罩 6–15 L/min（70–90%）；非再吸入面罩 60–100% 且儲氣袋保持三分之二滿；慢性高碳酸血症之 COPD 常需 1–2 L/min 低流量。
  • CPAP gives continuous pressure; BiPAP gives IPAP and EPAP. Ventilator modes: control, assist-control (risk of respiratory alkalosis), SIMV (weaning). Assess the client first, then the ventilator; never turn alarms off; high-pressure alarm = secretions, kinks, biting, cough; low-pressure = disconnection or leak.CPAP 提供持續正壓；BiPAP 提供吸氣與呼氣壓。呼吸器模式：控制、輔助控制（可能呼吸性鹼中毒）、SIMV（脫離）。先評估個案再看呼吸器；不可關閉警報；高壓警報＝分泌物、管路扭曲、咬管、咳嗽；低壓警報＝接頭脫落或漏氣。
  • Ventilator complications: hypotension, pneumothorax, stress ulcers, infection, bradycardia. Weaning methods: SIMV rate reduction, T-piece trials, pressure support. Alarm fatigue is the leading contributor to alarm-related sentinel events.呼吸器併發症：低血壓、氣胸、壓力性潰瘍、感染、心搏過緩。脫離方法：降低 SIMV 次數、T 型管試驗、壓力支持。警報疲勞是警報相關警訊事件最常見的促成因素。

Chest Trauma, Respiratory Failure and Cardiovascular Crises胸部創傷、呼吸衰竭與心血管危象

  • Rib fracture: pain, shallow breathing, splinting; Fowler's, analgesia. Flail chest: paradoxical movement, hypoxia; oxygen, pain control, possible ventilation with PEEP. Pulmonary contusion: risk of ARDS.肋骨骨折：疼痛、淺呼吸、護胸；半坐臥、止痛。連枷胸：反常呼吸、低氧；給氧、止痛、必要時呼吸器加 PEEP。肺挫傷：有 ARDS 風險。
  • Pneumothorax: absent breath sounds, tracheal deviation to unaffected side (tension); open wound gets a nonporous dressing taped on three sides; chest tube. Respiratory failure: PaO2 < 60, PaCO2 > 50 with acidemia. ARDS: earliest sign is increased respiratory rate; refractory hypoxemia, bilateral infiltrates; PEEP.氣胸：呼吸音消失、氣管偏向健側（張力性）；開放性傷口用不透氣敷料三邊固定；置胸管。呼吸衰竭：PaO2 < 60、PaCO2 > 50 並酸血症。ARDS：最早徵象為呼吸速率增加；難治性低氧、雙側浸潤；使用 PEEP。
  • Cardiogenic shock: SBP < 90, UO < 30 mL/hr, cold clammy skin, pulmonary congestion. Treat with oxygen, vasopressors and inotropes, morphine, diuretics, intra-aortic balloon pump, reperfusion. Normal CVP 3-8, PAWP 4-12, MAP 70-105 mm Hg.心因性休克：收縮壓 < 90、尿量 < 30 mL/hr、冰冷濕黏皮膚、肺充血。處置：給氧、升壓劑與強心劑、morphine、利尿劑、主動脈內氣球幫浦、再灌流。正常值：CVP 3–8、PAWP 4–12、MAP 70–105 mm Hg。
  • Pulseless rhythms: VF/VT shockable (shock, epinephrine 1 mg every 3-5 min, amiodarone 300 mg then 150 mg); asystole/PEA not shockable (CPR, epinephrine); look for reversible causes (5 Hs, 5 Ts). Post-arrest: SpO2 > 94%, avoid hyperventilation, 12-lead ECG, targeted temperature management.無脈搏心律：VF／VT 可電擊（電擊、epinephrine 1 mg 每 3–5 分鐘、amiodarone 300 mg 後 150 mg）；心搏停止／PEA 不可電擊（CPR、epinephrine）；找可逆原因（5H、5T）。心跳恢復後：SpO2 > 94%、避免過度換氣、12 導程心電圖、目標體溫管理。
  • Cardiac tamponade: Beck's signs (JVD with clear lungs, muffled heart sounds, hypotension), pulsus paradoxus, narrowing pulse pressure; pericardiocentesis. After CABG: report chest tube drainage > 100-150 mL/hr, sudden cessation of drainage suggests tamponade; keep K 4-5 mEq/L; rewarm slowly. Urosepsis: culture before antibiotics. CRRT without machine needs MAP > 60.心包填塞：Beck 三徵（頸靜脈怒張但肺清晰、心音遙遠、低血壓）、奇脈、脈壓變窄；心包穿刺。CABG 後：胸管引流 > 100–150 mL/hr 須通報，引流突然停止提示填塞；維持鉀 4–5 mEq/L；緩慢復溫。泌尿道敗血症：先培養再給抗生素。無需透析機的 CRRT 需 MAP > 60。

Neurological Emergencies and Sedation神經急症與鎮靜

  • Head injury: epidural hematoma is arterial, rapid, with lucid interval; subdural venous and slower. CSF leak: halo sign, glucose-positive; do not suction or pack nose or ears, no nose blowing. GCS < 8: consider intubation.頭部外傷：硬腦膜外血腫為動脈性、快速、有清醒期；硬腦膜下為靜脈性、較慢。腦脊髓液漏：暈環徵象、葡萄糖陽性；不可抽吸或填塞鼻耳，禁擤鼻。GCS < 8：考慮插管。
  • Increased ICP: earliest sign is decreased LOC; late signs Cushing's triad (rising SBP, widened pulse pressure, bradycardia), pupil changes, posturing. HOB 30-40 degrees, neutral neck, avoid Trendelenburg, Valsalva, hip flexion; PaCO2 30-35; avoid opioids; mannitol, controlled fluids.顱內壓升高：最早徵象為意識降低；晚期為 Cushing 三徵（收縮壓上升、脈壓變寬、心搏過緩）、瞳孔變化、異常姿勢。床頭抬高 30–40 度、頸部中線、避免頭低位、Valsalva、髖部屈曲；PaCO2 30–35；避免鴉片類；mannitol、控制輸液。
  • Craniotomy positioning depends on surgery: supratentorial HOB 30 degrees; posterior fossa flat or on side; bone-flap removal turn to non-operative side. Drain output over 30-50 mL per shift: notify.開顱術後擺位依手術而異：幕上手術床頭 30 度；後顱窩手術平躺或側臥；去骨瓣減壓轉向非手術側。引流量超過每班 30–50 mL 須通報。
  • Spinal cord injury: immobilize on backboard with neutral head, logroll. Injury above C4 compromises breathing. Neurogenic shock: hypotension and bradycardia (above T6). Spinal shock: flaccid paralysis, loss of reflexes. Halo vest: never lift by the frame, keep wrench at bedside.脊髓損傷：以脊板固定、頭頸中立、滾木式翻身。C4 以上損傷影響呼吸。神經性休克：低血壓與心搏過緩（T6 以上）。脊髓休克：弛緩性癱瘓、反射消失。Halo 背架：不可抓框架抬舉、床邊備扳手。
  • Autonomic dysreflexia (injury above T6): severe headache, severe hypertension, bradycardia, flushing above lesion, sweating. Sit client upright, loosen clothing, check bladder (catheter) and bowel, remove stimulus, give antihypertensive; neurological emergency.自律神經反射異常（T6 以上損傷）：劇烈頭痛、嚴重高血壓、心搏過緩、損傷平面以上潮紅冒汗。讓個案坐起、鬆開衣物、檢查膀胱（導尿）與直腸、移除刺激、給降壓藥；屬神經急症。
  • Sedation: use RASS to titrate; propofol is a lipid, change tubing every 6-12 hours, watch propofol infusion syndrome; dexmedetomidine for short-term sedation. Treat the cause of agitation (pain first); haloperidol over benzodiazepines for agitation/delirium; CAM-ICU for delirium.鎮靜：以 RASS 調整；propofol 為脂肪乳劑，管路每 6–12 小時更換，留意丙泊酚輸注症候群；dexmedetomidine 用於短期鎮靜。先處理躁動原因（先排除疼痛）；躁動／譫妄優先用 haloperidol 而非苯二氮平；以 CAM-ICU 評估譫妄。

Anaphylaxis, Shock, Sepsis, SIRS and MODS過敏性休克、休克、敗血症、SIRS 與 MODS

  • Anaphylaxis: assess airway and breathing, call for help but stay with the client, oxygen, IV line with normal saline, epinephrine, diphenhydramine, corticosteroids; document.過敏性休克：評估呼吸道與呼吸、求援但不離開個案、給氧、建立靜脈通路輸注生理食鹽水、epinephrine、diphenhydramine、皮質類固醇；記錄。
  • Shock types: hypovolemic (most common), cardiogenic, distributive/vasogenic (septic, anaphylactic, neurogenic), obstructive (tamponade, tension pneumothorax, PE). CPP = MAP - ICP, normal 70-100; MAP > 60 needed for organ perfusion.休克類型：低血容性（最常見）、心因性、分佈性／血管性（敗血性、過敏性、神經性）、阻塞性（填塞、張力性氣胸、肺栓塞）。CPP＝MAP－ICP，正常 70–100；器官灌流需 MAP > 60。
  • Stages: initial (restless, tachycardia, cool pale skin); compensatory (CO low, SBP < 100, oliguria, confusion); progressive (edema, dysrhythmias, thready pulse); refractory (unresponsive to pressors). Early intervention is the priority. Restore volume first in hypovolemia; in cardiogenic shock avoid fluids and support the heart.階段：初期（躁動、心搏過速、皮膚冷白）；代償期（心輸出量低、收縮壓 < 100、少尿、混亂）；進展期（水腫、心律不整、脈搏細弱）；難治期（對升壓劑無反應）。早期介入為首要。低血容先補容積；心因性休克避免輸液並支持心臟。
  • Sepsis criteria: temp > 100.9 F (38.3 C) or < 97 F (36 C), HR > 90, RR > 22, SBP <= 100 or MAP < 70, altered mental status, oliguria, ileus, lactate > 1. Septic shock: 30-50 mL/kg isotonic crystalloids, vasopressors, antibiotics within 1 hour after cultures, glucose < 180 mg/dL.敗血症標準：體溫 > 100.9 F（38.3 C）或 < 97 F（36 C）、心率 > 90、呼吸 > 22、收縮壓 <= 100 或 MAP < 70、意識改變、少尿、腸阻塞、乳酸 > 1。敗血性休克：30–50 mL/kg 等張晶體液、升壓劑、培養後 1 小時內給抗生素、血糖 < 180 mg/dL。
  • SIRS is widespread inflammation from infection, trauma or pancreatitis; MODS is failure of two or more organs, with poor prognosis when three or more fail. Support failing organs, maintain MAP > 65, stress ulcer and VTE prophylaxis, watch for DIC.SIRS 為感染、創傷或胰臟炎引起的廣泛性發炎；MODS 為兩個以上器官衰竭，三個以上預後差。支持衰竭器官、維持 MAP > 65、預防壓力性潰瘍與靜脈血栓、留意 DIC。

Test-critical points考試關鍵點

  1. Air embolism: clamp the tubing, turn client onto left side with head down, give oxygen, notify provider. Prevent with Trendelenburg and Valsalva during central line tubing changes.空氣栓塞：夾管、左側臥頭低、給氧、通報醫師。中心靜脈換管時以頭低位與 Valsalva 預防。 PDF p.1129, 1132, 1136
  2. Circulatory overload from IV fluids: slow the infusion first, raise head of bed, oxygen, notify provider; do not remove the IV.輸液循環超載：先減慢輸注、抬高床頭、給氧、通報醫師；不要拔除靜脈導管。 PDF p.1129, 1190, 1191
  3. Suspected transfusion reaction: stop transfusion, change tubing below the bag, keep line open with saline, check VS, notify provider and blood bank, stay with client, return bag and tubing.疑似輸血反應：停止輸血、更換血袋下方管路、以生理食鹽水維持通路、測生命徵象、通知醫師與血庫、陪伴個案、送回血袋與管路。 PDF p.1140, 1141
  4. Stay with the client during the first 15 minutes of a transfusion; ABO incompatibility or severe allergy usually shows within the first 50 mL. Fever before transfusion: notify provider before hanging.輸血前 15 分鐘須陪伴個案；ABO 不合或嚴重過敏通常在前 50 mL 內出現。輸血前發燒：掛血前先通知醫師。 PDF p.1140, 1141, 1191
  5. Two nurses verify identity and compatibility at the bedside; use only normal saline with blood; give within 4 hours per unit and start within 20-30 minutes of release from blood bank.兩位護理師於床邊核對身分與相容性；輸血僅用生理食鹽水；每單位 4 小時內輸完，血庫領出後 20–30 分鐘內開始。 PDF p.1139, 1140
  6. Lipid emulsion (contains egg yolk): 1.2-micron filter, 1 mL/min start, VS every 10 min for 30 min; stop with chest pain, dyspnea, fever. Never stop PN abruptly; use D10W to prevent rebound hypoglycemia.脂肪乳劑（含蛋黃）：1.2 微米濾器、起始 1 mL/min、前 30 分鐘每 10 分鐘測生命徵象；胸痛、呼吸困難、發燒即停止。PN 不可驟停；用 10% 葡萄糖預防反彈性低血糖。 PDF p.1134, 1135, 1136
  7. Verify NG tube placement before every feeding or medication (pH 3.5 or lower, x-ray initially); hold feeding if residual > 100 mL or bowel sounds absent; HOB elevated.每次灌食或給藥前確認鼻胃管位置（pH 3.5 以下、初次 X 光）；殘留 > 100 mL 或無腸蠕動音暫停灌食；抬高床頭。 PDF p.1144, 1145
  8. Esophageal balloon tamponade tube: keep scissors at bedside; cut tubes to deflate balloons if respiratory distress; report signs of esophageal rupture (hypotension, tachycardia, back/upper abdominal pain).食道氣囊管：床邊備剪刀；呼吸窘迫時剪管使氣囊洩氣；通報食道破裂徵象（低血壓、心搏過速、背部／上腹痛）。 PDF p.1146
  9. Tracheostomy: never plug the tube until the cuff is deflated and inner cannula removed; keep obturator, spare tube and Ambu bag at bedside; pulsating tube with heavy bleeding = tracheoinnominate fistula emergency.氣切：氣囊未放氣且內管未移除前不可堵管；床邊備閉塞器、備用管與 Ambu 袋；管子搏動並大量出血＝氣管無名動脈瘻管緊急狀況。 PDF p.1148, 1150
  10. Chest tube: continuous bubbling in the water seal chamber = air leak; no fluctuation = kink, obstruction or re-expansion; drainage > 70-100 mL/hr or sudden bright red = notify; never clamp without prescription; if pulled out, occlusive sterile dressing and call provider.胸管：水封腔持續冒泡＝漏氣；無擺動＝扭曲、阻塞或肺復張；引流 > 70–100 mL/hr 或突然鮮紅須通報；無處方不可夾管；管路脫出時貼密閉無菌敷料並通知醫師。 PDF p.1151, 1152, 1153
  11. Burns: airway is the first priority; 100% oxygen for inhalation injury; fluid resuscitation guided by urine output 30-50 mL/hr; IV (not IM) analgesics; Parkland 4 mL/kg/%TBSA with half in first 8 hours from injury.燒傷：呼吸道為首要；吸入性損傷給 100% 氧；以尿量 30–50 mL/hr 引導輸液；使用靜脈（非肌肉）止痛；Parkland 4 mL/kg/%TBSA，自受傷起前 8 小時給一半。 PDF p.1155, 1157, 1158
  12. Carbon monoxide binds hemoglobin 200 times more than oxygen; administer 100% oxygen until carboxyhemoglobin falls below 15%.一氧化碳與血紅素結合力為氧的 200 倍；給 100% 氧直到碳氧血紅素低於 15%。 PDF p.1155, 1157
  13. DKA: isotonic fluids, IV regular insulin by pump, monitor potassium (falls with treatment), add dextrose at glucose 250-300 mg/dL; too rapid correction risks cerebral edema. HHS: glucose > 800, osmolality > 350, no ketones.DKA：等張輸液、幫浦靜脈速效胰島素、監測鉀（治療後下降）、血糖降至 250–300 mg/dL 時加葡萄糖；矯正過快有腦水腫風險。HHS：血糖 > 800、滲透壓 > 350、無酮體。 PDF p.1162, 1163, 1192
  14. Tumor lysis syndrome: hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypocalcemia, hyperuricemia; hydrate, allopurinol; SVC syndrome: facial edema and collar tightness in the morning (Stokes' sign).腫瘤溶解症候群：高鉀、高磷、低鈣、高尿酸；水分補充、allopurinol；上腔靜脈症候群：晨間臉部水腫與領口緊繃（Stokes 徵象）。 PDF p.1161, 1162
  15. Earliest sign of ARDS is increased respiratory rate; hypoxemia refractory to oxygen; treat with PEEP ventilation.ARDS 最早徵象為呼吸速率增加；氧療無效之低氧血症；以 PEEP 呼吸器治療。 PDF p.1172, 1192
  16. Always assess the client first, then the ventilator; never turn off alarms; if the cause of alarm is unclear, bag the client manually.先評估個案再看呼吸器；不可關閉警報；警報原因不明時以人工袋瓣罩通氣。 PDF p.1168, 1169
  17. Increased ICP: decreasing LOC is the earliest sign; Cushing's triad is late; HOB 30-40 degrees, avoid Trendelenburg/Valsalva/neck flexion and opioids; PaCO2 30-35.顱內壓升高：意識降低為最早徵象；Cushing 三徵為晚期；床頭 30–40 度、避免頭低位／Valsalva／頸部屈曲與鴉片類；PaCO2 30–35。 PDF p.1178, 1179, 1193
  18. Suspected spinal cord injury: immobilize, neutral head, logroll. Autonomic dysreflexia (above T6): sit upright, check bladder/bowel, remove trigger, antihypertensive.疑似脊髓損傷：固定、頭頸中立、滾木翻身。自律神經反射異常（T6 以上）：坐起、檢查膀胱／直腸、移除誘因、給降壓藥。 PDF p.1182, 1183
  19. Cardiogenic shock: avoid volume expanders (pulmonary edema); give inotropes/vasopressors. In hypovolemic shock with low CVP (2 mm Hg) and MAP 60, increase IV fluids first.心因性休克：避免擴容（肺水腫）；給強心劑／升壓劑。低血容性休克且 CVP 2 mm Hg、MAP 60 時，首先加快靜脈輸液。 PDF p.1187, 1191, 1193
  20. Anaphylaxis: airway first, stay with the client, oxygen, IV saline, epinephrine, diphenhydramine; sepsis: cultures then antibiotics within 1 hour, 30-50 mL/kg crystalloid.過敏性休克：先顧呼吸道、不離開個案、給氧、靜脈生理食鹽水、epinephrine、diphenhydramine；敗血症：先培養再於 1 小時內給抗生素、30–50 mL/kg 晶體液。 PDF p.1186, 1188, 1191

Mnemonics記憶口訣

  • NEX for NG tube length: Nose to Earlobe to Xiphoid process.鼻胃管長度 NEX：鼻尖→耳垂→劍突。 PDF p.1144
  • Reversible causes of cardiac arrest: 5 Hs (hypoxia, hypovolemia, hydrogen ion acidosis, hyper/hypokalemia, hypothermia) and 5 Ts (tension pneumothorax, tamponade, toxins, thrombosis PE, thrombosis coronary).心臟停止可逆原因：5H（缺氧、低血容、酸中毒、高／低血鉀、低體溫）與 5T（張力性氣胸、填塞、毒物、肺栓塞、冠狀動脈栓塞）。 PDF p.1174
  • Beck's triad of tamponade: muffled heart sounds, JVD, hypotension.心包填塞 Beck 三徵：心音遙遠、頸靜脈怒張、低血壓。 PDF p.1174, 1175
  • Chest tube: 'Tidal water, bubbles are bad' in the water seal: fluctuation is normal, continuous bubbling means leak.胸管水封腔：擺動正常，持續冒泡代表漏氣。 PDF p.1152
  • Rule of nines: head 9, each arm 9, anterior trunk 18, posterior trunk 18, each leg 18, perineum 1.九分法：頭 9、單臂 9、前軀幹 18、後軀幹 18、單腿 18、會陰 1。 PDF p.1153
